Genesis: Bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz
Beqadmin bera Adonai yat shemayya veyat ara:
Vehaaretz hayeta tohu vabohu vechoshek al-pene tehom veruach elohim merachepet al-pene hammayim
Veara havat tzadeya vereqanya vachashoka paras al appe tehoma verucha min qodam Adonai menashsheba al appe mayya:
Vayyomer elohim yehi or vayehi-or
Vaamar Adonai yehe nehora vahava nehora:
Vayyar elohim et-haor ki-tob vayyabdel elohim ben haor uben hachoshek
Vachaza Adonai yat nehora are tab veapresh Adonai ben nehora uben chashoka:
Vayyiqra elohim laor yom velachoshek qara layela vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom echad
Uqera Adonai linhora yemama velachashoka qera leleya vahava remash vahava tzepar yoma chad:
Vayyomer elohim yehi raqia betok hammayim vihi mabdil ben mayim lamayim
Vaamar Adonai yehi reqia bimtziut mayya vihi maprish ben mayya lemayya:
Vayyaas elohim et-haraqia vayyabdel ben hammayim asher mittachat laraqia uben hammayim asher meal laraqia vayehi-ken
Vaabad Adonai yat reqia veapresh ben mayya di milra lirqia uben mayya di meal lirqia vahava ken:
Vayyiqra elohim laraqia shamayim vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom sheni
Uqera Adonai lirqia shemayya vahava remash vahava tzepar yom tinyan:
Vayyomer elohim yiqqavu hammayim mittachat hashshamayim el-maqom echad veteraeh hayyabbasha vayehi-ken
Vaamar Adonai yitkanshun mayya mittechot shemayya laatar chad vetitchaze yabbeshta vahava ken:
Vayyiqra elohim layyabbasha eretz ulemiqveh hammayim qara yammim vayyar elohim ki-tob
Uqera Adonai leyabbeshta ara ulebet kenishut mayya qera yamme vachaza Adonai are tab:
Vayyomer elohim tadeshe haaretz deshe eseb mazria zera etz peri oseh peri lemino asher zaro-bo al-haaretz vayehi-ken
Vaamar Adonai tadet ara ditea isba debar zareh mizdera ilan perin abad perin lizneh di bar zareh beh al ara vahava ken:
Vattotze haaretz deshe eseb mazria zera leminehu veetz oseh-peri asher zaro-bo leminehu vayyar elohim ki-tob
Veappeqat ara ditea isba debar zareh mizdera liznohi veilan abed perin debar zareh beh liznohi vachaza Adonai are tab:
Vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom shelishi
Vahava remash vahava tzepar yom telitai:
Vayyomer elohim yehi meorot birqia hashshamayim lehabdil ben hayyom uben hallayela vehayu leotot ulemoadim uleyamim veshanim
Vaamar Adonai yehon nehorin birqia dishmayya leaprasha ben yemama uben leleya vihon leatin ulezimnin ulemimene behon yomin ushenin:
Vehayu limorot birqia hashshamayim lehair al-haaretz vayehi-ken
Vihon linhorin birqia dishmayya leanhara al ara vahava ken:
Vayyaas elohim et-shene hammeorot haggedolim et-hammaor haggadol lememshelet hayyom veet-hammaor haqqaton lememshelet hallayla veet hakkokabim
Vaabad Adonai yat teren nehorayya rabrebayya yat nehora rabba lemishlat bimama veyat nehora zeera lemishlat beleleya veyat kokebayya:
Vayyitten otam elohim birqia hashshamayim lehair al-haaretz
Vihab yatehon Adonai birqia dishmayya leanhara al ara:
Velimshol bayyom uballayla ulehabdil ben haor uben hachoshek vayyar elohim ki-tob
Ulemishlat bimama ubeleleya uleaprasha ben nehora uben chashoka vachaza Adonai are tab:
Vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom rebii
Vahava remash vahava tzepar yom rebiai:
Vayyomer elohim yishretzu hammayim sheretz nepesh chayya veop yeopep al-haaretz al-pene reqia hashshamayim
Vaamar Adonai yirchashun mayya rechesh napsha chayta veopa yeparach al ara al appe reqia dishmayya:
Vayyibra elohim et-hattanninim haggedolim veet kol-nepesh hachayya haromeset asher sharetzu hammayim leminehem veet kol-op kanap leminehu vayyar elohim ki-tob
Ubera Adonai yat tanninayya rabrebayya veyat kol napsha chayta dirchisha di archishu mayya liznehon veyat kol opa deparach liznohi vachaza Adonai are tab:
Vayebarek otam elohim lemor peru urebu umilu et-hammayim bayyammim vehaop yireb baaretz
Ubarik yatehon Adonai lememar pushu usegu umelu yat mayya beyammayya veopa yisge beara:
Vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom chamishi
Vahava remash vahava tzepar yom chamishai:
Vayyomer elohim totze haaretz nepesh chayya leminah behema varemes vechayeto-eretz leminah vayehi-ken
Vaamar Adonai tappeq ara napsha chayta liznah beir urechesh vechevat ara liznah vahava ken:
Vayyaas elohim et-chayyat haaretz leminah veet-habbehema leminah veet kol-remes haadama leminehu vayyar elohim ki-tob
Vaabad Adonai yat chevat ara liznah veyat beira liznah veyat kol richasha deara liznohi vachaza Adonai are tab:
Vayyomer elohim naaseh adam betzalmenu kidmutenu veyirdu bidgat hayyam ubeop hashshamayim ubabbehema ubekol-haaretz ubekol-haremes haromes al-haaretz
Vaamar Adonai naabid enasha betzalmena kidmutana veyishletun benune yamma ubeopa dishmayya ubibira ubekol ara ubekol richasha derachesh al ara:
Vayyibra elohim et-haadam betzalmo betzelem elohim bara oto zakar uneqeba bara otam
Ubera Adonai yat adam betzalmeh betzalma daAdonai bera yateh dekar venuqeba bera yatehon:
Vayebarek otam elohim vayyomer lahem elohim peru urebu umilu et-haaretz vekibshuha uredu bidgat hayyam ubeop hashshamayim ubekol-chayya haromeset al-haaretz
Ubarik yatehon Adonai vaamar lehon Adonai pushu usegu umelu yat ara utequpu alah ushelutu benune yamma ubeopa dishmayya ubekol chayta derachesha al ara:
Vayyomer elohim hinneh natatti lakem et-kol-eseb zorea zera asher al-pene kol-haaretz veet-kol-haetz asher-bo peri-etz zorea zara lakem yiheyeh leokla
Vaamar Adonai ha yehabit lekon yat kol isba debar zareh mizdera di al appe kol ara veyat kol ilana di beh pere ilana debar zareh mizdera lekon yehe lemekal:
Ulekol-chayyat haaretz ulekol-op hashshamayim ulekol romes al-haaretz asher-bo nepesh chayya et-kol-yereq eseb leokla vayehi-ken
Ulekal chevat ara ulekal opa dishmayya ulekol derachesh al ara di beh napsha chayta yat kol yeroq isba lemekal vahava ken:
Vayyar elohim et-kol-asher asa vehinneh-tob meod vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom hashshishshi
Vachaza Adonai yat kol di abad veha taqqin lachada vahava remash vahava tzepar yom shetitai:
Vayekullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vekol-tzebaam
Veishtaklalu shemayya veara vekol chelehon:
Vayekal elohim bayyom hashshebii melakto asher asa vayyishbot bayyom hashshebii mikkol-melakto asher asa
Veshetze Adonai beyoma shebiaa abidteh di abad venach beyoma shebiaa mikkol abidteh di abad:
Vayebarek elohim et-yom hashshebii vayeqaddesh oto ki bo shabat mikkol-melakto asher-bara elohim laasot
Ubarik Adonai yat yoma shebiaa veqaddish yateh are beh nach mikkol abidteh di bera Adonai lemebad:
Elleh toledot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaream beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim
Illen tuledat shemayya veara kad itberiu beyoma di abad Adonai elohim ara ushemayya:
Vekol siach hassadeh terem yiheyeh baaretz vekol-eseb hassadeh terem yitzmach ki lo himtir Adonai elohim al-haaretz veadam ayin laabod et-haadama
Vekol ilane chaqla ad la havu beara vekol isba dechaqla ad la tzemach are la achit mitra Adonai elohim al ara veenash let lemiplach yat admeta:
Veed yaaleh min-haaretz vehishqa et-kol-pene haadama
Vaanana hava saleq min ara veashqe yat kol appe admeta:
Vayyitzer Adonai elohim et-haadam apar min-haadama vayyippach beappayv nishmat chayyim vayehi haadam lenepesh chayya
Ubera Adonai elohim yat adam apra min admeta unepach beappohi nishmeta dechayye vahavat beadam leruach memalla:
Vayyitta Adonai elohim gan-beeden miqqedem vayyasem sham et-haadam asher yatzar
Unetzib Adonai elohim gineta beeden milleqadmin veashve tamman yat adam di bera:
Vayyatzmach Adonai elohim min-haadama kol-etz nechmad lemareh vetob lemaakal veetz hachayyim betok haggan veetz haddaat tob vara
Veatzmach Adonai elohim min ara kol ilan dimraggeg lemecheze vetab lemekal veilan chayya bimtziut gineta veilan deoklin perohi chakkimin ben tab lebish:
Venahar yotze meeden lehashqot et-haggan umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim
Venahara hava napiq meeden leashqaa yat gineta umittamman yitparish vahave learbea reshe naharin:
Shem haechad pishon hu hassobeb et kol-eretz hachavila asher-sham hazzahab
Shum chad pishon hu maqqip yat kol ara dachavila di tamman dahaba:
Uzehab haaretz hahiv tob sham habbedolach veeben hashshoham
Vedahaba deara hahi tab taman bedalecha veabne burela:
Veshem-hannahar hashsheni gichon hu hassobeb et kol-eretz kush
Veshum nahara tinyana gichon hu maqqip yat kol ara dekush:
Veshem hannahar hashshelishi chiddeqel hu haholek qidmat ashshur vehannahar harebii hu perat
Veshum nahara telitaa digelat hu mehallek lemaddinecha deattur venahara rebiaa hu perat:
Vayyiqqach Adonai elohim et-haadam vayyannichehu began-eden leobdah uleshomrah
Udebar Adonai elohim yat adam veashreh begineta deeden lemiplechah ulemitrah:
Vayetzav Adonai elohim al-haadam lemor mikkol etz-haggan akol tokel
Upaqqid Adonai elohim al adam lememar mikkol ilan gineta mekal tekul:
Umeetz haddaat tob vara lo tokal mimmennu ki beyom akolka mimmennu mot tamut
Umeilan deoklin perohi chakkimin ben tab lebish la tekul minneh are beyoma detekul minneh memat temut:
Vayyomer Adonai elohim lo-tob heyot haadam lebaddo eeseh-lo ezer kenegdo
Vaamar Adonai elohim la taqqin lemeheve adam bilchodohi aabed leh semak leqibleh:
Vayyitzer Adonai elohim min-haadama kol-chayyat hassadeh veet kol-op hashshamayim vayyabe el-haadam lirot mah-yiqra-lo vekol asher yiqra-lo haadam nepesh chayya hu shemo
Ubera Adonai elohim min ara kol chevat bera veyat kol opa dishmayya veayteh levat adam lemecheze mah yiqre leh vekol di hava qare leh adam napsha chayta hu shemeh:
Vayyiqra haadam shemot lekol-habbehema uleop hashshamayim ulekol chayyat hassadeh uleadam lo-matza ezer kenegdo
Uqera adam shemahan lekol beira uleopa dishmayya ulekal chevat bera uleadam la ashkach samek leqibleh:
Vayyappel Adonai elohim tardema al-haadam vayyishan vayyiqqach achat mitztzalotayv vayyisgor basar tachtenna
Urema Adonai elohim shineta al adam udemek unesib chada meilohi umele bisra techotah:
Vayyiben Adonai elohim et-hatztzela asher-laqach min-haadam leishsha vayebieha el-haadam
Ubena Adonai elohim yat ila dinsib min adam leitteta veaytah levat adam:
Vayyomer haadam zot happaam etzem meatzamay ubasar mibbesari lezot yiqqare ishsha ki meish luqecha-zot
Vaamar haadam hada zimna garma miggarmay ubisra mibbisri leda yitqere itteta are mibbala nesiba da:
Al-ken yaazob-ish et-abiv veet-immo vedabaq beishto vehayu lebasar echad
Al ken yishboq gebar bet mishkebe abuhi veimmeh veyidbaq beitteteh vihon lebisra chad:
Vayyiheyu shenehem arummim haadam veishto velo yitboshashu
Vahavo tarvehon artilain adam veitteteh vela mitkalmin:
Vehannachash haya arum mikkol chayyat hassadeh asher asa Adonai elohim vayyomer el-haishsha ap ki-amar elohim lo tokelu mikkol etz haggan
Vechivya hava chakkim mikkol chevat bera di abad Adonai elohim vaamar leitteta bequsheta are amar Adonai la tekelun mikkol ilan gineta:
Vattomer haishsha el-hannachash mipperi etz-haggan nokel
Vaamarat itteta lechivya mippere ilan gineta nekul:
Umipperi haetz asher betok-haggan amar elohim lo tokelu mimmennu velo tiggeu bo pen-temutun
Umippere ilana di bimtziut gineta amar Adonai la tekelun minneh vela teqarbun beh dilema temutun:
Vayyomer hannachash el-haishsha lo-mot temutun
Vaamar chivya leitteta la mut temutun:
Ki yodea elohim ki beyom akolkem mimmennu venipqechu enekem vihyitem kelohim yodee tob vara
Are galle qodam Adonai are beyoma detekelun minneh veyitpattechan enekon utehon kerabrebin chakkimin ben tab lebish:
Vattere haishsha ki tob haetz lemaakal veki taava-hv laenayim venechmad haetz lehaskil vattiqqach mippiryo vattokal vattitten gam-leishah immah vayyokal
Vachazat itteta are tab ilan lemekal vaare asse hu leaynin umeraggeg ilana leistakkala beh unesebat meibbeh vaakalat vihabat ap lebalah immah vaakal:
Vattippaqachna ene shenehem vayyedeu ki erummim hem vayyitperu aleh teena vayyaasu lahem chagorot
Veitpattacha ene tarvehon vidau are artilain inun vechattitu lehon tarpe teenin vaabadu lehon zerazin:
Vayyishmeu et-qol Adonai elohim mithallek baggan leruach hayyom vayyitchabbe haadam veishto mippene Adonai elohim betok etz haggan
Ushemau yat qal memera daAdonai elohim mehallek begineta limnach yoma veitammar adam veitteteh min qodam Adonai elohim bego ilan gineta:
Vayyiqra Adonai elohim el-haadam vayyomer lo ayyekka
Uqera Adonai elohim leadam vaamar leh an at:
Vayyomer et-qoleka shamati baggan vaira ki-erom anoki vaechabe
Vaamar yat qal memerak shamit begineta udechelit are artilay ana veitammarit:
Vayyomer mi higgid leka ki erom atta hamin-haetz asher tzivvitika lebilti akol-mimmennu akaleta
Vaamar man chave lak are artilay at hamin ilana dipaqqedtak bedil dela lemekal minneh akalt:
Vayyomer haadam haishsha asher natatta immadi hiv natena-li min-haetz vaokel
Vaamar haadam itteta dihabta immi hi yahabat li min ilana vaakalit:
Vayyomer Adonai elohim laishsha mah-zot asit vattomer haishsha hannachash hishshiani vaokel
Vaamar Adonai elohim leitteta mah da abdat vaamarat itteta chivya atayani vaakalit:
Vayyomer Adonai elohim el-hannachash ki asita zot arur atta mikkol-habbehema umikkol chayyat hassadeh al-gechoneka telek veapar tokal kol-yeme chayyeka
Vaamar Adonai elohim lechivya are abadta da lit at mikkol beira umikkol chevat bara al meak tezil veapra tekul kol yome chayyayk:
Veeba ashit beneka uben haishsha uben zaraka uben zarah hu yeshupeka rosh veatta teshupennu aqeb
Udebabu eshavve benak uben itteta uben benak uben benahah hu yehe dekir lak mah diabadta leh milleqadmin veat tehe natir leh lesopa:
El-haishsha amar harba arbeh itztzebonek veheronek beetzeb teledi banim veel-ishek teshuqatek vehu yimshol-bak
Leitteta amar asgaa asge tzaarayki veidduyayki betzear teledi benin ulevat balik tehe tiubetik vehu yishlat bik:
Uleadam amar ki-shamata leqol ishteka vattokal min-haetz asher tzivvitika lemor lo tokal mimmennu arura haadama baabureka beitztzabon tokelenna kol yeme chayyeka
Uleadam amar are qabbeleta lememar ittetak vaakalta min ilana di paqqedetak lememar la tekul minneh lita ara bedilak baamal tikelinah kol yome chayyayk:
Veqotz vedardar tatzmiach lak veakalta et-eseb hassadeh
Vekubin veatdin tatzmach lak vetekul yat isba dechaqla:
Bezeat appeka tokal lechem ad shubeka el-haadama ki mimmenna luqqacheta ki-apar atta veel-apar tashub
Beziata deappak tekul lachma ad detitub leara deminnah itbereta are apra at uleapra tetub:
Vayyiqra haadam shem ishto chavva ki hiv hayeta em kol-chay
Uqera adam shum itteteh chavva are hi havat imma dekal bene enasha:
Vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto kotnot or vayyalbishem
Vaabad Adonai elohim leadam uleitteteh lebushin diqar al meshak bisrehon vealbishinun:
Vayyomer Adonai elohim hen haadam haya keachad mimmennu ladaat tob vara veatta pen-yishlach yado velaqach gam meetz hachayyim veakal vachay leolam
Vaamar Adonai elohim ha adam hava yechiday bealma minneh lemida tab ubish ukean dilema yoshit yedeh veyissab ap meilan chayyay veyekul viche lealam:
Vayeshallechehu Adonai elohim miggan-eden laabod et-haadama asher luqqach mishsham
Veshallecheh Adonai elohim miggineta deeden lemiplach yat admeta deitberi mittamman:
Vayegaresh et-haadam vayyashken miqqedem legan-eden et-hakkerubim veet lahat hachereb hammithappeket lishmor et-derek etz hachayyim
Vetarik yat adam veashre milleqadmin legineta deeden yat kerubayya veyat shenan charba demithappeka lemitar yat orach ilan chayyay:
Vehaadam yada et-chavva ishto vattahar vatteled et-qayin vattomer qaniti ish et-Adonai
Veadam yeda yat chavva itteteh veaddiat vilidat yat qayin vaameret qaniti gabra min qodam Adonai:
Vattosep laledet et-achiv et-habel vayehi-hebel roeh tzon veqayin haya obed adama
Veosipat lemelad yat achohi yat habel vahava hebel rae ana veqayin hava palach beara:
Vayehi miqqetz yamim vayyabe qayin mipperi haadama mincha la-Adonai
Vahava missop yomin veayti qayin meibba deara tiqrubeta qodam Adonai:
Vehebel hebi gam-hv mibbekorot tzono umechelbehen vayyisha Adonai el-hebel veel-minchato
Vehebel ayti ap hu mibbakkire aneh umishamminhon vahavat raava min qodam Adonai behebel ubequrebaneh:
Veel-qayin veel-minchato lo shaa vayyichar leqayin meod vayyippelu panayv
Ubeqayin ubequrebaneh la havat raava uteqep leqayin lachada veitkebishu appohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-qayin lamma chara lak velamma napelu paneka
Vaamar Adonai leqayin lema teqip lak ulema itkebishu appayk:
Halo im-tetib seet veim lo tetib lappetach chattat robetz veeleka teshuqato veatta timshol-bo
Hala im totib obadak yishtebeq lak veim la totib obadak leyom dina chetak netir diatid leitparea minnak im la tetub veim tetub yishtebeq lak:
Vayyomer qayin el-hebel achiv vayehi bihyotam bassadeh vayyaqom qayin el-hebel achiv vayyahargehu
Vaamar qayin lehebel achohi vahava bemehevehon bechaqla veqam qayin al hebel achohi veqatleh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-qayin e hebel achika vayyomer lo yadati hashomer achi anoki
Vaamar Adonai leqayin an hebel achuk vaamar la yadaana hanater achi ana:
Vayyomer meh asita qol deme achika tzoaqim elay min-haadama
Vaamar meh abadta qal dam zarin diatidin lemepaq min achuk qablin qodamay min ara:
Veatta arur atta min-haadama asher patzeta et-piha laqachat et-deme achika miyyadeka
Ukean lit at min ara diptachat yat pumah veqabbilat yat demeh deachuk min yedak:
Ki taabod et-haadama lo-tosep tet-kochah lak na vanad tiheyeh baaretz
Are tiplach beara la tosip lemittan chelah lak mitaltel vegale tehe beara:
Vayyomer qayin el-Adonai gadol avoni minneso
Vaamar qayin qodam Adonai saggi chobi millemishbaq:
Hen gerashta oti hayyom meal pene haadama umippaneka essater vehayiti na vanad baaretz vehaya kol-motzei yahargeni
Ha tariketa yati yoma den meal appe ara umin qodamak let epshar leittammara vaehi metaltel vegale beara vihe kol deyishkechinani yiqtelinani:
Vayyomer lo Adonai laken kol-horeg qayin shibatayim yuqqam vayyasem Adonai leqayin ot lebilti hakkot-oto kol-motzeo
Vaamar leh Adonai beken kol qatil qayin leshaba darin yitpera minneh veshavvi Adonai leqayin ata bedil dela lemiqtal yateh kol diyishkechuneh:
Vayyetze qayin millipne Adonai vayyesheb beeretz-nod qidmat-eden
Unepaq qayin min qodam Adonai viteb beara gale umittaltal dahava abida alohi milleqadmin degineta deeden:
Vayyeda qayin et-ishto vattahar vatteled et-chanok vayehi boneh ir vayyiqra shem hair keshem beno chanok
Vida qayin yat itteteh veaddiat viledat yat chanok vahava bane qarta uqera shema deqarta keshum bereh chanok:
Vayyivvaled lachanok et-irad veirad yalad et-mechuyael umechiyyayel yalad et-metushael umetushael yalad et-lamek
Veityelid lachanok yat irad veirad olid yat mechuyael umechiyyayel olid yat metushael umetushael olid yat lamek:
Vayyiqqach-lo lemek shete nashim shem haachat ada veshem hashshenit tzilla
Unesib leh lemek tarten neshin shum chada ada veshum tinyeta tzilla:
Vatteled ada et-yabal hu haya abi yosheb ohel umiqneh
Viledat ada yat yabal hu hava rabbehon deyatebe mashkenin umare beir:
Veshem achiv yubal hu haya abi kol-topes kinnor veugab
Veshum achohi yubal hu hava rabbehon dekal dimnaggen al pum nibla yadee zemar kinnora veabbuba:
Vetzilla gam-hiv yaleda et-tubal qayin lotesh kol-choresh nechoshet ubarzel vaachot tubal-qayin naama
Vetzilla ap hi yeledat yat tubal qayin rabbehon dekal deyadee ibidat nechasha uparzela vaachateh detubal qayin naama:
Vayyomer lemek lenashayv ada vetzilla shemaan qoli neshe lemek hazenna imrati ki ish haragti lepitzi veyeled lechabburati
Vaamar lemek linshohi ada vetzilla shiman qali neshe lemek atzeta lememeri la gabra qetalit dibdileh ana sabil chobin veap la ulema chabbalit dibdileh yishtetze zari:
Ki shibatayim yuqqam-qayin velemek shibim veshiba
Are shaba darin iteliu leqayin hala lelemek bereh shabin veshaba:
Vayyeda adam od et-ishto vatteled ben vattiqra et-shemo shet ki shat-li elohim zera acher tachat hebel ki harago qayin
Vida adam od yat itteteh viledat bar uqerat yat shemeh shet are amarat yehab li Adonai bar ocharan chalap hebel diqatleh qayin:
Uleshet gam-hv yullad-ben vayyiqra et-shemo enosh az huchal liqro beshem Adonai
Uleshet ap hu ityelid bar uqera yat shemeh enosh beken beyomohi chalu bene enasha milletzallaa bishma daAdonai:
Zeh seper toledot adam beyom bero elohim adam bidmut elohim asa oto
Den separ tuledat adam beyoma dibra Adonai adam bidmut elohim abad yateh:
Zakar uneqeba beraam vayebarek otam vayyiqra et-shemam adam beyom hibbaream
Dekar venuqeba beranun ubarik yatehon uqera yat shemahon adam beyoma deitberiu:
Vayechi adam sheloshim umeat shana vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo vayyiqra et-shemo shet
Vachaya adam mea utelatin shenin veolid bidmuteh dedame leh uqera yat shemeh shet:
Vayyiheyu yeme-adam achare holido et-shet shemoneh meot shana vayyoled banim ubanot
Vahavo yome adam batar deolid yat shet tamne mea shenin veolid benin ubenan:
Vayyiheyu kol-yeme adam asher-chay tesha meot shana usheloshim shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome adam dachaya tesha mea utelatin shenin umit:
Vayechi-shet chamesh shanim umeat shana vayyoled et-enosh
Vachaya shet mea vachamesh shenin veolid yat enosh:
Vayechi-shet achare holido et-enosh sheba shanim ushemoneh meot shana vayyoled banim ubanot
Vachaya shet batar deolid yat enosh tamne mea usheba shenin veolid benin ubenan:
Vayyiheyu kol-yeme-shet shetem esreh shana utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome shet tesha mea vetarte asre shenin umit:
Vayechi enosh tishim shana vayyoled et-qenan
Vachaya enosh tishin shenin veolid yat qenan:
Vayechi enosh achare holido et-qenan chamesh esreh shana ushemoneh meot shana vayyoled banim ubanot
Vachaya enosh batar deolid yat qenan tamne mea vachamesh asre shenin veolid benin ubenan:
Vayyiheyu kol-yeme enosh chamesh shanim utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome enosh tesha mea vachamesh shenin umit:
Vayechi qenan shibim shana vayyoled et-mahalalel
Vachaya qenan shabin shenin veolid yat mahalalel:
Vayechi qenan achare holido et-mahalalel arbaim shana ushemoneh meot shana vayyoled banim ubanot
Vachaya qenan batar deolid yat mahalalel tamne mea vearbein shenin veolid benin ubenan:
Vayyiheyu kol-yeme qenan eser shanim utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome qenan tesha mea vaasar shenin umit:
Vayechi mahalalel chamesh shanim veshishshim shana vayyoled et-yared
Vachaya mahalalel shittin vachamesh shenin veolid yat yared:
Vayechi mahalalel achare holido et-yered sheloshim shana ushemoneh meot shana vayyoled banim ubanot
Vachaya mahalalel batar deolid yat yered tamne mea utelatin shenin veolid benin ubenan:
Vayyihyu kol-yeme mahalalel chamesh vetishim shana ushemoneh meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome mahalalel tamne mea vetishin vachamesh shenin umit:
Vayechi-yered shetayim veshishshim shana umeat shana vayyoled et-chanok
Vachaya yered mea veshittin vetarten shenin veolid yat chanok:
Vayechi-yered achare holido et-chanok shemoneh meot shana vayyoled banim ubanot
Vachaya yered batar deolid yat chanok tamne mea shenin veolid benin ubenan:
Vayyiheyu kol-yeme-yered shetayim veshishshim shana utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome yered tesha mea veshittin vetarten shenin umit:
Vayechi chanok chamesh veshishshim shana vayyoled et-metushalach
Vachaya chanok shittin vachamesh shenin veolid yat metushalach:
Vayyithallek chanok et-haelohim achare holido et-metushelach shelosh meot shana vayyoled banim ubanot
Vehallik chanok bedachalta daAdonai batar deolid yat metushelach telat mea shenin veolid benin ubenan:
Vayehi kol-yeme chanok chamesh veshishshim shana ushelosh meot shana
Vahava kol yome chanok telat mea veshittin vachamesh shenin:
Vayyithallek chanok et-haelohim veenennu ki-laqach oto elohim
Vehallik chanok bedachalta daAdonai velaytohi are la amet yateh Adonai:
Vayechi metushelach sheba ushemonim shana umeat shana vayyoled et-lamek
Vachaya metushelach mea vetamnin usheba shenin veolid yat lamek:
Vayechi metushelach achare holido et-lemek shetayim ushemonim shana usheba meot shana vayyoled banim ubanot
Vachaya metushelach batar deolid yat lemek sheba mea vetamnin vetarten shenin veolid benin ubenan:
Vayyihyu kol-yeme metushelach tesha veshishshim shana utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome metushelach tesha mea veshittin utesha shenin umit:
Vayechi-lemek shetayim ushemonim shana umeat shana vayyoled ben
Vachaya lemek mea vetamnin vetarten shenin veolid bar:
Vayyiqra et-shemo noach lemor zeh yenachamenu mimmaasenu umeitztzebon yadenu min-haadama asher ererah Adonai
Uqera yat shemeh noach lememar den yenachaminnana meobadana umilleut yedana min ara di lattah Adonai:
Vayechi-lemek achare holido et-noach chamesh vetishim shana vachamesh meot shana vayyoled banim ubanot
Vachaya lemek batar deolid yat noach chamesh mea vetishin vachamesh shenin veolid benin ubenan:
Vayehi kol-yeme-lemek sheba veshibim shana usheba meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome lemek sheba mea veshabin usheba shenin umit:
Vayehi-noach ben-chamesh meot shana vayyoled noach et-shem et-cham veet-yapet
Vahava noach bar chamesh mea shenin veolid noach yat shem yat cham veyat yapet:
Vayehi ki-hechel haadam larob al-pene haadama ubanot yulledu lahem
Vahava kad sheriu bene enasha lemisge al appe ara ubenata ityelidu lehon:
Vayyiru bene-haelohim et-benot haadam ki tobot henna vayyiqchu lahem nashim mikkol asher bacharu
Vachazo bene rabrebayya yat benat enasha are shappiran inun unesibu lehon neshin mikkol di itreiu:
Vayyomer Adonai lo-yadon ruchi baadam leolam beshaggam hu basar vehayu yamayv mea veesrim shana
Vaamar Adonai la yitqayam dara bisha haden qodamay lealam bedil deinun bisra veobadehon bishaya arka yehibat lehon mea veasrin shenin im yetubun:
Hannepilim hayu baaretz bayyamim hahem vegam achare-ken asher yabou bene haelohim el-benot haadam veyaledu lahem hemma haggibborim asher meolam anshe hashshem
Gibbarayya havo beara beyomayya hainnun veap batar ken di yaalun bene rabrebayya levat benat enasha vilidan lehon inun gibbarayya dimealema enashin dishma:
Vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam baaretz vekol-yetzer machshebot libbo raq ra kol-hayyom
Vachaza Adonai are segiat bishat enasha beara vekol yitzra machshebat libbeh lechod bish kol yoma:
Vayyinnachem Adonai ki-asa et-haadam baaretz vayyitatztzeb el-libbo
Vetab Adonai bememereh are abad yat enasha beara vaamar bememereh lemittebar taqepehon kiruteh:
Vayyomer Adonai emcheh et-haadam asher-barati meal pene haadama meadam ad-behema ad-remes vead-op hashshamayim ki nichamti ki asitim
Vaamar Adonai emche yat anasha di bereti meal appe ara meenasha ad beira ad richasha vead opa dishmayya are tabit bememeri are abadtinun:
Venoach matza chen beene Adonai
Venoach ashkach rachamin qodam Adonai:
Elleh toledot noach noach ish tzaddiq tamim haya bedorotayv et-haelohim hitehallek-noach
Illen tuledat noach noach gebar zakkay shelim hava bedarohi bedachalta daAdonai hallik noach:
Vayyoled noach shelosha banim et-shem et-cham veet-yapet
Veolid noach telata benin yat shem yat cham veyat yapet:
Vattishshachet haaretz lipne haelohim vattimmale haaretz chamas
Veitchabbalat ara qodam Adonai veitmeliat ara chatopin:
Vayyar elohim et-haaretz vehinneh nishchata ki-hishchit kol-basar et-darko al-haaretz
Vachaza Adonai yat ara veha itchabbalat are chabbilu kol bisra enash yat orcheh al ara:
Vayyomer elohim lenoach qetz kol-basar ba lepanay ki-malea haaretz chamas mippenehem vehinni mashchitam et-haaretz
Vaamar Adonai lenoach qitztza dekal bisra allat liqodamay are itmeliat ara chatopin min qodam obadehon bishayya veha ana mechabbelhon im ara:
Aseh leka tebat atze-goper qinnim taaseh et-hatteba vekaparta otah mibbayit umichutz bakkoper
Ibed lak tebota deain deqadrom medorin tabed yat tebota vetechpe yatah miggav umibbara bekapera:
Vezeh asher taaseh otah shelosh meot amma orek hatteba chamishshim amma rochbah usheloshim amma qomatah
Veden ditaabbed yatah telat mea ammin ureka detebota chamshin ammin petayah utelatin ammin rumah:
Tzohar taaseh latteba veel-amma tekallenna milmala upetach hatteba betziddah tasim tachtiyyim sheniyyim ushelishim taaseha
Nehor tabed letebota uleamta teshaklelinnah milleella vetara detebota besitrah teshavvi medorin arain tinyanin utelitain tabedinnah:
Vaani hinni mebi et-hammabbul mayim al-haaretz leshachet kol-basar asher-bo ruach chayyim mittachat hashshamayim kol asher-baaretz yigva
Vaana ha ana mayte yat topana mayya al ara lechabbala kol bisra di beh rucha dechayye mittechot shemayya kol di beara yemut:
Vahaqimoti et-beriti ittak ubata el-hatteba atta ubaneka veishteka uneshe-baneka ittak
Veaqem yat qeyami immak veteol letebota at ubenak veittetak uneshe benak immak:
Umikkol-hachay mikkol-basar shenayim mikkol tabi el-hatteba lehachayot ittak zakar uneqeba yiheyu
Umikkal dechay mikkol bisra teren mikkola tael letebota leqayyama immak dekar venaqeba yehon:
Mehaop leminehu umin-habbehema leminah mikkol remes haadama leminehu shenayim mikkol yabou eleka lehachayot
Meopa liznohi umin beira liznah umikkol richasha deara liznohi teren mikkolla yaalun levatak leqayyama:
Veatta qach-leka mikkol-maakal asher yeakel veasapta eleka vehaya leka velahem leokla
Veat sab lak mikkol mekal dimitakel vetiknosh levatak vihe lak ulehon lemekal:
Vayyaas noach kekol asher tzivva oto elohim ken asa
Vaabad noch kekol di paqqed yateh Adonai ken abad:
Vayyomer Adonai lenoach bo-atta vekol-beteka el-hatteba ki-oteka raiti tzaddiq lepanay baddor hazzeh
Vaamar Adonai lenoach ul at vekol enash betak letebota are yatak chazeti zakkay qodamay bedara haden:
Mikkol habbehema hattehora tiqqach-leka shiba shiba ish veishto umin-habbehema asher lo tehora hiv shenayim ish veishto
Mikkol beira dakya tissab lak shaba shaba dekar venaqeba umin beira dila itaha dakya hi teren dekar venaqeba:
Gam meop hashshamayim shiba shiba zakar uneqeba lechayyot zera al-pene kol-haaretz
Ap meopa dishmayya shaba shaba dekar venaqeba leqayyama zara al appe kol ara:
Ki leyamim od shiba anoki mamtir al-haaretz arbaim yom vearbaim layela umachiti et-kol-hayequm asher asiti meal pene haadama
Are lizman yomin od shaba ana machet mitra al ara arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan veemche yat kol yequma di abdat meal appe ara:
Vayyaas noach kekol asher-tzivvahu Adonai
Vaabad noach kekol di paqqedeh Adonai:
Venoach ben-shesh meot shana vehammabbul haya mayim al-haaretz
Venoach bar shit mea shenin vetopana hava mayya al ara:
Vayyabo noach ubanayv veishto uneshe-banayv itto el-hatteba mippene me hammabbul
Veal noach ubenohi veitteteh uneshe benohi immeh letebota min qodam me topana:
Min-habbehema hattehora umin-habbehema asher enenna tehora umin-haop vekol asher-romes al-haadama
Min beira dakya umin beira di letaha dakya umin opa vekol di rachesh al ara:
Shenayim shenayim bau el-noach el-hatteba zakar uneqeba kaasher tzivva elohim et-noach
Teren teren allu levat noach letebota dekar venaqeba kema di paqqed Adonai yat noach:
Vayehi leshibat hayyamim ume hammabbul hayu al-haaretz
Vahava lizman shibat yomin ume topana havo al ara:
Bishnat shesh-meot shana lechayye-noach bachodesh hashsheni beshiba-asar yom lachodesh bayyom hazzeh nibqeu kol-mayenot tehom rabba vaarubbot hashshamayim niptachu
Bishnat shit mea shenin lechayye noach beyarcha tinyana beshibat asra yoma leyarcha beyoma haden itbezau kol mabbue tehoma rabba vekavve shemayya itpattachu:
Vayehi haggeshem al-haaretz arbaim yom vearbaim layela
Vahava mitra nachat al ara arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan:
Beetzem hayyom hazzeh ba noach veshem-vecham vayepet bene-noach veeshet noach usheloshet neshe-banayv ittam el-hatteba
Bikran yoma haden al noach veshem vecham vayepet bene noach veittat noach utelata neshe benohi immehon letebota:
Hemma vekol-hachayya leminah vekol-habbehema leminah vekol-haremes haromes al-haaretz leminehu vekol-haop leminehu kol tzippor kol-kanap
Innun vekol chayta liznah vekol beira liznah vekol richasha derachesh al ara liznohi vekol opa liznohi kol tzippar kol deparach:
Vayyabou el-noach el-hatteba shenayim shenayim mikkol-habbasar asher-bo ruach chayyim
Veallu im noach letebota teren teren mikkol bisra di beh rucha dechaye:
Vehabbaim zakar uneqeba mikkol-basar bau kaasher tzivva oto elohim vayyisgor Adonai baado
Vealayya dekar venaqeba mikkol bisra allu kema di paqqed yateh Adonai vaagen Adonai bememereh alohi:
Vayehi hammabbul arbaim yom al-haaretz vayyirbu hammayim vayyisu et-hatteba vattarom meal haaretz
Vahava topana arbein yomin al ara usegiu mayya unetalu yat tebota veittaramat meal ara:
Vayyigberu hammayim vayyirbu meod al-haaretz vattelek hatteba al-pene hammayim
Uteqipu mayya usegiu lachada al ara umehalleka tebota al appe mayya:
Vehammayim gaberu meod meod al-haaretz vayekussu kol-heharim haggebohim asher-tachat kol-hashshamayim
Umayya teqipu lachada lachada al ara veitchapiu kol turayya ramayya di techot kol shemayya:
Chamesh esreh amma milmala gaberu hammayim vayekussu heharim
Chamesh asreh ammin milella teqipu mayya veitchapiu turaya:
Vayyigva kol-basar haromes al-haaretz baop ubabbehema ubachayya ubekol-hashsheretz hashshoretz al-haaretz vekol haadam
Umit kol bisra derachesh al ara beopa ubibira ubechayta ubekol richasha derachesh al ara vekol enasha:
Kol asher nishmat-rvach chayyim beappayv mikkol asher becharaba metu
Kol di nishmeta rucha dechayyin beanpohi mikkol di beyabbeshta mitu:
Vayyimach et-kol-hayequm asher al-pene haadama meadam ad-behema ad-remes vead-op hashshamayim vayyimmachu min-haaretz vayyishshaer ak-noach vaasher itto batteba
Umecha yat kol yequma di al appe ara meenasha ad beira ad richasha vead opa dishmayya veitmechiu min ara veishtaar beram noach vedi immeh betebota:
Vayyigberu hammayim al-haaretz chamishshim umeat yom
Uteqipu mayya al ara mea vechamshin yomin:
Vayyizkor elohim et-noach veet kol-hachayya veet-kol-habbehema asher itto batteba vayyaaber elohim ruach al-haaretz vayyashokku hammayim
Udekir Adonai yat noach veyat kol chayta veyat kol beira di immeh betebota veabar Adonai rucha al ara venachu mayya:
Vayyissakeru mayenot tehom vaarubbot hashshamayim vayyikkale haggeshem min-hashshamayim
Veistekaru mabbue tehoma vekavve shemayya veitkeli mitra min shemayya:
Vayyashubu hammayim meal haaretz halok vashob vayyachseru hammayim miqtzeh chamishshim umeat yom
Vetabu mayya meal ara azelin vetayebin vachasaru mayya missop mea vechamshin yomin:
Vattanach hatteba bachodesh hashshebii beshiba-asar yom lachodesh al hare ararat
Venachat tebota beyarcha shebiaa beshibat asar yoma leyarcha al ture qardu:
Vehammayim hayu halok vechasor ad hachodesh haasiri baasiri beechad lachodesh niru rashe heharim
Umayya havo azelin vechaserin ad yarcha asiraa baasiraa bechad leyarcha itchaziu reshe turayya:
Vayehi miqqetz arbaim yom vayyiptach noach et-challon hatteba asher asa
Vahava missop arbein yomin upetach noach yat kavvat tebota di abad:
Vayeshallach et-haoreb vayyetze yatzo vashob ad-yeboshet hammayim meal haaretz
Veshallach yat areba unepaq mippaq vetayib ad deyabbishu mayya meal ara:
Vayeshallach et-hayyona meitto lirot haqallu hammayim meal pene haadama
Veshallach yat yona millevateh lemecheze haqalliu mayya meal appe ara:
Velo-matzea hayyona manoach lekap-raglah vattashob elayv el-hatteba ki-mayim al-pene kol-haaretz vayyishlach yado vayyiqqacheha vayyabe otah elayv el-hatteba
Vela ashkachat yona menach leparsat raglah vetabat levateh letebota are mayya al appe kol ara veoshit yedeh venasebah veael yatah levateh letebota:
Vayyachel od shibat yamim acherim vayyosep shallach et-hayyona min-hatteba
Veorik od shaba yomin ochoranin veosep shallach yat yona min tebota:
Vattabo elayv hayyona leet ereb vehinneh aleh-zayit tarap bepiha vayyeda noach ki-qallu hammayim meal haaretz
Vaatat levateh yona leiddan ramsha veha terap zeta tebir nachit bepumah vida noach are qalliu maya meal ara:
Vayyiyyachel od shibat yamim acherim vayeshallach et-hayyona velo-yasepa shub-elayv od
Veorik od shaba yomin ochoranin veshallach yat yona vela osepat lemittub levateh od:
Vayehi beachat veshesh-meot shana barishon beechad lachodesh charebu hammayim meal haaretz vayyasar noach et-mikseh hatteba vayyar vehinneh charebu pene haadama
Vahava beshit mea vechad shenin beqadmaa bechad leyarcha negubu mayya meal ara veadi noach yat chopaa detebota vachaza veha negubu appe ara:
Ubachodesh hashsheni beshiba veesrim yom lachodesh yabesha haaretz
Ubeyarcha tinyana beasrin veshaba yoma leyarcha yabbishat ara:
Vayedabber elohim el-noach lemor
Umallel Adonai im noach lememar:
Tze min-hatteba atta veishteka ubaneka uneshe-baneka ittak
Puq min tebota at veittetak ubenak uneshe benak immak:
Kol-hachayya asher-itteka mikkol-basar baop ubabbehema ubekol-haremes haromes al-haaretz hayetze ittak vesharetzu baaretz uparu verabu al-haaretz
Kol chayta diimmak mikkol bisra beopa ubibira ubekol richasha derachesh al ara appeq immak veyityalledun beara veyippeshun veyisgun al ara:
Vayyetze-noach ubanayv veishto uneshe-banayv itto
Unepaq noach ubenohi veitteteh uneshe benohi immeh:
Kol-hachayya kol-haremes vekol-haop kol romes al-haaretz lemishpechotehem yatzeu min-hatteba
Kol chayta kol richasha vekol opa kol derachesh al ara lezarayatehon nepaqu min tebota:
Vayyiben noach mizbeach la-Adonai vayyiqqach mikkol habbehema hattehora umikkol haop hattahor vayyaal olot bammizbeach
Ubena noach madbecha qodam Adonai unesib mikkol beira dakya umikkol opa deke veasseq alavan bemidbecha:
Vayyarach Adonai et-reach hannichoach vayyomer Adonai el-libbo lo-osip leqallel od et-haadama baabur haadam ki yetzer leb haadam ra minneurayv velo-osip od lehakkot et-kol-chay kaasher asiti

Veqabbil Adonai beraava yat qurebaneh vaamar Adonai bememereh la osep lemelat od yat ara bedil chobe enasha are yitzra libba deenasha bish mizzeireh vela osep od lemimche yat kol dechay kema deabedit:
Od kol-yeme haaretz zera veqatzir veqor vachom veqayitz vachorep veyom valayla lo yishbotu
Od kol yome ara zeroa vachatzada veqora vechoma veqayta vesitva vimam veleleya la yibtelun:
Vayebarek elohim et-noach veet-banayv vayyomer lahem peru urebu umilu et-haaretz
Ubarik Adonai yat noch veyat benohi vaamar lehon pushu usegu umelu yat ara:
Umoraakem vechittekem yiheyeh al kol-chayyat haaretz veal kol-op hashshamayim bekol asher tirmos haadama ubekol-dege hayyam beyedkem nittanu
Vedachalatkon veematkon tehe al kol chevat ara veal kol opa dishmayya bekol di tarchesh ara ubekol nune yamma beyedkon yehon mesirin:

Ubechar leh lot yat kol meshar yardena unetal lot milleqadmin veittaprashu gebar millevat achuhi:
Abram yashab beeretz-kenaan velot yashab beare hakkikkar vayyeehal ad-sedom
Abram yateb beara diknaan velot yateb beqireve meshera uperas ad sedom:
Veanshe sedom raim vechattaim la-Adonai meod
Veenashin s" vaanashe disdom bishin bemamonehon vechayyabin bigviyyatehon qodam Adonai lachada:
Va-Adonai amar el-abram achare hippared-lot meimmo sa na eneka ureeh min-hammaqom asher-atta sham tzapona vanegba vaqedema vayamma
VaAdonai amar leabram batar deitparesh lot meimmeh zeqop kean enak vachaze min atra diat tamman letzippuna uledaroma ulemadinecha ulemaaraba:
Ki et-kol-haaretz asher-atta roeh leka ettenenna ulezaraka ad-olam
Are yat kol ara di at chaze lak etteninnah velibnak ad alam:
Vesamti et-zaraka kaapar haaretz asher im-yvkal ish limnot et-apar haaretz gam-zaraka yimmaneh
Vaashavve yat benak saggiin keapra deara kema di la epshar ligbar lemimne yat apra deara ap benak la yittimnun:
Qum hithallek baaretz leorkah ulerochbah ki leka ettenenna
Qum hallik beara leorkah veliptayah are lak etteninnah:
Vayyeehal abram vayyabo vayyesheb beelone mamre asher bechebron vayyiben-sham mizbeach la-Adonai
Uperas abram vaata viteb bemeshere mamre di bechebron ubena tamman midbecha qodam Adonai:
Vayehi bime amrapel melek-shinar aryok melek ellasar kedorlaomer melek elam vetidal melek goyim
Vahava beyome amrapel malka debabel aryok malka deellasar kedarelaomer malka deelam vetidal malka deamme:
Asu milchama et-bera melek sedom veet-birsha melek amora shinab melek adma veshemeber melek tzeboyim umelek bela hi-tzoar
Sedaru ny" abadu qeraba im bera malka disdom veim birsha malka daamora shinab malka deadma veshemeber malka ditzboyim umalka debela hi tzoar:
Kol-elleh chaberu el-emeq hassiddim hu yam hammelach
Kol illen itkenashu lemeshar chaqlayya hu atar yamma demilcha:
Shetem esreh shana abedu et-kedorlaomer ushelosh-esreh shana maradu
Tarte asre shenin pelachu yat kedarelaomer utelat asre shenin meradu:
Ubearba esreh shana ba kedorlaomer vehammelakim asher itto vayyakku et-repaim beashterot qarnayim veet-hazzuzim beham veet haemim beshaveh qiryatayim
Ubearba asre shenin ata kedarelaomer umalkayya deimmeh umecho yat gibbarayya di beashterot qarnayim veyat taqqipayya dibhemta veyat emetane dibshaveh qiryatayim:
Veet-hachori beharram seir ad el paran asher al-hammidbar
Veyat chorae di beturehon deseir ad meshar paran dismik al madbera:
Vayyashubu vayyabou el-en mishpat hiv qadesh vayyakku et-kol-sedeh haamaleqi vegam et-haemori hayyosheb bechatzetzon tamar
Vetabu vaatu lemeshar pillug dina hi reqam umecho yat kol chaqal amalqaa veap yat emoraa deyateb been gedi:
Vayyetze melek-sedom umelek amora umelek adma umelek tzeboyim umelek bela hiv-tzoar vayyaarku ittam milchama beemeq hassiddim
Unepaq malka disdom umalka daamora umalka deadma umalka ditzboyim umalka debela hi tzoar vesaddaru immehon qeraba bemeshar chaqlayya:
Et kedorlaomer melek elam vetidal melek goyim veamrapel melek shinar vearyok melek ellasar arbaa melakim et-hachamishsha
Im kedarelaomer malka deelam vetidal malka deammin veamrapel malka debabel vearyok malka deellasar arbea malkin loqobel chamsha:
Veemeq hassiddim beerot beerot chemar vayyanusu melek-sedom vaamora vayyippelu-shamma vehannisharim hera nasu
Umeshar chaqlayya berin berin masqan chemara vaaraqu malka disdom vaamora unepalu tamman udeishtaaru letura araqu:
Vayyiqchu et-kol-rekush sedom vaamora veet-kol-oklam vayyeleku
Ushebo yat kol qinyana disdom vaamora veyat kol mekalehon vaazalu:
Vayyiqchu et-lot veet-rekusho ben-achi abram vayyeleku vehu yosheb bisdom
Ushebo yat lot veyat qinyaneh bar achuhi deabram vaazalu vehu yateb bisdom:
Vayyabo happalit vayyagged leabram haibri vehu shoken beelone mamre haemori achi eshkol vaachi aner vehem baale berit-abram
Vaata meshezaba vechavvi leabram ibraa vehu share bemeshere mamre emoraa achuhi deeshkol vaachuhi deaner veinnun enashe qeyameh deabram:
Vayyishma abram ki nishba achiv vayyareq et-chanikayv yelide beto shemona asar ushelosh meot vayyirdop ad-dan
Ushema abram are ishtebi achuhi vezarez yat ulemohi yelide beteh telat mea vetamne asar uredap ad dan:
Vayyechaleq alehem layla hu vaabadayv vayyakkem vayyirdepem ad-choba asher missemol ledammaseq
Veitpeleg alehon leleya hu veabdohi umechonun uredapinnun ad choba di mitztzippuna ledammaseq:
Vayyasheb et kol-harekush vegam et-lot achiv urekusho heshib vegam et-hannashim veet-haam
Vaateb yat kol qinyana veap yat lot bar achuhi veqinyaneh ateb veap yat neshayya veyat amma:
Vayyetze melek-sedom liqrato achare shubo mehakkot et-kedorlaomer veet-hammelakim asher itto el-emeq shaveh hu emeq hammelek
Unepaq malka disdom leqaddamuteh batar detab millemimche yat kedarelaomer veyat malkayya di immeh lemeshar mapna hu atar bet resa demalka:
Umalki-tzedeq melek shalem hotzi lechem vayayin vehu kohen leel elyon
Umalki tzedeq malka dirushelem appeq lechem vachamar vehu meshammesh qodam el illaa:
Vayebarekehu vayyomar baruk abram leel elyon qoneh shamayim vaaretz
Ubarekeh vaamar berik abram leel illaa diqinyaneh shemayya veara:
Ubaruk el elyon asher-miggen tzareka beyadeka vayyitten-lo maaser mikkol
Uberik el illaa dimsar saneak bidak vihab leh chad min asra mikkolla:
Vayyomer melek-sedom el-abram ten-li hannepesh veharekush qach-lak
Vaamar malka disdom leabram hab li napshata veqinyana debar lak:
Vayyomer abram el-melek sedom harimoti yadi el-Adonai el elyon qoneh shamayim vaaretz
Vaamar abram lemalka disdom aremit yeday bitzlo qodam Adonai qodam el illaa diqinyaneh shemayya veara:
Im-michut vead serok-naal veim-eqqach mikkol-asher-lak velo tomar ani heesharti et-abram
Im michuta vead arqat mesana veim essab mikkol di lak vela temar ana atarit yat abram:
Biladay raq asher akelu hannearim vecheleq haanashim asher haleku itti aner eshkol umamre hem yiqchu chelqam
Lechod middiakalu ulemayya vechulaq gubrayya di azalu immi aner eshkol umamre innun yeqabbelun chalaqehon:
Achar haddebarim haelleh haya debar-Adonai el-abram bammachazeh lemor al-tira abram anoki magen lak sekareka harbeh meod
Batar pitgamayya haillen hava pitgama daAdonai im abram binbua lememar la tidchal abram memeri teqop lak agrak saggi lachada:
Vayyomer abram adonay Adonai mah-titten-li veanoki holek ariri uben-mesheq beti hu dammeseq eliezer
Vaamar abram Adonai ellohim mah titten li vaana azel bela velad ubar parnasa haden dibbeti hu dammasqaa eliezer:
Vayyomer abram hen li lo natatta zara vehinneh ben-beti yoresh oti
Vaamar abram ha li la yehabt velad veha bar beti yarit yati:
Vehinneh debar-Adonai elayv lemor lo yirasheka zeh ki-im asher yetze mimmeeka hu yirasheka
Veha pitgama daAdonai immeh lememar la yirtinnak den elahen bar detolid hu yirtinnak:
Vayyotze oto hachutza vayyomer habbet-na hashshamayma usepor hakkokabim im-tukal lispor otam vayyomer lo koh yihyeh zareka
Veappeq yateh lebara vaamar isteki kean lishmayya umene kokebayya im tikkol lemimne yatehon vaamar leh keden yehon benak:
Veheemin ba-Adonai vayyachshebeha lo tzedaqa
Vehemin bememera daAdonai vechashebah leh lezaku:
Vayyomer elayv ani Adonai asher hotzetika meur kasdim latet leka et-haaretz hazzot lerishtah
Vaamar leh ana Adonai diappeqetak meura dekasdae lemittan lak yat ara hada lemeretah:
Vayyomar adonay Adonai bamma eda ki irashenna
Vaamar Adonai ellohim bema idda are eretinah:
Vayyomer elayv qecha li egla meshulleshet veez meshulleshet veayil meshullash vetor vegozal
Vaamar leh qareb qodamay eglin telata veizzin telata vedikrin telat veshapnina ubar yona:
Vayyiqqach-lo et-kol-elleh vayebatter otam battavek vayyitten ish-bitro liqrat reehu veet-hatztzippor lo batar
Veqareb qodamohi yat kol illen upallig yatehon beshaveh vihab palgayya pillug loqobel chabreh veyat opa la pallig:
Vayyered haayit al-happegarim vayyashsheb otam abram
Unechat opa al paglayya veaprach yatehon abram:
Vayehi hashshemesh labo vetardema napela al-abram vehinneh ema chasheka gedola nopelet alayv
Vahava shimsha lemeal veshinta nepalat al abram veha ema qebal saggi nepalat alohi:
Vayyomer leabram yadoa teda ki-ger yihyeh zaraka beeretz lo lahem vaabadum veinnu otam arba meot shana
Vaamar leabram midda tidda are dayyarin yehon benak beara dela dilehon veyiplechun behon viannun yatehon arba mea shenin:
Vegam et-haggoy asher yaabodu dan anoki veachare-ken yetzeu birkush gadol
Veap yat amma diyiplechun behon dayin ana ubatar ken yipqun beqinyana saggi:
Veatta tabo el-aboteka beshalom tiqqaber beseba toba
Veat teol levat abahatak bishlam titqebar besebu taba:
Vedor rebii yashubu henna ki lo-shalem avon haemori ad-henna
Vedara rebiaa yetubun haka are la shelim choba deemoraa ad kean:
Vayehi hashshemesh baa vaalata haya vehinneh tannur ashan velappid esh asher abar ben haggezarim haelleh
Vahava shimsha allat veqabla hava veha tannur ditnan ubeur deeshshata di ada ben palgayya haillen:
Bayyom hahu karat Adonai et-abram berit lemor lezaraka natatti et-haaretz hazzot minnehar mitzrayim ad-hannahar haggadol nehar-perat
Beyoma hahu gezar Adonai im abram qeyam lememar libnak yehabit yat ara hada min nahara demitzrayim vead nahara rabba nahara perat:
Et-haqqeni veet-haqqenizzi veet haqqadmoni
Yat shalmae veyat qenizzae veyat qadmonae:
Veet-hachitti veet-happerizzi veet-harepaim
Veyat chittae veyat perizzae veyat gibbarae:
Veet-haemori veet-hakkenaani veet-haggirgashi veet-hayebusi
Veyat emorae veyat kenaanae veyat girgashae veyat yebusae:
Vesaray eshet abram lo yaleda lo velah shipcha mitzrit ushemah hagar
Vesaray ittat abram la yelidat leh velah amta mitzreta ushemah hagar:
Vattomer saray el-abram hinneh-na atzarani Adonai milledet bo-na el-shipchati ulay ibbaneh mimmenna vayyishma abram leqol saray
Vaamarat saray leabram ha kean manani Adonai millemelad ul kean levat amti maim itbene minnah veqabbil abram lememar saray:
Vattiqqach saray eshet-abram et-hagar hammitzrit shipchatah miqqetz eser shanim leshebet abram beeretz kenaan vattitten otah leabram ishah lo leishsha
Udebarat saray ittat abram yat hagar mitzreta amtah missop asar shenin lemittab abram beara diknaan vihabat yatah leabram balah leh leintu:
Vayyabo el-hagar vattahar vattere ki harata vatteqal gebirtah beeneha
Veal levat hagar veaddiat vachazat are addiat uqelat ribbanetah beenahah:
Vattomer saray el-abram chamasi aleka anoki natatti shipchati becheqeka vattere ki harata vaeqal beeneha yishpot Adonai beni ubeneka
Vaamarat saray leabram din li alak ana yehabit amti lak vachazat are addiat uqelet beenahah yedin Adonai beni ubenak:
Vayyomer abram el-saray hinneh shipchatek beyadek asi-la hattob beenayik vatteanneha saray vattibrach mippaneha
Vaamar abram lesaray ha amtik bidik ibidi lah kidtaqqin beenayeki veanitah saray veareqat miqqodamahah:
Vayyimtzaah malak Adonai al-en hammayim bammidbar al-haayin bederek shur
Veashkechah malaka daAdonai al ena demayya bemadbera al ena beorcha dechagra:
Vayyomar hagar shipchat saray e-mizzeh bat veana teleki vattomer mippene saray gebirti anoki borachat
Vaamar hagar amta desaray menan at ateya ulean at azela vaamarat min qodam saray ribbaneti ana areqa ny" araqat:
Vayyomer lah malak Adonai shubi el-gebirtek vehitanni tachat yadeha
Vaamar lah malaka daAdonai tubi levat ribbonetik veishtabedi techot yedaha:
Vayyomer lah malak Adonai harba arbeh et-zarek velo yissaper merob
Vaamar lah malaka daAdonai asgaa asge yat benayeki vela yittimnun missege:
Vayyomer lah malak Adonai hinnak hara veyoladt ben veqarat shemo yishmael ki-shama Adonai el-onyek
Vaamar lah malaka daAdonai ha at meadya veteledin bar vetiqrin shemeh yishmael are qabbil Adonai tzelotik:
Vehu yihyeh pere adam yado bakkol veyad kol bo veal-pene kol-echayv yishkon
Vehu yehe marod beenasha hu yehe tzerik lekolla vida dibne anasha yehon tzerikin leh veal appe kol achohi yishre:
Vattiqra shem-Adonai haddober eleha atta el roi ki amera hagam halom raiti achare roi
Vetzalliat bishma daAdonai demitmallel immah amarat at hu elaha dechaze kolla are amarat habram haka ny" haap ana shareti chazeya batar deitgeli li:
Al-ken qara labbeer beer lachay roi hinneh ben-qadesh uben bared
Al ken qera libera beera demalak qayyama ittachazi alah ha hi ben reqam uben chagra:
Vatteled hagar leabram ben vayyiqra abram shem-beno asher-yaleda hagar yishmael
Vilidat hagar leabram bar uqera abram shum bereh dilidat hagar yishmael:
Veabram ben-shemonim shana veshesh shanim beledet-hagar et-yishmael leabram
Veabram bar temanan veshit shenin kad yelidat hagar yat yishmael leabram:
Vayehi abram ben-tishim shana vetesha shanim vayyera Adonai el-abram vayyomer elayv ani-el shadday hithallek lepanay vehyeh tamim
Vahava abram bar tishin utesha shenin veitgeli Adonai leabram vaamar leh ana el shadday pelach qodamay veheve shelim:
Veettena beriti beni ubeneka vearbeh oteka bimod meod
Veetten qeyami ben memeri ubenak veasge yatak lachada lachada:
Vayyippol abram al-panayv vayedabber itto elohim lemor
Unepal abram al appohi umallel immeh Adonai lememar:
Ani hinneh beriti ittak vehayita leab hamon goyim
Ana ha gezar bny" ynnv qeyami immak utehe leab saggi ammin:
Velo-yiqqare od et-shimka abram vehaya shimka abraham ki ab-hamon goyim netattika
Vela yitqere od yat shemak abram vihe shemak abraham are ab saggi ammin yehabittak:
Vehipreti oteka bimod meod unetattika legoyim umelakim mimmeka yetzeu
Veappesh yatak lachada lachada veetteninnak lekinshin umalkin deshallitin beammayya minnak yipqun:
Vahaqimoti et-beriti beni ubeneka uben zaraka achareka ledorotam librit olam lihyot leka lelohim ulezaraka achareka
Vaaqem yat qeyami ben memeri ubenak uben benak batrak ledarehon liqyam alam lemehave lak lelaha velibnak batrak:
Venatatti leka ulezaraka achareka et eretz megureka et kol-eretz kenaan laachuzzat olam vehayiti lahem lelohim
Veetten lak velibnak batrak yat ara totabutak yat kol ara diknaan leachasanat alam veeheve lehon lelaha:
Vayyomer elohim el-abraham veatta et-beriti tishmor atta vezaraka achareka ledorotam
Vaamar Adonai leabraham veat yat qeyami tittar at ubenak batrak ledarehon:
Zot beriti asher tishmeru beni ubenekem uben zaraka achareka himmol lakem kol-zakar
Da qeyami di titterun ben memeri ubenekon uben benak batrak migzar lekon kol dekura:
Unemaltem et besar orlatkem vehaya leot berit beni ubenekem
Vetigzerun yat bisra deorlatekon utehe ny" utehe leat qeyam ben memeri ubenekon:
Uben-shemonat yamim yimmol lakem kol-zakar ledorotekem yelid bayit umiqnat-kesep mikkol ben-nekar asher lo mizzaraka hu
Ubar temanya yomin yitgezar ny" yigzar lekon kol dekura ledaratekon yelide beta uzebine kaspa mikkol bar ammin dela mibbenak hu:
Himmol yimmol yelid beteka umiqnat kaspeka vehayeta beriti bibsarkem librit olam
Itgazzara yitgazzerun ny" migzar yigzar yelid betak uzebin kaspak utehe qeyami bebisrekon liqyam alam:
Vearel zakar asher lo-yimmol et-besar orlato venikreta hannepesh hahiv meammeha et-beriti hepar
Vearel dekura di la yigzar yat besar orlateh veyishtetze enasha hahi meammeh yat qeyami ashni:
Vayyomer elohim el-abraham saray ishteka lo-tiqra et-shemah saray ki sara shemah
Vaamar Adonai leabraham saray ittetak la tiqre yat shemah saray are sara shemah:
Uberakti otah vegam natatti mimmenna leka ben uberaktiha vehayeta legoyim malke ammim mimmenna yihyu
Veebarek yatah veap etten minnah lak bar veebarakinnah utehe lekinshin malkin deshallitin beammayya minnah yehon:
Vayyippol abraham al-panayv vayyitzchaq vayyomer belibbo halleben mea-shana yivvaled veim-sara habat-tishim shana teled
Unepal abraham al appohi vachadi vaamar belibbeh halebar mea shenin yehe velad veim sara habat tishin shenin telid:
Vayyomer abraham el-haelohim lu yishmael yichyeh lepaneka
Vaamar abraham qodam Adonai levay yishmael yitqayyam qodamak:
Vayyomer elohim abal sara ishteka yoledet leka ben veqarata et-shemo yitzchaq vahaqimoti et-beriti itto librit olam lezaro acharayv
Vaamar Adonai bequsheta sara ittetak telid lak bar vetiqre yat shemeh yitzchaq vaaqem yat qeyami immeh liqyam alam libnohi batrohi:
Uleyishmael shematika hinneh berakti oto vehipreti oto vehirbeti oto bimod meod shenem-asar nesiim yolid unetattiv legoy gadol
Veal yishmael qabbelit tzelotak ha barekit yateh veappesh yateh veasge yateh lachada lachada teren asar rabrebayya yelid veetteninneh leam saggi:
Veet-beriti aqim et-yitzchaq asher teled leka sara lammoed hazzeh bashshana haacheret
Veyat qeyami aqim im yitzchaq di telid lak sara lezimna haden beshatta ochoranta:
Vayekal ledabber itto vayyaal elohim meal abraham
Veshetze lemallala immeh veistallaq yeqara daAdonai meillavohi deabraham:
Vayyiqqach abraham et-yishmael beno veet kol-yelide beto veet kol-miqnat kaspo kol-zakar beanshe bet abraham vayyamol et-besar orlatam beetzem hayyom hazzeh kaasher dibber itto elohim
Udebar abraham yat yishmael bereh veyat kol yelide beteh veyat kol zebine kaspeh kol dekura baanashe bet abraham ugezar yat bisra deorlatehon bikran yoma haden kema di mallil immeh Adonai:
Veabraham ben-tishim vatesha shana behimmolo besar orlato
Veabraham bar tishin utesha shenin kad gezar bisra deorleteh:
Veyishmael beno ben-shelosh esreh shana behimmolo et besar orlato
Veyishmael bereh bar telat asre shenin kad gezar yat bisra deorleteh:
Beetzem hayyom hazzeh nimmol abraham veyishmael beno
Bikran yoma haden itgezar ny" gezar abraham veyishmael bereh:
Vekol-anshe beto yelid bayit umiqnat-kesep meet ben-nekar nimmolu itto
Vekol enashe beteh yelide beta uzebine kaspa min bar ammin itgezaru ny" gezaru immeh:
Vayyera elayv Adonai beelone mamre vehu yosheb petach-haohel kechom hayyom
Veitgeli leh Adonai bemeshere mamre vehu yateb bitra mashkena kemecham yoma:
Vayyissa enayv vayyar vehinneh shelosha anashim nitztzabim alayv vayyar vayyarotz liqratam mippetach haohel vayyishtachu aretza
Uzeqap enohi vachaza veha telata gubrin ny" gabrin qayemin illavohi vachaza urehat leqaddamutehon mittera mashkena usegid al ara:
Vayyomar adonay im-na matzati chen beeneka al-na taabor meal abdeka
Vaamar Adonai im kean ashkachit rachamin qodamak ny" beenayk la kean teibbar meal abdak:
Yuqqach-na meat-mayim verachatzu raglekem vehishshaanu tachat haetz
Yissebun kean zeer mayya veaschu raglekon veistemiku techot ilana:
Veeqcha pat-lechem vesaadu libbekem achar taaboru ki-al-ken abartem al-abdekem vayyomeru ken taaseh kaasher dibbarta
Veessab pitta delachma useidu libbekon batar ken taabarun are al ken abartun al abdekon vaamaru ken tabed kema di malleleta:
Vayemaher abraham haohela el-sara vayyomer mahari shelosh seim qemach solet lushi vaasi ugot
Veochi abraham lemashkena levat sara vaamar ocha telat sein qimcha desolta lushi veibidi geritzan:
Veel-habbaqar ratz abraham vayyiqqach ben-baqar rak vatob vayyitten el-hannaar vayemaher laasot oto
Ulevat tore rehat abraham udebar bar tore rakkik vetab vihab leulema veochi lemebad yateh:
Vayyiqqach chema vechalab uben-habbaqar asher asa vayyitten lipnehem vehu-omed alehem tachat haetz vayyokelu
Unesib sheman vachalab ubar tore di abad vihab qodamehon vehu meshammesh illavehon techot ilana vaakalu:

Vayyishma elohim et-qol hannaar vayyiqra malak elohim el-hagar min-hashshamayim vayyomer lah mah-lak hagar al-tirei ki-shama elohim el-qol hannaar baasher hu-sham
Ushemia qodam Adonai yat qaleh derabya uqera malaka daAdonai lehagar min shemayya vaamar lah ma lik hagar la tidchali are shemia qodam Adonai yat qaleh derabya baatar dehu tamman:
Qumi sei et-hannaar vehachaziqi et-yadek bo ki-legoy gadol asimennu
Qumi tuli yat rabya veatqipi yat yedek beh are leam saggi ashavvinneh:
Vayyipqach elohim et-eneha vattere beer mayim vattelek vattemalle et-hachemet mayim vattashq et-hannaar
Ugela Adonai yat enahah vachazat bera demayya vaazalat umelat yat raqeba mayya veashqiat yat rabya:
Vayehi elohim et-hannaar vayyigdal vayyesheb bammidbar vayehi robeh qashshat
Vahava memera daAdonai besaadeh derabya ureba viteb bemadbera vahava rabe qashta:
Vayyesheb bemidbar paran vattiqqach-lo immo ishsha meeretz mitzrayim
Viteb bemadbera deparan unesibat leh immeh itteta meara demitzrayim:
Vayehi baet hahiv vayyomer abimelek upikol sar-tzebao el-abraham lemor elohim immeka bekol asher-atta oseh
Vahava beiddana hahi vaamar abimelek upikol rab cheleh leabraham lememar memera daAdonai besaadak bekol di at abed:
Veatta hishshabea li belohim henna im-tishqor li ulenini ulenekdi kachesed asher-asiti immeka taaseh immadi veim-haaretz asher-garta bah
Ukean qayyem li bememera daAdonai haka dela teshaqqar bi ubibri ubebar beri ketebota di abadit immak tabed immi veim ara deittotabta bah:
Vayyomer abraham anoki ishshabea
Vaamar abraham ana aqayyem:
Vehokiach abraham et-abimelek al-odot beer hammayim asher gazelu abde abimelek
Veokach abraham yat abimelek al esaq bera demayya di annisu abde abimelek:
Vayyomer abimelek lo yadati mi asa et-haddabar hazzeh vegam-atta lo-higgadta li vegam anoki lo shamati bilti hayyom
Vaamar abimelek la yedait man abad yat pitgama haden veap at la chavveta li veap ana la shemait ellahen yoma den:
Vayyiqqach abraham tzon ubaqar vayyitten laabimelek vayyikretu shenehem berit
Udebar abraham an vetorin vihab laabimelek ugezaru tarvehon qeyam:
Vayyatztzeb abraham et-sheba kibsot hatztzon lebaddehen
Vaaqim abraham yat sheba churepan dean bilchodehen:
Vayyomer abimelek el-abraham ma henna sheba kebasot haelleh asher hitztzabta lebaddana
Vaamar abimelek leabraham ma innun sheba churepan illen daaqemeta bilchodehen:
Vayyomer ki et-sheba kebasot tiqqach miyyadi baabur tiheyeh-li leeda ki chaparti et-habbeer hazzot
Vaamar are yat sheba churepan teqabbel min yedi bedil dithe li lesahadu are chaparit yat bera haden ny" hada:
Al-ken qara lammaqom hahu beer shaba ki sham nishbeu shenehem
Al ken qera leatra hahu beer shaba are tamman qayyamu tarvehon:
Vayyikretu berit biber shaba vayyaqom abimelek upikol sar-tzebao vayyashubu el-eretz pelishtim
Ugezaru qeyam biber shaba veqam abimelek upikol rab cheleh vetabu leara pelishtae:
Vayyitta eshel biber shaba vayyiqra-sham beshem Adonai el olam
Unetzeb nitzba ny" ilana biber shaba vetzalli tamman bishma daAdonai elaha dealma:
Vayyagor abraham beeretz pelishtim yamim rabbim
Veittotab abraham beara pelishtae yomin saggiin:
Vayehi achar haddebarim haelleh vehaelohim nissa et-abraham vayyomer elayv abraham vayyomer hinneni
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillen vayya nassi yat abraham vaamar leh abraham vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer qach-na et-binka et-yechideka asher-ahabta et-yitzchaq velek-leka el-eretz hammoriyya vehaalehu sham leola al achad heharim asher omar eleka
Vaamar debar kean yat berak yat yechidak di rechamta yat yitzchaq veizel lak leara pulechana veasqeh qodamay tamman laalata al chad min turayya di emar lak:
Vayyashkem abraham babboqer vayyachabosh et-chamoro vayyiqqach et-shene nearayv itto veet yitzchaq beno vayebaqqa atze ola vayyaqom vayyelek el-hammaqom asher-amar-lo haelohim
Veaqdem abraham betzapra vezarez yat chamareh udebar yat teren ulemohi immeh veyat yitzchaq bereh vetzallach ae laalata veqam veazal leatra di amar leh Adonai:
Bayyom hashshelishi vayyissa abraham et-enayv vayyar et-hammaqom merachoq
Beyoma telitaa uzeqap abraham yat enohi vachaza yat atra merachiq:
Vayyomer abraham el-nearayv shebu-lakem poh im-hachamor vaani vehannaar neleka ad-koh venishetachaveh venashuba alekem
Vaamar abraham leulemohi oriku lekon haka im chamara vaana veulema nitmete ad ka venisgud unetub levatkon:
Vayyiqqach abraham et-atze haola vayyasem al-yitzchaq beno vayyiqqach beyado et-haesh veet-hammaakelet vayyeleku shenehem yachdav
Uneseb abraham yat ae daalata veshavvi al yitzchaq bereh uneseb bideh yat eshshata veyat sakkina vaazalu tarvehon batra kachada:
Vayyomer yitzchaq el-abraham abiv vayyomer abi vayyomer hinnenni beni vayyomer hinneh haesh vehaetzim veayyeh hasseh leola
Vaamar yitzchaq leabraham abuhi vaamar abba vaamar ha ana beri vaamar ha eshshata veaayya vean imera laalata:
Vayyomer abraham elohim yireh-lo hasseh leola beni vayyeleku shenehem yachdav
Vaamar abraham qodam Adonai gele leh imera laalata beri vaazalu tarvehon kachada:
Vayyabou el-hammaqom asher amar-lo haelohim vayyiben sham abraham et-hammizbeach vayyaarok et-haetzim vayyaaqod et-yitzchaq beno vayyasem oto al-hammizbeach mimmaal laetzim
Veatu leatra di amar leh Adonai ubena tamman abraham yat madbecha vesaddar yat aayya vaaqad yat yitzchaq bereh veshavvi yateh al madbecha el min aayya:
Vayyishlach abraham et-yado vayyiqqach et-hammaakelet lishchot et-beno
Veoshet abraham yat yedeh uneseb yat sakkina lemekas yat bereh:
Vayyiqra elayv malak Adonai min-hashshamayim vayyomer abraham abraham vayyomer hinneni
Uqera leh malaka daAdonai min shemayya vaamar abraham abraham vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer al-tishlach yadeka el-hannaar veal-taas lo meuma ki atta yadati ki-yere elohim atta velo chasakta et-binka et-yechideka mimmenni
Vaamar la toshet yedak leulema vela tabed leh middaam are kean yedana ny" yedait are dachala daAdonai at vela menata yat berak yat yechidak minni:
Vayyissa abraham et-enayv vayyar vehinneh-ayil achar neechaz bassebak beqarnayv vayyelek abraham vayyiqqach et-haayil vayyaalehu leola tachat beno
Uzeqap abraham yat enohi batar illen vachaza veha dikra batar achid beilana beqarnohi vaazal abraham uneseb yat dikra veasqeh laalata chalap bereh:
Vayyiqra abraham shem-hammaqom hahu Adonai yireh asher yeamer hayyom behar Adonai yeraeh
Upelach vetzalli abraham tamman beatra hahu vaamar qodam Adonai haka yehon palchan darayya beken yitammar beyoma haden betura haden abraham qodam Adonai pelach:
Vayyiqra malak Adonai el-abraham shenit min-hashshamayim
Uqera malaka daAdonai leabraham tinyanut min shemayya:
Vayyomer bi nishbati neum-Adonai ki yaan asher asita et-haddabar hazzeh velo chasakta et-binka et-yechideka
Vaamar bememere qayyemit amar Adonai are chalap di abadta yat pitgama haden vela menata yat berak yat yechidak:
Ki-barek abarekka veharba arbeh et-zaraka kekokebe hashshamayim vekachol asher al-sepat hayyam veyirash zaraka et shaar oyebayv
Are baraka abarekinnak veasgaa asge yat benak kekokebe shemayya ukechala di al kep yamma veyirtun benak yat qirve sanehon:
Vehitbareku bezaraka kol goye haaretz eqeb asher shamata beqoli
Veyitbarekun bedil benak kol ammayya deara chalap di qabbeleta lememeri:
Vayyashob abraham el-nearayv vayyaqumu vayyeleku yachdav el-beer shaba vayyesheb abraham biber shaba
Vetab abraham levat ulemohi veqamu vaazalu kachada liber shaba viteb abraham biber shaba:
Vayehi achare haddebarim haelleh vayyuggad leabraham lemor hinneh yaleda milka gam-hiv banim lenachor achika
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillen veitchava leabraham lememar ha yeledat milka ap hi benin lenachor achuk:
Et-vtz bekoro veet-buz achiv veet-qemuel abi aram
Yat utz bukereh veyat buz achuhi veyat qemuel abuhi daaram:
Veet-kesed veet-chazo veet-pildash veet-yidlap veet betuel
Veyat kesed veyat chazo veyat pildash veyat yidlap veyat betuel:
Ubetuel yalad et-ribqa shemona elleh yaleda milka lenachor achi abraham
Ubetuel olid yat ribqa temanya illen yeledat milka lenachor achuhi deabraham:
Upilagsho ushemah reuma vatteled gam-hiv et-tebach veet-gacham veet-tachash veet-maaka
Ulechenateh ushemah reuma viledat ap hi yat tebach veyat gacham veyat tachash veyat maaka:
Vayyihyu chayye sara mea shana veesrim shana vesheba shanim shene chayye sara
Vahavo chayye sara mea veesrin usheba shenin shene chayye sara:
Vattamot sara beqiryat arba hiv chebron beeretz kenaan vayyabo abraham lispod lesara velibkotah
Umitat sara beqiryat arba hi chebron beara diknaan vaata abraham lemispeda lesara ulemibkah:
Vayyaqom abraham meal pene meto vayedabber el-bene-chet lemor
Veqam abraham meal appe miteh umallel im bene chittaa lememar:
Ger-vetoshab anoki immakem tenu li achuzzat-qeber immakem veeqbera meti millepanay
Dayyar vetotab ana immekon habu li achsanat qebura immekon veiqbar miti min qodamay:
Vayyaanu bene-chet et-abraham lemor lo
Veatibu bene chittaa yat abraham lememar leh:
Shemaenu adoni nesi elohim atta betokenu bemibchar qebarenu qebor et-meteka ish mimmennu et-qibro lo-yikleh mimmeka miqqebor meteka
Qabbel minnana ribbonana rab qodam Adonai at benana bishpar qibrana qebar yat mitak ennash minnana yat qibreh la yimna minnak millemiqbar mitak:
Vayyaqom abraham vayyishtachu leam-haaretz libne-chet
Veqam abraham usegid leamma deara libne chittaa:
Vayedabber ittam lemor im-yesh et-napshekem liqbor et-meti millepanay shemauni upigu-li beepron ben-tzochar
Umallel immehon lememar im it raava benapshekon lemiqbar yat miti min qodamay qabbilu minni ubeu li min epron bar tzochar:
Veyitten-li et-mearat hammakpela asher-lo asher biqtzeh sadehu bekesep male yittenenna li betokekem laachuzzat-qaber
Veyitten li yat mearat kapelta di leh di bistar chaqleh bekaspa shelim yitteninah li benekon leachasanat qebura:
Veepron yosheb betok bene-chet vayyaan epron hachitti et-abraham beozne bene-chet lekol bae shaar-iro lemor
Veepron yateb bego bene chittaa veateb epron chittaa yat abraham qodam bene chittaa lekol ale tera qarteh lememar:
Lo-adoni shemaeni hassadeh natatti lak vehammeara asher-bo leka netattiha leene bene-ammi netattiha lak qebor meteka
La ribboni qabbel minni chaqla yehabit lak umearta di beh lak yehabitah leene bene ammi yehabitah lak qebar mitak:
Vayyishtachu abraham lipne am haaretz
Usegid abraham qodam amma deara:
Vayedabber el-epron beozne am-haaretz lemor ak im-atta lu shemaeni natatti kesep hassadeh qach mimmenni veeqbera et-meti shamma
Umallel im epron qodam amma deara lememar beram im at abed li tibu qabbel minni etten kaspa deme chaqla sab minni veeqbar yat miti tamman:
Vayyaan epron et-abraham lemor lo
Veateb epron yat abraham lememar leh:
Adoni shemaeni eretz arba meot sheqel-kesep beni ubeneka mah-hiv veet-meteka qebor
Ribboni qabbel minni ara shavya arba mea silin diksap bena ubenak mah hi veyat mitak qebar:
Vayyishma abraham el-epron vayyishqol abraham leepron et-hakkesep asher dibber beozne bene-chet arba meot sheqel kesep ober lassocher
Veqabbel abraham min epron uteqal abraham leepron yat kaspa demallel qodam bene chittaa arba mea silin diksap mitqabbel sechora ny" demitqabbel sechorata bekol medineta:
Vayyaqom sedeh epron asher bammakpela asher lipne mamre hassadeh vehammeara asher-bo vekol-haetz asher bassadeh asher bekol-gebulo sabib
Veqam chaqal epron di bekapelta di qodam mamre chaqla umearta di beh vekol ilane di bechaqla di bekal techumeh sechor sechor:
Leabraham lemiqna leene bene-chet bekol bae shaar-iro
Leabraham lizbinohi leene bene chittaa bekol ale tera qarteh:
Veachare-ken qabar abraham et-sara ishto el-mearat sedeh hammakpela al-pene mamre hiv chebron beeretz kenaan
Ubatar ken qebar abraham yat sara itteteh bimarat chaqal kapelta al appe mamre hi chebron beara diknaan:
Vayyaqom hassadeh vehammeara asher-bo leabraham laachuzzat-qaber meet bene-chet
Veqam chaqla umearta di beh leabraham leachasanat qebura min bene chittaa:
Veabraham zaqen ba bayyamim va-Adonai berak et-abraham bakkol
Veabraham sib al beyomin vayya berik yat abraham bekolla:
Vayyomer abraham el-abdo zeqan beto hammoshel bekol-asher-lo sim-na yadeka tachat yereki
Vaamar abraham leabdeh saba debeteh deshallit bekol di leh shavi kean yedak techot yarki:
Veashbiaka ba-Adonai elohe hashshamayim velohe haaretz asher lo-tiqqach ishsha libni mibbenot hakkenaani asher anoki yosheb beqirbo
Vaaqayyem alak bememera daAdonai elaha dishmayya velaha deara dela tissab itteta libri mibbenat kenaanae di ana yateb benehon:
Ki el-artzi veel-moladti telek velaqachta ishsha libni leyitzchaq
Elahen leari uleyalladuti tezil vetissab itteta libri leyitzchaq:
Vayyomer elayv haebed ulay lo-tobeh haishsha laleket acharay el-haaretz hazzot hehasheb ashib et-binka el-haaretz asher-yatzata mishsham
Vaamar leh abda maim la tebe itteta lemete batray leara hada haataba ateb yat berak leara di nepaqta mittamman:
Vayyomer elayv abraham hishshamer leka pen-tashib et-beni shamma
Vaamar leh abraham istammar lak dilema tateb yat beri letamman:

Adonai elohe hashshamayim asher leqachani mibbet abi umeeretz moladti vaasher dibber-li vaasher nisheba-li lemor lezaraka etten et-haaretz hazzot hu yishlach malako lepaneka velaqachta ishsha libni mishsham
Adonai elaha dishmayya di dabberani mibbet abba umeara yalduti vedi mallel li vedi qayyem li lememar librak etten yat ara hada hu yishlach malakeh qodamak vetissab itteta libri mittamman:
Veim-lo tobeh haishsha laleket achareka veniqqita mishshebuati zot raq et-beni lo tasheb shamma
Veim la tebe itteta lemete batrak utehe zakkaa mimmomati da lechod yat beri la tateb letamman:
Vayyasem haebed et-yado tachat yerek abraham adonayv vayyishshaba lo al-haddabar hazzeh
Veshavvi abda yat yedeh techot yarka deabraham ribboneh veqayyem leh al pitgama haden:
Vayyiqqach haebed asara gemallim miggemalle adonayv vayyelek vekol-tvb adonayv beyado vayyaqom vayyelek el-aram naharayim el-ir nachor
Udebar abda asra gamlin miggamle ribboneh vaazal vekol shepar ribboneh bideh veqam vaazal laaram di al perat leqarta denachor:
Vayyabrek haggemallim michutz lair el-beer hammayim leet ereb leet tzet hashshoabot
Veashre gamlayya mibbara leqarta libera demayya leiddan ramsha leiddan denapqan malyata:
Vayyomar Adonai elohe adoni abraham haqreh-na lepanay hayyom vaaseh-chesed im adoni abraham
Vaamar Adonai elaheh deribboni abraham zammin kean qodamay yoma den veibad tibu im ribboni abraham:
Hinneh anoki nitztzab al-en hammayim ubenot anshe hair yotzeot lishob mayim
Ha ana qaem al ena demayya ubenat enashe qarta napqan lemimle maya:
Vehaya hannaara asher omar eleha hatti-na kaddek veeshteh veamera sheteh vegam-gemalleka ashqeh otah hokachta leabdeka leyitzchaq ubah eda ki-asita chesed im-adoni
Utehe ulemta deemar lah arkini kean quletik veeshti vetemar esht veap gamlak ashqe yatah zamminta leabdak leyitzchaq ubah ida are abadta tibu im ribboni:
Vayehi-hv terem killa ledabber vehinneh ribqa yotzet asher yulleda libtuel ben-milka eshet nachor achi abraham vekaddah al-shikmah
Vahava hu ad la shetze lemallala veha ribqa nepaqat deityelidat libtuel bar milka ittat nachor achuhi deabraham vequletah al katpah:
Vehannaara tobat mareh meod betula veish lo yedaah vattered haayna vattemalle kaddah vattaal
Veulemta shappirat chezu ny" shappira lemecheze lachada betulta ugebar la yadah unechatat leena umelat quletah useleqat:
Vayyarotz haebed liqratah vayyomer hagmiini na meat-mayim mikkaddek
Urehat abda liqdamutah vaamar ashqini s" atemeni kean zeer mayya miqquletik:
Vattomer sheteh adoni vattemaher vattored kaddah al-yadah vattashqehu
Vaameret esht ribboni veochiat vaachetat quletah al yedah veashqeteh:
Vattekal lehashqoto vattomer gam ligmalleka eshab ad im-killu lishtot
Veshetziat leashqayuteh vaameret ap legamlak amle ad di sapqun lemishte:
Vattemaher vattear kaddah el-hashshoqet vattarotz od el-habbeer lishob vattishab lekol-gemallayv
Veochiat unepatzat quletah lebet shaqya urehatat od lebera lemimle umelat lekol gamlohi:
Vehaish mishtaeh lah macharish ladaat hahitzliach Adonai darko im-lo
Vegabra shahe bah mistakkel shatiq lemeda haatzlach Adonai orcheh im la:
Vayehi kaasher killu haggemallim lishtot vayyiqqach haish nezem zahab beqa mishqalo ushene tzemidim al-yadeha asara zahab mishqalam
Vahava kad sappiqu gamlayya lemishte uneseb gabra qadasha dedahaba tiqla matqeleh uteren sherin al yedaha matqal asar silin dedahaba matqalhon:
Vayyomer bat-mi at haggidi na li hayesh bet-abik maqom lanu lalin
Vaamar bat man at chavvi kean li hait bet abuk atar kashar lana limbat:
Vattomer elayv bat-betuel anoki ben-milka asher yaleda lenachor
Vaameret leh bat betuel ana bar milka diledat lenachor:
Vattomer elayv gam-teben gam-mispo rab immanu gam-maqom lalun
Vaameret leh ap tibna ap kissata saggi immana ap atar kashar limbat:
Vayyiqqod haish vayyishtachu la-Adonai
Ukera gabra usegid qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer baruk Adonai elohe adoni abraham asher lo-azab chasdo vaamitto meim adoni anoki badderek nachani Adonai bet ache adoni
Vaamar berik Adonai elaha deribboni abraham di la mena tibuteh vequsheteh min ribboni ana beorach taqna dabberani Adonai bet achohi deribboni:
Vattarotz hannaara vattagged lebet immah kaddebarim haelleh
Urehatat ulemta vechavviat lebet immah kepitgamayya haillen:
Uleribqa ach ushemo laban vayyarotz laban el-haish hachutza el-haayin
Uleribqa acha ushemeh laban urehat laban levat gabra lebara levat ena:
Vayehi kirot et-hannezem veet-hatztzemidim al-yede achoto ukeshomo et-dibre ribqa achoto lemor koh-dibber elay haish vayyabo el-haish vehinneh omed al-haggemallim al-haayin
Vahava kad chaza yat qadasha veyat sherayya al yede achateh vekad shema yat pitgame ribqa achateh lememar keden mallel immi gabra vaata levat gabra veha qaem illavve gamlayya al ena:
Vayyomer bo beruk Adonai lamma taamod bachutz veanoki pinniti habbayit umaqom laggemallim
Vaamar ul berika daAdonai lema at qaem bebara vaana panneti beta vaatar kashar legamlayya:
Vayyabo haish habbayta vayepattach haggemallim vayyitten teben umispo laggemallim umayim lirchotz raglayv veragle haanashim asher itto
Veal gabra lebeta ushera gamlayya vihab tibna vekissata legamlayya umayya leaschaa raglohi veragle gubrayya deimmeh:
Vayyusam lepanayv leekol vayyomer lo okal ad im-dibbarti debaray vayyomer dabber
Veshavviu qodamohi lemekal vaamar la ekul ad daamallel pitgamay vaamar mallel:
Vayyomar ebed abraham anoki
Vaamar abda deabraham ana:
Va-Adonai berak et-adoni meod vayyigdal vayyitten-lo tzon ubaqar vekesep vezahab vaabadim ushepachot ugemallim vachamorim
Vayya barik yat ribboni lachada ureba vihab leh an vetorin ukesap udehab veabdin veamhan vegamlin vachamarin:
Vatteled sara eshet adoni ben ladoni achare ziqnatah vayyitten-lo et-kol-asher-lo
Viledat sara ittat ribboni bar leribboni batar desebat vihab leh yat kol dileh:
Vayyashbieni adoni lemor lo-tiqqach ishsha libni mibbenot hakkenaani asher anoki yosheb beartzo
Veqayyem alay ribboni lememar la tissab itteta libri mibbenat kenaanae di ana yateb beareh:
Im-lo el-bet-abi telek veel-mishpachti velaqachta ishsha libni
Elahen lebet abba tezel ulezariti vetissab itteta libri:
Vaomar el-adoni ulay lo-telek haishsha acharay
Vaamarit leribboni maim la tete itteta batray:
Vayyomer elay Adonai asher-hithallakti lepanayv yishlach malako ittak vehitzliach darkeka velaqachta ishsha libni mimmishpachti umibbet abi
Vaamar li Adonai di pelachit qodamohi yishlach malakeh immak veyatzlach orchak vetissab itteta libri mizzariti umibbet abba:
Az tinnaqeh mealati ki tabo el-mishpachti veim-lo yittenu lak vehayita naqi mealati
Beken tehe zakkay ny" zakka mimmumati are tehak lezariti veim la yittenun lak utehe zakkay mimmumati:

Veatit ny" vaateti yoma den leena vaamarit Adonai elaha deribboni abraham im it kean raava qodamak leatzlacha orchi di ana azel alah:

Ha ana qaem al ena demayya vihe ulemta detippoq lemimle veemar lah ashqini kean zeer mayya miqquletik:

Vetemar li ap at esht veap legamlak amli hi itteta dezammin Adonai lebar ribboni:

Ana ad la shetziti lemallala belibbi veha ribqa nepaqat vequletah al katpah unechatat leena umelat vaamarit lah ashqini kean:

Veochiat vaachitat quletah minnah vaamarat esht veap gamlak ashqi usheteti veap gamlayya ashqiat:

Usheelit yatah vaamarit bat man at vaameret bat betuel bar nachor diledat leh milka veshavveti qadasha al appah vesherayya al yedaha:

Ukerait usegadit qodam Adonai ubarekit yat Adonai elaheh deribboni abraham dedabberani beorach qeshot lemisab yat bat achuhi deribboni libreh:

Ukean im itekon abedin tibu uqeshot im ribboni chavvo li veim la chavvo li veitpene al yammina o al semala:

Veateb laban ubetuel vaamaru min qodam Adonai nepaq pitgama let anachna yakelin lemallala immak bish o tab:

Uqero leribqa vaamaru lah hatezeli im gabra haden vaameret ezil:

Veshallechu yat ribqa achathon veyat meniqtah veyat abda deabraham veyat gabrohi:

Ushelimu yomaha lemelad veha teyumin bimaha:

Ubatar ken nepaq achuhi videh achida beiqba deesav uqera shemeh yaaqob veyitzchaq bar shittin shenin kad yelidat yatehon:

Vaamar esav ha ana azel limmat ulema denan li bekeruta:

Vahava kapna beara bar mikkapna qadmaa di hava beyome abraham vaazal yitzchaq levat abimelek malka diplishtae ligrar:

Veitgeli leh Adonai vaamar la techot lemitzrayim shere beara di emar lak:

Lek-na el-hatztzon veqach-li mishsham shene gedaye izzim tobim veeeseh otam matammim leabika kaasher aheb
Izzel kean levat ana vesab li mittamman teren gadye bar izzin taban veebed yatehon tabshilin leabuk kema di rechem:
Vehebeta leabika veakal baabur asher yebarekka lipne moto
Vetayte leabuk veyekul bedil diybarekinnak qodam moteh:
Vayyomer yaaqob el-ribqa immo hen esav achi ish sair veanoki ish chalaq
Vaamar yaaqob leribqa immeh ha esav achi gebar saaran vaana gebar sheia:
Ulay yemushsheni abi vehayiti beenayv kimtatea vehebeti alay qelala velo beraka
Maim yemushshinnani abba veehe beenohi kemitlaab veehe mayte alay levatin vela birkan:
Vattomer lo immo alay qillateka beni ak shema beqoli velek qach-li
Vaameret leh immeh alay itammar binbua dela yetun levatayya alak beri beram qabbel minni veizzel sab li:
Vayyelek vayyiqqach vayyabe leimmo vattaas immo matammim kaasher aheb abiv
Vaazal unesib veayti leimmeh vaabadat immeh tabshilin kema dirchem abuhi:
Vattiqqach ribqa et-bigde esav benah haggadol hachamudot asher ittah babbayit vattalbesh et-yaaqob benah haqqatan
Unesibat ribqa yat lebushe esav berah rabba dokyata di immah bebeta vealbishat yat yaaqob berah zeera:
Veet orot gedaye haizzim hilbisha al-yadayv veal chelqat tzavvarayv
Veyat mashke gadye bar izze albishat al yedohi veal sheiut tzavreh:
Vattitten et-hammatammim veet-hallechem asher asata beyad yaaqob benah
Vihabat yat tabshilayya veyat lachama di abadat bida deyaaqob berah:
Vayyabo el-abiv vayyomer abi vayyomer hinnenni mi atta beni
Veal levat abuhi vaamar abba vaamar ha ana man at beri:
Vayyomer yaaqob el-abiv anoki esav bekoreka asiti kaasher dibbarta elay qum-na sheba veokla mitztzedi baabur tebarekanni napsheka
Vaamar yaaqob laabuhi ana esav bukerak abadit kema di malleleta immi qum kean istachar veekul mitztzedi bedil di tebarakinnani napshak:
Vayyomer yitzchaq el-beno mah-zeh miharta limtzo beni vayyomer ki hiqra Adonai eloheka lepanay
Vaamar yitzchaq libreh ma den ocheta leashkacha beri vaamar are zammin Adonai elahak qodamay:
Vayyomer yitzchaq el-yaaqob gesha-na vaamusheka beni haatta zeh beni esav im-lo
Vaamar yitzchaq leyaaqob qereb kean veemushshinnak beri haat den beri esav im la:
Vayyiggash yaaqob el-yitzchaq abiv vayemushshehu vayyomer haqqol qol yaaqob vehayyadayim yede esav
