Uqereb yaaqob levat yitzchaq abuhi umasheyeh vaamar qala qala deyaaqob vidayya yedohi deesav:
Velo hikkiro ki-hayu yadayv kide esav achiv seirot vayebarekehu
Vela ishtemodeeh are havaa yedohi kide esav achuhi seiran ubarakeh:
Vayyomer atta zeh beni esav vayyomer ani
Vaamar at den beri esav vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer haggisha li veokela mitztzed beni lemaan tebarekka napshi vayyaggesh-lo vayyokal vayyabe lo yayin vayyesht
Vaamar qareb qodamay veekul mitztzeda dibri bedil di tebarekinnak napshi veqareb leh vaakal veayti leh chamra usheti:
Vayyomer elayv yitzchaq abiv gesha-na usheqa-li beni
Vaamar leh yitzchaq abuhi qereb kean uneshaq li beri:
Vayyiggash vayyishshaq-lo vayyarach et-reach begadayv vayebarekehu vayyomer reeh reach beni kereach sadeh asher bereko Adonai
Uqereb uneshaq leh vaarach yat recha dilbushohi ubarekeh vaamar havo recha dibri kerecha dechaqla di barakeh Adonai:
Veyitten-leka haelohim mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz verob dagan vetirosh
Veyitten lak Adonai mittalla dishmayya umittuba deara usegiut ibur vachamar:
Yaabduka ammim veyishetachavu leka leummim heveh gebir leacheka veyishtachavu leka bene immeka orereka arur umebarekeka baruk
Yiplechunnak ammin veyishtabedun lak malkevan heve rab leachayk veyisgedun lak bene immak melattayk yehon litin umebarakayk yehon berikin:
Vayehi kaasher killa yitzchaq lebarek et-yaaqob vayehi ak yatzo yatza yaaqob meet pene yitzchaq abiv veesav achiv ba mitztzedo
Vahava kad shetzi yitzchaq lebaraka yat yaaqob vahava beram mippaq nepaq yaaqob millevat appe yitzchaq abuhi veesav achuhi ata mitztzedeh:
Vayyaas gam-hv matammim vayyabe leabiv vayyomer leabiv yaqum abi veyokal mitztzed beno baabur tebarekanni napsheka
Vaabad ap hu tabshilin veael levat abuhi vaamar laabuhi yaqum abba veyekul mitztzeda dibreh bedil di tebarekinnani napshak:
Vayyomer lo yitzchaq abiv mi-atta vayyomer ani binka bekoreka esav
Vaamar leh yitzchaq abuhi man at vaamar ana berak bukerak esav:
Vayyecherad yitzchaq charada gedola ad-meod vayyomer mi-epo hu hatztzad-tzayid vayyabe li vaokal mikkol beterem tabo vaabarekehu gam-baruk yihyeh
Uteva yitzchaq tivha rabba ad lachada vaamar man hu deki detzad tzeda veael li vaakalit mikkolla ad la teol ubarekitteh ap berik yehe:
Kishmoa esav et-dibre abiv vayyitzaq tzeaqa gedola umara ad-meod vayyomer leabiv barekeni gam-ani abi
Kad shema esav yat pitgame abuhi utzevach tzivcha rabba umerira ad lachada vaamar laabuhi barekeni ap ana abba:
Vayyomer ba achika bemirma vayyiqqach birkateka
Vaamar al achuk bechokmeta veqabbil birketak:
Vayyomer haki qara shemo yaaqob vayyaqebeni zeh paamayim et-bekorati laqach vehinneh atta laqach birkati vayyomar halo-atzalta li beraka
Vaamar yaut qera shemeh yaaqob vechakkemani denan tarten zimnin yat bekeruti nesib veha kean qabbil birketi vaamar hala shebaqta li birketa:
Vayyaan yitzchaq vayyomer leesav hen gebir samtiv lak veet-kol-echayv natatti lo laabadim vedagan vetirosh semaktiv uleka epo ma eeseh beni
Vaateb yitzchaq vaamar leesav ha rab shavvitteh lak veyat kol achohi yehabit leh leabdin veibur vachamar seidteh velak haka ma ebed beri:
Vayyomer esav el-abiv haberaka achat hiv-leka abi barekeni gam-ani abi vayyissa esav qolo vayyebk
Vaamar esav laabuhi habirketa chada hi lak abba barek li ap ana abba vaarem esav qaleh ubeka:
Vayyaan yitzchaq abiv vayyomer elayv hinneh mishmanne haaretz yihyeh moshabeka umittal hashshamayim meal
Vaateb yitzchaq abuhi vaamar leh ha mittuba deara yehe motebak umittalla dishmayya milleella:
Veal-charbeka ticheyeh veet-achika taabod vehaya kaasher tarid uparaqta ullo meal tzavvareka
Veal charbak teche veyat achuk tiplach vihe kad yaberun benohi al pitgame orayta vetade nireh meal tzavrak:
Vayyistom esav et-yaaqob al-habberaka asher bereko abiv vayyomer esav belibbo yiqrebu yeme ebel abi veaharga et-yaaqob achi
Unetar esav debabu leyaaqob al birketa di barekeh abuhi vaamar esav belibbeh yiqrebun yome eble deabba veeqtol yat yaaqob achi:
Vayyuggad leribqa et-dibre esav benah haggadol vattishlach vattiqra leyaaqob benah haqqatan vattomer elayv hinneh esav achika mitnachem leka lehorgeka
Veitchavva leribqa yat pitgame esav berah rabba ushelachat uqerat leyaaqob berah zeera vaameret leh ha esav achuk kemin lak lemiqtelak:
Veatta beni shema beqoli vequm berach-leka el-laban achi charana
Ukean beri qabbel minni vequm izel lak levat laban achi lecharan:
Veyashabta immo yamim achadim ad asher-tashub chamat achika
Veteteb immeh yomin zeerin ad ditub rugeza deachuk:
Ad-shvb ap-achika mimmeka veshakach et asher-asita lo veshalachti uleqachtika mishsham lama eshkal gam-shenekem yom echad
Ad ditub rugeza deachuk minnak veyitneshe yat di abadta leh veeshlach veedberinnak mittamman lema etkal ap tarvekon yoma chad:
Vattomer ribqa el-yitzchaq qatzti bechayyay mippene benot chet im-loqeach yaaqob ishsha mibbenot-chet kaelleh mibbenot haaretz lamma li chayyim
Vaameret ribqa leyitzchaq aqit bechayyay min qodam benat chittaa im nesib yaaqob itteta mibbenat chittaa keillen mibbenat ara lema li chayyim:
Vayyiqra yitzchaq el-yaaqob vayebarek oto vayetzavvehu vayyomer lo lo-tiqqach ishsha mibbenot kenaan
Uqera yitzchaq leyaaqob ubarik yateh upaqqedeh vaamar leh la tissab itteta mibbenat kenaan:
Qum lek paddena aram beta betuel abi immeka veqach-leka mishsham ishsha mibbenot laban achi immeka
Qum izzel lepaddan aram lebet betuel abuha deimmak vesab lak mittamman itteta mibbenat laban achuha deimmak:
Veel shadday yebarek oteka veyapreka veyarbeka vehayita liqhal ammim
Veel shadday yebarek yatak veyappeshak veyasginnak utehe lekinshat shibtin:
Veyitten-leka et-birkat abraham leka ulezaraka ittak lerishteka et-eretz megureka asher-natan elohim leabraham
Veyitten lak yat birketa deabraham lak velibnak immak lemeretak yat ara totabutak di yehab Adonai leabraham:
Vayyishlach yitzchaq et-yaaqob vayyelek paddena aram el-laban ben-betuel haarammi achi ribqa em yaaqob veesav
Ushelach yitzchaq yat yaaqob vaazal lepaddan aram levat laban bar betuel arammaa achuha deribqa immeh deyaaqob veesav:
Vayyar esav ki-berak yitzchaq et-yaaqob veshillach oto paddena aram laqachat-lo mishsham ishsha bebareko oto vayetzav alayv lemor lo-tiqqach ishsha mibbenot kenaan
Vachaza esav are barik yitzchaq yat yaaqob veshallach yateh lepaddan aram lemissab leh mittamman itteta kad barik yateh upaqqid alohi lememar la tissab itteta mibbenat kenaan:
Vayyishma yaaqob el-abiv veel-immo vayyelek paddena aram
Veqabbil yaaqob min abuhi umin immeh vaazal lepaddan aram:
Vayyar esav ki raot benot kenaan beene yitzchaq abiv
Vachaza esav are bisha benat kenaan beene yitzchaq abuhi:
Vayyelek esav el-yishmael vayyiqqach et-machalat bat-yishmael ben-abraham achot nebayot al-nashayv lo leishsha
Vaazal esav levat yishmael unesib yat machalat bat yishmael bar abraham achateh dinbayot al neshohi leh leintu:
Vayyetze yaaqob mibbeer shaba vayyelek charana
Unepaq yaaqob mibbeera deshaba vaazal lecharan:
Vayyipga bammaqom vayyalen sham ki-ba hashshemesh vayyiqqach meabne hammaqom vayyasem meraashotayv vayyishkab bammaqom hahu
Vaara beatra ubat tamman are al shimsha unesib meabne atra veshavvi issadohi ushekib beatra hahu:
Vayyachalom vehinneh sullam mutztzab artza verosho maggia hashshamayema vehinneh malake elohim olim veyoredim bo
Vachalam veha sulma naitz beara veresheh mate ad tzet shemayya veha malakayya daAdonai saleqin venachatin beh:
Vehinneh Adonai nitztzab alayv vayyomar ani Adonai elohe abraham abika velohe yitzchaq haaretz asher atta shokeb aleha leka ettenenna ulezareka
Veha yeqara daAdonai meattad illavohi vaamar ana Adonai elaheh deabraham abuk veelaheh deyitzchaq ara di at share alah lak etteninnah velibnak:
Vehaya zaraka kaapar haaretz uparatzta yamma vaqedema vetzapona vanegba venibreku beka kol-mishpechot haadama ubezareka
Vihon benak saggiin keapra deara vetitqep lemaarba ulemadinecha uletzippuna uledaroma veyitbarekun bedilak kol zarayat ara ubedil benak:
Vehinneh anoki immak ushemartika bekol asher-telek vahashibotika el-haadama hazzot ki lo eezobka ad asher im-asiti et asher-dibbarti lak
Veha memeri besadak veetterinnak bekol atar di tehak vaatebinnak leara hada are la eshbeqinnak ad di ebed yat demallelit lak:
Vayyiqatz yaaqob mishshenato vayyomer aken yesh Adonai bammaqom hazzeh veanoki lo yadaeti
Veittear yaaqob mishshinteh vaamar bequsheta it yeqara daAdonai share beatra haden vaana la haveti yeda:
Vayyira vayyomar mah-nora hammaqom hazzeh en zeh ki im-bet elohim vezeh shaar hashshamayim
Udechil vaamar ma dechilu atra haden let den atar hedyot ellahen atar deraava beh min qodam Adonai veden tera qobel shemayya:
Vayyashkem yaaqob babboqer vayyiqqach et-haeben asher-sam meraashotayv vayyasem otah matztzeba vayyitzoq shemen al-roshah
Veaqdem yaaqob betzapra unesib yat abna di shavvi issadohi veshavvi yatah qama vaariq mishcha al reshah:
Vayyiqra et-shem-hammaqom hahu bet-el veulam luz shem-hair larishona
Uqera yat shema deatra hahu bet el uberam luz shema deqarta beqadmeta:
Vayyiddar yaaqob neder lemor im-yihyeh elohim immadi ushemarani badderek hazzeh asher anoki holek venatan-li lechem leekol ubeged lilbosh
Veqayyim yaaqob qeyam lememar im yehe memera daAdonai besadi veyitterinnani beorcha haden di ana azel veyitten li lachama lemekal ukesu lemilbash:
Veshabti beshalom el-bet abi vehaya Adonai li lelohim
Veetub bishlam lebet abba vihe memera daAdonai li lelaha:
Vehaeben hazzot asher-samti matztzeba yihyeh bet elohim vekol asher titten-li asser aasserennu lak
Veabna hada di shavveti qama tehe di ehe palach alah min qodam Adonai vekol di titten li chad min asra apreshinneh qodamak:
Vayyissa yaaqob raglayv vayyelek artza bene-qedem
Unetal yaaqob raglohi vaazal laara bene madinecha:
Vayyar vehinneh beer bassadeh vehinneh-sham shelosha edre-tzon robetzim aleha ki min-habbeer hahiv yashqu haadarim vehaeben gedola al-pi habbeer
Vachaza veha bera bechaqla veha tamman telata edrin dean rebiin alah are min bera hahi mashqan adarayya veabna rabbeta al puma debera:
Veneespu-shamma kol-haadarim vegalelu et-haeben meal pi habbeer vehishqu et-hatztzon veheshibu et-haeben al-pi habbeer limqomah
Umitkanneshin letamman kol adarayya umeganderin yat abna meal puma debera umashqan yat ana umetibin yat abna al puma debera leatrah:
Vayyomer lahem yaaqob achay meayin attem vayyomeru mecharan anachenu
Vaamar lehon yaaqob achay menan attun vaamaru mecharan anachena:
Vayyomer lahem hayedatem et-laban ben-nachor vayyomeru yadaenu
Vaamar lehon hayedatun yat laban bar nachor vaamaru yedanan:
Vayyomer lahem hashalom lo vayyomeru shalom vehinneh rachel bitto baa im-hatztzon
Vaamar lehon hashlam leh vaamaru shelam veha rachel beratteh ateya im ana:
Vayyomer hen od hayyom gadol lo-et heasep hammiqneh hashqu hatztzon uleku reu
Vaamar ha od yoma saggi la iddan lemiknash beir ashqu ana veizzilu reu:
Vayyomeru lo nukal ad asher yeasepu kol-haadarim vegalelu et-haeben meal pi habbeer vehishqinu hatztzon
Vaamaru la nikkul ad di mitkanneshin kol adarayya viganderun yat abna meal puma debera venashqe ana:
Odennu medabber immam verachel baa im-hatztzon asher leabiha ki roa hiv
Ad dehu memallel immehon verachel atat im ana di laabuha are raita hi:
Vayehi kaasher raa yaaqob et-rachel bat-laban achi immo veet-tzon laban achi immo vayyiggash yaaqob vayyagel et-haeben meal pi habbeer vayyashq et-tzon laban achi immo
Vahava kad chaza yaaqob yat rachel bat laban achuha deimmeh veyat ana delaban achuha deimmeh uqereb yaaqob vegandar yat abna meal puma debera veashqe yat ana delaban achuha deimmeh:
Vayyishshaq yaaqob lerachel vayyissa et-qolo vayyebk
Uneshaq yaaqob lerachel vaarem yat qaleh ubeka:
Vayyagged yaaqob lerachel ki achi abiha hu veki ben-ribqa hu vattarotz vattagged leabiha
Vechavvi yaaqob lerachel are bar acha deabuha hu vaare bar ribqa hu urehatat vechavviat leabuha:
Vayehi kishmoa laban et-shema yaaqob ben-achoto vayyarotz liqrato vayechabbeq-lo vayenashsheq-lo vayebiehu el-beto vayesapper lelaban et kol-haddebarim haelleh
Vahava kad shema laban yat shema yaaqob bar achateh urehat leqaddamuteh vegappep leh venashshiq leh veaaleh lebeteh veishtai lelaban yat kol pitgamayya haillen:
Vayyomer lo laban ak atzmi ubesari atta vayyesheb immo chodesh yamim
Vaamar leh laban beram qaribi ubisri at viteb immeh yerach yomin:
Vayyomer laban leyaaqob haki-achi atta vaabadtani chinnam haggida li mah-maskurteka
Vaamar laban leyaaqob hamiddeachi at vetiplechinnani maggan chavvi li ma agrak:
Ulelaban shete banot shem haggedola lea veshem haqqetanna rachel
Ulelaban tarten benan shum rabbeta lea veshum zeerta rachel:
Veene lea rakkot verachel hayeta yepat-toar vipat mareh
Veene lea yaayan verachel havat shappira bereva veyaaya bechezva:
Vayyeehab yaaqob et-rachel vayyomer eebodka sheba shanim berachel bitteka haqqetanna
Urechem yaaqob yat rachel vaamar eplechinnak sheba shenin berachel berattak zeerta:
Vayyomer laban tob titti otah lak mittitti otah leish acher sheba immadi
Vaamar laban tab deetten yatah lak middeetten yatah ligbar ochoran tib immi:
Vayyaabod yaaqob berachel sheba shanim vayyihyu beenayv keyamim achadim beahabato otah
Upelach yaaqob berachel sheba shenin vahavo beenohi keyomin zeirin kad rechem yatah:
Vayyomer yaaqob el-laban haba et-ishti ki maleu yamay veaboa eleha
Vaamar yaaqob lelaban hab yat itteti are ashlemit yome palechani veeol levatah:
Vayyeesop laban et-kol-anshe hammaqom vayyaas mishteh
Ukenash laban yat kol anashe atra vaabad mishteya:
Vayehi baereb vayyiqqach et-lea bitto vayyabe otah elayv vayyabo eleha
Vahava beramsha udebar yat lea beratteh veael yatah levateh veal levatah:
Vayyitten laban lah et-zilpa shipchato lelea bitto shipcha
Vihab laban lah yat zilpa amteh lelea beratteh leamhu:
Vayehi babboqer vehinneh-hiv lea vayyomer el-laban mah-zot asita li halo berachel abadti immak velamma rimmitani
Vahava betzapra veha hi lea vaamar lelaban ma da abadta li hala berachel pelachit immak ulema shaqqarta bi:
Vayyomer laban lo-yeaseh ken bimqomenu latet hatztzeira lipne habbekira
Vaamar laban la itabed keden beatrana lemittan zeerta qodam rabbeta:
Malle shebua zot venittena leka gam-et-zot baaboda asher taabod immadi od sheba-shanim acherot
Ashlim shebuata deda venitten lak ap yat da bepalechana di tiplach immi od sheba shenin ochoranin:
Vayyaas yaaqob ken vayemalle shebua zot vayyitten-lo et-rachel bitto lo leishsha
Vaabad yaaqob ken veashlem shebuata deda vihab leh yat rachel beratteh leh leintu:
Vayyitten laban lerachel bitto et-bilha shipchato lah leshipcha
Vihab laban lerachel beratteh yat bilha amteh lah leamhu:
Vayyabo gam el-rachel vayyeehab gam-et-rachel millea vayyaabod immo od sheba-shanim acherot
Veal ap levat rachel urechem ap yat rachel millea upelach immeh od sheba shenin ochoranin:
Vayyar Adonai ki-senua lea vayyiptach et-rachmah verachel aqara
Vachaza Adonai are seniata lea vihab lah idduy verachel aqra:
Vattahar lea vatteled ben vattiqra shemo reuben ki amera ki-raa Adonai beonyi ki atta yeehabani ishi
Veaddiat lea vilidat bar uqerat shemeh reuben are ameret are geli qodam Adonai ulboni are kean yirchaminnani bali:
Vattahar od vatteled ben vattomer ki-shama Adonai ki-senua anoki vayyitten-li gam-et-zeh vattiqra shemo shimon
Veaddiat od vilidat bar vaameret are shemia qodam Adonai are seniata ana vihab li ap yat den uqerat shemeh shimon:
Vattahar od vatteled ben vattomer atta happaam yillaveh ishi elay ki-yaladti lo shelosha banim al-ken qara-shemo levi
Veaddiat od vilidat bar vaameret hada zimna yitchabbar li bali are yeledit leh telata benin al ken qera shemeh levi:
Vattahar od vatteled ben vattomer happaam odeh et-Adonai al-ken qarea shemo yehuda vattaamod milledet
Veaddiat od vilidat bar vaameret hada zimna odeh qodam Adonai al ken qerat shemeh yehuda veqamat millemelad:
Vattere rachel ki lo yaleda leyaaqob vatteqanne rachel baachotah vattomer el-yaaqob haba-li banim veim-ayin meta anoki
Vachazat rachel are la yelidat leyaaqob veqanniat rachel baachatah vaameret leyaaqob hab li benin veim la meta ana:
Vayyichar-ap yaaqob berachel vayyomer hatachat elohim anoki asher-mana mimmek peri-baten
Uteqep rugeza deyaaqob berachel vaamar ha minni at baya hala min qodam Adonai tibin di mena minnik valeda dimin:
Vattomer hinneh amati bilha bo eleha veteled al-birkay veibbaneh gam-anoki mimmenna
Vaameret ha amti bilha ul levatah utelid vaana erabbe veetbene ap ana minnah:
Vattitten-lo et-bilha shipchatah leishsha vayyabo eleha yaaqob
Vihabat leh yat bilha amtah leintu veal levatah yaaqob:
Vattahar bilha vatteled leyaaqob ben
Veaddiat bilha vilidat leyaaqob bar:
Vattomer rachel dananni elohim vegam shama beqoli vayyitten-li ben al-ken qarea shemo dan
Vaameret rachel denanni Adonai veap qabbil tzeloti vihab li bar al ken qerat shemeh dan:
Vattahar od vatteled bilha shipchat rachel ben sheni leyaaqob
Veaddiat od vilidat bilha amta derachel bar tinyan leyaaqob:
Vattomer rachel naptule elohim niptalti im-achoti gam-yakoleti vattiqra shemo naptali
Vaameret rachel qabbil Adonai bauti beitchannanuti bitzloti chamedat dihe li velad kaachati ap ityehib li uqerat shemeh naptali:
Vattere lea ki ameda milledet vattiqqach et-zilpa shipchatah vattitten otah leyaaqob leishsha
Vachazat lea are qamat millemelad udebarat yat zilpa amtah vihabat yatah leyaaqob leintu:
Vatteled zilpa shipchat lea leyaaqob ben
Vilidat zilpa amta delea leyaaqob bar:
Vattomer lea ba gad vattiqra et-shemo gad
Vaameret lea ata gad uqerat yat shemeh gad:
Vatteled zilpa shipchat lea ben sheni leyaaqob
Vilidat zilpa amta delea bar tinyan leyaaqob:
Vattomer lea beoshri ki ishsheruni banot vattiqra et-shemo asher
Vaameret lea tushbachta havat li are beken yeshabbechunnani neshayya uqerat yat shemeh asher:
Vayyelek reuben bime qetzir-chittim vayyimtza dudaim bassadeh vayyabe otam el-lea immo vattomer rachel el-lea teni-na li middudae benek
Vaazal reuben beyome chatzad chittin veashkach yabruchin bechaqla veayti yatehon lelea immeh vaameret rachel lelea habi kean li miyyabruche dibrik:
Vattomer lah hameat qachtek et-ishi velaqachat gam et-dudae beni vattomer rachel laken yishkab immak hallayla tachat dudae benek
Vaameret lah hazer didbart yat bali vetissebin ap yat yabruche dibri vaameret rachel beken yishkub imak beleleya cholap yabruche dibrik:
Vayyabo yaaqob min-hassadeh baereb vattetze lea liqrato vattomer elay tabo ki sakor sekartika bedudae beni vayyishkab immah ballayla hu
Vaata yaaqob min chaqla beramsha unepaqat lea leqaddamuteh vaameret levati teol are megar agartik beyabruche dibri ushekib immah beleleya hu:
Vayyishma elohim el-lea vattahar vatteled leyaaqob ben chamishi
Veqabbil Adonai tzelotah delea veaddiat vilidat leyaaqob bar chamishai:
Vattomer lea natan elohim sekari asher-natatti shipchati leishi vattiqra shemo yissashkar
Vaameret lea yehab Adonai agri dihabit amti lebali uqerat shemeh yissaskar:
Vattahar od lea vatteled ben-shishshi leyaaqob
Veaddiat od lea vilidat bar shititai leyaaqob:
Vattomer lea zebadani elohim oti zebed tob happaam yizbeleni ishi ki-yaladti lo shishsha banim vattiqra et-shemo zebulun
Vaameret lea yehab Adonai yateh li cholaq tab hada zimna yehe medoreh debali levati are yeledit leh shitta benin uqerat yat shemeh zebulun:
Veachar yaleda bat vattiqra et-shemah dina
Ubatar ken yelidat beratta uqerat yat shemah dina:
Vayyizkor elohim et-rachel vayyishma eleha elohim vayyiptach et-rachmah
Veal dukerana derachel qodam Adonai veqabbil tzelotah Adonai vihab lah idduy:
Vattahar vatteled ben vattomer asap elohim et-cherpati
Veaddiat vilidat bar vaameret kenash Adonai yat chissudi:
Vattiqra et-shemo yosep lemor yosep Adonai li ben acher
Uqerat yat shemeh yosep lememar yosep Adonai li bar ochoran:
Vayehi kaasher yaleda rachel et-yosep vayyomer yaaqob el-laban shallecheni veeleka el-meqomi uleartzi
Vahava kad yelidat rachel yat yosep vaamar yaaqob lelaban shallechani veehak leatri uleari:
Tena et-nashay veet-yeladay asher abadti oteka bahen veeleka ki atta yadata et-abodati asher abadtika
Hab yat neshay veyat benay di pelachit yatak behen veezel are at yedata yat palechani diplachittak:
Vayyomer elayv laban im-na matzati chen beeneka nichashti vayebarekeni Adonai biglaleka
Vaamar leh laban im kean ashkachit rachamin qodamak nasseti ubarekani Adonai bedilak:
Vayyomar noqba sekareka alay veettena
Vaamar paresh agrak alay veetten:
Vayyomer elayv atta yadata et asher abadtika veet asher-haya miqneka itti
Vaamar leh at yedata yat diplachittak veyat dahava beirak immi:
Ki meat asher-haya leka lepanay vayyiprotz larob vayebarek Adonai oteka leragli veatta matay eeseh gam-anoki lebeti
Are zeer di hava lak qodamay uteqep lemisge ubarik Adonai yatak bedili ukean ematay ebed ap ana lebeti:
Vayyomer ma etten-lak vayyomer yaaqob lo-titten-li meuma im-taaseh-li haddabar hazzeh ashuba ereh tzoneka eshmor
Vaamar ma etten lak vaamar yaaqob la titten li middaam im tabed li pitgama haden etub ere anak ettar:
Eebor bekol-tzoneka hayyom haser mishsham kol-seh naqod vetalu vekol-seh-chvm bakkesabim vetalu venaqod baizzim vehaya sekari
Ebar bekol anak yoma den haade mittamman kol immar nemor ureqoa vekol immar shechum beimmerayya ureqoa unemor beizzayya vihe agri:
Veaneta-bi tzidqati beyom machar ki-tabo al-sekari lepaneka kol asher-enennu naqod vetalu baizzim vechum bakkesabim ganub hu itti
Vetashed bi zakuti beyom dimchar are teol al agri qodamak kol di letohi nemor ureqoa beizzayya ushechum beimmerayya genuba hu immi:
Vayyomer laban hen lu yehi kidbareka
Vaamar laban beram levay yehe kepitgamak:
Vayyasar bayyom hahu et-hatteyashim haaquddim vehatteluim veet kol-haizzim hannequddot vehatteluot kol asher-laban bo vekol-chvm bakkesabim vayyitten beyad-banayv
Veadi beyoma hahu yat teyashayya regolayya ureqoayya veyat kol izayya nemoreta ureqoata kol di chivvar beh vekol dishchum beimmerayya vihab beyad benohi:
Vayyasem derek sheloshet yamim beno uben yaaqob veyaaqob roeh et-tzon laban hannotarot
Veshavvi mahalak telata yomin benohi uben yaaqob veyaaqob rae yat ana delaban deishtooran:
Vayyiqqach-lo yaaqob maqqal libneh lach veluz vearmon vayepatztzel bahen petzalot lebanot machsop hallaban asher al-hammaqlot
Unesib leh yaaqob chuterin dilban rattibin didluz vedidlup veqalip behon qilpin chivvarin qilup chivvar di al chuterayya:
Vayyatztzeg et-hammaqlot asher pitztzel barehatim beshiqetot hammayim asher tabona hatztzon lishtot lenokach hatztzon vayyechamna beboan lishtot
Vedaetz yat chuterayya di qallip birhatayya atar bet shaqeya demayya atar deatan ana lemishte leqiblehon deana umityachaman bemetehon lemishte:
Vayyechemu hatztzon el-hammaqlot vatteladna hatztzon aquddim nequddim uteluim
Veityachama ana bechuterayya vilida ana regolin nemorin ureqoin:
Vehakkesabim hiprid yaaqob vayyitten pene hatztzon el-aqod vekol-chvm betzon laban vayyashet-lo adarim lebaddo velo shatam al-tzon laban
Veimmerayya apresh yaaqob vihab beresh ana kol dirgol vekol dishchum beana delaban veshavvi leh edrin bilchodohi vela arebinnun im ana delaban:
Vehaya bekol-yachem hatztzon hamequshsharot vesam yaaqob et-hammaqlot leene hatztzon barehatim leyachmenna bammaqlot
Vahave bekol iddan demityachaman ana mebakkarta umeshavvi yaaqob yat chuterayya leene ana birhatayya leyachamutehon bechuterayya:
Ubehaatip hatztzon lo yasim vehaya haatupim lelaban vehaqqeshurim leyaaqob
Ubelaqqishut ana la meshavve vahavo laqqeshaya lelaban ubakkirayya leyaaqob:
Vayyiprotz haish meod meod vayehi-lo tzon rabbot ushepachot vaabadim ugemallim vachamorim
Uteqep gabra lachada lachada vahavo leh an saggian vaamhan veabdin vegamlin vachamarin:
Vayyishma et-dibre bene-laban lemor laqach yaaqob et kol-asher leabinu umeasher leabinu asa et kol-hakkabod hazzeh
Ushema yat pitgame bene laban deamerin nesib yaaqob yat kol di leabuna umiddi leabuna qena yat kol niksayya haden:
Vayyar yaaqob et-pene laban vehinneh enennu immo kitmol shilshom
Vachaza yaaqob yat sebar appe laban veha letohi immeh kemeitmalle umiddeqammohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-yaaqob shub el-eretz aboteka ulemoladteka veeheyeh immak
Vaamar Adonai leyaaqob tub leara daabahatak uleyalladetak vihe memeri besadak:
Vayyishlach yaaqob vayyiqra lerachel ulelea hassadeh el-tzono
Ushelach yaaqob uqera lerachel ulelea lechaqla levat aneh:
Vayyomer lahen roeh anoki et-pene abiken ki-enennu elay kitmol shilshom velohe abi haya immadi
Vaamar lehen chaze ana yat sebar appe abuken are letohi immi kemeitmalli umiddeqammohi velaheh deabba hava besadi:
Veattena yedaten ki bekol-kochi abadti et-abiken
Veattin yedatin are bekol cheli pelachit yat abuken:
Vaabiken hetel bi vehechelip et-maskurti aseret monim velo-netano elohim lehara immadi
Vaabuken sheqar bi veashni yat agri asar zimnin vela shabeqeh Adonai leabasha immi:
Im-koh yomar nequddim yihyeh sekareka veyaledu kol-hatztzon nequddim veim-koh yomar aquddim yihyeh sekareka veyaledu kol-hatztzon aquddim
Im keden hava amar nemorin yehe agrak vilidan kol ana nemorin veim keden hava amar regolin yehe agrak vilidan kol ana regolin:
Vayyatztzel elohim et-miqneh abikem vayyitten-li
Veapresh Adonai yat gete daabukon vihab li:
Vayehi beet yachem hatztzon vaessa enay vaere bachalom vehinneh haattudim haolim al-hatztzon aquddim nequddim uberuddim
Vahava beiddan deityachama ana uzeqapit aynay vachazet bechelma veha teyashayya desaleqin al ana regolin nemorin upatztzichin:
Vayyomer elay malak haelohim bachalom yaaqob vaomar hinneni
Vaamar li malaka daAdonai bechelma yaaqob vaamarit ha ana:
Vayyomer sa-na eneka ureeh kol-haattudim haolim al-hatztzon aquddim nequddim uberuddim ki raiti et kol-asher laban oseh lak
Vaamar zeqop kean aynak vachaze kol teyashayya desaleqin al ana regolin nemorin upatztzichin are gele qodamay yat kol di laban abed lak:
Anoki hael bet-el asher mashachta sham matztzeba asher nadarta li sham neder atta qum tze min-haaretz hazzot veshub el-eretz moladteka
Ana elaha deitgeleti alak bebet el di meshachta tamman qama di qayyimta qodamay tamman qeyam kean qum puq min ara hada vetub leara yalladutak:
Vattaan rachel velea vattomarna lo haod lanu cheleq venachala bebet abinu
Vaatibat rachel velea vaamaran leh haod kean lana cholaq veachasana bebet abuna:
Halo nokriyyot nechshabnu lo ki mekaranu vayyokal gam-akol et-kaspenu
Hala nukeraan itchashabna leh are zabbenana vaakal ap mekal yat kaspana:
Ki kol-haosher asher hitztzil elohim meabinu lanu hu ulebanenu veatta kol asher amar elohim eleka aseh
Are kol utera di apresh Adonai meabuna dilana hu ulebanana ukean kol di amar Adonai lak abed:
Vayyaqom yaaqob vayyissa et-banayv veet-nashayv al-haggemallim
Veqam yaaqob unetal yat benohi veyat neshohi al gamlayya:
Vayyinhag et-kol-miqnehu veet-kol-rekusho asher rakash miqneh qinyano asher rakash bepaddan aram labo el-yitzchaq abiv artza kenaan
Udebar yat kol getohi veyat kol qinyaneh diqna gete qinyaneh di qena bepaddan aram lemete levat yitzchaq abuhi leara kenaan:
Velaban halak ligzoz et-tzono vattignob rachel et-hatterapim asher leabiha
Velaban azal lemiggaz yat aneh vekassiat rachel yat tzalmanayya di laabuha:
Vayyignob yaaqob et-leb laban haarammi al-beli higgid lo ki boreach hu
Vekassi yaaqob min libba delaban arammaa al dela chavvi leh are azel hu:
Vayyibrach hu vekol-asher-lo vayyaqom vayyaabor et-hannahar vayyasem et-panayv har haggilad
Vaazal hu vekol di leh veqam vaabar yat perat veshavvi yat appohi letura degilad:
Vayyuggad lelaban bayyom hashshelishi ki barach yaaqob
Veitchava lelaban beyoma telitaa are azel yaaqob:
Vayyiqqach et-echayv immo vayyirdop acharayv derek shibat yamim vayyadbeq oto behar haggilad
Udebar yat achuhi immeh uredap batrohi mahalak shibat yomin veadbeq yateh betura degilad:
Vayyabo elohim el-laban haarammi bachalom hallayela vayyomer lo hishshamer leka pen-tedabber im-yaaqob mittob ad-ra
Vaata memar min qodam Adonai levat laban arammaa bechelema deleleya vaamar leh istammar lak dilema temallel im yaaqob mittab ad bish:
Vayyasseg laban et-yaaqob veyaaqob taqa et-oholo bahar velaban taqa et-echayv behar haggilad
Veadbeq laban yat yaaqob veyaaqob peras yat mashkeneh betura velaban ashre yat achohi betura degilad:
Vayyomer laban leyaaqob meh asita vattignob et-lebabi vattenaheg et-benotay kishbuyot chareb
Vaamar laban leyaaqob ma abadta vekasseta minni udebarta yat benatay keshabyot charba:
Lamma nachbeta libroach vattignob oti velo-higgadta li vaashallechaka besimcha ubeshirim betop ubekinnor
Lema itmarta lemezal vekasseta minni vela chavveta li veshallachittak pon bechedva ubetushebechan betupin ubekinnarin:
Velo netashtani lenashsheq lebanay velibnotay atta hiskalta aso
Vela shebaqtani lenashshaqa libnay velibnatay kean askelta lemebad:
Yesh-leel yadi laasot immakem ra velohe abikem emesh amar elay lemor hishshamer leka middabber im-yaaqob mittob ad-ra
It chela bidi lemebad immekon bish velaha daabukon beramsha amar li lememar istammar lak millemallala im yaaqob mittab ad bish:
Veatta halok halakta ki-niksop niksapta lebet abika lamma ganabta et-elohay
Ukean mezal azalta are chammada chammedeta lebet abuk lema nesibta yat dachalti:
Vayyaan yaaqob vayyomer lelaban ki yareti ki amarti pen-tigzol et-benoteka meimmi
Vaateb yaaqob vaamar lelaban are dechelit are amarit dilema tanes yat benatak minni:
Im asher timtza et-eloheka lo yicheyeh neged achenu hakker-leka ma immadi veqach-lak velo-yada yaaqob ki rachel genabatam
Im di tashkach yat dachaltak la yitqayyam qodam achana ishtemoda lak ma deimmi vesab lak vela yeda yaaqob are rachel nesibatehon:
Vayyabo laban beohel yaaqob ubeohel lea ubeohel shete haamahot velo matza vayyetze meohel lea vayyabo beohel rachel
Veal laban bemashkena deyaaqob ubemashkena delea ubemashkena detarten lechenata vela ashkach unepaq mimmashkena delea veal bemashkena derachel:
Verachel laqecha et-hatterapim vattesimem bekar haggamal vattesheb alehem vayemashshesh laban et-kol-haohel velo matza
Verachel nesibat yat tzalmanayya veshavvittinnun baabita degamla vitibat alehon umashshish laban yat kol mashkena vela ashkach:
Vattomer el-abiha al-yichar beene adoni ki lo ukal laqum mippaneka ki-derek nashim li vayechappes velo matza et-hatterapim
Vaameret laabuha la yitqep beene ribboni are la ikkul lemeqam min qodamak are orach neshin li ubelash vela ashkach yat tzalmanayya:
Vayyichar leyaaqob vayyareb belaban vayyaan yaaqob vayyomer lelaban mah-pishi mah chattati ki dalaqta acharay
Uteqep leyaaqob unetza im laban vaateb yaaqob vaamar lelaban mah chobi mah surechani are redapta batray:
Ki-mishshashta et-kol-kelay mah-matzata mikkol kele-beteka sim koh neged achay veacheka veyokichu ben shenenu
Are mashshishta yat kol manay ma ashkachta mikkol mane betak shavvi haka qodam achay veachayk veyokichun ben tarvana:
Zeh esrim shana anoki immak recheleka veizzeka lo shikkelu veele tzoneka lo akaleti
Denan esrin shenin ana immak rechelak veizzak la atkilu vedikre anak la akalit:
Terepa lo-hebeti eleka anoki achattenna miyyadi tebaqshenna genubeti yom ugenubeti layela
Ditbira la ayteti levatak dahava shageya mimminyana minni at bae lah netarit bimama unetarit beleleya:
Hayiti bayyom akalani choreb veqerach ballayela vattiddad shenati meenay
Haveti bimama akalni sharba ugelida hava nachet alay beleleya unedad shinti meenay:
Zeh-li esrim shana bebeteka abadtika arba-esreh shana bishte benoteka veshesh shanim betzoneka vattachalep et-maskurti aseret monim
Denan li esrin shenin bebetak pelachittak arba esre shenin betarten benatayk veshit shenin beanak veashneta yat agri asar zimnin:
Lule elohe abi elohe abraham upachad yitzchaq haya li ki atta reqam shillachtani et-onyi veet-yegia kappay raa elohim vayyokach amesh
Ilula pon elaheh deabba elaheh deabraham udedachil leh yitzchaq hava besadi are kean reqan shillachtani yat amli veyat leut yeday gele qodam Adonai veokach beramsha:
Vayyaan laban vayyomer el-yaaqob habbanot benotay vehabbanim banay vehatztzon tzoni vekol asher-atta roeh li-hv velibnotay ma-eeseh laelleh hayyom o libnehen asher yaladu
Vaateb laban vaamar leyaaqob benata benatay ubenayya benay veana ani vekol di at chaze dili hu velibnatay ma ebed leillen yoma den o libnehen dilidan:
Veatta leka nikreta berit ani vaatta vehaya leed beni ubeneka
Ukean eta nigzar qeyam ana veat vihe lesahid beni ubenak:
Vayyiqqach yaaqob aben vayerimeha matztzeba
Unesib yaaqob abna uzeqapah qama:
Vayyomer yaaqob leechayv liqtu abanim vayyiqchu abanim vayyaasu-gal vayyokelu sham al-haggal
Vaamar yaaqob laachohi lequtu abnin unesibu abnin vaabadu degora vaakalu tamman al degora:
Vayyiqra-lo laban yegar sahaduta veyaaqob qara lo galed
Uqera leh laban yegar sahaduta veyaaqob qera leh galed:
Vayyomer laban haggal hazzeh ed beni ubeneka hayyom al-ken qara-shemo galed
Vaamar laban degora haden sahid beni ubenak yoma den al ken qera shemeh galed:
Vehammitzpa asher amar yitzep Adonai beni ubeneka ki nissater ish mereehu
Vesakuta di amar yisek memera daAdonai beni ubenak are nitkassi gebar mechabreh:
Im-teanneh et-benotay veim-tiqqach nashim al-benotay en ish immanu reeh elohim ed beni ubeneka
Im teanne yat benatay veim tissab neshin al benatay let enash immana chaze memera daAdonai sahid beni ubenak:
Vayyomer laban leyaaqob hinneh haggal hazzeh vehinneh hammatztzeba asher yariti beni ubeneka
Vaamar laban leyaaqob ha degora haden veha qamta di aqemit beni ubenak:
Ed haggal hazzeh veeda hammatztzeba im-ani lo-eebor eleka et-haggal hazzeh veim-atta lo-taabor elay et-haggal hazzeh veet-hammatztzeba hazzot leraa
Sahid degora haden vesahada qama im ana la ebar levatak yat degora haden veim at la teibbar levati yat degora haden veyat qamta hada lebishu:
Elohe abraham velohe nachor yishpetu benenu elohe abihem vayyishshaba yaaqob bepachad abiv yitzchaq
Elaheh deabraham veelaheh denachor yedunun benana elaheh daabuhon veqayyem yaaqob biddachil leh abuhi yitzchaq:
Vayyizbach yaaqob zebach bahar vayyiqra leechayv leekol-lachem vayyokelu lechem vayyalinu bahar
Unekes yaaqob niksata betura uqera laachohi lemekal lachama vaakalu lachama ubitu betura:
Vayyashkem laban babboqer vayenashsheq lebanayv velibnotayv vayebarek ethem vayyelek vayyashob laban limqomo
Veaqdem laban betzapra uneshaq libnohi velibnateh ubarik yatehen vaazal vetab laban leatreh:
Veyaaqob halak ledarko vayyipgeu-bo malake elohim
Veyaaqob azal leorcheh vaarau beh malakayya daAdonai:
Vayyomer yaaqob kaasher raam machaneh elohim zeh vayyiqra shem-hammaqom hahu machanayim
Vaamar yaaqob kad chazanun mashrita min qodam Adonai den uqera shema deatra hahu machanayim:
Vayyishlach yaaqob malakim lepanayv el-esav achiv artza seir sedeh edom
Ushelach yaaqob izgaddin qodamohi levat esav achuhi leara deseir lachaqal edom:
Vayetzav otam lemor koh tomerun ladoni leesav koh amar abdeka yaaqob im-laban garti vaechar ad-atta
Upaqqid yatehon lememar keden temerun leribboni leesav kidnan amar abdak yaaqob im laban darit veocharit ad kean:
Vayehi-li shor vachamor tzon veebed veshipcha vaeshlecha lehaggid ladoni limtzo-chen beeneka
Vahava li torin vachamarin an veabdin veamhan ushelachit lechavvaa leribboni leashkacha rachamin beenak:
Vayyashubu hammalakim el-yaaqob lemor banu el-achika el-esav vegam holek liqrateka vearba-meot ish immo
Vetabu izgaddayya levat yaaqob lememar atena levat achuk levat esav veap ate leqaddamutak vearba mea gabra immeh:
Vayyira yaaqob meod vayyetzer lo vayyachatz et-haam asher-itto veet-hatztzon veet-habbaqar vehaggemallim lishne machanot
Udechil yaaqob lachada vaaqat leh upalleg yat amma di immeh veyat ana veyat tore vegamlayya litren mashshireyan:
Vayyomer im-yabo esav el-hammachaneh haachat vehikkahu vehaya hammachaneh hannishar lipleta
Vaamar im yete esav lemashrita chada veyimchinneh vihe mashrita detishtaar leshezaba:
Vayyomer yaaqob elohe abi abraham velohe abi yitzchaq Adonai haomer elay shub leartzeka ulemoladteka veetiba immak
Vaamar yaaqob elaheh deabba abraham velaheh deabba yitzchaq Adonai di amar li tub learak uleyalladutak veoteb immak:
Qatoneti mikkol hachasadim umikkol-haemet asher asita et-abdeka ki bemaqli abarti et-hayyarden hazzeh veatta hayiti lishne machanot
Zeiran zakutay mikkol chisdin umikkal tabvan di abadta im abdak are yechidi abarit yat yardena haden ukean haveti litren mashshiryan:
Hatztzileni na miyyad achi miyyad esav ki-yare anoki oto pen-yabo vehikkani em al-banim
Shezabni kean mida deachi mida deesav are dachel ana minneh dilema yete veyimchinnani imma al benayya:
Veatta amarta heteb etib immak vesamti et-zaraka kechol hayyam asher lo-yissaper merob
Veat amarta otaba oteb immak veeshavvi yat benak saggiin kechalla deyamma di la yittimnun missaggi:
Vayyalen sham ballayla hahu vayyiqqach min-habba beyado mincha leesav achiv
Ubat tamman beleleya hahu unesib min deayti bideh tiqrubta leesav achuhi:
Izzim matayim uteyashim esrim rechelim matayim veelim esrim
Izze matan uteyashayya esrin rechelin matan vedikrin esrin:
Gemallim meniqot ubenehem sheloshim parot arbaim uparim asara atonot esrim vayarim asara
Gamle menqata ubenehon telatin toreta arbein vetore asra atnan esrin veire asra:
Vayyitten beyad-abadayv eder eder lebaddo vayyomer el-abadayv ibru lepanay verevach tasimu ben eder uben eder
Vihab beyad abdohi edra edra bilchodohi vaamar leabdohi ibbaru qodamay urevacha teshavvun ben edra uben edra:
Vayetzav et-harishon lemor ki yipegoshka esav achi usheeleka lemor lemi-atta veana telek ulemi elleh lepaneka
Upaqqed yat qadmaa lememar are yearinnak esav achi usheelinnak lememar leman at ulean at azel uleman illen diqodamak:
Veamarta leabdeka leyaaqob mincha hiv shelucha ladoni leesav vehinneh gam-hv acharenu
Vetemar leabdak leyaaqob tiqrubta hi dimshallecha leribboni leesav veha ap hu ate batrana:
Vayetzav gam et-hashsheni gam et-hashshelishi gam et-kol-haholekim achare haadarim lemor kaddabar hazzeh tedabberun el-esav bemotzaakem oto
Upaqqid ap yat tinyana ap yat telitaa ap yat kol deazelin batar adarayya lememar kepitgama haden temallelun im esav kad tashkechun yateh:
Vaamartem gam hinneh abdeka yaaqob acharenu ki-amar akappera panayv bammincha haholeket lepanay veachare-ken ereh panayv ulay yissa panay
Vetemerun ap ha abdak yaaqob ate batrana are amar anchinneh lerugezeh betiqrubta deazelat loqodamay ubatar ken echeze appohi maim yissab appay:
Vattaabor hammincha al-panayv vehu lan ballayela-hahu bammachaneh
Vaabarat tiqrubta al appohi vehu bat beleleya hahu bemashrita:
Vayyaqom ballayla hu vayyiqqach et-shete nashayv veet-shete shipchotayv veet-achad asar yeladayv vayyaabor et maabar yabboq
Veqam beleleya hu udebar yat tarten neshohi veyat tarten lechenateh veyat chad asar benohi vaabar yat maabar yubeqa:
Vayyiqqachem vayyaabirem et-hannachal vayyaaber et-asher-lo
Udebarinnun veabbarinnun yat nachla veabar yat dileh:
Vayyivvater yaaqob lebaddo vayyeabeq ish immo ad alot hashshachar
Veishtaar yaaqob bilchodohi veishtaddel gabra immeh ad disleq tzapra:
Vayyar ki lo yakol lo vayyigga bekap-yereko vatteqa kap-yerek yaaqob beheabeqo immo
Vachaza are la yakil leh uqereb bipte yarkeh veza pete yarka deyaaqob beishtaddaluteh immeh:
Vayyomer shallecheni ki ala hashshachar vayyomer lo ashallechaka ki im-beraktani
Vaamar shallechani are seliq tzapra vaamar la ashallechinnak ellahen beraktani:
Vayyomer elayv mah-shemeka vayyomer yaaqob
Vaamar leh ma shemak vaamar yaaqob:
Vayyomer lo yaaqob yeamer od shimka ki im-yisrael ki-sarita im-elohim veim-anashim vattukal
Vaamar la yaaqob yitamar od shemak ellahen yisrael are rabrebat qodam Adonai veim guberayya vikaleta:
Vayyishal yaaqob vayyomer haggida-na shemeka vayyomer lamma zeh tishal lishmi vayebarek oto sham
Usheel yaaqob vaamar chavvi kean shemak vaamar lema denan at shael lishmi ubarik yateh tamman:
Vayyiqra yaaqob shem hammaqom peniel ki-raiti elohim panim el-panim vattinnatzel napshi
Uqera yaaqob shema deatra peniel are chazeti malakayya daAdonai appin beappin veishtezabat napshi:
Vayyizerach-lo hashshemesh kaasher abar et-penuel vehu tzolea al-yereko
Udenach leh shimsha kema di abar yat penuel vehu matla al yarkeh:
Al-ken lo-yokelu bene-yisrael et-gid hannasheh asher al-kap hayyarek ad hayyom hazzeh ki naga bekap-yerek yaaqob begid hannasheh
Al ken la yekelun bene yisrael yat gida denashya di al pete yarka ad yoma haden are qereb bipte yarka deyaaqob begida denashya:
Vayyissa yaaqob enayv vayyar vehinneh esav ba veimmo arba meot ish vayyachatz et-hayeladim al-lea veal-rachel veal shete hashshepachot
Uzeqap yaaqob enohi vachaza veha esav ata veimmeh arba mea gubrin upallig yat benayya al lea veal rachel veal tarten lechenata:
Vayyasem et-hashshepachot veet-yaldehen rishona veet-lea viladeha acharonim veet-rachel veet-yosep acharonim
Veshavvi yat lechenata veyat benehen qadmain veyat lea ubenaha batrain veyat rachel veyat yosep batrain:
Vehu abar lipnehem vayyishtachu artza sheba peamim ad-gishto ad-achiv
Vehu abar qodamehon usegid al ara sheba zimnin ad miqrebeh ad achuhi:
Vayyarotz esav liqrato vayechabbeqehu vayyippol al-tzavvarav vayyishshaqehu vayyibku
Urehat esav leqaddamuteh vegappepeh unepal al tzavreh venashsheqeh ubeko:
Vayyissa et-enayv vayyar et-hannashim veet-hayeladim vayyomer mi-elleh lak vayyomar hayeladim asher-chanan elohim et-abdeka
Uzeqap yat enohi vachaza yat neshayya veyat benayya vaamar man illen lak vaamar benayya di chas Adonai yat abdak:
Vattiggashna hashshepachot henna veyaldehen vattishetachavena
Uqeribat lechenata innin ubenehen usegida:
Vattiggash gam-lea viladeha vayyishetachavu veachar niggash yosep verachel vayyishetachavu
Uqeriba ap lea ubenaha usegidu ubatar ken qereb yosep verachel usegidu:
Vayyomer mi leka kol-hammachaneh hazzeh asher pagasheti vayyomer limtzo-chen beene adoni
Vaamar man lak kol mashrita haden di arait vaamar leashkacha rachamin beene ribboni:
Vayyomer esav yesh-li rab achi yehi leka asher-lak
Vaamar esav it li saggi achi atzlach bedilak:
Vayyomer yaaqob al-na im-na matzati chen beeneka velaqachta minchati miyyadi ki al-ken raiti paneka kirot pene elohim vattirtzeni
Vaamar yaaqob bebau im kean ashkachit rachamin beenayk uteqabbel tiqrubti min yedi are al ken chazittinnun leappayk kechezu appe rabrebayya veitreet li:
Qach-na et-birkati asher hubat lak ki-channani elohim veki yesh-li-kol vayyiptzar-bo vayyiqqach
Qabbel kean yat tiqrubti deittotiat lak are rachim alay qodam Adonai vaare it li kolla veatqep beh veqabbil:
Vayyomer nisa veneleka veeleka lenegdeka
Vaamar nittal venehak veehak leqabelak:
Vayyomer elayv adoni yodea ki-hayeladim rakkim vehatztzon vehabbaqar alot alay udepaqum yom echad vametu kol-hatztzon
Vaamar leh ribboni yeda are yaneqayya rakkikin veana vetore meniqta alay udechoqinnun yoma chad vimutun kol ana:
Yaabor-na adoni lipne abdo vaani etenahala leitti leregel hammelaka asher-lepanay uleregel hayeladim ad asher-abo el-adoni seira
Yeibbar kean ribboni qodam abdeh vaana edabber beniach leregel obadta di qodamay uleregel yaneqayya ad di eol levat ribboni leseir:
Vayyomer esav atztziga-na immeka min-haam asher itti vayyomer lamma zeh emtza-chen beene adoni
Vaamar esav eshboq kean immak min amma diimmi vaamar lema denan ashkach rachamin beene ribboni:
Vayyashob bayyom hahu esav ledarko seira
Vetab beyoma hahu esav leorcheh leseir:
Veyaaqob nasa sukkota vayyiben lo bayit ulemiqnehu asa sukkot al-ken qara shem-hammaqom sukkot
Veyaaqob netal lesukkot ubena leh beta velibireh abad metallan al ken qera shema deatra sukkot:
Vayyabo yaaqob shalem ir shekem asher beeretz kenaan beboo mippaddan aram vayyichan et-pene hair
Vaata yaaqob shelim qarta dishkem di beara diknaan bemeteh mippaddan daaram ushera loqobel appe qarta:
Vayyiqen et-chelqat hassadeh asher nata-sham oholo miyyad bene-chamor abi shekem bemea qesita
Uzeban yat achasanat chaqla di peras tamman mashkeneh mida dibne chamor abuhi dishkem bemea churepan:
Vayyatztzeb-sham mizbeach vayyiqra-lo el elohe yisrael
Vaaqem tamman madbecha upelach alohi qodam el elaha deyisrael:
Vattetze dina bat-lea asher yaleda leyaaqob lirot bibnot haaretz
Unepaqat dina bat lea di yelidat leyaaqob lemecheze bibnat ara:
Vayyar otah shekem ben-chamor hachivvi nesi haaretz vayyiqqach otah vayyishkab otah vayeanneha
Vachaza yatah shekem bar chamor chivaa rabba deara udebar yatah ushekib yatah veanyah:
Vattidbaq napsho bedina bat-yaaqob vayyeehab et-hannaara vayedabber al-leb hannaara
Veitreiat napsheh bedina bat yaaqob urechem yat ulemta umalil al libba deulemta:
Vayyomer shekem el-chamor abiv lemor qach-li et-hayyalda hazzot leishsha
Vaamar shekem lachamor abuhi lememar sab li yat ulemta hada leintu:
Veyaaqob shama ki timme et-dina bitto ubanayv hayu et-miqnehu bassadeh vehecherish yaaqob ad-boam
Veyaaqob shema are saeb yat dina beratteh ubenohi havo im getohi bechaqla veshatiq yaaqob ad metehon:
Vayyetze chamor abi-shekem el-yaaqob ledabber itto
Unepaq chamor abuhi dishkem levat yaaqob lemallala immeh:
Ubene yaaqob bau min-hassadeh keshomam vayyiteatztzebu haanashim vayyichar lahem meod ki-nebala asa beyisrael lishkab et-bat-yaaqob veken lo yeaseh
Ubene yaaqob allu min chaqla kad shemau veitnesisu gubrayya uteqep lehon lachada are qelana abad beyisrael lemishkab im bat yaaqob veken la kashar leitabada:
Vayedabber chamor ittam lemor shekem beni chasheqa napsho bebittekem tenu na otah lo leishsha
Umallil chamor immehon lememar shekem beri itreiat napsheh bibrattekon habu kean yatah leh leintu:
Vehitechattenu otanu benotekem tittenu-lanu veet-benotenu tiqchu lakem
Vetitchattenun bana benatekon tittenun lana veyat benatana tissebun lekon:
Veittanu teshebu vehaaretz tihyeh lipnekem shebu usecharuha veheachazu bah
Veimmana tetebun veara tehe qodamekon tibu veibidu bah sechoreta veachasinu bah:
Vayyomer shekem el-abiha veel-acheha emtza-chen beenekem vaasher tomeru elay etten
Vaamar shekem laabuha uleachaha ashkach rachamin beenekon vedi temerun li etten:
Harbu alay meod mohar umattan veettena kaasher tomeru elay utenu-li et-hannaara leishsha
Asgo alay lachada moharin umattenan veetten kema di temerun li vehabu li yat ulemta leintu:
Vayyaanu bene-yaaqob et-shekem veet-chamor abiv bemirma vayedabberu asher timme et dina achotam
Vaatibu bene yaaqob yat shekem veyat chamor abuhi bechokmata umallilu di saeb yat dina achatehon:
Vayyomeru alehem lo nukal laasot haddabar hazzeh latet et-achotenu leish asher-lo orla ki-cherpa hiv lanu
Vaamaru lehon la nikkul lemebad pitgama haden lemittan yat achatana ligbar di leh orleta are chissuda hi lana:
Ak-bezot neot lakem im tihyu kamonu lehimmol lakem kol-zakar
Beram beda nitpes lekon im tehevon kevatana lemigzar lekon kol dekura:
Venatannu et-benotenu lakem veet-benotekem niqqach-lanu veyashabnu ittekem vehayinu leam echad
Venitten yat benatana lekon veyat benatekon nissab lana venittub immekon venehe leamma chad:
Veim-lo tishmeu elenu lehimmol velaqachnu et-bittenu vehalakenu
Veim la teqabbelun minnana lemigzar unedabber yat berattana venezel:
Vayyitebu dibrehem beene chamor ubeene shekem ben-chamor
Usheparu pitgamehon beene chamor ubeene shekem bar chamor:
Velo-echar hannaar laasot haddabar ki chapetz bebat-yaaqob vehu nikbad mikkol bet abiv
Vela ochar ulema lemebad pitgama are itrei bebat yaaqob vehu yaqqir mikkol bet abuhi:
Vayyabo chamor ushekem beno el-shaar iram vayedabberu el-anshe iram lemor
Vaata chamor ushekem bereh litra qartehon umallilu im anashe qartehon lememar:
Haanashim haelleh shelemim hem ittanu veyeshebu baaretz veyischaru otah vehaaretz hinneh rachabat-yadayim lipnehem et-benotam niqqach-lanu lenashim veet-benotenu nitten lahem
Gubrayya haillen shalemin innun immana vitibun beara veyabedun bah sechoreta veara ha petayut yedin qodamehon yat benatehon nissab lana linshin veyat benatana nitten lehon:
Ak-bezot yeotu lanu haanashim lashebet ittanu lihyot leam echad behimmol lanu kol-zakar kaasher hem nimmolim
Beram beda yittapesun lana guberayya lemittab immana lemehave leamma chad lemigzar lana kol dekura kema di innun gezirin:
Miqnehem veqinyanam vekol-behemtam halo lanu hem ak neota lahem veyeshebu ittanu
Getehon veqinyanehon vekol beirehon hala dilana innun beram nitpes lehon vitibun immana:
Vayyishmeu el-chamor veel-shekem beno kol-yotzee shaar iro vayyimmolu kol-zakar kol-yotzee shaar iro
Veqabbilu min chamor umin shekem bereh kol napeqe tera qarteh ugezaru kol dekura kol napeqe tera qarteh:
Vayehi bayyom hashshelishi biheyotam koabim vayyiqchu shene-bene-yaaqob shimon velevi ache dina ish charbo vayyabou al-hair betach vayyahargu kol-zakar
Vahava beyoma telitaa kad teqipu alehon kebehon unesibu teren bene yaaqob shimon velevi ache dina gebar charbeh veallu al qarta deyatebun lerachatzan uqetalu kol dekura:
Veet-chamor veet-shekem beno haregu lepi-chareb vayyiqchu et-dina mibbet shekem vayyetzeu
Veyat chamor veyat shekem bereh qetalu lepitgam dechareb udebaru yat dina mibbet shekem unepaqu:
Bene yaaqob bau al-hachalalim vayyabozzu hair asher timmeu achotam
Bene yaaqob alu lechallatza qatilayya ubezo qarta di saibu achatehon:
Et-tzonam veet-beqaram veet-chamorehem veet asher-bair veet-asher bassadeh laqachu
Yat anehon veyat torehon veyat chamarehon veyat di beqarta veyat di bechaqla bezo s" debaru:
Veet-kol-chelam veet-kol-tappam veet-neshehem shabu vayyabozzu veet kol-asher babbayit
Veyat kol niksehon veyat kol taplehon veyat neshehon shebo ubezo veyat kol di bebeta:
Vayyomer yaaqob el-shimon veel-levi akartem oti lehabisheni beyosheb haaretz bakkenaani ubapperizzi vaani mete mispar veneespu alay vehikkuni venishmadti ani ubeti
Vaamar yaaqob leshimon ulelevi akartun yati lemittan debabu benana uben yatebe ara biknaanaa ubapperizzaa vaana am deminyan veyitkanneshun alay veyimchinnuni veeshtetze ana veenash beti:
Vayyomeru hakzona yaaseh et-achotenu
Vaamaru haknapeqat bara yitabed laachatana:
Vayyomer elohim el-yaaqob qum aleh bet-el vesheb-sham vaaseh-sham mizbeach lael hannireh eleka beborchaka mippene esav achika
Vaamar Adonai leyaaqob qum saq lebet el vetib tamman veibed tamman madbecha lelaha deitgeli lak bemeirqak min qodam esav achuk:
Vayyomer yaaqob el-beto veel kol-asher immo hasiru et-elohe hannekar asher betokekem vehittaharu vehachalipu simlotekem
Vaamar yaaqob leenash beteh ulekol di immeh adu yat taavat ammayya di benekon veiddakku veshannu kesutekon:
Venaquma venaaleh bet-el veeeseh-sham mizbeach lael haoneh oti beyom tzarati vayehi immadi badderek asher halaketi
Veneqom venissaq lebet el veebed tamman madbecha lelaha deqabbel tzeloti beyoma deaqti vahava memereh besadi beorcha di azalit:
Vayyittenu el-yaaqob et kol-elohe hannekar asher beyadam veet-hannezamim asher beoznehem vayyitmon otam yaaqob tachat haela asher im-shekem
Vihabu leyaaqob yat kol taavat ammayya di bidehon veyat qadashayya di beudenehon vetammar yatehon yaaqob techot batema di im shekem:
Vayyissau vayehi chittat elohim al-hearim asher sebibotehem velo radepu achare bene yaaqob
Unetalu vahavat dachala daAdonai al ammayya di beqirve sacharanehon vela redapu batar bene yaaqob:
Vayyabo yaaqob luza asher beeretz kenaan hiv bet-el hu vekol-haam asher-immo
Vaata yaaqob leluz di beara diknaan hi bet el hu vekol amma di immeh:
Vayyiben sham mizbeach vayyiqra lammaqom el bet-el ki sham niglu elayv haelohim beborcho mippene achiv
Ubena tamman madbecha uqera leatra el bet el are tamman itgeli leh Adonai bemeirqeh min qodam achuhi:
Vattamot debora meneqet ribqa vattiqqaber mittachat lebet-el tachat haallon vayyiqra shemo allon bakut
Umitat debora meniqta deribqa veitqebarat millera lebet el beshippole meshera uqera shemeh meshar bakita:
Vayyera elohim el-yaaqob od beboo mippaddan aram vayebarek oto
Veitgeli Adonai leyaaqob od bemetohi mippaddan aram ubarik yateh:
Vayyomer-lo elohim shimka yaaqob lo-yiqqare shimka od yaaqob ki im-yisrael yihyeh shemeka vayyiqra et-shemo yisrael
Vaamar leh Adonai shemak yaaqob la yitqere shemak od yaaqob ellahen yisrael yehe shemak uqera yat shemeh yisrael:
Vayyomer lo elohim ani el shadday pereh urebeh goy uqehal goyim yihyeh mimmekka umelakim mechalatzeka yetzeu
Vaamar leh Adonai ana el shadday push usege am vekinshat shibtin yehe minnak umalkin deshallitin beammayya minnak yippequn:
Veet-haaretz asher natatti leabraham uleyitzchaq leka ettenenna ulezaraka achareka etten et-haaretz
Veyat ara di yehabit leabraham uleyitzchaq lak etteninah velibnak batrak etten yat ara:
Vayyaal mealayv elohim bammaqom asher-dibber itto
Veistallaq meillavohi yeqara daAdonai beatra di mallil immeh:
Vayyatztzeb yaaqob matztzeba bammaqom asher-dibber itto matztzebet aben vayyassek aleha nesek vayyitzoq aleha shamen
Vaaqem yaaqob qamta beatra di mallil immeh qamat abna veassik alah nissukin vaariq alah mishcha:
Vayyiqra yaaqob et-shem hammaqom asher dibber itto sham elohim bet-el
Uqera yaaqob yat shema deatra di mallil immeh tamman Adonai bet el:
Vayyisu mibbet el vayehi-od kibrat-haaretz labo eprata vatteled rachel vatteqash belidtah
Unetalu mibbet el vahava od kerubat ara lemeal leeprat vilidat rachel veqashshiat bemeledah:
Vayehi behaqshotah belidtah vattomer lah hameyalledet al-tirei ki-gam-zeh lak ben
Vahava beqashyutah bemeledah vaameret lah chayeta la tidchali are ap den lik bar:
Vayehi betzet napshah ki meta vattiqra shemo ben-oni veabiv qara-lo binyamin
Vahava bemippaq napshah are mitat uqerat shemeh bar devay vaabuhi qera leh binyamin:
Vattamot rachel vattiqqaber bederek eprata hiv bet lachem
Umitat rachel veitqebarat beorach eprat hi bet lachem:
Vayyatztzeb yaaqob matztzeba al-qeburatah hiv matztzebet qeburat-rachel ad-hayyom
Vaaqem yaaqob qamta al qeburtah hi qamat qeburta derachel ad yoma den:
Vayyissa yisrael vayyet oholoh mehalea lemigdal-eder
Unetal yisrael uperas mashkeneh millehalla lemigdela deeder:
Vayehi bishkon yisrael baaretz hahiv vayyelek reuben vayyishkab et-bilha pilegesh abiv vayyishma yisrael vayyiheyu bene-yaaqob shenem asar
Vahava kad shera yisrael beara hahi vaazal reuben ushekib im bilha lechenata daabuhi ushema yisrael vahavo bene yaaqob tere asar:
Bene lea bekor yaaqob reuben veshimon velevi vihuda veyissashkar uzebulun
Bene lea bukera deyaaqob reuben veshimon velevi vihuda veyisashkar uzebulun:
Bene rachel yosep ubinyamin
Bene rachel yosep ubinyamin:
Ubene bilha shipchat rachel dan venaptali
Ubene bilha amta derachel dan venaptali:
Ubene zilpa shipchat lea gad veasher elleh bene yaaqob asher yullad-lo bepaddan aram
Ubene zilpa amta delea gad veasher illen bene yaaqob di ityelidan leh bepaddan aram:
Vayyabo yaaqob el-yitzchaq abiv mamre qiryat haarba hiv chebron asher-gar-sham abraham veyitzchaq
Vaata yaaqob levat yitzchaq abuhi mamre qiryat arba hi chebron di dar tamman abraham veyitzchaq:
Vayyiheyu yeme yitzchaq meat shana ushemonim shana
Vahavo yome yitzchaq mea utemanan shenin:
Vayyigva yitzchaq vayyamot vayyeasep el-ammayv zaqen useba yamim vayyiqberu oto esav veyaaqob banayv
Veitnegid yitzchaq umit veitkenish leammeh sib useba yomin uqebaru yateh esav veyaaqob benohi:
Veelleh toledot esav hu edom
Veillen tuledat esav hu edom:
Esav laqach et-nashayv mibbenot kenaan et-ada bat-elon hachitti veet-oholibama bat-ana bat-tzibon hachivvi
Esav nesib yat neshohi mibbenat kenaan yat ada bat elon chittaa veyat oholibama bat ana bat tzibon chivvaa:
Veet-basemat bat-yishmael achot nebayot
Veyat basemat bat yishmael achateh dinbayot:
Vatteled ada leesav et-elipaz ubasemat yaleda et-reuel
Vilidat ada leesav yat elipaz ubasemat yelidat yat reuel:
Veoholibama yaleda et-yeush veet-yalam veet-qorach elleh bene esav asher yulledu-lo beeretz kenaan
Veoholibama yelidat yat yeush veyat yalam veyat qorach illen bene esav di ityelidu leh beara diknaan:
Vayyiqqach esav et-nashayv veet-banayv veet-benotayv veet-kol-napshot beto veet-miqnehu veet-kol-behemto veet kol-qinyano asher rakash beeretz kenaan vayyelek el-eretz mippene yaaqob achiv
Udebar esav yat neshohi veyat benohi veyat benateh veyat kol napshat beteh veyat getohi veyat kol beireh veyat kol qinyaneh di qena beara diknaan vaazal leara achare min qodam yaaqob achuhi:
Ki-haya rekusham rab mishshebet yachdav velo yakela eretz megurehem laset otam mippene miqnehem
Are hava qinyanehon saggi millemittab kachada vela yekilat ara totabutehon lesobara yatehon min qodam getehon:
Vayyesheb esav behar seir esav hu edom
Viteb esav betura deseir esav hu edom:
Veelleh toledot esav abi edom behar seir
Veillen tuledat esav abuhon deedomae betura deseir:
Elleh shemot bene-esav elipaz ben-ada eshet esav reuel ben-basemat eshet esav
Illen shemahat bene esav elipaz bar ada ittat esav reuel bar basemat ittat esav:
Vayyihyu bene elipaz teman omar tzepo vegatam uqenaz
Vahavo bene elipaz teman omar tzepo vegatam uqenaz:
Vetimna hayeta pilegesh leelipaz ben-esav vatteled leelipaz et-amaleq elleh bene ada eshet esav
Vetimna havat lechenata leelipaz bar esav vilidat leelipaz yat amaleq illen bene ada ittat esav:
Veelleh bene reuel nachat vazerach shamma umizza elleh hayu bene basemat eshet esav
Veillen bene reuel nachat vazerach shamma umizza illen havo bene basemat ittat esav:
Veelleh hayu bene oholibama bat-ana bat-tzibon eshet esav vatteled leesav et-yeush veet-yalam veet-qorach
Veillen havo bene oholibama bat ana bat tzibon ittat esav vilidat leesav yat yeush veyat yalam veyat qorach:
Elleh allupe bene-esav bene elipaz bekor esav allup teman allup omar allup tzepo allup qenaz
Illen rabrebe bene esav bene elipaz bukera deesav rabba teman rabba omar rabba tzepo rabba qenaz:
Allup-qorach allup gatam allup amaleq elleh allupe elipaz beeretz edom elleh bene ada
Rabba qorach rabba gatam rabba amaleq illen rabrebe deelipaz beara deedom illen bene ada:
Veelleh bene reuel ben-esav allup nachat allup zerach allup shamma allup mizza elleh allupe reuel beeretz edom elleh bene basemat eshet esav
Veillen bene reuel bar esav rabba nachat rabba zerach rabba shamma rabba mizza illen rabrebe reuel beara deedom illen bene basemat ittat esav:
Veelleh bene oholibama eshet esav allup yeush allup yalam allup qorach elleh allupe oholibama bat-ana eshet esav
Veillen bene oholibama ittat esav rabba yeush rabba yalam rabba qorach illen rabrebe oholibama bat ana ittat esav:
Elleh bene-esav veelleh allupehem hu edom
Illen bene esav veillen rabrebanehon hu edom:
Elleh bene-seir hachori yoshebe haaretz lotan veshobal vetzibon vaana
Illen bene seir choraa yatebe deara lotan veshobal vetzibon vaana:
Vedishon veetzer vedishan elleh allupe hachori bene seir beeretz edom
Vedishon veetzer vedishan illen rabrebe chorae bene seir beara deedom:
Vayyihyu bene-lotan chori vehemam vaachot lotan timna
Vahavo bene lotan chori vehemam vaachateh delotan timna:
Veelleh bene shobal alvan umanachat veebal shepo veonam
Veillen bene shobal alvan umanachat veebal shepo veonam:
Veelleh bene-tzibon veayya vaana hu ana asher matza et-hayyemim bammidbar biroto et-hachamorim letzibon abiv
Veillen bene tzibon veayya vaana hu ana di ashkach yat gibbarayya bemadbera kad hava rae yat chamarayya letzibon abuhi:
Veelleh bene-ana dishon veoholibama bat-ana
Veillen bene ana dishon veoholibama bat ana:
Veelleh bene dishan chemdan veeshban veyitran ukeran
Veillen bene dishan chemdan veeshban veyitran ukeran:
Elleh bene-etzer bilhan vezaavan vaaqan
Illen bene etzer bilhan vezaavan vaaqan:
Elleh bene-dishan utz vaaran
Illen bene dishan utz vaaran:
Elleh allupe hachori allup lotan allup shobal allup tzibon allup ana
Illen rabrebe choraa rabba lotan rabba shobal rabba tzibon rabba ana:
Allup dishon allup etzer allup dishan elleh allupe hachori leallupehem beeretz seir
Rabba dishon rabba etzer rabba dishan illen rabrebe choraa lerabrebanehon beara deseir:
Veelleh hammelakim asher maleku beeretz edom lipne melok-melek libne yisrael
Veillen malkayya di meliku beara deedom qodam di melak malka libne yisrael:
Vayyimlok beedom bela ben-beor veshem iro dinhaba
Umelak beedom bela bar beor veshum qarteh dinhaba:
Vayyamot bala vayyimlok tachtayv yobab ben-zerach mibbotzra
Umit bala umelak techotohi yobab bar zerach mibbatzera:
Vayyamot yobab vayyimlok tachtayv chusham meeretz hattemani
Umit yobab umelak techotohi chusham meara daroma:
Vayyamot chusham vayyimlok tachtayv hadad ben-bedad hammakkeh et-midyan bisdeh moab veshem iro avit
Umit chusham umelak techotohi hadad bar bedad diqtil yat midyanae bechaqla demoab veshum qarteh avit:
Vayyamot hadad vayyimlok tachtayv samla mimmasreqa
Umit hadad umelak techotohi samla mimmasreqa:
Vayyamot samla vayyimlok tachtayv shaul merechobot hannahar
Umit samla umelak techotohi shaul merechobe deal perat:
Vayyamot shaul vayyimlok tachtayv baal chanan ben-akbor
Umit shaul umelak techotohi baal chanan bar akbor:
Vayyamot baal chanan ben-akbor vayyimlok tachtayv hadar veshem iro pau veshem ishto mehetabel bat-matred bat me zahab
Umit baal chanan bar akbor umelak techotohi hadar veshum qarteh pau veshum itteteh mehetabel bat matred bat metzarep dahaba:
Veelleh shemot allupe esav lemishpechotam limqomotam bishmotam allup timna allup aleva allup yetet
Veillen shemahat rabrebe esav lezarayatehon leatrehon bishmahatehon rabba timna rabba alva rabba yetet:
Allup oholibama allup ela allup pinon
Rabba oholibama rabba ela rabba pinon:
Allup qenaz allup teman allup mibtzar
Rabba qenaz rabba teman rabba mibtzar:
Allup magdiel allup iram elleh allupe edom lemoshebotam beeretz achuzzatam hu esav abi edom
Rabba magdiel rabba iram illen rabrebe edom lemotebanehon beara achasantehon hu esav abuhon deedomae:
Vayyesheb yaaqob beeretz megure abiv beeretz kenaan
Viteb yaaqob beara totabut abuhi beara diknaan:
Elleh toledot yaaqob yosep ben-sheba-esreh shana haya roeh et-echayv batztzon vehu naar et-bene bilha veet-bene zilpa neshe abiv vayyabe yosep et-dibbatam raa el-abihem
Illen tuledat yaaqob yosep bar sheba asre shenin kad hava rae im achohi baana vehu merabbe im bene bilha veim bene zilpa neshe abuhi veayti yosep yat dibbehon bisha levat abuhon:
Veyisrael ahab et-yosep mikkol-banayv ki-ben-zequnim hu lo veasa lo ketonet passim
Veyisrael rechem yat yosep mikkol benohi are bar chakkim hu leh vaabad leh kittuna depasse:
Vayyiru echayv ki-oto ahab abihem mikkol-echayv vayyisneu oto velo yakelu dabbero leshalom
Vachazo achohi are yateh rechem abuhon mikkol achohi useno yateh vela tzaban lemallala immeh lishlam:
Vayyachalom yosep chalom vayyagged leechayv vayyosipu od seno oto
Vachalam yosep chelma vechavvi laachohi veosipu od seno yateh:
Vayyomer alehem shimu-na hachalom hazzeh asher chalameti
Vaamar lehon shemau kean chelma haden di chalemit:
Vehinneh anachnu meallemim alummim betok hassadeh vehinneh qama alummati vegam-nitztzaba vehinneh tesubbena alummotekem vattishetachavena laalummati
Veha anachna measserin esaran bego chaqla veha qamat esarti veap izdeqapat veha mistacharan esaratekon vesagedan leesarti:
Vayyomeru lo echayv hamalok timlok alenu im-mashol timshol banu vayyosipu od seno oto al-chalomotayv veal-debarayv
Vaamaru leh achohi hamalku at medamme lemimlak alana o shuletan at sebir lemishlat bana veosipu od seno yateh al chelmohi veal pitgamohi:
Vayyachalom od chalom acher vayesapper oto leechayv vayyomer hinneh chalamti chalom od vehinneh hashshemesh vehayyareach veachad asar kokabim mishetachavim li
Vachalam od chelma acharana veishtae yateh laachohi vaamar ha chalemit chelma od veha shimsha vesihara vechad asar kokebayya sagedan li:
Vayesapper el-abiv veel-echayv vayyigar-bo abiv vayyomer lo ma hachalom hazzeh asher chalameta habo nabo ani veimmeka veacheka lehishtachavot leka aretza
Veishtae laabuhi velaachohi unezap beh abuhi vaamar leh ma chelma haden di chalemeta hameta nete ana veimmak veachayk lemisgud lak al ara:
Vayeqanu-bo echayv veabiv shamar et-haddabar
Veqanniu beh achohi vaabuhi netar yat pitgama:
Vayyeleku echayv lirot et-tzon abihem bishkem
Vaazalu achohi lemire yat ana daabuhon bishkem:
Vayyomer yisrael el-yosep halo acheka roim bishkem leka veeshlachaka alehem vayyomer lo hinneni
Vaamar yisrael leyosep hala achayk raan bishkem eta veeshlechinnak levatehon vaamar leh ha ana:
Vayyomer lo lek-na reeh et-shelom acheka veet-shelom hatztzon vahashibeni dabar vayyishlachehu meemeq chebron vayyabo shekema
Vaamar leh izel kean chaze yat shelama deachuk veyat shelama deana vaatebni pitgama veshalcheh mimmeshar chebron vaata lishkem:
Vayyimtzaehu ish vehinneh toeh bassadeh vayyishalehu haish lemor mah-tebaqqesh
Veashkecheh gabra veha tae bechaqla ushealinneh gabra lememar ma at bae:
Vayyomer et-achay anoki mebaqqesh haggida-na li epoh hem roim
Vaamar yat achay ana bae chavvi kean li heka innun raan:
Vayyomer haish naseu mizzeh ki shamati omerim neleka dotayena vayyelek yosep achar echayv vayyimtzaem bedotan
Vaamar gabra netalu mikka are shemait deamerin nezel ledotan vaazal yosep batar achohi veashkechinnun bedotan:
Vayyiru oto merachoq ubeterem yiqrab alehem vayyitenakkelu oto lahamito
Vachazo yateh merachiq ad la qereb levatehon vechashshibu alohi lemiqteleh:
Vayyomeru ish el-achiv hinneh baal hachalomot hallazeh ba
Vaamaru gebar laachuhi ha mare chelmayya deki ata:
Veatta leku venahargehu venashlikehu beachad habborot veamarnu chayya raa akalatehu venireh mah-yihyu chalomotayv
Ukean eto veniqtelinneh venirminneh bachada min gubbayya venemar chayta bisheta akalteh venecheze ma yehon besop chelmohi:
Vayyishma reuben vayyatztzilehu miyyadam vayyomer lo nakkennu napesh
Ushema reuben veshezebeh midehon vaamar la niqtelinneh nepash:
Vayyomer alehem reuben al-tishpeku-dam hashliku oto el-habbor hazzeh asher bammidbar veyad al-tishlechu-bo lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam lahashibo el-abiv
Vaamar lehon reuben la toshedun dema remo yateh legubba haden di bemadbera vida la toshetun beh bedil leshezaba yateh midehon laatabuteh levat abuhi:
Vayehi kaasher-ba yosep el-echayv vayyapshitu et-yosep et-kuttonto et-ketonet happassim asher alayv
Vahava kad al yosep levat achuhi veashlachu yat yosep yat kittuneh yat kittuna depasse di alohi:
Vayyiqqachuhu vayyashliku oto habbora vehabbor req en bo mayim
Venasebuhi uremo yateh legubba vegubba reqa let beh mayya:
Vayyeshebu leekol-lechem vayyisu enehem vayyiru vehinneh orechat yishmeelim baa miggilad ugemallehem noseim nekot utzeri valot holekim lehorid mitzrayema
Veascharu lemekal lachma uzeqapu enehon vachazo veha sheyarat arabae ateya miggilad vegamlehon teinin sheap uqetap uletom azelin laachata lemitzrayim:
Vayyomer yehuda el-echayv mah-betza ki naharog et-achinu vekissinu et-damo
Vaamar yehuda laachohi ma mamon nithane lana are niqtol yat achuna unekasse al demeh:
Leku venimkerennu layyishmeelim veyadenu al-tehi-bo ki-achinu besarenu hu vayyishmeu echayv
Etu unezabbeninneh laarabae vidana la tehe beh are achuna bisrana hu veqabbilu minneh achohi:
Vayyaabru anashim midyanim socharim vayyimsheku vayyaalu et-yosep min-habbor vayyimkeru et-yosep layyishmeelim beesrim kasep vayyabiu et-yosep mitzrayema
Vaabaru gabre midyanae taggare unegidu veassiqu yat yosep min gubba vezabbinu yat yosep laarabae beesrin kesap veaytiyu yat yosep lemitzrayim:
Vayyashob reuben el-habbor vehinneh en-yosep babbor vayyiqra et-begadayv
Vetab reuben legubba veha let yosep begubba ubeza yat lebushohi:
Vayyashob el-echayv vayyomar hayyeled enennu vaani ana ani-ba
Vetab levat achohi vaamar ulema letohi vaana lean ana ate:
Vayyiqchu et-ketonet yosep vayyishchatu seir izzim vayyitbelu et-hakkuttonet baddam
Unesibu yat kittuna deyosep unekisu tzepir bar izze utebalu yat kittuna bidma:
Vayeshallechu et-ketonet happassim vayyabiu el-abihem vayyomeru zot matzanu hakker-na hakketonet binka hiv im-lo
Veshallachu yat kittuna depasse veaytiyu levat abuhon vaamaru da ashkachna ishtemoda kean hakittuna dibrak hi im la:
Vayyakkirah vayyomer ketonet beni chayya raa akalatehu tarop torap yosep
Veishtemodeah vaamar kittuna dibri chayta bisheta akalatteh miqtal qetil yosep:
Vayyiqra yaaqob simlotayv vayyasem saq bemotnayv vayyitabbel al-beno yamim rabbim
Ubeza yaaqob lebushohi vaasar saqqa bechartzeh veitabbal al bereh yomin saggiin:
Vayyaqumu kol-banayv vekol-benotayv lenachamo vayemaen lehitnachem vayyomer ki-ered el-beni abel sheola vayyebk oto abiv
Veqamu kol benohi vekol benateh lenachamuteh vesareb leqabbala tanchumin vaamar are echot levat al beri kad abela lishol ubeka yateh abuhi:
Vehammedanim makeru oto el-mitzrayim lepotipar seris paroh sar hattabbachim
Umidyanae zabbinu yateh lemitzrayim lepotipar rabba deparoh rab qatolayya:
Vayehi baet hahiv vayyered yehuda meet echayv vayyet ad-ish adullami ushemo chira
Vahava beiddana hahi unechat yehuda millevat achohi useta ad gabra adullamaa ushemeh chira:
Vayyar-sham yehuda bat-ish kenaani ushemo shua vayyiqqacheha vayyabo eleha
Vachaza tamman yehuda bat gebar taggara ushemeh shua venasebah veal levatah:
Vattahar vatteled ben vayyiqra et-shemo er
Veaddiat vilidat bar uqera yat shemeh er:
Vattahar od vatteled ben vattiqra et-shemo onan
Veaddiat od vilidat bar uqerat yat shemeh onan:
Vattosep od vatteled ben vattiqra et-shemo shela vehaya bikzib belidtah oto
Veosipat od vilidat bar uqerat yat shemeh shela vahava bikzib kad yelidat yateh:
Vayyiqqach yehuda ishsha leer bekoro ushemah tamar
Unesib yehuda itteta leer bukereh ushemah tamar:
Vayehi er bekor yehuda ra beene Adonai vayemitehu Adonai
Vahava er bukera dihuda bish qodam Adonai vaamiteh Adonai:
Vayyomer yehuda leonan bo el-eshet achika veyabbem otah vehaqem zera leachika
Vaamar yehuda leonan ul levat ittat achuk veyabbem yatah vaaqem zara leachuk:
Vayyeda onan ki lo lo yihyeh hazzara vehaya im-ba el-eshet achiv veshichet artza lebilti neton-zera leachiv
Vida onan are la al shemeh mitqere zara vahava kad alil levat ittat achuhi umechabbel orcheh al ara bedil dela leqayyama zara laachuhi:
Vayyera beene Adonai asher asa vayyamet gam-oto
Ubeesh qodam Adonai di abad vaamit ap yateh:
Vayyomer yehuda letamar kallato shebi almana bet-abik ad-yigdal shela beni ki amar pen-yamut gam-hv keechayv vattelek tamar vattesheb bet abiha
Vaamar yehuda letamar kalleteh tibi armela bet abik ad dirba shela beri are amar dilma yemut ap hu keachohi vaazalat tamar vitibat bet abuha:
Vayyirbu hayyamim vattamot bat-shva eshet-yehuda vayyinnachem yehuda vayyaal al-gozeze tzono hu vechira reehu haadullami timnata
Usegiu yomayya umitat bat shua ittat yehuda veitnachem yehuda useliq al gozeze aneh hu vechira rachameh adullamaa letimnat:
Vayyuggad letamar lemor hinneh chamik oleh timnata lagoz tzono
Veitchavva letamar lememar ha chamuyik saleq letimnat lemegaz aneh:
Vattasar bigde almenutah mealeha vattekas batztzaip vattitallap vattesheb bepetach enayim asher al-derek timnata ki raata ki-gadal shela vehiv lo-nittena lo leishsha
Veadiat lebushe armelutah minnah veitkassiat beepa veittaqqanat vitibat beparashut aynin di al orach timnat are chazat are reba shela vehi la ityehibat leh leintu:
Vayyireha yehuda vayyachshebeha lezona ki kisseta paneha
Vachazaah yehuda vechashshebah kenapeqat bara are kassiat appaha:
Vayyet eleha el-hadderek vayyomer haba-na abo elayik ki lo yada ki kallato hiv vattomer mah-titten-li ki tabo elay
Useta levatah leorcha vaamar habi kean eol levatik are la yeda are kalleteh hi vaameret mah titten li are teol levati:
Vayyomer anoki ashallach gedi-izzim min-hatztzon vattomer im-titten erabon ad sholcheka
Vaamar ana ashallach gadya bar izze min ana vaameret im titten mashkona ad detishlach:
Vayyomer ma haerabon asher etten-lak vattomer chotameka upetileka umatteka asher beyadeka vayyitten-la vayyabo eleha vattahar lo
Vaamar ma mashkona di etten lak vaameret izqetak veshoshippak vechuterak di bidak vihab lah veal levatah veaddiat leh:
Vattaqom vattelek vattasar tzeipah mealeha vattilbash bigde almenutah
Veqamat vaazalat veadiat epah minnah ulebeshat lebushe armelutah:
Vayyishlach yehuda et-gedi haizzim beyad reehu haadullami laqachat haerabon miyyad haishsha velo metzaah
Veshaddar yehuda yat gadya bar izze bida rachameh adullamaa lemissab mashkona mida deitteta vela ashkechah:
Vayyishal et-anshe meqomah lemor ayyeh haqqedesha hiv baenayim al-haddarek vayyomeru lo-hayeta bazeh qedesha
Usheil yat anashe atrah lememar an meqaddishta hi beaynin al orcha vaamaru let haka meqaddishta:
Vayyashob el-yehuda vayyomer lo metzatiha vegam anshe hammaqom ameru lo-hayeta bazeh qedesha
Vetab levat yehuda vaamar la ashkechitah veap anashe atra amaru let haka meqaddishta:
Vayyomer yehuda tiqqach-la pen nihyeh labuz hinneh shalachti haggedi hazzeh veatta lo metzatah
Vaamar yehuda tissab lah dilema nehe lechok ha shaddarit gadya haden veat la ashkechittah:
Vayehi kemishlosh chodashim vayyuggad lihuda lemor zaneta tamar kallateka vegam hinneh hara liznunim vayyomer yehuda hotziuha vetissarep
Vahava kitlatut yarchayya veitchavva lihuda lememar zanniat tamar kalletak veap ha madeya liznuta vaamar yehuda appequha vetittoqad:
Hiv mutzet vehi shalecha el-chamiha lemor leish asher-elleh lo anoki hara vattomer hakker-na lemi hachotemet vehappetilim vehammatteh haelleh
Hi mittappeqa vehi shelachat lachamuha lememar ligbar di illen dileh minneh ana madeya vaameret ishtemoda kean leman izqeta veshoshippa vechutera haillen:
Vayyakker yehuda vayyomer tzadeqa mimmenni ki-al-ken lo-netattiha leshela beni velo-yasap od ledatah
Veishtemoda yehuda vaamar zakkaa minni madeya are al ken la yehabittah leshela beri vela osip od lemideah:
Vayehi beet lidtah vehinneh teomim bebitnah
Vahava beiddan demeledah veha teyomin bimaha:
Vayehi belidtah vayyitten-yad vattiqqach hameyalledet vattiqshor al-yado shani lemor zeh yatza rishona
Vahava bemeledah vihab yeda unesibat chayta uqetarat al yedeh zehorita lememar den nepaq qadmaa:
Vayehi kemeshib yado vehinneh yatza achiv vattomer mah-paratzta aleka paretz vayyiqra shemo paretz
Vahava kad ateb yedeh veha nepaq achuhi vaameret ma teqop saggi alak lemitqap uqera shemeh paretz:
Veachar yatza achiv asher al-yado hashshani vayyiqra shemo zarach
Ubatar ken nepaq achuhi di al yedeh zehorita uqera shemeh zarach:
Veyosep hurad mitzrayema vayyiqnehu potipar seris paroh sar hattabbachim ish mitzri miyyad hayyishmeelim asher horiduhu shamma
Veyosep ittachat lemitzrayim uzebaneh potipar rabba deparoh rab qatolayya gebar mitzraa mida daarabae di achitohi letamman:
Vayehi Adonai et-yosep vayehi ish matzliach vayehi bebet adonayv hammitzri
Vahava memera daAdonai besadeh deyosep vahava gebar matzlach vahava bebet ribboneh mitzraa:
Vayyar adonayv ki Adonai itto vekol asher-hv oseh Adonai matzliach beyado
Vachaza ribboneh are memera daAdonai besadeh vekol di hu abed Adonai matzlach bideh:
Vayyimtza yosep chen beenayv vayesharet oto vayyapqidehu al-beto vekol-yesh-lo natan beyado
Veashkach yosep rachamin beenohi veshammesh yateh umanyeh al beteh vekol di it leh mesar bideh:
Vayehi meaz hipqid oto bebeto veal kol-asher yesh-lo vayebarek Adonai et-bet hammitzri biglal yosep vayehi birkat Adonai bekol-asher yesh-lo babbayit ubassadeh
Vahava meiddan demanne yateh bebeteh veal kol di it leh ubarik Adonai yat bet mitzraa bedil yosep vahava birketa daAdonai bekol di it leh bebeta ubechaqla:
Vayyaazob kol-asher-lo beyad-yosep velo-yada itto meuma ki im-hallechem asher-hv okel vayehi yosep yepeh-toar vipeh mareh
Ushebaq kol di leh bida deyosep vela yeda immeh middaam ellahen lachma di hu akel vahava yosep shappir bereva veyae bechezva:
Vayehi achar haddebarim haelleh vattissa eshet-adonayv et-eneha el-yosep vattomer shikba immi
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillen uzeqapat ittat ribboneh yat enaha leyosep vaameret shekub immi:
Vayemaen vayyomer el-eshet adonayv hen adoni lo-yada itti mah-babbayit vekol asher-yesh-lo natan beyadi
Vesareb vaamar levat ittat ribboneh ha ribboni la yeda immi ma dibbeta vekol di it leh mesar bidi:
Enennu gadol babbayit hazzeh mimmenni velo-chasak mimmenni meuma ki im-otak baasher at-ishto veek eeseh haraa haggedola hazzot vechatati lelohim
Letohi rab bebeta haden minni vela mena minni middaam ellahen yatik bedil at itteteh veekden ebed bisheta rabbeta hada veechob qodam Adonai:
Vayehi kedabberah el-yosep yom yom velo-shama eleha lishkab etzlah lihyot immah
Vahava kad mallelat im yosep yom yom vela qabbil minnah lemishkab levatah lemeheve immah:
Vayehi kehayyom hazzeh vayyabo habbayta laasot melakto veen ish meanshe habbayit sham babbayit
Vahava beyoma haden veal lebeta lemibdaq bekitbe chashebeneh velet enash meanashe beta tamman bebeta:
Vattitpesehu bebigdo lemor shikba immi vayyaazob bigdo beyadah vayyanos vayyetze hachutza
Vaachidteh bilbusheh lememar shekub immi veshabeqeh lilbusheh bidah vaaraq unepaq leshuqa:
Vayehi kirotah ki-azab bigdo beyadah vayyanos hachutza
Vahava kad chazat are shabeqeh lilbusheh bidah vaaraq leshuqa:
Vattiqra leanshe betah vattomer lahem lemor reu hebi lanu ish ibri letzacheq banu ba elay lishkab immi vaeqra beqol gadol
Uqerat laanashe betah vaameret lehon lememar chazo ayti lana gabra ibraa lechayyaka bana al levati lemishkab immi uqeret beqala rabba:
Vayehi keshomo ki-harimoti qoli vaeqra vayyaazob bigdo etzli vayyanos vayyetze hachutza
Vahava kad shema are aremit qali uqeret veshabeqeh lilbusheh levati vaaraq unepaq leshuqa:
Vattannach bigdo etzlah ad-bo adonayv el-beto
Vaachitteteh lilbusheh levatah ad deal ribboneh lebeteh:
Vattedabber elayv kaddebarim haelleh lemor ba-elay haebed haibri asher-hebeta lanu letzacheq bi
Umallelat immeh kepitgamayya haillen lememar al levati abda ibraa di ayteta lana lechayyaka bi:
Vayehi kaharimi qoli vaeqra vayyaazob bigdo etzli vayyanos hachutza
Vahava kad aremit qali uqeret veshabeqeh lilbusheh levati vaaraq leshuqa:
Vayehi kishmoa adonayv et-dibre ishto asher dibbera elayv lemor kaddebarim haelleh asa li abdeka vayyichar appo
Vahava kad shema ribboneh yat pitgame itteteh di mallelat immeh lememar kepitgamayya haillen abad li abdak uteqep rogzeh:
Vayyiqqach adone yosep oto vayyittenehu el-bet hassohar meqom asher-asire hammelek asurim vayehi-sham bebet hassohar
Unesib ribboneh deyosep yateh umanneyeh lebet asire atar di asire malka asirin vahava tamman bebet asire:
Vayehi Adonai et-yosep vayyet elayv chased vayyitten chinno beene sar bet-hassohar
Vahava memera daAdonai besadeh deyosep unegad leh chisda vihabeh lerachamin beene rab bet asire:
Vayyitten sar bet-hassohar beyad-yosep et kol-haasirim asher bebet hassohar veet kol-asher osim sham hu haya oseh
Umanne rab bet asire bida deyosep yat kol asirayya di bebet asire veyat kol di abedin tamman al memereh hava mitabed:
En sar bet-hassohar roeh et-kol-meuma beyado baasher Adonai itto vaasher-hv oseh Adonai matzliach
Let rab bet asire chaze yat kol sarechan bideh bedi memera daAdonai besadeh vedi hu abed Adonai matzlach:
Vayehi achar haddebarim haelleh chateu mashqeh melek-mitzrayim vehaopeh laadonehem lemelek mitzrayim
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillen serachu shaqeya malka demitzrayim venachtoma leribbonehon lemalka demitzrayim:
Vayyiqtzop paroh al shene sarisayv al sar hammashqim veal sar haopim
Uregez paroh al teren rabrebanohi al rab shaqe veal rab nachtome:
Vayyitten otam bemishmar bet sar hattabbachim el-bet hassohar meqom asher yosep asur sham
Vihab yatehon bemattera bet rab qatolayya lebet asire atar di yosep asir tamman:
Vayyipqod sar hattabbachim et-yosep ittam vayesharet otam vayyihyu yamim bemishmar
Umanni rab qatolayya yat yosep immehon veshammesh yatehon vahavo yomin bemattera:
Vayyachalmu chalom shenehem ish chalomo belayla echad ish kepitron chalomo hammashqeh vehaopeh asher lemelek mitzrayim asher asurim bebet hassohar
Vachalamu chelma tarvehon gebar chelmeh beleleya chad gebar kepusheran chelmeh shaqeya venachtoma di lemalka demitzrayim di asirin bebet asire:
Vayyabo alehem yosep babboqer vayyar otam vehinnam zoapim
Vaata levatehon yosep betzapra vachaza yatehon veha innun nesisin:
Vayyishal et-serise paroh asher itto bemishmar bet adonayv lemor maddua penekem raim hayyom
Usheel yat rabrebe paroh di immeh bemattera bet ribboneh lememar ma den appekon bishin yoma den:
Vayyomeru elayv chalom chalamnu upoter en oto vayyomer alehem yosep halo lelohim pitronim sapperu-na li
Vaamaru leh chelma chalemena upashar let leh vaamar lehon yosep hala min qodam Adonai pusheran chelmayya ishtau kean li:
Vayesapper sar-hammashqim et-chalomo leyosep vayyomer lo bachalomi vehinneh-gepen lepanay
Veishtai rab shaqe yat chelmeh leyosep vaamar leh bechelmi veha gupena qodamay:
Ubaggepen shelosha sarigim vehiv keporachat aleta nitztzah hibshilu ashkeloteha anabim
Ubegupena telata shibshin vehi kad aprachat appeqat lablebin vaanitzat netz bashshilu itkelataha innebin:
Vekos paroh beyadi vaeqqach et-haanabim vaeschat otam el-kos paroh vaetten et-hakkos al-kap paroh
Vekassa deparoh bidi unesebit yat innebayya veatztzarit yatehon lekassa deparoh vihabit yat kassa al yeda deparoh:
Vayyomer lo yosep zeh pitrono sheloshet hassarigim sheloshet yamim hem
Vaamar leh yosep den pishraneh telata shibshin telata yomin innun:
