Beod sheloshet yamim yissa paroh et-rosheka vahashibeka al-kanneka venatatta kos-paroh beyado kammishpat harishon asher hayita mashqehu
Besop telata yomin yadberinnak paroh yat reshak vitebinnak al shimmushak vetitten kassa deparoh bideh kehilketa qadmaa di haveta mashqe leh:
Ki im-zekartani itteka kaasher yitab lak veasita-na immadi chased vehizkartani el-paroh vehotzetani min-habbayit hazzeh
Ellahen tidkerinnani immak kad yetab lak vetabed kean immi tibu vetidkar alay qodam paroh vetappeqinnani min bet asira haden:
Ki-gunnob gunnabti meeretz haibrim vegam-poh lo-asiti meuma ki-samu oti babbor
Are mignab genebena meara deibrae veap haka la abadit middaam are shavviu yati bebet asire:
Vayyar sar-haopim ki tob patar vayyomer el-yosep ap-ani bachalomi vehinneh shelosha salle chori al-roshi
Vachaza rab nachtome are yaut pashar vaamar leyosep ap ana bechelmi veha telata sallin dechiru al reshi:
Ubassal haelyon mikkol maakal paroh maaseh opeh vehaop okel otam min-hassal meal roshi
Ubesalla illaa mikkol mekal paroh obad nachtom veopa akel yatehon min salla meillave reshi:
Vayyaan yosep vayyomer zeh pitrono sheloshet hassallim sheloshet yamim hem
Vaateb yosep vaamar den pishraneh telata sallin telata yomin innun:
Beod sheloshet yamim yissa paroh et-rosheka mealeka vetala oteka al-etz veakal haop et-besareka mealeka
Besop telata yomin yadi paroh yat reshak minnak veyitzlob yatak al tzeliba veyekul opa yat bisrak minnak:
Vayehi bayyom hashshelishi yom hulledet et-paroh vayyaas mishteh lekol-abadayv vayyissa et-rosh sar hammashqim veet-rosh sar haopim betok abadayv
Vahava beyoma telitaa yoma bet valeda deparoh vaabad mishteya lekol abdohi veidkar yat resh rab shaqe veyat resh rab nachtome bego abdohi:
Vayyasheb et-sar hammashqim al-mashqehu vayyitten hakkos al-kap paroh
Vaateb yat rab shaqe al shaqyuteh vihab yat kassa al yeda deparoh:
Veet sar haopim tala kaasher patar lahem yosep
Veyat rab nachtome tzelab kema di pashar lehon yosep:
Velo-zakar sar-hammashqim et-yosep vayyishkachehu
Vela dekir rab shaqe yat yosep veansheyeh:
Vayehi miqqetz shenatayim yamim uparoh cholem vehinneh omed al-hayeor
Vahava missop tarten shenin uparoh chalem veha qaem al nahara:
Vehinneh min-hayeor olot sheba parot yepot mareh uberiot basar vattirena baachu
Veha min nahara saleqan sheba toran shappiran lemecheze upattiman besar veraeyan beachava:
Vehinneh sheba parot acherot olot acharehen min-hayeor raot mareh vedaqqot basar vattaamodena etzel happarot al-sepat hayeor
Veha sheba toran ochoraneyan saleqan batrehon min nahara bishan lemecheze vachasiran besar veqaman leqiblehon detoran al kep nahara:
Vattokalna happarot raot hammareh vedaqqot habbasar et sheba happarot yepot hammareh vehabberiot vayyiqatz paroh
Vaakalan toreta bishan lemecheze vachasiran besar yat sheba toreta shappiran lemecheze upattimata veittear paroh:
Vayyishan vayyachalom shenit vehinneh sheba shibbolim olot beqaneh echad beriot vetobot
Udemuk vachalam tinyanut veha sheba shubbelayya saleqan beqanya chad pattiman vetaban:
Vehinneh sheba shibbolim daqqot ushedupot qadim tzomechot acharehen
Veha sheba shubbelayya laqeyan usheqipan qiddum tzamechan batrehon:
Vattiblana hashshibbolim haddaqqot et sheba hashshibbolim habberiot vehammeleot vayyiqatz paroh vehinneh chalom
Ubelaa shubbelayya laqeyata yat sheba shubbelayya pattimata umaleyata veittear paroh veha chelma:
Vayehi babboqer vattippaem rucho vayyishlach vayyiqra et-kol-chartumme mitzrayim veet-kol-chakameha vayesapper paroh lahem et-chalomo veen-poter otam leparoh
Vahava betzapra umittarpa rucheh ushelach uqera yat kol charashe mitzrayim veyat kol chakkimaha veishtai paroh lehon yat chelmeh velet depashar yatehon leparoh:
Vayedabber sar hammashqim et-paroh lemor et-chataay ani mazkir hayyom
Umallil rab shaqe im leparoh lememar yat sarechani ana madkar yoma den:
Paroh qatzap al-abadayv vayyitten oti bemishmar bet sar hattabbachim oti veet sar haopim
Paroh regez al abdohi vihab yati bematterat bet rab qatolayya yati veyat rab nachtome:
Vannachalma chalom belayla echad ani vahu ish kepitron chalomo chalamenu
Vachalemena chelma beleleya chad ana vahu gebar kepishran chelmeh chalemena:
Vesham ittanu naar ibri ebed lesar hattabbachim vannesapper-lo vayyiptor-lanu et-chalomotenu ish kachalomo patar
Vetamman immana ulem ibraa abda lerab qatolayya veishtaena leh upashar lana yat chelmana gebar kechelmeh pashar:
Vayehi kaasher patar-lanu ken haya oti heshib al-kanni veoto tala
Vahava kema di pashar lana ken hava yati ateb al shimmushi veyateh tzelab:
Vayyishlach paroh vayyiqra et-yosep vayeritzuhu min-habbor vayegallach vayechallep simlotayv vayyabo el-paroh
Ushelach paroh uqera yat yosep vearhitohi min bet asire vesappar veshanni kesuteh veal levat paroh:
Vayyomer paroh el-yosep chalom chalamti upoter en oto vaani shamati aleka lemor tishma chalom liptor oto
Vaamar paroh leyosep chelma chalemit upashar let leh vaana shimet alak lememar deat shama chelma lemipshar yateh:
Vayyaan yosep et-paroh lemor biladay elohim yaaneh et-shelom paroh
Vaateb yosep yat paroh lememar bar min chokmeti ellahen min qodam Adonai yitttab yat shelama deparoh:
Vayedabber paroh el-yosep bachalomi hinni omed al-sepat hayeor
Umallil paroh im leyosep bechelmi ha ana qaem al kep nahara:
Vehinneh min-hayeor olot sheba parot beriot basar vipot toar vattirena baachu
Veha min nahara saleqan sheba toreta pattiman besar veshappiran lemecheze veraeyan beachava:
Vehinneh sheba-parot acherot olot acharehen dallot veraot toar meod veraqqot basar lo-raiti kahenna bekol-eretz mitzrayim laroa
Veha sheba toreta ochoraneyan saleqan batrehon chasikan ubishan lemecheze lachada vachasiran besar la chazeti kevatehen bekol ara demitzrayim lebishu:
Vattokalna happarot haraqqot veharaot et sheba happarot harishonot habberiot
Vaakalan toreta chasikata ubishata yat sheba toreta qadmayata pattimata:
Vattabona el-qirbena velo noda ki-bau el-qirbena umarehen ra kaasher battechilla vaiqatz
Vaala limehen vela ityeda are allu limehen umechezehen bish kad beqadmeta veittearit:
Vaere bachalomi vehinneh sheba shibbolim olot beqaneh echad meleot vetobot
Vachazet bechelmi veha sheba shubbelayya saleqan beqanya chad maleyan vetaban:
Vehinneh sheba shibbolim tzenumot daqqot shedupot qadim tzomechot acharehem
Veha sheba shubbelayya natzan laqeyan sheqipan qiddum tzamechan batrehon:
Vattiblana hashshibbolim haddaqqot et sheba hashshibbolim hattobot vaomar el-hachartummim veen maggid li
Ubelaan shubbelayya laqeyata yat sheba shubbelayya tabata vaamarit lacharashayya velet di mechavve li:
Vayyomer yosep el-paroh chalom paroh echad hu et asher haelohim oseh higgid leparoh
Vaamar yosep leparoh chelma paroh chad hu yat di Adonai atid lemebad chavvi leparoh:
Sheba parot hattobot sheba shanim henna vesheba hashshibbolim hattobot sheba shanim henna chalom echad hu
Sheba toreta tabata sheba shenin innun usheba shubbelayya tabata sheba shenin innun chelma chad hu:
Vesheba happarot haraqqot veharaot haolot acharehen sheba shanim henna vesheba hashshibbolim hareqot shedupot haqqadim yihyu sheba shene raab
Usheba toreta chasikata ubishata desaleqan batrehon sheba shenin innun usheba shubbelayya laqeyata dishqipan qiddum yehevyan sheba shene kapna:
Hu haddabar asher dibbarti el-paroh asher haelohim oseh hera et-paroh
Hu pitgama di mallelit im paroh di Adonai atid lemebad achaze leparoh:
Hinneh sheba shanim baot saba gadol bekol-eretz mitzrayim
Ha sheba shenin ateyan siba rabba bekol ara demitzrayim:
Veqamu sheba shene raab acharehen venishkach kol-hassaba beeretz mitzrayim vekilla haraab et-haaretz
Viqumun sheba shene kapna batrehen veyittinshe kol siba beara demitzrayim vishetze kapna yat amma deara:
Velo-yivvada hassaba baaretz mippene haraab hahu achare-ken ki-kabed hu meod
Vela yityeda sobea beara min qadam kapna hahu dihe batar ken are taqip hu lachada:
Veal hishshanot hachalom el-paroh paamayim ki-nakon haddabar meim haelohim umemaher haelohim laasoto
Veal deittannet chelma leparoh tarten zimnin are taqqen pitgama min qodam Adonai veochi Adonai lemebedeh:
Veatta yere paroh ish nabon vechakam vishitehu al-eretz mitzrayim
Ukean yecheze paroh gebar sukeletan vechakkim umanneyeh al ara demitzrayim:
Yaaseh paroh veyapqed peqidim al-haaretz vechimmesh et-eretz mitzrayim besheba shene hassaba
Yabed paroh vimanne mehemenin al ara vizarez yat ara demitzrayim besheba shene sobea :
Veyiqbetzu et-kol-okel hashshanim hattobot habbaot haelleh veyitzberu-bar tachat yad-paroh okel bearim veshamaru
Veyikneshun yat kol ibur shenayya taban deateyan haillen veyitzberun ibura techot yeda deparoh ibura beqirevayya veyitterun:
Vehaya haokel lepiqqadon laaretz lesheba shene haraab asher tihyena beeretz mitzrayim velo-tikkaret haaretz baraab
Vihe ibura ganiz leamma d leara lishba shene kapna di tehevyan beara demitzrayim vela tishtetze amma deara bekapna:
Vayyitab haddabar beene paroh ubeene kol-abadayv
Ushepar pitgama beene paroh ubeene kol abdohi:
Vayyomer paroh el-abadayv hanimtza kazeh ish asher ruach elohim bo
Vaamar paroh leabdohi hanishkach keden gebar di ruach nebua min qodam Adonai beh:
Vayyomer paroh el-yosep achare hodia elohim oteka et-kol-zot en-nabon vechakam kamoka
Vaamar paroh leyosep batar deoda Adonai yatak yat kol da let sakeletan vechakkim kevatak:
Atta tihyeh al-beti veal-pika yishshaq kol-ammi raq hakkisse egdal mimmekka
At tehe memanna al beti veal memerak yittezan kol ammi lechod karese malkuta haden ehe yaqqir minnak:
Vayyomer paroh el-yosep reeh natatti oteka al kol-eretz mitzrayim
Vaamar paroh leyosep chaze manneti yatak al kol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyasar paroh et-tabbato meal yado vayyitten otah al-yad yosep vayyalbesh oto bigde-shesh vayyasem rebid hazzahab al-tzavvaro
Veadi paroh yat izqeteh meal yedeh vihab yatah al yeda deyosep vealbish yateh lebushin debutz veshavvi manika dedahaba al tzavvereh:
Vayyarkeb oto bemirkebet hammishneh asher-lo vayyiqreu lepanayv abrek venaton oto al kol-eretz mitzrayim
Vearkeb yateh birtikka tinyeta di leh veakrizu qodamohi den abba lemalka umanni yateh al kol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyomer paroh el-yosep ani paroh ubiladeka lo-yarim ish et-yado veet-raglo bekol-eretz mitzrayim
Vaamar paroh leyosep ana paroh ubar memerak la yerim gebar yat yedeh lemechad zen veyat ragleh lemirkab al suseya bekol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyiqra paroh shem-yosep tzapenat paneach vayyitten-lo et-asenat bat-poti pera kohen on leishsha vayyetze yosep al-eretz mitzrayim
Uqera paroh shum yosep gabra demittamran golyan leh vihab leh yat asenat bat poti pera rabba deon leitteta unepaq yosep shallit al ara demitzrayim:
Veyosep ben-sheloshim shana beomdo lipne paroh melek-mitzrayim vayyetze yosep millipne paroh vayyaabor bekol-eretz mitzrayim
Veyosep bar telatin shenin kad qam qodam paroh malka demitzrayim unepaq yosep min qodam paroh vaabar shallit bekol ara demitzrayim:
Vattaas haaretz besheba shene hassaba liqmatzim
Ukenashu dayere ara bishba shene sobea ibura leotzarin:
Vayyiqbotz et-kol-okel sheba shanim asher hayu beeretz mitzrayim vayyitten-okel bearim okel sedeh-hair asher sebiboteha natan betokah
Ukenash yat kol ibur sheba shenin di havo beara demitzrayim vihab ibur beqirvayya ibur chaqal qarta di besachranaha yehab begavvah:
Vayyitzbor yosep bar kechol hayyam harbeh meod ad ki-chadal lispor ki-en mispar
Ukenash yosep ibura kechalla deyamma saggi lachada ad di pesaq lemimne are let minyan:
Uleyosep yullad shene banim beterem tabo shenat haraab asher yaleda-lo asenat bat-poti pera kohen on
Uleyosep ityelid tarten benin ad la allat shatta dekapna diylidat leh asenat bat poti pera rabba deon:
Vayyiqra yosep et-shem habbekor menashsheh ki-nashshani elohim et-kol-amali veet kol-bet abi
Uqera yosep yat shum bukera menashsheh are ansheyani Adonai yat kol amli veyat kol bet abba:
Veet shem hashsheni qara eprayim ki-hiprani elohim beeretz onyi
Veyat shum tinyana qera eprayim are appeshani Adonai beara shibudi:
Vattiklena sheba shene hassaba asher haya beeretz mitzrayim
Ushelimat sheba shene sobea di hava beara demitzrayim:
Vattechillena sheba shene haraab labo kaasher amar yosep vayehi raab bekol-haaratzot ubekol-eretz mitzrayim haya lachem
Usheriat sheba shene kapna lemeal kema di amar yosep vahava kapna bekol arata ubekol ara demitzrayim hava lachma:
Vattirab kol-eretz mitzrayim vayyitzaq haam el-paroh lallachem vayyomer paroh lekol-mitzrayim leku el-yosep asher-yomar lakem taasu
Ukepanat kol ara demitzrayim utzevach amma qodam leparoh al lelachma vaamar paroh lekol mitzrae izilu levat yosep di yemar lekon tabedun:
Veharaab haya al kol-pene haaretz vayyiptach yosep et-kol-asher bahem vayyishbor lemitzrayim vayyechezaq haraab beeretz mitzrayim
Vekapna hava al kol appe ara upetach yosep yat kol otzerayya di behon ibura vezabbin lemitzrayim uteqep kapna beara demitzrayim:
Vekol-haaretz bau mitzrayma lishbor el-yosep ki-chazaq haraab bekol-haaretz
Vekol dayere ara allu lemitzrayim lemizban ibura min yosep are teqep kapna bekol ara:
Vayyar yaaqob ki yesh-sheber bemitzrayim vayyomer yaaqob lebanayv lamma titrau
Vachaza yaaqob are it ibura mizdabban bemitzrayim vaamar yaaqob libnohi lema titchazun:
Vayyomer hinneh shamati ki yesh-sheber bemitzrayim redu-shamma veshibru-lanu mishsham venichyeh velo namut
Vaamar ha shemait amerin are it ibura mizdabban bemitzrayim chutu tamman uzebunu lana mittamman veneche vela nemut:
Vayyeredu ache-yosep asara lishbor bar mimmitzrayim
Unechatu ache yosep asra lemizban ibura mimmitzrayim:
Veet-binyamin achi yosep lo-shalach yaaqob et-echayv ki amar pen-yiqraennu ason
Veyat binyamin achuhi deyosep la shelach yaaqob im achuhi are amar dilma yearinneh mota:
Vayyabou bene yisrael lishbor betok habbaim ki-haya haraab beeretz kenaan
Vaato bene yisrael lemizban ibura bego alayya are hava kapna beara diknaan:
Veyosep hu hashshallit al-haaretz hu hammashbir lekol-am haaretz vayyabou ache yosep vayyishtachavu-lo appayim aretza
Veyosep hu deshallit al ara hu dezabbin ibura lekol amma deara vaato ache yosep usegidu leh al appayya al ara:
Vayyar yosep et-echayv vayyakkirem vayyitnakker alehem vayedabber ittam qashot vayyomer alehem meayin batem vayyomeru meeretz kenaan lishbor-okel
Vachaza yosep yat achohi veishtemodeinnun vechashshib ma demallel lehon umallil immehon qashya vaamar lehon menan atetun vaamaru meara diknaan lemizban ibura:
Vayyakker yosep et-echayv vehem lo hikkiruhu
Veishtemoda yosep yat achohi veinnun la ishtemodeeh:
Vayyizkor yosep et hachalomot asher chalam lahem vayyomer alehem meraggelim attem lirot et-ervat haaretz batem
Udekir yosep yat chelmayya di chalim lehon vaamar lehon meallin attun lemecheze yat bidqa deara atetun:
Vayyomeru elayv lo adoni vaabadeka bau lishbor-okel
Vaamaru leh la ribboni veabdayk allu lemizban ibura:
Kullanu bene ish-echad nachenu kenim anachnu lo-hayu abadeka meraggelim
Kullana bene gabra chad nachena kevane anachna la havo abdayk allile:
Vayyomer alehem lo ki-ervat haaretz batem lirot
Vaamar lehon la are bidqa deara atetun lemecheze:
Vayyomeru shenem asar abadeka achim anachnu bene ish-echad beeretz kenaan vehinneh haqqaton et-abinu hayyom vehaechad enennu
Vaamaru teren asar abdayk achin anachna bene gabra chad beara diknaan veha zeera im abuna yoma den vechad letohi:
Vayyomer alehem yosep hu asher dibbarti alekem lemor meraggelim attem
Vaamar lehon yosep hu di mallelit immekon lememar meallile attun:
Bezot tibbachenu che paroh im-tetzeu mizzeh ki im-bebo achikem haqqaton henna
Beda titbachanun che paroh im tippequn mikka ellahen bemete achukon zeera haka:
Shilchu mikkem echad veyiqqach et-achikem veattem heaseru veyibbachanu dibrekem haemet ittekem veim-lo che paroh ki meraggelim attem
Shelachu minnekon chad vidabber yat achukon veattun hitasserun veyitbachanun pitgamekon haqshot attun amerin veim la che paroh are meallile attun:
Vayyeesop otam el-mishmar sheloshet yamim
Ukenash yatehon lebet lemattera telata yomin:
Vayyomer alehem yosep bayyom hashshelishi zot asu vicheyu et-haelohim ani yare
Vaamar lehon yosep beyoma telitaa da ibidu veqayyimu min qodam Adonai ana dachel:
Im-kenim attem achikem echad yeaser bebet mishmarkem veattem leku habiu sheber raabon battekem
Im kevane attun achukon chad yitassar bebet mattartekon veattun izilu obilu ibura dechassir bebattekon:
Veet-achikem haqqaton tabiu elay veyeamenu dibrekem velo tamutu vayyaasu-ken
Veyat achukon zeera taytun levati vihemenun pitgamekon vela temutun vaabadu ken:
Vayyomeru ish el-achiv abal ashemim anachnu al-achinu asher rainu tzarat napsho behitchaneno elenu velo shamaenu al-ken baa elenu hatztzara hazzot
Vaamaru gebar laachuhi bequsheta chayyabin anachna al achuna di chazena aqat napsheh kad hava mitchannen lana vela qabbelena minneh al ken ata levatana aqta hada:
Vayyaan reuben otam lemor halo amarti alekem lemor al-techetu bayyeled velo shematem vegam-damo hinneh nidrash
Vaateb reuben yatehon lememar hala amarit levatekon lememar la techobun beulema vela qabbeltun veap demeh ha mitbee:
Vehem lo yadeu ki shomea yosep ki hammelitz benotam
Veinnun la yadeun are shemia yosep are meturgeman hava benehon:
Vayyissob mealehem vayyebk vayyashob alehem vayedabber alehem vayyiqqach meittam et-shimon vayyeesor oto leenehem
Veistachar meillavehon ubeka vetab levatehon umallel immehon udebar millevatehon yat shimon vaasar yateh leenehon:
Vayetzav yosep vayemalu et-kelehem bar ulehashib kaspehem ish el-saqqo velatet lahem tzeda laddarek vayyaas lahem ken
Upaqqid yosep umelo yat manehon ibura velaataba kaspehon gebar lesaqqeh ulemittan lehon zevadin leorcha vaabad lehon ken:
Vayyisu et-shibram al-chamorehem vayyeleku mishsham
Unetalu yat iburehon al chamarehon vaazalu mittamman:
Vayyiptach haechad et-saqqo latet mispo lachamoro bammalon vayyar et-kaspo vehinneh-hv bepi amtachto
Upetach chad yat saqqeh lemittan kista lachamareh bebet mebata vachaza yat kaspeh veha hu bepum toaneh:
Vayyomer el-echayv hushab kaspi vegam hinneh beamtachti vayyetze libbam vayyecherdu ish el-achiv lemor mah-zot asa elohim lanu
Vaamar laachohi ittotab kaspi veap ha betoani unepaq madda libbehon utevahu gebar laachuhi lememar ma da abad Adonai lana:
Vayyabou el-yaaqob abihem artza kenaan vayyaggidu lo et kol-haqqorot otam lemor
Vaato levat yaaqob abuhon ara diknaan vechavviu leh yat kol diaraan yatehon lememar:
Dibber haish adone haaretz ittanu qashot vayyitten otanu kimeraggelim et-haaretz
Mallel gabra ribbona deara immana qashyan vihab yatana kimallile yat ara:
Vannomer elayv kenim anachenu lo hayinu meraggelim
Vaamarna leh kevane anachena la havena meallile:
Shenem-asar anachnu achim bene abinu haechad enennu vehaqqaton hayyom et-abinu beeretz kenaan
Teren asar anachna achin bene abuna chad letohi uzeera yoma den im abuna beara diknaan:
Vayyomer elenu haish adone haaretz bezot eda ki kenim attem achikem haechad hannichu itti veet-raabon battekem qechu valeku
Vaamar lana gabra ribbona deara beda idda are kevane attun achukon chad shebuqu levati veyat ibura dechassir bebattekon sibu veezilu:
Vehabiu et-achikem haqqaton elay veedea ki lo meraggelim attem ki kenim attem et-achikem etten lakem veet-haaretz tischaru
Veaytiu yat achukon zeera levati veidda are la meallile attun are kevane attun yat achukon etten lekon veyat ara tabedun bah sechoreta:
Vayehi hem meriqim saqqehem vehinneh-ish tzeror-kaspo besaqqo vayyiru et-tzerorot kaspehem hemma vaabihem vayyirau
Vahava innun meriqin saqqehon veha gebar tzerir kaspeh besaqqeh vachazo yat tzerare kaspehon innun vaabuhon udechilu:
Vayyomer alehem yaaqob abihem oti shikkaltem yosep enennu veshimon enennu veet-binyamin tiqqachu alay hayu kullana
Vaamar lehon yaaqob abuhon yati atkeltun yosep letohi veshimon la hava haka letohi veyat binyamin tidberun alay havo kallehon:
Vayyomer reuben el-abiv lemor et-shene banay tamit im-lo abiennu eleka tena oto al-yadi vaani ashibennu eleka
Vaamar reuben levat abuhi lememar yat teren benay temit im la aytinneh levatak hab yateh al yedi vaana atebinneh lak:
Vayyomer lo-yered beni immakem ki-achiv met vehu lebaddo nishar uqeraahu ason badderek asher teleku-ba vehoradtem et-sebati beyagon sheola
Vaamar la yechot beri immekon are achuhi mit vehu bilchodohi eshtaar viarinneh mota beorcha di tehakun bah vetachatun yat sibeti bedavona lishol:
Veharaab kabed baaretz
Vekapna taqqip beara:
Vayehi kaasher killu leekol et-hashsheber asher hebiu mimmitzrayim vayyomer alehem abihem shubu shibru-lanu meat-okel
Vahava kad sappiqu shetziu y' rshy" lemekal yat ibura deaytiu mimmitzrayim vaamar lehon abuhon tubu zebunu lana zeer ibura:
Vayyomer elayv yehuda lemor haed heid banu haish lemor lo-tiru panay bilti achikem ittekem
Vaamar leh yehuda lememar ashada ashed bana gabra lememar la techezun appay ellahen kad achukon immekon:
Im-yeshka meshalleach et-achinu ittanu nereda venishbera leka okel
Im itak meshallach yat achuna immana nechot venizben lak ibura:
Veim-eneka meshalleach lo nered ki-haish amar elenu lo-tiru panay bilti achikem ittekem
Veim letak meshallach la nechot are gabra amar lana la techezun appay ellahen kad achukon immekon:
Vayyomer yisrael lama hareotem li lehaggid laish haod lakem ach
Vaamar yisrael lema abeshtun li lechavvaa legabra haad kean lekon acha:
Vayyomeru shaol shaal-haish lanu ulemoladtenu lemor haod abikem chay hayesh lakem ach vannagged-lo al-pi haddebarim haelleh hayadoa neda ki yomar horidu et-achikem
Vaamaru mishal shael gabra lana uleyalladutana lememar haad kean abukon qayyam hait lekon acha vechavvena leh al memar pitgamayya haillen hamidda havena yadein are yemar ochitu yat achukon:
Vayyomer yehuda el-yisrael abiv shilcha hannaar itti venaquma veneleka venicheyeh velo namut gam-anachnu gam-atta gam-tappenu
Vaamar yehuda leyisrael abuhi shelach ulema immi venequm venezel veneche vela nemut ap anachna ap at ap taplana:
Anoki eerbennu miyyadi tebaqshennu im-lo habiotiv eleka vehitztzagtiv lepaneka vechatati leka kol-hayyamim
Ana mearabna beh min yedi tibinneh im la aytinneh lak vaaqeminneh qodamak veehe chate lak kol yomayya:
Ki lule hitmahmahenu ki-atta shabnu zeh paamayim
Are illulapon beda itakkabena are kean tabna denan tarten zimnin:
Vayyomer alehem yisrael abihem im-ken epo zot asu qechu mizzimrat haaretz biklekem vehoridu laish mincha meat tzori umeat debash nekot valot botnim usheqedim
Vaamar lehon yisrael abuhon im ken haka da ibidu sibu middimshabbach beara bemanekon veochitu legabra tiqrubta zeer qetap uzeer debash sheap uletom batenin veshigdin:
Vekesep mishneh qechu beyedkem veet-hakkesep hammushab bepi amtechotekem tashibu beyedkem ulay mishgeh hu
Vekaspa al chad teren sibu beyedkon veyat kaspa deittotab bepum toanekon tetibun beyedkon maim shalu hu:
Veet-achikem qachu vequmu shubu el-haish
Veyat achukon debaru vequmu tubu levat gabra:
Veel shadday yitten lakem rachamim lipne haish veshillach lakem et-achikem acher veet-binyamin vaani kaasher shakoleti shakaleti
Veel shadday yitten lekon rachamin loqodam gabra veyiptar lekon yat achukon ochorana veyat binyamin vaana kema deitkelit tekelit:
Vayyiqchu haanashim et-hammincha hazzot umishneh-kesep laqechu beyadam veet-binyamin vayyaqumu vayyeredu mitzrayim vayyaamdu lipne yosep
Unesibu gubrayya yat tiqrubta hada veal chad teren kaspa nesibu bidehon udebaru yat binyamin veqamu unechatu lemitzrayim veqamu qodam yosep:
Vayyar yosep ittam et-binyamin vayyomer laasher al-beto habe et-haanashim habbayeta uteboach tebach vehaken ki itti yokelu haanashim batztzohorayim
Vachaza yosep immehon yat binyamin vaamar ledi memanna al beteh ael yat gubrayya lebeta unekos niksata veatqen are immi yekelun gubrayya besheruta:
Vayyaas haish kaasher amar yosep vayyabe haish et-haanashim beta yosep
Vaabad gabra kema di amar yosep veael gabra yat gubrayya lebet yosep:
Vayyireu haanashim ki hubeu bet yosep vayyomeru al-debar hakkesep hashshab beamtechotenu battechilla anachnu mubaim lehitgolel alenu ulehitnappel alenu velaqachat otanu laabadim veet-chamorenu
Udechilu gubrayya are ittaalu lebet yosep vaamaru al esaq kaspa deittotab betoanana beqadmeta anachna mittaalin leitrabraba alana uleistaqqapa alana ulemiqne yatana leabdin ulemidbar yat chamarana:
Vayyiggeshu el-haish asher al-bet yosep vayedabberu elayv petach habbayit
Uqeribu levat gabra di memanna al bet yosep umallilu immeh bitra beta:
Vayyomeru bi adoni yarod yaradnu battechilla lishbor-okel
Vaamaru bebau ribboni mechat nechetena beqadmeta lemizban ibura:
Vayehi ki-banu el-hammalon vanniptecha et-amtechotenu vehinneh kesep-ish bepi amtachto kaspenu bemishqalo vannasheb oto beyadenu
Vahava kad atena lebet mebata upetachna yat toanana veha kesap gebar bepum toaneh kaspana bematqeleh vaatebena yateh bidana:
Vekesep acher horadnu beyadenu lishbor-okel lo yadanu mi-sam kaspenu beamtechotenu
Vekaspa ochorana ochitena bidana lemizban ibura la yedana man shavvi kaspana betoanana:
Vayyomer shalom lakem al-tirau elohekem velohe abikem natan lakem matmon beamtechotekem kaspekem ba elay vayyotze alehem et-shimon
Vaamar shelam lekon la tidchalun elahakon veelaha daabukon yehab lekon sima betoanekon kaspekon ata levati veappeq levatehon yat shimon:
Vayyabe haish et-haanashim beta yosep vayyitten-mayim vayyirchatzu raglehem vayyitten mispo lachamorehem
Veael gabra yat gubrayya lebet yosep vihab mayya veascho riglehon vihab kisseta lachamarehon:
Vayyakinu et-hammincha ad-bo yosep batztzohorayim ki shameu ki-sham yokelu lachem
Veatqinu yat tiqrubta ad deal yosep besheruta are shemau are tamman yekelun lachma:
Vayyabo yosep habbayta vayyabiu lo et-hammincha asher-beyadam habbayeta vayyishtachavu-lo aretza
Veal yosep lebeta veaytiu leh yat tiqrubta di bidehon lebayta usegidu leh leara:
Vayyishal lahem leshalom vayyomer hashalom abikem hazzaqen asher amartem haodennu chay
Usheel lehon lishlam vaamar hashlam abukon saba di amartun haad kean qayyam:
Vayyomeru shalom leabdeka leabinu odennu chay vayyiqqedu vayyishetachavu
Vaamaru shelam leabdak leabuna ad kean qayyam ukerau usegidu:
Vayyissa enayv vayyar et-binyamin achiv ben-immo vayyomer hazeh achikem haqqaton asher amartem elay vayyomar elohim yochneka beni
Uzeqap enohi vachaza yat binyamin achuhi bar immeh vaamar haden achukon zeera di amartun li vaamar min qodam Adonai yitracham alak beri:
Vayemaher yosep ki-nikmeru rachamayv el-achiv vayebaqqesh libkot vayyabo hachadra vayyebk shamma
Veochi yosep are itgolelu rachamohi al achuhi ubea lemibke veal leidron bet mishkeba ubeka tamman:
Vayyirchatz panayv vayyetze vayyitappaq vayyomer simu lachem
Veasche appohi unepaq veitchassin vaamar shavviu lachma:
Vayyasimu lo lebaddo velahem lebaddam velammitzrim haokelim itto lebaddam ki lo yukelun hammitzrim leekol et-haibrim lechem ki-toeba hiv lemitzrayim
Veshavviu leh bilchodohi ulehon bilchodehon ulemitzrae deoklin immeh bilchodehon are la yakelin mitzrae lemekal im ibrae lachma are beira demitzrae dachalin leh ibrae oklin:
Vayyeshebu lepanayv habbekor kibkorato vehatztzair kitzirato vayyitmehu haanashim ish el-reehu
Veascharu qodamohi rabba kerabyuteh uzeera kizeruteh utemahu gubrayya gebar lechabreh:
Vayyissa masot meet panayv alehem vattereb masat binyamin mimmasot kullam chamesh yadot vayyishtu vayyishkeru immo
Unetal cholaqin min qodamohi loqodamehon usegi chalaqa debinyamin mecholaqe dekallehon chamsha cholaqin ushetiu ureviu immeh:
Vayetzav et-asher al-beto lemor malle et-amtechot haanashim okel kaasher yukelun seet vesim kesep-ish bepi amtachto
Upaqqed yat di memanna al beteh lememar mele yat toane gubrayya ibura kema di yakelin lemattele veshavvi kesap gebar bepum toaneh:
Veet-gebii gebia hakkesep tasim bepi amtachat haqqaton veet kesep shibro vayyaas kidbar yosep asher dibber
Veyat qallidi qallida dekaspa teshavve bepum toana dizera veyat kesap zebinohi vaabad kepitgama deyosep di mallil:
Habboqer or vehaanashim shullechu hemma vachamorehem
Tzapra nehar vegubrayya itpattaru innun vachamarehon:
Hem yatzeu et-hair lo hirchiqu veyosep amar laasher al-beto qum redop achare haanashim vehissagtam veamarta alehem lamma shillamtem raa tachat toba
Innun nepaqu min qarta la archiqu veyosep amar ledi memanna al beteh qum redap batar gubrayya vetadbeqinnun vetemar lehon lema ashlemtun bisha cholap tabta:
Halo zeh asher yishteh adoni bo vehu nachesh yenachesh bo hareotem asher asitem
Hala den deshate ribboni beh vehu badaqa mebadeq beh abeshtun di abadtun:
Vayyassigem vayedabber alehem et-haddebarim haelleh
Veadbeqinnun umallil immehon yat pitgamayya haillen:
Vayyomeru elayv lamma yedabber adoni kaddebarim haelleh chalila laabadeka measot kaddabar hazzeh
Vaamaru leh lema yemallel ribboni kepitgamayya haillen chas leabdayk millemebad kepitgama haden:
Hen kesep asher matzanu bepi amtechotenu heshibonu eleka meeretz kenaan veek nignob mibbet adoneka kesep o zahab
Ha kaspa di ashkachna bepum toanana atebenohi lak meara diknaan veekden nignub mibbet ribbonak kaspa o dahaba manin diksap o manin didhab:
Asher yimmatze itto meabadeka vamet vegam-anachnu niheyeh ladoni laabadim
Di yishtekach immeh meabdayk umit veap anachna nehe leribboni leabdin:
Vayyomer gam-atta kedibrekem ken-hv asher yimmatze itto yihyeh-li abed veattem tihyu neqiyyim
Vaamar ap kean kepitgamekon ken hu di yishtekach immeh yehe li abda veattun tehon zakkain:
Vayemaharu vayyoridu ish et-amtachto aretza vayyiptechu ish amtachto
Veochiu unechitu s" veachitu gebar yat toaneh leara upetachu gebar toaneh:
Vayechappes baggadol hechel ubaqqaton killa vayyimmatze haggabia beamtachat binyamin
Ubelash berabba shari ubizera shetzi veishtekach qallida betoana debinyamin:
Vayyiqreu simlotam vayyaamos ish al-chamoro vayyashubu haira
Ubezau lebushehon uremo gebar al chamareh vetabu leqarta:
Vayyabo yehuda veechayv beta yosep vehu odennu sham vayyippelu lepanayv aretza
Veal yehuda vaachohi lebet yosep vehu ad kean tamman unepalu qodamohi leara:
Vayyomer lahem yosep ma-hammaaseh hazzeh asher asitem halo yedatem ki-nachesh yenachesh ish asher kamoni
Vaamar lehon yosep ma obada haden di abadtun hala yedatun are badaqa mebadeq gabra di kevati:
Vayyomer yehuda mah-nomar ladoni mah-nedabber umah-nitztaddaq haelohim matza et-avon abadeka hinnennu abadim ladoni gam-anachnu gam asher-nimtza haggabia beyado
Vaamar yehuda mah nemar leribboni mah nemallel umah nizke min qodam Adonai ishtekach yat choba beabdayk ha anachna abdin leribboni ap anachna ap deishtekach qallida bideh:
Vayyomer chalila li measot zot haish asher nimtza haggabia beyado hu yihyeh-li abed veattem alu leshalom el-abikem
Vaamar chas li millemebad da gabra di yishtekach qallida bideh hu yehe li abda veattun seqo lishlam levat abukon:
Vayyiggash elayv yehuda vayyomer bi adoni yedabber-na abdeka dabar beozne adoni veal-yichar appeka beabdeka ki kamoka keparoh
Uqereb levateh yehuda vaamar bebau ribboni yemallel kean abdak pitgama qodam ribboni vela yitqep rugezak beabdak are keparoh ken at:
Adoni shaal et-abadayv lemor hayesh-lakem ab o-ach
Ribboni sheil yat abdohi lememar hait lekon abba o acha:
Vannomer el-adoni yesh-lanu ab zaqen veyeled zequnim qatan veachiv met vayyivvater hu lebaddo leimmo veabiv ahebo
Vaamarna leribboni it lana abba saba ubar sibetin zeer veachuhi mit veishtaar hu bilchodohi leimmeh vaabuhi rechim leh:
Vattomer el-abadeka horiduhu elay veasima eni alayv

Vaamar yosep leamma ha zebenit yatekon yoma den veyat arakon leparoh he lekon bar zara vetizreun yat ara:
Vehaya battebuot unetattem chamishit leparoh vearba hayyadot yihyeh lakem lezera hassadeh uleoklekem velaasher bebattekem veleekol letappekem
Vihe beaole alalta vetittenun chad min chamsha leparoh vearba cholaqin yehe lekon lebar zera chaqla ulemekalkon veleenash bebattekon ulemekal letaplekon:
Vayyomeru hecheyitanu nimtza-chen beene adoni vehayinu abadim leparoh
Vaamaru qayyimtana nashkach rachamin beene ribboni unehe abdin leparoh:
Vayyasem otah yosep lechoq ad-hayyom hazzeh al-admat mitzrayim leparoh lachomesh raq admat hakkohanim lebaddam lo hayeta leparoh
Veshavvi yatah yosep ligzera ad yoma haden al ara demitzrayim dihon yahabin chad min chamsha leparoh lechod ara dekummarayya bilchodehon la havat leparoh:
Vayyesheb yisrael beeretz mitzrayim beeretz goshen vayyeachazu bah vayyipru vayyirbu meod
Viteb yisrael beara demitzrayim beara degshen veachasinu bah unepishu usegiu lachada:
Vayechi yaaqob beeretz mitzrayim sheba esreh shana vayehi yeme-yaaqob shene chayyayv sheba shanim vearbaim umeat shana
Vachaya yaaqob beara demitzrayim sheba esre shenin vahavo yome yaaqob shene chayyohi mea vearbein usheba shenin:
Vayyiqrebu yeme-yisrael lamut vayyiqra libno leyosep vayyomer lo im-na matzati chen beeneka sim-na yadeka tachat yereki veasita immadi chesed veemet al-na tiqbereni bemitzrayim
Uqeribu yome yisrael limmat uqera libreh leyosep vaamar leh im kean ashkachit rachamin beenayk shavvi kean yedak techot yarki vetabed immi tibu uqeshot la kean tiqberinnani bemitzrayim:
Veshakabti im-abotay unesatani mimmitzrayim uqebartani biqburatam vayyomar anoki eeseh kidbareka
Veishkub im abahatay vetittelinnani mimmitzrayim vetiqberinnani biqburtehon vaamar ana ebed kepitgamak:
Vayyomer hishshabea li vayyishshaba lo vayyishtachu yisrael al-rosh hammitta
Vaamar qayyam li veqayyim leh usegid yisrael al resh arsa:
Vayehi achare haddebarim haelleh vayyomer leyosep hinneh abika choleh vayyiqqach et-shene banayv immo et-menashsheh veet-eprayim
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillen vaamar leyosep ha abuk shekib mera udebar yat teren benohi immeh yat menashsheh veyat eprayim:
Vayyagged leyaaqob vayyomer hinneh binka yosep ba eleka vayyitchazzeq yisrael vayyesheb al-hammitta
Vechavvi leyaaqob vaamar ha berak yosep ata levatak veatqap yisrael viteb al arsa:
Vayyomer yaaqob el-yosep el shadday nira-elay beluz beeretz kenaan vayebarek oti
Vaamar yaaqob leyosep el shadday itgeli li beluz beara diknaan ubarik yati:
Vayyomer elay hinni mapreka vehirbitika unetattika liqhal ammim venatatti et-haaretz hazzot lezaraka achareka achuzzat olam
Vaamar li ha ana mappesh lak veasginnak veetteninnak lekinshat shibtin vaetten yat ara hada libnak batrak achasanat alam:
Veatta shene-baneka hannoladim leka beeretz mitzrayim ad-boi eleka mitzrayma li-hem eprayim umenashsheh kiruben veshimon yiheyu-li
Ukean teren benak deityelidu lak beara demitzrayim ad meti levatak lemitzrayim dili innun eprayim umenashsheh kiruben veshimon yehon qodamay:
Umoladteka asher-holadta acharehem leka yihyu al shem achehem yiqqareu benachalatam
Ubenak di tolid batrehon dilak yehon al shum achuhon yitqerun beachasantehon:
Vaani beboi mippaddan meta alay rachel beeretz kenaan badderek beod kibrat-eretz labo eprata vaeqbereha sham bederek eprat hiv bet lachem
Vaana bemeti mippaddan metat alay rachel beara diknaan beorcha beod keruba deara lemeal leeprat uqebarittah tamman beorach eprat hi bet lachem:
Vayyar yisrael et-bene yosep vayyomer mi-elleh
Vachaza yisrael yat bene yosep vaamar man illen:
Vayyomer yosep el-abiv banay hem asher-natan-li elohim bazeh vayyomar qachem-na elay vaabarekem
Vaamar yosep laabuhi benay innun dihab li Adonai haka vaamar qarebinnun kean levati veebarekinnun:
Veene yisrael kabedu mizzoqen lo yukal lirot vayyaggesh otam elayv vayyishshaq lahem vayechabbeq lahem
Veene yisrael yeqaran missebu la yikkul lemecheze veqarib yatehon levateh venashshiq lehon vegappip lehon:
Vayyomer yisrael el-yosep reoh paneka lo pillaleti vehinneh hera oti elohim gam et-zareka
Vaamar yisrael leyosep lemecheze appayk la sebarit veha achazi yati Adonai ap yat benak:
Vayyotze yosep otam meim birkayv vayyishtachu leappayv aretza
Veappeq yosep yatehon min qodamohi usegid al appohi al ara:
Vayyiqqach yosep et-shenehem et-eprayim bimino missemol yisrael veet-menashsheh bismolo mimin yisrael vayyaggesh elayv
Udebar yosep yat tarvehon yat eprayim bimineh missemala deyisrael veyat menashsheh bissemaleh mimina deyisrael veqareb levateh:
Vayyishlach yisrael et-yemino vayyashet al-rosh eprayim vehu hatztzair veet-semolo al-rosh menashsheh sikkel et-yadayv ki menashsheh habbekor
Veoshit yisrael yat yemineh veshavvi al resha deeprayim vehu zeera veyat semaleh al resha dimnashsheh achkiminnun lidohi are menashsheh bukera:
Vayebarek et-yosep vayyomar haelohim asher hithalleku abotay lepanayv abraham veyitzchaq haelohim haroeh oti meodi ad-hayyom hazzeh
Ubarik yat yosep vaamar Adonai di pelachu abahatay qodamohi abraham veyitzchaq Adonai dezan yati middeitani ad yoma haden:
Hammalak haggoel oti mikkol-ra yebarek et-hannearim veyiqqare bahem shemi veshem abotay abraham veyitzchaq veyidgu larob beqereb haaretz
Malaka di peraq yati mikkol bisha yebarek yat ulemayya veyitqere behon shemi veshum abahatay abraham veyitzchaq ukenune yamma yisgun bego bene enasha al ara:
Vayyar yosep ki-yashit abiv yad-yemino al-rosh eprayim vayyera beenayv vayyitmok yad-abiv lehasir otah meal rosh-eprayim al-rosh menashsheh
Vachaza yosep are shavvi abuhi yad yemineh al resha deeprayim ubeesh beenohi useed yeda deabuhi leaadaa yatah meal resha deeprayim leannachutah al resha dimnashsheh:
Vayyomer yosep el-abiv lo-ken abi ki-zeh habbekor sim yemineka al-rosho
Vaamar yosep leabuhi la ken abba are den bukera shav yeminak al resheh:
Vayemaen abiv vayyomer yadati beni yadati gam-hv yiheyeh-leam vegam-hv yigdal veulam achiv haqqaton yigdal mimmennu vezaro yihyeh melo-haggoyim
Vesareb abuhi vaamar yedana beri yedana ap hu yehe leamma veap hu yisge uberam achuhi zeira yisge minneh ubenohi yehon shallitin beammayya:
Vayebarekem bayyom hahu lemor beka yebarek yisrael lemor yesimeka elohim keeprayim vekimnashsheh vayyasem et-eprayim lipne menashsheh
Uberekinnun beyoma hahu lememar bak yebarek yisrael lememar yeshavvinak Adonai keeprayim vekimnashsheh veshavve yat eprayim qodam menashsheh:
Vayyomer yisrael el-yosep hinneh anoki met vehaya elohim immakem veheshib etkem el-eretz abotekem
Vaamar yisrael leyosep ha ana mait vihe memera daAdonai besadekon veyateb yatekon leara daabahatkon:
Vaani natatti leka shekem achad al-acheka asher laqachti miyyad haemori becharbi ubeqashti
Vaana yehabit lak chulaq chad yattir al achayk di nesebit mida deemoraa bitzloti ubebauti:
Vayyiqra yaaqob el-banayv vayyomer heasepu veaggida lakem et asher-yiqra etkem beacharit hayyamim
Uqera yaaqob libnohi vaamar itkannashu vaachavve lekon yat di yeara yatekon besop yomayya:
Hiqqabetzu veshimu bene yaaqob veshimu el-yisrael abikem
Itkannashu ushemau bene yaaqob veqabbilu ulepan min yisrael abukon:
Reuben bekori atta kochi vereshit oni yeter seet veyeter az
Reuben bukeri at cheli veresh taqepi lak hava chaze lemissab telata chulaqin bekeruta kehunta umalkuta:
Pachaz kammayim al-totar ki alita mishkebe abika az chillalta yetzui ala
Al daazalta loqobel appayk ha kemayya beram la ahaneta cholaq yattir la tissab are seleqta bet mishkebe abuk beken achelta leshivvuyi beri seleqta:
Shimon velevi achim kele chamas mekerotehem
Shimon velevi achin gabrin gibbarin beara totabutehon abadu gebura:
Besodam al-tabo napshi biqhalam al-techad kebodi ki beappam haregu ish ubirtzonam iqqeru-shor
Berazehon la havat napshi beitkanneshehon limhak la nechatit min yeqari are berogzehon qetalu qetol ubirutehon tarau shur sana:
Arur appam ki az veebratam ki qashata achalleqem beyaaqob vaapitzem beyisrael
Lit rogzehon are taqqip vechemathon are qashya apalleginnun beyaaqob veebaddarinnun beyisrael:
Yehuda atta yoduka acheka yadeka beorep oyebeka yishtachavu leka bene abika
Yehuda at odeta vela beheteta bak yodun achayk yedak titqep al baale debabak yitbadderun sanak yehon mechazzerin qedal qodamak vihon meqaddemin lemishal bishlamak bene abuk:
Gur aryeh yehuda mitterep beni alita kara rabatz kearyeh ukelabi mi yeqimennu
Shilton yehe besheruya ubesopa yitrabba malka middebet yehuda are middin qatla beri napshak seleqta yenuach yishre bitqop kearya ukeleta velet malku ditzazeinneh:
Lo-yasur shebet mihuda umechoqeq mibben raglayv ad ki-yabo shiloh velo yiqqehat ammim
La yaade abed shaletan middebet yehuda vesapra mibbene benohi ad alema ad deyete meshicha dedileh hi malkuta veleh yishtammeun ammayya:
Oseri laggepen iroh velassoreqa beni atono kibbes bayyayin lebusho ubedam-anabim sutoh
Yaschar yisrael leqarteh amma yibnun hekeleh yehon tzaddiqayya sechor sechor leh veabede orayta beulepan immeh yehe argevan tab lebushohi kesuteh mela mela tzeba zehori vetzibonin:
Chaklili enayim miyyayin uleben-shinnayim mechalab
Yesammequn turohi bekarmohi yetupun naavohi bachamar yechavveran biqateh beibur ubeedre ana:
Zebulun lechop yammim yishkon vehu lechop oniyyot veyarkato al-tzidon
Zebulun al separ yammayya yishre vehu yekabbesh mechozin bispinan vetub yamma yekul utechumeh yehe mate al tzidon:
Yissashkar chamor garem robetz ben hammishpetayim
Yissaskar attir beniksin veachasanteh ben techumayya:
Vayyar menucha ki tob veet-haaretz ki naema vayyet shikmo lisbol vayehi lemas-obed
Vachaza chulaqa are tab veyat ara are meabbeda perin vikabbesh machoze ammayya vishetze yat dayyarehon udeishtaarun behon yehon leh palchin umasseqe massin:
Dan yadin ammo keachad shibte yisrael
Middebet dan yitbechar viqum gabra beyomohi yitpereq ammeh ubishnohi yenuchun kachada shibtayya deyisrael:
Yehi-dan nachash ale-derek shepipon ale-orach hannoshek iqqebe-svs vayyippol rokebo achor

Yehe gabra deyitbechar viqum middebet dan emeteh titreme al ammayya umechateh titqep biplishtae kechive chureman yishre al orcha ukepitna yikmon al shebila yeqattel gibbare mashshiryat pelishtae parashin im raglain yeaqqer susavan uretikkin vimagger rokebehon laachora:
Lishuateka qivviti Adonai
Lepureqanak sabbarit Adonai:
Gad gedud yegudennu vehu yagud aqeb
Middebet gad mashshiryat mezayyenin kad yaabrun yat yardena qodam achehon liqraba ubeniksin saggiin yetubun learahon:
Measher shemena lachmo vehu yitten maadanne-melek
Deasher taba areh vehu merabya betapnuqe malkin:
Naptali ayyala shelucha hannoten imre-shaper
Naptali beara taba yitreme adbeh veachasanteh tehe meabbeda perin yehon modan umebarekin alehon:
Ben porat yosep ben porat ale-ayin banot tzaada ale-shvr
Beri deyisge yosep beri deyitbarak kegopen dintzeb al ena demayya teren shibtin yippequn mibbenohi yeqabbelun chulaqa veachasanta:
Vayemareruhu varobbu vayyistemuhu baale chitztzim
Veitmarru yateh venaqqemohi veaiqu leh gubrin gibbarin baale palgota:
Vattesheb beetan qashto vayyapozzu zeroe yadayv mide abir yaaqob mishsham roeh eben yisrael

Vetabat behon nebiuteh al deqayyam orayta besitra veshavvi betuqepa rochatzaneh beken yitrema dehab al deraohi veachasin malkuta uteqep da havat leh min qodam el taqqipa deyaaqob di bememereh zan abahan ubenin zara deyisrael:
Meel abika veyazerekka veet shadday vibarekekka birkot shamayim meal birkot tehom robetzet tachat birkot shadayim varacham
Memar elaha deabuk yehe besadak veyat shadday vibarekinnak birkan denachatan mittalla dishmayya milleella birkan denagdan mimmaamaqqe ara millera birketa deabuk udeimmak:
Birkot abika gaberu al-birkot horay ad-taavat gibot olam tiheyena lerosh yosep uleqodqod nezir echayv
Birketa deabuk yittosepan al birketa dili bariku abahatay dachamidu lehen rabrebayya demin alema yehevyan kol illen leresha deyosep ulegabra parisha daachohi:
Binyamin zeeb yitrap babboqer yokal ad velaereb yechalleq shalal
Binyamin beareh tishre shekinta ubeachasanteh yitbene maqdesha betzapra ubepanya yehon meqarebin kahanayya qorbana ubeiddan ramsha yehon mepallegin motar chuleqehon mishshear qodshayya:
Kol-elleh shibte yisrael shenem asar vezot asher-dibber lahem abihem vayebarek otam ish asher kebirkato berak otam
Kol illen shibtayya deyisrael teren asar veda demallel lehon abuhon ubarik yatehon gebar di kebirketeh barek yatehon:
Vayetzav otam vayyomer alehem ani neesap el-ammi qibru oti el-abotay el-hammeara asher bisdeh epron hachitti
Upaqqed yatehon vaamar lehon ana mitkenesh leammi qebaru yati levat abahatay bimarta di bachaqal epron chittaa:
Bammeara asher bisdeh hammakpela asher al-pene-mamre beeretz kenaan asher qana abraham et-hassadeh meet epron hachitti laachuzzat-qaber
Bimarta di bachaqal kapelta di al appe mamre beara diknaan di zeban abraham yat chaqla min epron chittaa leachasanat qebura:
Shamma qaberu et-abraham veet sara ishto shamma qaberu et-yitzchaq veet ribqa ishto veshamma qabarti et-lea
Tamman qebaru yat abraham veyat sara itteteh tamman qebaru yat yitzchaq veyat ribqa itteteh vetamman qebarit yat lea:
Miqneh hassadeh vehammeara asher-bo meet bene-chet
Zebine chaqla umearta di beh min bene chittaa:
Vayekal yaaqob letzavvot et-banayv vayyeesop raglayv el-hammitta vayyigva vayyeasep el-ammayv
Veshetze yaaqob lepaqqada yat benohi ukenash raglohi learsa veitnegid veitkenish leammeh:
Vayyippol yosep al-pene abiv vayyebk alayv vayyishshaq-lo
Unepal yosep al appe abuhi ubeka allohi uneshaq leh:
Vayetzav yosep et-abadayv et-haropeim lachanot et-abiv vayyachantu haropeim et-yisrael
Upaqqid yosep yat abdohi yat asvata lemechnat yat abuhi vechanetu asvata yat yisrael:
Vayyimleu-lo arbaim yom ki ken yimleu yeme hachanutim vayyibku oto mitzrayim shibim yom
Ushelimu leh arbein yomin are ken shelimu yome chanittayya ubeko yateh mitzrae shabin yomin:
Vayyaabru yeme bekito vayedabber yosep el-bet paroh lemor im-na matzati chen beenekem dabberu-na beozne paroh lemor
Vaabaru yome bekiteh umallel yosep im bet paroh lememar im kean ashkachit rachamin beenekon mallilu kean qodam paroh lememar:
Abi hishbiani lemor hinneh anoki met beqibri asher kariti li beeretz kenaan shamma tiqbereni veatta eeleh-na veeqbera et-abi veashuba
Abba qayyim alay lememar ha ana mait beqibri deatqenit li beara diknaan tamman tiqberinnani ukean essaq kean veeqbar yat abba veetub:
Vayyomer paroh aleh uqebor et-abika kaasher hishbieka
Vaamar paroh saq uqebor yat abuk kema deqayyim alak:
Vayyaal yosep liqbor et-abiv vayyaalu itto kol-abde paroh ziqne beto vekol ziqne eretz-mitzrayim
Useleq yosep lemiqbar yat abuhi useliqu immeh kol abde paroh sabe beteh vekol sabe ara demitzrayim:
Vekol bet yosep veechayv ubet abiv raq tappam vetzonam ubeqaram azebu beeretz goshen
Vekol bet yosep vaachohi ubet abuhi lechod taplehon veanehon vetorehon shebaqu beara degshen:
Vayyaal immo gam-rekeb gam-parashim vayehi hammachaneh kabed meod
Useliqu immeh ap retikkin ap parashin vahava mashrita saggia lachada:
Vayyabou ad-goren haatad asher beeber hayyarden vayyispedu-sham misped gadol vekabed meod vayyaas leabiv ebel shibat yamim
Vaato ad bet idre deatad di beibra deyardena usepadu tamman misped rab vetaqqip lachada veabad laabuhi ebla shaba yomin:
Vayyar yosheb haaretz hakkenaani et-haebel begoren haatad vayyomeru ebel-kabed zeh lemitzrayim al-ken qara shemah abel mitzrayim asher beeber hayyarden
Vachaza yateb ara kenaanaa yat ebla bebet idre deatad vaamaru abel taqqip den lemitzrae al ken qera shemah abel mitzrayim di beibra deyardena:
Vayyaasu banayv lo ken kaasher tzivvam
Vaabadu benohi leh ken kema di paqqedinnun:
Vayyisu oto banayv artza kenaan vayyiqberu oto bimarat sedeh hammakpela asher qana abraham et-hassadeh laachuzzat-qeber meet epron hachitti al-pene mamre
Unetalu yateh benohi leara diknaan uqebaru yateh bimarat chaqal kapelta di zeban abraham yat chaqla leachasanat qebura min epron chittaa al appe mamre:
Vayyashob yosep mitzrayma hu veechayv vekol-haolim itto liqbor et-abiv achare qobro et-abiv
Vetab yosep lemitzrayim hu vaachohi vekol disliqu immeh lemiqbar yat abuhi batar diqbar yat abuhi:
Vayyiru ache-yosep ki-met abihem vayyomeru lu yistemenu yosep vehasheb yashib lanu et kol-haraa asher gamalnu oto
Vachazo ache yosep are mit abuhon vaamaru dilma yittar lana debabu yosep vaataba yateb lana yat kol bisheta di gemalna yateh:
Vayetzavvu el-yosep lemor abika tzivva lipne moto lemor
Upaqqidu levat yosep lememar abuk paqqed qodam moteh lememar:
Koh-tomeru leyosep anna sa na pesha acheka vechattatam ki-raa gemaluka veatta sa na lepesha abde elohe abika vayyebk yosep bedabberam elayv
Keden temerun leyosep bebau sheboq kean lechoba achayk velachataehon are bisheta gemaluk ukean sheboq kean lechoba abde elaha deabuk ubeka yosep bemallalutehon immeh:
Vayyeleku gam-echayv vayyippelu lepanayv vayyomeru hinnennu leka laabadim
Vaazalu ap achohi unepalu qodamohi vaamaru ha anachna lak leabdin:
Vayyomer alehem yosep al-tirau ki hatachat elohim ani
Vaamar lehon yosep la tiddachalun are dachala daAdonai ana:
Veattem chashabtem alay raa elohim chashabah letoba lemaan asoh kayyom hazzeh lehachayot am-rab
Veattun chashabtun alay bisha min qodam Adonai itchashshebat letaba bedil lemebad keyoma haden leqayyama am saggi:
Veatta al-tirau anoki akalkel etkem veet-tappekem vayenachem otam vayedabber al-libbam
Ukean la tiddachalun ana ezun yatekon veyat taplekon venachem yatehon umallel tanchumin al libbehon:
Vayyesheb yosep bemitzrayim hu ubet abiv vayechi yosep mea vaeser shanim
Viteb yosep bemitzrayim hu ubet abuhi vachaya yosep mea vaasar shenin:
Vayyar yosep leeprayim bene shilleshim gam bene makir ben-menashsheh yulledu al-birke yosep
Vachaza yosep leeprayim benin telitain ap bene makir bar menashsheh ityelidu verabbi yosep:
Vayyomer yosep el-echayv anoki met velohim paqod yipqod etkem veheela etkem min-haaretz hazzot el-haaretz asher nishba leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob
Vaamar yosep laachohi ana mait vayya midkar dekir yatekon veyissaq yatekon min ara hada leara di qayyim leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob:
Vayyashba yosep et-bene yisrael lemor paqod yipqod elohim etkem vehaalitem et-atzmotay mizzeh
Veome yosep yat bene yisrael lememar midkar dekir Adonai yatekon vetassequn yat garmay mikka:
Vayyamot yosep ben-mea vaeser shanim vayyachantu oto vayyisem baaron bemitzrayim
Umit yosep bar mea vaasar shenin vachanatu yateh vesamuhi bearona bemitzrayim:
Exodus: Veelleh shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayema et yaaqob ish ubeto bau
Veilen shemahat bene yisrael dealu lemitzrayim im yaaqob gebar veenash beteh alu:
Reuben shimon levi vihuda
Reuben shimon levi vihuda:
Yissashkar zebulun ubinyamin
Yissaskar zebulun ubinyamin:
Dan venaptali gad veasher
Dan venaptali gad veasher:
Vayehi kol-nepesh yotzee yerek-yaaqob shibim napesh veyosep haya bemitzrayim
Vahava kol napshata napqe yarka deyaaqob shabin napshan veyosep dahava bemitzrayim:
Vayyamot yosep vekol-echayv vekol haddor hahu
Umit yosep vekol achohi vekol dara hahu:
Ubene yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu vayyaatzmu bimod meod vattimmale haaretz otam
Ubene yisrael nepishu veityaladu usegiu uteqipu lachada lachada veitmeliat ara minhon:
Vayyaqom melek-chadash al-mitzrayim asher lo-yada et-yosep
Veqam malka chadta al mitzrayim dela meqayem gezerat yosep:
Vayyomer el-ammo hinneh am bene yisrael rab veatzum mimmennu
Vaamar leameh ha ama bene yisrael sagan vetaqipin minana:
Haba nitechakkema lo pen-yirbeh vehaya ki-tiqrena milchama venosap gam-hv al-soneenu venilcham-banu veala min-haaretz
Habu nitchakkam lehon dilma yisgun vihe are yearinana qerab veyittosepun ap inun al sanana vigichun bana qerab veyisqun min ara:
Vayyasimu alayv sare missim lemaan annoto besiblotam vayyiben are miskenot leparoh et-pitom veet-raamses
Umaniu alehon shiltonin mabishin bedil leanoehon bepalechanehon ubeno qirve bet otzara leparoh yat pitom veyat raamses:
Vekaasher yeannu oto ken yirbeh veken yiprotz vayyaqutzu mippene bene yisrael
Ukema dimanan lehon ken sagan veken taqpin vaaqat lemitzrae min qodam bene yisrael:
Vayyaabidu mitzrayim et-bene yisrael beparek
Veaplachu mitzrae yat bene yisrael beqashyu:
Vayemareru et-chayyehem baaboda qasha bechomer ubilbenim ubekol-aboda bassadeh et kol-abodatam asher-abedu bahem beparek
Veamraru yat chayehon bepalechana qasheya betina ubelibnin ubekol palechana bechaqla yat kol palechanehon deaplachu behon beqashyu:
Vayyomer melek mitzrayim lameyalledot haibriyyot asher shem haachat shipra veshem hashshenit pua
Vaamar malka demitzrayim lechayata yehudayata deshum chada shipra veshum tinyeta pua:
Vayyomer beyalledken et-haibriyyot ureiten al-haobnayim im-ben hu vahamitten oto veim-bat hiv vachaya
Vaamar kad tehevyan moledan yat yehudayata vetechzeyan al matbera im bar hu tiqtelan yateh veim beratta hi vteqayminah:
Vattirena hameyalledot et-haelohim velo asu kaasher dibber alehen melek mitzrayim vattechayyena et-hayeladim
Udechila chayata min qodam Adonai vela abada kema demalil imhen malka demitzrayim veqayama yat benaya:
Vayyiqra melek-mitzrayim lameyalledot vayyomer lahen maddua asiten haddabar hazzeh vattechayyena et-hayeladim
Uqera malka demitzrayim lechayata vaamar lehen ma den abadtun yat pitgama haden veqayemetun yat benaya:
Vattomarna hameyalledot el-paroh ki lo kannashim hammitzriyyot haibriyyot ki-chayot henna beterem tabo alehen hameyalledet veyaladu
Vaamara chayata leparoh are la kinshaya mitzreyata yehudayata are chakkiman inun ad la alat levatehen chayata vilidan:
Vayyeteb elohim lameyalledot vayyireb haam vayyaatzmu meod
Veoteb Adonai lechayata usegi ama uteqipu lachada:
Vayehi ki-yareu hameyalledot et-haelohim vayyaas lahem battim
Vahava kad dechila chayata min qodam Adonai vaabad lehon battin:
Vayetzav paroh lekol-ammo lemor kol-habben hayyillod hayeora tashlikuhu vekol-habbat techayyun
Upaqid paroh lekol ameh lememar kol bera deyityelid lihudae benahara tirmuneh vekol beratta teqaymun:
Vayyelek ish mibbet levi vayyiqqach et-bat-levi
Vaazal gabra midbet levi unesib yat bat levi:
Vattahar haishsha vatteled ben vattere oto ki-tob hu vattitzpenehu shelosha yerachim
Veadiat itteta vilidat bar vachazat yateh are tab hu veatmarteh telata yarchin:
Velo-yakela od hatztzepino vattiqqach-lo tebat gome vattachmera bachemar ubazzapet vattasem bah et-hayyeled vattasem bassup al-sepat hayeor
Vela yekelat od leatmaruteh unesebat leh tebuta degome vechappatah bechemara ubezipta veshaviat bah yat rabya veshavitah beyaara al kep nahara:
Vattetatztzab achoto merachoq ledea mah-yeaseh lo
Veitattadat achateh merachiq lemida ma yitabed leh:
Vattered bat-paroh lirchotz al-hayeor venaaroteha holekot al-yad hayeor vattere et-hatteba betok hassup vattishlach et-amatah vattiqqacheha
Unechatat bat paroh lemische al nahara veulemataha mehalekan al kep nahara vachazat yat tebuta bego yaara veoshetat yat amtah unesebetah:
Vattiptach vattirehu et-hayyeled vehinneh-naar bokeh vattachmol alayv vattomer miyyalde haibrim zeh
Upetachat vachazat yat rabya veha ulema bake vechasat alohi vaameret mibbene yehudae hu den:
Vattomer achoto el-bat-paroh haelek veqarati lak ishsha meneqet min haibriyyot veteniq lak et-hayyaled
Vaameret achateh lebat paroh haezil veiqre lik itteta meniqta min yehudayata vetoniq lik yat rabya:
Vattomer-la bat-paroh leki vattelek haalma vattiqra et-em hayyaled
Vaameret lah bat paroh ezili vaazalat ulemta uqerat yat imeh derabya:
Vattomer lah bat-paroh heliki et-hayyeled hazzeh veheniqihu li vaani etten et-sekarek vattiqqach haishsha hayyeled vatteniqehu
Vaameret lah bat paroh obili yat rabya haden veoneqihi li vaana etten yat agrak unesebat itteta yat rabya veoniqteh:
Vayyigdal hayyeled vattebiehu lebat-paroh vayehi-la leben vattiqra shemo mosheh vattomer ki min-hammayim meshitihu
Ureba rabya veaytiteh lebat paroh vahava lah lebar uqerat shemeh msheh vaameret are min maya shechalteh:
Vayehi bayyamim hahem vayyigdal mosheh vayyetze el-echayv vayyar besiblotam vayyar ish mitzri makkeh ish-ibri meechayv
Vahava beyomaya hainun ureba msheh unepaq levat achohi vachaza bepalechanhon vachaza gebar mitzri mache ligbar yehudi meachohi:
Vayyipen koh vakoh vayyar ki en ish vayyak et-hammitzri vayyitmenehu bachol
Veitpene leka uleka vachaza are let gabra umecha yat mitzraa vetamreh bechala:
Vayyetze bayyom hashsheni vehinneh shene-anashim ibrim nitztzim vayyomer larasha lamma takkeh reeka
Unepaq beyoma tinyana veha teren gubrin yehudain natzan vaamar lechayaba lema at mache lechabrak:
Vayyomer mi sameka leish sar veshopet alenu halehorgeni atta omer kaasher haragta et-hammitzri vayyira mosheh vayyomar aken noda haddabar
Vaamar man shavyak ligbar rab vedayan alana halemiqteli at amar kema diqtalta yat mitzraa udechil msheh vaamar bequsheta ityeda pitgama:
Vayyishma paroh et-haddabar hazzeh vayebaqqesh laharog et-mosheh vayyibrach mosheh mippene paroh vayyesheb beeretz-midyan vayyesheb al-habbeer
Ushema paroh yat pitgama haden ubea lemiqtal yat msheh vaaraq msheh min qodam paroh viteb beara demidyan viteb al bera:
Ulekohen midyan sheba banot vattabona vattidlena vattemallena et-harehatim lehashqot tzon abihen
Ulerabba demidyan sheba benan veataa udelaa umelaa yat rehataya leashqaa ana daabuhen:
Vayyabou haroim vayegareshum vayyaqom mosheh vayyoshian vayyashq et-tzonam
Vaato raaya uteradunun veqam msheh uperaqinun veashqe yat anhen:
Vattabona el-reuel abihen vayyomer maddua miharten bo hayyom
Vaataa levat reuel abuhen vaamar ma den ochitun lemete yoma den:
Vattomarna ish mitzri hitztzilanu miyyad haroim vegam-daloh dala lanu vayyashq et-hatztzon
Vaamara gabra mitzraa shezebana miyad raaya veap midla dela lana veashqe yat ana:
Vayyomer el-benotayv veayyo lamma zeh azabten et-haish qiren lo veyokal lachem
Vaamar libnateh vean hu lema denan shebaqtin yat gabra qeran leh veyekul lachma:
Vayyoel mosheh lashebet et-haish vayyitten et-tzippora bitto lemosheh
Utzebi msheh lemitab im gabra vihab yat tzippora beratteh lemsheh:
Vatteled ben vayyiqra et-shemo gereshom ki amar ger hayiti beeretz nokriyya
Vilidat bar uqera yat shemeh gereshom are amar dayar haveti beara nukeraa:
Vayehi bayyamim harabbim hahem vayyamot melek mitzrayim vayyeanechu bene-yisrael min-haaboda vayyizaqu vattaal shavatam el-haelohim min-haaboda
Vahava beyomaya sagiaya hainun umit malka demitzrayim veitnachu bene yisrael min palechana dahava qeshe alehon uzeiqu useleqat qebeltehon loqodam Adonai min palechana:
Vayyishma elohim et-naaqatam vayyizkor elohim et-berito et-abraham et-yitzchaq veet-yaaqob
Ushemia qodam Adonai yat qebeltehon udekir Adonai yat qayameh deim abraham deim yitzchaq udeim yaaqob:
Vayyar elohim et-bene yisrael vayyeda elohim
Ugeli qedam Adonai shibuda dibne yisrael vaamar bememereh lemipraqhon Adonai:
Umosheh haya roeh et-tzon yitro choteno kohen midyan vayyinhag et-hatztzon achar hammidbar vayyabo el-har haelohim choreba
Umsheh hava rae yat ana deyitro chamohi rabba demidyan udebar yat ana lebatar shepar raaya lemadbera veata letura deitgeli alohi yeqara daAdonai lechoreb:
Vayyera malak Adonai elayv belabbat-esh mittok hasseneh vayyar vehinneh hasseneh boer baesh vehasseneh enennu ukkal
Veitgeli malaka daAdonai leh beshalhobit eshata migo asana vachaza veha asana baer beeshata vaasana letohi mitakil:
Vayyomer mosheh asura-na veereh et-hammareh haggadol hazzeh maddua lo-yibar hasseneh
Vaamar msheh itpene kean veecheze yat chazevana rabba haden ma den la mittoqad asana:
Vayyar Adonai ki sar lirot vayyiqra elayv elohim mittok hasseneh vayyomer mosheh mosheh vayyomer hinneni
Vachaza Adonai are itpene lemecheze uqera leh Adonai migo asana vaamar msheh msheh vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer al-tiqrab halom shal-nealeka meal ragleka ki hammaqom asher atta omed alayv admat-qodesh hu
Vaamar la tiqrab haleka sheri senak meal riglak are atra deat qaim alohi atar qadish hu:
Vayyomer anoki elohe abika elohe abraham elohe yitzchaq velohe yaaqob vayyaster mosheh panayv ki yare mehabbit el-haelohim
Vaamar ana elaha deabuk elaha deabraham elaha deyitzchaq velaha deyaaqob ukebeshinnun msheh leappohi are dachil milistakkala betzet yeqara daAdonai:
Vayyomer Adonai raoh raiti et-oni ammi asher bemitzrayim veet-tzaaqatam shamati mippene nogesayv ki yadati et-makobayv
Vaamar Adonai migla geli qodamay yat shibud ami di bemitzrayim veyat qebeltehon shemia qodamay min qodam maplechehon are gele qadamay yat kebehon:
Vaered lehatztzilo miyyad mitzrayim ulehaaloto min-haaretz hahiv el-eretz toba urechaba el-eretz zabat chalab udebash el-meqom hakkenaani vehachitti vehaemori vehapperizzi vehachivvi vehayebusi
Veitgeleti leshezabutehon mida demitzrae uleasaqutehon min ara hahi leara taba upatya leara abeda chalab udebash laatar kenaanae vechittae veemorae uperizae vechivae vibusae:
Veatta hinneh tzaaqat bene-yisrael baa elay vegam-raiti et-hallachatz asher mitzrayim lochatzim otam
Ukean ha qebelat bene yisrael alat qodamay veap gele qodamay yat dochaqa di mitzrae dachaqin lehon:
Veatta leka veeshelachaka el-paroh vehotze et-ammi bene-yisrael mimmitzrayim
Ukean ita vaashalchinnak levat paroh veappeq yat ami bene yisrael mimitzrayim:
Vayyomer mosheh el-haelohim mi anoki ki elek el-paroh veki otzi et-bene yisrael mimmitzrayim
Vaamar msheh qodam Adonai man ana are ezil levat paroh vaare appeq yat bene yisrael mimitzrayim:
Vayyomer ki-eheyeh immak vezeh-leka haot ki anoki shelachtika behotziaka et-haam mimmitzrayim taabdun et-haelohim al hahar hazzeh
Vaamar are yehe memeri besadak veden lak ata are ana shelachtak beappaqutak yat ama mimitzrayim tiplechun qodam Adonai al tura haden:
Vayyomer mosheh el-haelohim hinneh anoki ba el-bene yisrael veamarti lahem elohe abotekem shelachani alekem veameru-li mah-shemo ma omar alehem
Vaamar msheh qodam Adonai ha ana ate levat bene yisrael veemar lehon elaha deabhatkon shalchani levatekon veyemerun li ma shemeh ma emar lehon:
Vayyomer elohim el-mosheh eheyeh asher eheyeh vayyomer koh tomar libne yisrael eheyeh shelachani alekem
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ehyeh asher ehyeh vaamar kidnan temar libne yisrael ehyeh shalchani levatekon:
Vayyomer od elohim el-mosheh koh-tomar el-bene yisrael Adonai elohe abotekem elohe abraham elohe yitzchaq velohe yaaqob shelachani alekem zeh-shemi leolam vezeh zikri ledor dor
Vaamar od Adonai lemsheh kidnan temar libne yisrael Adonai elaha deabhatkon elaheh deabraham elaheh deyitzchaq velaheh deyaaqob shalchani levatekon den shemi lealam veden dakerani lekol dar vedar:
Lek veasapta et-ziqne yisrael veamarta alehem Adonai elohe abotekem nira elay elohe abraham yitzchaq veyaaqob lemor paqod paqadti etkem veet-heasuy lakem bemitzrayim
Izel vetiknosh yat sabe yisrael vetemar lehon Adonai elaha deabhatkon itgele li elaheh deabraham yitzchaq veyaaqob lememar midkar dekirena yatkon veyat deitabad lekon bemitzrayim:
Vaomar aaleh etkem meoni mitzrayim el-eretz hakkenaani vehachitti vehaemori vehapperizzi vehachivvi vehayebusi el-eretz zabat chalab udebash
Vaamarit aseq yatekon mishibud mitzrae laara kenaanae vechittae veemorae uperizae vechivae vibusae leara abda chalab udebash:
Veshameu leqoleka ubata atta veziqne yisrael el-melek mitzrayim vaamartem elayv Adonai elohe haibriyyim niqra alenu veatta neleka-na derek sheloshet yamim bammidbar venizbecha la-Adonai elohenu
Viqabbelun lememerak vetete at vesabe yisrael levat malka demitzrayim vetemerun leh Adonai elaha dihudae itqere alana ukean nezel kean mahalak telata yomin bemadbera unedabbach qodam Adonai elahana:
Vaani yadati ki lo-yitten etkem melek mitzrayim lahalok velo beyad chazaqa
Uqedamay gele are la yishboq yatekon malka demitzrayim lemezal vela min qodam decheleh taqip:
Veshalachti et-yadi vehikketi et-mitzrayim bekol nipleotay asher eeseh beqirbo veachare-ken yeshallach etkem
Vaashalach pon yat mechat geburti veemche yat mitzrae bekol perishvati di abed benehon ubatar ken yeshalach yatekon:
Venatatti et-chen haam-hazzeh beene mitzrayim vehaya ki telekun lo teleku reqam
Veetten yat ama haden lerachamin beene mitzrae vihe are tehakun la tehakun reqanin:
Veshaala ishsha mishshekentah umiggarat betah kele-kesep ukele zahab usemalot vesamtem al-benekem veal-benotekem venitztzaltem et-mitzrayim
Vetishal itteta mishbabtah umiqribat betah manin diksap umanin didhab ulebushin uteshavun al benekon veal benatekon uteroqinun yat mitzrayim:
Vayyaan mosheh vayyomer vehen lo-yaaminu li velo yishmeu beqoli ki yomeru lo-nira eleka Adonai
Vaateb msheh vaamar veha la yehemenun li vela yeqabbelun mini are yemerun la itgele lak Adonai:
Vayyomer elayv Adonai mah-zeh beyadeka vayyomer matteh
Vaamar leh Adonai ma den bidak vaamar chutera:
Vayyomer hashlikehu artza vayyashlikehu artza vayehi lenachash vayyanos mosheh mippanayv
Vaamar remihi leara uremahi leara vahava lechive vaaraq msheh min qodamohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh shelach yadeka veechoz biznabo vayyishlach yado vayyachazeq bo vayehi lematteh bekappo
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh oshit yedak veechod bezanbeh veoshet yedeh veatqep beh vahava lechutera bideh:
Lemaan yaaminu ki-nira eleka Adonai elohe abotam elohe abraham elohe yitzchaq velohe yaaqob
Bedil dihemenun are itgeli lak Adonai elaha deabhathon elaheh deabraham elaheh deyitzchaq veelaheh deyaaqob:
Vayyomer Adonai lo od habe-na yadeka becheqeka vayyabe yado becheqo vayyotziah vehinneh yado metzoraat kashshaleg
Vaamar Adonai leh od ael kean yedak beitpak veael yedeh beitpeh veapqah veha yedeh chavra ketalga:
Vayyomer hasheb yadeka el-cheqeka vayyasheb yado el-cheqo vayyotziah mecheqo vehinneh-shaba kibsaro
Vaamar ateb yedak leitpak vaateb yedeh leitpeh veapqah meitpeh veha tabat havat kebisreh:
Vehaya im-lo yaaminu lak velo yishmeu leqol haot harishon veheeminu leqol haot haacharon
Vihe im la yehemenun lak vela yeqabbelun leqal ata qadmaa vihemenun leqal ata batraa:
Vehaya im-lo yaaminu gam lishne haotot haelleh velo yishmeun leqoleka velaqachta mimmeme hayeor veshapakta hayyabbasha vehayu hammayim asher tiqqach min-hayeor vehayu ledam bayyabbashet
Vihe im la yehemenun ap litren ataya haillen vela yeqabbelun minak vetisab mimaya dibnahara veteshod leyabbeshta vihon maya di tisab min nahara vihon lidma beyabbeshta:
Vayyomer mosheh el-Adonai bi adonay lo ish debarim anoki gam mittemol gam mishshilshom gam meaz dabberka el-abdeka ki kebad-peh ukebad lashon anoki
Vaamar msheh qodam Adonai bebau Adonai la gebar demilul ana ap mittemali ap midqamohi ap meidan demalelta im abdak are yaqir mamlal veamiq lishan ana:
Vayyomer Adonai elayv mi sam peh laadam o mi-yasum illem o cheresh o piqqeach o ivver halo anoki Adonai
Vaamar Adonai leh man shavi puma laanasha o man shavi ilma o cheresha o piqcha o avira hala ana Adonai:
Veatta lek veanoki eheyeh im-pika vehoretika asher tedabber
Ukean ezel umemeri yehe im pumak vealepinak di temalel:
Vayyomer bi adonay shelach-na beyad-tishlach
Vaamar bebau Adonai shelach kean beyad man dekashar detishlach:
Vayyichar-ap Adonai bemosheh vayyomer halo aharon achika hallevi yadati ki-dabber yedabber hu vegam hinneh-hv yotze liqrateka veraaka vesamach belibbo
Uteqep rugeza daAdonai bemsheh vaamar hala aharon achuk levae gele qodamay are malala yemalel hu veap ha hu napeq leqadamutak veyechezinak veyechde belibbeh:
Vedibbarta elayv vesamta et-haddebarim bepiv veanoki eheyeh im-pika veim-pihu vehoreti etkem et asher taasun
Utemalel imeh uteshavi yat pitgamaya bepumeh umemeri yehe im pumak veim pumeh vealep yatekon yat di tabedun:
Vedibber-hv leka el-haam vehaya hu yiheyeh-leka lepeh veatta tiheyeh-lo lelohim
Vimalel hu lak leama vihe hu yehe lak limturgeman veat tehe leh lerab:
Veet-hammatteh hazzeh tiqqach beyadeka asher taaseh-bo et-haotot
Veyat chutra haden tisab bidak detabed beh yat ataya:
Vayyelek mosheh vayyashob el-yeter choteno vayyomer lo eleka na veashuba el-achay asher-bemitzrayim veereh haodam chayyim vayyomer yitro lemosheh lek leshalom
Vaazal msheh vetab levat yeter chamohi vaamar leh ezil kean veetub levat achay di bemitzrayim veecheze haad kean qayamin vaamar yitro lemsheh ezel lishlam:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh bemidyan lek shub mitzrayim ki-metu kol-haanashim hamebaqshim et-napsheka
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh bemidyan ezel tub lemitzrayim are mitu kol gubraya dibo lemiqtelak:
Vayyiqqach mosheh et-ishto veet-banayv vayyarkibem al-hachamor vayyashob artza mitzrayim vayyiqqach mosheh et-matteh haelohim beyado
Udebar msheh yat itteteh veyat benohi vearkebinun al chamara vetab leara demitzrayim unesib msheh yat chutera deitabidu beh nisin min qodam Adonai bideh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh belekteka lashub mitzrayma reeh kol-hammopetim asher-samti beyadeka vaasitam lipne paroh vaani achazzeq et-libbo velo yeshallach et-haam
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh bimhakak lemittub lemitzrayim chaze kol mopetaya di shaveti bidak vetabedinun qodam paroh vaana atqep yat libbeh vela yeshalach yat ama:
Veamarta el-paroh koh amar Adonai beni bekori yisrael
Vetemar levat paroh kidnan amar Adonai beri bukeri yisrael:
Vaomar eleka shallach et-beni veyaabdeni vattemaen leshallecho hinneh anoki horeg et-binka bekoreka
Vaamarit lak shalach yat beri veyiplach qodamay veim sarib at leshalachuteh ha ana qatil yat berak bukerak:
Vayehi badderek bammalon vayyipgeshehu Adonai vayebaqqesh hamito
Vahava beorcha bebet mebata vaara beh malaka daAdonai ubea lemiqteleh:
Vattiqqach tzippora tzor vattikrot et-orlat benah vattagga leraglayv vattomer ki chatan-damim atta li
Unesebat tzippora tinara ugezarat yat orlat berah uqeribat loqodamohi vaameret are bidma dimhulta haden ityeheb chatna lana:
Vayyirep mimmennu az amera chatan damim lammulot
Venach mineh beken ameret ilule dema dimhulta haden itchayab chatna qetol:
Vayyomer Adonai el-aharon lek liqrat mosheh hammidbara vayyelek vayyipgeshehu behar haelohim vayyishshaq-lo
Vaamar Adonai leaharon ezel leqadamut msheh lemadbera vaazal veareh betura deitgele alohi yeqara daAdonai uneshaq leh:
Vayyagged mosheh leaharon et kol-dibre Adonai asher shelacho veet kol-haotot asher tzivvahu
Vechavi msheh leaharon yat kol pitgamaya daAdonai di shalcheh veyat kol ataya di paqdeh:
Vayyelek mosheh veaharon vayyaaspu et-kol-ziqne bene yisrael

Vaamar Adonai lemsheh emar leaharon arem yat chutrak umecha yat apra deara vihe leqalmeta bekol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyaasu-ken vayyet aharon et-yado bemattehu vayyak et-apar haaretz vattehi hakkinnam baadam ubabbehema kol-apar haaretz haya kinnim bekol-eretz mitzrayim
Vaabadu ken vaarem aharon yat yedeh bechutreh umecha yat apra deara vahavat qalmeta baanasha ubibira kol apra deara havat qalmeta bekol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyaasu-ken hachartummim belatehem lehotzi et-hakkinnim velo yakolu vattehi hakkinnam baadam ubabbehema
Vaabadu ken charashayya belachashehon leappaqa yat qalmeta vela yakilu vahavat qalmeta baanasha ubibira:
Vayyomeru hachartummim el-paroh etzba elohim hiv vayyechezaq leb-paroh velo-shama alehem kaasher dibber Adonai
Vaamaru charashayya leparoh ha macha min qodam Adonai hi veittaqqap libba deparoh vela qabbil minnehon kema dimallil Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh hashkem babboqer vehityatztzeb lipne paroh hinneh yotze hammayema veamarta elayv koh amar Adonai shallach ammi veyaabduni
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh aqdem betzapra veitattad qodam paroh ha napeq lemayya vetemar leh kidnan amar Adonai shallach ammi veyiplechun qodamay:
Ki im-eneka meshalleach et-ammi hinni mashliach beka ubaabadeka ubeammeka ubebatteka et-hearob umaleu batte mitzrayim et-hearob vegam haadama asher-hem aleha
Are im letak meshallach yat ammi ha ana mashlach bak ubeabdayk ubeammak ubebattayk yat aroba veyimlun batte mitzrayim yat aroba veap ara diinnun alah:
Vehipleti bayyom hahu et-eretz goshen asher ammi omed aleha lebilti heyot-sham arob lemaan teda ki ani Adonai beqereb haaretz
Veapresh beyoma hahu yat ara degshen diammi qaim alah bedil dela lemeheve tamman aroba bedil detidda are ana Adonai shallit bego ara:
Vesamti pedut ben ammi uben ammeka lemachar yihyeh haot hazzeh
Veeshavve pureqan leammi veal ammak ayti macha limchar yehe ata haden:
Vayyaas Adonai ken vayyabo arob kabed beta paroh ubet abadayv ubekol-eretz mitzrayim tishshachet haaretz mippene hearob
Vaabad Adonai ken vaata aroba taqqip lebet paroh ulebet abdohi ubekol ara demitzrayim itchabbalat ara min qodam aroba:
Vayyiqra paroh el-mosheh uleaharon vayyomer leku zibchu lelohekem baaretz
Uqera paroh lemsheh uleaharon vaamar ezilu dabbachu qodam elahakon beara:
Vayyomer mosheh lo nakon laasot ken ki toabat mitzrayim nizbach la-Adonai elohenu hen nizbach et-toabat mitzrayim leenehem velo yisqelunu

Vaamar msheh la taqqen lemebad ken are beira demitzrae dachalin leh minneh anachna nasebin ledabbacha qodam Adonai elahana ha nedabbach yat beira demitzrae dachalin leh veinnun yehon chazan hala yemerun lemirgemana:
Derek sheloshet yamim nelek bammidbar vezabachnu la-Adonai elohenu kaasher yomar elenu
Mahalak telata yomin nezil bemadbera unedabbach qodam Adonai elahana kema diyemar lana:
Vayyomer paroh anoki ashallach etkem uzebachtem la-Adonai elohekem bammidbar raq harcheq lo-tarchiqu laleket hatiru baadi
Vaamar paroh ana ashallach yatekon vetidbechun qodam Adonai elahakon bemadbera lechod archaqa la terachaqun lemezal tzallo ap alay:
Vayyomer mosheh hinneh anoki yotze meimmak vehatarti el-Adonai vesar hearob mipparoh meabadayv umeammo machar raq al-yosep paroh hatel lebilti shallach et-haam lizboach la-Adonai
Vaamar msheh ha ana napeq meimmak veetzalle qodam Adonai veyade aroba mipparoh meabdohi umeammeh mechar lechod la yosep paroh leshaqqara bedil dela leshallacha yat amma ledabbacha qodam Adonai:
Vayyetze mosheh meim paroh vayyetar el-Adonai
Unepaq msheh min qodam paroh vetzalli qodam Adonai:
Vayyaas Adonai kidbar mosheh vayyasar hearob mipparoh meabadayv umeammo lo nishar echad
Vaabad Adonai kepitgama demsheh veadi aroba mipparoh meabdohi umeammeh la ishtaar chad:
Vayyakbed paroh et-libbo gam bappaam hazzot velo shillach et-haam
Veyaqqar paroh yat libbeh ap bezimna hada vela shallach yat amma:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh bo el-paroh vedibbarta elayv koh-amar Adonai elohe haibrim shallach et-ammi veyaabduni
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ul levat paroh utemallel immeh kidnan amar Adonai elaha dihudae shallach yat ammi veyiplechun qodamay:
Ki im-maen atta leshalleach veodeka machaziq bam
Are im sarib at leshallacha vead kean at matqep behon:
Hinneh yad-Adonai hoya bemiqneka asher bassadeh bassusim bachamorim baggemallim babbaqar ubatztzon deber kabed meod
Ha macha min qodam Adonai haveya bibirak dibchaqla besusavata bachamare begamle betore ubeana mota taqqip lachada:
Vehipla Adonai ben miqneh yisrael uben miqneh mitzrayim velo yamut mikkol-libne yisrael dabar
Veapresh Adonai ben beira deyisrael uben beira demitzrayim vela yemut mikkol libne yisrael middaam:
Vayyasem Adonai moed lemor machar yaaseh Adonai haddabar hazzeh baaretz
Veshavvi Adonai zimna lememar mechar yabed Adonai pitgama haden beara:
Vayyaas Adonai et-haddabar hazzeh mimmochorat vayyamot kol miqneh mitzrayim umimmiqneh bene-yisrael lo-met echad
Vaabad Adonai yat pitgama haden beyoma debatrohi umit kol beira demitzrayim umibbeira dibne yisrael la mit chad:
Vayyishlach paroh vehinneh lo-met mimmiqneh yisrael ad-echad vayyikbad leb paroh velo shillach et-haam
Ushelach paroh veha la mit mibbeira deyisrael ad chad veityaqqar libba deparoh vela shallach yat amma:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon qechu lakem melo chopnekem piach kibshan uzeraqo mosheh hashshamayma leene paroh
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh uleaharon sibu lekon mele chopnekon picha deattuna veyizreqinneh msheh letzet shemayya leene paroh
Vehaya leabaq al kol-eretz mitzrayim vehaya al-haadam veal-habbehema lishchin poreach ababuot bekol-eretz mitzrayim
Vihe leabqa al kol ara demitzrayim vihe al anasha veal beira leshichana saggi ababuin bekol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyiqchu et-piach hakkibshan vayyaamdu lipne paroh vayyizroq oto mosheh hashshamayema vayehi shechin ababuot poreach baadam ubabbehema
Unesibu yat picha deattuna veqamu qodam paroh uzeraq yateh msheh letzet shemayya vahava shichana ababuin sage baanasha ubibira:
Velo-yakelu hachartummim laamod lipne mosheh mippene hashshechin ki-haya hashshechin bachartummim ubekol-mitzrayim
Vela yakilu charashayya lemeqam qodam msheh min qodam shichana are hava shichana becharashayya ubekol mitzrae:
Vayechazzeq Adonai et-leb paroh velo shama alehem kaasher dibber Adonai el-mosheh
Vetaqqip Adonai yat libba deparoh vela qabbil minnehon kema demallel Adonai im msheh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh hashkem babboqer vehityatztzeb lipne paroh veamarta elayv koh-amar Adonai elohe haibrim shallach et-ammi veyaabduni
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh aqdem betzapra veitattad qodam paroh vetemar leh kidnan amar Adonai elaha dihudae shallach yat ammi veyiplechun qodamay:
Ki bappaam hazzot ani sholeach et-kol-maggepotay el-libbeka ubaabadeka ubeammeka baabur teda ki en kamoni bekol-haaretz
Are bezimna hada ana shalach yat kol mechatay lelibbak ubeabdayk ubeammak bedil detidda are let dikvati shallit bekol ara:
Ki atta shalachti et-yadi vaak oteka veet-ammeka baddaber vattikkached min-haaretz
Are kean qereb qodamay deeshlach pon yat machat geburti veemche yatak veyat ammak bemota veshetziat min ara:
Veulam baabur zot heemadtika baabur haroteka et-kochi ulemaan sapper shemi bekol-haaretz
Uberam bedil da qayyemittak bedil leachazayutak yat cheli ubedil dihon mishtaan geburat shemi bekol ara:
Odeka mistolel beammi lebilti shallecham
Ad kean at kebeshat beh beammi bedil dela leshallachutehon:
Hinni mamtir kaet machar barad kabed meod asher lo-haya kamohu bemitzrayim lemin-hayyom hivvaseda vead-atta
Ha ana machet mitra beiddana haden mechar barda taqqip lachada di la hava dikvateh bemitzrayim lemin yoma deishtaklalat vead kean:
Veatta shelach haez et-miqneka veet kol-asher leka bassadeh kol-haadam vehabbehema asher-yimmatze bassadeh velo yeasep habbayta veyarad alehem habbarad vametu
Ukean shelach kenosh yat beirak veyat kol di lak bechaqla kol anasha ubeira deishtekach bechaqla vela yitkenesh lebeta veyechot alehon barda vimutun:
Hayyare et-debar Adonai meabde paroh henis et-abadayv veet-miqnehu el-habbattim
Dedachil mippitgama daAdonai meabde paroh kenash yat abdohi veyat getohi lebattayya:
Vaasher lo-sam libbo el-debar Adonai vayyaazob et-abadayv veet-miqnehu bassadeh
Vedi la shavvi libbeh lepitgama daAdonai shebaq yat abdohi veyat getohi bechaqla:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh neteh et-yadeka al-hashshamayim vihi barad bekol-eretz mitzrayim al-haadam veal-habbehema veal kol-eseb hassadeh beeretz mitzrayim
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh arem yat yedak al tzet shemayya vihe barda bekol ara demitzrae al anasha veal beira veal kol esba dechaqla beara demitzrayim:
Vayyet mosheh et-mattehu al-hashshamayim va-Adonai natan qolot ubarad vattihalak esh aretza vayyamter Adonai barad al-eretz mitzrayim
Vaarem msheh yat chutreh al tzet shemayya vayya yehab qalin ubarda umehalleka eshshata al ara veamtar Adonai barda al ara demitzrayim:
Vayehi barad veesh mitlaqqachat betok habbarad kabed meod asher lo-haya kamohu bekol-eretz mitzrayim meaz hayeta legoy
Vahava barda veeshshata mishtalhabat bego barda taqqip lachada di la hava dikvateh bekol ara demitzrayim meiddan dahavat leam:
Vayyak habbarad bekol-eretz mitzrayim et kol-asher bassadeh meadam vead-behema veet kol-eseb hassadeh hikka habbarad veet-kol-etz hassadeh shibber
Umecha barda bekol ara demitzrayim yat kol di bechaqla meanasha vead beira veyat kol esba dechaqla mecha barda veyat kol ilan dibchaqla tebar:
Raq beeretz goshen asher-sham bene yisrael lo haya barad
Lechod beara degshen di tamman bene yisrael la hava barda:
Vayyishlach paroh vayyiqra lemosheh uleaharon vayyomer alehem chatati happaam Adonai hatztzaddiq vaani veammi hareshaim
Ushelach paroh uqera lemsheh uleaharon vaamar lehon chabit zimna hada Adonai zakkaa vaana veammi chayyabin:
Hatiru el-Adonai verab miheyot qolot elohim ubarad vaashallecha etkem velo tosipun laamod
Tzallo qodam Adonai vesaggi qodamohi revach dela yehon alana qalin dilvat keillen min qodam Adonai ubarda veeshlach yatekon vela tosepun leitakkaba:
Vayyomer elayv mosheh ketzeti et-hair epros et-kappay el-Adonai haqqolot yechdalun vehabbarad lo yiheyeh-od lemaan teda ki la-Adonai haaretz
Vaamar leh msheh kemippeqi min qarta epros yeday bitzlo qodam Adonai qalayya yitmanneun ubarda la yehe od bedil detidda are daAdonai ara:
Veatta vaabadeka yadati ki terem tireun mippene Adonai elohim
Veat veabdayk yedana are ad kean la itkenatun min qodam Adonai ellohim:
Vehappishta vehasseora nukkata ki hasseora abib vehappishta gibol
Vekittana vesaare leqo are saranya abbibin vekittana gabolin:
Vehachitta vehakkussemet lo nukku ki apilot henna
Vechittaa vekuntayya la leqo are apilata innun:
Vayyetze mosheh meim paroh et-hair vayyipros kappayv el-Adonai vayyachdelu haqqolot vehabbarad umatar lo-nittak aretza
Unepaq msheh millevat paroh yat qarta uperas yedohi bitzlo qodam Adonai veyitmanneun qalayya ubarda umitra dahava nachit la meta al ara:
Vayyar paroh ki-chadal hammatar vehabbarad vehaqqolot vayyosep lachato vayyakbed libbo hu vaabadayv
Vachaza paroh are itmena mitra ubarda veqalayya veosep lemechete veyaqqereh lelibbeh hu veabdohi:
Vayyechezaq leb paroh velo shillach et-bene yisrael kaasher dibber Adonai beyad-mosheh
Veittaqqap libba deparoh vela shallach yat bene yisrael kema di mallel Adonai bida demsheh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh bo el-paroh ki-ani hikbadti et-libbo veet-leb abadayv lemaan shiti ototay elleh beqirbo
