Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ul levat paroh are ana yaqarit yat libbeh veyat libba deabdohi bedil leshavaa atay ilen benehon:
Ulemaan tesapper beozne binka uben-binka et asher hitallalti bemitzrayim veet-ototay asher-samti bam vidatem ki-ani Adonai
Ubedil detishtae qodam berak ubar berak yat nisin di abadit bemitzrayim veyat atvatay di shaveti behon vetidun are ana Adonai:
Vayyabo mosheh veaharon el-paroh vayyomeru elayv koh-amar Adonai elohe haibrim ad-matay meanta leanot mippanay shallach ammi veyaabduni
Vaata msheh veaharon levat paroh vaamaru leh kidnan amar Adonai elaha dihudae ad imatay mesareb at leitkenaa min qodamay shalach ami veyiplechun qodamay:
Ki im-maen atta leshalleach et-ammi hinni mebi machar arbeh bigbuleka
Are im sareb at leshalacha yat ami ha ana mayyti mechar goba bitchumak:
Vekissa et-en haaretz velo yukal lirot et-haaretz veakal et-yeter happeleta hannisheret lakem min-habbarad veakal et-kol-haetz hatztzomeach lakem min-hassadeh
Vachapa yat en shimsha deara vela yikkul lemecheze yat ara veyekul yat shear shezabta deishtaar lekon min barda veyekul yat kol ilana deatzmach lekon min chaqla:
Umaleu batteka ubatte kol-abadeka ubatte kol-mitzrayim asher lo-rau aboteka vaabot aboteka miyyom heyotam al-haadama ad hayyom hazzeh vayyipen vayyetze meim paroh
Veyimlun battayk ubatte kol abdayk ubatte kol mitzrayim di la chazo abahatak vaabahat abahatak miyoma demehevehon al ara ad yoma haden veitpeni unepaq min qodam paroh:
Vayyomeru abde paroh elayv ad-matay yihyeh zeh lanu lemoqesh shallach et-haanashim veyaabdu et-Adonai elohehem haterem teda ki abeda mitzrayim
Vaamaru abde paroh leh ad imatay yehe den lana letaqla shalach yat gubraya veyiplechun qodam Adonai elahahon haad kean la yedata are abedat mitzrayim:
Vayyushab et-mosheh veet-aharon el-paroh vayyomer alehem leku ibdu et-Adonai elohekem mi vami haholekim
Veittotab yat msheh veyat aharon levat paroh vaamar lehon ezilu pelachu qodam Adonai elahakon man uman deazelin:
Vayyomer mosheh binarenu ubizqenenu nelek bebanenu ubibnotenu betzonenu ubibqarenu nelek ki chag-Adonai lanu
Vaamar msheh beulemanna ubesabanna nezel bebanana ubibnatana beanana ubetorana nezel are chaga qodam Adonai lana:
Vayyomer alehem yehi ken Adonai immakem kaasher ashallach etkem veet-tappekem reu ki raa neged penekem
Vaamar lehon yehe ken memera daAdonai besadekon kad ashshalach yatekon veyat taplekon chazo are bisha deattun sebirin lemebad loqobel appekon leistachara:
Lo ken leku-na haggebarim veibdu et-Adonai ki otah attem mebaqshim vayegaresh otam meet pene paroh
La ken ezilu kean gubraya upelachu qodam Adonai are yatah attun baan vetarik yatehon min qodam paroh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh neteh yadeka al-eretz mitzrayim baarbeh veyaal al-eretz mitzrayim veyokal et-kol-eseb haaretz et kol-asher hishir habbarad
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh arem yedak al ara demitzrayim veyete goba veyisaq al ara demitzrayim veyekul yat kol isba deara yat kol di ashar barda:
Vayyet mosheh et-mattehu al-eretz mitzrayim va-Adonai nihag ruach-qadim baaretz kol-hayyom hahu vekol-hallayela habboqer haya veruach haqqadim nasa et-haarbeh
Vaarem msheh yat chutreh al ara demitzrayim vaAdonai dabbar ruach qiduma beara kol yoma hahu vekol leleya tzapra hava veruach qiduma netal yat goba:
Vayyaal haarbeh al kol-eretz mitzrayim vayyanach bekol gebul mitzrayim kabed meod lepanayv lo-haya ken arbeh kamohu veacharayv lo yiheyeh-ken
Useleq goba al kol ara demitzrayim ushera bekol techum mitzrayim taqip lachada qodamohi la hava ken goba dikvateh ubatrohi la yehe ken:
Vayekas et-en kol-haaretz vattechshak haaretz vayyokal et-kol-eseb haaretz veet kol-peri haetz asher hotir habbarad velo-notar kol-yereq baetz ubeeseb hassadeh bekol-eretz mitzrayim
Vachapa yat en shimsha dekal ara vachashokat ara vaakal yat kol esba deara veyat kol pere ilana di ashar barda vela ishtaar kol yaroqa beilana ubeesba dechaqla bekol ara demitzrayim:
Vayemaher paroh liqro lemosheh uleaharon vayyomer chatati la-Adonai elohekem velakem
Veochi paroh lemiqre lemsheh uleaharon vaamar chabit qodam Adonai elahakon ulekon:
Veatta sa na chattati ak happaam vehatiru la-Adonai elohekem veyaser mealay raq et-hammavet hazzeh
Ukean sheboq kean lechobi beram zimna hada vetzalo qadam Adonai elahakon veyade mini lechod yat mota haden:
Vayyetze meim paroh vayyetar el-Adonai
Unepaq milvat paroh vetzali qodam Adonai:
Vayyahapok Adonai ruach-yam chazaq meod vayyissa et-haarbeh vayyitqaehu yamma sup lo nishar arbeh echad bekol gebul mitzrayim
Vahapak Adonai rucha maarba taqip lachada unetal yat goba uremahi leyama desup la ishtaar goba chad bekol techum mitzrayim:
Vayechazzeq Adonai et-leb paroh velo shillach et-bene yisrael
Veatqep Adonai yat libba deparoh vela shalach yat bene yisrael:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh neteh yadeka al-hashshamayim vihi choshek al-eretz mitzrayim veyamesh choshek
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh arem yedak al tzet shemaya vihe chashoka al ara demitzrayim batar deyade qebel leleya:
Vayyet mosheh et-yado al-hashshamayim vayehi choshek-apela bekol-eretz mitzrayim sheloshet yamim
Vaarem msheh yat yedeh al tzet shemaya vahava chashok qebel bekol ara demitzrayim telata yomin:
Lo-rau ish et-achiv velo-qamu ish mittachtayv sheloshet yamim ulekol-bene yisrael haya or bemoshebotam
La chazo enash yat achohi vela qamu enash mittechotohi telata yomin ulekal bene yisrael hava nehora bemotebanehon:
Vayyiqra paroh el-mosheh vayyomer leku ibdu et-Adonai raq tzonekem ubeqarkem yutztzag gam-tappekem yelek immakem
Uqera paroh lemsheh vaamar ezilu pelachu qodam Adonai lechod anekon vetorekon shebuqu ap taplekon yezel imkon:
Vayyomer mosheh gam-atta titten beyadenu zebachim veolot veasinu la-Adonai elohenu
Vaamar msheh ap at timsar bidana niksat qudshin vaalavan venabed qodam Adonai elahana:
Vegam-miqnenu yelek immanu lo tishshaer parsa ki mimmennu niqqach laabod et-Adonai elohenu vaanachnu lo-neda mah-naabod et-Adonai ad-boenu shamma
Veap beirana yezel imana la tishtaar midaam are mineh anachna nasebin lemiplach qodam Adonai elahana vaanachna let anachna yadein ma niplach qodam Adonai ad metana taman:
Vayechazzeq Adonai et-leb paroh velo aba leshallecham
Veatqep Adonai yat libba deparoh vela aba leshalachutehon:
Vayyomer-lo paroh lek mealay hishshamer leka al-tosep reot panay ki beyom reoteka panay tamut
Vaamar leh paroh izel meilavay istamar lak la tosip lemecheze appay are beyoma detecheze appay temut:
Vayyomer mosheh ken dibbarta lo-osip od reot paneka
Vaamar msheh yaut maleleta la osip od lemecheze appayk:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh od nega echad abi al-paroh veal-mitzrayim achare-ken yeshallach etkem mizzeh keshallecho kala garesh yegaresh etkem mizzeh
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh od maktash chad ayti al paroh veal mitzrayim batar ken yeshalach yatekon mikka keshalachuteh gemera taraka yetarek yatekon mikka:
Dabber-na beozne haam veyishalu ish meet reehu veishsha meet reutah kele-kesep ukele zahab
Malel kean qodam ama veyishalun gebar min chabreh veitteta min chabertah manin diksap umanin didhab:
Vayyitten Adonai et-chen haam beene mitzrayim gam haish mosheh gadol meod beeretz mitzrayim beene abde-paroh ubeene haam
Vihab Adonai yat ama lerachamin beene mitzrayim ap gabra msheh rab lachada beara demitzrayim beene abde paroh ubeene ama:
Vayyomer mosheh koh amar Adonai kachatzot hallayla ani yotze betok mitzrayim
Vaamar msheh kidnan amar Adonai kepalgut leleya ana mitgeli bego mitzrayim:
Umet kol-bekor beeretz mitzrayim mibbekor paroh hayyosheb al-kiso ad bekor hashshipcha asher achar harechayim vekol bekor behema
Vimut kol bukera beara demitzrayim mibbukera deparoh deatid lemittab al karese malkuteh ad bukera deamta di batar recheya vekol bukera dibira:
Vehayeta tzeaqa gedola bekol-eretz mitzrayim asher kamohu lo nihyata vekamohu lo tosip
Utehe tzevachta rabba bekol ara demitzrayim dikvateh la havat vedikvateh la tosep:
Ulekol bene yisrael lo yecheratz-keleb leshono lemeish vead-behema lemaan tedeun asher yapleh Adonai ben mitzrayim uben yisrael
Ulekol bene yisrael la yanzeq kalba belisheneh leminbach lemeanasha vead beira bedil detidun deyapresh Adonai ben mitzrayim uben yisrael:
Veyaredu kol-abadeka elleh elay vehishtachavu-li lemor tze atta vekol-haam asher-beragleka veachare-ken etze vayyetze meim-paroh bochori-ap
Veyechetun kol abdayk ilen levati veyibon mini lememar puq at vekol ama di imak ubatar ken eppoq unepaq milvat paroh bitqop regaz:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh lo-yishma alekem paroh lemaan rebot mopetay beeretz mitzrayim
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh la yeqabbel minkon paroh bedil leasgaa mopetay beara demitzrayim:
Umosheh veaharon asu et-kol-hammopetim haelleh lipne paroh vayechazzeq Adonai et-leb paroh velo-shillach et-bene-yisrael meartzo
Umsheh veaharon abadu yat kol mopetaya hailen qodam paroh veatqep Adonai yat libba deparoh vela shalach yat bene yisrael meareh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon beeretz mitzrayim lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh uleaharon beara demitzrayim lememar:
Hachodesh hazzeh lakem rosh chodashim rishon hu lakem lechodshe hashshana
Yarcha haden lekon resh yarchin qadmay hu lekon leyarche shatta:
Dabberu el-kol-adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh hazzeh veyiqchu lahem ish seh lebet-abot seh labbayit
Malilu im kol kenishta deyisrael lememar beasra leyarcha haden veyisbun lehon gebar imar lebet abba imar lebeta:
Veim-yimat habbayit mihyot misseh velaqach hu ushekeno haqqarob el-beto bemiksat nepashot ish lepi oklo takossu al-hasseh
Veim yizer beta militmenaa al imra veyisab hu veshebabeh deqarib lebeteh beminyan napshata gebar lepum mekeleh titmenun al imra:
Seh tamim zakar ben-shana yihyeh lakem min-hakkebasim umin-haizzim tiqqachu
Imar shelim dekar bar shatteh yehe lekon min imraya umin izaya tisbun:
Vehaya lakem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom lachodesh hazzeh veshachatu oto kol qehal adat-yisrael ben haarbayim
Vihe lekon lematra ad arbea asra yoma leyarcha haden veyikkesun yateh kol qehala kenishta deyisrael ben shimshaya:
Velaqechu min-haddam venatenu al-shete hammezuzot veal-hammashqop al habbattim asher-yokelu oto bahem
Veyisbun min dema veyittenun al teren sippaya veal shaqpa al battaya deyekelun yateh behon:
Veoklu et-habbasar ballayla hazzeh tzeli-esh umatztzot al-merorim yokeluhu
Veyekelun yat bisra belela hahu teve nur upatir al merarin yekeluneh:
Al-tokelu mimmennu na ubashel mebushshal bammayim ki im-tzeli-esh rosho al-keraayv veal-qirbo
La tekelun mineh kad chay veap la bashala mebashel bemaya elahen teve nur resheh al keraohi veal gaveh:
Velo-totiru mimmennu ad-boqer vehannotar mimmennu ad-boqer baesh tisropu
Vela tasharun mineh ad tzapra udeyishtaar mineh ad tzapra benura toqedun:
Vekaka tokelu oto motnekem chagurim naalekem beraglekem umaqqelkem beyedkem vaakaltem oto bechippazon pesach hu la-Adonai
Ukeden tekelun yateh chartzekon yehon asirin mesanekon beriglekon vechuterekon bidekon vetekelun yateh bibhilu pischa hu qodam Adonai:
Veabarti beeretz-mitzrayim ballayla hazzeh vehikketi kol-bekor beeretz mitzrayim meadam vead-behema ubekol-elohe mitzrayim eeseh shepatim ani Adonai
Veitgeleti beara demitzrayim beleleya haden veeqtol kol bukera beara demitzrayim meanasha vead beira ubekol taavat mitzrayim abed dinin ana Adonai:
Vehaya haddam lakem leot al habbattim asher attem sham veraiti et-haddam upasachti alekem velo-yiheyeh bakem negep lemashchit behakkoti beeretz mitzrayim
Vihe dema lekon leat al battaya di attun taman veecheze yat dema veechos alekon vela yehe bekon mota lechabbala bemiqteli beara demitzrayim:
Vehaya hayyom hazzeh lakem lezikkaron vechaggotem oto chag la-Adonai ledorotekem chuqqat olam techogguhu
Vihe yoma haden lekon ledukerana utechagun yateh chaga qodam Adonai ledarekon qeyam alam techaguneh:
Shibat yamim matztzot tokelu ak bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattekem ki kol-okel chametz venikreta hannepesh hahiv miyyisrael miyyom harishon ad-yom hashshebii
Shibat yomin patir tekelun beram beyoma qadmaa tebatlun chamira mibbattekon are kol deyekul chamia veyishtetze enasha hahu miyisrael miyoma qadmaa ad yoma shebiaa:
Ubayyom harishon miqra-qodesh ubayyom hashshebii miqra-qodesh yihyeh lakem kol-melaka lo-yeaseh bahem ak asher yeakel lekol-nepesh hu lebaddo yeaseh lakem
Ubeyoma qadmaa meara qadish ubeyoma shebiaa meara qadish yehe lekon kol ibida la yitabed behon beram di mitakel lekol nepash hu bilchodohi yitabed lekon:
Ushemartem et-hammatztzot ki beetzem hayyom hazzeh hotzeti et-tzibotekem meeretz mitzrayim ushemartem et-hayyom hazzeh ledorotekem chuqqat olam
Vetitrun yat patira are bikran yoma haden appeqit yat chelekon meara demitzrayim vetitrun yat yoma haden ledarekon qeyam alam:
Barishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh baereb tokelu matztzot ad yom haechad veesrim lachodesh baareb
Benisan bearbea asra yoma leyarcha beramsha tekelun patira ad yoma esrin vechad leyarcha beramsha:
Shibat yamim seor lo yimmatze bebattekem ki kol-okel machmetzet venikreta hannepesh hahiv meadat yisrael bagger ubeezrach haaretz
Shibat yomin chamir la yishtekach bebattekon are kol deyekul machmea veyishtetze enasha hahu mikkenishta deyisrael begiyora ubeyatziba deara:
Kol-machmetzet lo tokelu bekol moshebotekem tokelu matztzot
Kol machmea la tekelun bekol motebanekon tekelun patira:
Vayyiqra mosheh lekol-ziqne yisrael vayyomer alehem misheku uqechu lakem tzon lemishpechotekem veshachatu happasach
Uqera msheh lekol sabe yisrael vaamar lehon negidu vesibu lekon min bene ana lezarayatekon vekusu pischa:
Uleqachtem aguddat ezob utebaltem baddam asher-bassap vehiggatem el-hammashqop veel-shete hammezuzot min-haddam asher bassap veattem lo tetzeu ish mippetach-beto ad-boqer
Vetisbun esarat ezoba vetitbelun bidma dibmana vetadun leshaqpa velitren sippaya min dema dibmana veattun la tippequn enash mittera beteh ad tzapra:
Veabar Adonai lingop et-mitzrayim veraa et-haddam al-hammashqop veal shete hammezuzot upasach Adonai al-happetach velo yitten hammashchit labo el-battekem lingop
Veyitgele Adonai lemimche yat mitzrayim veyecheze yat dema al shaqpa veal teren sippaya veyechos Adonai al tara vela yishboq lechabbala lemeal lebattekon lemimche:
Ushemartem et-haddabar hazzeh lechoq-leka ulebaneka ad-olam
Vetitrun yat pitgama haden liqyam lak velibnayk ad alam:
Vehaya ki-tabou el-haaretz asher yitten Adonai lakem kaasher dibber ushemartem et-haaboda hazzot
Vihe are tealun leara deyitten Adonai lekon kema di malil vetitrun yat palechana haden:
Vehaya ki-yomeru alekem benekem ma haaboda hazzot lakem
Vihe are yemerun lekon benekon ma palechana haden lekon:
Vaamartem zebach-pesach hu la-Adonai asher pasach al-batte bene-yisrael bemitzrayim benogpo et-mitzrayim veet-battenu hitztzil vayyiqqod haam vayyishetachavu
Vetemerun dabbach chayas hu qodam Adonai di chas al batte bene yisrael bemitzrayim kad hava mache yat mitzrae veyat battana shezib ukera ama usegidu:
Vayyeleku vayyaasu bene yisrael kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh veaharon ken asu
Vaazalu vaabadu bene yisrael kema depaqid Adonai yat msheh veaharon ken abadu:
Vayehi bachatzi hallayla va-Adonai hikka kol-bekor beeretz mitzrayim mibbekor paroh hayyosheb al-kiso ad bekor hashshebi asher bebet habbor vekol bekor behema
Vahava bepalgut leleya vaAdonai qetal kol bukera beara demitzrayim mibbukera deparoh deatid lemittab al karese malkuteh ad bukera deshibya di bebet asire vekol bukera dibira:
Vayyaqom paroh layla hu vekol-abadayv vekol-mitzrayim vattehi tzeaqa gedola bemitzrayim ki-en bayit asher en-sham met
Veqam paroh leleya hu vekol abdohi vekol mitzrayim vahavat tzevachta rabbeta bemitzrayim are let beta dela hava beh taman meta:
Vayyiqra lemosheh uleaharon layla vayyomer qumu tzeu mittok ammi gam-attem gam-bene yisrael uleku ibdu et-Adonai kedabberkem
Uqera lemsheh uleaharon leleya vaamar qumu puqu migo ami ap attun ap bene yisrael veezilu pelachu qodam Adonai kema dihavetun amerin:
Gam-tzonekem gam-beqarkem qechu kaasher dibbartem valeku uberaktem gam-oti
Ap ankon ap torekon debaru kema di maleletun veezilu vetzalo ap alay:
Vattechezaq mitzrayim al-haam lemaher leshallecham min-haaretz ki ameru kullanu metim
Uteqepat mitzrayim al ama leochaa leshalachutehon min ara are amaru kulana mayetin:
Vayyissa haam et-betzeqo terem yechmatz misharotam tzerurot besimlotam al-shikmam
Unetal ama yat layshehon ad la chama motar atzvatehon tzerir bilbashehon al katpehon:
Ubene-yisrael asu kidbar mosheh vayyishalu mimmitzrayim kele-kesep ukele zahab usemalot
Ubene yisrael abadu kepitgama demsheh usheilu mimitzrayim manin diksap umanin didhab ulebushin:
Va-Adonai natan et-chen haam beene mitzrayim vayyashilum vayenatztzelu et-mitzrayim
Vayya yehab yat ama lerachamin beene mitzrayim veashelinun veroqinu yat mitzrayim:
Vayyisu bene-yisrael merameses sukkota keshesh-meot elep ragli haggebarim lebad mittap
Unetalu bene yisrael merameses lesukkot keshit mea alpin riglain gubraya bar mitapla:
Vegam-ereb rab ala ittam vetzon ubaqar miqneh kabed meod
Veap nukerain sagiin seliqu imhon veana vetorin beira sagi lachada:
Vayyopu et-habbatzeq asher hotziu mimmitzrayim ugot matztzot ki lo chametz ki-goreshu mimmitzrayim velo yakelu lehitmahmeah vegam-tzeda lo-asu lahem
Vaapo yat laysha di appiqu mimitzrayim geritzan patiran are la chama are ittaraku mimitzrayim vela yakilu leitakkaba veap zevadin la abadu lehon:
Umoshab bene yisrael asher yashebu bemitzrayim sheloshim shana vearba meot shana
Umotab bene yisrael di yetibu bemitzrayim arba mea utelatin shenin:
Vayehi miqqetz sheloshim shana vearba meot shana vayehi beetzem hayyom hazzeh yatzeu kol-tzibot Adonai meeretz mitzrayim
Vahava misop arba mea utelatin shenin vahava bikran yoma haden nepaqu kol chelaya daAdonai meara demitzrayim:
Lel shimmurim hu la-Adonai lehotziam meeretz mitzrayim hu-hallayla hazzeh la-Adonai shimmurim lekol-bene yisrael ledorotam
Lel netir hu qodam Adonai leappaqutehon meara demitzrayim hu leleya haden qodam Adonai netirin lekol bene yisrael ledarehon:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh veaharon zot chuqqat happasach kol-ben-nekar lo-yokal bo
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh uleaharon da gezerat pischa kol bar yisrael deyishtamad la yekul beh:
Vekol-ebed ish miqnat-kasep umalta oto az yokal bo
Vekol abad gebar zebine kaspa vetigzar yateh beken yekul beh:
Toshab vesakir lo-yokal bo
Totaba vaagira la yekul beh:
Bebayit echad yeakel lo-totzi min-habbayit min-habbasar chutza veetzem lo tishberu-bo
Bachabura chada yitakel la tappeq min beta min bisra lebara vegarma la titberun beh:
Kol-adat yisrael yaasu oto
Kol kenishta deyisrael yabedun yateh:
Veki-yagur itteka ger veasa pesach la-Adonai himmol lo kol-zakar veaz yiqrab laasoto vehaya keezrach haaretz vekol-arel lo-yokal bo
Vaare yitgayar imak giyora veyabed pischa qodam Adonai migzar leh kol dekura ubeken yiqrab lemebedeh vihe keyatziba deara vekol arla la yekul beh:
Tora achat yihyeh laezrach velagger haggar betokekem
Orayta chada yehe leyatziba ulegiyora deyitgayrun benekon:
Vayyaasu kol-bene yisrael kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh veet-aharon ken asu
Vaabadu kol bene yisrael kema di paqid Adonai yat msheh veyat aharon ken abadu:
Vayehi beetzem hayyom hazzeh hotzi Adonai et-bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim al-tzibotam
Vahava bikran yoma haden appeq Adonai yat bene yisrael meara demitzrayim al chelehon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umalel Adonai im msheh lememar:
Qaddesh-li kol-bekor peter kol-rechem bibne yisrael baadam ubabbehema li hu
Aqdesh qodamay kol bukera patach kol valeda bibne yisrael beenasha ubibira dili hu:
Vayyomer mosheh el-haam zakor et-hayyom hazzeh asher yetzatem mimmitzrayim mibbet abadim ki bechozeq yad hotzi Adonai etkem mizzeh velo yeakel chametz
Vaamar msheh leama havo dekirin yat yoma haden di nepaqtun mimitzrayim mibbet abduta are bitqop yeda appeq Adonai yatekon mikka vela yitakel chamia:
Hayyom attem yotzeim bechodesh haabib
Yoma den attun napeqin beyarcha deabbiba:
Vehaya ki-yebiaka Adonai el-eretz hakkenaani vehachitti vehaemori vehachivvi vehayebusi asher nishba laaboteka latet lak eretz zabat chalab udebash veabadta et-haaboda hazzot bachodesh hazzeh
Vihe are yaelinak Adonai leara diknaanae vechittae veemorae vechivae vibusae di qayim laabahatak lemittan lak ara abda chalab udebash vetiplach yat palechana hada beyarcha haden:
Shibat yamim tokal matztzot ubayyom hashshebii chag la-Adonai
Shiba yomin tekul patira ubeyoma shebiaa chaga qodam Adonai:
Matztzot yeakel et shibat hayyamim velo-yeraeh leka chametz velo-yeraeh leka seor bekol-gebuleka
Patir yitakel yat shibat yomin vela yitchaze lak chamia vela yitchaze lak chamir bekol techumak:
Vehiggadta lebinka bayyom hahu lemor baabur zeh asa Adonai li betzeti mimmitzrayim
Utechave librak beyoma hahu lememar bedil den abad Adonai li bemippeqi mimitzrayim:
Vehaya leka leot al-yadeka ulezikkaron ben eneka lemaan tihyeh torat Adonai bepika ki beyad chazaqa hotziaka Adonai mimmitzrayim
Vihe lak leat al yedak uledakerana ben enayk bedil tehe orayta daAdonai bepumak are bida taqipa appeqak Adonai mimitzrayim:
Veshamarta et-hachuqqa hazzot lemoadah miyyamim yamima
Vetitar yat qeyama hada lezimneh mizman lizman:
Vehaya ki-yebiaka Adonai el-eretz hakkenaani kaasher nishba leka velaaboteka unetanah lak
Vihe are yaelinak Adonai leara diknaanae kema di qayim lak velaabahatak veyitteninah lak:
Vehaabarta kol-peter-rechem la-Adonai vekol-peter sheger behema asher yihyeh leka hazzekarim la-Adonai
Vetabar kol patach valeda qodam Adonai vekol patach velad beira di yehe lak dikrin taqdesh qodam Adonai:
Vekol-peter chamor tipdeh beseh veim-lo tipdeh vaarapto vekol bekor adam bebaneka tipdeh
Vekol patach bukera dachamara tiproq beimra veim la tiproq vetinqepeh vekol bukera daanasha bibnayk tiproq:
Vehaya ki-yishaleka binka machar lemor mah-zot veamarta elayv bechozeq yad hotzianu Adonai mimmitzrayim mibbet abadim
Vihe are yishalinak berak mechar lememar ma da vetemar leh bitqop yeda appeqana Adonai mimitzrayim mibbet abduta:
Vayehi ki-hiqsha paroh leshallechenu vayyaharog Adonai kol-bekor beeretz mitzrayim mibbekor adam vead-bekor behema al-ken ani zobeach la-Adonai kol-peter rechem hazzekarim vekol-bekor banay epdeh

Vahava are aqshe paroh leshalachutana uqetal Adonai kol bukera beara demitzrayim mibbukera daanasha vead bukera dibira al ken ana dabach qodam Adonai kol patach valeda dikrin vekol bukera dibnay eproq:
Vehaya leot al-yadeka uletotapot ben eneka ki bechozeq yad hotzianu Adonai mimmitzrayim
Vihe leat al yedak velitpilin ben enayk are bitqop yeda appeqana Adonai mimitzrayim:
Vayehi beshallach paroh et-haam velo-nacham elohim derek eretz pelishtim ki qarob hu ki amar elohim pen-yinnachem haam birotam milchama veshabu mitzrayema
Vahava kad shalach paroh yat ama vela dabbarinun Adonai orach ara pelishtae are qariba hu are amar Adonai dilema yezuun ama bemechezehon qeraba vitubun lemitzrayim:
Vayyasseb elohim et-haam derek hammidbar yam-svp vachamushim alu bene-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim
Veaschar Adonai yat ama orach madbera yama desup umezarezin seliqu bene yisrael meara demitzrayim:
Vayyiqqach mosheh et-atzmot yosep immo ki hashbea hishbia et-bene yisrael lemor paqod yipqod elohim etkem vehaalitem et-atzmotay mizzeh ittekem
Veasiq msheh yat garme yosep imeh are omaa omi yat bene yisrael lememar midkar dekir Adonai yatekon vetasqun yat garmay mikka imkon:
Vayyisu missukkot vayyachanu beetam biqtzeh hammidbar
Unetalu misukkot ushero beetam bistar madbera:
Va-Adonai holek lipnehem yomam beammud anan lanchotam hadderek velayla beammud esh lehair lahem laleket yomam valayela
VaAdonai medabbar qadamehon bimama beamuda daanana ledabbarutehon beorecha veleleya beamuda deeshata leanhara lehon lemezal bimama ubeleleya:
Lo-yamish ammud heanan yomam veammud haesh layela lipne haam
La yaade amuda daanana bimama veap la amuda deeshata beleleya qodam ama:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umalel Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veyashubu veyachanu lipne pi hachirot ben migdol uben hayyam lipne baal tzepon nikcho tachanu al-hayyam
Malel im bene yisrael vitubun veyishrun qodam pum chirata ben migdol uben yama qodam beel tzepon leqibleh tishrun al yama:
Veamar paroh libne yisrael nebukim hem baaretz sagar alehem hammidbar
Veyemar paroh al bene yisrael mearbelin inun beara achad alehon madbera:
Vechizzaqti et-leb-paroh veradap acharehem veikkabeda beparoh ubekol-chelo veyadeu mitzrayim ki-ani Adonai vayyaasu-ken
Veatqep yat libba deparoh veyirdap batrehon veetyaqar beparoh ubekol mashiryateh veyidun mitzrae are ana Adonai vaabadu ken:
Vayyuggad lemelek mitzrayim ki barach haam vayyehapek lebab paroh vaabadayv el-haam vayyomeru mah-zot asinu ki-shillachnu et-yisrael meobdenu
Veitchava lemalka demitzrayim are azal ama veithapik libba deparoh veabdohi leama vaamaru ma da abadna are shalachna yat yisrael mippalechanana:
Vayyesor et-rikbo veet-ammo laqach immo
Vetaqis yat retikkeh veyat ameh dabbar imeh:
Vayyiqqach shesh-meot rekeb bachur vekol rekeb mitzrayim veshalishim al-kullo
Udebar shit mea retikkin bechiran vekol retikke mitzrae vegibbarin memanan al kulhon:
Vayechazzeq Adonai et-leb paroh melek mitzrayim vayyirdop achare bene yisrael ubene yisrael yotzeim beyad rama
Veatqep Adonai yat libba deparoh malka demitzrayim uredap batar bene yisrael ubene yisrael nepaqu beresh geli:
Vayyirdepu mitzrayim acharehem vayyassigu otam chonim al-hayyam kol-svs rekeb paroh uparashayv vechelo al-pi hachirot lipne baal tzepon
Uredapu mitzrae batrehon veadbiqu yatehon kad sharan al yama kol susavat retikke paroh uparashohi umashiryateh al pum chirata qodam beel tzepon:
Uparoh hiqrib vayyisu bene-yisrael et-enehem vehinneh mitzrayim nosea acharehem vayyireu meod vayyitzaqu bene-yisrael el-Adonai
Uparoh qereb uzeqapu bene yisrael yat enehon veha mitzrae natlin batrehon udechilu lachada uzeiqu bene yisrael qodam Adonai:
Vayyomeru el-mosheh hamibbeli en-qebarim bemitzrayim leqachtanu lamut bammidbar mah-zot asita lanu lehotzianu mimmitzrayim
Vaamaru lemsheh hamidlet qibrin bemitzrayim debartana limmat bemadbera ma da abadta lana leappaqutana mimitzrayim:
Halo-zeh haddabar asher dibbarnu eleka bemitzrayim lemor chadal mimmennu venaabda et-mitzrayim ki tob lanu abod et-mitzrayim mimmutenu bammidbar
Hala den pitgama di malelena imak bemitzrayim lememar sheboq minana veniplach yat mitzrae are tab lana deniplach yat mitzrae midinmut bemadbera:
Vayyomer mosheh el-haam al-tirau hiteyatztzebu ureu et-yeshuat Adonai asher-yaaseh lakem hayyom ki asher reitem et-mitzrayim hayyom lo tosipu lirotam od ad-olam
Vaamar msheh leama la tidchalun itattadu vachazo yat pureqana daAdonai deyabed lekon yoma den are kema dichazetun yat mitzrae yoma den la tosepun lemechezehon od ad alema:
Adonai yillachem lakem veattem tacharishun
Adonai yegiach lekon qerab veattun tishtequn:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh mah-titzaq elay dabber el-bene-yisrael veyissau
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh qabbelit tzelotak malel im bene yisrael veyitlun:
Veatta harem et-matteka uneteh et-yadeka al-hayyam ubeqaehu veyabou bene-yisrael betok hayyam bayyabbasha
Veat tol yat chutrak vaarem yat yedak al yama ubezaohi veyealun bene yisrael bego yama beyabbeshta:
Vaani hinni mechazzeq et-leb mitzrayim veyabou acharehem veikkabeda beparoh ubekol-chelo berikbo ubeparashayv
Vaana ha ana metaqep yat libba demitzrae veyealun batrehon veetyaqar beparoh ubekol mashiryateh birtikkohi ubeparashohi:
Veyadeu mitzrayim ki-ani Adonai behikkabedi beparoh berikbo ubeparashayv
Veyiddeun mitzrae are ana Adonai beityaqaruti beparoh birtikkohi ubeparashohi:
Vayyissa malak haelohim haholek lipne machaneh yisrael vayyelek meacharehem vayyissa ammud heanan mippenehem vayyaamod meacharehem
Unetal malaka daAdonai dimdabbar qodam mashrita deyisrael vaata mibbatrehon unetal ammuda daanana min qodamehon ushera mibbatrehon:
Vayyabo ben machaneh mitzrayim uben machaneh yisrael vayehi heanan vehachoshek vayyaer et-hallayela velo-qarab zeh el-zeh kol-hallayela
Veal ben mashrita demitzrae uben mashrita deyisrael vahava anana veqabla lemitzrae uleyisrael nehar kol leleya vela itqeribu den levat den kol leleya:
Vayyet mosheh et-yado al-hayyam vayyolek Adonai et-hayyam beruach qadim azza kol-hallayla vayyasem et-hayyam lecharaba vayyibbaqeu hammayim
Vaarem msheh yat yedeh al yamma vedabbar Adonai yat yamma beruach qiduma taqip kol leleya veshavi yat yamma leyabbeshta veitbezau mayya:
Vayyabou bene-yisrael betok hayyam bayyabbasha vehammayim lahem choma miminam umissemolam
Vealu bene yisrael bego yama beyabbeshta umayya lehon shurin miyyaminehon umismalehon:
Vayyirdepu mitzrayim vayyabou acharehem kol sus paroh rikbo uparashayv el-tok hayyam
Uredapu mitzrae vealu batrehon kol susavat paroh retikkohi uparashohi lego yama:
Vayehi beashmoret habboqer vayyashqep Adonai el-machaneh mitzrayim beammud esh veanan vayyahom et machaneh mitzrayim
Vahava bematrat tzapra veisteke Adonai lemashrita demitzrae beamuda deeshata vaanana veshagish yat mashrita demitzrae:
Vayyasar et opan markebotayv vayenahagehu bikbedut vayyomer mitzrayim anusa mippene yisrael ki Adonai nilcham lahem bemitzrayim
Veadi yat galgale retikkohi umedabberin lehon bitqop vaamar mitzrae neiroq min qodam yisrael are da hi geburta daAdonai daabed lehon qerabin bemitzrayim:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh neteh et-yadeka al-hayyam veyashubu hammayim al-mitzrayim al-rikbo veal-parashayv
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh arem yat yedak al yama vitubun maya al mitzrae al retikkehon veal parashehon:
Vayyet mosheh et-yado al-hayyam vayyashob hayyam lipnot boqer leetano umitzrayim nasim liqrato vayenaer Adonai et-mitzrayim betok hayyam
Vaarem msheh yat yedeh al yama vetab yama leidan tzapra letaqepeh umitzrae areqin leqadamuteh veshaniq Adonai yat mitzrae bego yama:
Vayyashubu hammayim vayekassu et-harekeb veet-happarashim lekol chel paroh habbaim acharehem bayyam lo-nishar bahem ad-echad
Vetabu maya vachapo yat retikkaya veyat parashaya lekol mashiryat paroh dealu batrehon beyama la ishtaar behon ad chad:
Ubene yisrael haleku bayyabbasha betok hayyam vehammayim lahem choma miminam umissemolam
Ubene yisrael haliku beyabbeshta bego yama umaya lehon shurin miyaminehon umismalehon:
Vayyosha Adonai bayyom hahu et-yisrael miyyad mitzrayim vayyar yisrael et-mitzrayim met al-sepat hayyam
Uperaq Adonai beyoma hahu yat yisrael mida demitzrae vachazo yisrael yat mitzrae maytin al kep yama:
Vayyar yisrael et-hayyad haggedola asher asa Adonai bemitzrayim vayyireu haam et-Adonai vayyaaminu ba-Adonai ubemosheh abdo
Vachaza yisrael yat gebureta yeda rabbeta di abad Adonai bemitzrayim udechilu ama min qodam Adonai veheminu bememera daAdonai ubinbiut msheh abdeh:
Az yashir-mosheh ubene yisrael et-hashshira hazzot la-Adonai vayyomeru lemor ashira la-Adonai ki-gaoh gaa sus verokebo rama bayyam
Beken shabbach msheh ubene yisrael yat tishbachta hada qodam Adonai vaamaru lememar neshabbach venode qadam Adonai are itgae al gevetanaya vegeuta dileh hi suseya verakebeh rema beyama:
Ozzi vezimrat yah vayehi-li lishua zeh eli veanvehu elohe abi vaaromemenhu
Taqepi vetushbachti dechila Adonai vaamar bememereh vahava li leparaq den elahay veebne leh maqdesha elaha daabahatay veeplach qodamohi:
Adonai ish milchama Adonai shemo
Adonai mare nitzchan qerabaya Adonai shemeh:
Markebot paroh vechelo yara bayyam umibchar shalishayv tubbeu beyam-svp
Retikke paroh umashiryateh shedi beyama ushepar gibbarohi itbau beyama desup:
Tehomot yekasyumu yaredu bimtzolot kemo-aben
Tehomaya chapo alehon nechatu leumeqaya keabna:
Yemineka Adonai nedari bakkoach yemineka Adonai tiratz oyeb
Yaminak Adonai adira bechela yaminak Adonai tebarat sanea:
Uberob geoneka taharos qameka teshallach charoneka yokelemo kaqqash
Ubisge taqepak tebartanun lidqamu al amak shalachta rugezak shetzitinun kenura leqasha:
Uberuach appeka neermu mayim nitztzebu kemo-ned nozelim qapeu tehomot beleb-yam
Ubememar pumak chakkimu maya qamu keshur azalaya qapu tehomin belibba deyama:
Amar oyeb erdop assig achalleq shalal timlaemo napshi ariq charbi torishemo yadi
Dahava amar sanea erdop adbeq apaleg bizta tisba minhon napshi eshlop charbi teshetzinun yedi:
Nashapta beruchaka kissamo yam tzalelu kaoperet bemayim addirim
Amarta bememerak chapa alehon yama ishteqau kaabara bemayin taqipin:
Mi-kamoka baelim Adonai mi kamoka nedar baqqodesh nora tehillot oseh pele
Let bar minak deat hu elaha Adonai let bar minak elaha at adir bequdesha dechel tushbechan abed parishan:
Natita yemineka tiblaemo aretz
Aremeta yaminak belaatenun ara:
Nachita bechasdeka am-zv gaaleta nehaleta beozzeka el-neveh qodsheka
Dabbarhi betabvatak ama denan dipraqeta sobarhi betaqepak ledira dequdshak:
Shameu ammim yirgazun chil achaz yoshebe pelashet
Shemau ammaya vezau dachala achadatenun ledahavo yatebin biplashet:
Az nibhalu allupe edom ele moab yochazemo raad namogu kol yoshebe kenaan
Beken itbehilu rabrebe edom taqipe moab achadatenun reteta itbaru kol dahavo yatebin biknaan:
Tippol alehem emata vapachad bigdol zeroaka yiddemu kaaben ad-yaabor ammeka Adonai ad-yaabor am-zv qanita
Tappel alehon emeta vedachalta bisge taqepak yishtequn keabna ad deyeibbar amak Adonai yat arnona ad deyeibbar ama denan di peraqta yat yardena:
Tebiemo vetittaemo behar nachalateka makon leshibteka paalta Adonai miqqedash adonay konenu yadeka
Taelinun vetashrinun betura deachsantak atar metaqen lebet shekintak atqeneta Adonai maqdesha Adonai atqenohi yedayk:
Adonai yimlok leolam vaed
Adonai malkuteh qaem lealam ulealeme alemaya:
Ki ba sus paroh berikbo ubeparashayv bayyam vayyasheb Adonai alehem et-me hayyam ubene yisrael haleku bayyabbasha betok hayyam
Are al susavat paroh birtikkohi ubeparashohi beyama vaateb Adonai alehon yat me yama ubene yisrael haliku beyabbeshta bego yama:
Vattiqqach miryam hannebia achot aharon et-hattop beyadah vattetzena kol-hannashim achareha betuppim ubimcholot
Unesebat miryam nebiata achateh deaharon yat tuppa bidah unepaqu kol neshaya batraha betuppin ubechingin:
Vattaan lahem miryam shiru la-Adonai ki-gaoh gaa sus verokebo rama bayyam
Umeanya lahen miryam shabbachu veodu qodam Adonai are itgae al gevetanaya vegeuta dileh hi suseya verakebeh rema beyama:
Vayyassa mosheh et-yisrael miyyam-svp vayyetzeu el-midbar-shvr vayyeleku sheloshet-yamim bammidbar velo-matzeu mayim
Veatel msheh yat yisrael miyama desup unepaqu lemadbera dechagra vaazalu telata yomin bemadbera vela ashkachu maya:
Vayyabou marata velo yakelu lishtot mayim mimmara ki marim hem al-ken qara-shemah mara
Vaato lemara vela yekilu lemishte maya mimara are meririn inun al ken qera shemah mara:
Vayyillonu haam al-mosheh lemor mah-nishteh
Veitraamu ama al msheh lememar ma nishte:
Vayyitzaq el-Adonai vayyorehu Adonai etz vayyashlek el-hammayim vayyimtequ hammayim sham sam lo choq umishpat vesham nissahu
Vetzali qodam Adonai vealpeh Adonai aa urema lemaya ubasimu maya taman gezar leh qeyam vedin vetaman nasyeh:
Vayyomer im-shamoa tishma leqol Adonai eloheka vehayyashar beenayv taaseh vehaazanta lemitzvotayv veshamarta kol-chuqqayv kol-hammachala asher-samti bemitzrayim lo-asim aleka ki ani Adonai ropeeka
Vaamar im qabbala teqabbel lememera daAdonai elahak udekashar qodamohi tabed vetatzet lipiqudohi vetitar kol qeyamohi kol marin di shaveti bemitzrayim la ashave alak are ana Adonai asak:
Vayyabou elima vesham shetem esreh enot mayim veshibim temarim vayyachanu-sham al-hammayim
Vaato leelim vetaman tere asar mabbuin demayin veshibin diqlin ushero taman al maya:
Vayyisu meelim vayyabou kol-adat bene-yisrael el-midbar-sin asher ben-elim uben sinay bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashsheni letzetam meeretz mitzrayim
Unetalu meelim vaato kol kenishta dibne yisrael lemadbera desin di ben elim uben sinay bechamsha asra yoma leyarcha tinyana lemippaqehon meara demitzrayim:
Vayyillonu kol-adat bene-yisrael al-mosheh veal-aharon bammidbar
Veitraamu kol kenishta dibne yisrael al msheh veal aharon bemadbera:

Vayyomeru alehem bene yisrael mi-yitten mutenu beyad-Adonai beeretz mitzrayim beshibtenu al-sir habbasar beoklenu lechem lasoba ki-hotzetem otanu el-hammidbar hazzeh lehamit et-kol-haqqahal hazzeh baraab

Vaamaru lehon bene yisrael levay demitena qodam Adonai beara demitzrayim kad havena yatebin al dude bisra kad havena oklin lachma vesabein are appeqtun yatana lemadbera haden leqatala yat kol qehala haden bekapna:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh hinni mamtir lakem lechem min-hashshamayim veyatza haam velaqetu debar-yom beyomo lemaan anassennu hayelek betorati im-lo
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ha ana machet lekon lachma min shemaya veyipqun ama veyilqetun pitgam yom beyomeh bedil daanasinun hayehakun beorayti im la:
Vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehekinu et asher-yabiu vehaya mishneh al asher-yilqetu yom yom
Vihe beyoma shetitaa vitaqnun yat deyaytun vihe al chad teren al deyilqetun yom yom:
Vayyomer mosheh veaharon el-kol-bene yisrael ereb vidatem ki Adonai hotzi etkem meeretz mitzrayim
Vaamar msheh veaharon lekol bene yisrael beramsha vetidun are Adonai appeq yatekon meara demitzrayim:
Uboqer ureitem et-kebod Adonai beshomo et-telunnotekem al-Adonai venachnu ma ki tallinu alenu
Ubetzapra vetechezun yat yeqara daAdonai kad shemia qodamohi yat turamutekon al memera daAdonai venachna ma are atraamtun alana:
Vayyomer mosheh betet Adonai lakem baereb basar leekol velechem babboqer lisboa bishmoa Adonai et-telunnotekem asher-attem mallinim alayv venachnu ma lo-alenu telunnotekem ki al-Adonai

Vaamar msheh bidyitten Adonai lekon beramsha bisra lemekal velachma betzapra lemisba bedishmia qodam Adonai yat turamutekon di attun mitraamin alohi venachna ma la alana turamutekon elahen al memera daAdonai:
Vayyomer mosheh el-aharon emor el-kol-adat bene yisrael qirbu lipne Adonai ki shama et telunnotekem
Vaamar msheh leaharon emar lekol kenishta dibne yisrael qeribu qodam Adonai are shemian qodamohi yat turamutekon:
Vayehi kedabber aharon el-kol-adat bene-yisrael vayyipnu el-hammidbar vehinneh kebod Adonai nira beanan
Vahava kad malil aharon im kol kenishta dibne yisrael veitpeniyu lemadbera veha yeqara daAdonai itgeli baanana:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umalel Adonai im msheh lememar:
Shamati et-telunnot bene yisrael dabber alehem lemor ben haarbayim tokelu basar ubabboqer tisbeu-lachem vidatem ki ani Adonai elohekem
Shemia qodamay yat turamat bene yisrael malel imhon lememar ben shimshaya tekelun bisra ubetzapra tisbeun lachma vetidun are ana Adonai elahakon:
Vayehi baereb vattaal hasselav vattekas et-hammachaneh ubabboqer hayeta shikbat hattal sabib lammachaneh
Vahava beramsha useleqat selayv vachapat yat mashrita ubetzapra havat nechatat tala sechor sechor lemashrita:
Vattaal shikbat hattal vehinneh al-pene hammidbar daq mechuspas daq kakkepor al-haaretz
Useleqat nechatat tala veha al appe madbera dadaq meqalap dadaq kegir kiglida al ara:
Vayyiru bene-yisrael vayyomeru ish el-achiv man hu ki lo yadeu mah-hv vayyomer mosheh alehem hu hallechem asher natan Adonai lakem leokla
Vachazo bene yisrael vaamaru gebar laachuhi mana hu are la yedau ma hu vaamar msheh lehon hu lachma di yehab Adonai lekon lemekal:
Zeh haddabar asher tzivva Adonai liqtu mimmennu ish lepi oklo omer laggulgolet mispar napshotekem ish laasher beoholo tiqqachu
Den pitgama di paqed Adonai lequtu mineh gebar lepum mekeleh umra legulgalta minyan napshatekon gebar ledi bemashkeneh tisbun:
Vayyaasu-ken bene yisrael vayyilqetu hammarbeh vehammamit
Vaabadu ken bene yisrael uleqatu deasge udeazer:
Vayyamoddu baomer velo hedip hammarbeh vehammamit lo hechsir ish lepi-oklo laqatu
Ukelo beumera vela otar deasge udeazer la chasir gebar lepum mekeleh leqatu:
Vayyomer mosheh alehem ish al-yoter mimmennu ad-boqer
Vaamar msheh lehon enash la yashar mineh ad tzapra:
Velo-shameu el-mosheh vayyotiru anashim mimmennu ad-boqer vayyarum tolaim vayyibash vayyiqtzop alehem mosheh
Vela qabbilu min msheh veasharu gubraya mineh ad tzapra urechesh richasha useri uregaz alehon msheh:
Vayyilqetu oto babboqer babboqer ish kepi oklo vecham hashshemesh venamas
Uleqatu yateh bitzpar bitzpar gebar lepum mekeleh uma demishtaar mineh al appe chaqla kad chama alohi shimsha pashar:
Vayehi bayyom hashshishshi laqetu lechem mishneh shene haomer laechad vayyabou kol-nesie haeda vayyaggidu lemosheh
Vahava beyoma shetitaa leqatu lachma al chad teren teren umrin lechad vaato kol rabrebe kenishta vechaviu lemsheh:
Vayyomer alehem hu asher dibber Adonai shabbaton shabbat-qodesh la-Adonai machar et asher-topu epu veet asher-tebashshelu bashshelu veet kol-haodep hannichu lakem lemishmeret ad-habboqer
Vaamar lehon hu di malil Adonai shebata shebat qudesha qodam Adonai mechar yat di attun atidin lemepa apo veyat di attun atidin lebashala bashilu veyat kol motara atznau lekon lematara ad tzapra:
Vayyannichu oto ad-habboqer kaasher tzivva mosheh velo hibish verimma lo-hayeta bo
Veatznau yateh ad tzapra kema depaqid msheh vela seri verichasha la hava beh:
Vayyomer mosheh ikluhu hayyom ki-shabbat hayyom la-Adonai hayyom lo timtzauhu bassadeh
Vaamar msheh ikluhi yoma den are shabbeta yoma den qodam Adonai yoma den la tashkechuneh bechaqla:
Sheshet yamim tilqetuhu ubayyom hashshebii shabbat lo yiheyeh-bo
Shitta yomin tilqetuneh ubeyoma shebiaa shabbeta la yehe beh:
Vayehi bayyom hashshebii yatzeu min-haam lilqot velo matzau
Vahava beyoma shebiaa nepaqu min ama lemilqat vela ashkachu:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh ad-ana meantem lishmor mitzvotay vetorotay
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ad ematay attun mesarebin lemitar piquday veorayatay:
Reu ki-Adonai natan lakem hashshabbat al-ken hu noten lakem bayyom hashshishshi lechem yomayim shebu ish tachtayv al-yetze ish mimmeqomo bayyom hashshebii
Chazo are Adonai yehab lekon shabbeta al ken hu yaheb lekon beyoma shetitaa lechem teren yomin tibu anash techotohi la yippoq anash meatreh beyoma shebiaa
Vayyishbetu haam bayyom hashshebii
Venachu ama beyoma shebiaa:
Vayyiqreu bet-yisrael et-shemo man vehu kezera gad laban vetamo ketzappichit bidbash
Uqero bet yisrael yat shemeh man vehu kebar zera gida chivar vetameh keisqeretavan bidbash:
Vayyomer mosheh zeh haddabar asher tzivva Adonai melo haomer mimmennu lemishmeret ledorotekem lemaan yiru et-hallechem asher heekalti etkem bammidbar behotzii etkem meeretz mitzrayim
Vaamar msheh den pitgama di paqid Adonai mile umra mineh lematra ledarekon bedil deyechzun yat lachma di okalit yatekon bemadbera beappaquti yatekon meara demitzrayim:
Vayyomer mosheh el-aharon qach tzintzenet achat veten-shamma melo-haomer man vehannach oto lipne Adonai lemishmeret ledorotekem
Vaamar msheh leaharon sab tzelochit chada vehab taman mele umra man veatzna yateh qodam Adonai lematra ledarekon:
Kaasher tzivva Adonai el-mosheh vayyannichehu aharon lipne haedut lemishmaret
Kema di paqid Adonai lemsheh veatzneeh aharon qodam sahaduta lematra:
Ubene yisrael akelu et-hamman arbaim shana ad-boam el-eretz noshabet et-hamman akelu ad-boam el-qetzeh eretz kenaan
Ubene yisrael akalu yat mana arbein shenin ad demetehon leara yatebata yat mana akalu ad deato lisyape ara diknaan:
Vehaomer asirit haepa hu
Veumra chad min asra bitlat sein hu:
Vayyisu kol-adat bene-yisrael mimmidbar-sin lemasehem al-pi Adonai vayyachanu birpidim veen mayim lishtot haam
Unetalu kol kenishta dibne yisrael mimadbera desin lematlanehon al memera daAdonai ushero birpidim velet maya lemishte ama:
Vayyareb haam im-mosheh vayyomeru tenu-lanu mayim venishteh vayyomer lahem mosheh mah-teribun immadi mah-tenassun et-Adonai
Unetza ama im msheh vaamaru habu lana maya venishte vaamar lehon msheh ma attun natzan imi ma menasun attun qodam Adonai:
Vayyitzma sham haam lammayim vayyalen haam al-mosheh vayyomer lamma zeh heelitanu mimmitzrayim lehamit oti veet-banay veet-miqnay batztzama
Utzechi taman ama lemaya veitraam ama al msheh vaamar lema denan aseqtana mimitzrayim leqatala yati veyat benay veyat beiray betzachuta:
Vayyitzaq mosheh el-Adonai lemor ma eeseh laam hazzeh od meat useqaluni
Vetzali msheh qodam Adonai lememar ma ebed leama haden od zeer pon veyirgemunani:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh abor lipne haam veqach itteka mizziqne yisrael umatteka asher hikkita bo et-hayeor qach beyadeka vehalaketa
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ibbar qodam ama udebar imak misabe yisrael vechutrak di macheta beh yat nahara sab bidak vetezil:
Hinni omed lepaneka sham al-hatztzur bechoreb vehikkita batztzur veyatzeu mimmennu mayim veshata haam vayyaas ken mosheh leene ziqne yisrael
Ha ana qaem qodamak taman al tinara bechoreb vetimche betinara veyippequn mineh maya veyishte ama vaabad ken msheh leene sabe yisrael:
Vayyiqra shem hammaqom massa umeriba al-rib bene yisrael veal nassotam et-Adonai lemor hayesh Adonai beqirbenu im-ayin
Uqera shema deatra niseta umatzuta al dintzo bene yisrael veal denasiu qodam Adonai lememar hait shekineta daAdonai benana im la:
Vayyabo amaleq vayyillachem im-yisrael birpidim
Vaata amaleq vaagach qeraba im yisrael birpidim:
Vayyomer mosheh el-yehoshua bechar-lanu anashim vetze hillachem baamaleq machar anoki nitztzab al-rosh haggiba umatteh haelohim beyadi
Vaamar msheh lihoshua bechar lana gubrin upuq agach qeraba baamaleq mechar ana qaem al resh ramata vechutera deitabidu beh nisin min qodam Adonai bidi:
Vayyaas yehoshua kaasher amar-lo mosheh lehillachem baamaleq umosheh aharon vechur alu rosh haggiba
Vaabad yehoshua kema deamar leh msheh leagacha qeraba baamaleq umsheh aharon vechur seliqu leresh ramata:
Vehaya kaasher yarim mosheh yado vegabar yisrael vekaasher yaniach yado vegabar amaleq
Vahava kad merim msheh yedohi umitgabberin debet yisrael vekad manach yedohi umitgabberin debet amaleq:
Vide mosheh kebedim vayyiqchu-eben vayyasimu tachtayv vayyesheb aleha veaharon vechur tameku beyadayv mizzeh echad umizzeh echad vayehi yadayv emuna ad-bo hashshamesh
Vide msheh yeqaran unesibu abna veshaviu techotohi viteb alah veaharon vechur sadan bidohi mikka chad umikka chad vahava yedohi perisan bitzlo ad deal shimsha:
Vayyachalosh yehoshua et-amaleq veet-ammo lepi-chareb
Vetabbar yehoshua yat amaleq veyat ameh lepitgam dechareb:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh ketob zot zikkaron basseper vesim beozne yehoshua ki-machoh emcheh et-zeker amaleq mittachat hashshamayim
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ketab da dukerana besipra veshavi qodam yehoshua are mimcha emche yat dukerana daamaleq mittechot shemaya:
Vayyiben mosheh mizbeach vayyiqra shemo Adonai nissi
Ubena msheh madbecha upelach alohi qodam Adonai daabad leh nisin:
Vayyomer ki-yad al-kes yah milchama la-Adonai baamaleq middor dor
Vaamar bishbua amira da min qodam dechela dishkinteh al kareseh yeqareh deatid deyittagach qeraba qodam Adonai bidbet amaleq leshetzayutehon midare alema:
Vayyishma yitro kohen midyan choten mosheh et kol-asher asa elohim lemosheh uleyisrael ammo ki-hotzi Adonai et-yisrael mimmitzrayim
Ushema yitro rabba demidyan chamuhi demsheh yat kol di abad Adonai lemsheh uleyisrael ameh are appiq Adonai yat yisrael mimitzrayim:
Vayyiqqach yitro choten mosheh et-tzippora eshet mosheh achar shillucheha
Udebar yitro chamuhi demsheh yat tzippora ittat msheh batar depatrah:
Veet shene baneha asher shem haechad gereshom ki amar ger hayiti beeretz nokriyya
Veyat teren benaha di shum chad gereshom are amar dayar haveti beara nukeraa:
Veshem haechad eliezer ki-elohe abi beezri vayyatztzileni mechereb paroh
Veshum chad eliezer are elaha deabba hava besadi veshezebani mecharba deparoh:
Vayyabo yitro choten mosheh ubanayv veishto el-mosheh el-hammidbar asher-hv choneh sham har haelohim
Vaata yitro chamuhi demsheh ubenohi veitteteh levat msheh lemadbera di hu share taman letura deitgele alohi yeqara daAdonai:
Vayyomer el-mosheh ani chotenka yitro ba eleka veishteka ushene baneha immah
Vaamar lemsheh ana chamuk yitro ate levatak veittetak uteren benaha imah:
Vayyetze mosheh liqrat choteno vayyishtachu vayyishshaq-lo vayyishalu ish-lereehu leshalom vayyabou haohela
Unepaq msheh leqadamut chamuhi usegid uneshiq leh usheilu gebar lechabreh lishlam vealu lemashkena:
Vayesapper mosheh lechoteno et kol-asher asa Adonai leparoh ulemitzrayim al odot yisrael et kol-hattelaa asher metzaatam badderek vayyatztzilem Adonai
Veishtai msheh lachamuhi yat kol di abad Adonai leparoh ulemitzrae al esaq yisrael yat kol aqta di ashkachtinun beorcha veshezebanun Adonai:
Vayyichad yitro al kol-hattoba asher-asa Adonai leyisrael asher hitztzilo miyyad mitzrayim
Vachadi yitro al kol tabta di abad Adonai leyisrael di shezebeh mida demitzrae:
Vayyomer yitro baruk Adonai asher hitztzil etkem miyyad mitzrayim umiyyad paroh asher hitztzil et-haam mittachat yad-mitzrayim
Vaamar yitro berik Adonai di shezib yatekon mida demitzrae umida deparoh di shezib yat ama mittechot marvat mitzrae:
Atta yadati ki-gadol Adonai mikkol-haelohim ki baddabar asher zadu alehem
Kean yedana are rab Adonai velet elah bar mineh are bepitgama di chashibu mitzrae lemidan yat yisrael beh daninun:
Vayyiqqach yitro choten mosheh ola uzebachim lelohim vayyabo aharon vekol ziqne yisrael leekol-lechem im-choten mosheh lipne haelohim
Veqarib yitro chamuhi demsheh alavan veniksat qudeshin qodam Adonai vaata aharon vekol sabe yisrael lemekal lachma im chamuhi demsheh qodam Adonai:
Vayehi mimmochorat vayyesheb mosheh lishpot et-haam vayyaamod haam al-mosheh min-habboqer ad-haareb
Vahava miyoma debatrohi viteb msheh lemidan yat ama veqam ama ilavohi demsheh min tzapra ad ramsha:
Vayyar choten mosheh et kol-asher-hv oseh laam vayyomer ma-haddabar hazzeh asher atta oseh laam maddua atta yosheb lebaddeka vekol-haam nitztzab aleka min-boqer ad-areb
Vachaza chamuhi demsheh yat kol di hu abed leama vaamar ma pitgama haden di at abed leama ma den at yateb bilchodak vekol ama qayemin ilavak min tzapra ad ramsha:
Vayyomer mosheh lechoteno ki-yabo elay haam lidrosh elohim
Vaamar msheh lachamuhi are atan levati ama lemitba ulepan min qodam Adonai:
Ki-yihyeh lahem dabar ba elay veshapatti ben ish uben reehu vehodati et-chuqqe haelohim veet-torotayv
Kad have lehon dina atan levati vedaina ben gabra uben chabreh umehodana lehon yat qeyamaya daAdonai veyat orayateh:
Vayyomer choten mosheh elayv lo-tob haddabar asher atta oseh
Vaamar chamuhi demsheh leh la taqin pitgama deat abed:
Nabol tibbol gam-atta gam-haam hazzeh asher immak ki-kabed mimmeka haddabar lo-tvkal asohu lebaddeka
Mila tileh ap at ap ama haden diimak are yaqir minak pitgama la tikkol lemebedeh bilchodak:
Atta shema beqoli iatzeka vihi elohim immak heyeh atta laam mul haelohim vehebeta atta et-haddebarim el-haelohim
Kean qabbel mini amalkinak vihe memera daAdonai besadak heve at leama teba ulepan min qodam Adonai utehe mayti at yat pitgamaya liqodam Adonai:
Vehizharta ethem et-hachuqqim veet-hattorot vehodata lahem et-hadderek yeleku bah veet-hammaaseh asher yaasun
Vetazhar yatehon yat qeyamaya veyat orayta utehoda lehon yat orecha diyhakun bah veyat obada diyabedun:
Veatta techezeh mikkol-haam anshe-chayil yire elohim anshe emet sonee batza vesamta alehem sare alapim sare meot sare chamishshim vesare asarot
Veat techeze mikkol ama gubrin dechela dachalaya daAdonai gubrin diqshot desanan leqabbala mamon utemane alehon rabbane alpin rabbane mavata rabbane chamshin verabbane isoreyata:
Veshapetu et-haam bekol-et vehaya kol-haddabar haggadol yabiu eleka vekol-haddabar haqqaton yishpetu-hem vehaqel mealeka venaseu ittak
Vidunun yat ama bekol idan vihe kol pitgam rab yaytun levatak vekol pitgam zeer yedunun inun veyiqlun minak visoberun imak:
Im et-haddabar hazzeh taaseh vetzivveka elohim veyakolta amod vegam kol-haam hazzeh al-meqomo yabo beshalom
Im yat pitgama haden tabed vipaqdinak Adonai vetikkol lemeqam veap kol ama haden al atreh yehak bishlam:
Vayyishma mosheh leqol choteno vayyaas kol asher amar
Veqabbil msheh lememera dachamuhi vaabad kol di amar:
Vayyibchar mosheh anshe-chayil mikkol-yisrael vayyitten otam rashim al-haam sare alapim sare meot sare chamishshim vesare asarot
Ubechar msheh gubrin dechela mikkol yisrael umani yatehon reshin al ama rabbane alpin rabbane mavata rabbane chamshin verabbane isoreyata:
Veshapetu et-haam bekol-et et-haddabar haqqasheh yebiun el-mosheh vekol-haddabar haqqaton yishputu hem
Vedaynin yat ama bekol idan yat pitgam qashe maytin levat msheh vekol pitgam zeer dayenin inun:
Vayeshallach mosheh et-choteno vayyelek lo el-artzo
Veshalach msheh yat chamuhi vaazal leh leareh:
Bachodesh hashshelishi letzet bene-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bayyom hazzeh bau midbar sinay
Beyarcha telitaa lemippaq bene yisrael meara demitzrayim beyoma haden ato lemadbera desinay:
Vayyisu merepidim vayyabou midbar sinay vayyachanu bammidbar vayyichan-sham yisrael neged hahar
Unetalu merepidim vaato lemadbera desinay ushero bemadbera ushera taman yisrael loqobel tura:
Umosheh ala el-haelohim vayyiqra elayv Adonai min-hahar lemor koh tomar lebet yaaqob vetagged libne yisrael
Umsheh seleq qodam Adonai uqera leh Adonai min tura lememar kidnan temar lebet yaaqob utechavi libne yisrael:
Attem reitem asher asiti lemitzrayim vaessa etkem al-kanpe nesharim vaabi etkem elay
Attun chazittun di abadit lemitzrayim unetalit yatekon kidal gadpe nishrin veqarebit yatekon lepalechani:
Veatta im-shamoa tishmeu beqoli ushemartem et-beriti vihyitem li segulla mikkol-haammim ki-li kol-haaretz
Ukean im qabbala teqabbelun lememeri vetitrun yat qeyami utehon qodamay chabbibin mikkol ammaya are di li kol ara:
Veattem tihyu-li mamleket kohanim vegoy qadosh elleh haddebarim asher tedabber el-bene yisrael
Veattun tehon qodamay malkin kahanin veam qadish ilen pitgamaya di temalel im bene yisrael:
Vayyabo mosheh vayyiqra leziqne haam vayyasem lipnehem et kol-haddebarim haelleh asher tzivvahu Adonai
Vaata msheh uqera lesabe ama vesadar qodamehon yat kol pitgamaya hailen depaqdeh Adonai:
Vayyaanu kol-haam yachdav vayyomeru kol asher-dibber Adonai naaseh vayyasheb mosheh et-dibre haam el-Adonai
Vaatibu kol ama kachada vaamaru kol di malil Adonai nabed vaateb msheh yat pitgame ama qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh hinneh anoki ba eleka beab heanan baabur yishma haam bedabberi immak vegam-beka yaaminu leolam vayyagged mosheh et-dibre haam el-Adonai
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ha ana mitgeli lak beeba daanana bedil deyishma ama bemalaluti imak veap bak yehemenun lealam vechavi msheh yat pitgame ama qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh lek el-haam veqiddashtam hayyom umachar vekibbesu simlotam
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh izel levat ama utezamninun yoma den umechar vichavrun lebushehon:
Vehayu nekonim layyom hashshelishi ki bayyom hashshelishi yered Adonai leene kol-haam al-har sinay
Vihon zeminin leyoma telitaa are beyoma telitaa yitgeli Adonai leene kol ama al tura desinay:
Vehigbalta et-haam sabib lemor hishshameru lakem alot bahar unegoa beqatzehu kol-hannogea bahar mot yumat
Utetachem yat ama sechor sechor lememar istamaru lekon milmisaq betura ulemiqrab besopeh kol deyiqrab betura itqetala yitqetel:
Lo-tigga bo yad ki-saqol yissaqel o-yaroh yiyyareh im-behema im-ish lo yichyeh bimshok hayyobel hemma yaalu bahar
La tiqrab beh yeda are itregama yitregem o ishtedaa yishtedi im beira im enasha la yitqayam bemegad shopara inun merashan lemisaq betura:
Vayyered mosheh min-hahar el-haam vayeqaddesh et-haam vayekabbesu simlotam
Unechat msheh min tura levat ama vezamin yat ama vechavaru lebushehon:
Vayyomer el-haam heyu nekonim lishloshet yamim al-tiggeshu el-ishsha
Vaamar leama hevo zeminin litlata yomin la tiqrebun letzad itteta:
Vayehi bayyom hashshelishi biheyot habboqer vayehi qolot uberaqim veanan kabed al-hahar veqol shopar chazaq meod vayyecherad kol-haam asher bammachaneh
Vahava beyoma telitaa bemeheve tzapra vahava qalin ubarqin vaanana taqip al tura veqal shopara taqip lachada veza kol ama di bemashrita:
Vayyotze mosheh et-haam liqrat haelohim min-hammachaneh vayyiteyatztzebu betachtit hahar
Veappeq msheh yat ama leqadamut memera daAdonai min mashrita veitattadu beshippole tura:
Vehar sinay ashan kullo mippene asher yarad alayv Adonai baesh vayyaal ashano keeshen hakkibshan vayyecherad kol-hahar meod
Vetura desinay tanan kuleh min qodam deitgeli alohi Adonai beeshata useliq tenaneh kitnana deattuna veza kol tura lachada:
Vayehi qol hashshopar holek vechazeq meod mosheh yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu beqol
Vahava qal shopara azel vetaqep lachada msheh memalel umin qodam Adonai mitane leh beqal:
Vayyered Adonai al-har sinay el-rosh hahar vayyiqra Adonai lemosheh el-rosh hahar vayyaal mosheh
Veitgeli Adonai al tura desinay leresh tura uqera Adonai lemsheh leresh tura useliq msheh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh red haed baam pen-yehersu el-Adonai lirot venapal mimmennu rab
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh chut ashed beama dilema yepagrun qodam Adonai lemecheze veyippel minhon sagi:
Vegam hakkohanim hanniggashim el-Adonai yitqaddashu pen-yiprotz bahem Adonai
Veap kahanaya diqribin leshamasha qodam Adonai yitqadshun dilema yiqtol behon Adonai:
Vayyomer mosheh el-Adonai lo-yvkal haam laalot el-har sinay ki-atta haedota banu lemor hagbel et-hahar veqiddashto
Vaamar msheh qodam Adonai la yikkol ama lemisaq letura desinay are at ashedeta bana lememar tachim yat tura veqadeshehi:
Vayyomer elayv Adonai lek-red vealita atta veaharon immak vehakkohanim vehaam al-yehersu laalot el-Adonai pen-yiprotz-bam
Vaamar leh Adonai izel chut vetisaq at veaharon imak vekahanaya veama la yepagrun lemisaq liqodam Adonai dilema yiqtol behon:
Vayyered mosheh el-haam vayyomer alehem
Unechat msheh leama vaamar lehon:
Vayedabber elohim et kol-haddebarim haelleh lemor
Umalil Adonai yat kol pitgamaya hailen lememar:
Anoki Adonai eloheka asher hotzetika meeretz mitzrayim mibbet abadim
Ana Adonai elahak di appeqetak meara demitzrayim mibbet abduta:
Lo-yihyeh-leka elohim acherim al-panaay
La yehe lak elah ochoran bar mini:
Lo-taaseh-leka pesel vekol-temuna asher bashshamayim mimmaal vaasher baaretz mittaachat vaasher bammayim mittachat laaretz
La tabed lak tzelem vekol demut di bishmaya milela vedi beara milra vedi bemaya milra leara:
Lo-tishtachaveh lahem velo toobdem ki anoki Adonai eloheka el qanna poqed avon abot al-banim al-shilleshim veal-ribbeim lesoneay
La tisgud lehon vela tiplechinun are ana Adonai elahak el qana masar chobe abahan al benin maradin al dar telitay veal dar rebiay lesaneay kad meshalmin benaya lemechete batar abahatehon:
Veoseh chesed laalapim leohabay uleshomere mitzvotay
Veabed tibu lealpe darin lerachamay ulenatere piqoday:
Lo tissa et-shem-Adonai eloheka lashshav ki lo yenaqqeh Adonai et asher-yissa et-shemo lashshav
La teme bishma daAdonai elahak lemagana are la yizakke Adonai yat diyeme bishmeh leshiqra:
Zakor et-yom hashshabbat leqaddesho
Have dekir yat yoma deshabbeta leqadashuteh:
Sheshet yamim taabod veasita kol-melakteka
Shitta yomin tiplach vetabed kol ibidtak:
Veyom hashshebii shabbat la-Adonai eloheka lo-taaseh kol-melaka atta ubinka-vbitteka abdeka vaamateka ubehemteka vegereka asher bishareka
Veyoma shebiaa shabbeta qodam Adonai elahak la tabed kol ibidta at uberak uberattak abdak veamtak ubeirak vegiyorak di beqirvak:
Ki sheshet-yamim asa Adonai et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz et-hayyam veet-kol-asher-bam vayyanach bayyom hashshebii al-ken berak Adonai et-yom hashshabbat vayeqaddeshehu
Are shitta yomin abad Adonai yat shemaya veyat ara yat yama veyat kol di behon venach beyoma shebiaa al ken barik Adonai yat yoma deshabbeta veqadsheh:
Kabbed et-abika veet-immeka lemaan yaarikun yameka al haadama asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak
Yaqar yat abuk veyat imak bedil deyorekun yomayk al ara daAdonai elahak yaheb lak:
Lo tirtzach lo tinap lo tignob lo-taaneh bereaka ed shaqer
La tiqtol nepash la tegup la tignub la tashed bechabrak sahaduta deshiqra:
Lo tachmod bet reeka lo-tachmod eshet reeka veabdo vaamato veshoro vachamoro vekol asher lereeka
La tachmed bet chabrak la tachmed ittat chabrak veabdeh veamteh vetoreh vachamareh vekol di lechabrak:
Vekol-haam roim et-haqqolot veet-hallappidim veet qol hashshopar veet-hahar ashen vayyar haam vayyanuu vayyaamdu merachoq
Vekol ama chazan yat qalaya veyat baoraya veyat qal shopara veyat tura tanen vachaza ama vezau veqamu merachiq:
Vayyomeru el-mosheh dabber-atta immanu venishmaa veal-yedabber immanu elohim pen-namut
Vaamaru lemsheh malel at imana uneqabbel vela yitmalel imana min qodam Adonai dilema nemut:
Vayyomer mosheh el-haam al-tirau ki lebaabur nassot etkem ba haelohim ubaabur tihyeh yirato al-penekem lebilti techetau
Vaamar msheh leama la tidchalun are bedil lenasaa yatekon itgeli lekon yeqara daAdonai ubedil dithe dachalteh al appekon bedil dela techubun:
Vayyaamod haam merachoq umosheh niggash el-haarapel asher-sham haelohim
Veqam ama merachiq umsheh qareb letzad amiteta ditaman yeqara daAdonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh koh tomar el-bene yisrael attem reitem ki min-hashshamayim dibbarti immakem
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh kidnan temar libne yisrael attun chazittun are min shemaya malelit imkon:
Lo taasun itti elohe kesep velohe zahab lo taasu lakem
La tabedun qodamay dachalan diksap vedachalan didhab la tabedun lekon:
Mizbach adama taaseh-li vezabachta alayv et-oloteka veet-shelameka et-tzoneka veet-beqareka bekol-hammaqom asher azkir et-shemi abo eleka uberaktika
Madbach admeta tabed qodamay utehe dabbach alohi yat alavatak veyat niksat qudeshak min anak umin torak bekol atra di ashre yat shekinti letaman eshlach birketi lak veebarekinak:
Veim-mizbach abanim taaseh-li lo-tibneh ethen gazit ki charbeka henapta aleha vattechaleleha
Veim madbach abnin tabed qodamay la tibne yatehon pesilan dilma terim charbak alah utechallinah:
Velo-taaleh bemaalot al-mizbechi asher lo-tiggaleh ervateka alayv
Vela tisaq bedargin al madbechi di la titgele eryetak alohi:
Veelleh hammishpatim asher tasim lipnehem
Veilen dinaya di tasdar qodamehon:
Ki tiqneh ebed ibri shesh shanim yaabod ubashshebiit yetze lachopshi chinnam
Are tizban abda bar yisrael shit shenin yiplach ubashbieta yippoq lebar chorin magan:
Im-begappo yabo begappo yetze im-baal ishsha hu veyatzea ishto immo
Im bilchodohi yeol bilchodohi yippoq im beel itteta hu vetippoq itteteh imeh:
Im-adonayv yitten-lo ishsha veyaleda-lo banim o banot haishsha viladeha tihyeh ladoneha vehu yetze begappo
Im ribboneh yitten leh itteta utelid leh benin o benan itteta ubenaha tehe leribbonaha vehu yippoq bilchodohi:
Veim-amor yomar haebed ahabti et-adoni et-ishti veet-banay lo etze chopshi
Veim memar yemar abda rachemena yat ribboni yat itteti veyat benay la eppoq lebar chorin:
Vehiggisho adonayv el-haelohim vehiggisho el-haddelet o el-hammezuza veratza adonayv et-ozno bammartzea vaabado leolam
Viqarebineh ribboneh liqodam dayanaya viqarebineh levat dasha o levat mezuzta veyartza ribboneh yat udeneh bemartzea vihe leh abad palach lealam:
Veki-yimkor ish et-bitto leama lo tetze ketzet haabadim
Vaare yezabben gebar yat beratteh leamhu la tippoq kemapqanut abdaya:
Im-raa beene adoneha asher-lo yeadah vehepdah leam nokri lo-yimshol lemokrah bebigdo-ba
Im bisha beene ribbonah diqaymah leh veyipreqinah ligbar ochoran let leh reshu lezabbonah bemishleteh bah:
Veim-libno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaaseh-lah
Veim libreh yeqayminah kehilkat benat yisrael yabed lah:
Im-acheret yiqqach-lo sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra
Im ochoranta yisab leh ziyunah kesutah veonatah la yimna:
Veim-shelosh-elleh lo yaaseh lah veyatzea chinnam en kasep
Veim telat ilen la yabed lah vetippoq magan bela kesap:
Makkeh ish vamet mot yumat
Deyimche leenash veyiqtelineh itqetala yitqetel:
Vaasher lo tzada vehaelohim inna leyado vesamti leka maqom asher yanus shamma
Udela keman leh umin qodam Adonai ittimsar lideh veeshavi lak atar di yeiroq letaman:
Veki-yazid ish al-reehu lehorgo beorma meim mizbechi tiqqachennu lamut
Vaare yarsha gebar al chabreh lemiqteleh binkilu min madbechi tidberineh limmat:
Umakkeh abiv veimmo mot yumat
Udeyimche abuhi veimeh itqetala yitqetel:
Vegoneb ish umekaro venimtza beyado mot yumat
Vediyignub napsha min bene yisrael vizabbenineh veyishtekach bideh itqetala yitqetel:
Umeqallel abiv veimmo mot yumat
Vediylut abuhi veimeh itqetala yitqetel:
Veki-yeribun anashim vehikka-ish et-reehu beeben o beegrop velo yamut venapal lemishkab
Vaare yintzun gubrin veyimche gebar yat chabreh beabna o bekuremeza vela yemut veyippol lebutelan:
Im-yaqum vehithallek bachutz al-mishanto veniqqa hammakkeh raq shibto yitten verappo yerappe
Im yequm vihalik bebara al bureyeh vihe zakkaa macheya lechod butelaneh yitten vaagar asya yeshalem:
Veki-yakkeh ish et-abdo o et-amato bashshebet umet tachat yado naqom yinnaqem
Vaare yimche gebar yat abdeh o yat amteh beshaletan vimut techot yedeh itdana yittedan:
Ak im-yom o yomayim yaamod lo yuqqam ki kaspo hu
Beram im yoma o teren yomin yitqayam la yittedan are kaspeh hu:
Veki-yinnatzu anashim venagepu ishsha hara veyatzeu yeladeha velo yihyeh ason anosh yeanesh kaasher yashit alayv baal haishsha venatan biplilim
Vaare yintzun gubrin veyimchun itteta maadya veyippequn valedaha vela yehe mota itgebaa yitgebe kema di yeshavi alohi baalah deitteta veyitten al memar dayanaya:
Veim-ason yihyeh venatatta nepesh tachat napesh
Veim mota yehe vetitten napsha cholap napsha:
Ayin tachat ayin shen tachat shen yad tachat yad regel tachat ragel
Ena cholap ena shina cholap shina yeda cholap yeda ragla cholap ragla:
Keviyya tachat keviyya petza tachat patza chabbura tachat chabbura
Kevaa cholap kevaa pida cholap pida mashqope cholap mashqope:
Veki-yakkeh ish et-en abdo o-et-en amato veshichatah lachopshi yeshallechennu tachat eno
Vaare yimche gebar yat ena deabdeh o yat ena deamteh vichabbelinah lebar chorin yipterineh cholap eneh:
Veim-shen abdo o-shen amato yappil lachopshi yeshallechennu tachat shinno
Veim shina deabdeh o shina deamteh yappel lebar chorin yipterineh cholap shineh:
Veki-yiggach shor et-ish o et-ishsha vamet saqol yissaqel hashshor velo yeakel et-besaro ubaal hashshor naqi
Vaare yagach tora yat gabra o yat itteta vimut itregama yitregem tora vela yitakel yat bisreh umareh detora yehe zakkaa:
Veim shor naggach hu mittemol shilshom vehuad bibalayv velo yishmerennu vehemit ish o ishsha hashshor yissaqel vegam-bealayv yumat
Veim tor nagach hu meittemale umidqamohi veyittashed bemareh vela natreh veyiqtol gabra o itteta tora yitregem veap mareh yitqetel:
Im-koper yushat alayv venatan pidyon napsho kekol asher-yvshat alayv
Im mamon yeshavun alohi veyitten pureqan napsheh kekol di yeshavun alohi:
O-ben yiggach o-bat yiggach kammishpat hazzeh yeaseh lo
O lebar yisrael yagach tora o lebat yisrael yagach kedina haden yitabed leh:
Im-ebed yiggach hashshor o ama kesep sheloshim sheqalim yitten ladonayv vehashshor yissaqel
Im leabda yagach tora o leamta kesap telatin silin yitten leribboneh vetora yitregem:
Veki-yiptach ish bor o ki-yikreh ish bor velo yekassennu venapal-shamma shor o chamor
Vaare yiptach gebar gob o are yikreh gebar gob vela yekasineh veyippel taman tora o chamara:
Baal habbor yeshallem kesep yashib libalayv vehammet yiheyeh-lo
Mare degubba yeshalem kaspa yatib lemarohi umeta yehe dileh:
Veki-yiggop shor-ish et-shor reehu vamet umakeru et-hashshor hachay vechatzu et-kaspo vegam et-hammet yechetzun
Vaare yigop tor digbar yat tora dechabreh vimut vizabbenun yat tora chaya vipalgun yat kaspeh veap yat deme meta yepalgun:
O noda ki shor naggach hu mittemol shilshom velo yishmerennu bealayv shallem yeshallem shor tachat hashshor vehammet yiheyeh-lo
O ityeda are tor nagach hu meittemale umidqamohi vela natereh mareh shalama yeshalem tora chalap tora umeta yehe dileh:
Ki yignob-ish shor o-seh utebacho o mekaro chamishsha baqar yeshallem tachat hashshor vearba-tzon tachat hasseh
Are yignub gebar tor o imar veyikkesineh o yezabbenineh chamsha torin yeshalem chalap tora vearba ana cholap imra:
Im-bammachteret yimmatze haggannab vehukka vamet en lo damim
Im bemachtarta yishtekach ganaba veyitmeche vimut let leh dam:
Im-zarecha hashshemesh alayv damim lo shallem yeshallem im-en lo venimkar bignebato
Im ena desahadaya nepalat alohi dema leh shalama yeshalem im let leh veyizdabban bignubteh:
Im-himmatze timmatze beyado haggeneba mishshor ad-chamor ad-seh chayyim shenayim yeshallem
Im ishtekacha yishtekach bideh genubta mittor ad chamar ad imar kad inun chayin al chad teren yeshalem:
Ki yaber-ish sadeh o-kerem veshillach et-beiroh ubier bisdeh acher metab sadehu umetab karmo yeshallem
Are yokil gebar chaqal o keram vishalach yat beireh veyekul bachaqal ochoran shepar chaqleh ushepar karmeh yeshalem:
Ki-tetze esh umatzea qotzim veneekal gadish o haqqama o hassadeh shallem yeshallem hammabir et-habbeera
Are tittappaq nur veyashkach kubin veyekul gedishin o qoma o chaqla shalama yeshalem deadleq yat deleqta:
Ki-yitten ish el-reehu kesep o-kelim lishmor vegunnab mibbet haish im-yimmatze haggannab yeshallem shenayim
Are yitten gebar lechabreh kesap o manin lemitar veyitganbun mibbet gabra im yishtekach ganaba yeshalem al chad teren:
Im-lo yimmatze haggannab veniqrab baal-habbayit el-haelohim im-lo shalach yado bimleket reehu
Im la yishtekach ganaba veyitqareb mare debeta liqodam dayanaya im la oshit yedeh bema dimsar leh chabreh:
Al-kol-debar-pesha al-shor al-chamor al-seh al-salma al-kol-abeda asher yomar ki-hv zeh ad haelohim yabo debar-shenehem asher yarshiun elohim yeshallem shenayim lereehu
Al kol pitgam dechob al tor al chamar al imar al kesu al kol abedta di yemar are hu den liqodam dayanaya yeol din tarvehon di yechaybun dayanaya yeshalem al chad teren lechabreh:
Ki-yitten ish el-reehu chamor o-shor o-seh vekol-behema lishmor umet o-nishbar o-nishba en roeh
Are yitten gebar lechabreh chamar o tor o imar vekol beira lemitar umit o ittebar o ishtebi let dechaze:
Shebuat Adonai tihyeh ben shenehem im-lo shalach yado bimleket reehu velaqach bealayv velo yeshallem
Momata daAdonai tehe ben tarvehon im la oshit yedeh bema dimsar leh chabreh viqabbel mareh mineh momata vela yeshalem:
Veim-ganob yigganeb meimmo yeshallem libalayv
Veim itgenaba yitgeneb meimeh yeshalem lemarohi:
Im-tarop yittarep yebiehu ed hatterepa lo yeshallem
Im ittebara yittebar yayti sahadin ditbira la yeshalem:
Veki-yishal ish meim reehu venishbar o-met bealayv en-immo shallem yeshallem
Vaare yishal gebar min chabreh veyittebar o mit mareh let imeh shalama yeshalem:
Im-bealayv immo lo yeshallem im-sakir hu ba biskaro
Im mareh imeh la yeshalem im agira hu al beagreh:
Veki-yepatteh ish betula asher lo-orasa veshakab immah mahor yimharenna lo leishsha
Vaare yeshadel gebar betulta di la mearsa veyishkub imah qayama yeqayminah leh leintu:
Im-maen yemaen abiha letittah lo kesep yishqol kemohar habbetulot
Im mitzba la yitzbe abuha lemittenah leh kaspa yitqol kemohare betulta:
Mekashshepa lo techayyeh
Charasha la tache:
Kol-shokeb im-behema mot yumat
Kol deyishkub im beira itqetala yitqetel:
Zobeach laelohim yochoram bilti la-Adonai lebaddo
Dedabbach letavat ammaya yitqetel elahen lishma daAdonai bilchodohi:
Veger lo-toneh velo tilchatzennu ki-gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim
Vegiyora la tonun vela teiqun leh are dayarin hevetun beara demitzrayim:
Kol-almana veyatom lo teannun
Kol armela veyittam la teanun:
Im-anneh teanneh oto ki im-tzaoq yitzaq elay shamoa eshma tzaaqato
Im anaa teane yateh are im miqbal yiqbel qodamay qabbala eqabbel qebilteh:
Vechara appi veharagti etkem bechareb vehayu neshekem almanot ubenekem yetomim
Veyitqep rugezi veeqtol yatekon becharba vihevyan neshekon armelin ubenekon yatmin:
Im-kesep talveh et-ammi et-heani immak lo-tihyeh lo kenosheh lo-tesimun alayv neshek
Im kaspa tozep beami leanya di imak la tehe leh kerashya la teshavvon alohi chibbuleya:
Im-chabol tachbol salmat reeka ad-bo hashshemesh teshibennu lo
Im mashkona tisab kesuta dechabrak ad meal shimsha tetibineh leh:
Ki hiv kesutoh lebaddah hiv simlato leoro bammeh yishkab vehaya ki-yitzaq elay veshamati ki-channun ani
Are hi kesuteh bilchodah hi totebeh lemashkeh bema yishkub vihe are yiqbel qodamay veeqabbel qebilteh are chanana ana:
Elohim lo teqallel venasi beammeka lo taor
Dayana la teqil verabba beamak la telut:
Meleateka vedimaka lo teacher bekor baneka titten-li
Bikkurak vedimak la teacher bukera dibnayk tapresh qodamay:
Ken-taaseh leshoreka letzoneka shibat yamim yihyeh im-immo bayyom hashshemini titteno-li
Ken tabed letorak leanak shiba yomin yehe im imeh beyoma teminaa tipreshineh qodamay:
Veanshe-qodesh tihyun li ubasar bassadeh terepa lo tokelu lakkeleb tashlikun oto
Veenashin qadishin tehon qodamay ubesar telish min cheva chayta la tekelun lekalba tirmun yateh:
Lo tissa shema shav al-tashet yadeka im-rasha lihyot ed chamas
La teqabbel shema dishqar la teshavi yedak im chayaba lemeheve leh sahid sheqar:
Lo-tihyeh achare-rabbim leraot velo-taaneh al-rib lintot achare rabbim lehattot
La tehe batar sagiin leabasha vela titmena milalapa ma dibenak al dina batar sagie shelam dina:
Vedal lo tehdar beribo
Veal miskena la terachem bedineh:
Ki tipga shor oyibka o chamoro toeh hasheb teshibennu lo
Are tipga tora desaneak o chamareh detae ataba tetibineh leh:
Ki-tireh chamor sonaaka robetz tachat massao vechadalta meazob lo azob taazob immo
Are techeze chamara desaneak rebia techot toaneh vetittimna milmishbaq leh mishbaq tishboq ma diblibbak alohi utepareq imeh:
Lo tatteh mishpat ebyoneka beribo
La tatzle din miskenak bedineh:
Middebar-sheqer tirchaq venaqi vetzaddiq al-taharog ki lo-atzdiq rasha
Mippitgama deshiqra heve rachiq vedizke vedi nepaq deke min dina la tiqtol are la ezakke chayaba:
Veshochad lo tiqqach ki hashshochad yeavver piqchim visallep dibre tzaddiqim
Veshochada la teqabbel are shochada meaver ene chakkimin umeqalqel pitgamin teritzin:
Veger lo tilchatz veattem yedatem et-nepesh hagger ki-gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim
Vegiyora la teiqun veattun yedatun yat napsha degiyora are dayarin havetun beara demitzrayim:
Veshesh shanim tizra et-artzeka veasapta et-tebuatah
Veshit shenin tizra yat arak vetiknosh yat alaltah:
Vehashshebiit tishmetenna unetashtah veakelu ebyone ammeka veyitram tokal chayyat hassadeh ken-taaseh lekarmeka lezeteka
Ushebieta tashmetinah vetarteshinah veyekelun miskene amak ushearehon tekul chevat bara ken tabed lekarmak lezetak:
Sheshet yamim taaseh maaseka ubayyom hashshebii tishbot lemaan yanuach shoreka vachamoreka veyinnapesh ben-amateka vehagger
Shitta yomin tabed obadayk ubeyoma shebiaa tanuach bedil dinuach torak vechamarak veyishsheqot bar amtak vegiyora:
Ubekol asher-amarti alekem tishshameru veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru lo yishshama al-pika
Ubekol di amarit lekon tistamrun veshum taavat ammaya la tidkerun la yishtema al pumekon:
Shalosh regalim tachog li bashshana
Telat zimnin techog qodamay beshatta:
Et-chag hammatztzot tishmor shibat yamim tokal matztzot kaasher tzivvitika lemoed chodesh haabib ki-bo yatzata mimmitzrayim velo-yerau panay reqam
Yat chaga depatiraya titar shiba yomin tekul patira kema dipaqedittak lizman yarcha daabiba are beh nepaqta mimitzrayim vela yitchazun qodamay reqanun:
Vechag haqqatzir bikkure maaseka asher tizra bassadeh vechag haasip betzet hashshana beospeka et-maaseka min-hassadeh
Vechaga dachatzada bikkure obadayk di tizra bechaqla vechaga diknasha bemippeqa deshatta bemikneshak yat obadayk min chaqla:
Shalosh peamim bashshana yeraeh kol-zekureka el-pene haadon Adonai
Telat zimnin beshatta yitchazun kol dekurak qodam ribbon alema Adonai:
Lo-tizbach al-chametz dam-zibchi velo-yalin cheleb-chaggi ad-boqer
La tikkos al chamia dam pischi vela yebitun bar min madbecha tarbe niksat chaga ad tzapra:
Reshit bikkure admateka tabi bet Adonai eloheka lo-tebashshel gedi bachaleb immo
Resh bikkure arak tayti lebet miqdesha daAdonai elahak la tekelun besar bachalab:
Hinneh anoki sholeach malak lepaneka lishmorka baddarek velahabiaka el-hammaqom asher hakinoti
Ha ana shalach malaka qodamak lemitrak beorcha uleoolutak leatra diatqenit:
Hishshamer mippanayv ushema beqolo al-tammer bo ki lo yissa lepishakem ki shemi beqirbo
Istammar min qodamohi veqabbel lememereh la tesareb leqibleh are la yishboq lechobekon are bishmi memereh:
Ki im-shamoa tishma beqolo veasita kol asher adabber veayabti et-oyebeka vetzarti et-tzorereka
Are im qabbala teqabbel lememereh vetabed kol deemalel veesne yat saneak veaiq ledimiqin lak:
Ki-yelek malaki lepaneka vehebiaka el-haemori vehachitti vehapperizzi vehakkenaani hachivvi vehayebusi vehikchadtiv
Are yehak malaki qodamak veyaelinak levat emorae vechittae uperizae ukenaanae chivae vibusae veeshetzinun:
Lo-tishtachaveh lelohehem velo toobdem velo taaseh kemaasehem ki hares teharesem veshabber teshabber matztzebotehem
La tisgud letaavatehon vela tiplechinun vela tabed keobadehon are pagara tepagrinun vetabbara tetabbar qamatehon:
Vaabadtem et Adonai elohekem uberak et-lachmeka veet-memeka vahasiroti machala miqqirbeka
Vetiplechun qodam Adonai elahakon vibarek yat mekelak veyat mishteyak veadi marin bishin mibbenak:
Lo tihyeh meshakkela vaaqara beartzeka et-mispar yameka amalle
La tehe metakkela veaqra bearak yat minyan yomayk ashlim:
Et-emati ashallach lepaneka vehammoti et-kol-haam asher tabo bahem venatatti et-kol-oyebeka eleka orep
Yat emeti ashalach qodamak veitebar yat kol ama deat ate laagacha behon veemsar yat kol baale debabak qodamak mechazre qedal:
Veshalachti et-hatztzira lepaneka vegeresha et-hachivvi et-hakkenaani veet-hachitti millepaneka
Veeshlach yat araita qodamak utetarek yat chivae yat kenaanae veyat chittae min qodamak:
Lo agareshennu mippaneka beshana echat pen-tihyeh haaretz shemama verabba aleka chayyat hassadeh
La etarekinun min qodamak beshatta chada dilema tehe ara tzadya vetisge alak chevat bara:
Meat meat agareshennu mippaneka ad asher tipreh venachalta et-haaretz
Zeer zeer etarekinun min qodamak ad detisge vetachsen yat ara:
Veshatti et-gebulka miyyam-svp vead-yam pelishtim umimmidbar ad-hannahar ki etten beyedkem et yoshebe haaretz vegerashtamo mippaneka
Veeshave yat techumak miyama desup vead yama diplishtae umimadbera ad perat are emsar bidekon yat yatebe ara utetarekinun min qodamak:
Lo-tikrot lahem velelohehem berit
La tigzar lehon uletaavatehon qeyam:
Lo yeshebu beartzeka pen-yachatiu oteka li ki taabod et-elohehem ki-yihyeh leka lemoqesh
La yetebun bearak dilema yechaybun yatak qodamay are tiplach yat taavatehon are yehon lak letaqla:
Veel-mosheh amar aleh el-Adonai atta veaharon nadab vaabihu veshibim mizziqne yisrael vehishtachavitem merachoq
Ulemsheh amar saq liqodam Adonai at veaharon nadab vaabihu veshibin misabe yisrael vetisgedun merachiq:
Veniggash mosheh lebaddo el-Adonai vehem lo yiggashu vehaam lo yaalu immo
Veyitqereb msheh bilchodohi liqodam Adonai veinun la yitqarebun veama la yisqun imeh:
Vayyabo mosheh vayesapper laam et kol-dibre Adonai veet kol-hammishpatim vayyaan kol-haam qol echad vayyomeru kol-haddebarim asher-dibber Adonai naaseh
Vaata msheh veishtai leama yat kol pitgamaya daAdonai veyat kol dinaya vaateb kol ama qala chad vaamaru kol pitgamaya di malil Adonai nabed:
Vayyiktob mosheh et kol-dibre Adonai vayyashkem babboqer vayyiben mizbeach tachat hahar ushetem esreh matztzeba lishnem asar shibte yisrael
Uketab msheh yat kol pitgamaya daAdonai veaqdem betzapra ubena madbecha beshippole tura vetarta esre qaman litre asar shibtaya deyisrael:
Vayyishlach et-naare bene yisrael vayyaalu olot vayyizbechu zebachim shelamim la-Adonai parim
Ushelach yat bukere bene yisrael veasiqu alavan veqaribu niksat qudeshin qodam Adonai torin:
Vayyiqqach mosheh chatzi haddam vayyasem baagganot vachatzi haddam zaraq al-hammizbeach
Unesib msheh palgut dema veshavi bemizreqaya upalgut dema zeraq al madbecha:
Vayyiqqach seper habberit vayyiqra beozne haam vayyomeru kol asher-dibber Adonai naaseh venishma
Unesib sipra diqyama uqera qodam ama vaamaru kol di malil Adonai nabed uneqabbel:
Vayyiqqach mosheh et-haddam vayyizroq al-haam vayyomer hinneh dam-habberit asher karat Adonai immakem al kol-haddebarim haelleh
Unesib msheh yat dema uzeraq al madbecha lekappara al ama vaamar ha den dam qeyama digzar Adonai imkon al kol pitgamaya hailen:
Vayyaal mosheh veaharon nadab vaabihu veshibim mizziqne yisrael
Useleq msheh veaharon nadab vaabihu veshibin misabe yisrael
Vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglayv kemaaseh libnat hassappir ukeetzem hashshamayim latohar
Vachazo yat yeqar elaha deyisrael utechot karesa yeqareh keobad eben taba ukemecheze shemaya lebariru:
Veel-atzile bene yisrael lo shalach yado vayyechezu et-haelohim vayyokelu vayyishtu
Ulerabrebe bene yisrael la hava nizqa vachazo yat yeqara daAdonai vahavo chadan beqorbanehon deitqabbalu beraava keilu oklin veshatan:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh aleh elay hahara vehyeh-sham veettena leka et-luchot haeben vehattora vehammitzva asher katabti lehorotam
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh saq liqodamay letura veheve taman veetten lak yat luche abna veorayta vetapqedta diktabit lealupehon:
Vayyaqom mosheh vihoshua meshareto vayyaal mosheh el-har haelohim
