Veqam msheh vihoshua meshumshaneh useleq msheh letura deitgeli alohi yeqara daAdonai:
Veel-hazzeqenim amar shebu-lanu bazeh ad asher-nashub alekem vehinneh aharon vechur immakem mi-baal debarim yiggash alehem
Ulesabaya amar oriku lana haka ad dintub levatekon veha aharon vechur imkon man deit leh dina yitqereb liqodamehon:
Vayyaal mosheh el-hahar vayekas heanan et-hahar
Useleq msheh letura vachapa anana yat tura:
Vayyishkon kebod-Adonai al-har sinay vayekassehu heanan sheshet yamim vayyiqra el-mosheh bayyom hashshebii mittok heanan
Ushera yeqara daAdonai al tura desinay vachapahi anana shitta yomin uqera lemsheh beyoma shebiaa migo anana:
Umareh kebod Adonai keesh okelet berosh hahar leene bene yisrael
Vechezu yeqara daAdonai kechezu esha okla beresh tura leene bene yisrael:
Vayyabo mosheh betok heanan vayyaal el-hahar vayehi mosheh bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layela
Veal msheh bego anana useleq letura vahava msheh betura arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veyiqchu-li teruma meet kol-ish asher yiddebennu libbo tiqchu et-terumati
Mallel im bene yisrael veyapreshun qodamay aprashuta min kol gebar deyitreeh libbeh tissebun yat aprashuti:
Vezot hatteruma asher tiqchu meittam zahab vakesep unechoshet
Veda aprashuta ditissebun minnehon dahaba vekaspa unechasha:
Utekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh veizzim
Vetikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz umeazze:
Veorot elim meoddamim veorot techashim vaatze shittim
Umashke dedikre mesammeqe umashke sasgona veae shittin:
Shemen lammaor besamim leshemen hammishcha veliqtoret hassammim
Mishcha leanharuta busemayya lemishcha dirbuta veliqtoret busemayya:
Abne-shoham veabne milluim laepod velachoshen
Abne burela veabne ashlamuta leshaqqaa beepoda ubechushena:
Veasu li miqdash veshakanti betokam
Veyabedun qodamay miqdesha veashre shekinti benehon:
Kekol asher ani mareh oteka et tabnit hammishkan veet tabnit kol-kelayv veken taasu
Kekol di ana machaze yatak yat demut mashkena veyat demut kol manohi veken tabedun:
Veasu aron atze shittim ammatayim vachetzi orko veamma vachetzi rochbo veamma vachetzi qomato
Veyabedun arona deae shittin tarten ammin upalga urkeh veammeta upalga petayeh veammeta upalga rumeh:
Vetzippita oto zahab tahor mibbayit umichutz tetzappennu veasita alayv zer zahab sabib
Vetechepe yateh dehab deke miggav umibbara tachapinneh vetabed alohi zer didhab sechor sechor:
Veyatzaqta lo arba tabbeot zahab venatatta al arba paamotayv ushete tabbaot al-tzalo haechat ushete tabbaot al-tzalo hashshenit
Vetattik leh arba izqan didhab vetitten al arba zivyateh vetarten izqan al sitreh chad vetarten izqan al sitreh tinyeta:
Veasita badde atze shittim vetzippita otam zahab
Vetabed ariche deae shittin vetachape yatehon dahaba:
Vehebeta et-habbaddim battabbaot al tzalot haaron laset et-haaron bahem
Vetael yat arichayya beizqata al sitre arona lemittal yat arona behon:
Betabbeot haaron yihyu habbaddim lo yasuru mimmennu
Beizqeta daarona yehon arichayya la yeiddun minneh:
Venatatta el-haaron et haedut asher etten eleka
Vetitten baarona yat sahaduta di etten lak:
Veasita kapporet zahab tahor ammatayim vachetzi orkah veamma vachetzi rochbah
Vetabed kappurta didhab deke tarten ammin upalga urkah veammeta upalga petayah:
Veasita shenayim kerubim zahab miqsha taaseh otam mishshene qetzot hakkapporet
Vetabed teren kerubin didhab negid tabed yatehon mitteren sitre kappurta:
Vaaseh kerub echad miqqatza mizzeh ukerub-echad miqqatza mizzeh min-hakkapporet taasu et-hakkerubim al-shene qetzotayv
Veibbed keruba chad missitra mikka ukeruba chad missitra mikka min kappurta tabedun yat kerubayya al teren sitrohi:

Vihon kerubayya perisan gadpehon leella metallin begadpehon al kappurta veappehon chad loqobel chad loqobel kappurta yehon appe kerubayya:
Venatatta et-hakkapporet al-haaron milmaela veel-haaron titten et-haedut asher etten eleka
Vetitten yat kappurta al arona milleella ubaarona titten yat sahaduta di etten lak:

Veezammen memeri lak tamman veemallel immak meillave kappurta mibben teren kerubayya di al arona desahaduta yat kol di apaqqed yatak levat bene yisrael:
Veasita shulchan atze shittim ammatayim orko veamma rochbo veamma vachetzi qomato
Vetabed patora deae shittin tarten ammin urkeh veammeta petayeh veammeta upalga rumeh:
Vetzippita oto zahab tahor veasita lo zer zahab sabib
Vetachape yateh dehab deke vetabed leh zer didhab sechor sechor:
Veasita lo misgeret topach sabib veasita zer-zahab lemisgarto sabib
Vetabed leh gedanpa rumeh pushka sechor sechor vetabed zer didhab ligdanpeh sechor sechor:

Vetabed leh arba izqan didhab vetitten yat izqata al arba zivyata di learba raglohi:
Leummat hammisgeret tihyena hattabbaot lebattim lebaddim laset et-hashshulchan
Loqobel gedanpa yehevyan izqata leatra laarichayya lemittal yat patora:
Veasita et-habbaddim atze shittim vetzippita otam zahab venissa-bam et-hashshulchan
Vetabed yat arichayya deae shittin vetachape yatehon dahaba vihon natelin behon yat patora:
Veasita qearotayv vekappotayv uqesotayv umenaqqiyyotayv asher yussak bahen zahab tahor taaseh otam
Vetabed magisohi ubazikkohi veqasvateh umekilateh diyitnassak behen dehab deke tabed yatehon:
Venatatta al-hashshulchan lechem panim lepanay tamid
Vetitten al patora lechem appayya qodamay tedira:
Veasita menorat zahab tahor miqsha teaseh hammenora yerekah veqanah gebieha kaptoreha uperacheha mimmenna yihyu
Vetabed menarta didhab deke negid titabed menarta shiddah uqenah kallidaha chezuraha veshoshannaha minnah yehon:

Veshitta qenin napeqin missitraha telata qene menarta missitrah chad utelata qene menarta missitrah tinyana:

Telata kallidin metzayrin beqanya chad chezur veshoshan utelata kallidin metzayrin beqanya chad chezur veshoshan ken leshitta qenin denapeqin min menarta:
Ubammenora arbaa gebiim meshuqqadim kaptoreha uperacheha
Ubimnarta arbea kallidin metzayrin chezuraha veshoshannaha:

Vechezur techot teren qenin minnah vechezur techot teren qenin minnah vechezur techot teren qenin minnah leshitta qenin denapeqin min menarta:
Kaptorehem uqenotam mimmenna yihyu kullah miqsha achat zahab tahor
Chezurehon uqenehon minnah yehon kullah negida chada didhab deke:
Veasita et-neroteha shiba veheela et-neroteha veheir al-eber paneha
Vetabed yat botzinaha shiba vetadleq yat botzinaha vihon menaharin al qobel appaha:
Umalqacheha umachtoteha zahab tahor
Vetzibyataha umachteyataha didhab deke:
Kikkar zahab tahor yaaseh otah et kol-hakkelim haelleh
Kikkera didhab deke yabed yatah yat kol manayya haillen:
Ureeh vaaseh betabnitam asher-atta moreh bahar
Vachaze vaabed kidmutehon diat mitchazi betura:
Veet-hammishkan taaseh eser yeriot shesh moshzar utekelet veargaman vetolaat shani kerubim maaseh chosheb taaseh otam
Veyat mashkena tabed asar yerian debutz shezir vetikla veargevana utzeba zehori tzurat kerubin obad oman tabed yatehon:
Orek hayeria haachat shemoneh veesrim baamma verochab arba baamma hayeria haechat midda achat lekol-hayeriot
Urka diriata chada asrin vetamne ammin uputeya arba ammin diriata chada meshachta chada lekol yeriata:
Chamesh hayeriot tiheyena choberot ishsha el-achotah vechamesh yeriot choberot ishsha el-achotah
Chamesh yerian yehevyan melappepan chada im chada vachamesh yerian melappepan chada im chada:
Veasita luleot tekelet al sepat hayeria haechat miqqatza bachobaret veken taaseh bispat hayeria haqqitzona bammachberet hashshenit
Vetabed anubin detikla al sipta diriata chada missitra bet lope veken tabed besipta diriata besitra debet lope tinyeta:
Chamishshim lulaot taaseh bayria haechat vachamishshim lulaot taaseh biqtzeh hayeria asher bammachberet hashshenit maqbilot hallulaot ishsha el-achotah
Chamshin anubin tabed biriata chada vechamshin anubin tabed besitra diriata debet lope tinyana mekavvenan anubayya chada loqobel chada:
Veasita chamishshim qarse zahab vechibbarta et-hayeriot ishsha el-achotah baqqerasim vehaya hammishkan echad
Vetabed chamshin purepin didhab utelapep yat yeriata chada im chada bepurepayya vihe mashkena chad:
Veasita yeriot izzim leohel al-hammishkan ashte-esreh yeriot taaseh otam
Vetabed yerian meazze liprasa al mashkena chada esre yerian tabed yatehon:
Orek hayeria haachat sheloshim baamma verochab arba baamma hayeria haechat midda achat leashte esreh yeriot
Urka diriata chada telatin ammin uputeya arba ammin diriata chada meshachta chada lachada esre yerian:
Vechibbarta et-chamesh hayeriot lebad veet-shesh hayeriot lebad vekapalta et-hayeria hashshishshit el-mvl pene haohel
Utelapep yat chamesh yerian lechod veyat shit yerian lechod veteup yat yeriata shetiteta loqobel appe mashkena:
Veasita chamishshim lulaot al sepat hayeria haechat haqqitzona bachobaret vachamishshim lulaot al sepat hayeria hachoberet hashshenit
Vetabed chamshin anubin al sipta diriata chada besitra bet lope vechamshin anubin al sipta diriata debet lope tinyeta:
Veasita qarse nechoshet chamishshim vehebeta et-haqqerasim ballulaot vechibbarta et-haohel vehaya echad
Vetabed purepin dinchasha chamshin vetael yat purepayya baanubayya utelapep yat mashkena vihe chad:
Veserach haodep biriot haohel chatzi hayeria haodepet tisrach al achore hammishkan
Vesircha deyattira biriat mashkena palgut yeriata deyattira tisrach al achore mashkena:
Vehaamma mizzeh vehaamma mizzeh baodep beorek yeriot haohel yihyeh saruach al-tzidde hammishkan mizzeh umizzeh lekassoto
Veammeta mikka veammeta mikka bidyattira beurka yeriata demashkena yehe seriach al sitre mashkena mikka umikka lekassayuteh:
Veasita mikseh laohel orot elim meoddamim umikseh orot techashim milmaela
Vetabed chopaa liprasa mashke dedikre mesammeqe vechopaa mashke desasgona milleella:
Veasita et-haqqerashim lammishkan atze shittim omedim
Vetabed yat dappayya lemashkena deae shittin qayemin:
Eser ammot orek haqqaresh veamma vachatzi haamma rochab haqqeresh haechad
Asar ammin urka dedappa veammeta upalgut ammeta puteya dedappa chad:
Shete yadot laqqeresh haechad meshullabot ishsha el-achotah ken taaseh lekol qarshe hammishkan
Tarten tzirin ledappa chad meshallebin chada loqobel chada ken tabed lekol dappe mashkena:
Veasita et-haqqerashim lammishkan esrim qeresh lipat negba temana
Vetabed yat dappayya lemashkena asrin dappin leruach ebar daroma:
Vearbaim adne-kesep taaseh tachat esrim haqqaresh shene adanim tachat-haqqeresh haechad lishte yedotayv ushene adanim tachat-haqqeresh haechad lishte yedotayv
Vearbein samkin diksap tabed techot asrin dappin teren samkin techot dappa chad litren tzirohi uteren samkin techot dappa chad litren tzirohi:
Uletzela hammishkan hashshenit lipat tzapon esrim qaresh
Velistar mashkena tinyeta leruach tzippuna asrin dappin:
Vearbaim adnehem kasep shene adanim tachat haqqeresh haechad ushene adanim tachat haqqeresh haechad
Vearbein samkehon diksap teren samkin techot dappa chad uteren samkin techot dappa chad:
Uleyarkete hammishkan yamma taaseh shishsha qerashim
Velisyape mashkena maarba tabed shitta dappin:
Ushene qerashim taaseh limqutzot hammishkan bayyarkatayim
Uteren dappin tabed lezaveyat mashkena besopehon:
Veyiheyu toamim millematta veyachdav yihyu tammim al-rosho el-hattabbaat haechat ken yihyeh lishnehem lishne hammiqtzoot yihyu
Vihon mekavvenin millera vekachada yehon mekavvenin al resheh leizqeta chada ken yehe letarvehon litren zaveyan yehon:
Vehayu shemona qerashim veadnehem kesep shishsha asar adanim shene adanim tachat haqqeresh haechad ushene adanim tachat haqqeresh haechad
Vihon temanya dappin vesamkehon diksap shitta asar samkin teren samkin techot dappa chad uteren samkin techot dappa chad:
Veasita berichim atze shittim chamishsha leqarshe tzela-hammishkan haechad
Vetabed abbere deae shittin chamsha ledappe setar mashkena chad:
Vachamishsha berichim leqarshe tzela-hammishkan hashshenit vachamishsha berichim leqarshe tzela hammishkan layyarkatayim yamma
Vechamsha abberin ledappe setar mashkena tinyeta vechamsha abberin ledappe setar mashkena lesopehon maarba:
Vehabberiach hattikon betok haqqerashim mabriach min-haqqatzeh el-haqqatzeh
Veabbera metziaa bego dappayya mabar min seyape lisyape:
Veet-haqqerashim tetzappeh zahab veet-tabbeotehem taaseh zahab battim labberichim vetzippita et-habberichim zahab
Veyat dappayya tachpe dahaba veyat izqatehon tabed dahaba atra leabrayya vetachpe yat abberayya dahaba:
Vahaqemota et-hammishkan kemishpato asher horeta bahar
Uteqim yat mashkena kehilketeh di itchazeta betura:
Veasita paroket tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maaseh chosheb yaaseh otah kerubim
Vetabed parukta tikla veaggevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir obad oman yabed yatah tzurat kerubin:
Venatatta otah al-arbaa ammude shittim metzuppim zahab vavehem zahab al-arbaa adne-kasep
Vetitten yatah al arbea ammude shittin mechappeyan dahaba vavehon dahaba al arbea samke diksap:
Venatatta et-happaroket tachat haqqerasim vehebeta shamma mibbet lapparoket et aron haedut vehibdila happaroket lakem ben haqqodesh uben qodesh haqqodashim
Vetitten yat parukta techot purepayya vetael tamman miggav leparukta yat arona desahaduta vetapresh parukta lekon ben qudesha uben qodesh qudeshayya:
Venatatta et-hakkapporet al aron haedut beqodesh haqqodashim
Vetitten yat kappurta al arona desahaduta beqodesh qudeshayya:
Vesamta et-hashshulchan michutz lapparoket veet-hammenora nokach hashshulchan al tzela hammishkan temana vehashshulchan titten al-tzela tzapon
Uteshavvi yat patora mibbara leparukta veyat menarta loqobel patora al tzidda demashkena daroma upatora titten al setar tzippuna:
Veasita masak lepetach haohel tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maaseh roqem
Vetabed perasa litra mashkena tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir obad tzayyar:
Veasita lammasak chamishsha ammude shittim vetzippita otam zahab vavehem zahab veyatzaqta lahem chamishsha adne nechoshet
Vetabed liprasa chamsha ammude shittin vetachappe yatehon dahaba vavehon dahaba vetattik lehon chamsha samke nechasha:
Veasita et-hammizbeach atze shittim chamesh ammot orek vechamesh ammot rochab rabua yihyeh hammizbeach veshalosh ammot qomato
Vetabed yat madbecha deae shittin chamesh ammin urka vachamesh ammin puteya merabba yehe madbecha utelat ammin rumeh:
Veasita qarnotayv al arba pinnotayv mimmennu tihyena qarnotayv vetzippita oto nechoshet
Vetabed qarnohi al arba zivyateh minneh tehevyan qarnohi vetachappe yateh nechasha:
Veasita sirotayv ledashsheno veyaayv umizreqotayv umizlegotayv umachtotayv lekol-kelayv taaseh nechoshet
Vetabed pesakteravateh lemispe qitmeh umagropeyateh umizreqateh vetzinnureyateh umachteyateh lekol manohi tabed nechasha:
Veasita lo mikbar maaseh reshet nechoshet veasita al-hareshet arba tabbeot nechoshet al arba qetzotayv
Vetabed leh serada obad metzadta dinchasha vetabed al metzadta arba izqan dinchasha al arba sitrohi:
Venatatta otah tachat karkob hammizbeach millematta vehayeta hareshet ad chatzi hammizbeach
Vetitten yatah techot sobabe madbecha millera utehe metzadta ad palgut madbecha:
Veasita baddim lammizbeach badde atze shittim vetzippita otam nechoshet
Vetabed arichayya lemadbecha ariche deae shittin vetachape yatehon nechasha:
Vehuba et-baddayv battabbaot vehayu habbaddim al-shete tzalot hammizbeach biset oto
Veyael yat arichohi beizqata vihon arichayya al teren sitre madbecha bemittal yateh:
Nebub luchot taaseh oto kaasher hera oteka bahar ken yaasu
Chalil luche tabed yateh kema di achazi yatak betura ken yabedun:
Veasita et chatzar hammishkan lipat negeb-temana qelaim lechatzer shesh moshzar mea baamma orek lappea haechat
Vetabed yat darat mashkena leruach ebar daroma seradin ledareta debutz shezir mea beammin urka leebar chad:
Veammudayv esrim veadnehem esrim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashuqehem kasep
Veammudohi esrin vesamkehon esrin nechasha vave ammudayya vekibbushehon kesap:
Veken lipat tzapon baorek qelaim mea orek veammudav esrim veadnehem esrim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashuqehem kasep
Veken leruach tzippuna beurka seradin mea urka veammudohi esrin vesamkehon esrin nechasha vave ammudayya vekibbushehon diksap:
Verochab hechatzer lipat-yam qelaim chamishshim amma ammudehem asara veadnehem asara
Uputeya dedarta leruach maarba seradin chamshin ammin ammudehon asra vesamkehon asra:
Verochab hechatzer lipat qedema mizracha chamishshim amma
Uputeya dedarta leruach qidduma maddinecha chamshin ammin:
Vachamesh esreh amma qelaim lakkatep ammudehem shelosha veadnehem shelosha
Vachamesh esre ammin seradin leibra ammudehon telata vesamkehon telata:
Velakkatep hashshenit chamesh esreh qelaim ammudehem shelosha veadnehem shelosha
Uleibra tinyana chamesh esre seradin ammudehon telata vesamkehon telata:
Uleshaar hechatzer masak esrim amma tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maaseh roqem ammudehem arbaa veadnehem arbaa
Velitra darta perasa esrin ammin tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir obad tzayyar ammudehon arbea vesamkehon arbea:
Kol-ammude hechatzer sabib mechushshaqim kesep vavehem kasep veadnehem nechoshet
Kol ammude darta sechor sechor mekabbeshin kesap vavehon kesap vesamkehon nechasha:
Orek hechatzer mea baamma verochab chamishshim bachamishshim veqoma chamesh ammot shesh moshzar veadnehem nechoshet
Urka dedarta mea beammin uputeya chamshin bechamshin veruma chamesh ammin debutz shezir vesamkehon nechasha:
Lekol kele hammishkan bekol abodato vekol-yetedotayv vekol-yitdot hechatzer nechoshet
Lekol mane mashkena bekol palechaneh vekol sikkohi vekol sikke dedarta nechasha:
Veatta tetzavveh et-bene yisrael veyiqchu eleka shemen zayit zak katit lammaor lehaalot ner tamid
Veat tepaqqed yat bene yisrael veyissebun lak mishcha zeta dakya katisha leanhara leadlaqa botzinayya tedira:
Beohel moed michutz lapparoket asher al-haedut yaarok oto aharon ubanayv meereb ad-boqer lipne Adonai chuqqat olam ledorotam meet bene yisrael
Bemashkan zimna mibbara leparukta dial sahaduta yesaddar yateh aharon ubenohi meramsha ad tzapra qodam Adonai qeyam alam ledarehon min bene yisrael:
Veatta haqreb eleka et-aharon achika veet-banayv itto mittok bene yisrael lekahano-li aharon nadab vaabihu elazar veitamar bene aharon
Veat qareb levatak yat aharon achuk veyat benohi immeh miggo bene yisrael leshammasha qodamay aharon nadab vaabihu elazar veitamar bene aharon:
Veasita bigde-qodesh leaharon achika lekabod uletiparet
Vetabed lebushe qudesha leaharon achuk liqar uletushbechan:
Veatta tedabber el-kol-chakme-leb asher milletiv ruach chokma veasu et-bigde aharon leqaddesho lekahano-li
Veat temallel im kol chakkime libba diashlemit immeh ruach chokmeta veyabedun yat lebushe aharon leqaddashuteh leshammasha qodamay:
Veelleh habbegadim asher yaasu choshen veepod umeil uketonet tashbetz mitznepet veabnet veasu bigde-qodesh leaharon achika ulebanayv lekahano-li
Veillen lebushayya di yabedun chushena veepoda umeila vekittuna merammetza mitznepta vehemyana veyabedun lebushe qudesha leaharon achuk velibnohi leshammasha qodamay:
Vehem yiqchu et-hazzahab veet-hattekelet veet-haargaman veet-tolaat hashshani veet-hashshesh
Veinnun yissebun yat dahaba veyat tikla veyat argevana veyat tzeba zehori veyat butza:
Veasu et-haepod zahab tekelet veargaman tolaat shani veshesh moshzar maaseh chosheb
Veyabedun yat epoda dahaba tikla veargevana tzeba zehori ubutz shezir obad oman:
Shete ketepot choberot yiheyeh-lo el-shene qetzotayv vechubbar
Tarten katpin melappepan yehon leh al teren sitrohi veyitlapap:
Vechesheb apuddato asher alayv kemaasehu mimmennu yihyeh zahab tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar
Vehemyan tiqquneh di alohi keobadohi minneh yehe dahaba tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir:
Velaqachta et-shete abne-shoham upittachta alehem shemot bene yisrael
Vetissab yat tarten abne burela vetiglop alehen shemahat bene yisrael:
Shishsha mishshemotam al haeben haechat veet-shemot hashshishsha hannotarim al-haeben hashshenit ketoledotam
Shitta mishshemahatehon al abna chada veyat shemahat shitta deishtaaru al abna tinyeta ketuledatehon:
Maaseh charash eben pittuche chotam tepattach et-shete haabanim al-shemot bene yisrael musabbot mishbetzot zahab taaseh otam
Obad oman eben taba ketab meparash kiglop deizqa tiglop yat tarten abnayya al shemahat bene yisrael meshaqqean merammetzan didhab tabed yatehon:
Vesamta et-shete haabanim al kitpot haepod abne zikkaron libne yisrael venasa aharon et-shemotam lipne Adonai al-shete ketepayv lezikkaron
Uteshavvi yat tarten abnaya al kitpe epoda abne dakerana libne yisrael veyittol aharon yat shemahatehon qodam Adonai al teren kitpohi ledakerana:
Veasita mishbetzot zahab
Vetabed merammetzan didhab:
Ushete sharsherot zahab tahor migbalot taaseh otam maaseh abot venatatta et-sharsherot haabotot al-hammishbetzot
Vetarten tikkin dehab deke metachman tabed yatehon obad gedilu vetitten yat tikkayya gedilata al merammetzata:
Veasita choshen mishpat maaseh chosheb kemaaseh epod taasennu zahab tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar taaseh oto
Vetabed chshen dina obad oman keobad epoda tabedinneh dahaba tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir tabed yateh:
Rabua yiheyeh kapul zeret orko vezeret rochbo
Merabba yehe ep zerta urkeh vezerta petayeh:
Umilleta bo milluat eben arbaa turim aben tur odem pitda ubareqet hattur haechad
Vetashlem beh ashlamut abna arbea sidrin eben taba sidra qadmaa samqan yarqan ubarqan sidra chad:
Vehattur hashsheni nopek sappir veyahalom
Vesidra tinyana izmaragdin veshabziz vesibhalom:
Vehattur hashshelishi leshem shebo veachlama
Vesidra telitaa qankire tarqeya veen egla:
Vehattur harebii tarshish veshoham veyashepeh meshubbatzim zahab yihyu bemilluotam
Vesidra rebiaa kerum yamma uburela upantere merammetzan didhab yehon beashlamutehon:
Vehaabanim tiheyena al-shemot bene-yisrael shetem esreh al-shemotam pittuche chotam ish al-shemo tiheyena lishne asar shabet
Veabnayya yehevyan al shemahat bene yisrael tarte esre al shemahathon ketab meparash kiglop deizqa gebar al shemeh tehevyan litren asar shibtin:
Veasita al-hachoshen shareshot gablut maaseh abot zahab tahor
Vetabed al chushena tikkin metachman obad gedilu dehab deke:
Veasita al-hachoshen shete tabbeot zahab venatatta et-shete hattabbaot al-shene qetzot hachoshen
Vetabed al chushena tarten izqan didhab vetitten yat tarten izqata al teren sitre chushena:
Venatatta et-shete abotot hazzahab al-shete hattabbaot el-qetzot hachoshen
Vetitten yat tarten gedilan didhab al tarten izqata lesitre chushena:
Veet shete qetzot shete haabotot titten al-shete hammishbetzot venatatta al-kitpot haepod el-mvl panayv
Veyat tarten gedilan deal tarten sitrohi titten al tarten merammetzata vetitten al kitpe epoda loqobel appohi:
Veasita shete tabbeot zahab vesamta otam al-shene qetzot hachoshen al-sepato asher el-eber haepod bayeta
Vetabed tarten izqan didhab uteshavvi yatehon al teren sitre chushena al sipteh di leibra deepoda millegayv:
Veasita shete tabbeot zahab venatatta otam al-shete kitpot haepod millematta mimmul panayv leummat machbarto mimmaal lechesheb haepod
Vetabed tarten izqan didhab vetitten yatehon al tarten kitpe epoda millera milloqobel appohi loqobel bet lope meillave lehemyan epoda:
Veyirkesu et-hachoshen mittabbeotav el-tabbeot haepod biptil tekelet liheyot al-chesheb haepod velo-yizzach hachoshen meal haepod
Veyechdun yat chushena meizqeteh leizqeta deepoda bechuta ditkelta lemeheve al hemyan epoda vela yitpareq chushena meillave epoda:
Venasa aharon et-shemot bene-yisrael bechoshen hammishpat al-libbo beboo el-haqqodesh lezikkaron lipne-Adonai tamid
Veyittol aharon yat shemahat bene yisrael bechshen dina al libbeh bemealeh lequdesha ledukerana qodam Adonai tedira:
Venatatta el-choshen hammishpat et-haurim veet-hattummim vehayu al-leb aharon beboo lipne Adonai venasa aharon et-mishpat bene-yisrael al-libbo lipne Adonai tamid
Vetitten bechshen dina yat urayya veyat tummayya vihon al libba deaharon bemealeh qodam Adonai veyittol aharon yat dina dibne yisrael al libbeh qodam Adonai tedira:
Veasita et-meil haepod kelil tekelet
Vetabed yat meila deepoda gemir tikla:
Vehaya pi-rosho betoko sapa yiheyeh lepiv sabib maaseh oreg kepi tachra yiheyeh-lo lo yiqqarea
Vihe pum resheh kapil legavveh tora yehe maqqap lepumeh sechor sechor obad mache kepum shiryan yehe leh la yitbeza:
Veasita al-shvlayv rimmone tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani al-shvlayv sabib upaamone zahab betokam sabib
Vetabed al shipolohi rimmone tikla veargevana utzeba zehori al shipolohi sechor sechor vezaggin dedahaba benehon sechor sechor:
Paamon zahab verimmon paamon zahab verimmon al-shvle hammeil sabib
Zagga dedahaba verimmona zaga dedahaba verimona al shipole meila sechor sechor:
Vehaya al-aharon lesharet venishma qolo beboo el-haqqodesh lipne Adonai ubetzeto velo yamut
Vihe al aharon leshammasha veyishtema qaleh bemealeh lequdesha qodam Adonai ubemippeqeh vela yemut:
Veasita tzitz zahab tahor upittachta alayv pittuche chotam qodesh la-Adonai
Vetabed tzitza didhab deke vetiglop alohi ketab meparash qodesh layya:
Vesamta oto al-petil tekelet vehaya al-hammitznapet el-mvl pene-hammitznepet yihyeh
Uteshavvi yateh al chuta ditkelta vihe al mitznepta loqobel appe mitznepta yehe:
Vehaya al-metzach aharon venasa aharon et-avon haqqodashim asher yaqdishu bene yisrael lekol-mattenot qodshehem vehaya al-mitzcho tamid leratzon lahem lipne Adonai
Vihe al bet enohi deaharon veyittol aharon yat avayat qudeshayya di yeqaddeshun bene yisrael lekol mattenat qudeshehon vihe al bet enohi tedira leraava lehon qodam Adonai:
Veshibbatzta hakketonet shesh veasita mitznepet shesh veabnet taaseh maaseh roqem
Uterammetz kittuna butza vetabed mitznepta debutza vehemyana tabed obad tzayyar:
Velibne aharon taaseh kuttonot veasita lahem abnetim umigbaot taaseh lahem lekabod uletiparet
Velibne aharon tabed kittunin vetabed lehon hemyanin vekobain tabed lehon liqar uletushbechan:
Vehilbashta otam et-aharon achika veet-banayv itto umashachta otam umilleta et-yadam veqiddashta otam vekihanu li
Vetalbesh yatehon yat aharon achuk veyat benohi immeh uterabbe yatehon uteqareb yat qurbanhon uteqaddesh yatehon vishammeshun qodamay:
Vaaseh lahem miknese-bad lekassot besar erva mimmotnayim vead-yerekayim yihyu
Veibed lehon miknesin debutz lekassaa besar eryeta mechartzan vead yarkan yehon:
Vehayu al-aharon veal-banayv beboam el-ohel moed o begishtam el-hammizbeach lesharet baqqodesh velo-yisu avon vametu chuqqat olam lo ulezaro acharayv
Vihon al aharon veal benohi bemealhon lemashkan zimna o bemiqrabehon lemadbecha leshammasha bequdesha vela yeqabbelun choba vimutun qeyam alam leh velibnohi batrohi:
Vezeh haddabar asher-taaseh lahem leqaddesh otam lekahen li leqach par echad ben-baqar veelim shenayim temimim
Veden pitgama di tabed lehon leqaddasha yatehon leshammasha qodamay sab tor chad bar tore vedikrin teren shalmin:
Velechem matztzot vechallot matztzot belulot bashshemen ureqiqe matztzot meshuchim bashshamen solet chittim taaseh otam
Ulechem pattir ugeritzin pattirin depilan bimshach veespogin pattirin dimshichin bimshach sulta chittin tabed yatehon:
Venatatta otam al-sal echad vehiqrabta otam bassal veet-happar veet shene haelim
Vetitten yatehon al salla chad uteqareb yatehon besalla veyat tora veyat teren dikrin:
Veet-aharon veet-banayv taqrib el-petach ohel moed verachatzta otam bammayim
Veyat aharon veyat benohi teqareb litra mashkan zimna vetasche yatehon bemayya:
Velaqachta et-habbegadim vehilbashta et-aharon et-hakkuttonet veet meil haepod veet-haepod veet-hachoshen veapadta lo bechesheb haepod
Vetissab yat lebushayya vetalbesh yat aharon yat kittuna veyat meil epoda veyat epoda veyat chushena vetatqen leh behemyan epoda:
Vesamta hammitznepet al-rosho venatatta et-nezer haqqodesh al-hammitznapet
Uteshavvi mitznepta al resheh vetitten yat kelila dequdesha al mitznepta:
Velaqachta et-shemen hammishcha veyatzaqta al-rosho umashachta oto
Vetissab yat mishcha dirbuta uteriq al resheh uterabbi yateh:
Veet-banayv taqrib vehilbashtam kuttonot
Veyat benohi teqareb vetalbeshinnun kittunin:
Vechagarta otam abnet aharon ubanayv vechabashta lahem migbaot vehayeta lahem kehunna lechuqqat olam umilleta yad-aharon veyad-banayv
Utezarez yatehon hemyanin aharon ubenohi vetatqan lehon kobain utehe lehon kehunta liqyam alam uteqareb qurbana deaharon vequrbana dibnohi:
Vehiqrabta et-happar lipne ohel moed vesamak aharon ubanayv et-yedehem al-rosh happar
Uteqareb yat tora liqodam mashkan zimna veyismok aharon ubenohi yat yedehon al resh tora:
Veshachatta et-happar lipne Adonai petach ohel moed
Vetikkos yat tora qodam Adonai bitra mashkan zimna:
Velaqachta middam happar venatatta al-qarnot hammizbeach beetzbaeka veet-kol-haddam tishpok el-yesod hammizbeach
Vetissab middema detora vetitten al qarnat madbecha beetzbaak veyat kol dema teshod lisoda demadbecha:
Velaqachta et-kol-hacheleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veet hayyoteret al-hakkabed veet shete hakkelayot veet-hacheleb asher alehen vehiqtarta hammizbecha
Vetissab yat kol tarba dechape yat gavva veyat chitzra dial kabda veyat tarten kaleyan veyat tarba di alehen vetasseq lemadbecha:
Veet-besar happar veet-oro veet-pirsho tisrop baesh michutz lammachaneh chattat hu
Veyat bisra detora veyat mashkeh veyat ukeleh toqid benura mibbara lemashrita chattata hu:
Veet-haayil haechad tiqqach vesameku aharon ubanayv et-yedehem al-rosh haayil
Veyat dikra chad tissab veyismekun aharon ubenohi yat yedehon al resh dikra:
Veshachatta et-haayil velaqachta et-damo vezaraqta al-hammizbeach sabib
Vetikkos yat dikra vetissab yat demeh vetizroq al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet-haayil tenatteach lintachayv verachatzta qirbo ukeraayv venatatta al-netachayv veal-rosho
Veyat dikra tepalleg leebarohi utechallil gavveh ukeraohi vetitten al ebarohi veal resheh:
Vehiqtarta et-kol-haayil hammizbecha ola hu la-Adonai reach nichoach ishsheh la-Adonai hu
Vetasseq yat kol dikra lemadbecha alata hu qodam Adonai leitqabbala beraava qurbana qodam Adonai hu:
Velaqachta et haayil hashsheni vesamak aharon ubanayv et-yedehem al-rosh haayil
Vetissab yat dikra tinyana veyismok aharon ubenohi yat yedehon al resh dikra:

Veshachatta et-haayil velaqachta middamo venatatta al-tenuk ozen aharon veal-tenuk ozen banayv hayemanit veal-bohen yadam hayemanit veal-bohen raglam hayemanit vezaraqta et-haddam al-hammizbeach sabib

Vetikkos yat dikra vetissab midmeh vetitten al rum udena deaharon veal rum udena dibnohi deyammina veal ilyon yedehon deyammina veal ilyon raglehon deyammina vetizroq yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor:
Velaqachta min-haddam asher al-hammizbeach umishshemen hammishcha vehizzeta al-aharon veal-begadayv veal-banayv veal-bigde banayv itto veqadash hu ubegadayv ubanayv ubigde banayv itto
Vetissab min dema di al madbecha umimmishcha dirbuta vetadde al aharon veal lebushohi veal benohi veal lebushe benohi immeh veyitqaddash hu ulebushohi ubenohi ulebushe benohi immeh:
Velaqachta min-haayil hacheleb vehaalya veet-hacheleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veet yoteret hakkabed veet shete hakkelayot veet-hacheleb asher alehen veet shoq hayyamin ki el milluim hu
Vetissab min dikra tarba veallita veyat tarba dechape yat gavva veyat chatzar kabda veyat tarten kaleyan veyat tarba di alehen veyat shoqa deyammina are dekar qurbana hu:
Vekikkar lechem achat vechallat lechem shemen achat veraqiq echad missal hammatztzot asher lipne Adonai
Upitta dilchem chad ugeritzta dilchem meshach chada veespog chad missalla depattirayya di qodam Adonai:
Vesamta hakkol al kappe aharon veal kappe banayv vehenapta otam tenupa lipne Adonai
Uteshavvi kolla al yeda deaharon veal yeda dibnohi uterim yatehon aramuta qodam Adonai:
Velaqachta otam miyyadam vehiqtarta hammizbecha al-haola lereach nichoach lipne Adonai ishsheh hu la-Adonai
Vetissab yatehon midehon vetasseq lemadbecha al alata leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai qurbana hu qodam Adonai:
Velaqachta et-hechazeh meel hammilluim asher leaharon vehenapta oto tenupa lipne Adonai vehaya leka lemana
Vetissab yat chedya middekar qurbanayya di leaharon uterim yateh aramuta qodam Adonai vihe lak locholaq:
Veqiddashta et chazeh hattenupa veet shoq hatteruma asher hunap vaasher huram meel hammilluim measher leaharon umeasher lebanayv
Uteqaddesh yat chedya daaramuta veyat shoqa deaprashuta di ittaram vedi ittaprash middekar qurbanayya middi leaharon umiddi libnohi:
Vehaya leaharon ulebanayv lechoq-olam meet bene yisrael ki teruma hu uteruma yihyeh meet bene-yisrael mizzibche shalmehem terumatam la-Adonai
Vihe leaharon velibnohi liqyam alam min bene yisrael are aprashuta hu veaprashuta yehe min bene yisrael minniksat qudeshehon aprashutehon qodam Adonai:
Ubigde haqqodesh asher leaharon yihyu lebanayv acharayv lemoshcha bahem ulemalle-bam et-yadam
Ulebushe qudesha di leaharon yehon libnohi batrohi ledakkaa behon uleqaraba behon yat qurbanehon:
Shibat yamim yilbasham hakkohen tachtayv mibbanayv asher yabo el-ohel moed lesharet baqqodesh
Shibat yomin yalbeshinnun kahana techotohi mibbenohi di yeol lemashkan zimna leshammasha bequdesha:
Veet el hammilluim tiqqach ubishshalta et-besaro bemaqom qadosh
Veyat dekar qurbanayya tissab utebashshel yat bisreh baatar qaddish:
Veakal aharon ubanayv et-besar haayil veet-hallechem asher bassal petach ohel moed
Veyekul aharon ubenohi yat besar dikra veyat lachma di besalla litra mashkan zimna:
Veoklu otam asher kuppar bahem lemalle et-yadam leqaddesh otam vezar lo-yokal ki-qodesh hem
Veyekelun yatehon di yitkappar behon leqaraba yat qurbanehon leqaddasha yatehon vechillonay la yekul are qudesha innun:
Veim-yivvater mibbesar hammilluim umin-hallechem ad-habboqer vesarapta et-hannotar baesh lo yeakel ki-qodesh hu
Veim yishtaar mibbesar qurbanayya umin lachma ad tzapra vetoqid yat deishtaar benura la yitakel are qudesha hu:
Veasita leaharon ulebanayv kaka kekol asher-tzivviti otaka shibat yamim temalle yadam
Vetabed leaharon velibnohi keden kekol di paqqedit yatak shibat yomin teqareb qurbanehon:
Upar chattat taaseh layyom al-hakkippurim vechitteta al-hammizbeach bekapperka alayv umashachta oto leqaddesho
Vetora dechattata tabed leyoma al kippurayya utedakke al madbecha bekapparutak alohi uterabbe yateh leqaddashuteh:
Shibat yamim tekapper al-hammizbeach veqiddashta oto vehaya hammizbeach qodesh qodashim kol-hannogea bammizbeach yiqdash
Shibat yomin tekapper al madbecha uteqaddesh yateh vihe madbecha qodesh qudeshayya kol deyiqrab bemadbecha yitqaddash:
Vezeh asher taaseh al-hammizbeach kebasim bene-shana shenayim layyom tamid
Veden di tabed al madbecha immerin bene shena teren leyoma tedira:
Et-hakkebes haechad taaseh babboqer veet hakkebes hashsheni taaseh ben haarbayim
Yat immera chad tabed betzapra veyat imra tinyana tabed ben shimshayya:
Veissaron solet balul beshemen katit reba hahin venesek rebiit hahin yayin lakkebes haechad
Veisrona sulta depila bimshach katisha rabut hina veniska rabut hina chamra leimra chad:
Veet hakkebes hashsheni taaseh ben haarbayim keminchat habboqer ukeniskah taaseh-lah lereach nichoach ishsheh la-Adonai
Veyat imra tinyana tabed ben shimshayya keminchat tzapra ukeniskah tabed lah leitqabbala beraava qurbana qodam Adonai:
Olat tamid ledorotekem petach ohel-moed lipne Adonai asher ivvaed lakem shamma ledabber eleka sham
Alata tedira ledarekon bitra mashkan zimna qodam Adonai diezammen memeri lekon tamman lemallala immak tamman:
Venoadti shamma libne yisrael veniqdash bikbodi
Veezammen memeri tamman libne yisrael veyitqaddash biqari:
Veqiddashti et-ohel moed veet-hammizbeach veet-aharon veet-banayv aqaddesh lekahen li
Veeqaddesh yat mashkan zimna veyat madbecha veyat aharon veyat benohi eqaddesh leshammasha qodamay:
Veshakanti betok bene yisrael vehayiti lahem lelohim
Veashre shekinti bego bene yisrael veeheve lehon leelah:
Veyadeu ki ani Adonai elohehem asher hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim leshokni betokam ani Adonai elohehem
Veyiddeun are ana Adonai elahahon di appeqit yatehon meara demitzrayim leashraa shekinti benehon ana Adonai elahahon:
Veasita mizbeach miqtar qetoret atze shittim taaseh oto
Vetabed madbecha leaqtara alohi qetoret busemayya deae shittin tabed yateh:
Amma orko veamma rochbo rabua yihyeh veammatayim qomato mimmennu qarnotayv
Ammeta urkeh veammeta petayeh merabba yehe vetarten ammin rumeh minneh qarnohi:
Vetzippita oto zahab tahor et-gaggo veet-qirotayv sabib veet-qarnotayv veasita lo zer zahab sabib
Vetachape yateh dehab deke yat iggareh veyat katelohi sechor sechor veyat qarnohi vetabed leh der didhab sechor sechor:
Ushete tabbeot zahab taaseh-lo mittachat lezero al shete tzalotayv taaseh al-shene tziddayv vehaya lebattim lebaddim laset oto bahemma
Vetarten izqan didhab tabed leh millera ledereh al tarten zivyateh tabed al teren sitrohi vihe leatra laarichayya lemittal yateh behon:
Veasita et-habbaddim atze shittim vetzippita otam zahab
Vetabed yat arichayya deae shittin vetachape yatehon dahaba:
Venatatta oto lipne happaroket asher al-aron haedut lipne hakkapporet asher al-haedut asher ivvaed leka shamma
Vetitten yateh qodam parukta di al arona desahaduta liqodam kappurta di al sahaduta di azammen memeri lak tamman:
Vehiqtir alayv aharon qetoret sammim babboqer babboqer behetibo et-hannerot yaqtirenna
Veyaqtar alohi aharon qetoret busemin bitzpar bitzpar beatqanuteh yat botzinayya yasseqinnah:
Ubehaalot aharon et-hannerot ben haarbayim yaqtirenna qetoret tamid lipne Adonai ledorotekem
Ubeadlaqut aharon yat botzinayya ben shimshayya yasseqinnah qetoret busemayya tedira qodam Adonai ledarekon:
Lo-taalu alayv qetoret zara veola umincha venesek lo tisseku alayv
La tassequn alohi qetoret busemin nukerain vaalata uminchata veniska la tenassekun alohi:
Vekipper aharon al-qarnotayv achat bashshana middam chattat hakkippurim achat bashshana yekapper alayv ledorotekem qodesh-qodashim hu la-Adonai
Vikapper aharon al qarnohi chada beshatta middema chattat kippurayya chada beshatta yekapper alohi ledarekon qodesh qudeshin hu qodam Adonai:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Ki tissa et-rosh bene-yisrael lipqudehem venatenu ish koper napsho la-Adonai bipqod otam velo-yihyeh bahem negep bipqod otam
Are teqabbel yat chushban bene yisrael leminyanehon veyittenun gebar purqan napsheh qodam Adonai kad timne yatehon vela yehe behon mota kad timne yatehon:
Zeh yittenu kol-haober al-happequdim machatzit hashsheqel besheqel haqqodesh esrim gera hashsheqel machatzit hashsheqel teruma la-Adonai
Den yittenun kol deabar al minyanayya palgut sila besile qudesha esrin main sila palgut sila aprashuta qodam Adonai:
Kol haober al-happequdim mibben esrim shana vamaela yitten terumat Adonai
Kol deabar al minyanayya mibbar esrin shenin uleella yitten aprashuta qodam Adonai:
Heashir lo-yarbeh vehaddal lo yamit mimmachatzit hashshaqel latet et-terumat Adonai lekapper al-napshotekem
Deattir la yasge udemisken la yazer mippalgut sila lemittan yat aprashuta qodam Adonai lekappara al napshatekon:
Velaqachta et-kesep hakkippurim meet bene yisrael venatatta oto al-abodat ohel moed vehaya libne yisrael lezikkaron lipne Adonai lekapper al-napshotekem
Vetissab yat kesap kippurayya min bene yisrael vetitten yateh al palechan mashkan zimna vihe libne yisrael ledakerana qodam Adonai lekappara al napshatekon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Veasita kiyyor nechoshet vekanno nechoshet lerochtza venatatta oto ben-ohel moed uben hammizbeach venatatta shamma mayim
Vetabed kiyyora dinchasha ubesiseh nechasha leqiddush vetitten yateh ben mashkan zimna uben madbecha vetitten tamman mayya:
Verachatzu aharon ubanayv mimmennu et-yedehem veet-raglehem
Viqaddeshun aharon ubenohi minneh yat yedehon veyat raglehon:
Beboam el-ohel moed yirchatzu-mayim velo yamutu o begishtam el-hammizbeach lesharet lehaqtir ishsheh la-Adonai
Bemealhon lemashkan zimna yeqaddeshun mayya vela yemutun o bemiqrabehon lemadbecha leshammasha leassaqa qurbana qodam Adonai:
Verachatzu yedehem veraglehem velo yamutu vehayeta lahem choq-olam lo ulezaro ledorotam
Viqaddeshun yedehon veraglehon vela yemutun utehe lehon qeyam alam leh velibnohi ledarehon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Veatta qach-leka besamim rosh mor-deror chamesh meot veqinnemon-besem machatzito chamishshim umatayim uqeneh-bosem chamishshim umatayim
Veat sab lak busemin resha mera dakya matqal chamesh mea veqinneman besem palguteh matqal matan vechamshin uqeneh busema matqal matan vechamshin:
Veqidda chamesh meot besheqel haqqodesh veshemen zayit hin
Uqetziata matqal chamesh mea besile qudesha umeshach zeta mele hina:
Veasita oto shemen mishchat-qodesh roqach mirqachat maaseh roqeach shemen mishchat-qodesh yihyeh
Vetabed yateh meshach rebut qudesha bosem mebassam obad busemanu meshach rebut qudesha yehe:
Umashachta bo et-ohel moed veet aron haedut
Uterabbi beh yat mashkan zimna veyat arona desahaduta:
Veet-hashshulchan veet-kol-kelayv veet-hammenora veet-keleha veet mizbach haqqetoret
Veyat patora veyat kol manohi veyat menarta veyat manaha veyat madbecha diqtoret busemayya:
Veet-mizbach haola veet-kol-kelayv veet-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Veyat madbach daalata veyat kol manohi veyat kiyyora veyat besiseh:
Veqiddashta otam vehayu qodesh qodashim kol-hannogea bahem yiqdash
Uteqaddesh yatehon vihon qodesh qudeshayya kol deyiqrab behon yitqaddash:
Veet-aharon veet-banayv timshach veqiddashta otam lekahen li
Veyat aharon veyat benohi terabbi uteqaddesh yatehon leshammasha qodamay:
Veel-bene yisrael tedabber lemor shemen mishchat-qodesh yihyeh zeh li ledorotekem
Veim bene yisrael temallel lememar meshach rebut qudesha yehe den qodamay ledarekon:
Al-besar adam lo yisak ubematkunto lo taasu kamohu qodesh hu qodesh yihyeh lakem
Al bisra daanasha la yitnassak ubidmuteh la tabedun kevateh qudesha hu qudesha yehe lekon:
Ish asher yirqach kamohu vaasher yitten mimmennu al-zar venikrat meammayv
Gebar di yebassam dikvateh vedi yitten minneh al chillonay veyishtetze meammeh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh qach-leka sammim natap ushechelet vechelbena sammim ulebona zakka bad bebad yihyeh
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh sab lak busemin netopa vetupera vechelbeneta busemin ulebuneta dakita matqal bematqal yehe:
Veasita otah qetoret roqach maaseh roqeach memullach tahor qodesh
Vetabed yatah qetoret busemin bosem obad busemanu mearab deke qudesha:
Veshachaqta mimmenna hadeq venatatta mimmenna lipne haedut beohel moed asher ivvaed leka shamma qodesh qodashim tihyeh lakem
Vetishchoq minnah vetaddiq vetitten minnah qodam sahaduta bemashkan zimna di ezammen memeri lak tamman qodesh qudeshin tehe lekon:
Vehaqqetoret asher taaseh bematkuntah lo taasu lakem qodesh tihyeh leka la-Adonai
Uqetoret busemin di tabed bidmutah la tabedun lekon qudesha tehe lak qodam Adonai:
Ish asher-yaaseh kamoha lehariach bah venikrat meammayv
Gebar deyabed dikvatah laaracha bah veyishtetze meammeh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Reeh qarati beshem betzalel ben-vri ben-chvr lematteh yehuda
Chaze derabbeti beshum betzalel bar uri bar chur leshibta dihuda:
Vaamalle oto ruach elohim bechokma ubitbuna ubedaat ubekol-melaka
Veashlemit immeh ruach min qodam Adonai bechokmeta ubesukeletanu ubemadda ubekol ibida:
Lachshob machashabot laasot bazzahab ubakkesep ubannechoshet
Leallapa umanvan lemebad bedahaba ubekaspa ubinchasha:
Ubacharoshet eben lemallot ubacharoshet etz laasot bekol-melaka
Ubeamanut eben taba leashlama ubenaggarut aa lemebad bekol ibida:
Vaani hinneh natatti itto et oholiab ben-achisamak lematteh-dan ubeleb kol-chakam-leb natatti chokma veasu et kol-asher tzivvitika
Vaana ha yehabit immeh yat oholiab bar achisamak leshibta dedan ubelibba kol chakkime libba yehabit chokmeta veyabedun yat kol di paqedittak:
Et ohel moed veet-haaron laedut veet-hakkapporet asher alayv veet kol-kele haohel
Yat mashkan zimna veyat arona lesahaduta veyat kappurta di alohi veyat kol mane mashkena:
Veet-hashshulchan veet-kelayv veet-hammenora hattehora veet-kol-keleha veet mizbach haqqetoret
Veyat patora veyat manohi veyat menarta dakita veyat kol manaha veyat madbecha diqtoret busemaya:
Veet-mizbach haola veet-kol-kelayv veet-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Veyat madbecha daalata veyat kol manohi veyat kiyora veyat besiseh:
Veet bigde hasserad veet-bigde haqqodesh leaharon hakkohen veet-bigde banayv lekahen
Veyat lebushe shimusha veyat lebushe qudesha leaharon kahana veyat lebushe benohi leshammasha:
Veet shemen hammishcha veet-qetoret hassammim laqqodesh kekol asher-tzivvitika yaasu
Veyat mishcha dirbuta veyat qetoret busemayya lequdesha kekol di paqqedetak yabedun:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh lememar:
Veatta dabber el-bene yisrael lemor ak et-shabbetotay tishmoru ki ot hiv beni ubenekem ledorotekem ladaat ki ani Adonai meqaddishkem
Veat mallel im bene yisrael lememar beram yat yome shabbayya di li titterun are at hi ben memeri ubenekon ledarekon lemidda are ana Adonai meqaddishkon:
Ushemartem et-hashshabbat ki qodesh hiv lakem mechaleleha mot yumat ki kol-haoseh bah melaka venikreta hannepesh hahiv miqqereb ammeha
Vetitterun yat shabbeta are qudesha hi lekon mechallelinnah itqetala yitqetel are kol deyabed bah ibida veyishtetze anasha hahu miggo ammeh:
Sheshet yamim yeaseh melaka ubayyom hashshebii shabbat shabbaton qodesh la-Adonai kol-haoseh melaka beyom hashshabbat mot yumat
Shitta yomin yitabed ibida ubeyoma shebiaa shebat shabbeta qudesha qodam Adonai kol deyabed ibidta beyoma deshabbeta itqetala yitqetel:
Veshameru bene-yisrael et-hashshabbat laasot et-hashshabbat ledorotam berit olam
Veyitterun bene yisrael yat shabbeta lemebad yat shabbeta ledarehon qeyam alam:
Beni uben bene yisrael ot hiv leolam ki-sheshet yamim asa Adonai et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz ubayyom hashshebii shabat vayyinnapash
Ben memeri uben bene yisrael at hi lealam are shitta yomin abad Adonai yat shemayya veyat ara ubeyoma shebiaa shebat venach:
Vayyitten el-mosheh kekalloto ledabber itto behar sinay shene luchot haedut luchot eben ketubim beetzba elohim
Vihab lemsheh kad shetze lemallala immeh betura desinay teren luche sahaduta luche abna ketibin beetzbea daAdonai:

Vayyar haam ki-boshesh mosheh laredet min-hahar vayyiqqahel haam al-aharon vayyomeru elayv qum aseh-lanu elohim asher yeleku lepanenu ki-zeh mosheh haish asher heelanu meeretz mitzrayim lo yadanu meh-haya lo
Vachaza amma are ochar msheh lemechat min tura veitkenesh amma al aharon vaamaru leh qum abed lana dachalan diyhakun qodamana are den msheh gabra di asseqana meara demitzrayim la yedana ma hava leh:
Vayyomer alehem aharon parequ nizme hazzahab asher beozne neshekem benekem ubenotekem vehabiu elay
Vaamar lehon aharon periqu qadashe dedahaba di beudene neshekon benekon ubenatekon veaytiyyu levati:
Vayyitparequ kol-haam et-nizme hazzahab asher beoznehem vayyabiu el-aharon
Veitperiqu kol amma yat qadashe dedahaba di beudenehon veaytiyyu leaharon:
Vayyiqqach miyyadam vayyatzar oto bacheret vayyaasehu egel masseka vayyomeru elleh eloheka yisrael asher heeluka meeretz mitzrayim
Unesib midehon vetzar yateh bezipa veabedeh egel matteka vaamaru illen dachaltak yisrael di assequk meara demitzrayim:
Vayyar aharon vayyiben mizbeach lepanayv vayyiqra aharon vayyomar chag la-Adonai machar
Vachaza aharon ubena madbecha qodamohi uqera aharon vaamar chagga qodam Adonai mechar:
Vayyashkimu mimmochorat vayyaalu olot vayyaggishu shelamim vayyesheb haam leekol veshato vayyaqumu letzacheq
Veaqdimu beyoma debatrohi veassiqu alavan veqaribu niksin veaschar amma lemekal ulemishte veqamu lechayyaka:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lek-red ki shichet ammeka asher heeleta meeretz mitzrayim
Umallil Adonai im msheh izel chut are chabbil ammak di asseqta meara demitzrayim:
Saru maher min-hadderek asher tzivvitim asu lahem egel masseka vayyishtachavu-lo vayyizbechu-lo vayyomeru elleh eloheka yisrael asher heeluka meeretz mitzrayim
Satu bipria min orecha di paqqedtinnun abadu lehon egal matteka usegidu leh vedabbachu leh vaamaru illen dachaltak yisrael di assequk meara demitzrayim:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh raiti et-haam hazzeh vehinneh am-qesheh-orep hu
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh gele qodamay amma haden veha amma qeshe qedal hu:
Veatta hannicha li veyichar-appi bahem vaakallem veeeseh oteka legoy gadol
Ukean hannach bautak min qodamay veyitqep rugezi behon veeshetzinnun veebed yatak leam saggi:
Vayechal mosheh et-pene Adonai elohayv vayyomer lama Adonai yechereh appeka beammeka asher hotzeta meeretz mitzrayim bekoach gadol ubeyad chazaqa
Vetzalli msheh qodam Adonai elaheh vaamar lema Adonai yitqep rugezak beammak di appeqta meara demitzrayim bechel rab ubida taqqipa:
Lamma yomeru mitzrayim lemor beraa hotziam laharog otam beharim ulekallotam meal pene haadama shub mecharon appeka vehinnachem al-haraa leammeka
Lema yemerun mitzrae lememar bebisheta appeqtinnun leqattala yatehon bene turayya uleshetzayutehon meal appe ara tub mitteqop rugezak veateb min bisheta demellelta lemebad leammak:
Zekor leabraham leyitzchaq uleyisrael abadeka asher nishbata lahem bak vattedabber alehem arbeh et-zarakem kekokebe hashshamayim vekol-haaretz hazzot asher amarti etten lezarakem venachalu leolam
Idkar leabraham leyitzchaq uleyisrael abdayk di qayyemta lehon bememerak umallelta immehon asge yat benekon kekokebe shemayya vekol ara hada di amarit etten libnekon veyachsenun laalam:
Vayyinnachem Adonai al-haraa asher dibber laasot leammo
Vetab Adonai min bisheta di mallel lemebad leammeh:
Vayyipen vayyered mosheh min-hahar ushene luchot haedut beyado luchot ketubim mishshene ebrehem mizzeh umizzeh hem ketubim
Veitpene unechat msheh min tura uteren luche sahaduta bideh luche ketibin mitteren ibrehon mikka umikka innun ketibin:
Vehalluchot maaseh elohim hemma vehammiktab miktab elohim hu charut al-halluchot
Veluchayya obada daAdonai innun uketaba ketaba daAdonai hu meparash al luchayya:
Vayyishma yehoshua et-qol haam bereoh vayyomer el-mosheh qol milchama bammachaneh
Ushema yehoshua yat qal amma kad meyabbebin vaamar lemsheh qal qeraba bemashrita:
Vayyomer en qol anot gebura veen qol anot chalusha qol annot anoki shomea
Vaamar la qal gibbarin denatzchin biqraba veap la qal challashin demittabberin qal dimchayyekin ana shema:
Vayehi kaasher qarab el-hammachaneh vayyar et-haegel umecholot vayyichar-ap mosheh vayyashlek miyyadav et-halluchot vayeshabber otam tachat hahar
Vahava kad qarib lemashrita vachaza yat egla vechingin uteqep rugeza demsheh urema midohi yat luchayya vetabbar yatehon beshippole tura:
Vayyiqqach et-haegel asher asu vayyisrop baesh vayyitchan ad asher-daq vayyizer al-pene hammayim vayyashq et-bene yisrael
Uneseb yat egla di abadu veoqed benura veshap ad dahava daqqiq uzera al appe mayya veashqe yat bene yisrael:
Vayyomer mosheh el-aharon meh-asa leka haam hazzeh ki-hebeta alayv chataa gedola
Vaamar msheh leaharon ma abad lak amma haden are ayteta alohi choba rabba:
Vayyomer aharon al-yichar ap adoni atta yadata et-haam ki bera hu
Vaamar aharon la yitqep rugeza deribboni at yedaat yat amma are bebish hu:
Vayyomeru li aseh-lanu elohim asher yeleku lepanenu ki-zeh mosheh haish asher heelanu meeretz mitzrayim lo yadanu meh-haya lo
Vaamaru li ibed lana dachalan di yehakan qodamana are den msheh gabra di asseqana meara demitzrayim la yedana mah hava leh:
Vaomar lahem lemi zahab hitparaqu vayyittenu-li vaashlikehu baesh vayyetze haegel hazzeh
Vaamarit lehon leman dahaba pariqu vihabu li uremiteh benura unepaq egla haden:
Vayyar mosheh et-haam ki parua hu ki-peraoh aharon leshimtza beqamehem
Vachaza msheh yat amma are betil hu are batelinnun aharon laasabutehon shum bish ledarehon:
Vayyaamod mosheh beshaar hammachaneh vayyomer mi la-Adonai elay vayyeasepu elayv kol-bene levi
Veqam msheh bitra mashrita vaamar man dachalayya daAdonai yetun levati veitkannashu levateh kol bene levi:
Vayyomer lahem koh-amar Adonai elohe yisrael simu ish-charbo al-yereko ibru vashubu mishshaar lashaar bammachaneh vehirgu ish-et-achiv veish et-reehu veish et-qerobo
Vaamar lehon kidnan amar Adonai elaha deyisrael shavvu gebar charbeh al yarkeh ibaru vetubu mittera litra bemashrita uqetulu gebar yat achuhi ugebar yat chabreh veenash yat qaribeh:
Vayyaasu bene-levi kidbar mosheh vayyippol min-haam bayyom hahu kishloshet alpe ish
Vaabadu bene levi kepitgama demsheh unepal min amma beyoma hahu kitlata alpin gabra:
Vayyomer mosheh milu yedkem hayyom la-Adonai ki ish bibno ubeachiv velatet alekem hayyom beraka
Vaamar msheh qaribu yedkon qurbana yoma den qodam Adonai are gebar bibreh ubeachuhi uleaytaa alekon yoma den birkan:
Vayehi mimmochorat vayyomer mosheh el-haam attem chatatem chataa gedola veatta eeleh el-Adonai ulay akappera bead chattatkem
Vahava beyoma debatrohi vaamar msheh leamma attun chabtun choba rabba ukean essaq qodam Adonai maim akapper al chobekon:
Vayyashob mosheh el-Adonai vayyomar anna chata haam hazzeh chataa gedola vayyaasu lahem elohe zahab
Vetab msheh liqodam Adonai vaamar bebau chab amma haden choba rabba vaabadu lehon dachalan didhab:
Veatta im-tissa chattatam veim-ayin mecheni na missipreka asher katabeta
Ukean im shabqat lechobehon veim la mecheni kean missiprak di ketabta:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh mi asher chata-li emchennu missipri
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh man di chab qodamay emchinneh misipri:
Veatta lek necheh et-haam el asher-dibbarti lak hinneh malaki yelek lepaneka ubeyom poqdi upaqadti alehem chattatam
Ukean izzel dabbar yat amma laatar di mallelit lak ha malaki yehak qodamak ubeyom asaruti veasar alehon chobehon:
Vayyiggop Adonai et-haam al asher asu et-haegel asher asa aharon
Umecha Adonai yat amma al di ishtabadu leegla di abad aharon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lek aleh mizzeh atta vehaam asher heelita meeretz mitzrayim el-haaretz asher nishbati leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob lemor lezaraka ettenenna
Umallil Adonai im msheh izzel saq mikka at veamma deasseqta meara demitzrayim leara di qayyemit leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob lememar libnayk etteninnah:
Veshalachti lepaneka malak vegerashti et-hakkenaani haemori vehachitti vehapperizzi hachivvi vehayebusi
Veeshlach qodamak malaka veetarek yat kenaanae emorae vechittae uperizzae chivvae vibusae:
El-eretz zabat chalab udebash ki lo eeleh beqirbeka ki am-qesheh-orep atta pen-akelka baddarek
Leara abda chalab udebash are la asalleq shekinti mibbenak are am qeshe qedal at dilema ashetzinnak beorcha:
Vayyishma haam et-haddabar hara hazzeh vayyitabbalu velo-shatu ish edyo alayv
Ushema amma yat pitgama bisha haden veitabbalu vela shavviyu gebar tiqqun zeneh alohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh emor el-bene-yisrael attem am-qesheh-orep rega echad eeleh beqirbeka vekillitika veatta hored edyeka mealeka veedea ma eeseh-lak
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh emar libne yisrael attun am qeshe qedal shaa chada asalleq shekinti mibbenak veeshetzinnak ukean adi tiqqun zenak minnak ugele qodamay ma abed lak:
Vayyitenatztzelu bene-yisrael et-edyam mehar choreb
Veadiu bene yisrael yat tiqqun zenehon mittura dechoreb:
Umosheh yiqqach et-haohel venata-lo michutz lammachaneh harcheq min-hammachaneh veqara lo ohel moed vehaya kol-mebaqqesh Adonai yetze el-ohel moed asher michutz lammachaneh
Umsheh nesib yat mashkena uparseh leh mibbara lemashrita archeq min mashrita veqare leh mashkan bet ulepana vihe kol detaba ulepan min qodam Adonai nepaq lemashkan bet ulepana mibbara lemashrita:
Vehaya ketzet mosheh el-haohel yaqumu kol-haam venitztzebu ish petach oholo vehibbitu achare mosheh ad-boo haohela
Vahava kad nepaq msheh lemashkena qayyemin kol amma umitattedin gebar bitra mashkena umistakkelin achore msheh ad dealel lemashkena:
Vehaya kebo mosheh haohela yered ammud heanan veamad petach haohel vedibber im-mosheh
Vahava kad alel msheh lemashkena nachit ammuda daanana veqaem bitra mashkena umitmallel im msheh:
Veraa kol-haam et-ammud heanan omed petach haohel veqam kol-haam vehishetachavu ish petach oholo
Vachazan kol amma yat ammuda daanana qaem bitra mashkena veqayyemin kol amma vesagedin gebar bitra mashkeneh:
Vedibber Adonai el-mosheh panim el-panim kaasher yedabber ish el-reehu veshab el-hammachaneh umeshareto yehoshua bin-nvn naar lo yamish mittok haohel
Umitmallel Adonai im msheh mamlal im mamlal kema dimmallel gebar im chabreh vetab lemashrita umeshumeshaneh yehoshua bar nun ulema la ade miggo mashkena:
Vayyomer mosheh el-Adonai reeh atta omer elay haal et-haam hazzeh veatta lo hodatani et asher-tishlach immi veatta amarta yedatika beshem vegam-matzata chen beenay
Vaamar msheh qodam Adonai chaze deat amar li asseq yat amma haden veat la hodatani yat di tishlach immi veat amart rabbitak beshum veap ashkachta rachamin qodamay:
Veatta im-na matzati chen beeneka hodieni na et-derakeka veedaaka lemaan emtza-chen beeneka ureeh ki ammeka haggoy hazzeh
Ukean im kean ashkachit rachamin qodamak hodani kean yat orach tubak veidda rachamak bedil deashkach rachamin qodamak ugele qadamak are ammak amma haden:
Vayyomar panay yeleku vahanichoti lak
Vaamar shekinti tehak veaniach lak:
Vayyomer elayv im-en paneka holekim al-taalenu mizzeh
Vaamar qodamohi im let shekintak mehalleka benana la tasqinana mikka:
Ubammeh yivvada epo ki-matzati chen beeneka ani veammeka halo belekteka immanu veniplinu ani veammeka mikkol-haam asher al-pene haadama
Ubammeh yityadda haka are ashkachit rachamin qodamak ana veammak hala bemehak shekintak immana veyitabbedan lana perishan li uleammak meshanne mikkol amma di al appe ara:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh gam et-haddabar hazzeh asher dibbarta eeseh ki-matzata chen beenay vaedaaka beshem
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ap yat pitgama haden di mallelta ebed are ashkachta rachamin qodamay verabbitak beshum:
Vayyomar hareni na et-kebodeka
Vaamar achazeni kean yat yeqarak:
Vayyomer ani aabir kol-tvbi al-paneka veqarati beshem Adonai lepaneka vechannoti et-asher achon verichamti et-asher arachem
Vaamar ana abar kol tubi al appayk veeqre bishma daAdonai qodamak veechon leman deechon veerachem al man deerachem:
Vayyomer lo tukal lirot et-panay ki lo-yirani haadam vachay
Vaamar la tikul lemecheze yat appe shekinti are la yechezinani enasha veyitqayyam:
Vayyomer Adonai hinneh maqom itti venitztzabta al-hatztzur
Vaamar Adonai ha atar matqan qodamay vetitattad al tinnara:
Vehaya baabor kebodi vesamtika beniqrat hatztzur vesakkoti kappi aleka ad-obri
Vihe bemeabar yeqari veeshavvinak bimarat tinnara veagen bememeri alak ad deeebar:
Vahasiroti et-kappi veraita et-achoray upanay lo yerau
Veade yat dibrat yeqari vetecheze yat debatray vediqodamay la yitchazun:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh pesol-leka shene-luchot abanim karishonim vekatabti al-halluchot et-haddebarim asher hayu al-halluchot harishonim asher shibbarta
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh pesal lak teren luche abnayya keqadmae veektob al luchayya yat pitgamayya di havo al luchayya qadmae di tebarta:
Vehyeh nakon labboqer vealita babboqer el-har sinay venitztzabta li sham al-rosh hahar
Veheve zammin letzapra vetissaq betzapra letura desinay vetitattad qodamay tamman al resh tura:
Veish lo-yaaleh immak vegam-ish al-yera bekol-hahar gam-hatztzon vehabbaqar al-yiru el-mvl hahar hahu
Veenash la yissaq immak veap enash la yitchaze bekol tura ap ana vetore la yirun loqobel tura hahu:
Vayyipsol shene-luchot abanim karishonim vayyashkem mosheh babboqer vayyaal el-har sinay kaasher tzivva Adonai oto vayyiqqach beyado shene luchot abanim
Upesal teren luche abnayya keqadmae veaqdem msheh betzapra useleq letura desinay kema depaqqed Adonai yateh uneseb bideh teren luche abnayya:
Vayyered Adonai beanan vayyityatztzeb immo sham vayyiqra beshem Adonai
Veitgeli Adonai baanana veitattad immeh tamman uqera bishma daAdonai:
Vayyaabor Adonai al-panayv vayyiqra Adonai Adonai el rachum vechannun erek appayim verab-chesed veemet
Veabar Adonai shekinteh al appohi uqera Adonai Adonai elaha rachamana vechannana marchiq regaz umasge lemebad tabvan uqeshot:
Notzer chesed laalapim nose avon vapesha vechattaa venaqqeh lo yenaqqeh poqed avon abot al-banim veal-bene banim al-shilleshim veal-ribbeim
Natar tibu lealpe darin shabeq laavayan velimrod ulechobin salach lidtaybin leorayteh velidla taybin la mezakke masar chobe abahan al benin veal bene benin maradin al dar telitay veal dar rebiay:
Vayemaher mosheh vayyiqqod artza vayyishtachu
Veochi msheh ukera al ara usegid:
Vayyomer im-na matzati chen beeneka adonay yelek-na adonay beqirbenu ki am-qesheh-orep hu vesalachta laavonenu ulechattatenu unechaltanu
Vaamar im kean ashkachit rachamin qodamak Adonai tehak kean shekinta daAdonai benana are am qeshe qedal hu vetishboq lechobana velachataana vetachsenana:
Vayyomer hinneh anoki koret berit neged kol-ammeka eeseh niplaot asher lo-nibreu bekol-haaretz ubekol-haggoyim veraa kol-haam asher-atta beqirbo et-maaseh Adonai ki-nora hu asher ani oseh immak
Vaamar ha ana gezar qeyam qodam kol ammak aabbed perishan di la itberiu bekol ara ubekol ammayya veyecheze kol amma di at benehon yat obada daAdonai are dachel hu di ana abed immak:
Shemor-leka et asher anoki metzavveka hayyom hinni goresh mippaneka et-haemori vehakkenaani vehachitti vehapperizzi vehachivvi vehayebusi
Tar lak yat di ana mepaqdak yoma den ha ana metarek min qodamak yat emorae ukenaanae vechittae uperizzae vechivvae vibusae:
Hishshamer leka pen-tikrot berit leyosheb haaretz asher atta ba aleha pen-yihyeh lemoqesh beqirbeka
Istammar lak dilema tigzar qeyam leyateb ara di at alel alah dilema yehe letaqla benak:
Ki et-mizbechotam tittotzun veet-matztzebotam teshabberun veet-asherayv tikrotun
Are yat agorehon tetarun veyat qamathon tetabberun veyat asherehon teqatztzetzun:
Ki lo tishetachaveh leel acher ki Adonai qanna shemo el qanna hu
Are la tisgod letaavat ammayya are Adonai qanna shemeh el qanna hu:
Pen-tikrot berit leyosheb haaretz vezanu achare elohehem vezabechu lelohehem veqara leka veakalta mizzibcho
Dilema tigzar qeyam leyateb ara veyitun batar taavathon veyidbechun letaavathon veyiqrun lak vetekul middibchehon:
Velaqachta mibbenotayv lebaneka vezanu benotayv achare elohehen vehiznu et-baneka achare elohehen
Vetissab mibbenathon libnayk veyitayyan benathon batar taavathon veyitayyan yat benayk batar taavathon:
Elohe masseka lo taaseh-lak
Dachalan dematka la tabed lak:
Et-chag hammatztzot tishmor shibat yamim tokal matztzot asher tzivvitika lemoed chodesh haabib ki bechodesh haabib yatzata mimmitzrayim
Yat chagga depattirayya tittar shiba yomin tekul pattira kema di paqqedetak lizman yarcha deabbiba are beyarcha deabbiba nepaqta mimmitzrayim:
Kol-peter rechem li vekol-miqneka tizzakar peter shor vaseh
Kol patach valeda dili vekol beirak dikrin taqdesh bekor tor veimar:
Upeter chamor tipdeh beseh veim-lo tipdeh vaarapto kol bekor baneka tipdeh velo-yerau panay reqam
Ubukera dachamara tiproq beimera veim la tiproq vetanqepeh kol bukera dibnayk tiproq vela yitchazun qodamay reqanin:
Sheshet yamim taabod ubayyom hashshebii tishbot becharish ubaqqatzir tishbot
Shitta yomin tiplach ubeyoma shebiaa tenuach bizroa ubachatzada tenuach:
Vechag shabuot taaseh leka bikkure qetzir chittim vechag haasip tequpat hashshana
Vechagga deshabuayya tabed lak bikkure chatzad chittin vechagga diknasha bemipqa deshatta:
Shalosh peamim bashshana yeraeh kol-zekureka et-pene haadon Adonai elohe yisrael
Telat zimnin beshatta yitchazun kol dekurayk qodam ribbon alema Adonai elaha deyisrael:
Ki-orish goyim mippaneka vehirchabti et-gebuleka velo-yachmod ish et-artzeka baaloteka leraot et-pene Adonai eloheka shalosh peamim bashshana
Are atarek ammin min qodamak veapte yat techumak vela yachmed enash yat arak bemisqak leitchazzaa qodam Adonai elahak telat zimnin beshatta:
Lo-tishchat al-chametz dam-zibchi velo-yalin labboqer zebach chag happasach
La tikkos al chamia dam pischi vela yebitun letzapra bar mimmadbecha tarbe niksat chagga depischa:
Reshit bikkure admateka tabi bet Adonai eloheka lo-tebashshel gedi bachaleb immo
Resh bikkure arak tayte lebet maqdesha daAdonai elahak la tekelun besar bachalab:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh ketob-leka et-haddebarim haelleh ki al-pi haddebarim haelleh karatti itteka berit veet-yisrael
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ketab lak yat pitgamayya haillen are al memar pitgamayya haillen gezarit immak qeyam veim yisrael:
Vayehi-sham im-Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo akal umayim lo shata vayyiktob al-halluchot et dibre habberit aseret haddebarim
Vahava tamman qodam Adonai arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan lachma la akal umayya la shete uketab al luchayya yat pitgame qeyama asra pitgamin:
Vayehi beredet mosheh mehar sinay ushene luchot haedut beyad-mosheh beridto min-hahar umosheh lo-yada ki qaran or panayv bedabbero itto
Vahava kad nechat msheh mittura desinay uteren luche sahaduta bida demsheh bemechateh min tura umsheh la yeda are sege ziv yeqara deappohi bemallaluteh immeh:
Vayyar aharon vekol-bene yisrael et-mosheh vehinneh qaran or panayv vayyireu miggeshet elayv
Vachaza aharon vekol bene yisrael yat msheh veha sege ziv yeqara deappohi udechilu milleitqeraba levateh:
Vayyiqra alehem mosheh vayyashubu elayv aharon vekol-hannesiim baeda vayedabber mosheh alehem
Uqera lehon msheh vetabu levateh aharon vekol rabrebayya biknishta umallel msheh immehon:
Veachare-ken niggeshu kol-bene yisrael vayetzavvem et kol-asher dibber Adonai itto behar sinay
Ubatar ken itqeribu kol bene yisrael upaqqedinnun yat kol di mallel Adonai immeh betura desinay:
Vayekal mosheh middabber ittam vayyitten al-panayv masveh
Veshetze msheh milmallala immehon vihab al appohi bet appe:
Ubebo mosheh lipne Adonai ledabber itto yasir et-hammasveh ad-tzeto veyatza vedibber el-bene yisrael et asher yetzuvveh
Vekad alel msheh loqodam Adonai lemallala immeh adi yat bet appohi ad mippeqeh venapeq umemallel im bene yisrael yat di mitpaqqad:
Verau bene-yisrael et-pene mosheh ki qaran or pene mosheh veheshib mosheh et-hammasveh al-panayv ad-boo ledabber itto
Vachazan bene yisrael yat appe msheh are sege ziv yeqara deappe msheh vaateb msheh yat bet appe al appohi ad dealel lemallala immeh:
Vayyaqhel mosheh et-kol-adat bene yisrael vayyomer alehem elleh haddebarim asher-tzivva Adonai laasot otam
Veaknesh msheh yat kol kenishta dibne yisrael vaamar lehon illen pitgamayya di paqqed Adonai lemebad yatehon:
Sheshet yamim teaseh melaka ubayyom hashshebii yihyeh lakem qodesh shabbat shabbaton la-Adonai kol-haoseh bo melaka yumat
Shitta yomin titabed ibidta ubeyoma shebiaa yehe lekon qudesha shabba shabbeta qodam Adonai kol deyabed beh ibidta yitqetel:
Lo-tebaaru esh bekol moshebotekem beyom hashshabbat
La tebaarun eshshata bekol motebanekon beyoma deshabbeta:
Vayyomer mosheh el-kol-adat bene-yisrael lemor zeh haddabar asher-tzivva Adonai lemor
Vaamar msheh lekol kenishta dibne yisrael lememar den pitgama di paqqed Adonai lememar:
Qechu meittekem teruma la-Adonai kol nedib libbo yebieha et terumat Adonai zahab vakesep unechoshet
Sabu minnekon aprashuta qodam Adonai kol deyitree libbeh yayte yat aprashuta qodam Adonai dahaba vekaspa unechasha:
Utekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh veizzim
Vetikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz umeazze:
Veorot elim meoddamim veorot techashim vaatze shittim
Umashke dedikre mesammeqe umashke desasgona veae shittin:
Veshemen lammaor ubesamim leshemen hammishcha veliqtoret hassammim
Umishcha leanharuta ubusemayya limshach rebuta veliqtoret busemayya:
Veabne-shoham veabne milluim laepod velachoshen
Veabne burela veabne ashlamuta leshaqqaa beepoda ubechushena:
Vekol-chakam-leb bakem yabou veyaasu et kol-asher tzivva Adonai
Vekol chakkime libba bekon yetun veyaabdun yat kol di paqqed Adonai:
Et-hammishkan et-oholo veet-miksehu et-qerasayv veet-qerashayv et-berichav et-ammudayv veet-adanayv
Yat mashkena yat peraseh veyat chopaeh yat purepohi veyat dappohi yat abrohi yat ammudohi veyat samkohi:
Et-haaron veet-baddayv et-hakkapporet veet paroket hammasak
Yat arona veyat arichohi yat kappurta veyat parukta diprasa:
Et-hashshulchan veet-baddayv veet-kol-kelayv veet lechem happanim
Yat patora veyat arichohi veyat kol manohi veyat lechem appayya:
Veet-menorat hammaor veet-keleha veet-neroteha veet shemen hammaor
Veyat menarta deanhore veyat manaha veyat botzinaha veyat mishcha deanharuta:
Veet-mizbach haqqetoret veet-baddayv veet shemen hammishcha veet qetoret hassammim veet-masak happetach lepetach hammishkan
Veyat madbecha diqtoret busemayya veyat arichohi veyat mishcha dirbuta veyat qetoret busemayya veyat perasa detara litra mashkena:
Et mizbach haola veet-mikbar hannechoshet asher-lo et-baddayv veet-kol-kelayv et-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Yat madbecha daalata veyat serada dinchasha dileh yat arichohi veyat kol manohi yat kiyora veyat besiseh:
Et qale hechatzer et-ammudayv veet-adaneha veet masak shaar hechatzer
Yat serade darta yat ammudohi veyat samkaha veyat perasa ditra darta:
Et-yitdot hammishkan veet-yitdot hechatzer veet-meterehem
Yat sikke mashkena veyat sikke dedarta veyat attunehon:
Et-bigde hasserad lesharet baqqodesh et-bigde haqqodesh leaharon hakkohen veet-bigde banayv lekahen
Yat lebushe shimmusha leshammasha bequdesha yat lebushe qudesha leaharon kahana veyat lebushe benohi leshammasha:
Vayyetzeu kol-adat bene-yisrael millipne mosheh
Unepaqu kol kenishta dibne yisrael min qodam msheh:
Vayyabou kol-ish asher-nesao libbo vekol asher nadeba rucho oto hebiu et-terumat Adonai limleket ohel moed ulekol-abodato ulebigde haqqodesh
Vaato kol gebar deitree libbeh vekol di ashlemat rucheh yateh aytiu yat aprashuta qodam Adonai laabidat mashkan zimna ulekal pulchaneh velilbushe qudesha:
Vayyabou haanashim al-hannashim kol nedib leb hebiu chach vanezem vetabbaat vekumaz kol-keli zahab vekol-ish asher henip tenupat zahab la-Adonai
Umaytan gubrayya al neshayya kol deitree libbeh aytiu sherin veshibkin veizqan umachuk kol man didhab vekol gebar di arem aramut dahaba qodam Adonai:
Vekol-ish asher-nimtza itto tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh veizzim veorot elim meoddamim veorot techashim hebiu
Vekol gebar deishtekach immeh tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz umeazze umashke dedikre mesammeqe umashke sasgona aytiu:
Kol-merim terumat kesep unechoshet hebiu et terumat Adonai vekol asher nimtza itto atze shittim lekol-meleket haaboda hebiu
Kol daarem aramut kesap unechash aytiu yat aprashuta qodam Adonai vekol di ishtekach immeh ae shittin lekol ibidat pulchana aytiu:
Vekol-ishsha chakmat-leb beyadeha tavu vayyabiu matveh et-hattekelet veet-haargaman et-tolaat hashshani veet-hashshesh
Vekol itteta chakkimat libba bidaha meazzela umaytan kad azel yat tikla veyat argevana yat tzeba zehori veyat butza:
Vekol-hannashim asher nasa libban otana bechokma tavu et-haizzim
Vekol neshayya deitree libbehen immehen bechokma azzelan yat meazya:
Vehannesiim hebiu et abne hashshoham veet abne hammilluim laepod velachoshen
Verabrebayya aytiu yat abne burela veyat abne ashlamuta leshaqqaa beepoda ubechushena:
Veet-habbosem veet-hashshamen lemaor uleshemen hammishcha veliqtoret hassammim
Veyat busema veyat mishcha leanharuta ulemishcha dirbuta veliqtoret busemayya:
Kol-ish veishsha asher nadab libbam otam lehabi lekol-hammelaka asher tzivva Adonai laasot beyad-mosheh hebiu bene-yisrael nedaba la-Adonai
Kol gebar veitteta deitree libbehon immehon leaytaa lekol ibidta di paqqed Adonai lemebad bida demsheh aytiu bene yisrael nedabta qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer mosheh el-bene yisrael reu qara Adonai beshem betzalel ben-vri ben-chvr lematteh yehuda
Vaamar msheh libne yisrael chazo derabbi Adonai beshum betzalel bar uri bar chur leshibta dihuda:
Vayemalle oto ruach elohim bechokma bitbuna ubedaat ubekol-melaka
Veashlem immeh ruach nebua min qodam Adonai bechokmeta besukeletanu ubemadda ubekol ibida:
Velachshob machashabot laasot bazzahab ubakkesep ubannechoshet
Uleallapa umanvan lemebad bedahaba ubekaspa ubinchasha:
Ubacharoshet eben lemallot ubacharoshet etz laasot bekol-meleket machashabet
Ubeumanut eben taba leashlama ubenaggarut aa lemebad bekol ibidat umanvan:
Ulehorot natan belibbo hu veoholiab ben-achisamak lematteh-dan
Uleallapa yehab belibbeh hu veoholiab bar achisamak leshibta dedan:
Mille otam chokmat-leb laasot kol-meleket charash vechosheb veroqem battekelet ubaargaman betolaat hashshani ubashshesh veoreg ose kol-melaka vechoshebe machashabot
Ashlem immehon chakkimut libba lemebad kol ibidat naggar veamman vetzayyar betikla ubeargevana bitzba zehori ubebutza umache abede kol ibida umalpe umanvan:
Veasa betzalel veoholiab vekol ish chakam-leb asher natan Adonai chokma utebuna bahemma ladaat laasot et-kol-meleket abodat haqqodesh lekol asher-tzivva Adonai
Vaabad betzalel veoholiab vekol gebar chakkim libba dihab Adonai chokma vesukeletanuta behon lemidda lemebad yat kol ibidat palechan qudesha lekol di paqqed Adonai:
Vayyiqra mosheh el-betzalel veel-oholiab veel kol-ish chakam-leb asher natan Adonai chokma belibbo kol asher nesao libbo leqorba el-hammelaka laasot otah
Uqera msheh libtzalel uleoholiab ulekal gebar chakkim libba dihab Adonai chokmeta belibbeh kol deitree libbeh lemiqrab leibidta lemebad yateh:
Vayyiqchu millipne mosheh et kol-hatteruma asher hebiu bene yisrael limleket abodat haqqodesh laasot otah vehem hebiu elayv od nedaba babboqer babboqer
Unesibu min qodam msheh yat kol aprashuta di aytiu bene yisrael leibidat palechan qudesha lemebad yatah veinnun maytan leh od nedabta bitzpar bitzpar:
Vayyabou kol-hachakamim haosim et kol-meleket haqqodesh ish-ish mimmelakto asher-hemma osim
Vaato kol chakkimayya deabedin yat kol ibidat qudesha gebar gebar meibidteh deinnun abedin:
Vayyomeru el-mosheh lemor marbim haam lehabi midde haaboda lammelaka asher-tzivva Adonai laasot otah
Vaamaru lemsheh lememar masgan amma leaytaa missat palechana leibidta depaqqed Adonai lemebad yatah:
Vayetzav mosheh vayyaabiru qol bammachaneh lemor ish veishsha al-yaasu-od melaka litrumat haqqodesh vayyikkale haam mehabi
Upaqqed msheh veaabaru karoza bemashrita lememar gebar veitteta la yaabdun od ibidta leaprashut qudesha upesaq amma milleaytaa:
Vehammelaka hayeta dayyam lekol-hammelaka laasot otah vehoter
Veibidta havat missat lekol ibidta lemebad yatah vitarat:
Vayyaasu kol-chakam-leb beose hammelaka et-hammishkan eser yeriot shesh moshzar utekelet veargaman vetolaat shani kerubim maaseh chosheb asa otam
Vaabadu kol chakkime libba beabede ibidta yat mashkena asar yerian debutz shezir vetikla veargevana utzeba zehori tzurat kerubin obad amman abad yatehon:
Orek hayeria haachat shemoneh veesrim baamma verochab arba baamma hayeria haechat midda achat lekol-hayeriot
Urka diriata chada asrin utemanya ammin uputeya arba ammin diriata chada meshachta chada lekol yeriata:
Vayechabber et-chamesh hayeriot achat el-echat vechamesh yeriot chibbar achat el-echat
Velapep yat chamesh yerian chada im chada vechamesh yerian lapep chada im chada:
Vayyaas luleot tekelet al sepat hayeria haechat miqqatza bammachbaret ken asa bispat hayeria haqqitzona bammachberet hashshenit
Vaabad anubin detikla al sipta diriata chada missitra bet lope ken abad besipta diriata besitra bet lope tinyeta:
Chamishshim lulaot asa bayria haechat vachamishshim lulaot asa biqtzeh hayeria asher bammachberet hashshenit maqbilot hallulaot achat el-echat
Chamshin anubin abad biriata chada vechamshin anubin abad besitra diriata debet lope tinyeta mekavvenan anubayya chada loqobel chada:
Vayyaas chamishshim qarse zahab vayechabber et-hayeriot achat el-achat baqqerasim vayehi hammishkan echad
Vaabad chamshin purepin didhab velapep yat yeriata chada im chada bepurepayya vahava mashkena chad:
Vayyaas yeriot izzim leohel al-hammishkan ashte-esreh yeriot asa otam
Vaabad yerian dimazze liprasa al mashkena chad asar yerian abad yatehen:
Orek hayeria haachat sheloshim baamma vearba ammot rochab hayeria haechat midda achat leashte esreh yeriot
Urka diriata chada telatin beammin vearba ammin puteya diriata chada meshachta chada lechad asar yerian:
Vayechabber et-chamesh hayeriot lebad veet-shesh hayeriot lebad
Velapep yat chamesh yerian lechod veyat shet yerian lechod:
Vayyaas lulaot chamishshim al sepat hayeria haqqitzona bammachbaret vachamishshim lulaot asa al-sepat hayeria hachoberet hashshenit
Vaabad anubin chamshin al sipta diriata besitra bet lope vechamshin anubin abad al sipta diriata debet lope tinyeta:
Vayyaas qarse nechoshet chamishshim lechabber et-haohel lihyot echad
Vaabad purepin dinchasha chamshin lelappapa yat mashkena lemeheve chad:
Vayyaas mikseh laohel orot elim meoddamim umikseh orot techashim milmaela
Vaabad chopaa lemashkena mashke dedikre mesammeqe vechopaa mashke desasgona milleella:
Vayyaas et-haqqerashim lammishkan atze shittim omedim
Vaabad yat dappayya lemashkena deae shittin qayemin:
Eser ammot orek haqqaresh veamma vachatzi haamma rochab haqqeresh haechad
Asar ammin urka dedappa veammeta upalgut ammeta puteya dedappa chad:
Shete yadot laqqeresh haechad meshullabot achat el-echat ken asa lekol qarshe hammishkan
Tarten tzirin ledappa chad meshallebin chada loqobel chada ken abad lekol dappe mashkena:
Vayyaas et-haqqerashim lammishkan esrim qerashim lipat negeb temana
Vaabad yat dappayya lemashkena esrin dappin leruach ebar daroma:
Vearbaim adne-kesep asa tachat esrim haqqerashim shene adanim tachat-haqqeresh haechad lishte yedotayv ushene adanim tachat-haqqeresh haechad lishte yedotayv
Vearbein samkin diksap abad techot esrin dappin teren samkin techot dappa chad litren tzirohi uteren samkin techot dappa chad litren tzirohi:
Uletzela hammishkan hashshenit lipat tzapon asa esrim qerashim
Velistar mashkena tinyeta leruach tzippuna abad esrin dappin:
Vearbaim adnehem kasep shene adanim tachat haqqeresh haechad ushene adanim tachat haqqeresh haechad
Vearbein samkehon diksap teren samkin techot dappa chad uteren samkin techot dappa chad:
Uleyarkete hammishkan yamma asa shishsha qerashim
Velisyape mashkena maarba abad shitta dappin:
Ushene qerashim asa limqutzot hammishkan bayyarkatayim
Uteren dappin abad lezaveyat mashkena besopehon:
Vehayu toamim millematta veyachdav yihyu tammim el-rosho el-hattabbaat haechat ken asa lishnehem lishne hammiqtzoot
Vahavo mekavvenin millera vekachada havo mekavvenin al resheh leizqata chada ken abad letarvehon litren zaveyan:
Vehayu shemona qerashim veadnehem kesep shishsha asar adanim shene adanim shene adanim tachat haqqeresh haechad
Vahavo temanya dappin vesamkehon diksap shitta asar samkin teren samkin teren samkin techot dappa chad:
Vayyaas beriche atze shittim chamishsha leqarshe tzela-hammishkan haechat
Vaabad abbere deae shittin chamsha ledappe setar mashkena chad:
Vachamishsha berichim leqarshe tzela-hammishkan hashshenit vachamishsha berichim leqarshe hammishkan layyarkatayim yamma
Vechamsha abberin ledappe setar mashkena tinyeta vechamsha abberin ledappe mashkena lesopehon maarba:
Vayyaas et-habberiach hattikon libroach betok haqqerashim min-haqqatzeh el-haqqatzeh
Vaabad yat abbera metziaa leabara bego dappayya min seyape lisyape:
Veet-haqqerashim tzippa zahab veet-tabbeotam asa zahab battim labberichim vayetzap et-habberichim zahab
Veyat dappayya chapa dahaba veyat izqatehon abad dahaba atra leabberayya vachapa yat abberayya dahaba:
Vayyaas et-happaroket tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maaseh chosheb asa otah kerubim
Vaabad yat parukta tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir obad amman abad yatah tzurat kerubin:
Vayyaas lah arbaa ammude shittim vayetzappem zahab vavehem zahab vayyitzoq lahem arbaa adne-kasep
Vaabad leh arbea ammude shittin vachapanun dahaba vavehon dahaba veattik lehon arbea samkin diksap:
Vayyaas masak lepetach haohel tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maaseh roqem
Vaabad perasa litra mashkena tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir obad tzayyar:
Veet-ammudayv chamishsha veet-vavehem vetzippa rashehem vachashuqehem zahab veadnehem chamishsha nechoshet
Veyat ammudohi chamsha veyat vavehon vachapa reshehon vekibbushehon dahaba vesamkehon chamsha nechasha:
Vayyaas betzalel et-haaron atze shittim ammatayim vachetzi orko veamma vachetzi rochbo veamma vachetzi qomato
Vaabad betzalel yat arona deae shittin tarten ammin upalga urkeh veammeta upalga petayeh veamta upalga rumeh:
Vayetzappehu zahab tahor mibbayit umichutz vayyaas lo zer zahab sabib
Vachapahi dehab deke miggav umibbara vaabad leh der didhab sechor sechor:
Vayyitzoq lo arba tabbeot zahab al arba paamotayv ushete tabbaot al-tzalo haechat ushete tabbaot al-tzalo hashshenit
Veattik leh arba izqan didhab al arba zivyateh vetarten izqan al sitreh chad vetarten izqan al sitreh tinyeta:
Vayyaas badde atze shittim vayetzap otam zahab
Vaabad ariche deae shittin vachapa yatehon dahaba:
Vayyabe et-habbaddim battabbaot al tzalot haaron laset et-haaron
Veael yat arichayya beizqata al sitre arona lemittal yat arona:
