Vayyaas kapporet zahab tahor ammatayim vachetzi orkah veamma vachetzi rochbah
Vaabad kappurta dehab deke tarten ammin upalga urkah veammeta upalga petayah:
Vayyaas shene kerubim zahab miqsha asa otam mishshene qetzot hakkapporet
Vaabad teren kerubin didhab negid abad yatehon mitteren sitre kappurta:
Kerub-echad miqqatza mizzeh ukerub-echad miqqatza mizzeh min-hakkapporet asa et-hakkerubim mishshene qetzotayv
Keruba chad missitra mikka ukeruba chad missitra mikka min kappurta abad yat kerubayya mitteren sitrohi:
Vayyihyu hakkerubim porese kenapayim lemala sokekim bekanpehem al-hakkapporet upenehem ish el-achiv el-hakkapporet hayu pene hakkerubim
Vahavo kerubayya perisan gadpehon leella natelin begadpehon al kappurta veappehon chad loqobel chad loqobel kappurta havo appe kerubayya:
Vayyaas et-hashshulchan atze shittim ammatayim orko veamma rochbo veamma vachetzi qomato
Vaabad yat patora deae shittin tarten ammin urkeh veammeta petayeh veammeta upalga rumeh:
Vayetzap oto zahab tahor vayyaas lo zer zahab sabib
Vachapa yateh dehab deke vaabad leh der didhab sechor sechor:
Vayyaas lo misgeret topach sabib vayyaas zer-zahab lemisgarto sabib
Vaabad leh gedanpa rumeh pusheka sechor sechor vaabad der didhab ligdanpeh sechor sechor:
Vayyitzoq lo arba tabbeot zahab vayyitten et-hattabbaot al arba happeot asher learba raglayv
Veattik leh arba izqan didhab vihab yat izqata al arba zivyata di learba raglohi:
Leummat hammisgeret hayu hattabbaot battim labbaddim laset et-hashshulchan
Loqobel gedanpa havo izqata atra laarichayya lemittal yat patora:
Vayyaas et-habbaddim atze shittim vayetzap otam zahab laset et-hashshulchan
Vaabad yat arichayya deae shittin vachapa yatehon dahaba lemittal yat patora:
Vayyaas et-hakkelim asher al-hashshulchan et-qearotayv veet-kappotayv veet menaqqiyyotayv veet-haqqesavot asher yussak bahen zahab tahor
Vaabad yat manayya di al patora yat magisohi veyat bazikohi veyat mekilateh veyat qasvata di yitnassak behon dehab deke:
Vayyaas et-hammenora zahab tahor miqsha asa et-hammenora yerekah veqanah gebieha kaptoreha uperacheha mimmenna hayu
Vaabad yat menarta dehab deke negid abad yat menarta shidah uqenah kalidaha chezuraha veshoshannaha minnah havo:
Veshishsha qanim yotzeim mitztziddeha shelosha qene menora mitztziddah haechad ushelosha qene menora mitztziddah hashsheni
Veshitta qenin napeqin missitraha telata qene menarta missitrah chad utelata qene menarta missitrah tinyana:
Shelosha gebiim meshuqqadim baqqaneh haechad kaptor vaperach ushelosha gebiim meshuqqadim beqaneh echad kaptor vaparach ken lesheshet haqqanim hayyotzeim min-hammenora
Telata kallidin metzayyerin beqanya chad chezur veshoshan utelata kallidin metzayyerin beqanya chad chezur veshoshan ken leshitta qenin denapeqin min menarta:
Ubammenora arbaa gebiim meshuqqadim kaptoreha uperacheha
Ubimnarta arbea kallidin metzayyerin chezzuraha veshoshannaha:
Vekaptor tachat shene haqqanim mimmenna vekaptor tachat shene haqqanim mimmenna vekaptor tachat-shene haqqanim mimmenna lesheshet haqqanim hayyotzeim mimmenna
Vechezur techot teren qenin minnah vechezur techot teren qenin minnah vechezur techot teren qenin minnah leshitta qenin denapeqin minnah:
Kaptorehem uqenotam mimmenna hayu kullah miqsha achat zahab tahor
Chezurehon uqenehon minnah havo kulah negida chada dehab deke:
Vayyaas et-neroteha shiba umalqacheha umachtoteha zahab tahor
Vaabad yat botzinaha shiba vetzibyetaha umachitteyetaha dehab deke:
Kikkar zahab tahor asa otah veet kol-keleha
Kikkera dehab deke abad yatah veyat kol manaha:
Vayyaas et-mizbach haqqetoret atze shittim amma orko veamma rochbo rabua veammatayim qomato mimmennu hayu qarnotayv
Vaabad yat madbecha diqtoret busemayya deae shittin ammeta urkeh veammeta petayeh merabba vetarten ammin rumeh minneh havo qarnohi:
Vayetzap oto zahab tahor et-gaggo veet-qirotayv sabib veet-qarnotayv vayyaas lo zer zahab sabib
Vachapa yateh dehab deke yat iggareh veyat katelohi sechor sechor veyat qarnohi vaabad leh der didhab sechor sechor:
Ushete tabbeot zahab asa-lo mittachat lezero al shete tzalotayv al shene tziddayv lebattim lebaddim laset oto bahem
Vetarten izqan didhab abad leh millera ledereh al tarten zivyateh al teren sitrohi leatra laarichayya lemittal yateh behon:
Vayyaas et-habbaddim atze shittim vayetzap otam zahab
Vaabad yat arichayya deae shittin vachapa yatehon dahaba:
Vayyaas et-shemen hammishcha qodesh veet-qetoret hassammim tahor maaseh roqeach
Vaabad yat mishcha dirbuta qudesha veyat qetoret busemayya deke obad busemanu:
Vayyaas et-mizbach haola atze shittim chamesh ammot orko vechamesh-ammot rochbo rabua veshalosh ammot qomato
Vaabad yat madbecha daalata deae shittin chamesh ammin urkeh vachamesh ammin petayeh merabba utelata ammin rumeh:
Vayyaas qarnotayv al arba pinnotayv mimmennu hayu qarnotayv vayetzap oto nechoshet
Vaabad qarnohi al arba zivyateh minneh havo qarnohi vachapa yateh nechasha:
Vayyaas et-kol-kele hammizbeach et-hassirot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizraqot et-hammizlagot veet-hammachtot kol-kelayv asa nechoshet
Vaabad yat kol mane madbecha yat pesakteravata veyat magropeyata veyat mizreqata yat tzinnureyata veyat machteyata kol manohi abad nechasha:
Vayyaas lammizbeach mikbar maaseh reshet nechoshet tachat karkubbo millematta ad-chetzyo
Vaabad lemadbecha serada obad metzadta dinchasha techot sobabeh millera ad palgeh:
Vayyitzoq arba tabbaot bearba haqqetzavot lemikbar hannechoshet battim labbaddim
Veattik arba izqata bearba sitrata lisrada dinchasha atra laarichayya:
Vayyaas et-habbaddim atze shittim vayetzap otam nechoshet
Vaabad yat arichayya deae shittin vachapa yatehon nechasha:
Vayyabe et-habbaddim battabbaot al tzalot hammizbeach laset oto bahem nebub luchot asa oto
Veael yat arichayya beizqata al sitre madbecha lemittal yateh behon chalil luchin abad yateh:
Vayyaas et hakkiyyor nechoshet veet kanno nechoshet bemarot hatztzobeot asher tzabeu petach ohel moed
Vaabad yat kiyora nechasha veyat besiseh nechasha bemechzeyan neshayya deateyan letzallaa bitra mashkan zimna:
Vayyaas et-hechatzer lipat negeb temana qale hechatzer shesh moshzar mea baamma
Vaabad yat darta leruach ebar daroma serade darta debutz shezir mea beammin:
Ammudehem esrim veadnehem esrim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashuqehem kasep
Ammudehon esrin vesamkehon esrin nechasha vave ammudayya vekibbushehon kesap:
Velipat tzapon mea baamma ammudehem esrim veadnehem esrim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashuqehem kasep
Uleruach tzippuna mea ammin ammudehon esrin vesamkehon esrin nechasha vave ammudayya vekibbushehon diksap:
Velipat-yam qelaim chamishshim baamma ammudehem asara veadnehem asara vave haammudim vachashuqehem kasep
Uleruach maarba seradin chamshin beammin ammudehon asra vesamkehon asra vave ammudayya vekibbushehon diksap:
Velipat qedema mizracha chamishshim amma
Uleruach qidduma madinecha chamshin ammin:
Qelaim chamesh-esreh amma el-hakkatep ammudehem shelosha veadnehem shelosha
Seradin chamesh esre ammin leibra ammudehon telata vesamkehon telata:
Velakkatep hashshenit mizzeh umizzeh leshaar hechatzer qelaim chamesh esreh amma ammudehem shelosha veadnehem shelosha
Uleibra tinyeta mikka umikka litra darta seradin chamesh esre ammin ammudehon telata vesamkehon telata
Kol-qale hechatzer sabib shesh moshzar
Kol serade dedarta sechor sechor debutz shezir:
Vehaadanim laammudim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashuqehem kesep vetzippuy rashehem kasep vehem mechushshaqim kesep kol ammude hechatzer
Vesamkayya leammudayya nechasha vave ammudayya vekibbushehon diksap vechippuy reshehon diksap veinnun mekabbeshin diksap kol ammude darta:
Umasak shaar hechatzer maaseh roqem tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar veesrim amma orek veqoma berochab chamesh ammot leummat qale hechatzer
Uperasa ditra darta obad tzayyar tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir veesrin ammin urka veruma beputeya chamesh ammin loqobel serade darta:
Veammudehem arbaa veadnehem arbaa nechoshet vavehem kesep vetzippuy rashehem vachashuqehem kasep
Veammudehon arbea vesamkehon arbea nechasha vavehon diksap vechippuy reshehon vekibbushehon diksap:
Vekol-hayetedot lammishkan velechatzer sabib nechoshet
Vekol sikkayya lemashkena uledarta sechor sechor dinchasha:
Elleh pequde hammishkan mishkan haedut asher puqqad al-pi mosheh abodat haleviyyim beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohen
Illen minyane mashkena mashkena desahaduta di itmene al memera demsheh palechan levae bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Ubetzalel ben-vri ben-chvr lematteh yehuda asa et kol-asher-tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Ubetzalel bar uri bar chur leshibta dihuda abad yat kol di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Veitto oholiab ben-achisamak lematteh-dan charash vechosheb veroqem battekelet ubaargaman ubetolaat hashshani ubashshesh
Veimmeh oholiab bar achisamak leshibta dedan naggar veomman vetzayyar betikla ubeargevana ubitzba zehori ubebutza:
Kol-hazzahab heasuy lammelaka bekol meleket haqqodesh vayehi zehab hattenupa tesha veesrim kikkar usheba meot usheloshim sheqel besheqel haqqodesh
Kol dahaba deitabed leibida bekol ibidat qudesha vahava dehab aramuta esrin utesha kikkerin usheba mea utelatin silin besile qudesha:
Vekesep pequde haeda meat kikkar veelep usheba meot vachamishsha veshibim sheqel besheqel haqqodesh
Ukesap minyane kenishta mea kikkerin veelep usheba mea veshibin vechamsha silin besile qudesha:
Beqa laggulgolet machatzit hashsheqel besheqel haqqodesh lekol haober al-happequdim mibben esrim shana vamala leshesh-meot elep usheloshet alapim vachamesh meot vachamishshim
Tiqla legulgalta palgut sila besile qudesha lekol deabar al minyanayya mibbar esrin shenin uleella leshet mea utelata alpin vachamesh mea vechamshin:
Vayehi meat kikkar hakkesep latzeqet et adne haqqodesh veet adne happaroket meat adanim limat hakkikkar kikkar laaden
Vahava mea kikkerin diksap leattaka yat samke qudesha veyat samke deparukta mea samkin lima kikkerin kikkera lesamka:
Veet-haelep usheba hammeot vachamishsha veshibim asa vavim laammudim vetzippa rashehem vechishshaq otam
Veyat alpa usheba mea veshibin vechamsha abad vavin leammudayya vechippa reshehon vekabbesh yatehon:
Unechoshet hattenupa shibim kikkar vealpayim vearba-meot shaqel
Unechasha daaramuta shibin kikkerin uteren alpin vearba mea silin:
Vayyaas bah et-adne petach ohel moed veet mizbach hannechoshet veet-mikbar hannechoshet asher-lo veet kol-kele hammizbeach
Vaabad bah yat samke tera mashkan zimna veyat madbecha dinchasha veyat serada dinchasha di leh veyat kol mane madbecha:
Veet-adne hechatzer sabib veet-adne shaar hechatzer veet kol-yitdot hammishkan veet-kol-yitdot hechatzer sabib
Veyat samke dedarta sechor sechor veyat samke tera darta veyat kol sikke mashkena veyat kol sikke darta sechor sechor:
Umin-hattekelet vehaargaman vetolaat hashshani asu bigde-serad lesharet baqqodesh vayyaasu et-bigde haqqodesh asher leaharon kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Umin tikla veargevana utzeba zehori abadu lebushe shimmusha leshammasha bequdesha vaabadu yat lebushe qudesha di leaharon kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaas et-haepod zahab tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar
Vaabad yat epoda dahaba tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir:
Vayeraqqeu et-pache hazzahab veqitztzetz petilim laasot betok hattekelet ubetok haargaman ubetok tolaat hashshani ubetok hashshesh maaseh chosheb
Veraddidu yat tasse dahaba veqatztzitzu chutin lemebad bego tikla ubego argevana ubego tzeba zehori ubego butza obad amman:
Ketepot asu-lo choberot al-shene qetzotayv chubbar
Katpan abadu leh melappepan al teren sitrohi yitlapep:
Vechesheb apuddato asher alayv mimmennu hu kemaasehu zahab tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vehemyan tiqquneh di alohi minneh hu keobadohi dahaba tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaasu et-abne hashshoham musabbot mishbetzot zahab meputtachot pittuche chotam al-shemot bene yisrael
Vaabadu yat abne burela meshaqqean merammetzan didhab gelipan ketab meparash al shemahat bene yisrael:
Vayyasem otam al kitpot haepod abne zikkaron libne yisrael kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veshavvi yatehon al kitpa deepoda abne dukerana libne yisrael kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaas et-hachoshen maaseh chosheb kemaaseh epod zahab tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar
Vaabad yat chushena obad amman keobade epoda dahaba tikla veargevana utzeba zehori ubutz shezir:
Rabua haya kapul asu et-hachoshen zeret orko vezeret rochbo kapul
Merabba hava ep abadu yat chushena zerta urkeh vezerta petayeh ep:
Vayemalu-bo arbaa ture aben tur odem pitda ubareqet hattur haechad
Veashlimu beh arbea sidre eben taba sidra qadmaa samqan yarqan ubarqan sidra chad:
Vehattur hashsheni nopek sappir veyahalom
Vesidra tinyana izmaragdin shabzez vesabhalom:
Vehattur hashshelishi leshem shebo veachlama
Vesidra telitaa qankere tarqeya veen egla:
Vehattur harebii tarshish shoham veyashepeh musabbot mishbetzot zahab bemilluotam
Vesidra rebiaa kerum yamma uburela upantere meshaqqean merammetzan didhab beashlamutehon:
Vehaabanim al-shemot bene-yisrael henna shetem esreh al-shemotam pittuche chotam ish al-shemo lishnem asar shabet
Veabnayya al shemahat bene yisrael innin tarte esre al shemahatehon ketab meparash kiglop deizqa gebar al shemeh litren asar shibtin:
Vayyaasu al-hachoshen sharsherot gablut maaseh abot zahab tahor
Vaabadu al chushena tikkin metachman obad gedilu dehab deke:
Vayyaasu shete mishbetzot zahab ushete tabbeot zahab vayyittenu et-shete hattabbaot al-shene qetzot hachoshen
Vaabadu tarten merammetzan didhab vetarten izqan didhab vihabu yat tarten izqata al teren sitre chushena:
Vayyittenu shete haabotot hazzahab al-shete hattabbaot al-qetzot hachoshen
Vihabu tarten gedilata didhab al tarten izqata al sitre chushena:
Veet shete qetzot shete haabotot natenu al-shete hammishbetzot vayyittenum al-kitpot haepod el-mvl panayv
Veyat tarten gedilan dial tarten sitrohi yehabu al tarten merammetzata vihabunnun al katpe epoda loqobel appohi:
Vayyaasu shete tabbeot zahab vayyasimu al-shene qetzot hachoshen al-sepato asher el-eber haepod bayeta
Vaabadu tarten izqan didhab veshavviu al teren sitre chushena al sipteh di leibra deepoda millegayv:
Vayyaasu shete tabbeot zahab vayyittenum al-shete kitpot haepod millematta mimmul panayv leummat machbarto mimmaal lechesheb haepod
Vaabadu tarten izqan didhab vihabunnun al tarten kitpe epoda millera milloqobel appohi loqobel bet lope meillave lehemyan epoda:
Vayyirkesu et-hachoshen mittabbeotayv el-tabbeot haepod biptil tekelet liheyot al-chesheb haepod velo-yizzach hachoshen meal haepod kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veyachadun yat chushena meizqateh leizqeta deepoda bechuta ditkelta lemeheve al hemyan epoda vela yitpareq chushena meillave epoda kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaas et-meil haepod maaseh oreg kelil tekelet
Vaabad yat meila deepoda obad mache gemir tikla:
Upi-hammeil betoko kepi tachra sapa lepiv sabib lo yiqqarea
Upum meila kapil legavveh kepum shiryan tora maqqap lepumeh sechor sechor la yitbeza:
Vayyaasu al-shvle hammeil rimmone tekelet veargaman vetolaat shani moshzar
Vaabadu al shippole meila rimmone tikla veargevana utzeba zehori shezir:
Vayyaasu paamone zahab tahor vayyittenu et-happaamonim betok harimmonim al-shvle hammeil sabib betok harimmonim
Vaabadu zaggayya dehab deke vihabu yat zaggayya bego rimmonayya al shippole meila sechor sechor bego rimmonayya:
Paamon verimmon paamon verimmon al-shvle hammeil sabib lesharet kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Zagga verimmona zagga verimmona al shippole meila sechor sechor leshammasha kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaasu et-hakkotnot shesh maaseh oreg leaharon ulebanayv
Vaabadu yat kittunin debutza obad mache leaharon velibnohi:
Veet hammitznepet shesh veet-paare hammigbaot shesh veet-miknese habbad shesh moshzar
Veyat mitznepta debutza veyat shebach kobaayya debutza veyat miknese butza debutz shezir:
Veet-haabnet shesh moshzar utekelet veargaman vetolaat shani maaseh roqem kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veyat hemyana debutz shezir vetikla veargevana utzeba zehori obad tzayyar kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaasu et-tzitz nezer-haqqodesh zahab tahor vayyiktebu alayv miktab pittuche chotam qodesh la-Adonai
Vaabadu yat tzitza kelila dequdesha dehab deke uketabu alohi gelipan ketab meparash qodesh layya:
Vayyittenu alayv petil tekelet latet al-hammitznepet milmaela kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vihabu alohi chuta tekelta lemittan al mitznepta milleella kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vattekel kol-abodat mishkan ohel moed vayyaasu bene yisrael kekol asher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh ken asu
Ushelim kol palechan mashkena mashkan zimna vaabadu bene yisrael kekol di paqqid Adonai yat msheh ken abadu:
Vayyabiu et-hammishkan el-mosheh et-haohel veet-kol-kelayv qerasayv qerashayv berichav veammudayv vaadanayv
Veaytiu yat mashkena lemsheh yat mashkena veyat kol manohi purepohi dappohi abberohi veammudohi vesammekohi:
Veet-mikseh orot haelim hameoddamim veet-mikseh orot hattechashim veet paroket hammasak
Veyat chopaa mashke dedikre mesammeqe veyat chopaa mashke desasgona veyat parukta diprasa:
Et-aron haedut veet-baddayv veet hakkapporet
Yat arona desahaduta veyat arichohi veyat kapurta:
Et-hashshulchan et-kol-kelayv veet lechem happanim
Yat patora yat kol manohi veyat lechem appayya:
Et-hammenora hattehora et-neroteha nerot hammaaraka veet-kol-keleha veet shemen hammaor
Yat menarta dakita yat botzinaha botzine sidra veyat kol manaha veyat mishcha deanharuta:
Veet mizbach hazzahab veet shemen hammishcha veet qetoret hassammim veet masak petach haohel
Veyat madbecha dedahaba veyat mishcha dirbuta veyat qetoret busemayya veyat perasa ditra mashkena:
Et mizbach hannechoshet veet-mikbar hannechoshet asher-lo et-baddayv veet-kol-kelayv et-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Yat madbecha dinchasha veyat serada dinchasha dileh yat arichohi veyat kol manohi yat kiyyora veyat besiseh:
Et qale hechatzer et-ammudeha veet-adaneha veet-hammasak leshaar hechatzer et-metarayv vitedoteha veet kol-kele abodat hammishkan leohel moed
Yat serade dedarta yat ammudaha veyat sammekaha veyat perasa litra darta yat atunohi vesikkaha veyat kol mane palechan mashkena lemashkan zimna:
Et-bigde hasserad lesharet baqqodesh et-bigde haqqodesh leaharon hakkohen veet-bigde banayv lekahen
Yat lebushe shimmusha leshammasha bequdesha yat lebushe qudesha leaharon kahana veyat lebushe benohi leshammasha:
Kekol asher-tzivva Adonai et-mosheh ken asu bene yisrael et kol-haaboda
Kekol di paqqid Adonai yat msheh ken abadu bene yisrael yat kol palechana:
Vayyar mosheh et-kol-hammelaka vehinneh asu otah kaasher tzivva Adonai ken asu vayebarek otam mosheh
Vachaza msheh yat kol ibidta veha abadu yatah kema di paqqid Adonai ken abadu ubarik yatehon msheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Beyom-hachodesh harishon beechad lachodesh taqim et-mishkan ohel moed
Beyoma yarcha qadmaa bechad leyarcha teqim yat mashkena mashkan zimna:
Vesamta sham et aron haedut vesakkota al-haaron et-happaroket
Uteshavvi tamman yat arona desahaduta vetattel al arona yat parukta:
Vehebeta et-hashshulchan vearakta et-erko vehebeta et-hammenora vehaaleta et-neroteha
Vetael yat patora vetasdar yat sidreh vetael yat menarta vetadleq yat botzinaha:
Venatatta et-mizbach hazzahab liqtoret lipne aron haedut vesamta et-masak happetach lammishkan
Vetitten yat madbecha dedahaba liqtoret busemayya qodam arona desahaduta uteshavvi yat perasa detara lemashkena:
Venatatta et mizbach haola lipne petach mishkan ohel-moed
Vetitten yat madbecha daalata qodam tera mashkena mashkan zimna:
Venatatta et-hakkiyyor ben-ohel moed uben hammizbeach venatatta sham mayim
Vetitten yat kiyyora ben mashkan zimna uben madbecha vetitten tamman mayya:
Vesamta et-hechatzer sabib venatatta et-masak shaar hechatzer
Uteshavve yat darta sechor sechor vetitten yat perasa ditra darta:
Velaqachta et-shemen hammishcha umashachta et-hammishkan veet-kol-asher-bo veqiddashta oto veet-kol-kelayv vehaya qodesh
Vetissab yat mishcha dirbuta uterabbe yat mashkena veyat kol di beh uteqaddesh yateh veyat kol manohi vihe qudesha:
Umashachta et-mizbach haola veet-kol-kelayv veqiddashta et-hammizbeach vehaya hammizbeach qodesh qodashim
Uterabbe yat madbecha daalata veyat kol manohi uteqaddesh yat madbecha vihe madbecha qodesh qudeshin:
Umashachta et-hakkiyyor veet-kanno veqiddashta oto
Uterabbe yat kiyyora veyat besiseh uteqaddesh yateh:
Vehiqrabta et-aharon veet-banayv el-petach ohel moed verachatzta otam bammayim
Uteqareb yat aharon veyat benohi litra mashkan zimna vetasche yatehon bemayya:
Vehilbashta et-aharon et bigde haqqodesh umashachta oto veqiddashta oto vekihen li
Vetalbesh yat aharon yat lebushe qudesha uterabbe yateh uteqaddesh yateh vishammesh qodamay:
Veet-banayv taqrib vehilbashta otam kuttonot
Veyat benohi teqareb vetalbesh yatehon kittunin:
Umashachta otam kaasher mashachta et-abihem vekihanu li vehayeta lihyot lahem moshchatam likhunnat olam ledorotam
Uterabbe yatehon kema di rabbeta yat abuhon vishammeshun qodamay utehe lemeheve lehon rebutehon lekahanut alam ledarehon:
Vayyaas mosheh kekol asher tzivva Adonai oto ken asa
Vaabad msheh kekol di paqqid Adonai yateh ken abad:
Vayehi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit beechad lachodesh huqam hammishkan
Vahava beyarcha qadmaa beshatta tinyeta bechad leyarcha ittaqam mashkena:
Vayyaqem mosheh et-hammishkan vayyitten et-adanayv vayyasem et-qerashayv vayyitten et-berichayv vayyaqem et-ammudayv
Vaaqem msheh yat mashkena vihab yat sammekohi veshavvi yat dappohi vihab yat abrohi vaaqem yat ammudohi:
Vayyipros et-haohel al-hammishkan vayyasem et-mikseh haohel alayv milmaela kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Uperas yat perasa al mashkena veshavvi yat chopaa demashkena alohi milleella kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyiqqach vayyitten et-haedut el-haaron vayyasem et-habbaddim al-haaron vayyitten et-hakkapporet al-haaron milmaela
Unesib vihab yat sahaduta laarona veshavvi yat arichayya al arona vihab yat kappurta al arona milella:
Vayyabe et-haaron el-hammishkan vayyasem et paroket hammasak vayyasek al aron haedut kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veael yat arona lemashkena veshavvi yat parukta diprasa veattel al arona desahaduta kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyitten et-hashshulchan beohel moed al yerek hammishkan tzapona michutz lapparoket
Vihab yat patora bemashkan zimna al tzidda demashkena tzippuna mibbara leparukta:
Vayyaarok alayv erek lechem lipne Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vesaddar alohi siddur dilchem qodam Adonai kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyasem et-hammenora beohel moed nokach hashshulchan al yerek hammishkan negba
Veshavvi yat menarta bemashkan zimna loqobel patora al tzidda demashkena ledaroma:
Vayyaal hannerot lipne Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veadleq botzinaha qodam Adonai kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyasem et-mizbach hazzahab beohel moed lipne happaroket
Veshavvi yat madbecha dedahaba bemashkan zimna qodam parukta:
Vayyaqter alayv qetoret sammim kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veaqtar alohi qetoret busemin kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyasem et-masak happetach lammishkan
Veshavvi yat perasa detara lemashkena:
Veet mizbach haola sam petach mishkan ohel-moed vayyaal alayv et-haola veet-hammincha kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veyat madbecha daalata shavvi bitra mashkena mashkan zimna veasseq alohi yat alata veyat minchata kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyasem et-hakkiyyor ben-ohel moed uben hammizbeach vayyitten shamma mayim lerochtza
Veshavvi yat kiyora ben mashkan zimna uben madbecha vihab tamman mayya leqiddush:
Verachatzu mimmennu mosheh veaharon ubanayv et-yedehem veet-raglehem
Viqaddeshun minneh msheh veaharon ubenohi yat yedehon veyat raglehon:
Beboam el-ohel moed ubeqorbatam el-hammizbeach yirchatzu kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Bemealhon lemashkan zimna ubemiqrabehon lemadbecha yeqaddeshun kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaqem et-hechatzer sabib lammishkan velammizbeach vayyitten et-masak shaar hechatzer vayekal mosheh et-hammelaka
Vaaqem yat darta sechor sechor lemashkena ulemadbecha vihab yat perasa ditra darta veshetze msheh yat ibida:
Vayekas heanan et-ohel moed ukebod Adonai male et-hammishkan
Vachapa anana yat mashkan zimna viqara daAdonai itmeli yat mashkena:
Velo-yakol mosheh labo el-ohel moed ki-shakan alayv heanan ukebod Adonai male et-hammishkan
Vela yakil msheh lemeal lemashkan zimna are shera alohi anana viqara daAdonai itmeli yat mashkena:
Ubehealot heanan meal hammishkan yisu bene yisrael bekol masehem
Ubeistallaqut anana meillave mashkena natelin bene yisrael bekol mattelanehon:
Veim-lo yealeh heanan velo yisu ad-yom healoto
Veim la yistallaq anana vela natelin ad yoma deistallaquteh:
Ki anan Adonai al-hammishkan yomam veesh tihyeh layla bo leene kol-bet-yisrael bekol-masehem
Are anana yeqara daAdonai al mashkena bimama vechezu eshshata have beleleya beh leene kol bet yisrael bekol mattelanehon:
Leviticus: Vayyiqra el-mosheh vayedabber Adonai elayv meohel moed lemor
Uqera lemsheh umallel Adonai immeh mimmashkan zimna lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem adam ki-yaqrib mikkem qorban la-Adonai min-habbehema min-habbaqar umin-hatztzon taqribu et-qorbankem
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon enash are yeqareb minnekon qurbana qodam Adonai min beira min tore umin ana teqarebun yat qurbankon:
Im-ola qorbano min-habbaqar zakar tamim yaqribennu el-petach ohel moed yaqrib oto lirtzono lipne Adonai
Im alata qurbaneh min tore dekar shelim yeqarebinneh litra mashkan zimna yeqareb yateh leraava leh qodam Adonai:
Vesamak yado al rosh haola venirtza lo lekapper alayv
Veyismok yedeh al resh alata veyitree leh lekappara alohi:
Veshachat et-ben habbaqar lipne Adonai vehiqribu bene aharon hakkohanim et-haddam vezarequ et-haddam al-hammizbeach sabib asher-petach ohel moed
Veyikkos yat bar tore qodam Adonai viqarebun bene aharon kahanayya yat dema veyizrequn yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor di bitra mashkan zimna:
Vehipshit et-haola venittach otah lintacheha
Veyashlach yat alata vipalleg yatah leebraha:
Venatenu bene aharon hakkohen esh al-hammizbeach veareku etzim al-haesh
Veyittenun bene aharon kahana eshshata al madbecha visadderun aayya al eshshata:
Veareku bene aharon hakkohanim et hannetachim et-harosh veet-happader al-haetzim asher al-haesh asher al-hammizbeach
Visadderun bene aharon kahanayya yat ebrayya yat resha veyat tarba al aayya di al eshata di al madbecha:
Veqirbo ukeraayv yirchatz bammayim vehiqtir hakkohen et-hakkol hammizbecha ola ishsheh reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Vegaveh ukeraohi yechallel bemayya veyasseq kahana yat kola lemadbecha alata qurban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai:
Veim-min-hatztzon qorbano min-hakkesabim o min-haizzim leola zakar tamim yaqribennu
Veim min ana qurbaneh min immerayya o min bene izayya laalata dekar shelim yeqarebineh:
Veshachat oto al yerek hammizbeach tzapona lipne Adonai vezarequ bene aharon hakkohanim et-damo al-hammizbeach sabib
Veyikkos yateh al tzidda demadbecha tzippuna qodam Adonai veyizrequn bene aharon kahanayya yat demeh al madbecha sechor sechor:
Venittach oto lintachayv veet-rosho veet-pidro vearak hakkohen otam al-haetzim asher al-haesh asher al-hammizbeach
Vipalleg yateh leebarohi veyat resheh veyat tarbeh veyasdar kahana yatehon al aayya di al eshshata di al madbecha:
Vehaqqereb vehakkeraayim yirchatz bammayim vehiqrib hakkohen et-hakkol vehiqtir hammizbecha ola hu ishsheh reach nichoach la-Adonai
Vegavva ukeraayya yechallel bemayya viqareb kahana yat kola veyasseq lemadbecha alata hu qurban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai:
Veim min-haop ola qorbano la-Adonai vehiqrib min-hattorim o min-bene hayyona et-qorbano
Veim min opa alata qurbaneh qodam Adonai viqareb min shapninayya o min bene yona yat qurbaneh:
Vehiqribo hakkohen el-hammizbeach umalaq et-rosho vehiqtir hammizbecha venimtza damo al qir hammizbeach
Viqarebineh kahana lemadbecha veyimloq yat resheh veyasseq lemadbecha veyittimtze demeh al kotel madbecha:
Vehesir et-murato benotzatah vehishlik otah etzel hammizbeach qedema el-meqom haddashen
Veyaadde yat zepaqeh beukeleh veyirme yatah listar madbecha qiduma laatar demoshedin qitma:
Veshissa oto biknapayv lo yabdil vehiqtir oto hakkohen hammizbecha al-haetzim asher al-haesh ola hu ishsheh reach nichoach la-Adonai
Vipareq yateh begadpohi la yapresh veyasseq yateh kahana lemadbecha al aayya di al eshshata alata hu qurban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai:
Venepesh ki-taqrib qorban mincha la-Adonai solet yihyeh qorbano veyatzaq aleha shemen venatan aleha lebona
Veenash are yeqareb qurban minchata qodam Adonai suleta yehe qurbaneh viriq alah mishcha veyitten alah leboneta:
Vehebiah el-bene aharon hakkohanim veqamatz mishsham melo qumtzo missoltah umishshamnah al kol-lebonatah vehiqtir hakkohen et-azkaratah hammizbecha ishsheh reach nichoach la-Adonai
Veyaytinnah levat bene aharon kahanayya veyiqmotz mittamman mele qumtzeh missulta umimmishchah al kol lebonetah veyasseq kahana yat adkartah lemadbecha qurban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai:
Vehannoteret min-hammincha leaharon ulebanayv qodesh qodashim meishshe Adonai
Udeishtaar min minchata leaharon velibnohi qodesh qudeshin miqqurbanayya daAdonai:
Veki taqrib qorban mincha maapeh tannur solet challot matztzot belulot bashshemen ureqiqe matztzot meshuchim bashshamen
Vaare teqareb qurban minchata maapeh tannura suleta geritzan pattiran depilan bimshach veaspogin pattirin dimshichin bimshach:
Veim-mincha al-hammachabat qorbaneka solet belula bashshemen matztza tihyeh
Veim minchata al masreta qurbanak suleta depila bimshach pattir tehe:
Patot otah pittim veyatzaqta aleha shamen mincha hiv
Betza yatah bitzuin uteriq alah mishcha minchata hi:
Veim-minchat marcheshet qorbaneka solet bashshemen teaseh
Veim minchata deradta qurbanak suleta bimshach titabed:
Vehebeta et-hammincha asher yeaseh meelleh la-Adonai vehiqribah el-hakkohen vehiggishah el-hammizbeach
Vetayte yat minchata di yitabed meillen qodam Adonai viqarbina levat kahana viqarbinnah lemadbecha:
Veherim hakkohen min-hammincha et-azkaratah vehiqtir hammizbecha ishsheh reach nichoach la-Adonai
Veyapresh kahana min minchata yat adkarta veyasseq lemadbecha qurban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai:
Vehannoteret min-hammincha leaharon ulebanayv qodesh qodashim meishshe Adonai
Udeishtaar min minchata leaharon velibnohi qodesh qudeshin miqqurbanayya daAdonai:
Kol-hammincha asher taqribu la-Adonai lo teaseh chametz ki kol-seor vekol-debash lo-taqtiru mimmennu ishsheh la-Adonai
Kol minchata di teqarebun qodam Adonai la titabed chamia are kol chamir vekol debash la tassequn minneh qurbana qodam Adonai:
Qorban reshit taqribu otam la-Adonai veel-hammizbeach lo-yaalu lereach nichoach
Qurban qadmay teqarebun yatehon qodam Adonai ulemadbecha la yittassequn leitqabbala beraava:
Vekol-qorban minchateka bammelach timlach velo tashbit melach berit eloheka meal minchateka al kol-qorbaneka taqrib melach
Vekol qurban minchatak bemilcha timlach vela tebattel melach qeyam elahak meal minchatak al kol qurbanak teqareb milcha:
Veim-taqrib minchat bikkurim la-Adonai abib qaluy baesh geres karmel taqrib et minchat bikkureka
Veim teqareb minchat bikkurin qodam Adonai abib qele benur perokan rakkikan teqareb yat minchat bikkurak:
Venatatta aleha shemen vesamta aleha lebona mincha hiv
Vetitten alah mishcha uteshavve alah leboneta minchata hi:
Vehiqtir hakkohen et-azkaratah miggirsah umishshamnah al kol-lebonatah ishsheh la-Adonai
Veyasseq kahana yat idkartah mipperukah umimmishchah al kol lebonetah qurbana qodam Adonai:
Veim-zebach shelamim qorbano im min-habbaqar hu maqrib im-zakar im-neqeba tamim yaqribennu lipne Adonai
Veim niksat qudeshayya qurbaneh im min tore hu meqareb im dekar im nuqeba shelim yeqarebineh qodam Adonai:
Vesamak yado al-rosh qorbano ushechato petach ohel moed vezarequ bene aharon hakkohanim et-haddam al-hammizbeach sabib
Veyismok yedeh al resh qurbaneh veyikkesinneh bitra mashkan zimna veyizrequn bene aharon kahanayya yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor:
Vehiqrib mizzebach hashshelamim ishsheh la-Adonai et-hacheleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veet kol-hacheleb asher al-haqqereb
Viqareb minniksat qudeshayya qurbana qodam Adonai yat tarba dechape yat gavva veyat kol tarba di al gavva:
Veet shete hakkelayot veet-hacheleb asher alehen asher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabed al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tarten kaleyan veyat tarba di alehen di al gissayya veyat chatzra deal kabda al kaleyeta yaaddinnah:
Vehiqtiru oto bene-aharon hammizbecha al-haola asher al-haetzim asher al-haesh ishsheh reach nichoach la-Adonai
Veyasqun yateh bene aharon lemadbecha al alata di al aayya di al eshshata qurban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai:
Veim-min-hatztzon qorbano lezebach shelamim la-Adonai zakar o neqeba tamim yaqribennu
Veim min ana qurbaneh leniksat qudeshayya qodam Adonai dekar o nuqba shelim yeqarebinneh:
Im-keseb hu-maqrib et-qorbano vehiqrib oto lipne Adonai
Im imar hu meqareb yat qurbaneh viqareb yateh qodam Adonai:
Vesamak et-yado al-rosh qorbano veshachat oto lipne ohel moed vezarequ bene aharon et-damo al-hammizbeach sabib
Veyismok yat yedeh al resh qurbaneh veyikkos yateh qodam mashkan zimna veyizrequn bene aharon yat demeh al madbecha sechor sechor:
Vehiqrib mizzebach hashshelamim ishsheh la-Adonai chelbo haalya temima leummat heatzeh yesirenna veet-hacheleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veet kol-hacheleb asher al-haqqereb
Viqareb minniksat qudeshayya qurbana qodam Adonai tarbeh alita shelimeta loqobel shezarta yedinnah veyat tareba dechape yat gavva veyat kol tarba di al gavva:
Veet shete hakkelayot veet-hacheleb asher alehen asher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabed al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tarten kaleyan veyat tarba di alehen di al gissayya veyat chatzra deal kabda al kaleyeta yedinnah:
Vehiqtiro hakkohen hammizbecha lechem ishsheh la-Adonai
Veyasseqinneh kahana lemadbecha lechem qurbana qodam Adonai:
Veim ez qorbano vehiqribo lipne Adonai
Veim min bene izzayya qurbaneh viqarebinneh qodam Adonai:
Vesamak et-yado al-rosho veshachat oto lipne ohel moed vezarequ bene aharon et-damo al-hammizbeach sabib
Veyismok yat yedeh al resheh veyikkos yateh qodam mashkan zimna veyizrequn bene aharon yat demeh al madbecha sechor sechor:
Vehiqrib mimmennu qorbano ishsheh la-Adonai et-hacheleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veet kol-hacheleb asher al-haqqereb
Viqareb minneh qurbaneh qurban qodam Adonai yat tarba dechape yat gavva veyat kol tarba di al gavva:
Veet shete hakkelayot veet-hacheleb asher alehen asher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabed al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tarten kaleyan veyat tarba di alehen di al gissayya veyat chatzra di al kabda al kaleyeta yedinnah:
Vehiqtiram hakkohen hammizbecha lechem ishsheh lereach nichoach kol-cheleb la-Adonai
Veyasseqinnun kahana lemadbecha lechem qurbana leitqabbala beraava kol tarba qodam Adonai:
Chuqqat olam ledorotekem bekol moshebotekem kol-cheleb vekol-dam lo tokelu
Qeyam alam ledaratekon bekol motebanekon kol tarba vekol dema la tekelun:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor nepesh ki-techeta bishgaga mikkol mitzvot Adonai asher lo teasena veasa meachat mehenna
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar enash are yechob beshalu mikkol piqqudayya daAdonai di la kashrin leitabada veyabed min chad minnehon:
Im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta leashmat haam vehiqrib al chattato asher chata par ben-baqar tamim la-Adonai lechattat
Im kahana rabba yechob lechobat amma viqareb al chobeteh di chab tor bar tore shelim qodam Adonai lechattata:
Vehebi et-happar el-petach ohel moed lipne Adonai vesamak et-yado al-rosh happar veshachat et-happar lipne Adonai
Veyayti yat tora litra mashkan zimna loqodam Adonai veyismok yat yedeh al resh tora veyikkos yat tora qodom Adonai:
Velaqach hakkohen hammashiach middam happar vehebi oto el-ohel moed
Veyissab kahana rabba middema detora veyael yateh lemashkan zimna:
Vetabal hakkohen et-etzbao baddam vehizza min-haddam sheba peamim lipne Adonai et-pene paroket haqqodesh
Veyitbol kahana yat etzbeeh bidma veyaddi min dema sheba zimnin qodam Adonai qodam paruketa dequdesha:
Venatan hakkohen min-haddam al-qarnot mizbach qetoret hassammim lipne Adonai asher beohel moed veet kol-dam happar yishpok el-yesod mizbach haola asher-petach ohel moed
Veyitten kahana min dema al qarnat madbach diqtoret busemaya qodam Adonai di bemashkan zimna veyat kol dema detora yeshud lisoda demadbecha daalata di bitra mashkan zimna:
Veet-kol-cheleb par hachattat yarim mimmennu et-hacheleb hamekasseh al-haqqereb veet kol-hacheleb asher al-haqqereb
Veyat kol terab tora dechattata yapresh minneh yat tarba dechape al gavva veyat kol tarba di al gavva:
Veet shete hakkelayot veet-hacheleb asher alehen asher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabed al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tarten kaleyan veyat tarba di alehon di al gissayya veyat chitzra deal kabda al kaleyeta yedinnah:
Kaasher yuram mishshor zebach hashshelamim vehiqtiram hakkohen al mizbach haola
Kema di mittaprash mittor niksat qudeshayya veyasseqinnun kahana al madbecha daalata:
Veet-or happar veet-kol-besaro al-rosho veal-keraayv veqirbo upirsho
Veyat meshak tora veyat kol bisreh al resheh veal keraohi vegavveh veukeleh:
Vehotzi et-kol-happar el-michutz lammachaneh el-maqom tahor el-shepek haddeshen vesarap oto al-etzim baesh al-shepek haddeshen yissarep
Veyappeq yat kol tora mibbara lemashrita laatar deke laatar bet meshad qitma veyoqid yateh al aayya beeshshata al atar bet meshad qitma yittoqad:
Veim kol-adat yisrael yishgu venelam dabar meene haqqahal veasu achat mikkol-mitzvot Adonai asher lo-teasena veashemu
Veim kol kenishta deyisrael yishtelun vihe mekassa pitgama meene qehala veyabedun chad mikkol piqqudayya daAdonai di la kasherin leitabada vichobun:
Venodea hachattat asher chateu aleha vehiqribu haqqahal par ben-baqar lechattat vehebiu oto lipne ohel moed
Vetityeda chobeta di chabu alah viqarbun qehala tor bar tore lechattata veyaytun yateh loqodam mashkan zimna:
Vesameku ziqne haeda et-yedehem al-rosh happar lipne Adonai veshachat et-happar lipne Adonai
Veyismekun sabe kenishta yat yedehon al resh tora qodam Adonai veyikkos yat tora qodam Adonai:
Vehebi hakkohen hammashiach middam happar el-ohel moed
Veyael kahana rabba min dema detora lemashkan zimna:
Vetabal hakkohen etzbao min-haddam vehizza sheba peamim lipne Adonai et pene happaroket
Veyitbol kahana itzbeeh min dema veyaddi sheba zimnin qodam Adonai qodam parukta:
Umin-haddam yitten al-qarnot hammizbeach asher lipne Adonai asher beohel moed veet kol-haddam yishpok el-yesod mizbach haola asher-petach ohel moed
Umin dema yitten al qarnat madbecha di qodam Adonai di bemashkan zimna veyat kol dema yeshod lisoda demadbecha daalata di bitra mashkan zimna:
Veet kol-chelbo yarim mimmennu vehiqtir hammizbecha
Veyat kol tarbeh yapresh minneh veyasseq lemadbecha:
Veasa lappar kaasher asa lepar hachattat ken yaaseh-lo vekipper alehem hakkohen venislach lahem
Veyabed letora kema di abad letora dechattata ken yabed leh vikapper alehon kahana veyishtebeq lehon:
Vehotzi et-happar el-michutz lammachaneh vesarap oto kaasher sarap et happar harishon chattat haqqahal hu
Veyappeq yat tora lemibbara lemashrita veoqid yateh kema di oqid yat tora qadmaa chattat qehala hu:
Asher nasi yecheta veasa achat mikkol-mitzvot Adonai elohayv asher lo-teasena bishgaga veashem
Im rabba yechob veyabed chad mikkol piqqudayya daAdonai elaheh di la kashrin leitabada beshalu veyechob:
O-hoda elayv chattato asher chata bah vehebi et-qorbano seir izzim zakar tamim
O ityeda leh chobeteh di chab bah veyayti yat qurbaneh tzepir bar izzin dekar shelim:
Vesamak yado al-rosh hassair veshachat oto bimqom asher-yishchat et-haola lipne Adonai chattat hu
Veyismok yedeh al resha ditzpira veyikkos yateh baatar deyikkos yat alata loqodam Adonai chattata hu:
Velaqach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao venatan al-qarnot mizbach haola veet-damo yishpok el-yesod mizbach haola
Veyissab kahana middema dechattata beetzbeeh veyitten al qarnat madbecha daalata veyat demeh yeshod lisoda demadbecha daalata:
Veet-kol-chelbo yaqtir hammizbecha kecheleb zebach hashshelamim vekipper alayv hakkohen mechattato venislach lo
Veyat kol tarbeh yasseq lemadbecha kitrab niksat qudeshayya vikapper alohi kahana mechobeteh veyishtebeq leh:
Veim-nepesh achat techeta bishgaga meam haaretz baasotah achat mimmitzvot Adonai asher lo-teasena veashem
Veim enash chad yechob beshalu meamma deara bemebedah chad mippiqqudayya daAdonai di la kashrin leitabada veyechob:
O hoda elayv chattato asher chata vehebi qorbano seirat izzim temima neqeba al-chattato asher chata
O ityeda leh chobeteh di chab veyayti qurbaneh tzepirat izzin shelemta nequbeta al chobeteh di chab:
Vesamak et-yado al rosh hachattat veshachat et-hachattat bimqom haola
Veyismok yat yedeh al resh chattata veyikkos yat chattata baatar daalata:
Velaqach hakkohen middamah beetzbao venatan al-qarnot mizbach haola veet-kol-damah yishpok el-yesod hammizbeach
Veyissab kahana midmah beetzbeeh veyitten al qarnat madbecha daalata veyat kol demah yeshod lisoda demadbecha:
Veet-kol-chelbah yasir kaasher husar cheleb meal zebach hashshelamim vehiqtir hakkohen hammizbecha lereach nichoach la-Adonai vekipper alayv hakkohen venislach lo
Veyat kol tarbah yede kema di mittada terab meal niksat qudeshayya veyasseq kahana lemadbecha leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai vikapper alohi kahana veyishtebeq leh:
Veim-kebes yabi qorbano lechattat neqeba temima yebienna
Veim imar yayti qurbaneh lechattata nuqba shelemta yaytinnah:
Vesamak et-yado al rosh hachattat veshachat otah lechattat bimqom asher yishchat et-haola
Veyismok yat yedeh al resh chattata veyikkos yatah lechattata beatra di yikkos yat alata:
Velaqach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao venatan al-qarnot mizbach haola veet-kol-damah yishpok el-yesod hammizbeach
Veyissab kahana middema dechattata beetzbeeh veyitten al qarnat madbecha daalata veyat kol demah yeshod lisoda demadbecha:
Veet-kol-chelbah yasir kaasher yusar cheleb-hakkeseb mizzebach hashshelamim vehiqtir hakkohen otam hammizbecha al ishshe Adonai vekipper alayv hakkohen al-chattato asher-chata venislach lo
Veyat kol tarbah yede kema di mittada terab immera minniksat qudeshayya veyasseq kahana yatehon lemadbecha al qurbenayya daAdonai vikapper alohi kahana al chobeteh di chab veyishtebeq leh:
Venepesh ki-techeta veshamea qol ala vehu ed o raa o yada im-lo yaggid venasa avono
Veenash are yechob veyishma qal mome vehu sahid o chaza o yeda im la yechavvi viqabbel chobeh:
O nepesh asher tigga bekol-dabar tame o beniblat chayya temea o beniblat behema temea o beniblat sheretz tame venelam mimmennu vehu tame veashem
O enash di yiqrab bekol middaam mesaab o beniblat chayta mesaaba o beniblat beira mesaaba o beniblat richasha mesaab vihe mekassa minneh vehu mesaab vechab:
O ki yigga betumat adam lekol tumato asher yitma bah venelam mimmennu vehu yada veashem
O are yiqrab besoabat enasha lekol sobeteh di yistaab bah vihe mekassa minneh vehu yada vechab:
O nepesh ki tishshaba lebatte bispatayim lehara o lehetib lekol asher yebatte haadam bishbua venelam mimmennu vehu-yada veashem leachat meelleh
O enash are yeqayyem leparasha besipvan leabasha o leotaba lekol di yeparesh enasha beqiyyum vihe mekassa minneh vehu yada vechab lachada meillen:
Vehaya ki-yesham leachat meelleh vehitvadda asher chata aleha
Vihe are yechob lachada meillen vivaddi di chab alah:
Vehebi et-ashamo la-Adonai al chattato asher chata neqeba min-hatztzon kisba o-seirat izzim lechattat vekipper alayv hakkohen mechattato
Veyayti yat ashmeh qodam Adonai al chobeteh di chab nequbeta min ana immerata o tzepirat izzin lechatata vikapper alohi kahana mechobeteh:
Veim-lo taggia yado de seh vehebi et-ashamo asher chata shete torim o-shene bene-yona la-Adonai echad lechattat veechad leola
Veim la timte yedeh kemissat seta veyayti yat chobeteh di chab tarten shapninin o teren bene yona qodam Adonai chad lechattata vechad laalata:
Vehebi otam el-hakkohen vehiqrib et-asher lachattat rishona umalaq et-rosho mimmul orpo velo yabdil
Veyayti yatehon levat kahana viqareb yat di lechattata qadmeta veyimloq yat resheh milloqobel qedaleh vela yapresh:
Vehizza middam hachattat al-qir hammizbeach vehannishar baddam yimmatzeh el-yesod hammizbeach chattat hu
Veyaddi middema dechattata al kotel madbecha udeishtaar bidma yittimtze lisoda demadbecha chattata hu:
Veet-hashsheni yaaseh ola kammishpat vekipper alayv hakkohen mechattato asher-chata venislach lo
Veyat tinyana yabed alata kidchaze vikapper alohi kahana mechobeteh di chab veyishtebeq leh:
Veim-lo tassig yado lishte torim o lishne bene-yona vehebi et-qorbano asher chata asirit haepa solet lechattat lo-yasim aleha shemen velo-yitten aleha lebona ki chattat hiv
Veim la tadbeq yedeh letarten shapninin o litren bene yona veyayti yat qurbaneh di chab chad min asra bitlat sein sulta lechattata la yeshavvi alah mishcha vela yitten alah lebunta are chattata hi:
Vehebiah el-hakkohen veqamatz hakkohen mimmenna melo qumtzo et-azkaratah vehiqtir hammizbecha al ishshe Adonai chattat hiv
Veyaytinnah levat kahana veyiqmotz kahana minnah mele qumtzeh yat idkartah veyasseq lemadbecha al qurbanayya daAdonai chattata hi:
Vekipper alayv hakkohen al-chattato asher-chata meachat meelleh venislach lo vehayeta lakkohen kammincha
Vikapper alohi kahana al chobeteh di chab mechada meillen veyishtebeq leh utehe lekahana keminchata:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Nepesh ki-timol maal vechatea bishgaga miqqodshe Adonai vehebi et-ashamo la-Adonai ayil tamim min-hatztzon beerkeka kesep-sheqalim besheqel-haqqodesh leasham
Enash are yeshaqqar sheqar veyechob beshalu miqudeshayya daAdonai veyayti yat ashmeh qodam Adonai dekar shelim min ana bepursaneh kesap silin besile qudesha laashama:
Veet asher chata min-haqqodesh yeshallem veet-chamishito yosep alayv venatan oto lakkohen vehakkohen yekapper alayv beel haasham venislach lo
Veyat di chab min qudesha yeshallem veyat chumsheh yosep alohi veyitten yateh lekahana vekahana yekapper alohi bedikra daashama veyishtebeq leh:
Veim-nepesh ki techeta veaseta achat mikkol-mitzvot Adonai asher lo teasena velo-yada veashem venasa avono
Veim enash are yechob veyabed chada mikkol piqqodayya daAdonai di la kasherin leitabada vela yada veyechob viqabbel chobeh:
Vehebi ayil tamim min-hatztzon beerkeka leasham el-hakkohen vekipper alayv hakkohen al shiggato asher-shagag vehu lo-yada venislach lo
Veyayti dekar shelim min ana bepursaneh laashama levat kahana vikapper alohi kahana al shaluteh deishteli vehu la yada veyishtebeq leh:
Asham hu ashom asham la-Adonai
Ashama hu al chobeteh dehu chab ashama yeqareb qodam Adonai:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Nepesh ki techeta umaala maal ba-Adonai vekichesh baamito bepiqqadon o-bitsumet yad o begazel o ashaq et-amito
Enash are yechob vishaqqar sheqar qodam Adonai vikadeb bechabreh bpiqqedona o beshuttaput yeda o bigzela o annis yat chabreh:
O-matza abeda vekichesh bah venishba al-shaqer al-achat mikkol asher-yaaseh haadam lachato bahenna
O ashkach abedeta vikaddeb bah veishteba al shiqra al chada mikkol di yabed enasha lemechab behen:
Vehaya ki-yecheta veashem veheshib et-haggezela asher gazal o et-haosheq asher ashaq o et-happiqqadon asher hopqad itto o et-haabeda asher matza
Vihe are yechete veyechob veyateb yat gezela di gezal o yat ushqa di ashaq o yat piqqedona di itpaqqad levateh o yat abedeta di ashkach:
O mikkol asher-yishshaba alayv lashsheqer veshillam oto berosho vachamishitayv yosep alayv laasher hu lo yittenennu beyom ashmato
O mikkol di yishteba alohi leshiqra vishallem yateh beresheh vechumsheh yosep alohi ledi hu dileh yitteninneh beyoma dechobeteh:
Veet-ashamo yabi la-Adonai ayil tamim min-hatztzon beerkeka leasham el-hakkohen
Veyat ashmah yayti loqodam Adonai dekar shelim min ana bepursaneh laashama levat kahana:
Vekipper alayv hakkohen lipne Adonai venislach lo al-achat mikkol asher-yaaseh leashma bah
Vikapper alohi kahana qodam Adonai veyishtebeq leh al chada mikkol di yabed lemechab bah:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Tzav et-aharon veet-banayv lemor zot torat haola hiv haola al moqeda al-hammizbeach kol-hallayla ad-habboqer veesh hammizbeach tuqad bo
Paqqed yat aharon veyat benohi lememar da orayta daalata hi alata al demittoqeda al madbecha kol leleya ad tzapra veeshshata demadbecha tehe yaqeda beh:
Velabash hakkohen middo bad umikenese-bad yilbash al-besaro veherim et-haddeshen asher tokal haesh et-haola al-hammizbeach vesamo etzel hammizbeach
Veyalbesh kahana lebushin debutz umiknesin debutz yalbesh al bisreh veyapresh yat qitma di tekul eshshata yat alata al madbecha vishavvinneh bistar madbecha:
Upashat et-begadayv velabash begadim acherim vehotzi et-haddeshen el-michutz lammachaneh el-maqom tahor
Veyashlach yat lebushohi veyilbash lebushin ochoranin veyappeq yat qitma lemibbara lemashrita laatar deke:
Vehaesh al-hammizbeach tuqad-bo lo tikbeh ubier aleha hakkohen etzim babboqer babboqer vearak aleha haola vehiqtir aleha chelbe hashshelamim
Veeshshata al madbecha tehe yaqeda beh la tittepe veyabar alah kahana aayya bitzpar bitzpar veyasdar allah alata veyasseq alah tarbe niksat qudeshayya:
Esh tamid tuqad al-hammizbeach lo tikbeh
Eshshata tedira tehe yaqeda al madbecha la tittepe:
Vezot torat hammincha haqreb otah bene-aharon lipne Adonai el-pene hammizbeach
Veda orayta deminchata diqarebun yatah bene aharon qodam Adonai loqodam madbecha:
Veherim mimmennu bequmtzo missolet hammincha umishshamnah veet kol-hallebona asher al-hammincha vehiqtir hammizbeach reach nichoach azkaratah la-Adonai
Veyapresh minneh bequmtzeh missulta deminchata umimmishchah veyat kol lebuneta di al minchata veyasseq lemadbecha leitqabbala beraava adkarta qodam Adonai:
Vehannoteret mimmenna yokelu aharon ubanayv matztzot teakel bemaqom qadosh bachatzar ohel-moed yokeluha
Udeishtaar minnah yekelun aharon ubenohi pattir titakel baatar qaddish bedarat mishkan zimna yekelunnah:
Lo teapeh chametz chelqam natatti otah meishshay qodesh qodashim hiv kachattat vekaasham
La titape chamia cholaqehon yehabit yatah miqqurbanay qodesh qudeshin hi kechattata vekaashama:
Kol-zakar bibne aharon yokelenna choq-olam ledorotekem meishshe Adonai kol asher-yigga bahem yiqdash
Kol dekura bibne aharon yekelunnah qeyam alam ledaratekon miqqurbanayya daAdonai kol deyiqrab behon yitqaddash:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Zeh qorban aharon ubanayv asher-yaqribu la-Adonai beyom himmashach oto asirit haepa solet mincha tamid machatzitah babboqer umachatzitah baareb
Den qurban aharon ubenohi di yeqarebun qodam Adonai beyoma derabbiu yateh chad min asra bitlat sein sulta minchata tedira palgutah betzapra upalgutah beramsha:
Al-machabat bashshemen teaseh murbeket tebienna tupine minchat pittim taqrib reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Al masreta bimshach titabed rebika taytinnah tupine minchat bitztzuin teqareb leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai:
Vehakkohen hammashiach tachtayv mibbanayv yaaseh otah choq-olam la-Adonai kalil toqtar
Vekahana dimrabba techotohi mibbenohi yabed yatah qeyam alam qodam Adonai gemir tittassaq:
Vekol-minchat kohen kalil tihyeh lo teakel
Vekol minchata dekahana gemir tehe la titakel:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banayv lemor zot torat hachattat bimqom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat lipne Adonai qodesh qodashim hiv
Mallel im aharon veim benohi lememar da orayta dechattata beatar di titnekes alata titnekes chattata qodam Adonai qodesh qudeshin hi:
Hakkohen hamechatte otah yokelenna bemaqom qadosh teakel bachatzar ohel moed
Kahana dimkapper bidmah yekelinnah baatar qaddish titakel bedarat mashkan zimna:
Kol asher-yigga bibsarah yiqdash vaasher yizzeh middamah al-habbeged asher yizzeh aleha tekabbes bemaqom qadosh
Kol di yiqrab bebisrah yitqaddash vedi yaddi middemah al lebush di yaddi alah titchavvar baatar qaddish:
Ukeli-cheres asher tebushshal-bo yishshaber veim-bikli nechoshet bushshala umoraq veshuttap bammayim
Uman dachasap di titbashshel beh yittabar veim bemana dinchasha titbashshel veyitmereq veyishtattep bemayya:
Kol-zakar bakkohanim yokal otah qodesh qodashim hiv
Kol dekura bekahanayya yekul yatah qodesh qudeshin hi:
Vekol-chattat asher yuba middamah el-ohel moed lekapper baqqodesh lo teakel baesh tissarep
Vekol chattata di yittaal middemah lemashkan zimna lekappara bequdesha la titakel benura tittoqad:
Vezot torat haasham qodesh qodashim hu
Veda orayta daashama qodesh qudeshin hu:
Bimqom asher yishchatu et-haola yishchatu et-haasham veet-damo yizroq al-hammizbeach sabib
Beatra di yikkesun yat alata yikkesun yat ashama veyat demeh yizraq al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet kol-chelbo yaqrib mimmennu et haalya veet-hacheleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb
Veyat kol tarbeh yapresh minneh yat alita veyat tarba dechape yat gavva:
Veet shete hakkelayot veet-hacheleb asher alehen asher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabed al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tarten kaleyan veyat tarba di alehen di al gissayya veyat chitzra deal kabda al kaleyeta yedinnah:
Vehiqtir otam hakkohen hammizbecha ishsheh la-Adonai asham hu
Veyasseq yatehon kahana lemadbecha qurbana qodam Adonai ashama hu:
Kol-zakar bakkohanim yokelennu bemaqom qadosh yeakel qodesh qodashim hu
Kol dekura bekahanayya yekelinneh baatar qaddish yitakal qodesh qudeshin hu:
Kachattat kaasham tora achat lahem hakkohen asher yekapper-bo lo yihyeh
Kechattata kaashama orayta chada lehon kahana di yekapper beh dileh yehe:
Vehakkohen hammaqrib et-olat ish or haola asher hiqrib lakkohen lo yihyeh
Vekahana dimqareb yat alat gebar meshak alata di yeqareb lekahana dileh yehe:
Vekol-mincha asher teapeh battannur vekol-naasa bammarcheshet veal-machabat lakkohen hammaqrib otah lo tiheyeh
Vekol minchata di titape betannura vekol detitabed beridta veal masreta lekahana dimqareb yatah dileh tehe:
Vekol-mincha belula-bashshemen vachareba lekol-bene aharon tihyeh ish keachiv
Vekol minchata depila bimshach udela pila lekol bene aharon tehe gebar keachohi:
Vezot torat zebach hashshelamim asher yaqrib la-Adonai
Veda orayta deniksat qudeshayya di yeqareb qodam Adonai:
Im al-toda yaqribennu vehiqrib al-zebach hattoda challot matztzot belulot bashshemen ureqiqe matztzot meshuchim bashshamen vesolet murbeket challot belulot bashshamen
Im al todeta yeqarebinneh viqareb al niksat todeta geritzan pattiran depilan bimshach veespogin pattirin dimshichin bimshach vesulta rebika geritzan depilan bimshach:
Al-challot lechem chametz yaqrib qorbano al-zebach todat shelamayv
Al geritzan dilchem chamia yeqareb qurbaneh al niksat todat qudeshohi:
Vehiqrib mimmennu echad mikkol-qorban teruma la-Adonai lakkohen hazzoreq et-dam hashshelamim lo yihyeh
Viqareb minneh chad mikkol qureban aprashuta qodam Adonai lekahana dizeraq yat dam niksat qudeshayya dileh yehe:
Ubesar zebach todat shelamayv beyom qorbano yeakel lo-yanniach mimmennu ad-boqer
Ubesar niksat todat qudeshohi beyom qurbaneh yitakel la yatzna minneh ad tzapra:
Veim-neder o nedaba zebach qorbano beyom haqribo et-zibcho yeakel umimmochorat vehannotar mimmennu yeakel
Veim nidra o nedabta niksat qurbeneh beyoma di yeqareb yat nikseteh yitakel ubeyoma debatrohi udeishtaar minneh yitakel:
Vehannotar mibbesar hazzabach bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissarep
Udeishtaar mibbesar nikseta beyoma telitaa benura yittoqad:
Veim heakol yeakel mibbesar-zebach shelamayv bayyom hashshelishi lo yeratzeh hammaqrib oto lo yechasheb lo piggul yihyeh vehannepesh haokelet mimmennu avonah tissa
Veim itakala yitakel mibbesar niksat qudeshohi beyoma telitaa la yehe leraava dimqareb yateh la yitchasheb leh merachaq yehe veenash detekul minneh chobeh yeqabbel:
Vehabbasar asher-yigga bekol-tame lo yeakel baesh yissarep vehabbasar kol-tahor yokal basar
Ubesar qudesha di yiqrab bekol mesaab la yitakel benura yittoqad ubesar qudesha kol di deke lequdesha yekul besar qudesha:
Vehannepesh asher-tokal basar mizzebach hashshelamim asher la-Adonai vetumato alayv venikreta hannepesh hahiv meammeha
Veenash di tekul bisra minniksat qudeshayya di qodam Adonai vesobeteh alohi veyishtetze enasha hahi meammah:
Venepesh ki-tigga bekol-tame betumat adam o bibhema temea o bekol-sheqetz tame veakal mibbesar-zebach hashshelamim asher la-Adonai venikreta hannepesh hahiv meammeha
Veenash are tiqrab bekol mesaab besoabat enasha o bibira mesaaba o bekol shiqtza mesaab veyekul mibbesar niksat qudeshayya di qodam Adonai vishetetze enasha hahi meammah:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor kol-cheleb shor vekeseb vaez lo tokelu
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar kol terab tor veimmar veizza la tekelun:
Vecheleb nebela vecheleb terepa yeaseh lekol-melaka veakol lo tokeluhu
Uterab nebila uterab tebira yitabed lekol ibidta umekal la tekelunneh:
Ki kol-okel cheleb min-habbehema asher yaqrib mimmenna ishsheh la-Adonai venikreta hannepesh haokelet meammeha
Are kol deyekul tarba min beira di yeqarebun minnah qurbana qodam Adonai veyishtetze enasha di tekul meammah:
Vekol-dam lo tokelu bekol moshebotekem laop velabbehema
Vekol dema la tekelun bekol motebanekon deopa vedibira:
Kol-nepesh asher-tokal kol-dam venikreta hannepesh hahiv meammeha
Kol enasha di tekul kol dema veyishtetze enasha hahi meammah:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor hammaqrib et-zebach shelamayv la-Adonai yabi et-qorbano la-Adonai mizzebach shelamayv
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar dimqareb yat niksat qudeshohi qodam Adonai yayti yat qurbaneh loqodam Adonai minniksat qudeshohi:
Yadayv tebiena et ishshe Adonai et-hacheleb al-hechazeh yebiennu et hechazeh lehanip oto tenupa lipne Adonai
Yedohi taytun yat qurbanayya daAdonai yat tarba al chedya yaytinneh yat chedya laarama yateh aruma qodam Adonai:
Vehiqtir hakkohen et-hacheleb hammizbecha vehaya hechazeh leaharon ulebanayv
Veyasseq kahana yat tarba lemadbecha vihe chedya leaharon velibnohi:
Veet shoq hayyamin tittenu teruma lakkohen mizzibche shalmekem
Veyat shoqa deyammina tittenun aprashuta lekahana minniksat qudeshekon:
Hammaqrib et-dam hashshelamim veet-hacheleb mibbene aharon lo tihyeh shoq hayyamin lemana
Dimqareb yat dam niksat qudeshayya veyat tarba mibbene aharon dileh tehe shoqa deyammina locholaq:
Ki et-chazeh hattenupa veet shoq hatteruma laqachti meet bene-yisrael mizzibche shalmehem vaetten otam leaharon hakkohen ulebanayv lechoq-olam meet bene yisrael
Are yat chedya daaramuta veyat shoqa deaprashuta nesebit min bene yisrael minniksat qudeshehon vihabit yatehon leaharon kahana velibnohi liqyam alam min bene yisrael:
Zot mishchat aharon umishchat banayv meishshe Adonai beyom hiqrib otam lekahen la-Adonai
Da rebut aharon urebut benohi miqqurbanayya daAdonai beyoma diyqarebun yatehon leshammasha qodam Adonai:
Asher tzivva Adonai latet lahem beyom moshcho otam meet bene yisrael chuqqat olam ledorotam
Di paqqid Adonai lemittan lehon beyoma derabbi yatehon min bene yisrael qeyam alam ledarehon:
Zot hattora laola lammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim ulezebach hashshelamim
Da orayta laalata leminchata ulechattata velaashama ulequrbanayya uleniksat qudeshayya:
Asher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh behar sinay beyom tzavvoto et-bene yisrael lehaqrib et-qorbenehem la-Adonai bemidbar sinay
Di paqqid Adonai yat msheh betura desinay beyoma dipaqqedeh yat bene yisrael leqaraba yat qurbanehon qodam Adonai bemadbera desinay:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Qach et-aharon veet-banayv itto veet habbegadim veet shemen hammishcha veet par hachattat veet shene haelim veet sal hammatztzot
Qareb yat aharon veyat benohi immeh veyat lebushayya veyat mishcha dirbuta veyat tora dechattata veyat teren dikrin veyat salla depattirayya:
Veet kol-haeda haqhel el-petach ohel moed
Veyat kol kenishta kenesh litra mashkan zimna:
Vayyaas mosheh kaasher tzivva Adonai oto vattiqqahel haeda el-petach ohel moed
Vaabad msheh kema di paqqid Adonai yateh veitkenishat kenishta litra mashkan zimna:
Vayyomer mosheh el-haeda zeh haddabar asher-tzivva Adonai laasot
Vaamar msheh liknishta den pitgama di paqqid Adonai lemebad:
Vayyaqreb mosheh et-aharon veet-banayv vayyirchatz otam bammayim
Veqarib msheh yat aharon veyat benohi veasche yatehon bemayya:
Vayyitten alayv et-hakkuttonet vayyachgor oto baabnet vayyalbesh oto et-hammeil vayyitten alayv et-haepod vayyachgor oto bechesheb haepod vayyepod lo bo
Vihab alohi yat kittuna vezarez yateh behemyana vealbesh yateh yat meila vihab alohi yat epoda vezarez yateh behemyan epoda veatqen leh beh:
Vayyasem alayv et-hachoshen vayyitten el-hachoshen et-haurim veet-hattummim
Veshavvi alohi yat chushena vihab bechushena yat urayya veyat tumayya:
Vayyasem et-hammitznepet al-rosho vayyasem al-hammitznepet el-mvl panayv et tzitz hazzahab nezer haqqodesh kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veshavvi yat mitznepta al resheh veshavvi al mitznepta loqobel appohi yat tzitza dedahaba kelila dequdesha kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyiqqach mosheh et-shemen hammishcha vayyimshach et-hammishkan veet-kol-asher-bo vayeqaddesh otam
Unesib msheh yat mishcha dirbuta verabbi yat mashkena veyat kol di beh veqaddish yatehon:
Vayyaz mimmennu al-hammizbeach sheba peamim vayyimshach et-hammizbeach veet-kol-kelayv veet-hakkiyyor veet-kanno leqaddesham
Veaddi minneh al madbecha sheba zimnin verabbi yat madbecha veyat kol manohi veyat kiyyora veyat besiseh leqaddashutehon:
Vayyitzoq mishshemen hammishcha al rosh aharon vayyimshach oto leqaddesho
Vaariq mimmishcha dirbuta al resha deaharon verabbi yateh leqaddashuteh:
Vayyaqreb mosheh et-bene aharon vayyalbishem kuttonot vayyachgor otam abnet vayyachabosh lahem migbaot kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veqarib msheh yat bene aharon vealbeshinnun kittunin vezarez yatehon hemyanin veatqen lehon kobain kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaggesh et par hachattat vayyismok aharon ubanayv et-yedehem al-rosh par hachattat
Veqareb yat tora dechattata usemak aharon ubenohi yat yedehon al resh tora dechattata:
Vayyishchat vayyiqqach mosheh et-haddam vayyitten al-qarnot hammizbeach sabib beetzbao vayechatte et-hammizbeach veet-haddam yatzaq el-yesod hammizbeach vayeqaddeshehu lekapper alayv
Unekes unesib msheh yat dema vihab al qarnat madbecha sechor sechor beetzbeeh vedakki yat madbecha veyat dema ariq lisoda demadbecha veqaddesheh lekappara alohi:
Vayyiqqach et-kol-hacheleb asher al-haqqereb veet yoteret hakkabed veet-shete hakkelayot veet-chelbehen vayyaqter mosheh hammizbecha
Unesib yat kol tarba di al gavva veyat chatzar kabda veyat tarten kaleyan veyat tarbehen veasseq msheh lemadbecha:
Veet-happar veet-oro veet-besaro veet-pirsho sarap baesh michutz lammachaneh kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veyat tora veyat mashkeh veyat bisreh veyat okleh oqid benura mibbara lemashrita kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaqreb et el haola vayyismeku aharon ubanayv et-yedehem al-rosh haayil
Veqarib yat dikra daalata usemaku aharon ubenohi yat yedehon al resh dikra:
Vayyishchat vayyizroq mosheh et-haddam al-hammizbeach sabib
Unekes uzeraq msheh yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet-haayil nittach lintachayv vayyaqter mosheh et-harosh veet-hannetachim veet-happader
Veyat dikra palleg leebrohi veasseq msheh yat resha veyat ebarayya veyat tarba:
Veet-haqqereb veet-hakkeraayim rachatz bammayim vayyaqter mosheh et-kol-haayil hammizbecha ola hu lereach-nichoach ishsheh hu la-Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veyat gavva veyat keraayya challil bemayya veasseq msheh yat kol dikra lemadbecha alata hu leitqabbala beraava qurbana hu qodam Adonai kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyaqreb et-haayil hashsheni el hammilluim vayyismeku aharon ubanayv et-yedehem al-rosh haayil
Veqarib yat dikra tinyana dekar qurbanayya usemaku aharon ubenohi yat yedehon al resh dikra:
Vayyishchat vayyiqqach mosheh middamo vayyitten al-tenuk ozen-aharon hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit
Unekes unesib msheh min dema vihab al rum udena deaharon deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina:
Vayyaqreb et-bene aharon vayyitten mosheh min-haddam al-tenuk oznam hayemanit veal-bohen yadam hayemanit veal-bohen raglam hayemanit vayyizroq mosheh et-haddam al-hammizbeach sabib
Veqarib yat bene aharon vihab msheh min dema al rum udenehon deyammina veal ilyon yedehon deyammina veal ilyon raglehon deyammina uzeraq msheh yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor:
Vayyiqqach et-hacheleb veet-haalya veet-kol-hacheleb asher al-haqqereb veet yoteret hakkabed veet-shete hakkelayot veet-chelbehen veet shoq hayyamin
Unesib yat tarba veyat alita veyat kol tarba di al gavva veyat chatzar kabda veyat tarten kaleyan veyat tarbehen veyat shoqa deyammina:
Umissal hammatztzot asher lipne Adonai laqach challat matztza achat vechallat lechem shemen achat veraqiq echad vayyasem al-hachalabim veal shoq hayyamin
Umissalla depattirayya di qodam Adonai nesib geritzta pattira chada ugeritzta dilchem meshach chada veespog chad veshavvi al tarbayya veal shoqa deyammina:
Vayyitten et-hakkol al kappe aharon veal kappe banayv vayyanep otam tenupa lipne Adonai
Vihab yat kolla al yede aharon veal yede benohi vaarem yatehon arama qodam Adonai:
Vayyiqqach mosheh otam meal kappehem vayyaqter hammizbecha al-haola milluim hem lereach nichoach ishsheh hu la-Adonai
Unesib msheh yatehon meal yedehon veasseq lemadbecha al alata qurbanayya innun leitqabbala beraava qurbana hu qodam Adonai:
Vayyiqqach mosheh et-hechazeh vayenipehu tenupa lipne Adonai meel hammilluim lemosheh haya lemana kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Unesib msheh yat chedya vaarimeh arama qodam Adonai middekar qurbanayya lemsheh hava locholaq kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:

Vayyiqqach mosheh mishshemen hammishcha umin-haddam asher al-hammizbeach vayyaz al-aharon al-begadayv veal-banayv veal-bigde banayv itto vayeqaddesh et-aharon et-begadayv veet-banayv veet-bigde banayv itto

Unesib msheh mimmishcha dirbuta umin dema di al madbecha veaddi al aharon al lebushohi veal benohi veal lebushe benohi immeh veqaddish yat aharon yat lebushohi veyat benohi veyat lebushe benohi immeh:
Vayyomer mosheh el-aharon veel-banayv bashshelu et-habbasar petach ohel moed vesham tokelu oto veet-hallechem asher besal hammilluim kaasher tzivveti lemor aharon ubanayv yokeluhu
Vaamar msheh leaharon velibnohi bashshilu yat bisra bitra mashkan zimna vetamman tekelun yateh veyat lachma di besal qurbanayya kema di paqqedit lememar aharon ubenohi yekelunneh:
Vehannotar babbasar uballachem baesh tisropu
Udeishtaar bebisra ubelachma benura toqedun:
Umippetach ohel moed lo tetzeu shibat yamim ad yom melot yeme milluekem ki shibat yamim yemalle et-yedkem
Umittera mashkan zimna la tippequn shiba yomin ad yom mishlam yome qurbanekon are shiba yomin yeqareb yat qurbanekon:
Kaasher asa bayyom hazzeh tzivva Adonai laasot lekapper alekem
Kema di abad beyoma haden paqqid Adonai lemebad lekappara alekon:
Upetach ohel moed teshebu yomam valayla shibat yamim ushemartem et-mishmeret Adonai velo tamutu ki-ken tzuvveti
Ubitra mashkan zimna tetebun yemam velele shiba yomin vetitterun yat matterat memera daAdonai vela temutun are ken itpaqqadit:
Vayyaas aharon ubanayv et kol-haddebarim asher-tzivva Adonai beyad-mosheh
Vaabad aharon ubenohi yat kol pitgamayya di paqqid Adonai bida demsheh:
Vayehi bayyom hashshemini qara mosheh leaharon ulebanayv uleziqne yisrael
Vahava beyoma teminaa qera msheh leaharon velibnohi ulesabe yisrael:
Vayyomer el-aharon qach-leka egel ben-baqar lechattat veayil leola temimim vehaqreb lipne Adonai
Vaamar leaharon sab lak egal bar tore lechattata udekar laalata shalmin veqareb qodam Adonai:
Veel-bene yisrael tedabber lemor qechu seir-izzim lechattat veegel vakebes bene-shana temimim leola
Veim bene yisrael temallel lememar sibu tzepir bar izzin lechattata veegal veimmar bene shena shalmin laalata:
Veshor vaayil lishlamim lizboach lipne Adonai umincha belula bashshamen ki hayyom Adonai nira alekem
Vetor udekar leniksat qudeshayya ledabbacha qodam Adonai uminchata depila bimshach are yoma den yeqara daAdonai mitgeli lekon:
Vayyiqchu et asher tzivva mosheh el-pene ohel moed vayyiqrebu kol-haeda vayyaamdu lipne Adonai
Unesibu yat di paqqid msheh loqodam mashkan zimna uqeribu kol kenishta veqamu qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer mosheh zeh haddabar asher-tzivva Adonai taasu veyera alekem kebod Adonai
Vaamar msheh den pitgama di paqqid Adonai tabedun veyitgeli lekon yeqara daAdonai:
Vayyomer mosheh el-aharon qerab el-hammizbeach vaaseh et-chattateka veet-olateka vekapper baadka ubead haam vaaseh et-qorban haam vekapper baadam kaasher tzivva Adonai
Vaamar msheh leaharon qerab lemadbecha veibed yat chattatak veyat alatak vekappar alak veal amma veibed yat qurban amma vekappar alehon kema di paqqid Adonai:
Vayyiqrab aharon el-hammizbeach vayyishchat et-egel hachattat asher-lo
Uqereb aharon lemadbecha unekes yat egla dechattata di leh:
Vayyaqribu bene aharon et-haddam elayv vayyitbol etzbao baddam vayyitten al-qarnot hammizbeach veet-haddam yatzaq el-yesod hammizbeach
Veqaribu bene aharon yat dema leh utebal etzbeeh bidma vihab al qarnat madbecha veyat dema ariq lisoda demadbecha:
Veet-hacheleb veet-hakkelayot veet-hayyoteret min-hakkabed min-hachattat hiqtir hammizbecha kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veyat tarba veyat kaleyeta veyat chitzra min kabda min chattata asseq lemadbecha kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Veet-habbasar veet-haor sarap baesh michutz lammachaneh
Veyat bisra veyat mashka oqid benura mibbara lemashrita:
Vayyishchat et-haola vayyamtziu bene aharon elayv et-haddam vayyizreqehu al-hammizbeach sabib
Unekes yat alata veamtiu bene aharon leh yat dema uzeraqeh al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet-haola himtziu elayv lintacheha veet-harosh vayyaqter al-hammizbeach
Veyat alata amtiu leh leebaraha veyat resha veasseq al madbecha:
Vayyirchatz et-haqqereb veet-hakkeraayim vayyaqter al-haola hammizbecha
Vechallil yat gavva veyat keraayya veasseq al alata lemadbecha:
Vayyaqreb et qorban haam vayyiqqach et-seir hachattat asher laam vayyishchatehu vayechatteehu karishon
Veqareb yat qurban amma unesib yat tzepira dechattata di leamma venakeseh vekapper bidmeh keqadmaa:
Vayyaqreb et-haola vayyaaseha kammishpat
Veqareb yat alata veabedah kidchaze:
Vayyaqreb et-hammincha vayemalle kappo mimmenna vayyaqter al-hammizbeach millebad olat habboqer
Veqareb yat minchata umela yedeh minnah veasseq al madbecha bar mealat tzapra:
Vayyishchat et-hashshor veet-haayil zebach hashshelamim asher laam vayyamtziu bene aharon et-haddam elayv vayyizreqehu al-hammizbeach sabib
Unekes yat tora veyat dikra niksat qudeshayya di leamma veamtiu bene aharon yat dema leh uzeraqeh al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet-hachalabim min-hashshor umin-haayil haalya vehamekasseh vehakkelayot veyoteret hakkabed
Veyat tarbayya min tora umin dikra alita vechape gavva vekaleyeta vachatzar kabda:
Vayyasimu et-hachalabim al-hechazot vayyaqter hachalabim hammizbecha
Veshavviu yat tarbayya al chedvata veasseq tarbayya lemadbecha:
Veet hechazot veet shoq hayyamin henip aharon tenupa lipne Adonai kaasher tzivva mosheh
Veyat chedvata veyat shoqa deyammina arem aharon arama qodam Adonai kema di paqqid msheh:
Vayyissa aharon et-yadav el-haam vayebarekem vayyered measot hachattat vehaola vehashshelamim
Vaarem aharon yat yedohi al amma ubarekinnun unechat millemebad chattata vaalata veniksat qudeshayya:
Vayyabo mosheh veaharon el-ohel moed vayyetzeu vayebareku et-haam vayyera kebod-Adonai el-kol-haam
Veal msheh veaharon lemashkan zimna unepaqu ubariku yat amma veitgeli yeqara daAdonai lekol amma:
Vattetze esh millipne Adonai vattokal al-hammizbeach et-haola veet-hachalabim vayyar kol-haam vayyaronnu vayyippelu al-penehem
Unepaqat eshshata min qodam Adonai vaakalat al madbecha yat alata veyat tarbayya vachaza kol amma veshabbachu unepalu al appehon:
Vayyiqchu bene-aharon nadab vaabihu ish machtato vayyittenu bahen esh vayyasimu aleha qetoret vayyaqribu lipne Adonai esh zara asher lo tzivva otam
Unesibu bene aharon nadab vaabihu gebar machtiteh vihabu behon eshshata veshavviu alah qetoret veqaribu qodam Adonai eshshata nukereta di la paqqid yatehon:
Vattetze esh millipne Adonai vattokal otam vayyamutu lipne Adonai
Unepaqat eshshata min qodam Adonai vaakalat yatehon umitu qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer mosheh el-aharon hu asher-dibber Adonai lemor biqrobay eqqadesh veal-pene kol-haam ekkabed vayyiddom aharon
Vaamar msheh leaharon hu di mallil Adonai lememar beqaribay itqaddash veal appe kol amma ityaqqar ushetiq aharon:
Vayyiqra mosheh el-mishael veel eltzapan bene uzziel dod aharon vayyomer alehem qirbu seu et-achekem meet pene-haqqodesh el-michutz lammachaneh
Uqera msheh lemishael uleeltzapan bene uzziel ach abuhi deaharon vaamar lehon qeribu tulu yat achukon min qodam appe qudesha lemibbara lemashrita:
Vayyiqrebu vayyissaum bekuttonotam el-michutz lammachaneh kaasher dibber mosheh
Uqeribu unetalunnun bekittunnehon lemibbara lemashrita kema di mallil msheh:
Vayyomer mosheh el-aharon uleelazar uleitamar banayv rashekem al-tiprau ubigdekem lo-tipromu velo tamutu veal kol-haeda yiqtzop vaachekem kol-bet yisrael yibku et-hasserepa asher sarap Adonai

Vaamar msheh leaharon uleelazar uleitamar benohi reshekon la terabbun perua ulebushekon la tebazzeun vela temutun veal kol kenishta yehe rugeza vaachekon kol bet yisrael yibkun yat yeqidta di oqid Adonai:
Umippetach ohel moed lo tetzeu pen-tamutu ki-shemen mishchat Adonai alekem vayyaasu kidbar mosheh
Umittera mashkan zimna la tippequn dilema temutun are meshach rebuta daAdonai alekon vaabadu kepitgama demsheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai leaharon lememar:
Yayin veshekar al-tesht atta ubaneka ittak beboakem el-ohel moed velo tamutu chuqqat olam ledorotekem
Chamar umeravve la tishte at ubenayk immak bemealkon lemashkan zimna vela temutun qeyam alam ledarekon:
Ulehabdil ben haqqodesh uben hachol uben hattame uben hattahor
Uleaprasha ben qudesha uben chulla uben mesaaba uben dakya:
Ulehorot et-bene yisrael et kol-hachuqqim asher dibber Adonai alehem beyad-mosheh
Uleallapa yat bene yisrael yat kol qeyamayya di mallil Adonai lehon bida demsheh:
Vayedabber mosheh el-aharon veel elazar veel-itamar banayv hannotarim qechu et-hammincha hannoteret meishshe Adonai veikluha matztzot etzel hammizbeach ki qodesh qodashim hiv
Umallil msheh im aharon veim elazar veim itamar benohi deishtaaru sibu yat minchata deishtaarat miqqurbanayya daAdonai veikluha pattir bistar madbecha are qodesh qudeshin hi:
Vaakaltem otah bemaqom qadosh ki choqka vechoq-baneka hiv meishshe Adonai ki-ken tzuvveti
Vetekelun yatah baatar qaddish are cholaqak vocholaq benayk hi miqqurbanayya daAdonai are ken itpaqqadit:
Veet chazeh hattenupa veet shoq hatteruma tokelu bemaqom tahor atta ubaneka ubenoteka ittak ki-choqka vechoq-baneka nittenu mizzibche shalme bene yisrael
Veyat chedya daaramuta veyat shoqa deaprashuta tekelun baatar deke at ubenayk ubenatayk immak are cholaqak vocholaq benayk ityehibu minniksat qudeshayya dibne yisrael:
Shoq hatteruma vachazeh hattenupa al ishshe hachalabim yabiu lehanip tenupa lipne Adonai vehaya leka ulebaneka itteka lechoq-olam kaasher tzivva Adonai
Shoqa deaprashuta vechedya daaramuta al qurbane tarbayya yaytun laarama arama qodam Adonai vihe lak velibnayk immak liqyam alam kema di paqqid Adonai:
Veet seir hachattat darosh darash mosheh vehinneh sorap vayyiqtzop al-elazar veal-itamar bene aharon hannotarim lemor
Veyat tzepira dechattata mitba tabee msheh veha ittoqad uregez al elazar veal itamar bene aharon deishtaaru lememar:
Maddua lo-akaltem et-hachattat bimqom haqqodesh ki qodesh qodashim hiv veotah natan lakem laset et-avon haeda lekapper alehem lipne Adonai
Maden la akaltun yat chattata baatar qaddish are qodesh qudeshin hi veyatah yaheb lekon lesallacha al chobe kenishta lekappara alehon qodam Adonai:
Hen lo-hvba et-damah el-haqqodesh penima akol tokelu otah baqqodesh kaasher tzivveti
Ha la ittaal yat demah lebet qudsha gavvaa mekal tekelun yatah bequdsha kema di paqqedit:
Vayedabber aharon el-mosheh hen hayyom hiqribu et-chattatam veet-olatam lipne Adonai vattiqrena oti kaelleh veakalti chattat hayyom hayyitab beene Adonai
Umallil aharon im msheh ha yoma den qaribu yat chattatehon veyat alatehon qodam Adonai vaaraa yati aqan keillen veillupon akalit chattata yoma den hataqqen qodam Adonai:
Vayyishma mosheh vayyitab beenayv
Ushema msheh ushepar beenohi:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon lemor alehem
Umallil Adonai im msheh uleaharon lememar lehon:
Dabberu el-bene yisrael lemor zot hachayya asher tokelu mikkol-habbehema asher al-haaretz
Mallilu im bene yisrael lememar da chayta di tekelun mikkol beira di al ara:
Kol mapreset parsa veshosaat shesa perasot maalat gera babbehema otah tokelu
Kol di sediqan parsata umattilpan tilpin parsata masseqa pishra bibira yatah tekelun:
Ak et-zeh lo tokelu mimmaale haggera umimmaprise happarsa et-haggamal ki-maaleh gera hu uparsa enennu mapris tame hu lakem
Beram yat den la tekelun mimmasseqe pishra umimmasdiqe parsata yat gamla are massiq pishra hu uparsata la sediqa mesaab hu lekon:
Veet-hashshapan ki-maaleh gera hu uparsa lo yapris tame hu lakem
Veyat tapza are massiq pishra hu uparsata la sediqa mesaab hu lekon:
Veet-haarnebet ki-maalat gera hiv uparsa lo hiprisa temea hiv lakem
Veyat arneba are masseqa pishra hi uparsata la sediqa mesaaba hi lekon:
Veet-hachazir ki-mapris parsa hu veshosa shesa parsa vehu gera lo-yiggar tame hu lakem
Veyat chazira are sediq parsata hu umattilepan tilpin parsateh vehu pishra la pashar mesaab hu lekon:
Mibbesaram lo tokelu ubeniblatam lo tiggau temeim hem lakem
Mibbisrehon la tekelun ubinbiltehon la tiqrebun mesaabin innun lekon:
Et-zeh tokelu mikkol asher bammayim kol asher-lo senappir veqasqeset bammayim bayyammim ubannechalim otam tokelu
Yat den tekelun mikkol di bemayya kol di leh tzitzin veqalpin bemayya beyamemayya ubenachalayya yatehon tekelun:
Vekol asher en-lo senappir veqasqeset bayyammim ubannechalim mikkol sheretz hammayim umikkol nepesh hachayya asher bammayim sheqetz hem lakem
Vekol di let leh tzitzin veqalpin beyammayya ubenachalayya mikkol richasha demayya umikkal napsha chayta di bemayya shiqtza innun lekon:
Vesheqetz yihyu lakem mibbesaram lo tokelu veet-niblatam teshaqqetzu
Veshiqtza yehon lekon mibbisrehon la tekelun veyat nebiltehon teshaqqetzun:
Kol asher en-lo senappir veqasqeset bammayim sheqetz hu lakem
Kol di let leh tzitzin veqalpin bemayya shiqtza hu lekon:
Veet-elleh teshaqqetzu min-haop lo yeoklu sheqetz hem et-hannesher veet-happeres veet haozniyya
Veyat illen tashaqqetzun min opa la yitaklun shiqtza innun nishra vear veazya:
Veet-haddaa veet-haayya leminah
Vedayta vetarapita liznah:
Et kol-oreb lemino
Yat kol ureba lizneh:
Veet bat hayyaana veet-hattachmas veet-hashshachap veet-hannetz leminehu
Veyat bat naamita vetzitza vetzippar shachpa venatza liznohi:
Veet-hakkos veet-hashshalak veet-hayyanshup
Veqarya veshalenuna veqippopa:
Veet-hattinshemet veet-haqqaat veet-haracham
Ubavta veqata viraqreqa:
Veet hachasida haanapa leminah veet-haddukipat veet-haatallep
Vechavvarita veibbu liznah venaggar tura vaatallepa:
Kol sheretz haop haholek al-arba sheqetz hu lakem
Kol richasha deopa dimhallek al arba shiqtza hu lekon:
Ak et-zeh tokelu mikkol sheretz haop haholek al-arba asher-lo keraayim mimmaal leraglayv lenatter bahen al-haaretz
Beram yat den tekelun mikkol richasha deopa dimhallek al arba di leh qartzulin meillave raglohi leqappatza behon al ara:
Et-elleh mehem tokelu et-haarbeh lemino veet-hassolam leminehu veet-hachargol leminehu veet-hechagab leminehu
Yat illen minnehon tekelun yat goba liznah veyat rashuna liznohi veyat chargola liznohi veyat chagaba liznohi:
Vekol sheretz haop asher-lo arba raglayim sheqetz hu lakem
Vekol richasha deopa di leh arba raglin shiqtza hu lekon:
Uleelleh tittammau kol-hannogea beniblatam yitma ad-haareb
Uleillen tistaabun kol deyiqrab binbiltehon yehe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vekol-hannose minniblatam yekabbes begadayv vetame ad-haareb
Vekol deyitol minnebiltehon yetzabba lebushohi vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Lekol-habbehema asher hiv mapreset parsa veshesa enenna shosaat vegera enenna maala temeim hem lakem kol-hannogea bahem yitma
