Lekol beira di hi sediqa parsata vetilpin letaha mattilpa upishra letaha masseqa mesaabin innun lekon kol deyiqrab behon yehe mesaab:
Vekol holek al-kappayv bekol-hachayya haholeket al-arba temeim hem lakem kol-hannogea beniblatam yitma ad-haareb
Vekol dimhallek al yedohi bekol chayta dimhaleka al arba mesaabin innun lekon kol deyiqrab binbiltehon yehe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vehannose et-niblatam yekabbes begadayv vetame ad-haareb temeim hemma lakem
Udeyittol yat nebiltehon yetzabba lebushohi vihe mesaab ad ramsha mesaabin innun lekon:
Vezeh lakem hattame bashsheretz hashshoretz al-haaretz hacholed vehaakbar vehatztzab leminehu
Veden lekon mesaaba berichasha derachesh al ara chulda veakbara vetzaba liznohi:
Vehaanaqa vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet vehattinshamet
Veyala vekocha vechulteta vechumta veashuta:
Elleh hattemeim lakem bekol-hashsharetz kol-hannogea bahem bemotam yitma ad-haareb
Illen dimsaabin lekon bekol richasha kol deyiqrab behon bemotehon yehe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vekol asher-yippol-alayv mehem bemotam yitma mikkol-keli-etz o beged o-or o saq kol-keli asher-yeaseh melaka bahem bammayim yuba vetame ad-haereb vetaher
Vekol di yippel alohi minnehon bemotehon yehe mesaab mikkol man deaa o lebush o meshak o saq kol man di titabed ibida behon bemayya yittaal vihe mesaab ad ramsha veyidke:
Vekol-keli-cheres asher-yippol mehem el-toko kol asher betoko yitma veoto tishboru
Vekol man dachasap di yippel minnehon legavveh kol di begavveh yistaab veyateh tetabberun:
Mikkol-haokel asher yeakel asher yabo alayv mayim yitma vekol-mashqeh asher yishshateh bekol-keli yitma
Mikkol mekela demitakel di yaalun alohi mayya yehe mesaab vekol mashqeh di yishtete bekol man yehe mesaab:
Vekol asher-yippol minniblatam alayv yitma tannur vekirayim yuttatz temeim hem utemeim yihyu lakem
Vekol di yippel minnebiltehon alohi yehe mesaab tannur vekirayim yittareun mesaabin innun umesaabin yehon lekon:
Ak mayan ubor miqveh-mayim yihyeh tahor venogea beniblatam yitma
Beram mayan vegob bet kenishut mayya yehe deke udeyiqrab binbiltehon yehe mesaab:
Veki yippol minniblatam al-kol-zera zerua asher yizzarea tahor hu
Vaare yippel minnebiltehon al kol bar zera zerua di yizdera deke hu:
Veki yuttan-mayim al-zera venapal minniblatam alayv tame hu lakem
Vaare yityahabun mayya al bar zara veyippel minnebiltehon alohi mesaab hu lekon:
Veki yamut min-habbehema asher-hi lakem leokla hannogea beniblatah yitma ad-haareb
Vaare yemut min beira di hi lekon lemekal deyiqrab binbiltah yehe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vehaokel minniblatah yekabbes begadayv vetame ad-haareb vehannose et-niblatah yekabbes begadayv vetame ad-haareb
Udeyekul minnebiltah yetzabba lebushohi vihe mesaab ad ramsha udeyittol yat nebiltah yetzabba lebushohi vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vekol-hashsheretz hashshoretz al-haaretz sheqetz hu lo yeakel
Vekol richasha derachesh al ara shiqtza hu la yitakel:
Kol holek al-gachon vekol holek al-arba ad kol-marbeh raglayim lekol-hashsheretz hashshoretz al-haaretz lo tokelum ki-sheqetz hem
Kol dimhallek al meohi vekol dimhallek al arba ad kol segiut raglain lekol richasha derachesh al ara la tekelunnun are shiqtza innun:
Al-teshaqqetzu et-napshotekem bekol-hashsheretz hashshoretz velo tittammeu bahem venitmetem bam
La teshaqqetzu yat napshatekon bekol richasha derachesh vela tistaabun behon vetistaabun pon behon:
Ki ani Adonai elohekem vehitqaddishtem vihyitem qedoshim ki qadosh ani velo tetammeu et-napshotekem bekol-hashsheretz haromes al-haaretz
Are ana Adonai elahakon vetitqaddeshun utehon qaddishin are qaddish ana vela tesaabun yat napshatekon bekol richasha derachesh al ara:
Ki ani Adonai hammaaleh etkem meeretz mitzrayim lihyot lakem lelohim vihyitem qedoshim ki qadosh ani
Are ana Adonai deasseq yatekon meara demitzrayim lemeheve lekon leelah utehon qaddishin are qaddish ana:
Zot torat habbehema vehaop vekol nepesh hachayya haromeset bammayim ulekol-nepesh hashshoretzet al-haaretz
Da orayta dibira udeopa udekol napshata chayta dirchesha bemayya ulekal napsha dirchesha al ara:
Lehabdil ben hattame uben hattahor uben hachayya hanneekelet uben hachayya asher lo teakel
Leaprasha ben mesaaba uben dakya uben chayta demitakla uben chayta di la mitakla:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor ishsha ki tazria veyaleda zakar vetamea shibat yamim kime niddat devotah titma
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar itteta are teaddi utelid dekar utehe mesaaba shibat yomin keyome richuq sobetah tehe mesaaba:
Ubayyom hashshemini yimmol besar orlato
Ubeyoma teminaa yigzar bisra deorleteh:
Usheloshim yom usheloshet yamim tesheb bidme tohora bekol-qodesh lo-tigga veel-hammiqdash lo tabo ad-melot yeme tohorah
Utelatin utelata yomin teteb bedam deku bekol qudesha la tiqrab ulemiqdesha la teol ad mishlam yome dakutah:
Veim-neqeba teled vetamea shebuayim keniddatah veshishshim yom vesheshet yamim tesheb al-deme tohora
Veim nequbeta telid utehe mesaaba arbea asar kerichuqah veshittin veshitta yomin teteb al dam deku:
Ubimlot yeme tohorah leben o lebat tabi kebes ben-shenato leola uben-yona o-tor lechattat el-petach ohel-moed el-hakkohen
Ubemishlam yome dakutah libra o libratta tayti immar bar shatteh laalata ubar yona o shapnina lechattata litra mashkan zimna levat kahana:
Vehiqribo lipne Adonai vekipper aleha vetahara mimmeqor dameha zot torat hayyoledet lazzakar o lanneqeba
Viqarebinneh qodam Adonai vikapper alah vetidke missoabat demaha da orayta deyalledta ledukera o linqubta:
Veim-lo timtza yadah de seh velaqecha shete-torim o shene bene yona echad leola veechad lechattat vekipper aleha hakkohen vetahera
Veim la tashkach yedah kemissat immera vetissab tarten shapninin o teren bene yona chad laalata vechad lechattata vikapper alah kahana vetidke:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh veim aharon lememar:
Adam ki-yihyeh beor-besaro seet o-sappachat o baheret vehaya beor-besaro lenega tzaraat vehuba el-aharon hakkohen o el-achad mibbanayv hakkohanim
Enash are yehe bimshak bisreh amqa o adya o bahara vihe bimshak bisreh lemaktash segiru veyittete levat aharon kahana o levat chad mibbenohi kahanayya:
Veraa hakkohen et-hannega beor-habbasar vesear bannega hapak laban umareh hannega amoq meor besaro nega tzaraat hu veraahu hakkohen vetimme oto
Veyecheze kahana yat maktasha bimshak bisra vesear bemaktasha ithapik lemechevar umecheze maktasha ammiq bimshak bisreh maktash segiruta hu veyechezinneh kahana visaeb yateh:
Veim-baheret lebana hiv beor besaro veamoq en-mareha min-haor useara lo-hapak laban vehisgir hakkohen et-hannega shibat yamim
Veim bahara chavvera hi bimshak bisreh veammiq let mechezaha min mashka useara la ithapik lemechevar veyasgar kahana yat maktasha shiba yomin:
Veraahu hakkohen bayyom hashshebii vehinneh hannega amad beenayv lo-pasa hannega baor vehisgiro hakkohen shibat yamim shenit
Veyechezinneh kahana beyoma shebiaa veha maktesha qam kad hava la osep maktasha bemashka veyasgerinneh kahana shiba yomin tinyanut:
Veraa hakkohen oto bayyom hashshebii shenit vehinneh keha hannega velo-pasa hannega baor vetiharo hakkohen mispachat hiv vekibbes begadayv vetaher
Veyecheze kahana yateh beyoma shebiaa tinyanut veha amya maktasha vela osep maktasha bemashka vidakkinneh kahana adita hi vitzabba lebushohi veyidke:
Veim-pasoh tipseh hammispachat baor achare heraoto el-hakkohen letohorato venira shenit el-hakkohen
Veim osapa tosep adita bemashka batar diittachazi lekahana ledakkuteh veyittachazi tinyanut lekahana:
Veraa hakkohen vehinneh paseta hammispachat baor vetimmeo hakkohen tzaraat hiv
Veyecheze kahana veha osepat adita bemashka visaebinneh kahana segiruta hi:
Nega tzaraat ki tihyeh beadam vehuba el-hakkohen
Maktash segiru are tehe beenasha veyittete levat kahana:
Veraa hakkohen vehinneh seet-lebana baor vehi hapeka sear laban umicheyat basar chay baset
Veyecheze kahana veha amqa chavvera bemashka vehi hapakat sear lechivvar vershem bisra chayta beammiqta:
Tzaraat noshenet hiv beor besaro vetimmeo hakkohen lo yasgirennu ki tame hu
Segirut attiqa hi bimshak bisreh visaebinneh kahana la yasgerineh are mesaab hu:
Veim-paroach tiprach hatztzaraat baor vekisseta hatztzaraat et kol-or hannega merosho vead-raglayv lekol-mareh ene hakkohen
Veim misga tisge segiruta bemashka vetachape segiruta yat kol meshak maktasha meresheh vead raglohi lekol chezu ene kahana:
Veraa hakkohen vehinneh kisseta hatztzaraat et-kol-besaro vetihar et-hannaga kullo hapak laban tahor hu
Veyecheze kahana veha chapat segiruta yat kol bisreh vidakki yat maktasha kulleh ithapik lemechevar deke hu:
Ubeyom heraot bo basar chay yitma
Ubeyoma deittachazi beh bisra chayya yehe mesaab:
Veraa hakkohen et-habbasar hachay vetimmeo habbasar hachay tame hu tzaraat hu
Veyecheze kahana yat bisra chayya visaebinneh bisra chayya mesaab hu segirut hu:
O ki yashub habbasar hachay venehpak lelaban uba el-hakkohen
O are yetub bisra chayya veyithapik lemechevar veyittete levat kahana:
Veraahu hakkohen vehinneh nehpak hannega lelaban vetihar hakkohen et-hannega tahor hu
Veyechezinneh kahana veha ithapik maktasha lemechevar vidakke kahana yat maktasha deke hu:
Ubasar ki-yihyeh bo-beoro shechin venirpa
Ubisra are yehe beh bemashkeh shichana veyittasse:
Vehaya bimqom hashshechin seet lebana o baheret lebana adamdamet venira el-hakkohen
Vihe baatar shichana amqa chavvera o bahara chavvera samqa veyittachazi lekahana:
Veraa hakkohen vehinneh mareha shapal min-haor usearah hapak laban vetimmeo hakkohen nega-tzaraat hiv bashshechin paracha
Veyecheze kahana veha mechezaha makkik min mashka usearah ithapik lemechevar visaebineh kahana maktash segiruta hi beshichana segiat:
Veim yirenna hakkohen vehinneh en-bah sear laban ushepala enenna min-haor vehi keha vehisgiro hakkohen shibat yamim
Veim yechezinnah kahana veha let bah sear chivvar umakkika letaha min mashka vehi ameya veyasgerinneh kahana shiba yomin:
Veim-pasoh tipseh baor vetimme hakkohen oto nega hiv
Veim osapa tosep bemashka visaeb kahana yateh maktasha hi:
Veim-tachteha taamod habbaheret lo pasata tzarebet hashshechin hiv vetiharo hakkohen
Veim beatraha qamat beharta la osepat rshem shichana hi vidakkinneh kahana:
O basar ki-yihyeh beoro mikvat-esh vehayeta micheyat hammikva baheret lebana adamdemet o lebana
O bisra are yehe bemashkeh kevaa denur utehe rshem kevaa bahara chavvera samqa o chavvera:
Veraa otah hakkohen vehinneh nehpak sear laban babbaheret umareha amoq min-haor tzaraat hiv bammikva paracha vetimme oto hakkohen nega tzaraat hiv
Veyecheze yatah kahana veha ithapik sear chivvar bebaherta umechezaha ammiq min mashka segiruta hi bikvaa segia visaeb yateh kahana maktash segiruta hi:
Veim yirenna hakkohen vehinneh en-babbaheret sear laban ushepala enenna min-haor vehiv keha vehisgiro hakkohen shibat yamim
Veim yechezinnah kahana veha let bebaherta sear chivvar umakkika letaha min mashka vehi ameya veyasgrinneh kahana shiba yomin:
Veraahu hakkohen bayyom hashshebii im-pasoh tipseh baor vetimme hakkohen oto nega tzaraat hiv
Veyechezinneh kahana beyoma shebiaa im osapa tosep bemashka visaeb kahana yateh maktash segiruta hi:
Veim-tachteha taamod habbaheret lo-paseta baor vehiv keha seet hammikva hiv vetiharo hakkohen ki-tzarebet hammikva hiv
Veim beatraha qamat baherta la osepat bemashka vehi ameya omeq kevaa hi vidakkinneh kahana are rshem kevaa hi:
Veish o ishsha ki-yihyeh bo naga berosh o bezaqan
Ugebar o itteta are yehe beh maktasha beresha o bidqan:
Veraa hakkohen et-hannega vehinneh marehu amoq min-haor ubo sear tzahob daq vetimme oto hakkohen neteq hu tzaraat harosh o hazzaqan hu
Veyecheze kahana yat maktasha veha mechezohi ammiq min mashka ubeh sear summaq dadaq visaeb yateh kahana nitqa hu segirut resha o diqna hu:
Veki-yireh hakkohen et-nega hanneteq vehinneh en-marehu amoq min-haor vesear shachor en bo vehisgir hakkohen et-nega hanneteq shibat yamim
Vaare yecheze kahana yat maktash nitqa veha let mechezohi ammiq min mashka vesear ukkam let beh veyasgar kahana yat maktash nitqa shibat yomin:
Veraa hakkohen et-hannega bayyom hashshebii vehinneh lo-pasa hanneteq velo-haya bo sear tzahob umareh hanneteq en amoq min-haor
Veyecheze kahana yat maktasha beyoma shebiaa veha la osep nitqa vela hava beh sear summaq umecheze nitqa let ammiq min mashka:
Vehitgallach veet-hanneteq lo yegalleach vehisgir hakkohen et-hanneteq shibat yamim shenit
Vigallach sochorane nitqa udeim nitqa la yegallach veyasgar kahana yat nitqa shiba yomin tinyanut:
Veraa hakkohen et-hanneteq bayyom hashshebii vehinneh lo-pasa hanneteq baor umarehu enennu amoq min-haor vetihar oto hakkohen vekibbes begadayv vetaher
Veyecheze kahana yat nitqa beyoma shebiaa veha la osep nitqa bemashka umechezohi letohi ammiq min mashka vidakke yateh kahana vitzabba lebushohi veyidke:
Veim-pasoh yipseh hanneteq baor achare tohorato
Veim osapa yosep nitqa bemashka batar dakuteh:
Veraahu hakkohen vehinneh pasa hanneteq baor lo-yebaqqer hakkohen lassear hatztzahob tame hu
Veyechezinneh kahana veha osep nitqa bemashka la yebaqqer kahana lesear summaq mesaab hu:
Veim-beenayv amad hanneteq vesear shachor tzamach-bo nirpa hanneteq tahor hu vetiharo hakkohen
Veim kad hava qam nitqa vesear ukkam tzemach beh ittassi nitqa deke hu vidakkinneh kahana:
Veish o-ishsha ki-yihyeh beor-besaram beharot beharot lebanot
Ugebar o itteta are yehe bimshak bisrehon baharan baharan chavveran:
Veraa hakkohen vehinneh beor-besaram beharot kehot lebanot bohaq hu parach baor tahor hu
Veyecheze kahana veha bimshak bisrehon baharan ameyan chavveran bahaqa hu sage bemashka deke hu:
Veish ki yimmaret rosho qereach hu tahor hu
Ugebar are yattar sear resheh qerach hu deke hu:
Veim mippeat panayv yimmaret rosho gibbeach hu tahor hu
Veim milloqobel appohi yattar sear resheh gelosh hu deke hu:
Veki-yihyeh baqqarachat o baggabbachat nega laban adamdam tzaraat porachat hiv beqarachto o begabbachto
Vaare yehe beqarachuteh o bigloshuteh maktash chivvar sammoq segirut sageya hi beqarachuteh o bigloshuteh:
Veraa oto hakkohen vehinneh seet-hannega lebana adamdemet beqarachto o begabbachto kemareh tzaraat or basar
Veyecheze yateh kahana veha ammiq maktasha chavvera sammeqa beqarachuteh o bigloshuteh kemecheze segiruta meshak bisra:
Ish-tzarua hu tame hu tamme yetammeennu hakkohen berosho nigo
Gebar segir hu mesaab hu sooba yesaebinneh kahana beresheh maktasheh:
Vehatztzarua asher-bo hannega begadayv yihyu perumim verosho yihyeh parua veal-sapam yateh vetame tame yiqra
Usegira di beh maktasha lebushohi yehon mebazzein veresheh yehe peria veal sapam kaabela yitattap vela tistaabun vela tistaabun yiqre:
Kol-yeme asher hannega bo yitma tame hu badad yesheb michutz lammachaneh moshabo
Kol yome di maktasha beh yehe mesaab mesaab hu bilchodohi yeteb mibbara lemashrita motebeh:
Vehabbeged ki-yihyeh bo nega tzaraat bebeged tzemer o bebeged pishtim
Ulebusha are yehe beh maktash segiru bilbush amar o bilbush kittan:
O bisheti o beereb lappishtim velatztzamer o beor o bekol-meleket or
O beshitya o bearba lekittana uleamra o bemashka o bekol abidat meshak:
Vehaya hannega yeraqraq o adamdam babbeged o baor o-bashsheti o-baereb o bekol-keli-or nega tzaraat hu vehora et-hakkohen
Vihe maktasha yaroq o sammoq bilbusha o bemashka o beshitya o bearba o bekal man dimshak maktash segiruta hu veyittachaze lekahana:
Veraa hakkohen et-hannaga vehisgir et-hannega shibat yamim
Veyecheze kahana yat maktasha veyasgar yat maktasha shibat yomin:
Veraa et-hannega bayyom hashshebii ki-pasa hannega babbeged o-bashsheti o-baereb o baor lekol asher-yeaseh haor limlaka tzaraat mameret hannega tame hu
Veyecheze yat maktasha beyoma shebiaa are osep maktasha bilbusha o beshitya o bearba o bemashka lekol di yitabed mashka leibida segirut mechasra maktasha mesaab hu:
Vesarap et-habbeged o et-hashsheti o et-haereb batztzemer o bappishtim o et-kol-keli haor asher-yihyeh bo hannaga ki-tzaraat mameret hiv baesh tissarep
Veyoqid yat lebusha o yat shitya o yat arba beamra o bekittana o yat kol man dimshak di yehe beh maktasha are segirut mechasra hi benura tittoqad:
Veim yireh hakkohen vehinneh lo-pasa hannega babbeged o bashsheti o baereb o bekol-keli-or
Veim yecheze kahana veha la osep maktasha bilbusha o beshitya o bearba o bekol man dimshak:
Vetzivva hakkohen vekibbesu et asher-bo hannaga vehisgiro shibat-yamim shenit
Vipaqqed kahana vichavverun yat di beh maktasha veyasgerinneh shibat yomin tinyanut:
Veraa hakkohen achare hukkabbes et-hannega vehinneh lo-hapak hannega et-eno vehannega lo-pasa tame hu baesh tisrepennu pechetet hiv beqarachto o begabbachto
Veyecheze kahana batar dechavvaru yat maktasha veha la shena maktasha min kad hava umaktasha la osep mesaab hu benura toqedinneh tabra hi beshechiquteh o bechaddatuteh:
Veim raa hakkohen vehinneh keha hannega achare hukkabbes oto veqara oto min-habbeged o min-haor o min-hashsheti o min-haereb
Veim chaza kahana veha ameya maktasha batar dechavvaru yateh ubeza yateh min lebusha o min mashka o min shitya o min arba:
Veim-teraeh od babbeged o-bashsheti o-baereb o bekol-keli-or porachat hiv baesh tisrepennu et asher-bo hannaga
Veim titchaze od bilbusha o beshitya o bearba o bekal man dimshak sageya hi benura toqedinneh yat di beh maktasha:
Vehabbeged o-hashsheti o-haereb o-kol-keli haor asher tekabbes vesar mehem hannaga vekubbas shenit vetaher
Ulebusha o shitya o arba o kol man dimshak di yitchavvar veyede minnehon maktasha veyitztabba tinyanut veyidke:
Zot torat nega-tzaraat beged hatztzemer o happishtim o hashsheti o haereb o kol-keli-or letaharo o letammeo
Da orayta demaktash segiru bilbush amar o kittana o shitya o arba o kol man dimshak ledakkayuteh o lesaabuteh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Zot tiheyeh torat hammetzora beyom tohorato vehuba el-hakkohen
Da tehe orayta disgira biyoma dedakuteh veyittete levat kahana:
Veyatza hakkohen el-michutz lammachaneh veraa hakkohen vehinneh nirpa nega-hatztzaraat min-hatztzarua
Veyippoq kahana lemibbara lemashrita veyecheze kahana veha ittassi maktash segiruta min segira:
Vetzivva hakkohen velaqach lammittaher shete-tzipporim chayyot tehorot veetz erez usheni tolaat veezob
Vipaqqed kahana veyissab lemiddakke tarten tzipperin chayyin dokyan veaa dearza utzeba zehori veezoba:
Vetzivva hakkohen veshachat et-hatztzippor haechat el-keli-cheres al-mayim chayyim
Vipaqqed kahana veyikkos yat tzippera chada leman dachasap al me mabbua:
Et-hatztzippor hachayya yiqqach otah veet-etz haerez veet-sheni hattolaat veet-haezob vetabal otam veet hatztzippor hachayya bedam hatztzippor hashshechuta al hammayim hachayyim
Yat tzippera chayta yissab yatah veyat aa dearza veyat tzeba zehori veyat ezoba veyitbol yatehon veyat tzippera chayta bidma detzippera dinkisa al me mabbua:
Vehizza al hammittaher min-hatztzaraat sheba peamim vetiharo veshillach et-hatztzippor hachayya al-pene hassadeh
Veyaddi al demiddakke min segiruta sheba zimnin vidakkinneh vishallach yat tzippera chayta al appe chaqla:
Vekibbes hammittaher et-begadayv vegillach et-kol-searo verachatz bammayim vetaher veachar yabo el-hammachaneh veyashab michutz leoholo shibat yamim
Vitzabba demiddakke yat lebushohi vigallach yat kol saareh veyasche bemayya veyidke ubatar ken yeol lemashrita viteb mibbara lemashkeneh shaba yomin:
Vehaya bayyom hashshebii yegallach et-kol-searo et-rosho veet-zeqano veet gabbot enayv veet-kol-searo yegalleach vekibbes et-begadayv verachatz et-besaro bammayim vetaher
Vihe beyoma shebiaa yegallach yat kol saareh yat resheh veyat diqneh veyat gebine enohi veyat kol saareh yegallach vitzabba yat lebushohi veyasche yat bisreh bemayya veyidke:
Ubayyom hashshemini yiqqach shene-kebasim temimim vekabsa achat bat-shenatah temima ushelosha esronim solet mincha belula bashshemen velog echad shamen
Ubeyoma teminaa yissab teren immerin shalmin veimmarta chada bat shatta shelemta utelata esronin sulta minchata depila bimshach velugga chad demishcha:
Veheemid hakkohen hametaher et haish hammittaher veotam lipne Adonai petach ohel moed
Viqim kahana dimdakke yat gabra demiddakke veyatehon qodam Adonai bitra mashkan zimna:
Velaqach hakkohen et-hakkebes haechad vehiqrib oto leasham veet-log hashshamen vehenip otam tenupa lipne Adonai
Veyissab kahana yat immera chada viqareb yateh laashama veyat lugga demishcha virim yatehon arama qodam Adonai:
Veshachat et-hakkebes bimqom asher yishchat et-hachattat veet-haola bimqom haqqodesh ki kachattat haasham hu lakkohen qodesh qodashim hu
Veyikkos yat immera baatar di yikkos yat chattata veyat alata baatar qaddish are kechattata ashama hu lekahana qodesh qudeshin hu:
Velaqach hakkohen middam haasham venatan hakkohen al-tenuk ozen hammittaher hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit
Veyissab kahana middema daashama veyitten kahana al rum udena demiddakke deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina:
Velaqach hakkohen millog hashshamen veyatzaq al-kap hakkohen hassemalit
Veyissab kahana millugga demishcha viriq al yeda dekahana dismala:
Vetabal hakkohen et-etzbao hayemanit min-hashshemen asher al-kappo hassemalit vehizza min-hashshemen beetzbao sheba peamim lipne Adonai
Veyitbol kahana yat etzbeeh deyammina min mishcha di al yedeh dismala veyaddi min mishcha beetzbeeh sheba zimnin qodam Adonai:
Umiyyeter hashshemen asher al-kappo yitten hakkohen al-tenuk ozen hammittaher hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit al dam haasham
Umishshear mishcha di al yedeh yitten kahana al rum udena demiddakke deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina al dema daashama:
Vehannotar bashshemen asher al-kap hakkohen yitten al-rosh hammittaher vekipper alayv hakkohen lipne Adonai
Udeishtaar bemishcha di al yeda dekahana yitten al resha demiddakke vikapper alohi kahana qodam Adonai:
Veasa hakkohen et-hachattat vekipper al-hammittaher mittumato veachar yishchat et-haola
Veyabed kahana yat chattata vikapper al demiddakke mesobeteh ubatar ken yikkos yat alata:
Veheela hakkohen et-haola veet-hammincha hammizbecha vekipper alayv hakkohen vetaher
Veyasseq kahana yat alata veyat minchata lemadbecha vikapper alohi kahana veyidke:
Veim-dal hu veen yado masseget velaqach kebes echad asham litnupa lekapper alayv veissaron solet echad balul bashshemen lemincha velog shamen
Veim misken hu velet yedeh madbeqa veyissab immar chad ashama laarama lekappara alohi veisrona sulta chad depil bimshach lemincha velugga demishcha:
Ushete torim o shene bene yona asher tassig yado vehaya echad chattat vehaechad ola
Vetarten shapninin o teren bene yona di tadbeq yedeh vihe chad chattata vechad alata:
Vehebi otam bayyom hashshemini letohorato el-hakkohen el-petach ohel-moed lipne Adonai
Veyayti yatehon beyoma teminaa ledakkayuteh levat kahana litra mashkan zimna qodam Adonai:
Velaqach hakkohen et-kebes haasham veet-log hashshamen vehenip otam hakkohen tenupa lipne Adonai
Veyissab kahana yat immera daashama veyat lugga demishcha virim yatehon kahana arama qodam Adonai:
Veshachat et-kebes haasham velaqach hakkohen middam haasham venatan al-tenuk ozen-hammittaher hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit
Veyikkos yat immera daashama veyissab kahana middema daashama veyitten al rum udena demiddakke deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina:
Umin-hashshemen yitzoq hakkohen al-kap hakkohen hassemalit
Umin mishcha yeriq kahana al yeda dekahana dismala:
Vehizza hakkohen beetzbao hayemanit min-hashshemen asher al-kappo hassemalit sheba peamim lipne Adonai
Veyaddi kahana beetzbeeh deyammina min mishcha di al yedeh dismala sheba zimnin qodam Adonai:
Venatan hakkohen min-hashshemen asher al-kappo al-tenuk ozen hammittaher hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit al-meqom dam haasham
Veyitten kahana min mishcha di al yedeh al rum udena demiddakke deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina al atar dema daashama:
Vehannotar min-hashshemen asher al-kap hakkohen yitten al-rosh hammittaher lekapper alayv lipne Adonai
Udeyishtaar min mishcha di al yeda dekahana yitten al resha demiddakke lekappara alohi qodam Adonai:
Veasa et-haechad min-hattorim o min-bene hayyona measher tassig yado
Veyabed yat chad min shapninayya o min bene yona middi tadbeq yedeh:
Et asher-tassig yado et-haechad chattat veet-haechad ola al-hammincha vekipper hakkohen al hammittaher lipne Adonai
Yat di tadbeq yedeh yat chad chattata veyat chad alata al minchata vikapper kahana al demiddakke qodam Adonai:
Zot torat asher-bo nega tzaraat asher lo-tassig yado betohorato
Da orayta di beh maktash segiru di la tadbeq yedeh bedakuteh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh veim aharon lememar:
Ki tabou el-eretz kenaan asher ani noten lakem laachuzza venatatti nega tzaraat bebet eretz achuzzatkem
Are tealun leara diknaan di ana yaheb lekon leachasana veetten maktash segiru bebet ara achasnetekon:
Uba asher-lo habbayit vehiggid lakkohen lemor kenega nira li babbayit
Veyete dedileh beta vichavvi lekahana lememar kemaktasha itchazi li bebeta:
Vetzivva hakkohen upinnu et-habbayit beterem yabo hakkohen lirot et-hannega velo yitma kol-asher babbayit veachar ken yabo hakkohen lirot et-habbayit
Vipaqqed kahana vipannun yat beta ad la yeol kahana lemecheze yat maktasha vela yistaab kol di bebeta ubatar ken yeol kahana lemecheze yat beta:
Veraa et-hannega vehinneh hannega beqirot habbayit sheqaarurot yeraqraqqot o adamdammot umarehen shapal min-haqqir
Veyecheze yat maktasha veha maktasha bekatele beta pachatin yarqan o samqan umechezehon makkik min katela:
Veyatza hakkohen min-habbayit el-petach habbayit vehisgir et-habbayit shibat yamim
Veyippoq kahana min beta litra beta veyasgar yat beta shiba yomin:
Veshab hakkohen bayyom hashshebii veraa vehinneh pasa hannega beqirot habbayit
Vitub kahana beyoma shebiaa veyecheze veha osip maktasha bekatele beta:
Vetzivva hakkohen vechilletzu et-haabanim asher bahen hannaga vehishliku ethen el-michutz lair el-maqom tame
Vipaqqed kahana vishallepun yat abnayya di behon maktasha veyirmun yatehon lemibbara leqarta laatar mesaab:
Veet-habbayit yaqtzia mibbayit sabib veshapeku et-heapar asher hiqtzu el-michutz lair el-maqom tame
Veyat beta yeqallepun miggayv sechor sechor veyirmun yat apra di qallipu lemibbara leqarta laatar mesaab:
Velaqechu abanim acherot vehebiu el-tachat haabanim veapar acher yiqqach vetach et-habbayit
Veyissebun abnayya ochoranin veyaalun laatar abnayya vaapar ochoran yissab vishua yat beta:
Veim-yashub hannega uparach babbayit achar chilletz et-haabanim veachare hiqtzot et-habbayit veachare hittoach
Veim yetub maktasha veyisge bebeta batar deshallipu yat abnayya ubatar deqallipu yat beta ubatar deittesha:
Uba hakkohen veraa vehinneh pasa hannega babbayit tzaraat mameret hiv babbayit tame hu
Veyeol kahana veyecheze veha osep maktasha bebeta segirut mechasra hi bebeta mesaab hu:
Venatatz et-habbayit et-abanayv veet-etzayv veet kol-apar habbayit vehotzi el-michutz lair el-maqom tame
Vitara yat beta yat abnohi veyat aohi veyat kol apar beta veyappeq lemibbara leqarta laatar mesaab:
Vehabba el-habbayit kol-yeme hisgir oto yitma ad-haareb
Udeyeol lebeta kol yomin deyasgar yateh yehe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vehashshokeb babbayit yekabbes et-begadayv vehaokel babbayit yekabbes et-begadayv
Udeyishkub bebeta yetzabba yat lebushohi udeyekul bebeta yetzabba yat lebushohi:
Veim-bo yabo hakkohen veraa vehinneh lo-pasa hannega babbayit achare hittoach et-habbayit vetihar hakkohen et-habbayit ki nirpa hannaga
Veim meal yeol kahana veyecheze veha la osep maktasha bebeta batar deittesha yat beta vidakke kahana yat beta are ittassi maktasha:
Velaqach lechatte et-habbayit shete tzipporim veetz erez usheni tolaat veezob
Veyissab ledakkaa yat beta tarten tzipperin veaa dearza utzeba zehori veezoba:
Veshachat et-hatztzippor haechat el-keli-cheres al-mayim chayyim
Veyikkos yat tzippara chada leman dachasap al me mabbua:
Velaqach et-etz-haerez veet-haezob veet sheni hattolaat veet hatztzippor hachayya vetabal otam bedam hatztzippor hashshechuta ubammayim hachayyim vehizza el-habbayit sheba peamim
Veyissab yat aa dearza veyat ezoba veyat tzeba zehori veyat tzippara chayta veyitbol yatehon bidma detzippara dinkisa ubeme mabbua veyaddi lebeta sheba zimnin:
Vechitte et-habbayit bedam hatztzippor ubammayim hachayyim ubatztzippor hachayya ubeetz haerez ubaezob ubishni hattolaat
Vidakke yat beta bidma detzippara ubeme mabbua ubetzippara chayta ubeaa dearza ubeezoba ubitzba zehori:
Veshillach et-hatztzippor hachayya el-michutz lair el-pene hassadeh vekipper al-habbayit vetaher
Vishallach yat tzippara chayta lemibbara leqarta leappe chaqla vikappar al beta veyidke:
Zot hattora lekol-nega hatztzaraat velannateq
Da orayta lekol maktash segiruta ulenitqa:
Uletzaraat habbeged velabbayit
Velisgirut lebusha ulebeta:
Velaset velassappachat velabbeharet
Uleamqa uleadya ulebahara:
Lehorot beyom hattame ubeyom hattahor zot torat hatztzaraat
Leallapa beyoma mesaaba ubeyoma dakya da orayta disgiruta:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh veim aharon lememar:
Dabberu el-bene yisrael vaamartem alehem ish ish ki yihyeh zab mibbesaro zobo tame hu
Mallilu im bene yisrael vetemerun lehon gebar gebar are yehe daib mibbisreh dobeh mesaab hu:
Vezot tihyeh tumato bezobo rar besaro et-zobo o-hechtim besaro mizzobo tumato hiv
Veda tehe sobeteh bedobeh rar bisreh yat dobeh o chatim bisreh middobeh sobeteh hi:
Kol-hammishkab asher yishkab alayv hazzab yitma vekol-hakkeli asher-yesheb alayv yitma
Kol mishkeba di yishkub alohi dobana yehe mesaab vekol mana deyeteb alohi yehe mesaab:
Veish asher yigga bemishkabo yekabbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Ugebar di yiqrab bmishkebeh yetzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vehayyosheb al-hakkeli asher-yesheb alayv hazzab yekabbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Udeyeteb al mana deyeteb alohi dobana yetzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vehannogea bibsar hazzab yekabbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Udeyiqrab bibsar dobana yetzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Veki-yaroq hazzab battahor vekibbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Vaare yeroq dobana bedakya vitzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vekol-hammerkab asher yirkab alayv hazzab yitma
Vekol merkeba di yirkub alohi dobana yehe mesaab:
Vekol-hannogea bekol asher yihyeh tachtayv yitma ad-haareb vehannose otam yekabbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Vekol deyiqrab bekol di yehe techotohi yehe mesaab ad ramsha udeyittol yatehon yetzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vekol asher yigga-bo hazzab veyadayv lo-shatap bammayim vekibbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Vekol di yiqrab beh dobana vidohi la shetap bemayya vitzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Ukeli-cheres asher-yigga-bo hazzab yishshaber vekol-keli-etz yishshatep bammayim
Uman dachasap di yiqrab beh dobana yittabar vekol man dea yishtattap bemayya:
Veki-yithar hazzab mizzobo vesapar lo shibat yamim letohorato vekibbes begadayv verachatz besaro bemayim chayyim vetaher
Vaare yidke dobana middobeh veyimne leh shibat yomin ledakuteh vitzabba lebushohi veyasche bisreh beme mabbua veyidke:
Ubayyom hashshemini yiqqach-lo shete torim o shene bene yona uba lipne Adonai el-petach ohel moed unetanam el-hakkohen
Ubeyoma teminaa yissab leh tarten shapninin o teren bene yona veyete loqodam Adonai litra mashkan zimna veyitteninnun lekahana:
Veasa otam hakkohen echad chattat vehaechad ola vekipper alayv hakkohen lipne Adonai mizzobo
Veyabed yatehon kahana chad chattata vechad alata vikapper alohi kahana qodam Adonai middobeh:
Veish ki-tetze mimmennu shikbat-zara verachatz bammayim et-kol-besaro vetame ad-haareb
Ugebar are tippoq minneh shikbat zara veyasche bemayya yat kol bisreh vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vekol-beged vekol-or asher-yihyeh alayv shikbat-zara vekubbas bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Vekol lebush vekol meshak di yehe alohi shikbat zara veyitztabba bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Veishsha asher yishkab ish otah shikbat-zara verachatzu bammayim vetameu ad-haareb
Veitteta di yishkub gebar yatah shikbat zara veyaschun bemayya veyisabun ad ramsha:
Veishsha ki-tihyeh zaba dam yihyeh zobah bibsarah shibat yamim tihyeh beniddatah vekol-hannogea bah yitma ad-haareb
Veitteta are tehe dayeba dam yehe dobah bebisrah shiba yomin tehe berichuqah vekol deyiqrab bah yehe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vekol asher tishkab alayv beniddatah yitma vekol asher-tesheb alayv yitma
Vekol di tishkub alohi berichuqah yehe mesaab vekol di teteb alohi yehe mesaab:
Vekol-hannogea bemishkabah yekabbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Vekol deyiqrab bemishkebah yetzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vekol-hannogea bekol-keli asher-tesheb alayv yekabbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Vekol deyiqrab bekol mana di teteb alohi yetzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Veim al-hammishkab hu o al-hakkeli asher-hiv yoshebet-alayv benogo-bo yitma ad-haareb
Veim al mishkeba hu o al mana di hi yateba alohi bemiqrebeh beh yehe mesaab ad ramsha:
Veim shakob yishkab ish otah utehi niddatah alayv vetame shibat yamim vekol-hammishkab asher-yishkab alayv yitma
Veim mishkab yishkub gebar yatah utehe richuqah alohi vihe mesaab shibat yomin vekol mishkeba di yishkub alohi yehe mesaab:
Veishsha ki-yazub zob damah yamim rabbim belo et-niddatah o ki-tazub al-niddatah kol-yeme zob tumatah kime niddatah tihyeh temea hiv
Veitteta are yedub dob demah yomin saggiin bela iddan richuqah o are tedub al richuqah kol yome dob sobetah keyomeh richuqah tehe mesooba hi:
Kol-hammishkab asher-tishkab alayv kol-yeme zobah kemishkab niddatah yiheyeh-lah vekol-hakkeli asher tesheb alayv tame yihyeh ketumat niddatah
Kol mishkeba di tishkub alohi kol yome dobah kemishkab richuqah yehe lah vekol mana di teteb alohi mesaab yehe kesoabat richuqah:
Vekol-hannogea bam yitma vekibbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Vekol deyiqrab behon yehe mesaab vitzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Veim-tahara mizzobah vesapera lah shibat yamim veachar tithar
Veim dekiat middobah vetimne lah shibat yomin ubatar ken tidke:
Ubayyom hashshemini tiqqach-la shete torim o shene bene yona vehebia otam el-hakkohen el-petach ohel moed
Ubeyoma teminaa tissab lah tarten shapninin o teren bene yona vetayti yatehon levat kahana litra mashkan zimna:
Veasa hakkohen et-haechad chattat veet-haechad ola vekipper aleha hakkohen lipne Adonai mizzob tumatah
Veyabed kahana yat chad chattata veyat chad alata vikapper alah kahana qodam Adonai middob sobetah:
Vehizzartem et-bene-yisrael mittumatam velo yamutu betumatam betammeam et-mishkani asher betokam
Vetapreshun yat bene yisrael missoabathon vela yemutun besoabathon besaabehon yat mashkeni di benehon:
Zot torat hazzab vaasher tetze mimmennu shikbat-zera letoma-ba
Da orayta dedobena vedi tippoq minneh shikbat zara leistaaba bah:
Vehaddava beniddatah vehazzab et-zobo lazzakar velanneqeba uleish asher yishkab im-temea
Velidsaubeta berichuqah veliddaib yat dobeh lidkar ulenuqba veligbar di yishkub im mesaaba:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh achare mot shene bene aharon beqorbatam lipne-Adonai vayyamutu
Umallil Adonai im msheh batar demitu teren bene aharon beqarobehon eshshata nukereta qodam Adonai umitu:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh dabber el-aharon achika veal-yabo bekol-et el-haqqodesh mibbet lapparoket el-pene hakkapporet asher al-haaron velo yamut ki beanan eraeh al-hakkapporet
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh mallel im aharon achuk vela yehe alel bekol iddan lequdesha miggayv leparukta loqodam kappurta di al arona vela yemut are baanana ana mitgeli al bet kappurta:
Bezot yabo aharon el-haqqodesh bepar ben-baqar lechattat veayil leola
Beda yehe alel aharon lequdesha betor bar tore lechattata udekar laalata:
Ketonet-bad qodesh yilbash umikenese-bad yihyu al-besaro ubeabnet bad yachgor ubemitznepet bad yitznop bigde-qodesh hem verachatz bammayim et-besaro ulebesham
Kittuna debutza qudesha yilbash umiknesin debutz yehon al bisreh ubehemyana debutza yesar ubemitznepta debutza yachet beresheh lebushe qudesha innun veyasche bemayya yat bisreh veyalbeshinnun:
Umeet adat bene yisrael yiqqach shene-seire izzim lechattat veayil echad leola
Umin kenishta dibne yisrael yissab teren tzepire izzin lechattata udekar chad laalata:
Vehiqrib aharon et-par hachattat asher-lo vekipper baado ubead beto
Viqareb aharon yat tora dechattata di leh vikapper alohi veal enash beteh:
Velaqach et-shene hasseirim veheemid otam lipne Adonai petach ohel moed
Veyissab yat teren tzepirin viqim yatehon qodam Adonai bitra mashkan zimna:
Venatan aharon al-shene hasseirim goralot goral echad la-Adonai vegoral echad laazazel
Veyitten aharon al teren tzepirin adbin adba chad lishma daAdonai veadba chad laazazel:
Vehiqrib aharon et-hassair asher ala alayv haggoral la-Adonai veasahu chattat
Viqareb aharon yat tzepira di seliq alohi adba lishma daAdonai veyabidineh chattata:
Vehassair asher ala alayv haggoral laazazel yoomad-chay lipne Adonai lekapper alayv leshallach oto laazazel hammidbara
Utzepira di seliq alohi adba laazazel yittaqam kad chay qodam Adonai lekappara alohi leshallach yateh laazazel lemadbera:
Vehiqrib aharon et-par hachattat asher-lo vekipper baado ubead beto veshachat et-par hachattat asher-lo
Viqareb aharon yat tora dechattata di leh vikapper alohi veal enash beteh veyikkos yat tora dechattata di leh:
Velaqach melo-hammachta gachale-esh meal hammizbeach millipne Adonai umelo chopnayv qetoret sammim daqqa vehebi mibbet lapparoket
Veyissab mele machtita gumerin deeshsha meillave madbecha min qodam Adonai umele chopnohi qetoret busemin daqqiqin veyael miggayv leparukta:
Venatan et-haqqetoret al-haesh lipne Adonai vekissa anan haqqetoret et-hakkapporet asher al-haedut velo yamut
Veyitten yat qetoret busemayya al eshshata loqodam Adonai vechape anana qetareta yat kappurta di al sahaduta vela yemut:
Velaqach middam happar vehizza beetzbao al-pene hakkapporet qedema velipne hakkapporet yazzeh sheba-peamim min-haddam beetzbao
Veyissab middema detora veyaddi beetzbeeh al appe kappurta qidduma veloqodam kappurta yaddi sheba zimnin min dema beetzbeeh:
Veshachat et-seir hachattat asher laam vehebi et-damo el-mibbet lapparoket veasa et-damo kaasher asa ledam happar vehizza oto al-hakkapporet velipne hakkapporet
Veyikkos yat tzepira dechattata di leamma veyael yat demeh lemiggayv leparukta veyabed lidmeh kema di abad lidma detora veyaddi yateh al kappurta veloqodam kappurta:
Vekipper al-haqqodesh mittumot bene yisrael umippishehem lekol-chattotam veken yaaseh leohel moed hashshoken ittam betok tumotam
Vikapper al qudesha missoabat bene yisrael umimmerdehon lekol chataehon veken yabed lemashkan zimna deshare immehon bego soabatehon:
Vekol-adam lo-yihyeh beohel moed beboo lekapper baqqodesh ad-tzeto vekipper baado ubead beto ubead kol-qehal yisrael
Vekol enash la yehe bemashkan zimna bemealeh lekappara bequdesha ad mippeqeh vikapper alohi veal enash beteh veal kol qehala deyisrael:
Veyatza el-hammizbeach asher lipne-Adonai vekipper alayv velaqach middam happar umiddam hassair venatan al-qarnot hammizbeach sabib
Veyippoq lemadbecha di qodam Adonai vikapper alohi veyissab middema detora umiddema ditzpira veyitten al qarnat madbecha sechor sechor:
Vehizza alayv min-haddam beetzbao sheba peamim vetiharo veqiddesho mittumot bene yisrael
Veyadde alohi min dema beetzbeeh sheba zimnin vidakkinneh viqaddeshinneh missoabat bene yisrael:
Vekilla mikkapper et-haqqodesh veet-ohel moed veet-hammizbeach vehiqrib et-hassair hechay
Vishetze millekappara al qudesha veal mashkan zimna veal madbecha viqareb yat tzepira chayya:
Vesamak aharon et-shete yadav al rosh hassair hachay vehitvadda alayv et-kol-avonot bene yisrael veet-kol-pishehem lekol-chattotam venatan otam al-rosh hassair veshillach beyad-ish itti hammidbara

Veyismok aharon yat tarten yedohi al resh tzepira chayya veyivadde alohi yat kol avayat bene yisrael veyat kol merdehon lekol chataehon veyitten yatehon al resh tzepira vishallach beyad gebar dizmin limhak lemadbera:
Venasa hassair alayv et-kol-avonotam el-eretz gezera veshillach et-hassair bammidbar
Veyittol tzepira alohi yat kol chobehon leara dela yateba vishallach yat tzepira bemadbera:
Uba aharon el-ohel moed upashat et-bigde habbad asher labash beboo el-haqqodesh vehinnicham sham
Veyeol aharon lemashkan zimna veyashlach yat lebushe butza di lebash bemealeh lequdesha veyatzneinnun tamman:
Verachatz et-besaro bammayim bemaqom qadosh velabash et-begadayv veyatza veasa et-olato veet-olat haam vekipper baado ubead haam
Veyasche yat bisreh bemayya baatar qaddish veyilbash yat lebushohi veyippoq veyabed yat alateh veyat alat amma vikappar alohi veal amma:
Veet cheleb hachattat yaqtir hammizbecha
Veyat tarba dechattata yasseq lemadbecha:
Vehameshalleach et-hassair laazazel yekabbes begadayv verachatz et-besaro bammayim veachare-ken yabo el-hammachaneh
Udemobil yat tzepira laazazel yetzabba lebushohi veyasche yat bisreh bemayya ubatar ken yeol lemashrita:
Veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat asher huba et-damam lekapper baqqodesh yotzi el-michutz lammachaneh vesarepu baesh et-orotam veet-besaram veet-pirsham
Veyat tora dechattata veyat tzepira dechattata di ittaal middimhon lekappara bequdesha yittappequn lemibbara lemashrita veyoqedun benura yat mashkehon veyat bisrehon veyat oklehon:
Vehassorep otam yekabbes begadayv verachatz et-besaro bammayim veachare-ken yabo el-hammachaneh
Udemoqid yatehon yetzabba lebushohi veyasche yat bisreh bemayya ubatar ken yeol lemashrita:
Vehayeta lakem lechuqqat olam bachodesh hashshebii beasor lachodesh teannu et-napshotekem vekol-melaka lo taasu haezrach vehagger haggar betokekem
Utehe lekon liqyam alam beyarcha shebiaa beasra leyarcha teannun yat napshatekon vekol ibida la tabedun yatztziba vegiyyora deyitgayyerun benekon:
Ki-bayyom hazzeh yekapper alekem letaher etkem mikkol chattotekem lipne Adonai titharu
Are beyoma haden yekapper alekon ledakkaa yatekon mikkol chobekon qodam Adonai tidkun:
Shabbat shabbaton hi lakem veinnitem et-napshotekem chuqqat olam
Shebat shebata hi lekon uteannun yat napshatekon qeyam alam:
Vekipper hakkohen asher-yimshach oto vaasher yemalle et-yado lekahen tachat abiv velabash et-bigde habbad bigde haqqodesh
Vikappar kahana di rabbi yateh vedi yeqareb yat qurbaneh leshammasha techot abuhi veyilbash yat lebushe butza lebushe qudesha:
Vekipper et-miqdash haqqodesh veet-ohel moed veet-hammizbeach yekapper veal hakkohanim veal-kol-am haqqahal yekapper
Vikappar al miqdash qudesha veal mashkan zimna veal madbecha yekappar veal kahanayya veal kol amma diqhala yekappar:
Vehayeta-zot lakem lechuqqat olam lekapper al-bene yisrael mikkol-chattotam achat bashshana vayyaas kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Utehe da lekon liqyam alam lekappara al bene yisrael mikkol chobehon chada beshatta vaabad kema di paqqed Adonai yat msheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banayv veel kol-bene yisrael veamarta alehem zeh haddabar asher-tzivva Adonai lemor
Mallel im aharon veim benohi veim kol bene yisrael vetemar lehon den pitgama di paqqid Adonai lememar:
Ish ish mibbet yisrael asher yishchat shor o-keseb o-ez bammachaneh o asher yishchat michutz lammachaneh
Gebar gebar mibbet yisrael di yikkos tor o immar o izza bemashrita o di yikkos mibbara lemashrita:
Veel-petach ohel moed lo hebio lehaqrib qorban la-Adonai lipne mishkan Adonai dam yechasheb laish hahu dam shapak venikrat haish hahu miqqereb ammo
Velitra mashkan zimna la ayteh leqaraba qurbana qodam Adonai qodam mashkena daAdonai dema yitchashshab legabra hahu dema ashad veyishtetze anasha hahu miggo ammeh:
Lemaan asher yabiu bene yisrael et-zibchehem asher hem zobechim al-pene hassadeh vehebium la-Adonai el-petach ohel moed el-hakkohen vezabechu zibche shelamim la-Adonai otam
Bedil di yaytun bene yisrael yat dibchehon di innun dabechin al appe chaqla veyaytunnun loqodam Adonai litra mashkan zimna levat kahana veyikkesun niksat qudeshin qodam Adonai yatehon:
Vezaraq hakkohen et-haddam al-mizbach Adonai petach ohel moed vehiqtir hacheleb lereach nichoach la-Adonai
Veyizroq kahana yat dema al madbecha daAdonai bitra mashkan zimna veyasseq tarba leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai:
Velo-yizbechu od et-zibchehem lasseirim asher hem zonim acharehem chuqqat olam tiheyeh-zot lahem ledorotam
Vela yidbechun od yat dibchehon lashshedin di innun taan batrehon qeyam alam tehe da lehon ledarehon:
Vaalehem tomar ish ish mibbet yisrael umin-hagger asher-yagur betokam asher-yaaleh ola o-zabach
Ulehon temar gebar gebar mibbet yisrael umin giyyora deyitgayyerun benekon di yasseq alata o niksat qudeshayya:
Veel-petach ohel moed lo yebiennu laasot oto la-Adonai venikrat haish hahu meammayv
Velitra mashkan zimna la aytinneh lemebad yateh qodam Adonai veyishtetze anasha hahu meammeh:
Veish ish mibbet yisrael umin-hagger haggar betokam asher yokal kol-dam venatatti panay bannepesh haokelet et-haddam vehikratti otah miqqereb ammah
Ugebar gebar mibbet yisrael umin giyyora deyitgayyerun benekon di yekul kol dema veetten rugezi baanasha deyekul yat dema veeshetze yateh miggo ammeh:
Ki nepesh habbasar baddam hiv vaani netattiv lakem al-hammizbeach lekapper al-napshotekem ki-haddam hu bannepesh yekapper
Are nepash bisra bidma hi vaana yehabitteh lekon al madbecha lekappara al napshatekon are dema hu al napsha mekapper:
Al-ken amarti libne yisrael kol-nepesh mikkem lo-tokal dam vehagger haggar betokekem lo-yokal dam
Al ken amarit libne yisrael kol enash minnekon la yekul dema vegiyyora deyitgayyerun benekon la yekul dema:
Veish ish mibbene yisrael umin-hagger haggar betokam asher yatzud tzed chayya o-op asher yeakel veshapak et-damo vekissahu beapar
Ugebar gebar min bene yisrael umin giyyora deyitgayyerun benekon di yetzud tzeda chayta o opa di mitakel veyeshod yat demeh vikassinneh beapra:
Ki-nepesh kol-basar damo benapsho hu vaomar libne yisrael dam kol-basar lo tokelu ki nepesh kol-basar damo hiv kol-okelayv yikkaret
Are nepash kol bisra demeh benapsheh hu vaamarit libne yisrael dam kol bisra la tekelun are nepash kol bisra demeh hi kol deyekelinneh yishtetze:
Vekol-nepesh asher tokal nebela uterepa baezrach ubagger vekibbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haereb vetaher
Vekol enash di yekul nebila utebira beyatztziba ubegiyyora vitzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha veyidke:
Veim lo yekabbes ubesaro lo yirchatz venasa avono
Veim la yetzabba ubisreh la yasche viqabbel chobeh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ani Adonai elohekem
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon ana Adonai elahakon:
Kemaaseh eretz-mitzrayim asher yeshabtem-bah lo taasu ukemaaseh eretz-kenaan asher ani mebi etkem shamma lo taasu ubechuqqotehem lo teleku
Keobade amma deara demitzrayim di yetebtun bah la tabedun ukeobade amma deara diknaan di ana mael yatekon tamman la tabedun ubenimosehon la tehakun:
Et-mishpatay taasu veet-chuqqotay tishmeru laleket bahem ani Adonai elohekem
Yat dinay tabedun veyat qeyamay titterun lehallaka behon ana Adonai elahakon:
Ushemartem et-chuqqotay veet-mishpatay asher yaaseh otam haadam vachay bahem ani Adonai
Vetitterun yat qeyamay veyat dinay di yabed yatehon anasha veyeche behon lechayye alema ana Adonai:
Ish ish el-kol-sheer besaro lo tiqrebu legallot erva ani Adonai
Gebar gebar lekol qarib bisreh la tiqrebun legallaa erya ana Adonai:
Ervat abika veervat immeka lo tegalleh immeka hiv lo tegalleh ervatah
Eryat abuk veeryat immak la tegalle immak hi la tegalle eryetah:
Ervat eshet-abika lo tegalleh ervat abika hiv
Eryat ittat abuk la tegalle eryat abuk hi:
Ervat achoteka bat-abika o bat-immeka moledet bayit o moledet chutz lo tegalleh ervatan
Eryat achatak bat abuk o bat immak dilida min abuk min ittat ochori o min immak ligbar ochoran la tegalle eryathen:
Ervat bat-binka o bat-bitteka lo tegalleh ervatan ki ervateka henna
Eryat bat berak o bat berattak la tegalle eryathen are eryetak innun:
Ervat bat-eshet abika moledet abika achoteka hiv lo tegalleh ervatah
Eryat bat ittat abuk dilida min abuk achatak hi la tegalle eryetah:
Ervat achot-abika lo tegalleh sheer abika hiv
Eryat achat abuk la tegalle qaribat abuk hi:
Ervat achot-immeka lo tegalleh ki-sheer immeka hiv
Eryat achat immak la tegalle are qaribat immak hi:
Ervat achi-abika lo tegalleh el-ishto lo tiqrab dodateka hiv
Eryat ach abuk la tegalle leitteteh la tiqrab ittat ach abuk hi:
Ervat kallateka lo tegalleh eshet binka hiv lo tegalleh ervatah
Eryat kalletak la tegalle ittat berak hi la tegalle eryetah:
Ervat eshet-achika lo tegalleh ervat achika hiv
Eryat ittat achuk la tegalle eryat achuk hi:
Ervat ishsha ubittah lo tegalleh et-bat-benah veet-bat-bittah lo tiqqach legallot ervatah shaara henna zimma hiv
Eryat itteta uberattah la tegalle yat bat berah veyat bat berattah la tissab legallaa eryetah qariban innun etzat chitin hi:
Veishsha el-achotah lo tiqqach litzror legallot ervatah aleha bechayyeha
Veitteta im achatah la tissab leaqaa legallaa eryetah alah bechayyayha:
Veel-ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tiqrab legallot ervatah
Uleitteta berichuq sobetah la tiqrab legallaa eryetah:
Veel-eshet amiteka lo-titten shekobteka lezara letoma-ba
Ubeittat chabrak la titten shekubtak lezara leistaaba bah:
Umizzaraka lo-titten lehaabir lammolek velo techallel et-shem eloheka ani Adonai
Umibbenayk la titten leabara lemolek vela tachel yat shema deelahak ana Adonai:
Veet-zakar lo tishkab mishkebe ishsha toeba hiv
Veim dekura la tishkub mishkebe itteta toebta hi:
Ubekol-behema lo-titten shekobteka letoma-ba veishsha lo-taamod lipne behema leribah tebel hu
Ubekol beira la titten shekubtak leistaaba bah veitteta la tequm qodam beira lemishlat bah tibla hu:
Al-tittammeu bekol-elleh ki bekol-elleh nitmeu haggoyim asher-ani meshalleach mippenekem
La tistaabun bekol illen are bekal illen istaabu ammayya di ana magle min qodamekon:
Vattitma haaretz vaepqod avonah aleha vattaqi haaretz et-yoshebeha
Veistaabat ara veasarit chobah alah veroqenat ara yat yatebaha:
Ushemartem attem et-chuqqotay veet-mishpatay velo taasu mikkol hattoebot haelleh haezrach vehagger haggar betokekem
Vetitterun attun yat qeyamay veyat dinay vela tabedun mikkol toebta haillen yatztziba vegiyyora deyitgayyerun benekon:
Ki et-kol-hattoebot hael asu anshe-haaretz asher lipnekem vattitma haaretz
Are yat kol toebta haillen abadu enashe ara di qodamekon veistaabat ara:
Velo-taqi haaretz etkem betammaakem otah kaasher qaa et-haggoy asher lipnekem
Vela teroqen ara yatekon besoobekon yatah kema deroqenat yat ammayya di qodamekon:
Ki kol-asher yaaseh mikkol hattoebot haelleh venikretu hannepashot haosot miqqereb ammam
Are kol di yabed mikkol toebta haillen veyishtetzun napshata diyabedun miggo ammehon:
Ushemartem et-mishmarti lebilti asot mechuqqot hattoebot asher naasu lipnekem velo tittammeu bahem ani Adonai elohekem
Vetitterun yat matterat memeri bedil dela lemebad minnimose toebta deitabada qodamekon vela tistaabun behon ana Adonai elahakon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-kol-adat bene-yisrael veamarta alehem qedoshim tihyu ki qadosh ani Adonai elohekem
Mallel im kol kenishta dibne yisrael vetemar lehon qaddishin tehon are qaddish ana Adonai elahakon:
Ish immo veabiv tirau veet-shabbetotay tishmoru ani Adonai elohekem
Gebar min immeh umin abuhi tehon dachalin veyat yome shabbayya dili titrun ana Adonai elahakon:
Al-tipnu el-haelilim velohe masseka lo taasu lakem ani Adonai elohekem
La titpenun batar taavan vedachalan dematteka la tabedun lekon ana Adonai elahakon:
Veki tizbechu zebach shelamim la-Adonai liretzonekem tizbachuhu
Vaare tikkesun niksat qudeshayya qodam Adonai leraava lekon tikkesunneh:
Beyom zibchakem yeakel umimmochorat vehannotar ad-yom hashshelishi baesh yissarep
Beyoma deyitnekes yitakel ubeyoma debatrohi udeishtaar ad yoma telitaa benura yittoqad:
Veim heakol yeakel bayyom hashshelishi piggul hu lo yeratzeh
Veim itakala yitakel beyoma telitaa merachaq hu la yehe leraava:
Veokelayv avono yissa ki-et-qodesh Adonai chillel venikreta hannepesh hahiv meammeha
Udeyekelinneh chobeh yeqabbel are yat qudesha daAdonai achel veyishtetze anasha hahu meammeh:
Ubequtzrekem et-qetzir artzekem lo tekalleh peat sadeka liqtzor veleqet qetzireka lo telaqqet
Ubemechtzadekon yat chatzada dearakon la teshetze pata dechaqlak lemechtzad uleqata dachatzadak la telaqqet:
Vekarmeka lo teolel uperet karmeka lo telaqqet leani velagger taazob otam ani Adonai elohekem
Vekarmak la tealel venitra dekarmak la telaqqet leanye ulegiyyore tishboq yatehon ana Adonai elahakon:
Lo tignobu velo-tekachashu velo-teshaqqeru ish baamito
La tignebun vela tekaddebun vela teshaqqerun enash bechabreh:
Velo-tishshabeu bishmi lashshaqer vechillalta et-shem eloheka ani Adonai
Vela tishshabeun bishmi leshiqra vetachel yat shema deelahak ana Adonai:
Lo-taashoq et-reaka velo tigzol lo-talin peullat sakir itteka ad-boqer
La taashoq yat chabrak vela teannes la tebit agra daagira levatak ad tzapra:
Lo-teqallel cheresh velipne ivver lo titten mikshol veyareta meeloheka ani Adonai
La telut dela shama veqodam dela chaze la tesim taqla vetidchal meelahak ana Adonai:
Lo-taasu avel bammishpat lo-tissa pene-dal velo tehdar pene gadol betzedeq tishpot amiteka
La tabedun sheqar bedina la tissab appe maskena vela tehdar appe rabba bequsheta tedineh lechabrak:
Lo-telek rakil beammeka lo taamod al-dam reeka ani Adonai
La tekul quretzin beammak la tequm al dema dechabrak ana Adonai:
Lo-tisna et-achika bilbabeka hokeach tokiach et-amiteka velo-tissa alayv chet
La tisne yat achuk belibbak okacha tokach yat chabrak vela teqabbel al di leh choba:
Lo-tiqqom velo-tittor et-bene ammeka veahabta lereaka kamoka ani Adonai
La tiqqom vela tittar debabu libne ammak uterachem lechabrak kevatak ana Adonai:
Et-chuqqotay tishmoru behemteka lo-tarbia kilayim sadeka lo-tizra kilayim ubeged kilayim shaatnez lo yaaleh aleka
Yat qeyamay titterun beirak la tarkeb erubin chaqlak la tizra erubin ulebush erubin shaatneza la yissaq alak:
Veish ki-yishkab et-ishsha shikbat-zera vehiv shipcha necherepet leish vehopdeh lo nipdata o chupsha lo nittan-la biqqoret tihyeh lo yumetu ki-lo chuppasha
Ugebar are yishkub im itteta shikbat zara vehi amta achida ligbar veitperaqa la itperiqat bekaspa o cheruta la ityehibat lah bishtar biqqurta tehe la yumetun are la itchararat:
Vehebi et-ashamo la-Adonai el-petach ohel moed el asham
Veyayti yat ashmeh qodam Adonai litra mashkan zimna dekar laashama:
Vekipper alayv hakkohen beel haasham lipne Adonai al-chattato asher chata venislach lo mechattato asher chata
Vikapper alohi kahana bedikra daashama qodam Adonai al chobeteh di chab veyishtebeq leh mechobeteh di chab:
Veki-tabou el-haaretz unetatem kol-etz maakal vaaraltem orlato et-piryo shalosh shanim yihyeh lakem arelim lo yeakel
Vaare tealun leara vetitztzebun kol illan demekal uterachaqun rachaqa yat ibbeh telat shenin yehe lekon merachaq laabada la yitakel:
Ubashshana harebiit yihyeh kol-piryo qodesh hillulim la-Adonai
Ubeshatta rebieta yehe kol ibbeh qodesh tushbechan qodam Adonai:
Ubashshana hachamishit tokelu et-piryo lehosip lakem tebuato ani Adonai elohekem
Ubeshatta chamishsheta tekelun yat ibbeh leosapa lekon alalteh ana Adonai elahakon:
Lo tokelu al-haddam lo tenachashu velo teonenu
La tekelun al dema la tenachashun vela teonun:
Lo taqqipu peat roshekem velo tashchit et peat zeqaneka
La taqqepun pata dereshekon vela techabbel yat pata dediqnak:
Veseret lanepesh lo tittenu bibsarkem uketobet qaaqa lo tittenu bakem ani Adonai
Vechibbul al mit la tittenun bebisreykon verushemin charitin la tittenun bekon ana Adonai:
Al-techallel et-bitteka lehaznotah velo-tizneh haaretz umalea haaretz zimma
La tachel yat berattak leatayutah vela tite ara vetitmele ara etzat chitin:
Et-shabbetotay tishmoru umiqdashi tirau ani Adonai
Yat yome shabbayya dili titrun ulebet maqdeshi tehon dachalin ana Adonai:
Al-tipnu el-haobot veel-hayyiddeonim al-tebaqshu letoma bahem ani Adonai elohekem
La titpenun batar biddin udekuru la titbeun leistaaba behon ana Adonai elahakon:
Mippene seba taqum vehadarta pene zaqen veyareta meeloheka ani Adonai
Min qodam desabbar beorayta tequm utehaddar appe saba vetidchal meelahak ana Adonai:
Veki-yagur itteka ger beartzekem lo tonu oto
Vaare yitgayyar immak giyyora bearakon la tonun yateh:
Keezrach mikkem yihyeh lakem hagger haggar ittekem veahabta lo kamoka ki-gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim ani Adonai elohekem
Keyatztziba minnekon yehe lekon giyyora deyitgayyar benekon uterachem leh kevatak are dayyarin havetun beara demitzrayim ana Adonai elahakon:
Lo-taasu avel bammishpat bammidda bammishqal ubammesura
La tabedun sheqar bedin bimshachta bematqela ubimkilta:
Mozene tzedeq abne-tzedeq epat tzedeq vehin tzedeq yihyeh lakem ani Adonai elohekem asher-hotzeti etkem meeretz mitzrayim
Mozenavan diqshot matqelan diqshot mekilan diqshot vehinin diqshot yehon lekon ana Adonai elahakon di appeqit yatekon meara demitzrayim:
Ushemartem et-kol-chuqqotay veet-kol-mishpatay vaasitem otam ani Adonai
Vetitterun yat kol qeyamay veyat kol dinay vetabedun yatehon ana Adonai:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Veel-bene yisrael tomar ish ish mibbene yisrael umin-hagger haggar beyisrael asher yitten mizzaro lammolek mot yumat am haaretz yirgemuhu baaben
Veim bene yisrael temar gebar gebar mibbene yisrael umin giyyora deyitgayrun beyisrael di yitten mizzareh lemolek itqetala yitqetel amma bet yisrael yirgemunneh beabna:
Vaani etten et-panay baish hahu vehikratti oto miqqereb ammo ki mizzaro natan lammolek lemaan tamme et-miqdashi ulechallel et-shem qodshi
Vaana etten yat rugezi begabra hahu veeshetze yateh miggo ammeh are mizzareh yehab lemolek bedil lesaaba yat maqdeshi uleachalla yat shema dequdeshi:
Veim halem yalimu am haaretz et-enehem min-haish hahu betitto mizzaro lammolek lebilti hamit oto
Veim mikbash yikbeshun amma bet yisrael yat enehon min gabra hahu bidyaheb mizzareh lemolek bedil dela leqattala yateh:
Vesamti ani et-panay baish hahu ubemishpachto vehikratti oto veet kol-hazzonim acharayv liznot achare hammolek miqqereb ammam
Veeshavve ana yat rugezi begabra hahu ubisadohi veeshetze yateh veyat kol detaan batrohi lemite batar molek miggo ammehon:
Vehannepesh asher tipneh el-haobot veel-hayyiddeonim liznot acharehem venatatti et-panay bannepesh hahiv vehikratti oto miqqereb ammo
Veenash di yitpene batar biddin udekuru lemite batrehon veetten yat rugezi baanasha hahi veeshetze yateh miggo ammeh:
Vehitqaddishtem vihyitem qedoshim ki ani Adonai elohekem
Vetitqaddeshun utehon qaddishin are ana Adonai elahakon:
Ushemartem et-chuqqotay vaasitem otam ani Adonai meqaddishkem
Vetitterun yat qeyamay vetabedun yatehon ana Adonai meqaddishkon:
Ki-ish ish asher yeqallel et-abiv veet-immo mot yumat abiv veimmo qillel damayv bo
Are gebar gebar di yelut yat abuhi veyat immeh itqetala yitqetel abuhi veimmeh lat qetala chayyab:
Veish asher yinap et-eshet ish asher yinap et-eshet reehu mot-yvmat hannoep vehannoapet
Ugebar di yegup yat ittat gebar di yegup yat ittat chabreh itqetala yitqetel gayyapa vegayyapta:
Veish asher yishkab et-eshet abiv ervat abiv gilla mot-yvmetu shenehem demehem bam
Ugebar di yishkub im ittat abuhi eryeta daabuhi galli itqetala yitqattelun tarvehon qetala chayyabin:
Veish asher yishkab et-kallato mot yumetu shenehem tebel asu demehem bam
Ugebar di yishkub yat kalleteh itqetala yitqattelun tarvehon tibla abadu qetala chayyabin:
Veish asher yishkab et-zakar mishkebe ishsha toeba asu shenehem mot yumatu demehem bam
Ugebar di yishkub yat dekura mishkebe itteta toebta abadu tarvehon itqetala yitqattelun qetala chayyabin:
Veish asher yiqqach et-ishsha veet-immah zimma hiv baesh yisrepu oto veethen velo-tihyeh zimma betokekem
Ugebar di yissab yat itteta veyat immah etzat chitin hi benura yoqedun yateh veyatehen vela tehe etzat chitin benekon:
Veish asher yitten shekobto bibhema mot yumat veet-habbehema taharogu
Ugebar di yitten shekabeteh bibira itqetala yitqetel veyat beira tiqtelun:
Veishsha asher tiqrab el-kol-behema leriba otah veharagta et-haishsha veet-habbehema mot yumatu demehem bam
Veitteta di tiqrab lekol beira lemishlat bah vetiqtol yat itteta veyat beira itqetala yitqattelun qetala chayyabin:
Veish asher-yiqqach et-achoto bat-abiv o bat-immo veraa et-ervatah vehi-tireh et-ervato chesed hu venikretu leene bene ammam ervat achoto gilla avono yissa
Ugebar di yissab yat achateh bat abuhi o bat immeh veyecheze yat eryetah vehi techeze yat eryeteh qelana hu veyishtetzun leene bene ammehon eryat achateh galli chobeh yeqabbel:
Veish asher-yishkab et-ishsha dava vegilla et-ervatah et-meqorah heera vehiv gilleta et-meqor dameha venikretu shenehem miqqereb ammam
Ugebar di yishkub yat itteta soabata vigalli yat eryetah yat qelanah galli vehi tegalle yat soabat demaha veyishtetzun tarvehon miggo ammehon:
Veervat achot immeka vaachot abika lo tegalleh ki et-sheero heera avonam yissau
Veeryat achat immak vaachat abuk la tegalle are yat qaribeh galli chobehen yeqabbelun:
Veish asher yishkab et-dodato ervat dodo gilla chetam yissau aririm yamutu
Ugebar di yishkub yat ittat ach abuhi eryat ach abuhi galli chobehen yeqabbelun bela velad yemutun:
Veish asher yiqqach et-eshet achiv nidda hiv ervat achiv gilla aririm yihyu
Ugebar di yissab yat ittat achuhi merachaqa hi eryeta daachuhi galli bela velad yehon:
Ushemartem et-kol-chuqqotay veet-kol-mishpatay vaasitem otam velo-taqi etkem haaretz asher ani mebi etkem shamma lashebet bah
Vetitterun yat kol qeyamay veyat kol dinay vetabedun yatehon vela teroqen yatekon ara di ana mael yatekon tamman lemittab bah:
Velo teleku bechuqqot haggoy asher-ani meshalleach mippenekem ki et-kol-elleh asu vaaqutz bam
Vela tehakun benimose ammayya di ana magle min qodamekon are yat kol illen abadu verachiq memeri yatehon:
Vaomar lakem attem tireshu et-admatam vaani ettenenna lakem lareshet otah eretz zabat chalab udebash ani Adonai elohekem asher-hibdalti etkem min-haammim
Vaamarit lekon attun tiretun yat arahon vaana etteninnah lekon lemerat yatah ara abeda chalab udebash ana Adonai elahakon di apreshit yatekon min ammayya:
Vehibdaltem ben-habbehema hattehora lattemea uben-haop hattame lattahor velo-teshaqqetzu et-napshotekem babbehema ubaop ubekol asher tirmos haadama asher-hibdalti lakem letamme
Vetapreshun ben beira dakya limsaaba uben opa mesaaba lidke vela teshaqqetzun yat napshatekon bibira ubeopa ubekol di tarchesh ara di apreshit lekon lesaaba:
Vihyitem li qedoshim ki qadosh ani Adonai vaabdil etkem min-haammim lihyot li
Utehon qodamay qaddishin are qaddish ana Adonai veapreshit yatekon min ammayya lemeheve palechin qodamay:
Veish o-ishsha ki-yihyeh bahem ob o yiddeoni mot yumatu baeben yirgemu otam demehem bam
Ugebar o itteta are yehe behon biddin o dekur itqetala yitqattelun beabna yirgemun yatehon qetala chayyabin:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh emor el-hakkohanim bene aharon veamarta alehem lenepesh lo-yittamma beammayv
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh emar lekahanayya bene aharon vetemar lehon al mit la yistaab beammeh:
Ki im-lishero haqqarob elayv leimmo uleabiv velibno ulebitto uleachiv
Ellahen leqaribeh deqarib leh leimmeh velaabuhi velibreh velibratteh velaachuhi:
Velaachoto habbetula haqqeroba elayv asher lo-hayeta leish lah yittamma
Velaachateh betulta deqariba leh di la havat ligbar lah yistaab:
Lo yittamma baal beammayv lehechallo
La yistaab rabba beammeh leachaluteh:
Lo-yiqrechu qorcha berosham upeat zeqanam lo yegallechu ubibsaram lo yisretu saratet
La yimretun merat bereshehon upata dediqnehon la yegallechun ubebisrehon la yechabbelun chibbul:
Qedoshim yihyu lelohehem velo yechallelu shem elohehem ki et-ishshe Adonai lechem elohehem hem maqribim vehayu qodesh
Qaddishin yehon qodam elahahon vela yechallun shema deelahahon are yat qurbenayya daAdonai qurban elahahon innun maqribin vihon qaddishin:
Ishsha zona vachalala lo yiqqachu veishsha gerusha meishah lo yiqqachu ki-qadosh hu lelohayv
Itteta mataya umechallela la yissebun veitteta dimtareka mibbalah la yissebun are qaddish hu qodam elaheh:
Veqiddashto ki-et-lechem eloheka hu maqrib qadosh yiheyeh-lak ki qadosh ani Adonai meqaddishkem
Uteqaddeshinneh are yat qurban elahak hu meqareb qaddish yehe lak are qaddish ana Adonai meqaddishkon:
Ubat ish kohen ki techel liznot et-abiha hi mechallelet baesh tissarep
Ubat gebar kahen are titchal lemite miqqedushshat abuha hi mittachala benura tittoqad:
Vehakkohen haggadol meechayv asher-yvtzaq al-rosho shemen hammishcha umille et-yado lilbosh et-habbegadim et-rosho lo yipra ubegadayv lo yiprom
Vekahana deitrabba meachohi d yittariq al resheh mishcha dirbuta vedi qarib yat qurbaneh lemilbash yat lebushayya yat resheh la yerabbe perua ulebushohi la yibza:
Veal kol-napshot met lo yabo leabiv uleimmo lo yittamma
Veal kol napshat meta la yeol laabuhi uleimmeh la yistaab:
Umin-hammiqdash lo yetze velo yechallel et miqdash elohayv ki nezer shemen mishchat elohayv alayv ani Adonai
Umin maqdesha la yippoq vela yachel yat maqdesha deelaheh are kelil meshach rebuta deelaheh alohi ana Adonai:
Vehu ishsha bibtuleha yiqqach
Vehu itteta bibtultaha yissab:
Almana ugerusha vachalala zona et-elleh lo yiqqach ki im-betula meammayv yiqqach ishsha
Armela umetareka vechallila mataya yat illen la yissab elahen betulta meammeh yissab itteta:
Velo-yechallel zaro beammayv ki ani Adonai meqaddesho
Vela yachel zareh beammeh are ana Adonai meqaddesheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-aharon lemor ish mizzaraka ledorotam asher yihyeh bo mum lo yiqrab lehaqrib lechem elohayv
Mallel im aharon lememar gebar mibbenayk ledarehon di yehe beh muma la yiqrab leqaraba qurbana qodam elaheh:
Ki kol-ish asher-bo mum lo yiqrab ish ivver o pisseach o charum o sarua
Are kol gebar di beh muma la yiqrab gebar avvir o chagir o charim o seria:
O ish asher-yihyeh bo sheber ragel o sheber yad
O gebar di yehe beh tebar ragla o tebar yeda:
O-gibben o-daq o teballul beeno o garab o yallepet o meroach ashek
O gebin o duqqa o chilliz beeneh o garban o chazazan o meras pachadin:
Kol-ish asher-bo mum mizzera aharon hakkohen lo yiggash lehaqrib et-ishshe Adonai mum bo et lechem elohayv lo yiggash lehaqrib
Kol gebar di beh muma mizzara deaharon kahana la yiqrab leqaraba yat qurbanayya daAdonai muma beh yat qurban elaheh la yiqrab leqaraba:
Lechem elohayv miqqodshe haqqodashim umin-haqqodashim yokel
Qurban elaheh miqqodesh qudeshayya umin qudeshayya yekul:
Ak el-happaroket lo yabo veel-hammizbeach lo yiggash ki-mvm bo velo yechallel et-miqdashay ki ani Adonai meqaddesham
Beram leparukta la yeol ulemadbecha la yiqrab are muma beh vela yachel yat maqdeshay are ana Adonai meqaddishhon:
Vayedabber mosheh el-aharon veel-banayv veel-kol-bene yisrael
Umallil msheh im aharon veim benohi veim kol bene yisrael:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banayv veyinnazeru miqqodshe bene-yisrael velo yechallelu et-shem qodshi asher hem maqdishim li ani Adonai
Mallel im aharon veim benohi veyippareshun miqqudeshayya dibne yisrael vela yechallun yat shema dequdeshi di innun meqaddeshin qodamay ana Adonai:
Emor alehem ledorotekem kol-ish asher-yiqrab mikkol-zarakem el-haqqodashim asher yaqdishu bene-yisrael la-Adonai vetumato alayv venikreta hannepesh hahiv millepanay ani Adonai
Emar lehon ledarekon kol gebar di yiqrab mikkol benekon lequdeshayya di yeqaddeshun bene yisrael qodam Adonai vesobeteh alohi veyishtetze anasha hahi min qodamay ana Adonai:
Ish ish mizzera aharon vehu tzarua o zab baqqodashim lo yokal ad asher yithar vehannogea bekol-teme-nepesh o ish asher-tetze mimmennu shikbat-zara
Gebar gebar mizzara deaharon vehu segir o daib bequdeshayya la yekul ad di yidke udeyiqrab bekol teme napsha o gebar di tippoq minneh shikbat zara:
O-ish asher yigga bekol-sheretz asher yitma-lo o beadam asher yitma-lo lekol tumato
O gebar di yiqrab bekol richasha di yistaab leh o baanasha di yistaab leh lekol sobeteh:
Nepesh asher tigga-bo vetamea ad-haareb velo yokal min-haqqodashim ki im-rachatz besaro bammayim
Enash di yiqrab beh vihe mesaab ad ramsha vela yekul min qudeshayya elahen asche bisreh bemayya:
Uba hashshemesh vetaher veachar yokal min-haqqodashim ki lachmo hu
Ubemeal shimsha veyidke ubatar ken yekul min qudeshayya are lachmeh hu:
Nebela uterepa lo yokal letoma-ba ani Adonai
Nebila utebira la yekul leistaaba bah ana Adonai:
Veshameru et-mishmarti velo-yisu alayv chet umetu bo ki yechalleluhu ani Adonai meqaddesham
Veyitterun yat matterat memeri vela yeqabbelun alohi choba vimutun beh are yechallunneh ana Adonai meqaddishhon:
Vekol-zar lo-yokal qodesh toshab kohen vesakir lo-yokal qodesh
Vekol chillonay la yekul qudesha totaba dekahana vaagira la yekul qudesha:
Vekohen ki-yiqneh nepesh qinyan kaspo hu yokal bo vilid beto hem yokelu belachmo
Vekahen are yiqne nepash qinyan kaspeh hu yekul beh vilid beteh innun yekelun belachmeh:
Ubat-kohen ki tihyeh leish zar hiv bitrumat haqqodashim lo tokel
Ubat kahen are tehe ligbar chillonay hi beaprashut qudeshayya la tekul:
Ubat-kohen ki tihyeh almana ugerusha vezera en lah veshaba el-bet abiha kinureha millechem abiha tokel vekol-zar lo-yokal bo
Ubat kahen are tehe armela umetareka ubar let lah utetub lebet abuha kerabyutaha millachma daabuha tekul vekol chillonay la yekul beh:
Veish ki-yokal qodesh bishgaga veyasap chamishito alayv venatan lakkohen et-haqqodesh
Ugebar are yekul qudesha beshalu veyosep chumesheh alohi vitten lekahana yat qudesha:
Velo yechallelu et-qodshe bene yisrael et asher-yarimu la-Adonai
Vela yechallun yat qudeshayya dibne yisrael yat di yapreshun qodam Adonai:
Vehissiu otam avon ashma beoklam et-qodshehem ki ani Adonai meqaddesham
Viqabbelun alehon avayan vechobin bemekalehon besoaba yat qudeshehon are ana Adonai meqaddishhon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banayv veel kol-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ish mibbet yisrael umin-hagger beyisrael asher yaqrib qorbano lekol-nidrehem ulekol-nidbotam asher-yaqribu la-Adonai leola

Mallel im aharon veim benohi veim kol bene yisrael vetemar lehon gebar gebar mibbet yisarael umin giyyora beyisrael di yeqareb qurbaneh lekol nidrehon ulekal nidbathon di yeqarebun qodam Adonai laalata:
Liretzonekem tamim zakar babbaqar bakkesabim ubaizzim
Leraava lekon shelim dekura betore beimrayya ubeizzayya:
Kol asher-bo mum lo taqribu ki-lo leratzon yihyeh lakem
Kol di beh muma la teqarebun are la leraava yehe lekon:
Veish ki-yaqrib zebach-shelamim la-Adonai lepalle-neder o lindaba babbaqar o batztzon tamim yiheyeh leratzon kol-mvm lo yihyeh-bo
Ugebar are yeqareb niksat qudeshayya qodam Adonai leparasha nidra o lindabta betore o beana shelim yehe leraava kol muma la yehe beh:
Avveret o shabur o-charutz o-yabbelet o garab o yallepet lo-taqribu elleh la-Adonai veishsheh lo-tittenu mehem al-hammizbeach la-Adonai
Avvir o tebir o pesiq o yabbelan o garban o chazazan la teqarebun illen qodam Adonai vequrbana la tittenun minnehon al madbecha qodam Adonai:
Veshor vaseh sarua veqalut nedaba taaseh oto uleneder lo yeratzeh
Vetor veimmar yattir vechassir nedabta tabed yateh ulenidra la yehe leraava:
Umauk vekatut venatuq vekarut lo taqribu la-Adonai ubeartzekem lo taasu
Vedi meris vedi resis vedi shelip vedi gezir la teqarebun qodam Adonai ubearakon la tabedun:
Umiyyad ben-nekar lo taqribu et-lechem elohekem mikkol-elleh ki moshchatam bahem mum bam lo yeratzu lakem
Umin bar ammin la teqarebun yat qurban elahakon mikkol illen are chibbulehon behon muma behon la leraava yehon lekon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Shor o-keseb o-ez ki yivvaled vehaya shibat yamim tachat immo umiyyom hashshemini vahalea yeratzeh leqorban ishsheh la-Adonai
Tor o immar o izza are yityelid vihe shiba yomin batar immeh umiyyoma teminaa ulehalla yittire leqaraba qurbana qodam Adonai:
Veshor o-seh oto veet-beno lo tishchatu beyom echad
Vetoreta o seta lah velibrah la tikkesun beyoma chad:
Veki-tizbechu zebach-toda la-Adonai liretzonekem tizbachu
Vaare tikkesun niksat todeta qodam Adonai leraava lekon tikkesunneh:
Bayyom hahu yeakel lo-totiru mimmennu ad-boqer ani Adonai
Beyoma hahu yitakel la tasharun minneh ad tzapra ana Adonai:
Ushemartem mitzvotay vaasitem otam ani Adonai
Vetitterun piqqoday vetabedun yatehon ana Adonai:
Velo techallelu et-shem qodshi veniqdashti betok bene yisrael ani Adonai meqaddishkem
Vela techallelun yat shema dequdeshay veitqaddash bego bene yisrael ana Adonai meqaddishkon:
Hammotzi etkem meeretz mitzrayim lihyot lakem lelohim ani Adonai
Deappiq yatekon meara demitzrayim lemeheve lekon lelaha ana Adonai:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem moade Adonai asher-tiqreu otam miqrae qodesh elleh hem moaday
Mallel im bene yishrael vetemar lehon moadayya daAdonai di teareun yatehon mearee qaddish illen innun moaday:
Sheshet yamim teaseh melaka ubayyom hashshebii shabbat shabbaton miqra-qodesh kol-melaka lo taasu shabbat hiv la-Adonai bekol moshebotekem
Shitta yomin titabed ibida ubeyoma shebiaa shebat shebata meara qaddish kol ibida la tabedun shabbeta hi qodam Adonai bekol motebanekon:
Elleh moade Adonai miqrae qodesh asher-tiqreu otam bemoadam
Illen moadayya daAdonai mearee qaddish di teareun yatehon bezimnehon:
Bachodesh harishon bearbaa asar lachodesh ben haarbayim pesach la-Adonai
Beyarcha qadmaa bearbeat asra leyarcha ben shimshayya pischa qodam Adonai:
Ubachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hazzeh chag hammatztzot la-Adonai shibat yamim matztzot tokelu
Ubechamshat asra yoma leyarcha haden chagga depattirayya qodam Adonai shiba yomin pattir tekelun:
Bayyom harishon miqra-qodesh yihyeh lakem kol-meleket aboda lo taasu
Beyoma qadmaa meara qaddish yihe lekon kol ibidat palechan la tabedun:
Vehiqrabtem ishsheh la-Adonai shibat yamim bayyom hashshebii miqra-qodesh kol-meleket aboda lo taasu
Uteqarebun qurbana qodam Adonai shiba yomin beyoma shebiaa meara qaddish kol ibidat palechan la tabedun:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki-tabou el-haaretz asher ani noten lakem uqetzartem et-qetzirah vahabetem et-omer reshit qetzirekem el-hakkohen
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are tealun leara di ana yaheb lekon vetachtzedun yat chatzadah vetaytun yat umera resh chatzadekon levat kahana:
Vehenip et-haomer lipne Adonai liretzonekem mimmochorat hashshabbat yenipennu hakkohen
Virim yat umera qodam Adonai leraava lekon mibbatar yoma taba yeriminneh kahana:
Vaasitem beyom hanipekem et-haomer kebes tamim ben-shenato leola la-Adonai
Vetabedun beyoma daaramutekon yat umera immar shelim bar shatteh laalata qodam Adonai:
Uminchato shene esronim solet belula bashshemen ishsheh la-Adonai reach nichoach veniskoh yayin rebiit hahin
Uminchateh teren eshronin sulta depila bimshach qurbana qodam Adonai leitqabbala beraava veniskeh chamra rabut hina:
Velechem veqali vekarmel lo tokelu ad-etzem hayyom hazzeh ad habiakem et-qorban elohekem chuqqat olam ledorotekem bekol moshebotekem
Ulechem uqeli uperukan la tekelun ad keran yoma haden ad aytoekon yat qurban elahakon qeyam alam ledarekon bekol motebanekon:
Usepartem lakem mimmochorat hashshabbat miyyom habiakem et-omer hattenupa sheba shabbatot temimot tihyena
Vetimnun lekon mibbatar yoma taba miyyom aytoekon yat umera daaramuta shiba shabuin shalmin yehevyan:
Ad mimmochorat hashshabbat hashshebiit tisperu chamishshim yom vehiqrabtem mincha chadasha la-Adonai
Ad mibbatar shebuata shebieta timnun chamshin yomin uteqarebun minchata chadatta qodam Adonai:
Mimmoshebotekem tabiu lechem tenupa shetayim shene esronim solet tihyena chametz teapena bikkurim la-Adonai
Mimmotebanekon taytun lechem aramuta tarten geritzan teren eshronin sulta yehevyan chamia yitapyan bikkurin qodam Adonai:
Vehiqrabtem al-hallechem shibat kebasim temimim bene shana upar ben-baqar echad veelim shenayim yihyu ola la-Adonai uminchatam veniskehem ishsheh reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Uteqarebun al lachma shiba immerin shalmin bene shena vetor bar tore chad vedikrin teren yehon alata qodam Adonai uminchatehon veniskehon qurban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai:
Vaasitem seir-izzim echad lechattat ushene kebasim bene shana lezebach shelamim
Vetabedun tzepir bar izze chad lechattata uteren immerin bene shena leniksat qudeshayya:
Vehenip hakkohen otam al lechem habbikkurim tenupa lipne Adonai al-shene kebasim qodesh yihyu la-Adonai lakkohen
Virim kahana yatehon al lechem bikkurayya aramuta qodam Adonai al teren immerin qudesha yehon qodam Adonai lekahana:
Uqeratem beetzem hayyom hazzeh miqera-qodesh yihyeh lakem kol-meleket aboda lo taasu chuqqat olam bekol-moshebotekem ledorotekem
Uteareun bikran yoma haden meara qaddish yehe lekon kol ibidat palechan la tabedun qeyam alam bekol motebanekon ledarekon:
Ubequtzrekem et-qetzir artzekem lo-tekalleh peat sadeka bequtzreka veleqet qetzireka lo telaqqet leani velagger taazob otam ani Adonai elohekem
Ubemechetzadekon yat chatzada dearakon la teshetze pata dechaqlak bemechetzadak uleqata dachatzadak la telaqqet leanye ulegiyyore tishboq yatehon ana Adonai elahakon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor bachodesh hashshebii beechad lachodesh yihyeh lakem shabbaton zikron terua miqra-qodesh
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar beyarcha shebiaa bechad leyarcha yehe lekon neyacha dukeran yabbaba meara qaddish:
Kol-meleket aboda lo taasu vehiqrabtem ishsheh la-Adonai
Kol ibidat palechana la tabedun uteqarebun qurbana qodam Adonai:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Ak beasor lachodesh hashshebii hazzeh yom hakkippurim hu miqera-qodesh yihyeh lakem veinnitem et-napshotekem vehiqrabtem ishsheh la-Adonai
Beram beasra leyarcha shebiaa haden yoma dekippurayya hu meara qaddish yehe lekon uteannun yat napshatekon uteqarebun qurbana qodam Adonai:
Vekol-melaka lo taasu beetzem hayyom hazzeh ki yom kippurim hu lekapper alekem lipne Adonai elohekem
Vekol ibida la tabedun bikran yoma haden are yoma dekippurayya hu lekappara alekon qodam Adonai elahakon:
Ki kol-hannepesh asher lo-teunneh beetzem hayyom hazzeh venikreta meammeha
Are kol anasha di la mitanne bikran yoma haden veyishtetze meammaha:
Vekol-hannepesh asher taaseh kol-melaka beetzem hayyom hazzeh vehaabadti et-hannepesh hahiv miqqereb ammah
Vekol enash di tabed kol ibida bikran yoma haden veobed yat anasha hahi miggo ammah:
Kol-melaka lo taasu chuqqat olam ledorotekem bekol moshebotekem
Kol ibida la tabedun qeyam alam ledarekon bekol motebanekon:
Shabbat shabbaton hu lakem veinnitem et-napshotekem betisha lachodesh baereb meereb ad-ereb tishbetu shabbattekem
Shebat shebata hu lekon uteannun yat napshatekon betishea leyarcha beramsha meramsha ad ramsha tenuchun neyachakon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashshebii hazzeh chag hassukkot shibat yamim la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar bechamsha ashra yoma leyarcha shebiaa haden chagga dimtallayya shibat yomin qodam Adonai:
Bayyom harishon miqra-qodesh kol-meleket aboda lo taasu
Beyoma qadmaa meara qaddish kol ibidat palechan la tabedun:
Shibat yamim taqribu ishsheh la-Adonai bayyom hashshemini miqra-qodesh yihyeh lakem vehiqrabtem ishsheh la-Adonai atzeret hiv kol-meleket aboda lo taasu
Shiba yomin teqarebun qurbana qodam Adonai beyoma teminaa meara qaddish yehe lekon uteqarebun qurbana qodam Adonai kenesh tehon kol ibidat palechan la tabedun:
Elleh moade Adonai asher-tiqreu otam miqrae qodesh lehaqrib ishsheh la-Adonai ola umincha zebach unesakim debar-yom beyomo
Illen moadayya daAdonai di teareun yatehon mearee qaddish leqaraba qurbana qodam Adonai alata uminchata niksat qudeshin venissukin pitgam yom beyomeh:
Millebad shabbetot Adonai umillebad mattenotekem umillebad kol-nidrekem umillebad kol-nidbotekem asher tittenu la-Adonai
Bar shabbayya daAdonai ubar mattenatekon ubar kol nidrekon ubar kol nidbatekon di tittenun qodam Adonai:
