Ak bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashshebii beospekem et-tebuat haaretz tachoggu et-chag-Adonai shibat yamim bayyom harishon shabbaton ubayyom hashshemini shabbaton
Beram bechamsha ashar yoma leyarcha shebiaa bemikneshekon yat alalat ara techaggun yat chagga qodam Adonai shiba yomin beyoma qadmaa neyacha ubeyoma teminaa neyacha:
Uleqachtem lakem bayyom harishon peri etz hadar kappot temarim vaanap etz-abot vearbe-nachal usemachtem lipne Adonai elohekem shibat yamim
Vetissebun lekon beyoma qadmaa pere ilana etrogin velullabbin vahadassin vearbin dinchal vetechedun qodam Adonai elahakon shabat yomin:
Vechaggotem oto chag la-Adonai shibat yamim bashshana chuqqat olam ledorotekem bachodesh hashshebii tachoggu oto
Utechaggun yateh chagga qodam Adonai shabat yomin beshatta qeyam alam ledarekon beyarcha shebiaa techaggun yateh:
Bassukkot teshebu shibat yamim kol-haezrach beyisrael yeshebu bassukkot
Bimtallayya tetebun shabat yomin kol yatztziba beyisrael yetebun bimtallayya:
Lemaan yedeu dorotekem ki bassukkot hoshabti et-bene yisrael behotzii otam meeretz mitzrayim ani Adonai elohekem
Bedil diyiddeun darekon are bimtallayut anane otebit yat bene yisrael beappaquti yatehon meara demitzrayim ana Adonai elahakon:
Vayedabber mosheh et-moade Adonai el-bene yisrael
Umallil msheh yat sedar moadayya daAdonai veallepinnun libne yisrael:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Tzav et-bene yisrael veyiqchu eleka shemen zayit zak katit lammaor lehaalot ner tamid
Paqqed yat bene yisrael veyissebun lak meshach zeta dakya katisha leanhara leadlaqa botzinayya tedira:
Michutz leparoket haedut beohel moed yaarok oto aharon meereb ad-boqer lipne Adonai tamid chuqqat olam ledorotekem
Mibbara leparukta desahaduta bemashkan zimna yasdar yateh aharon meramsha ad tzapra qodam Adonai tedira qeyam alam ledarekon:
Al hammenora hattehora yaarok et-hannerot lipne Adonai tamid
Al menarta dakita yasdar yat botzinayya qodam Adonai tedira:
Velaqachta solet veapita otah shetem esreh challot shene esronim yihyeh hachalla haechat
Vetissab sulta vetepe yatah tarta asre geritzan teren esronin tehe geritzta chada:
Vesamta otam shetayim maarakot shesh hammaaraket al hashshulchan hattahor lipne Adonai
Uteshavvi yatehon tarten sidrin shit sidra al patora dakya qodam Adonai:
Venatatta al-hammaareket lebona zakka vehayeta lallechem leazkara ishsheh la-Adonai
Vetitten al sidra lebunta dakita utehe lilchem leidkarta qurbana qodam Adonai:
Beyom hashshabbat beyom hashshabbat yaarkennu lipne Adonai tamid meet bene-yisrael berit olam
Beyoma deshabbeta beyoma deshabbeta yasderinneh qodam Adonai tedira min qodam bene yisrael qeyam alam:
Vehayeta leaharon ulebanayv vaakaluhu bemaqom qadosh ki qodesh qodashim hu lo meishshe Adonai choq-olam
Utehe leaharon velibnohi veyekelunneh baatar qaddish are qodesh qudeshin hu leh miqqurbanayya daAdonai qeyam alam:
Vayyetze ben-ishsha yisreelit vehu ben-ish mitzri betok bene yisrael vayyinnatzu bammachaneh ben hayyisreelit veish hayyisreeli
Unepaq bar itteta bat yisrael vehu bar gebar mitzraa bego bene yisrael unetzo bemashrita bar itteta bat yisrael vegabra bar yisrael:
Vayyiqqob ben-haishsha hayyisreelit et-hashshem vayeqallel vayyabiu oto el-mosheh veshem immo shelomit bat-dibri lematteh-dan
Uparesh bar itteta bat yisrael yat shema veargez veaytiu yateh levat msheh veshum immeh shelomit bat dibri leshibta dedan:
Vayyannichuhu bammishmar liprosh lahem al-pi Adonai
Veasserohi bebet mattera ad deyitparash lehon al gezerat memera daAdonai:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Hotze et-hameqallel el-michutz lammachaneh vesameku kol-hashshomeim et-yedehem al-rosho veragemu oto kol-haeda
Appeq yat deargez lemibbara lemashrita veyismekun kol di shemau yat yedehon al resheh veyirgemun yateh kol kenishta:
Veel-bene yisrael tedabber lemor ish ish ki-yeqallel elohayv venasa cheto
Veim bene yisrael temallel lememar gebar gebar di yargez qodam elaheh viqabbel chobeh:
Venoqeb shem-Adonai mot yumat ragom yirgemu-bo kol-haeda kagger kaezrach benoqbo-shem yumat
Vedi paresh shema daAdonai itqetala yitqetel mirgam yirgemun beh kol kenishta kegiyyora keyatztziba beparashuteh shema yitqetel:
Veish ki yakkeh kol-nepesh adam mot yumat
Ugebar are yiqtol kol napsha daanasha itqetala yitqetel:
Umakkeh nepesh-behema yeshallemenna nepesh tachat napesh
Udeyiqtol nepash beira yeshalleminnah napsha chalap napsha:
Veish ki-yitten mum baamito kaasher asa ken yeaseh lo
Ugebar are yitten muma bechabreh kema di abad ken yitabed leh:
Sheber tachat sheber ayin tachat ayin shen tachat shen kaasher yitten mum baadam ken yinnaten bo
Tabra cholap tabra ena cholap ena shinna cholap shinna kema di yitten muma baanasha ken yityeheb beh:
Umakkeh behema yeshallemenna umakkeh adam yumat
Udeyiqtol beira yeshalleminnah udeyiqtol anasha yitqetel:
Mishpat echad yihyeh lakem kagger kaezrach yihyeh ki ani Adonai elohekem
Dina chada yehe lekon kegiyyora keyatztziba yehe are ana Adonai elahakon:
Vayedabber mosheh el-bene yisrael vayyotziu et-hameqallel el-michutz lammachaneh vayyirgemu oto aben ubene-yisrael asu kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Umallil msheh im bene yisrael veappiqu yat deargez lemibbara lemashrita uregamu yateh abna ubene yisrael abadu kema di paqqed Adonai yat msheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh behar sinay lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh betura desinay lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki tabou el-haaretz asher ani noten lakem veshabeta haaretz shabbat la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are tealun leara di ana yaheb lekon vetashmet ara shemitteta qodam Adonai:
Shesh shanim tizra sadeka veshesh shanim tizmor karmeka veasapta et-tebuatah
Shit shenin tizra chaqlak veshit shenin tiksach karmak vetiknosh yat alaltah:
Ubashshana hashshebiit shabbat shabbaton yihyeh laaretz shabbat la-Adonai sadeka lo tizra vekarmeka lo tizmor
Ubeshatta shebiata neyach shemitteta yehe leara detashmet qodam Adonai chaqlak la tizra vekarmak la tiksach:
Et sepiach qetzireka lo tiqtzor veet-innebe nezireka lo tibtzor shenat shabbaton yihyeh laaretz
Yat katte dachatzadak la techetzad veyat innebe shibqak la tiqtop shenat shemitteta yehe leara:
Vehayeta shabbat haaretz lakem leokla leka uleabdeka velaamateka veliskireka uletoshabeka haggarim immak
Utehe shemittat ara lekon lemekal lak uleabdak uleamtak velaagirak uletotabak dedayerin immak:
Velibhemteka velachayya asher beartzeka tihyeh kol-tebuatah leekol
Velibirak ulechayta di bearak tehe kol alaltah lemekal:
Vesaparta leka sheba shabbetot shanim sheba shanim sheba peamim vehayu leka yeme sheba shabbetot hashshanim tesha vearbaim shana
Vetimne lak sheba shemittin dishnin sheba shenin sheba zimnin vihon lak yome sheba shemittin dishnin arbein vetesha shenin:
Vehaabarta shopar terua bachodesh hashshebii beasor lachodesh beyom hakkippurim taabiru shopar bekol-artzekem
Vetaabar shopar yabbaba beyarcha shebiaa beasra leyarcha beyoma dekippurayya taabberun shopara bekol arakon:
Veqiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana uqeratem deror baaretz lekol-yoshebeha yobel hiv tihyeh lakem veshabtem ish el-achuzzato veish el-mishpachto tashubu
Uteqaddeshun yat shenat chamshin shenin vetaqrun cheruta beara lekol yatebaha yobela hi tehe lekon utetubun gebar leachasanteh ugebar lezariteh tetubun:
Yobel hiv shenat hachamishshim shana tihyeh lakem lo tizrau velo tiqtzeru et-sepicheha velo tibtzeru et-nezireha
Yobela hi shenat chamshin shenin tehe lekon la tizreun vela tachtzedun yat kattaha vela tiqtepun yat shibqaha:
Ki yobel hiv qodesh tihyeh lakem min-hassadeh tokelu et-tebuatah
Are yobela hi qudesha tehe lekon min chaqla tekelun yat alaltah:
Bishnat hayyobel hazzot tashubu ish el-achuzzato
Beshatta deyobela hada tetubun gebar leachasanteh:
Veki-timkeru mimkar laamiteka o qanoh miyyad amiteka al-tonu ish et-achiv
Vaare tezabben zebinin lechabrak o tizben mida dechabrak la tonun gebar yat achohi:
Bemispar shanim achar hayyobel tiqneh meet amiteka bemispar shene-tebuot yimkor-lak
Beminyan shenayya batar yobela tizben min chabrak beminyan shene alalta yezabben lak:
Lepi rob hashshanim tarbeh miqnato ulepi meot hashshanim tamit miqnato ki mispar tebuot hu moker lak
Lepum segiut shenayya tasge zebinohi ulepum zeerut shenayya tazer zebinohi are minyan alalta hu mezabben lak:
Velo tonu ish et-amito veyareta meeloheka ki ani Adonai elohekem
Vela tonun gebar yat chabreh vetidchal meelahak are ana Adonai elahakon:
Vaasitem et-chuqqotay veet-mishpatay tishmeru vaasitem otam vishabtem al-haaretz labetach
Vetabedun yat qeyamay veyat dinay titterun vetabedun yatehon vetetebun al ara lerachetzan:
Venatena haaretz piryah vaakaltem lasoba vishabtem labetach aleha
Vetitten ara ibbah vetekelun lemisba vetetebun lerachatzan alah:
Veki tomeru mah-nokal bashshana hashshebiit hen lo nizra velo neesop et-tebuatenu
Vaare temerun ma nekul beshatta shebieta ha la nizra vela niknosh yat alaltana:
Vetzivviti et-birkati lakem bashshana hashshishshit veasat et-hattebua lishlosh hashshanim
Veepaqqed yat birkati lekon beshatta shetiteta vetabed yat alalta litlat shenin:
Uzeratem et hashshana hashsheminit vaakaltem min-hattebua yashan ad hashshana hatteshiit ad-bo tebuatah tokelu yashan
Vetizreun yat shatta temineta vetekelun min alalta attiqa ad shatta teshieta ad meal alaltah tekelun attiqa:
Vehaaretz lo timmaker litzmitut ki-li haaretz ki-gerim vetoshabim attem immadi
Veara la tizdabban lachalutin are dili ara are dayyarin vetotabin attun qodamay:
Ubekol eretz achuzzatkem geulla tittenu laaretz
Ubekol ara achasantekon purqana tittenun leara:
Ki-yamuk achika umakar meachuzzato uba goalo haqqarob elayv vegaal et mimkar achiv
Are yetemaskan achuk vizabben meachasanteh veyete pariqeh deqarib leh veyiproq yat zebine achuhi:
Veish ki lo yiheyeh-lo goel vehissiga yado umatza kede geullato
Ugebar are la yehe leh pariq vetadbeq yedeh veyashkach kemissat purqaneh:
Vechishshab et-shene mimkaro veheshib et-haodep laish asher makar-lo veshab laachuzzato
Vichashsheb yat shene zebinohi veyateb yat motara ligbar di zabben leh vitub leachasanteh:
Veim lo-matzea yado de hashib lo vehaya mimkaro beyad haqqoneh oto ad shenat hayyobel veyatza bayyobel veshab laachuzzato
Veim la tashkach yedeh kemissat ateb leh vihe zebinohi bida dizban yateh ad shatta deyobela veyippoq beyobela vitub leachasanteh:
Veish ki-yimkor bet-moshab ir choma vehayeta geullato ad-tom shenat mimkaro yamim tihyeh geullato
Ugebar are yezabben bet motab qarta maqqepa shur utehe purqaneh ad mishlam shatta dizbinohi iddan beiddan tehe purqaneh:
Veim lo-yiggael ad-melot lo shana temima veqam habbayit asher-bair asher-lo choma latztzemitut laqqoneh oto ledorotayv lo yetze bayyobel
Veim la yitparaq ad mishlam leh shatta shelemta viqum beta di beqarta di leh shura lachalutin ledi zeban yateh ledarohi la yippoq beyobela:
Ubatte hachatzerim asher en-lahem choma sabib al-sedeh haaretz yechasheb geulla tihyeh-lo ubayyobel yetze
Ubatte patzchayya di let lehon shur maqqap sechor sechor al chaqal ara yitchashshab purqana tehe leh ubeyobela yippoq:
Veare haleviyyim batte are achuzzatam geullat olam tihyeh lalviyyim
Veqirve levae batte qirve achasantehon purqan alam tehe lelevae:
Vaasher yigal min-haleviyyim veyatza mimkar-bayit veir achuzzato bayyobel ki batte are haleviyyim hiv achuzzatam betok bene yisrael
Vedi yiproq min levae veyippoq zebin beta veqarta achasanteh beyobela are batte qirve levae hi achasantehon bego bene yisrael:
Usedeh migrash arehem lo yimmaker ki-achuzzat olam hu lahem
Vachaqal revach qirvehon la yizdabban are achasanat alam hu lehon:
Veki-yamuk achika umata yado immak vehechezaqta bo ger vetoshab vachay immak
Vaare yitmaskan achuk utemut yedeh immak vetatqep beh dayyar vetotab viche immak:
Al-tiqqach meitto neshek vetarbit veyareta meeloheka veche achika immak
La tissab minneh chibbuleya veribbita vetidchal meelahak viche achuk immak:
Et-kaspeka lo-titten lo beneshek ubemarbit lo-titten okleka
Yat kaspak la titten leh bechibbuleya uberibbita la titten mekelak:
Ani Adonai elohekem asher-hotzeti etkem meeretz mitzrayim latet lakem et-eretz kenaan lihyot lakem lelohim
Ana Adonai elahakon di appeqit yatekon meara demitzrayim lemittan lekon yat ara diknaan lemeheve lekon leelah:
Veki-yamuk achika immak venimkar-lak lo-taabod bo abodat abed
Vaare yitmaskan achuk immak veyizdabban lak la tiplach beh palechan abdin:
Kesakir ketoshab yihyeh immak ad-shenat hayyobel yaabod immak
Kaagira ketotaba yehe immak ad shatta deyobela yiplach immak:
Veyatza meimmak hu ubanayv immo veshab el-mishpachto veel-achuzzat abotayv yashub
Veyippoq meimmak hu ubenohi immeh vitub lezariteh uleachasanat abahatohi yetub:
Ki-abaday hem asher-hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim lo yimmakeru mimkeret abed
Are abday innun di appeqit yatehon meara demitzrayim la yizdabbenun zebun abdin:
Lo-tirdeh bo beparek veyareta meeloheka
La tiplach beh beqashyu vetidchal meelahak:
Veabdeka vaamateka asher yihyu-lak meet haggoyim asher sebibotekem mehem tiqnu ebed veama
Veabdak veamtak di yehon lak min ammayya di besacharanekon minnehon tiqnun abdin veamhan:
Vegam mibbene hattoshabim haggarim immakem mehem tiqnu umimmishpachtam asher immakem asher holidu beartzekem vehayu lakem laachuzza
Veap mibbene totabayya orlayya dedayerin immekon minnehon tiqnun umizzaritehon deimmekon di ityelidu bearakon vihon lekon leachasana:
Vehitnachaltem otam libnekem acharekem lareshet achuzza leolam bahem taabodu ubeachekem bene-yisrael ish beachiv lo-tirdeh bo beparek
Vetachsenun yatehon libnekon batrekon lirutat achasana lealam behon tiplechun ubeachekon bene yisrael gebar baachuhi la tiplach beh beqashyu:
Veki tassig yad ger vetoshab immak umak achika immo venimkar leger toshab immak o leeqer mishpachat ger
Vaare tadbeq yad arel vetotab immak veyitmaskan achuk immeh veyizdabban learel totab immak o learmay zarit giyyora:
Achare nimkar geulla tihyeh-lo echad meechayv yigalennu
Batar deyizdabban purqana tehe leh chad meachohi yipreqinneh:
O-dodo o ben-dodo yigalennu o-mishsheer besaro mimmishpachto yigalennu o-hissiga yado venigal
O ach abuhi o bar ach abuhi yipreqinneh o miqqarib bisreh mizzariteh yipreqinneh o detadbeq yedeh veyitparaq:
Vechishshab im-qonehu mishshenat himmakero lo ad shenat hayyobel vehaya kesep mimkaro bemispar shanim kime sakir yihyeh immo
Vichashsheb im zabeneh mishshatta deizdabban leh ad shatta deyobela vihe kesap zebinohi beminyan shenaya keyome agira yehe immeh:
Im-od rabbot bashshanim lepihen yashib geullato mikkesep miqnato
Im od segiyyut bishnayya lepumehen yateb purqaneh mikkesap zebinohi:
Veim-meat nishar bashshanim ad-shenat hayyobel vechishshab-lo kepi shanayv yashib et-geullato
Veim zeer yishtaar bishnayya ad shatta deyobela vichashsheb leh kepum shenohi yateb yat purqaneh:
Kiskir shana beshana yihyeh immo lo-yirdennu beperek leeneka
Kaagir shena bishna yehe immeh la yiplach beh beqashyu leenayk:
Veim-lo yiggael beelleh veyatza bishnat hayyobel hu ubanayv immo
Veim la yitparaq beillen veyippoq beshatta deyobela hu ubenohi immeh:
Ki-li bene-yisrael abadim abaday hem asher-hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim ani Adonai elohekem
Are dili bene yisrael abdin abday innun di appeqit yatehon meara demitzrayim ana Adonai elahakon:
Lo-taasu lakem elilim upesel umatztzeba lo-taqimu lakem veeben maskit lo tittenu beartzekem lehishetachavot aleha ki ani Adonai elohekem
La tabedun lekon taavan vetzelem veqama la teqimun lekon veeben sageda la tittenun bearakon lemisgud alah are ana Adonai elahakon:
Et-shabbetotay tishmoru umiqdashi tirau ani Adonai
Yat yome shabbayya dili titterun ulebet maqdeshi tehon dachalin ana Adonai:
Im-bechuqqotay teleku veet-mitzvotay tishmeru vaasitem otam
Im biqyamay tehakun veyat piqqoday titterun vetabedun yatehon:
Venatatti gishmekem beittam venatena haaretz yebulah veetz hassadeh yitten piryo
Veetten matrekon beiddanehon vetitten ara alalta veilan chaqla yitten ibbeh:
Vehissig lakem dayish et-batzir ubatzir yassig et-zara vaakaltem lachmekem lasoba vishabtem labetach beartzekem
Viara lekon deyasha yat qetapa uqetapa yeara leappoqe bar zara vetekelun lachmekon lemisba vetetebun lerachetzan bearakon:
Venatatti shalom baaretz ushekabtem veen macharid vehishbatti chayya raa min-haaretz vechereb lo-taabor beartzekem
Veetten shelama beara vetishrun velet demanid veebattel chayta bishta min ara udeqatelin becharba la yeiddun bearakon:
Uredaptem et-oyebekem venapelu lipnekem lechareb
Vetirdepun yat baale debabekon veyippelun qodamekon lecharba:
Veradepu mikkem chamishsha mea umea mikkem rebaba yirdopu venapelu oyebekem lipnekem lechareb
Veyirdepun minnekon chamsha mea umea minnekon leribbota yeirequn veyippelun baale debabekon qodamekon lecharba:
Upaniti alekem vehipreti etkem vehirbeti etkem vahaqimoti et-beriti ittekem
Veetpeni bememeri leotaba lekon veappesh yatekon veasge yatekon vaaqem yat qeyami immekon:
Vaakaltem yashan noshan veyashan mippene chadash totziu
Vetekelun attiqa deattiq veattiqa min qodam chadatta tepannun:
Venatatti mishkani betokekem velo-tigal napshi etkem
Veetten mashkeni benekon vela yeracheq memeri yatekon:
Vehithallakti betokekem vehayiti lakem lelohim veattem tihyu-li leam
Veashre shekineti benekon veeheve lekon leelah veattun tehon qodamay leam:
Ani Adonai elohekem asher hotzeti etkem meeretz mitzrayim miheyot lahem abadim vaeshbor motot ullekem vaolek etkem qomemiyyut
Ana Adonai elahakon di appeqit yatekon meara demitzrayim millemeheve lehon abdin vetabbarit nir ammayya minnekon vedabbarit yatekon lecheruta:
Veim-lo tishmeu li velo taasu et kol-hammitzvot haelleh
Veim la teqabbelun lememeri vela tabedun yat kol piqqudayya haillen:
Veim-bechuqqotay timasu veim et-mishpatay tigal napshekem lebilti asot et-kol-mitzvotay lehaprekem et-beriti
Veim biqyamay teqotzun veim yat dinay teracheq napshekon bedil dela lemebad yat kol piqqoday leashnayutekon yat qeyami:
Ap-ani eeseh-zot lakem vehipqadti alekem behala et-hashshachepet veet-haqqaddachat mekallot enayim umedibot napesh uzeratem lariq zarakem vaakaluhu oyebekem
Ap ana ebad da lekon veasar alekon bahelta yat shachepta veyat qaddachta mechashshekan aynin umappechan nepash vetizreun lereqanun zarakon veyekelunneh baale debabekon:
Venatatti panay bakem veniggaptem lipne oyebekem veradu bakem soneekem venastem veen-rodep etkem
Veetten rugezi bekon vetittabberun qodam baale debabekon veyirdun bekon sanekon veteirequn velet deradip yatekon:
Veim-ad-elleh lo tishmeu li veyasapti leyassera etkem sheba al-chattotekem
Veim ad illen la teqabbelun lememeri veosep lemirde yatkon sheba al chobekon:
Veshabarti et-geon uzzekem venatatti et-shemekem kabbarzel veet-artzekem kannechusha
Veetbar yat yeqar taqepekon veetten yat shemayya di illavekon taqqipin keparzela millaachata mitra veara ditchotekon chasina kinchasha millemebad perin:
Vetam lariq kochakem velo-titten artzekem et-yebulah veetz haaretz lo yitten piryo
Visupun lereqanu chelekon vela titten arakon yat alaltah veilan ara la yitten ibbeh:
Veim-teleku immi qeri velo tobu lishmoa li veyasapti alekem makka sheba kechattotekem
Veim tehakun qodamay beqashyu vela tebun leqabbala lememeri veosep leetaa alekon macha sheba kechobekon:
Vehishlachti bakem et-chayyat hassadeh veshikkela etkem vehikrita et-behemtekem vehimita etkem venashammu darkekem
Veegare bekon yat chevat bara utetakkel yatekon uteshetze yat beirekon vetazer yatekon vitzadyan orechatekon:
Veim-beelleh lo tivvaseru li vahalaktem immi qeri
Veim beillen la titredun lememeri utehakun qodamay beqashyu:
Vehalakti ap-ani immakem beqeri vehikketi etkem gam-ani sheba al-chattotekem
Veehak ap ana immekon beqashyu vealqe yatekon ap ana sheba al chobekon:
Vehebeti alekem chereb noqemet neqam-berit veneesaptem el-arekem veshillachti deber betokekem venittattem beyad-oyeb
Veayti alekon deqatelin becharba veyitpareun minnekon puranuta al daabartun al pitgame orayta vetitkanneshun leqirvekon veegare motana benekon vetitmasserun bida desanea:
Beshibri lakem matteh-lechem veapu eser nashim lachmekem betannur echad veheshibu lachmekem bammishqal vaakaltem velo tisbau
Bidittebar lekon said mekela veyopyan asar neshin lachmekon betannura chad vitibun lachmekon bematqela vetokelun vela tisbeun:
Veim-bezot lo tishmeu li vahalaktem immi beqeri
Veim beda la teqabbelun lememeri utehakun qodamay beqashyu:
Vehalakti immakem bachamat-qeri veyissarti etkem ap-ani sheba al-chattotekem
Veehak immekon bitqop regaz veirde yatekon ap ana sheba al chobekon:
Vaakaltem besar benekem ubesar benotekem tokelu
Vetekelun besar benekon ubeshar benatekon tekelun:
Vehishmadti et-bamotekem vehikratti et-chammanekem venatatti et-pigrekem al-pigre gillulekem vegaala napshi etkem
Veeshetze yat bamatekon veeqatztzetz yat chanisenesekon veetten yat pigrekon al piggur taavatekon viracheq memeri yatekon:
Venatatti et-arekem chorba vahashimmoti et-miqdeshekem velo ariach bereach nichochakem
Veetten yat qirvekon tzada veetzde yat maqdeshekon vela aqabbel beraava qurban kenishshatekon:
Vahashimmoti ani et-haaretz veshamemu aleha oyebekem hayyoshebim bah
Veetzde ana yat ara vitzareyun alah baale debabekon deyatebun bah:
Veetkem ezareh baggoyim vahariqoti acharekem chareb vehayeta artzekem shemama vearekem yihyu chorba
Veyatekon abaddar bene ammayya veegare batrekon deqatelin becharba utehe arakon tzadeya veqirvekon yehon chorba:
Az tirtzeh haaretz et-shabbetoteha kol yeme hoshshamma veattem beeretz oyebekem az tishbat haaretz vehirtzat et-shabbetoteha
Beken tare ara yat shemittaha kol yomin di tzediat veattun beara baale debabekon beken tashmet ara vetare yat shemittaha:
Kol-yeme hoshshamma tishbot et asher lo-shabeta beshabbetotekem beshibtekem aleha
Kol yomin di tzediat tashmet yat di la shemetat bishmittekon kad havetun yatebin alah:
Vehannisharim bakem vehebeti morek bilbabam beartzot oyebehem veradap otam qol aleh niddap venasu menusat-chereb venapelu veen rodep
Udeyishtaarun bekon veael tabra belibbehon bearata desanehon veyirdop yatehon qal tarpa deshaqqip veyearqun kemeiroq min qodam deqatelin becharba veyippelun velet deradip:
Vekashelu ish-beachiv kemippene-chereb verodep ayin velo-tiheyeh lakem tequma lipne oyebekem
Veyittaqlun gebar beachuhi kemiqqadam deqatelin becharba veradip layit vela tehe lekon tequma qodam baale debabekon:
Vaabadtem baggoyim veokla etkem eretz oyebekem
Vetebedun bene ammayya utegammar yatekon ara baale debabekon:
Vehannisharim bakem yimmaqqu baavonam beartzot oyebekem veap baavonot abotam ittam yimmaqqu
Udeyishtaarun bekon yittimsun bechobehon bearata baale debabekon veap bechobe abahathon bishayya daachidin bidehon yittimsun:
Vehitvaddu et-avonam veet-avon abotam bemaalam asher maalu-bi veap asher-haleku immi beqeri
Vivaddun yat chobehon veyat chobe abahathon beshiqrehon deshaqqaru qodamay veap di halliku qodamay beqashyu:
Ap-ani elek immam beqeri vehebeti otam beeretz oyebehem o-az yikkana lebabam hearel veaz yirtzu et-avonam
Ap ana ehak immehon beqashyu veael yatehon beara baale debabehon o beken yittabar libbehon tapsha ubeken yirun yat chobehon:
Vezakarti et-beriti yaaqob veap et-beriti yitzchaq veap et-beriti abraham ezkor vehaaretz ezkor
Vedakirena yat qeyami deim yaaqob veap yat qeyami deim yitzchaq veap yat qeyami deim abraham ana dakir veara ana dakir:
Vehaaretz teazeb mehem vetiretz et-shabbetoteha bohshamma mehem vehem yirtzu et-avonam yaan ubeyaan bemishpatay maasu veet-chuqqotay gaala napsham
Veara titretesh minnehon vetare yat shemittaha beditzdiat minnehon veinnun yirun yat chobehon levatin cholap birkan ayti alehon bedil dibdinay qatzu veyat qeyamay recheqat napshehon:
Veap-gam-zot biheyotam beeretz oyebehem lo-meastim velo-gealtim lekallotam lehaper beriti ittam ki ani Adonai elohehem
Veap beram da bemehevehon beara baale debabehon la arteshinnun vela archeqinnun leshetzayutehon leashnaa qeyami immehon are ana Adonai elahahon:
Vezakarti lahem berit rishonim asher hotzeti-otam meeretz mitzrayim leene haggoyim lihyot lahem lelohim ani Adonai
Vedakirena lehon qeyam qadmae di appeqit yatehon meara demitzrayim leene ammayya lemeheve lehon lelaha ana Adonai:
Elleh hachuqqim vehammishpatim vehattorot asher natan Adonai beno uben bene yisrael behar sinay beyad-mosheh
Illen qeyamayya vedinayya veorayata di yehab Adonai ben memereh uben bene yisrael betura desinay bida demsheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ki yapli neder beerkeka nepashot la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon gebar are yapresh nedar bepursan napshata qodam Adonai:
Vehaya erkeka hazzakar mibben esrim shana vead ben-shishshim shana vehaya erkeka chamishshim sheqel kesep besheqel haqqodesh
Vihe pursaneh dekura mibbar esrin shenin vead bar shittin shenin vihe pursaneh chamshin silin diksap besile qudesha:
Veim-neqeba hiv vehaya erkeka sheloshim shaqel
Veim nequbeta hi vihe pursaneh telatin silin:
Veim mibben-chamesh shanim vead ben-esrim shana vehaya erkeka hazzakar esrim sheqalim velanneqeba aseret sheqalim
Veim mibbar chamesh shenin vead bar esrin shenin vihe pursaneh dekura esrin silin velinqubeta asar silin:
Veim mibben-chodesh vead ben-chamesh shanim vehaya erkeka hazzakar chamishsha sheqalim kasep velanneqeba erkeka sheloshet sheqalim kasep
Veim mibbar yarcha vead bar chamesh shenin vihe pursaneh dekura chamesh silin diksap velinqubeta pursanah telat silin diksap:
Veim mibben-shishshim shana vamala im-zakar vehaya erkeka chamishsha asar shaqel velanneqeba asara sheqalim
Veim mibbar shittin shenin uleella im dekura vihe pursaneh chamesh esre silin velinqubeta asar silin:
Veim-mak hu meerkeka veheemido lipne hakkohen veheerik oto hakkohen al-pi asher tassig yad hannoder yaarikennu hakkohen
Veim misken hu mippursanneh viqiminneh qodam kahana veyipros yateh kahana al memar di tadbeq yeda denodera yipresinneh kahana:
Veim-behema asher yaqribu mimmenna qorban la-Adonai kol asher yitten mimmennu la-Adonai yiheyeh-qodesh
Veim beira di yeqarebun minnah qurbana qodam Adonai kol di yitten minneh qodam Adonai yehe qudesha:
Lo yachalipennu velo-yamir oto tob bera o-ra betob veim-hamer yamir behema bibhema vehaya-hv utemurato yiheyeh-qodesh
La yechallepinneh vela yeibbar yateh tab bebish o bish betab veim challapa yechallep beira bibira vihe hu vechillupeh yehe qaddish:
Veim kol-behema temea asher lo-yaqribu mimmenna qorban la-Adonai veheemid et-habbehema lipne hakkohen
Veim kol beira mesaaba di la yeqarebun minnah qurbana qodam Adonai viqim yat beira qodam kahana:
Veheerik hakkohen otah ben tob uben ra keerkeka hakkohen ken yihyeh
Veyipros kahana yatah ben tab uben bish kepursana dekahana ken yehe:
Veim-gaol yigalenna veyasap chamishito al-erkeka
Veim mipraq yiprequnnah veyosep chumsheh al pursaneh:
Veish ki-yaqdish et-beto qodesh la-Adonai veheeriko hakkohen ben tob uben ra kaasher yaarik oto hakkohen ken yaqum
Ugebar are yaqdesh yat beteh qudesha qodam Adonai veyipresinneh kahana ben tab uben bish kema di yipros yateh kahana ken yequm:
Veim-hammaqdish yigal et-beto veyasap chamishit kesep-erkeka alayv vehaya lo
Veim deaqdesh yiproq yat beteh veyosep chomesh kesap pursaneh alohi vihe leh:
Veim missedeh achuzzato yaqdish ish la-Adonai vehaya erkeka lepi zaro zera chomer seorim bachamishshim sheqel kasep
Veim mechaqal achasanteh yaqdish gebar qadam Adonai vihe pursaneh lepum zareh bar zera kur seorin bechamshin silin diksap:
Im-mishshenat hayyobel yaqdish sadehu keerkeka yaqum
Im mishshatta deyobela yaqdesh chaqleh kepursaneh yequm:
Veim-achar hayyobel yaqdish sadehu vechishshab-lo hakkohen et-hakkesep al-pi hashshanim hannotarot ad shenat hayyobel venigra meerkeka
Veim batar yobela yaqdesh chaqleh vichashsheb leh kahana yat kaspa al memar shenayya deishtaaran ad shatta deyobela veyittimna mippursaneh:
Veim-gaol yigal et-hassadeh hammaqdish oto veyasap chamishit kesep-erkeka alayv veqam lo
Veim mipraq yiproq yat chaqla deaqdesh yateh veyosep chomesh kesap pursaneh alohi viqum leh:
Veim-lo yigal et-hassadeh veim-makar et-hassadeh leish acher lo yiggael od
Veim la yiproq yat chaqla veim zabbin yat chaqla ligbar ochoran la yitparaq od
Vehaya hassadeh betzeto bayyobel qodesh la-Adonai kisdeh hacherem lakkohen tihyeh achuzzato
Vihe chaqla bemippeqeh beyobela qudesha qodam Adonai kachaqal cherma lekahana tehe achasanteh:
Veim et-sedeh miqnato asher lo missedeh achuzzato yaqdish la-Adonai
Veim yat chaqal zebinohi di la mechaqal achasanteh yaqdesh qodam Adonai:
Vechishshab-lo hakkohen et miksat haerkeka ad shenat hayyobel venatan et-haerkeka bayyom hahu qodesh la-Adonai
Vichashsheb leh kahana yat minyan pursanneh ad shatta deyobela veyitten yat pursaneh beyoma hahu qudesha qodam Adonai:
Bishnat hayyobel yashub hassadeh laasher qanahu meitto laasher-lo achuzzat haaretz
Beshatta deyobela yetub chaqla ledizbaneh minneh lededileh achasanat ara:
Vekol-erkeka yihyeh besheqel haqqodesh esrim gera yihyeh hashshaqel
Vekol pursaneh yehe besile qudesha esrin main yehe sila:
Ak-bekor asher-yebukkar la-Adonai bibhema lo-yaqdish ish oto im-shor im-seh la-Adonai hu
Beram bukera di yitbakkar qodam Adonai bibira la yaqdesh gebar yateh im tor im immar daAdonai hu:
Veim babbehema hattemea upada beerkeka veyasap chamishito alayv veim-lo yiggael venimkar beerkeka
Veim bibira mesaaba veyiproq bepursaneh veyosep chumsheh alohi veim la yitparaq veyizdabban bepursaneh:
Ak-kol-cherem asher yacharim ish la-Adonai mikkol-asher-lo meadam ubehema umissedeh achuzzato lo yimmaker velo yiggael kol-cherem qodesh-qodashim hu la-Adonai
Beram kol cherma di yacharem gebar qodam Adonai mikkol di leh meanasha ubeira umechaqal achasanteh la yizdabban vela yitparaq kol cherma qodesh qudeshin hu qodam Adonai:
Kol-cherem asher yochoram min-haadam lo yippadeh mot yumat
Kol cherma di yittachram min enasha la yitparaq itqetala yitqetel:
Vekol-masar haaretz mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz la-Adonai hu qodesh la-Adonai
Vekol masera deara mizzara deara mippere ilana daAdonai hu qudesha qodam Adonai:
Veim-gaol yigal ish mimmaasro chamishito yosep alayv
Veim mipraq yiproq gebar mimmaasreh chumsheh yosep alohi:
Vekol-masar baqar vatzon kol asher-yaabor tachat hashshabet haasiri yiheyeh-qodesh la-Adonai
Vekol maasar torin vean kol deyeibbar techot chutra asiraa yehe qaddish qodam Adonai:
Lo yebaqqer ben-tob lara velo yemirennu veim-hamer yemirennu vehaya-hv utemurato yiheyeh-qodesh lo yiggael
La yebaqqar ben tab lebish vela yechallepinneh veim challapa yechallepinneh vihe hu vechillupeh yehe qudesha la yitparaq:

Vetitten yat levae leaharon velibnohi mesirin yehibin innun leh min bene yisrael:
Veet-aharon veet-banayv tipqod veshameru et-kehunnatam vehazzar haqqareb yumat
Veyat aharon veyat benohi temanne veyitterun yat kehunnathon vechillonay deyiqrab yitqetal:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Vaani hinneh laqachti et-haleviyyim mittok bene yisrael tachat kol-bekor peter rechem mibbene yisrael vehayu li haleviyyim
Vaana ha qarebit yat levae miggo bene yisrael chalap kol bukera patach valeda mibbene yisrael vihon meshammeshin qodamay levae:
Ki li kol-bekor beyom hakkoti kol-bekor beeretz mitzrayim hiqdashti li kol-bekor beyisrael meadam ad-behema li yihyu ani Adonai
Are dili kol bukera beyoma diqtalit kol bukera beara demitzrayim aqdeshit qodamay kol bukera beyisrael meenasha ad beira dili yehon ana Adonai:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh bemidbar sinay lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh bemadbera desinay lememar:
Peqod et-bene levi lebet abotam lemishpechotam kol-zakar mibben-chodesh vamala tipqedem
Mene yat bene levi lebet abahathon lezarayathon kol dekura mibbar yarcha uleella timninnun:
Vayyipqod otam mosheh al-pi Adonai kaasher tzuvva
Umena yatehon msheh al memera daAdonai kema deitpaqqad:
Vayyiheyu-elleh bene-levi bishmotam gereshon uqehat umerari
Vahavo illen bene levi bishmahathon gereshon uqehat umerari:
Veelleh shemot bene-gereshon lemishpechotam libni veshimi
Veillen shemahat bene gereshon lezarayathon libni veshimi:
Ubene qehat lemishpechotam amram veyitzhar chebron veuzziel
Ubene qehat lezarayathon amram veyitzhar chebron veuzziel:
Ubene merari lemishpechotam machli umushi elleh hem mishpechot hallevi lebet abotam
Ubene merari lezarayathon machli umushi illen innun zarayat levae lebet abahathon:
Legereshon mishpachat hallibni umishpachat hashshimi elleh hem mishpechot haggereshunni
Legereshon zarit libni vezarit shimi illen innun zarayat gereshon:
Pequdehem bemispar kol-zakar mibben-chodesh vamaela pequdehem shibat alapim vachamesh meot
Minyanehon beminyan kol dekura mibbar yarcha uleella minyanehon shaba alpin vachamesh mea:
Mishpechot haggereshunni achare hammishkan yachanu yamma
Zarayat gereshon achore mashkena yishrun maarba:
Unesi bet-ab laggereshunni elyasap ben-lael
Verab bet abba lebet gereshon elyasap bar lael:
Umishmeret bene-gereshon beohel moed hammishkan vehaohel miksehu umasak petach ohel moed
Umatterat bene gereshon bemashkan zimna mashkena uperasa chopaeh uperasa ditra mashkan zimna:
Veqale hechatzer veet-masak petach hechatzer asher al-hammishkan veal-hammizbeach sabib veet metarayv lekol abodato
Userade dedarta veyat perasa ditra darta di al mashkena veal madbecha sechor sechor veyat attunohi lekol pulechaneh:
Veliqhat mishpachat haamrami umishpachat hayyitzhari umishpachat hachebroni umishpachat haozzieli elleh hem mishpechot haqqehati
Veliqhat zarit amram vezarit yitzhar vezarit chebron vezarit uzziel illen innun zarayat qehat:
Bemispar kol-zakar mibben-chodesh vamaela shemonat alapim veshesh meot shomere mishmeret haqqodesh
Beminyan kol dekura mibbar yarcha uleella temanya alpin veshit mea natere mattarta dequdesha:
Mishpechot bene-qehat yachanu al yerek hammishkan temana
Zarayat bene qehat yishrun al tzidda demashkena daroma:
Unesi bet-ab lemishpechot haqqehati elitzapan ben-uzziel
Verab bet abba lezarayat qehat elitzapan bar uzziel:
Umishmartam haaron vehashshulchan vehammenora vehammizbechot ukele haqqodesh asher yesharetu bahem vehammasak vekol abodato
Umattartehon arona upatora umenarta umadbecha umane qudesha di yeshammeshun behon uperasa vekol palechaneh:
Unesi nesie hallevi elazar ben-aharon hakkohen pequddat shomere mishmeret haqqodesh
Vaamarkela dimmanna al rabrebe levae elazar bar aharon kahana demittechot yedohi memannan natere matterat qudesha:
Limrari mishpachat hammachli umishpachat hammushi elleh hem mishpechot merari
Limrari zarit machli vezarit mushi illen innun zarayat merari:
Upequdehem bemispar kol-zakar mibben-chodesh vamaela sheshet alapim umatayim
Uminyanehon beminyan kol dekura mibbar yarcha uleella shitta alpin umatan:
Unesi bet-ab lemishpechot merari tzuriel ben-abichayil al yerek hammishkan yachanu tzapona
Verab bet abba lezarayat merari tzuriel bar abichayil al tzidda demashkena yishrun tzippuna:
Upequddat mishmeret bene merari qarshe hammishkan uberichayv veammudayv vaadanayv vekol-kelayv vekol abodato
Vedi mesir lematterat bene merari dappe mashkena veabrohi veammudohi vesamkohi vekol manohi vekol pulechaneh:
Veammude hechatzer sabib veadnehem vitedotam umeterehem
Veammude dedarta sechor sechor vesamkehon vesikkehon veattunehon:
Vehachonim lipne hammishkan qedema lipne ohel-moed mizracha mosheh veaharon ubanayv shomerim mishmeret hammiqdash lemishmeret bene yisrael vehazzar haqqareb yumat
Vedi sheran qodam mashkena qidduma qodam mashkan zimna maddinecha msheh veaharon ubenohi naterin matterat maqdesha lematterat bene yisrael vechillonay deyiqrab yitqetal:
Kol-pequde haleviyyim asher paqad mosheh veaharon al-pi Adonai lemishpechotam kol-zakar mibben-chodesh vamala shenayim veesrim alep
Kol minyane levae di mena msheh veaharon al memera daAdonai lezarayathon kol dekura mibbar yarcha uleella asrin uteren alpin:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh peqod kol-bekor zakar libne yisrael mibben-chodesh vamaela vesa et mispar shemotam
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh mene kol bukerayya dikrayya libne yisrael mibbar yarcha uleella veqabbel yat minyan shemahathon:
Velaqachta et-haleviyyim li ani Adonai tachat kol-bekor bibne yisrael veet behemat haleviyyim tachat kol-bekor bebehemat bene yisrael
Uteqareb yat levae qodamay ana Adonai chalap kol bukera bibne yisrael veyat beira delevae chalap kol bukera bibira dibne yisrael:
Vayyipqod mosheh kaasher tzivva Adonai oto et-kol-bekor bibne yisrael
Umena msheh kema di paqid Adonai yateh yat kol bukera bibne yisrael:
Vayehi kol-bekor zakar bemispar shemot mibben-chodesh vamala lipqudehem shenayim veesrim elep shelosha veshibim umatayim
Vahavo kol bukerayya dikrayya beminyan shemahan mibbar yarcha uleella leminyanehon asrin uteren alpin matan veshabin utelata:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Qach et-haleviyyim tachat kol-bekor bibne yisrael veet-behemat haleviyyim tachat behemtam vehayu-li haleviyyim ani Adonai
Qareb yat levae chalap kol bukera bibne yisrael veyat beira delevae chalap beirehon vihon meshammeshin qodamay levae ana Adonai:
Veet peduye hashshelosha vehashshibim vehammatayim haodepim al-haleviyyim mibbekor bene yisrael
Veyat purqan matan veshabin utelata deyattirin al levae mibbukerayya dibne yisrael:
Velaqachta chameshet chameshet sheqalim laggulgolet besheqel haqqodesh tiqqach esrim gera hashshaqel
Vetissab chamesh chamesh silin legulgalta besile qudesha tissab asrin main sila:
Venatatta hakkesep leaharon ulebanayv peduye haodepim bahem
Vetitten kaspa leaharon velibnohi purqan deyattirin behon:
Vayyiqqach mosheh et kesep happidyom meet haodepim al peduye haleviyyim
Uneseb msheh yat kesap purqanhon min deyattirin al periqe levae:
Meet bekor bene yisrael laqach et-hakkasep chamishsha veshishshim ushelosh meot vaelep besheqel haqqodesh
Min bukerayya dibne yisrael nesib yat kaspa alap utelat mea veshittin vechamesh silin besile qudesha:
Vayyitten mosheh et-kesep happeduyim leaharon ulebanayv al-pi Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vihab msheh yat kesap periqayya leaharon velibnohi al memera daAdonai kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh veim aharon lememar:
Naso et-rosh bene qehat mittok bene levi lemishpechotam lebet abotam
Qabbilu yat chushban bene qehat miggo bene levi lezarayathon lebet abahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-ba latztzaba laasot melaka beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lechela lemebad ibidta bemashkan zimna:
Zot abodat bene-qehat beohel moed qodesh haqqodashim
Den pulechan bene qehat bemashkan zimna qodesh qudeshayya:
Uba aharon ubanayv binsoa hammachaneh vehoridu et paroket hammasak vekissu-ba et aron haedut
Veyeol aharon ubenohi bemittal mashrita viparequn yat parukta diprasa vikassun bah yat arona desahaduta:
Venatenu alayv kesuy or tachash uparesu beged-kelil tekelet milmaela vesamu baddayv
Veyittenun alohi chopaa dimshak sasgona veyipresun lebush gemir tikla milella vishavvun arichohi:
Veal shulchan happanim yipresu beged tekelet venatenu alayv et-haqqearot veet-hakkappot veet-hammenaqqiyyot veet qesot hannasek velechem hattamid alayv yihyeh
Veal patora dilchem appayya yipresun lebush tikla veyittenun alohi yat magisayya veyat bazikayya veyat mekilata veyat qasvot nissuka ulechem tedira alohi yehe:
Uparesu alehem beged tolaat shani vekissu oto bemikseh or tachash vesamu et-baddayv
Veyipresun alehon lebush tzeba zehori vikassun yateh bechopaa dimshak sasgona vishavvun yat arichohi:
Velaqechu beged tekelet vekissu et-menorat hammaor veet-neroteha veet-malqacheha veet-machtoteha veet kol-kele shamnah asher yesharetu-la bahem
Veyissebun lebush tikla vikassun yat menarta deanhore veyat botzinaha veyat tzibtaha veyat machteytaha veyat kol mane mishcha di yeshammeshun leh behon:
Venatenu otah veet-kol-keleha el-mikseh or tachash venatenu al-hammot
Veyittenun yatah veyat kol manaha lechopaa dimshak sasgona veyittenun al aricha:
Veal mizbach hazzahab yipresu beged tekelet vekissu oto bemikseh or tachash vesamu et-baddayv
Veal madbecha dedahaba yipresun lebush tikla vikassun yateh bechopaa dimshak sasgona vishavvun yat arichohi:
Velaqechu et-kol-kele hashsharet asher yesharetu-bam baqqodesh venatenu el-beged tekelet vekissu otam bemikseh or tachash venatenu al-hammot
Veyissebun yat kol mane shimmusha di yeshammeshun behon bequdesha veyittenun lilbush tikla vikassun yatehon bechopaa dimshak sasgona veyittenun al aricha:
Vedishshenu et-hammizbeach uparesu alayv beged argaman
Veyissepun yat qitma demadbecha veyipresun alohi lebush argevan:
Venatenu alayv et-kol-kelayv asher yesharetu alayv bahem et-hammachtot et-hammizlagot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizraqot kol kele hammizbeach uparesu alayv kesuy or tachash vesamu baddayv

Veyittenun alohi yat kol manohi di yeshammeshun alohi behon yat machteyata veyat tzinnoreyata veyat magropeyata veyat mizreqayya kol mane madbecha veyipresun alohi chopaa dimshak sasgona vishavun arichohi:
Vekilla aharon-vbanayv lekassot et-haqqodesh veet-kol-kele haqqodesh binsoa hammachaneh veachare-ken yabou bene-qehat laset velo-yiggeu el-haqqodesh vametu elleh massa bene-qehat beohel moed

Vishetze aharon ubenohi lekassaa yat qudesha veyat kol mane qudesha bemittal mashrita ubatar ken yealun bene qehat lemittal vela yiqrebun lequdesha vela yemutun illen mattul bene qehat bemashkan zimna:
Upequddat elazar ben-aharon hakkohen shemen hammaor uqetoret hassammim uminchat hattamid veshemen hammishcha pequddat kol-hammishkan vekol-asher-bo beqodesh ubekelayv
Vedi mesir leelazar bar aharon kahana mishcha deanharuta uqetoret busemayya uminchata tedira umishcha dirbuta matrat kol mashkena vekol di beh bequdesha ubemanohi:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh veim aharon lememar:
Al-takritu et-shebet mishpechot haqqehati mittok haleviyyim
La teshetzun yat shibta zarayat qehat miggo levae:
Vezot asu lahem vechayu velo yamutu begishtam et-qodesh haqqodashim aharon ubanayv yabou vesamu otam ish ish al-abodato veel-massao
Veda ibidu lehon veyechun vela yemutun bemiqrabhon leqodesh qudeshayya aharon ubenohi yealun vimannun yatehon gebar gebar al pulechaneh ulemattuleh:
Velo-yabou lirot keballa et-haqqodesh vametu
Vela yealun lemecheze kad mekassan yat mane qudesha vela yemutun:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Naso et-rosh bene gereshon gam-hem lebet abotam lemishpechotam
Qabbel yat chushban bene gereshon ap innun lebet abahathon lezarayathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala ad ben-chamishshim shana tipqod otam kol-habba litzbo tzaba laabod aboda beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella ad bar chamshin shenin timne yatehon kol deate lechayyala chela lemiplach palechana bemashkan zimna:
Zot abodat mishpechot haggereshunni laabod ulemassa
Den palechan zarayat gereshon lemiplach ulemattol:
Venaseu et-yeriot hammishkan veet-ohel moed miksehu umikseh hattachash asher-alayv milmaela veet-masak petach ohel moed
Veyittelun yat yeriat mashkena veyat mashkan zimna chopaeh vechopaa desasgona di alohi milleella veyat perasa ditra mashkan zimna:
Veet qale hechatzer veet-masak petach shaar hechatzer asher al-hammishkan veal-hammizbeach sabib veet meterehem veet-kol-kele abodatam veet kol-asher yeaseh lahem veabadu
Veyat serade darta veyat perasa demaalana ditra darta di al mashkena veal madbecha sechor sechor veyat attunehon veyat kol mane palechanhon veyat kol di yitmesar lehon veyiplechun:
Al-pi aharon ubanayv tihyeh kol-abodat bene haggereshunni lekol-massaam ulekol abodatam upeqadtem alehem bemishmeret et kol-massaam
Al memar aharon ubenohi yehe kol palechan bene gereshon lekol mattulehon ulekol palechanhon utemannun alehon bemattera yat kol mattulehon:
Zot abodat mishpechot bene haggereshunni beohel moed umishmartam beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohen
Den palechan zarayat bene gereshon bemashkan zimna umattartehon bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Bene merari lemishpechotam lebet-abotam tipqod otam
Bene merari lezarayathon lebet abahathon timne yatehon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana tipqedem kol-habba latztzaba laabod et-abodat ohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin timninnun kol deate lechela lemiplach yat palechan mashkan zimna:
Vezot mishmeret massaam lekol-abodatam beohel moed qarshe hammishkan uberichayv veammudayv vaadanayv
Veda matterat mattulehon lekol palechanhon bemashkan zimna dappe mashkena veabrohi veammudohi vesamkohi:
Veammude hechatzer sabib veadnehem vitedotam umeterehem lekol-kelehem ulekol abodatam ubeshemot tipqedu et-kele mishmeret massaam
Veammude dedarta sechor sechor vesamkehon vesikkehon veattunehon lekol manehon ulekol palechanhon ubishmahan temannun yat mane matterat mattulehon:
Zot abodat mishpechot bene merari lekol-abodatam beohel moed beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohen
Den palechan zarayat bene merari lekol palechanhon bemashkan zimna bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Vayyipqod mosheh veaharon unesie haeda et-bene haqqehati lemishpechotam ulebet abotam
Umena msheh veaharon verabrebe kenishta yat bene qehat lezarayathon ulebet abahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-habba latztzaba laaboda beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lechela lepalechana bemashkan zimna:
Vayyihyu pequdehem lemishpechotam alpayim sheba meot vachamishshim
Vahavo meneyanehon lezarayathon teren alpin sheba mea vechamshin:
Elleh pequde mishpechot haqqehati kol-haobed beohel moed asher paqad mosheh veaharon al-pi Adonai beyad-mosheh
Illen minyane zarayat qehat kol depalach bemashkan zimna di mena msheh veaharon al memera daAdonai bida demsheh:
Upequde bene gereshon lemishpechotam ulebet abotam
Uminyane bene gereshon lezarayathon ulebet abahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-habba latztzaba laaboda beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lechela lepalechana bemashkan zimna:
Vayyiheyu pequdehem lemishpechotam lebet abotam alpayim veshesh meot usheloshim
Vahavo minyanehon lezarayathon lebet abahathon teren alpin veshit mea utelatin:
Elleh pequde mishpechot bene gereshon kol-haobed beohel moed asher paqad mosheh veaharon al-pi Adonai
Illen minyane zarayat bene gereshon kol depalach bemashkan zimna di mena msheh veaharon al memera daAdonai:
Upequde mishpechot bene merari lemishpechotam lebet abotam
Uminyane zarayat bene merari lezarayathon lebet abahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-habba latztzaba laaboda beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lechela lepalechana bemashkan zimna:
Vayyihyu pequdehem lemishpechotam sheloshet alapim umatayim
Vahavo minyanehon lezarayathon telata alpin umatan:
Elleh pequde mishpechot bene merari asher paqad mosheh veaharon al-pi Adonai beyad-mosheh
Illen minyane zarayat bene merari di mena msheh veaharon al memera daAdonai bida demsheh:
Kol-happequdim asher paqad mosheh veaharon unesie yisrael et-haleviyyim lemishpechotam ulebet abotam
Kol minyanayya di mena msheh veaharon verabrebe yisrael yat levae lezarayathon ulebet abahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-habba laabod abodat aboda vaabodat massa beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lemiplach palechan palechana upalechan mattul bemashkan zimna:
Vayyihyu pequdehem shemonat alapim vachamesh meot ushemonim
Vahavo minyanehon temanya alpin vachamesh mea vetamnan:
Al-pi Adonai paqad otam beyad-mosheh ish ish al-abodato veal-massao upequdayv asher-tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Al memera daAdonai mena yatehon bida demsheh gebar gebar al palechaneh veal mattuleh uminyanohi di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Tzav et-bene yisrael vishallechu min-hammachaneh kol-tzarua vekol-zab vekol tame lanapesh
Paqqed yat bene yisrael vishallechun min mashrita kol disgir vekol dedaeb vekol dimsaab litme napsha deenasha:
Mizzakar ad-neqeba teshallechu el-michutz lammachaneh teshallechum velo yetammeu et-machanehem asher ani shoken betokam
Middekar ad nuqeba teshallechun lemibbara lemashrita teshallechunnun vela yesaabun yat mashritehon di shekinti shareya benehon:
Vayyaasu-ken bene yisrael vayeshallechu otam el-michutz lammachaneh kaasher dibber Adonai el-mosheh ken asu bene yisrael
Vaabadu ken bene yisrael veshallechu yatehon lemibbara lemashrita kema di mallil Adonai im msheh ken abadu bene yisrael:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael ish o-ishsha ki yaasu mikkol-chattot haadam limol maal ba-Adonai veashema hannepesh hahiv
Mallel im bene yisrael gebar o itteta are yabedun mikkol chobe enasha leshaqqara sheqar qodam Adonai veyechob enasha hahu:
Vehitvaddu et-chattatam asher asu veheshib et-ashamo berosho vachamishito yosep alayv venatan laasher asham lo
Vivaddun yat chobehon di abadu veyateb yat chobeteh beresheh vechumsheh yosep alohi veyitten lidchab leh:
Veim-en laish goel lehashib haasham elayv haasham hammushab la-Adonai lakkohen millebad el hakkippurim asher yekapper-bo alayv
Veim let ligbar pariq laataba chobeta leh chobeta dimteb qodam Adonai lekahana bar middekar kippurayya di yekapper beh alohi:
Vekol-teruma lekol-qodshe bene-yisrael asher-yaqribu lakkohen lo yihyeh
Vekol aprashuta lekol qudeshayya dibne yisrael di yeqarebun lekahana dilleh yehe:
Veish et-qodashayv lo yihyu ish asher-yitten lakkohen lo yihyeh
Ugebar yat maasar qudesheh dilleh yehon gebar diyitten lekahana dilleh yehe:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ish ki-tisteh ishto umaala bo maal
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon gebar gebar are tiste itteteh uteshaqqer beh sheqar:
Veshakab ish otah shikbat-zera venelam meene ishah venistera vehi nitmaa veed en bah vehiv lo nitpasa
Veyishkub gebar yatah shakebat zara vihe mekassa meene balah umittammera vehi mesaaba vesahid let bah vehi la ittachadat:
Veabar alayv ruach-qina veqinne et-ishto vehiv nitmaa o-abar alayv ruach-qina veqinne et-ishto vehi lo nitmaa
Veyebar alohi ruach qina viqanne yat itteteh vehi mesaaba o abar alohi ruach qina viqanne yat itteteh vehi la mesaaba:
Vehebi haish et-ishto el-hakkohen vehebi et-qorbanah aleha asirit haepa qemach seorim lo-yitzoq alayv shemen velo-yitten alayv lebona ki-minchat qenaot hu minchat zikkaron mazkeret avon

Veyayti gabra yat itteteh levat kahana veyayti yat qurbanah alah chad min asra bitlat sein qimcha searin la yeriq alohi mishcha vela yitten alohi lebunta are minchat qinata hu minchat dukerana madkarat choba:
Vehiqrib otah hakkohen veheemidah lipne Adonai
Viqareb yatah kahana viqiminnah qodam Adonai:
Velaqach hakkohen mayim qedoshim bikli-chares umin-heapar asher yihyeh beqarqa hammishkan yiqqach hakkohen venatan el-hammayim
Veyissab kahana me kiyyor beman dachasap umin apra di yehe bisode mashkena yissab kahana veyitten lemayya:
Veheemid hakkohen et-haishsha lipne Adonai upara et-rosh haishsha venatan al-kappeha et minchat hazzikkaron minchat qenaot hiv ubeyad hakkohen yihyu me hammarim hamearerim
Viqim kahana yat itteta qodam Adonai veyipra yat resha deitteta viheb al yedaha yat minchat dukerana minchat qinata hi ubida dekahana yehon mayya merirayya melattayya:
Vehishbia otah hakkohen veamar el-haishsha im-lo shakab ish otak veim-lo satit tuma tachat ishek hinnaqi mimme hammarim hamearerim haelleh
Veyome yatah kahana veyemar leitteta im la shekib gebar yatik veim la setit leistaaba bar mibbaalik heve zakkaa mimmayya merirayya melattayya haillen:
Veat ki satit tachat ishek veki nitmet vayyitten ish bak et-shekobto mibbalade ishek
Veat are setit bar mibbaalik vaare istaabt vihab gebar bik yat shekubteh bar mibbaalik:
Vehishbia hakkohen et-haishsha bishbuat haala veamar hakkohen laishsha yitten Adonai otak leala velishbua betok ammek betet Adonai et-yerekek nopelet veet-bitnek tzaba
Veyome kahana yat itteta bemomata dilvata veyemar kahana leitteta yeheb Adonai yatik lilvat ulemome bego ammik bediheb Adonai yat yarkik masya veyat meayki nepichin:
Ubau hammayim hamearerim haelleh bemeayik latzbot beten velanpil yarek veamera haishsha amen amen
Veyealun mayya melattayya haillen bimayki laapacha mein uleamsaa yarka vetemar itteta amen amen:
Vekatab et-haalot haelleh hakkohen basseper umacha el-me hammarim
Veyiktob yat levatayya haillen kahana besipra veyimchoq lemayya merirayya:
Vehishqa et-haishsha et-me hammarim hamearerim ubau bah hammayim hamearerim lemarim
Veyashqe yat itteta yat mayya merirayya melattayya veyealun bah mayya melattayya limriru:
Velaqach hakkohen miyyad haishsha et minchat haqqenaot vehenip et-hammincha lipne Adonai vehiqrib otah el-hammizbeach
Veyissab kahana mida deitteta yat minchat qinata virim yat minchata qodam Adonai viqareb yatah lemadbecha:
Veqamatz hakkohen min-hammincha et-azkaratah vehiqtir hammizbecha veachar yashqeh et-haishsha et-hammayim
Veyiqmotz kahana min minchata yat adkartah veyasseq lemadbecha ubatar ken yashqe yat itteta yat mayya:
Vehishqah et-hammayim vehayeta im-nitmea vattimol maal beishah ubau bah hammayim hamearerim lemarim vetzabeta bitnah venapela yerekah vehayeta haishsha leala beqereb ammah
Veyashqinnah yat mayya utehe im istaabat veshaqqarat sheqar bebaalah veyealun bah mayya melattayya limriru veyippechun meaha vetitmese yarkah utehe itteta lilvat bego ammah:
Veim-lo nitmea haishsha utehora hiv veniqqeta venizrea zara
Veim la istaabat itteta vedakyaa hi vetippoq zakkaa vetadi idduy:
Zot torat haqqenaot asher tisteh ishsha tachat ishah venitmaa
Da orayta deqinata di tiste itteta bar mibbaalah vetistaab:
O ish asher taabor alayv ruach qina veqinne et-ishto veheemid et-haishsha lipne Adonai veasa lah hakkohen et kol-hattora hazzot
O gebar di tebar alohi ruach qina viqanne yat itteteh viqem yat itteta qodam Adonai veyebad lah kahana yat kol orayta hada:
Veniqqa haish meavon vehaishsha hahiv tissa et-avonah
Vihe zakkaa gabra mechoba veitteta hahi teqabbel yat chobah:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish o-ishsha ki yapli lindor neder nazir lehazzir la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon gebar o itteta are yeparesh lemiddar nedar neziru lemezar qodam Adonai:
Miyyayin veshekar yazzir chometz yayin vechometz shekar lo yishteh vekol-mishrat anabim lo yishteh vaanabim lachim vibeshim lo yokel
Mechamar chadat veattiq yizzar chal dachamar chadat vechal dachamar attiq la yishte vekol matrut inbin la yishte veinbin rattibin vibeshin la yekul:
Kol yeme nizro mikkol asher yeaseh miggepen hayyayin mechartzannim vead-zag lo yokel
Kol yome nizreh mikkol deyitabed miggupna dechamra mippuretzenin vead itztzurin la yekul:
Kol-yeme neder nizro taar lo-yaabor al-rosho ad-melot hayyamim asher-yazzir la-Adonai qadosh yihyeh gaddel pera sear rosho
Kol yome nedar nizreh maspar la yebar al resheh ad mishlam yomayya deyanzer qodam Adonai qaddish yehe marbe perua sear resheh:
Kol-yeme hazziro la-Adonai al-nepesh met lo yabo
Kol yomin deyanzer qodam Adonai al napsha demeta la yeul:
Leabiv uleimmo leachiv uleachoto lo-yittamma lahem bemotam ki nezer elohayv al-rosho
Leabuhi uleimmeh leachuhi uleachateh la yistaab lehon bemotehon are kelila deelaheh al resheh:
Kol yeme nizro qadosh hu la-Adonai
Kol yome nizreh qaddish hu qodam Adonai:
Veki-yamut met alayv bepeta pitom vetimme rosh nizro vegillach rosho beyom tohorato bayyom hashshebii yegallechennu
Vaare yemut meta alohi bitkep shalu visaeb resh nizreh vigallach resheh beyoma didkuteh beyoma shebiaa yegallechinneh:
Ubayyom hashshemini yabi shete torim o shene bene yona el-hakkohen el-petach ohel moed
Ubeyoma teminaa yayte tarten shapninin o teren bene yona levat kahana litra mashkan zimna:
Veasa hakkohen echad lechattat veechad leola vekipper alayv measher chata al-hannapesh veqiddash et-rosho bayyom hahu
Veyabed kahana chad lechattata vechad laalata vikapper alohi middechab al meta viqaddash yat resheh beyoma hahu:
Vehizzir la-Adonai et-yeme nizro vehebi kebes ben-shenato leasham vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ki tame nizro
Veyazzer qodam Adonai yat yome nizreh veyayti immar bar shatteh laashama veyomayya qadmae yibtelun are istaab nizreh:
Vezot torat hannazir beyom melot yeme nizro yabi oto el-petach ohel moed
Veda orayta dinzira beyom mishlam yome nizreh yayti yateh litra mashkan zimna:
Vehiqrib et-qorbano la-Adonai kebes ben-shenato tamim echad leola vekabsa achat bat-shenatah temima lechattat veayil-echad tamim lishlamim
Viqareb yat qurbaneh qodam Adonai immar bar shatteh shelim chad laalata veimmarta chada bat shatteh shelemta lechattata udekar chad shelim leniksat qudeshayya:
Vesal matztzot solet challot belulot bashshemen ureqiqe matztzot meshuchim bashshamen uminchatam veniskehem
Vesal pattir sulta geritzan depilan bimshach veispogin pattirin dimshichin bimshach uminchathon veniskehon:
Vehiqrib hakkohen lipne Adonai veasa et-chattato veet-olato
Viqareb kahana qodam Adonai veyabed yat chattateh veyat alateh:
Veet-haayil yaaseh zebach shelamim la-Adonai al sal hammatztzot veasa hakkohen et-minchato veet-nisko
Veyat dikra yabed niksat qudeshayya qodam Adonai al salla depattirayya veyabed kahana yat minchateh veyat niskeh:
Vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed et-rosh nizro velaqach et-sear rosh nizro venatan al-haesh asher-tachat zebach hashshelamim
Vigallach nezira bitra mashkan zimna yat resh nizreh veyissab yat sear resh nizreh veyitten al eshshata di techot duda deniksat qudeshayya:
Velaqach hakkohen et-hazzeroa beshela min-haayil vechallat matztza achat min-hassal ureqiq matztza echad venatan al-kappe hannazir achar hitegallecho et-nizro
Veyissab kahana yat deraa beshela min dikra ugeritzta pattireta chada min salla veispog pattir chad veyitten al yede nezira batar degallach yat nizreh:
Vehenip otam hakkohen tenupa lipne Adonai qodesh hu lakkohen al chazeh hattenupa veal shoq hatteruma veachar yishteh hannazir yayin
Virim yatehon kahana arama qodam Adonai qudesha hu lekahana al chadya daaramuta veal shaqa deaprashuta ubatar ken yishte nezira chamra:
Zot torat hannazir asher yiddor qorbano la-Adonai al-nizro millebad asher-tassig yado kepi nidro asher yiddor ken yaaseh al torat nizro
Da orayta dinzira di yiddar qurbaneh qodam Adonai al nizreh bar middetadbeq yedeh kepum nidreh di yiddar ken yabed al orayta denizreh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banayv lemor koh tebareku et-bene yisrael amor lahem
Mallel im aharon veim benohi lememar keden tebarekun yat bene yisrael temerun lehon:
Yebarekka Adonai veyishmereka
Yebarekinnak Adonai veyitterinnak:
Yaer Adonai panayv eleka vichunnekka
Yanhar Adonai shekinteh levatak virachem yatak:
Yissa Adonai panayv eleka veyasem leka shalom
Yissab Adonai appeh levatak vishavve lak shelam:
Vesamu et-shemi al-bene yisrael vaani abarekem
Vishavvun yat birkat shemi al bene yisrael vaana abarekinnun:
Vayehi beyom kallot mosheh lehaqim et-hammishkan vayyimshach oto vayeqaddesh oto veet-kol-kelayv veet-hammizbeach veet-kol-kelayv vayyimshachem vayeqaddesh otam
Vahava beyoma deshetze msheh laaqama yat mashkena verabbi yateh veqaddish yateh veyat kol manohi veyat madbecha veyat kol manohi verabbinnun veqaddish yatehon:
Vayyaqribu nesie yisrael rashe bet abotam hem nesie hammattot hem haomedim al-happequdim
Uqeribu rabrebe yisrael reshe bet abahathon innun rabrebe shibtayya innun deqaymin al minyanayya:
Vayyabiu et-qorbanam lipne Adonai shesh-eglot tzab ushene asar baqar agala al-shene hannesiim veshor leechad vayyaqribu otam lipne hammishkan
Veaytiyu yat qurbanehon qodam Adonai shit eglan kad mechapyan utere asar torin egleta al teren rabrebayya vetor lechad veqaribu yatehon loqodam mashkena:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh lememar:
Qach meittam vehayu laabod et-abodat ohel moed venatatta otam el-haleviyyim ish kepi abodato
Qabbel minnehon vihon lemiplach yat palechan mashkan zimna vetitten yatehon lelevae gebar kemissat palechaneh:
Vayyiqqach mosheh et-haagalot veet-habbaqar vayyitten otam el-haleviyyim
Uneseb msheh yat eglata veyat tore vihab yatehon lelevae:
Et shete haagalot veet arbaat habbaqar natan libne gereshon kepi abodatam
Yat tarten eglata veyat arbea tore yehab libne gereshon kemissat palechanhon:
Veet arba haagalot veet shemonat habbaqar natan libne merari kepi abodatam beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohen
Veyat arba eglan veyat temanya tore yehab libne merari kemissat palechanhon bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Velibne qehat lo natan ki-abodat haqqodesh alehem bakkatep yissau
Velibne qehat la yehab are palechan qudesha alehon bekatpa natelin:
Vayyaqribu hannesiim et chanukkat hammizbeach beyom himmashach oto vayyaqribu hannesiim et-qorbanam lipne hammizbeach
Veqaribu rabrebayya yat chanukkat madbecha beyoma derabbiyyu yateh veqaribu rabrebayya yat qurbanhon leqodam madbecha:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh nasi echad layyom nasi echad layyom yaqribu et-qorbanam lachanukkat hammizbeach
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh rabba chad leyoma rabba chad leyoma yeqarebun yat qurbanhon lachanukkat madbecha:

Qorbano qaarat-kesep achat sheloshim umea mishqalah mizraq echad kesep shibim sheqel besheqel haqqodesh shenehem meleim solet belula bashshemen lemincha
Qurbaneh megista diksap chada mea utelatin silin hava matqelah mizreqa chad diksap matqeleh shabin silin besile qudesha tarvehon melan sulta depila bimshach leminchata:

Bazika chada matqal asar silin hi didhab malya qetoret busemayya:
Par echad ben-baqar ayil echad kebes-echad ben-shenato leola
Tor chad bar tore dekar chad immar chad bar shatteh laalata:

Uleniksat qudeshayya torin teren dikrin chamsha gedaye chamsha immerin bene shena chamsha den qurban achira bar enan:
Zot chanukkat hammizbeach beyom himmashach oto meet nesie yisrael qaarot kesep shetem esreh mizereqe-kesep shenem asar kappot zahab shetem esreh
Da chanukkat madbecha beyoma derabbiyyu yateh min rabrebe yisrael megise kaspa tarta asre mazreqe kaspa teren asar bazike dedahaba tarta asre:
Sheloshim umea haqqeara haachat kesep veshibim hammizraq haechad kol kesep hakkelim alpayim vearba-meot besheqel haqqodesh
Mea utelatin silin hava matqela dimgiseta chada dekaspa veshabin demizreqa chad kol kesap manayya teren alpin vearba mea bisile qudesha:
Kappot zahab shetem-esreh meleot qetoret asara asara hakkap besheqel haqqodesh kol-zehab hakkappot esrim umea
Bazike dedahaba tarte asre malyan qetoret busemayya matqal asar silin hava matqela debazika besile qudesha kol dehab bazikayya mea veasrin:
Kol-habbaqar laola shenem asar parim elim shenem-asar kebasim bene-shana shenem asar uminchatam useire izzim shenem asar lechattat
Kol tore laalata tere asar torin dikrin tere asar immerin bene shena tere asar uminchathon utzepire bar izzin tere asar lechattata:
Vekol beqar zebach hashshelamim esrim vearbaa parim elim shishshim attudim shishshim kebasim bene-shana shishshim zot chanukkat hammizbeach achare himmashach oto
Vekol tore leniksat qudeshayya asrin vearbea torin dikrin shittin gadyan shittin immerin bene shena shittin da chanukkat madbecha batar derabbiyyu yateh:
Ubebo mosheh el-ohel moed ledabber itto vayyishma et-haqqol middabber elayv meal hakkapporet asher al-aron haedut mibben shene hakkerubim vayedabber elayv
Vekad alil msheh lemashkan zimna lemallala immeh ushema yat qala demitmallel immeh meillave kappurta di al arona desahaduta mibben teren kerubayya umitmallel immeh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veamarta elayv behaaloteka et-hannerot el-mvl pene hammenora yairu shibat hannerot
Mallel im aharon vetemar leh beadlaqutak yat botzinayya loqobel appe menarta yehon menaharin shiba botzinayya:
Vayyaas ken aharon el-mvl pene hammenora heela neroteha kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vaabad ken aharon loqobel appe menarta adleq botzinaha kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vezeh maaseh hammenora miqsha zahab ad-yerekah ad-pirchah miqsha hiv kammareh asher hera Adonai et-mosheh ken asa et-hammenora
Veden obad menarta negida dehab ad shidah ad shoshannah negida hi kechezva di achaze Adonai yat msheh ken abad yat menarta:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Qach et-haleviyyim mittok bene yisrael vetiharta otam
Qareb yat levae miggo bene yisrael utedakke yatehon:
Vekoh-taaseh lahem letaharam hazzeh alehem me chattat veheebiru taar al-kol-besaram vekibbesu bigdehem vehitteharu
Ukeden tabed lehon ledakkoehon adde alehon mayya dechattata veyaberun maspar al kol bisrehon vichavverun lebushehon veyiddekun:
Velaqechu par ben-baqar uminchato solet belula bashshamen upar-sheni ben-baqar tiqqach lechattat
Visebun tor bar tore uminchateh sulta depila bimshach vetor tinyan bar tore tissab lechattata:
Vehiqrabta et-haleviyyim lipne ohel moed vehiqhaleta et-kol-adat bene yisrael
Uteqareb yat levae qodam mashkan zimna vetiknesh yat kol kenishta dibne yisrael:
Vehiqrabta et-haleviyyim lipne Adonai vesameku bene-yisrael et-yedehem al-haleviyyim
Uteqareb yat levae qodam Adonai veyismekun bene yisrael yat yedehon al levae:
Vehenip aharon et-haleviyyim tenupa lipne Adonai meet bene yisrael vehayu laabod et-abodat Adonai
Virim aharon yat levae arama qodam Adonai min bene yisrael vihon lemiplach yat palechana daAdonai:
Vehaleviyyim yismeku et-yedehem al rosh happarim vaaseh et-haechad chattat veet-haechad ola la-Adonai lekapper al-haleviyyim
Velevae yismekun yat yedehon al resh torayya veyaabbed yat chad chattata veyat chad alata qodam Adonai lekappara al levae:
Vehaamadta et-haleviyyim lipne aharon velipne banayv vehenapta otam tenupa la-Adonai
Uteqem yat levae qodam aharon veqadam benohi uterem yatehon arama qodam Adonai:
Vehibdalta et-haleviyyim mittok bene yisrael vehayu li haleviyyim
Vetapresh yat levae miggo bene yisrael vihon meshammeshin qodamay levae:
Veachare-ken yabou haleviyyim laabod et-ohel moed vetiharta otam vehenapta otam tenupa
Ubatar ken yaalun levae lemiplach yat mashkan zimna utedakke yatehon uterem yatehon arama:
Ki netunim netunim hemma li mittok bene yisrael tachat pitrat kol-rechem bekor kol mibbene yisrael laqachti otam li
Are aprasha mapreshin innun li miggo bene yisrael chalap petach kol valeda bukera kolla mibbene yisrael qarebit yatehon qodamay:
Ki li kol-bekor bibne yisrael baadam ubabbehema beyom hakkoti kol-bekor beeretz mitzrayim hiqdashti otam li
Are dili kol bukera bibne yisrael baanasha ubibira beyoma diqtalit kol bukera beara demitzrayim aqdeshit yatehon qodamay:
Vaeqqach et-haleviyyim tachat kol-bekor bibne yisrael
Veqarebit yat levae chalap kol bukera bibne yisrael:

Vaettena et-haleviyyim netunim leaharon ulebanayv mittok bene yisrael laabod et-abodat bene-yisrael beohel moed ulekapper al-bene yisrael velo yihyeh bibne yisrael negep begeshet bene-yisrael el-haqqodesh

Vihabit yat levae mesirin leaharon velibnohi miggo bene yisrael lemiplach yat palechan bene yisrael bemashkan zimna ulekappara al bene yisrael vela yehe bibne yisrael mota bemiqrab bene yisrael lequdesha:
Vayyaas mosheh veaharon vekol-adat bene-yisrael lalviyyim kekol asher-tzivva Adonai et-mosheh lalviyyim ken-asu lahem bene yisrael
Vaabad msheh veaharon vekol kenishta dibne yisrael lelevae kekol di paqqid Adonai yat msheh lelevae ken abadu lehon bene yisrael:
Vayyitechatteu haleviyyim vayekabbesu bigdehem vayyanep aharon otam tenupa lipne Adonai vayekapper alehem aharon letaharam
Veiddakkiyyu levae vechavvaru lebushehon vaarem aharon yatehon arama qodam Adonai vekappar alehon aharon ledakkoehon:
Veachare-ken bau haleviyyim laabod et-abodatam beohel moed lipne aharon velipne banayv kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh al-haleviyyim ken asu lahem
Ubatar ken allu levae lemiplach yat palechanhon bemashkan zimna qodam aharon veqadam benohi kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh al levae ken abadu lehon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Zot asher lalviyyim mibben chamesh veesrim shana vamala yabo litzbo tzaba baabodat ohel moed
Da di lelevae mibbar chamesh veasrin shenin uleella yete lachayala chela bepalechan mashkan zimna:
Umibben chamishshim shana yashub mitztzeba haaboda velo yaabod od
Umibbar chamshin shenin yetub mechel palechana vela yiplach od:
Vesheret et-echayv beohel moed lishmor mishmeret vaaboda lo yaabod kaka taaseh lalviyyim bemishmerotam
Vishammash im achohi bemashkan zimna lemittar mattara upalechana la yiplach keden tabed lelevae bematterathon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh bemidbar-sinay bashshana hashshenit letzetam meeretz mitzrayim bachodesh harishon lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh bemadbera desinay beshatta tinyeta lemippaqhon meara demitzrayim beyarcha qadmaa lememar:
Veyaasu bene-yisrael et-happasach bemoado
Veyabedun bene yisrael yat pischa bezimneh:
Bearbaa asar-yom bachodesh hazzeh ben haarbayim taasu oto bemoado kekol-chuqqotayv ukekol-mishpatayv taasu oto
Bearbeat asra yoma beyarcha haden ben shimshayya tabedun yateh bezimneh kekal gezerateh ukekal dechaze leh tabedun yateh:
Vayedabber mosheh el-bene yisrael laasot happasach
Umallil msheh im bene yisrael lemebad pischa:
Vayyaasu et-happesach barishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh ben haarbayim bemidbar sinay kekol asher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh ken asu bene yisrael
Vaabadu yat pischa benisan bearbeat asra yoma leyarcha ben shimshayya bemadbera desinay kekol di paqqid Adonai yat msheh ken abadu bene yisrael:
Vayehi anashim asher hayu temeim lenepesh adam velo-yakelu laasot-happesach bayyom hahu vayyiqrebu lipne mosheh velipne aharon bayyom hahu
Vahavo gubrayya di havo mesaabin litme napsha deenasha vela yekilu lemebad pischa beyoma hahu uqeribu qodam msheh veqadam aharon beyoma hahu:
Vayyomeru haanashim hahemma elayv anachnu temeim lenepesh adam lamma niggara lebilti haqrib et-qorban Adonai bemoado betok bene yisrael
Vaamaru gubrayya hainnun leh anachna mesaabin litme napsha deenasha lema nitmena bedil dela leqaraba yat qurbana daAdonai bezimneh bego bene yisrael:
Vayyomer alehem mosheh imdu veeshmea mah-yetzavveh Adonai lakem
Vaamar lehon msheh oriku ad deishma ma deitpaqqad qodam Adonai al di lekon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor ish ish ki-yihyeh-tame lanepesh o bederek rechoqa lakem o ledorotekem veasa pesach la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar gebar gebar are yehe mesaab litme napsha deenasha o beorcha rechiqa lekon o ledarekon veyabed pischa qodam Adonai:
Bachodesh hashsheni bearbaa asar yom ben haarbayim yaasu oto al-matztzot umerorim yokeluhu
Beyarcha tinyana bearbeat asra yoma ben shimshayya yabedun yateh al pattir umerarin yekelunneh:
Lo-yashiru mimmennu ad-boqer veetzem lo yishberu-bo kekol-chuqqat happesach yaasu oto
La yasharun minneh ad tzapra vegarma la yitberun beh kekal gezerat pischa yabedun yateh:
Vehaish asher-hv tahor ubederek lo-haya vechadal laasot happesach venikreta hannepesh hahiv meammeha ki qorban Adonai lo hiqrib bemoado cheto yissa haish hahu
Vegabra dehu deke ubeorach la hava veyitmena lemebad pischa veyishtetze anasha hahi meammah are qurbana daAdonai la qarib bezimneh chobeh yeqabbel gabra hahu:
Veki-yagur ittekem ger veasa pesach la-Adonai kechuqqat happesach ukemishpato ken yaaseh chuqqa achat yihyeh lakem velagger uleezrach haaretz
Vaare yitgayyar immekon giyyora veyabed pischa qodam Adonai kigzerat pischa vekidchaze leh ken yabed qeyama chad yehe lekon ulegiyyora uleyatztziba deara:
Ubeyom haqim et-hammishkan kissa heanan et-hammishkan leohel haedut ubaereb yihyeh al-hammishkan kemareh-esh ad-boqer
Ubeyoma deittaqam yat mashkena chapa anana yat mashkena lemashkena desahaduta uberamsha hava al mashkena kechezu eshshata ad tzapra:
Ken yihyeh tamid heanan yekassennu umareh-esh layela
Ken hava tedira anana chape leh vechezu eshshata beleleya:
Ulepi healot heanan meal haohel veachare ken yisu bene yisrael ubimqom asher yishkon-sham heanan sham yachanu bene yisrael
Ulepum istallaqut anana meillave mashkena ubatar ken natelin bene yisrael ubeatra deshare tamman anana tamman sharan bene yisrael:
Al-pi Adonai yisu bene yisrael veal-pi Adonai yachanu kol-yeme asher yishkon heanan al-hammishkan yachanu
Al memera daAdonai natelin bene yisrael veal memera daAdonai sharan kol yome di share anana al mashkena sharan:
Ubehaarik heanan al-hammishkan yamim rabbim veshameru bene-yisrael et-mishmeret Adonai velo yissau
Ubeorakut anana al mashkena yomin saggiin veyitterun bene yisrael yat matterat memera daAdonai vela natelin:
Veyesh asher yihyeh heanan yamim mispar al-hammishkan al-pi Adonai yachanu veal-pi Adonai yissau
Veit di hava anana yome deminyan al mashkena al memera daAdonai sharan veal memera daAdonai natelin:
Veyesh asher-yihyeh heanan meereb ad-boqer venaala heanan babboqer venasau o yomam valayla venaala heanan venasau
Veit di hava anana meramsha ad tzapra umistallaq anana betzapra venatelin o yemam velele umistallaq anana venatelin:
O-yomayim o-chodesh o-yamim behaarik heanan al-hammishkan lishkon alayv yachanu bene-yisrael velo yissau ubehealoto yissau
O teren yomin o yarcha o iddan beiddan beorakut anana al mashkena lemishre alohi sharan bene yisrael vela natelin ubeistallaquteh natelin:
Al-pi Adonai yachanu veal-pi Adonai yissau et-mishmeret Adonai shamaru al-pi Adonai beyad-mosheh
Al memera daAdonai sharan veal memera daAdonai natelin yat matterat memera daAdonai naterin al memera daAdonai bida demsheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Aseh leka shete chatzotzerot kesep miqsha taaseh otam vehayu leka lemiqra haeda ulemassa et-hammachanot
Ibed lak tarten chatzotzeran diksap negid tabed yatehon vihevyan lak leara kenishta uleattala yat mashrita:
Vetaqeu bahen venoadu eleka kol-haeda el-petach ohel moed
Veyitqeun behen veyizdammenun levatak kol kenishta litra mashkan zimna:
Veim-beachat yitqau venoadu eleka hannesiim rashe alpe yisrael
Veim bachada yitqeun veyizdammenun levatak rabrebayya reshe alpayya deyisrael:
Uteqatem terua venaseu hammachanot hachonim qedema
Vetitqeun yabbebta veyittelun mashshiryata dishran qidduma:
Uteqatem terua shenit venaseu hammachanot hachonim temana terua yitqeu lemasehem
Vetitqeun yabbebta tinyanut veyittelun mashshiryata dishran daroma yabbaba yitqeun lemattelanehon:
Ubehaqhil et-haqqahal titqeu velo tariu
Ubemiknash yat qehala titqeun vela teyabbebun:
Ubene aharon hakkohanim yitqeu bachatzotzerot vehayu lakem lechuqqat olam ledorotekem
Ubene aharon kahanayya yitqeun bachatzotzerata vihevyan lekon liqyam alam ledarekon:
Veki-tabou milchama beartzekem al-hatztzar hatztzorer etkem vahareotem bachatzotzerot venizkartem lipne Adonai elohekem venoshatem meoyebekem
Vaare tealun leaggacha qeraba bearakon al meiqe dimiqin lekon uteyabbebun bachatzotzerata veyeul dukeranekon letaba qodam Adonai elahakon vetitparequn missanekon:
Ubeyom simchatkem ubemoadekem uberashe chodshekem uteqatem bachatzotzerot al olotekem veal zibche shalmekem vehayu lakem lezikkaron lipne elohekem ani Adonai elohekem
Ubeyom chedvatkon ubemoadekon ubereshe yarchekon vetitqeun bachatzotzerata al alavatekon veal niksat qudeshekon vihevyan lekon ledukerana qodam elahakon ana Adonai elahakon:
Vayehi bashshana hashshenit bachodesh hashsheni beesrim bachodesh naala heanan meal mishkan haedut
Vahava beshatta tinyeta beyarcha tinyana beasrin leyarcha istallaq anana meillave mashkena desahaduta:
Vayyisu bene-yisrael lemasehem mimmidbar sinay vayyishkon heanan bemidbar paran
Unetalu bene yisrael lemattelanehon mimmadbera desinay ushera anana bemadbera deparan:
Vayyisu barishona al-pi Adonai beyad-mosheh
Unetalu beqadmeta al memera daAdonai bida demsheh:
Vayyissa degel machaneh bene-yehuda barishona letzibotam veal-tzebao nachshon ben-amminadab
Unetal teqas mashrit bene yehuda beqadmeta lechelehon veal cheleh nachshon bar amminadab:
Veal-tzeba matteh bene yissashkar netanel ben-tzvar
Veal chela deshibta dibne yissashkar netanel bar tzuar:
Veal-tzeba matteh bene zebulun eliab ben-chelon
Veal chela deshibta dibne zebulun eliab bar chelon:
Vehurad hammishkan venaseu bene-gereshon ubene merari nosee hammishkan
Umitparaq mashkena venatelin bene gereshon ubene merari natele mashkena:
Venasa degel machaneh reuben letzibotam veal-tzebao elitzur ben-shedeur
Unetal teqas mashrit reuben lechelehon veal cheleh elitzur bar shedeur:
Veal-tzeba matteh bene shimon shelumiel ben-tzvrishadday
Veal chela deshibta dibne shimon shelumiel bar tzurishadday:
Veal-tzeba matteh bene-gad elyasap ben-deuel
Veal chela deshibta dibne gad elyasap bar deuel:
Venaseu haqqehatim nosee hammiqdash veheqimu et-hammishkan ad-boam
Venatelin bene qehat natele maqdesha umeqimin yat mashkena ad metehon:
Venasa degel machaneh bene-eprayim letzibotam veal-tzebao elishama ben-ammihud
Unetal teqas mashrit bene eprayim lechelehon veal cheleh elishama bar ammihud:
Veal-tzeba matteh bene menashsheh gamliel ben-pedatzur
Veal chela deshibta dibne menashsheh gamliel bar pedatzur:
Veal-tzeba matteh bene binyamin abidan ben-gidoni
Veal chela deshibta dibne binyamin abidan bar gidoni:
Venasa degel machaneh bene-dan meassep lekol-hammachanot letzibotam veal-tzebao achiezer ben-ammishadday
Venatel teqas mashrit bene dan maknesh lekol mashshiryata lechelehon veal cheleh achiezer bar ammishadday:
Veal-tzeba matteh bene asher pagiel ben-okran
Veal chela deshibta dibne asher pagiel bar akeran:
Veal-tzeba matteh bene naptali achira ben-enan
Veal chela deshibta dibne naptali achira bar enan:
Elleh mase bene-yisrael letzibotam vayyissau
Illen mattelane bene yisrael lechelehon unetalu:
Vayyomer mosheh lechobab ben-reuel hammidyani choten mosheh noseim anachnu el-hammaqom asher amar Adonai oto etten lakem leka ittanu vehetabnu lak ki-Adonai dibber-tob al-yisrael
Vaamar msheh lechobab bar reuel midyanaa chamuhi demsheh natelin anachna leatra di amar Adonai yateh etten lekon ita immana venoteb lak are Adonai mallil leaytaa taba al yisrael:
Vayyomer elayv lo elek ki im-el-artzi veel-moladti elek
Vaamar leh la ezel ellahen leari uleyalladuti ezel:
Vayyomer al-na taazob otanu ki al-ken yadata chanotenu bammidbar vehayita lanu leenayim
Vaamar la kean tishboq yatana are al ken yedaat kad havena sharan bemadbera ugeburan deitabidan lana chazeta beenayik:
Vehaya ki-telek immanu vehaya hattob hahu asher yetib Adonai immanu vehetabnu lak
Vihe are tezel immana vihe taba hahu di yotib Adonai immana venoteb lak:
Vayyisu mehar Adonai derek sheloshet yamim vaaron berit-Adonai nosea lipnehem derek sheloshet yamim latur lahem menucha
Unetalu mittura deitgele alohi yeqara daAdonai mahalak telata yomin vaaron qeyama daAdonai natel qodamehon mahalak telata yomin leatqenaa lehon atar bet meshere:
Vaanan Adonai alehem yomam benosam min-hammachaneh
Vaanan yeqara daAdonai mattel alehon bimama bemittalhon min mashrita:
Vayehi binsoa haaron vayyomer mosheh quma Adonai veyaputzu oyebeka veyanusu mesaneka mippaneka
Vahava bemittal arona vaamar msheh itgele Adonai veyitbadderun sanayk viarequn baale debabak min qodamak:
Ubenuchoh yomar shuba Adonai ribebot alpe yisrael
Ubemishrohi amar tub Adonai shere biqarak bego ribvat alpayya deyisrael:
Vayehi haam kemitonenim ra beozne Adonai vayyishma Adonai vayyichar appo vattibar-bam esh Adonai vattokal biqtzeh hammachaneh
Vahava amma kad mistaqpin bish qodam Adonai ushemia qodam Adonai uteqep rogzeh udeleqat behon eshshata min qodam Adonai veshetziat bisyape mashrita:
Vayyitzaq haam el-mosheh vayyitpallel mosheh el-Adonai vattishqa haesh
Utzevach amma al msheh vetzalli msheh qodam Adonai veishtaqqeat eshshata:
Vayyiqra shem-hammaqom hahu tabera ki-baara bam esh Adonai
Uqera shema deatra hahu deleqta are deleqat behon eshshata min qodam Adonai:
Vehasapsup asher beqirbo hitavvu taava vayyashubu vayyibku gam bene yisrael vayyomeru mi yaakilenu basar
Vaarabrebin di benehon sheilu sheelta vetabu ubeko ap bene yisrael vaamaru man yekelinnana bisra:
Zakarnu et-haddaga asher-nokal bemitzrayim chinnam et haqqishshuim veet haabattichim veet-hechatzir veet-habbetzalim veet-hashshumim
Dekirin anachna yat nunayya dahavena oklin bemitzrayim maggan yat botzinayya veyat abattichayya ukerate ubutzele vetume:
Veatta napshenu yebesha en kol bilti el-hamman enenu
Ukean napshana taiba let kol middaam ellahen lemanna enana:
Vehamman kizra-gad hu veeno keen habbedolach
Umanna kebar zera gadda hu vechezveh kechezu bedolecha:
Shatu haam velaqetu vetachanu barechayim o daku bammedoka ubishshelu bapparur veasu oto ugot vehaya tamo ketaam leshad hashshamen
