Shaytin amma velaqetin detzabe tachin berechayya o detzabe daik bammedukta umebashshelin leh beqidra veabedin yateh geritzan vahava taameh kitem delish bemishcha:
Uberedet hattal al-hammachaneh layela yered hamman alayv
Vekad nachet talla al mashrita leleya nachet manna alohi:
Vayyishma mosheh et-haam bokeh lemishpechotayv ish lepetach oholo vayyichar-ap Adonai meod ubeene mosheh ra
Ushema msheh yat amma bakan lezarayathon gebar bitra mashkeneh uteqep rogza daAdonai lachada ubeene msheh bish:
Vayyomer mosheh el-Adonai lama hareota leabdeka velamma lo-matzati chen beeneka lasum et-massa kol-haam hazzeh alay
Vaamar msheh qodam Adonai lema abeshta leabdak ulema la ashkachit rachamin qodamak leshavvaa yat metul kol amma haden alay:
Heanoki hariti et kol-haam hazzeh im-anoki yelidtihu ki-tomar elay saehu becheqeka kaasher yissa haomen et-hayyoneq al haadama asher nishbata laabotayv
Haab ana lekol amma haden im benay innun deameret li sobarhi betaqepak kema dimsobar turbeyana yat yanqa al ara di qayyemta laabahatohi:
Meayin li basar latet lekol-haam hazzeh ki-yibku alay lemor tena-lanu basar venokela
Menan li bisra lemehab lekol amma haden are bakan alay lememar hab lana bisra venekul:
Lo-vkal anoki lebaddi laset et-kol-haam hazzeh ki kabed mimmenni
Let ana yakil bilchodi lesobara yat kol amma haden are yaqqir minni:
Veim-kaka at-oseh li horgeni na harog im-matzati chen beeneka veal-ereh beraati
Veim keden at abed li qetaleni kean qetol im ashkachit rachamin qodamak vela echeze bebisheti:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh espa-li shibim ish mizziqne yisrael asher yadata ki-hem ziqne haam veshoterayv velaqachta otam el-ohel moed vehiteyatztzebu sham immak
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh kenosh qodamay shabin gabra missabe yisrael di yedaat are innun sabe amma vesarkohi utedabbar yatehon lemashkan zimna veyitattedun tamman immak:
Veyaradti vedibbarti immeka sham veatzalti min-haruach asher aleka vesamti alehem venaseu itteka bemassa haam velo-tissa atta lebaddeka
Veetgele veemallel immak tamman vaarabbe min rucha daalak veeshavve alehon visoberun immak bemattul amma vela tesobar at bilchodak:
Veel-haam tomar hitqaddeshu lemachar vaakaltem basar ki bekitem beozne Adonai lemor mi yaakilenu basar ki-tob lanu bemitzrayim venatan Adonai lakem basar vaakaltem
Uleamma temar izdammenu limchar vetekelun bisra are beketun qodam Adonai lememar man yekelinnana bisra are tab lana bemitzrayim veyitten Adonai lekon bisra vetekelun:
Lo yom echad tokelun velo yomayim velo chamishsha yamim velo asara yamim velo esrim yom
La yoma chad tekelun vela teren yomin vela chamsha yomin vela asra yomin vela asrin yomin:
Ad chodesh yamim ad asher-yetze meappekem vehaya lakem lezara yaan ki-meastem et-Adonai asher beqirbekem vattibku lepanayv lemor lamma zeh yatzanu mimmitzrayim
Ad yerach yomin ad di teqotzun beh vihe lekon letaqla chalap deqatztun yat memera daAdonai dishkinteh sharyat benekon ubeketun qodamohi lememar lema denan nepaqna mimmitzrayim:
Vayyomer mosheh shesh-meot elep ragli haam asher anoki beqirbo veatta amarta basar etten lahem veoklu chodesh yamim
Vaamar msheh shit mea alpin gabra riglaa amma di ana benehon veat amart bisra etten lehon veyekelun yerach yomin:
Hatzon ubaqar yishshachet lahem umatza lahem im et-kol-dege hayyam yeasep lahem umatza lahem
Haan vetorin yitnakkesun lehon hayesappequn lehon im yat kol nune yamma yitkanneshun lehon hayesappequn lehon:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh hayad Adonai tiqtzar atta tireh hayiqreka debari im-lo
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh hamemera daAdonai yitakkab kean techeze hayearinnak pitgami im la:
Vayyetze mosheh vayedabber el-haam et dibre Adonai vayyeesop shibim ish mizziqne haam vayyaamed otam sebibot haohel
Unepaq msheh umallil leamma yat pitgamayya daAdonai ukenesh shabin gabra missabe amma vaaqem yatehon sechor sechor lemashkena:
Vayyered Adonai beanan vayedabber elayv vayyatzel min-haruach asher alayv vayyitten al-shibim ish hazzeqenim vayehi kenoach alehem haruach vayyitenabbeu velo yasapu
Veitgeli Adonai baanana umallil immeh verabbi min rucha di alohi vihab al shabin gabra sabayya vahava kad sherat alehon rucha dinbua umitnabbein vela pasqin:
Vayyishshaaru shene-anashim bammachaneh shem haechad eldad veshem hashsheni medad vattanach alehem haruach vehemma bakketubim velo yatzeu haohela vayyitenabbeu bammachaneh
Veishtaaru teren gubrin bemashrita shum chad eldad veshum tinyana medad usherat alehon rucha dinbua veinnun biktibayya vela nepaqu lemashkena veitnabbiu bemashrita:
Vayyarotz hannaar vayyagged lemosheh vayyomar eldad umedad mitenabbeim bammachaneh
Urehat ulema vechavvi lemsheh vaamar eldad umedad mitnabbein bemashrita:
Vayyaan yehoshua bin-nvn mesharet mosheh mibbechurayv vayyomar adoni mosheh kelaem
Vaateb yehoshua bar nun meshummeshaneh demsheh meulemuteh vaamar ribboni msheh asarinnun:
Vayyomer lo mosheh hameqanne atta li umi yitten kol-am Adonai nebiim ki-yitten Adonai et-rvcho alehem
Vaamar leh msheh haqinati at meqanne li reena pon dihon kol amma daAdonai nebiayn are yitten Adonai yat ruach nebuateh alehon:
Vayyeasep mosheh el-hammachaneh hu veziqne yisrael
Veitkenesh msheh lemashrita hu vesabe yisrael:
Veruach nasa meet Adonai vayyagoz salvim min-hayyam vayyittosh al-hammachaneh kederek yom koh ukederek yom koh sebibot hammachaneh ukeammatayim al-pene haaretz
Verucha netal min qodam Adonai veaprach selayv min yamma urema al mashrita kemahalak yoma leka ukemahalak yoma leka sechor sechor lemashrita ukerum tarten ammin al appe ara:
Vayyaqom haam kol-hayyom hahu vekol-hallayla vekol yom hammochorat vayyaaspu et-hasselav hammamit asap asara chomarim vayyishtechu lahem shatoach sebibot hammachaneh
Veqam amma kol yoma hahu vekol leleya vekol yoma debatrohi ukenashu yat selayv deazar kenash asra degorin ushetachu lehon mashtichin sechor sechor lemashrita:
Habbasar odennu ben shinnehem terem yikkaret veap Adonai chara baam vayyak Adonai baam makka rabba meod
Bisra ad kean ben shinnehon ad la pesaq verogza daAdonai teqep beamma uqetal Adonai beamma qetol saggi lachada:
Vayyiqra et-shem-hammaqom hahu qibrot hattaava ki-sham qaberu et-haam hammitavvim
Uqera yat shema deatra hahu qibre dimshaale are tamman qebaru yat amma deshailu:
Miqqibrot hattaava naseu haam chatzerot vayyihyu bachatzerot
Miqqibre dimshaale netalu amma lachatzerot vahavo bachatzerot:
Vattedabber miryam veaharon bemosheh al-odot haishsha hakkushit asher laqach ki-ishsha kushit laqach
Umallelat miryam veaharon bemsheh al esaq itteta shappirta di nesib are itteta shappirta dinsib rachiq:
Vayyomeru haraq ak-bemosheh dibber Adonai halo gam-banu dibber vayyishma Adonai
Vaamaru halechod beram bemsheh mallil Adonai hala ap immana mallil ushemia qodam Adonai:
Vehaish mosheh anav meod mikkol haadam asher al-pene haadama
Vegabra msheh invetan lachada mikkol enasha di al appe ara:
Vayyomer Adonai pitom el-mosheh veel-aharon veel-miryam tzeu sheloshtekem el-ohel moed vayyetzeu sheloshtam
Vaamar Adonai bitkep lemsheh uleaharon ulemiryam puqu telatekon lemashkan zimna unepaqu telatehon:
Vayyered Adonai beammud anan vayyaamod petach haohel vayyiqra aharon umiryam vayyetzeu shenehem
Veitgeli Adonai beammuda daanana veqam bitra mashkena uqera aharon umiryam unepaqu tarvehon:
Vayyomer shimu-na debaray im-yiheyeh nebiakem Adonai bammara elayv etvadda bachalom adabber-bo
Vaamar shemau kean pitgamay im yehon lekon nebiin ana Adonai bechezyan ana mitgeli lehon bechelmin ana memallel immehon:
Lo-ken abdi mosheh bekol-beti neeman hu
La ken abdi msheh bekol beti meheman hu:
Peh el-peh adabber-bo umareh velo bechidot utemunat Adonai yabbit umaddua lo yeretem ledabber beabdi bemosheh
Mamlal im mamlal mallelna immeh bechezu vela bechidvan udemut yeqara daAdonai mistakkal uma den la decheltun lemallala beabdi bemsheh:
Vayyichar-ap Adonai bam vayyelak
Uteqip rogza daAdonai behon veistallaq:
Veheanan sar meal haohel vehinneh miryam metzoraat kashshaleg vayyipen aharon el-miryam vehinneh metzoraat
Vaanana istallaq meillave mashkena veha miryam chavvera ketalga veitpeni aharon levat miryam veha segirat:
Vayyomer aharon el-mosheh bi adoni al-na tashet alenu chattat asher noalnu vaasher chatanu
Vaamar aharon lemsheh bebau ribboni la kean teshavvi alana choba deitpashna vedi serachena:
Al-na tehi kammet asher betzeto merechem immo vayyeakel chatzi besaro
La kean titrachaq da mibbenana are achatana hi tzalli kean al bisra mita haden di bah veyittassi:
Vayyitzaq mosheh el-Adonai lemor el na repa na lah
Vetzalli msheh qodam Adonai lememar elaha bebau asse kean yatah:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh veabiha yaroq yaraq bepaneha halo tikkalem shibat yamim tissager shibat yamim michutz lammachaneh veachar teasep
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh veillu abuhah minzap nezip bah hala titkelem shaba yomin tistegar shaba yomin mibbara lemashrita ubatar ken titkenesh:
Vattissager miryam michutz lammachaneh shibat yamim vehaam lo nasa ad-heasep miryam
Veistegarat miryam mibbara lemashrita shaba yomin veamma la netal ad deitkeneshat miryam:
Veachar naseu haam mechatzerot vayyachanu bemidbar paran
Ubatar ken netalu amma mechatzerot ushero bemadbera deparan:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Shelach-leka anashim veyaturu et-eretz kenaan asher-ani noten libne yisrael ish echad ish echad lematteh abotayv tishlachu kol nasi bahem
Shelach lak gubrin viallelun yat ara diknaan di ana yaheb libne yisrael gabra chad gabra chad leshibta daabahatohi teshallechun kol rabba dibhon:
Vayyishlach otam mosheh mimmidbar paran al-pi Adonai kullam anashim rashe bene-yisrael hemma
Ushelach yatehon msheh mimmadbera deparan al memera daAdonai kullehon gubrin reshe bene yisrael innun:
Veelleh shemotam lematteh reuben shammua ben-zakkur
Veillen shemahathon leshibta diruben shammua bar zakkur:
Lematteh shimon shapat ben-chori
Leshibta deshimon shapat bar chori:
Lematteh yehuda kaleb ben-yepunneh
Leshibta dihuda kaleb bar yepunneh:
Lematteh yissashkar yigal ben-yosep
Leshibta deyissashkar yigal bar yosep:
Lematteh eprayim hoshea bin-nvn
Leshibta deeprayim hoshea bar nun:
Lematteh binyamin palti ben-rapu
Leshibta debinyamin palti bar rapu:
Lematteh zebulun gaddiel ben-sodi
Leshibta dizbulun gaddiel bar sodi:
Lematteh yosep lematteh menashsheh gaddi ben-svsi
Leshibta deyosep leshibta dimnashsheh gaddi bar susi:
Lematteh dan ammiel ben-gemalli
Leshibta dedan ammiel bar gemalli:
Lematteh asher setur ben-mikael
Leshibta deasher setur bar mikael:
Lematteh naptali nachbi ben-vopsi
Leshibta denaptali nachbi bar vapesi:
Lematteh gad geuel ben-maki
Leshibta degad geuel bar maki:
Elleh shemot haanashim asher-shalach mosheh latur et-haaretz vayyiqra mosheh lehoshea bin-nvn yehoshua
Illen shemahat gubrayya di shelach msheh leallala yat ara uqera msheh lehoshea bar nun yehoshua:
Vayyishlach otam mosheh latur et-eretz kenaan vayyomer alehem alu zeh bannegeb vaalitem et-hahar
Ushelach yatehon msheh leallala yat ara diknaan vaamar lehon saqu da bidroma vetisqun letura:
Ureitem et-haaretz mah-hiv veet-haam hayyosheb aleha hechazaq hu harapeh hameat hu im-rab
Vetechezun yat ara ma hi veyat amma deyateb alah hataqqip hu im challash hazer hu im saggi:
Uma haaretz asher-hv yosheb bah hatoba hiv im-raa uma hearim asher-hv yosheb bahenna habbemachanim im bemibtzarim
Uma ara di hu yateb bah hataba hi im bisha uma qirvayya di hu yateb behon habbepatzchin im bikrakkin:
Uma haaretz hashshemena hiv im-raza hayesh-bah etz im-ayin vehitchazzaqtem uleqachtem mipperi haaretz vehayyamim yeme bikkure anabim
Uma ara haattira hi im miskena hait bah ilanin im la vetitqepun vetissebun meibba deara veyomayya yome bikkure innebin:
Vayyaalu vayyaturu et-haaretz mimmidbar-tzin ad-rechob lebo chamat
Useliqu veallilu yat ara mimmadbbra detzin ad rechob limte chamat:
Vayyaalu bannegeb vayyabo ad-chebron vesham achiman sheshay vetalmay yelide haanaq vechebron sheba shanim nibneta lipne tzoan mitzrayim
Useliqu bidroma vaata ad chebron vetamman achiman sheshay vetalmay bene gibbarayya vechebron sheba shenin itbeniat qodam tanas demitzrayim:
Vayyabou ad-nachal eshkol vayyikretu mishsham zemora veeshkol anabim echad vayyissauhu bammot bishnayim umin-harimmonim umin-hatteenim
Vaato ad nachala deatkala uqetzo mittamman obarta veatkal innebin chad unetalohi baaricha bitren umin rimmonayya umin teenayya:
Lammaqom hahu qara nachal eshkol al odot haeshkol asher-karetu mishsham bene yisrael
Leatra hahu qera nachla deatkala al esaq atkala diqtzo mittamman bene yisrael:
Vayyashubu mittur haaretz miqqetz arbaim yom
Vetabu milleallala yat ara missop arbein yomin:
Vayyeleku vayyabou el-mosheh veel-aharon veel-kol-adat bene-yisrael el-midbar paran qadesha vayyashibu otam dabar veet-kol-haeda vayyarum et-peri haaretz
Vaazalu vaato levat msheh ulevat aharon ulevat kol kenishta dibne yisrael lemadbera deparan lirqam vaatibu yatehon pitgama veyat kol kenishta veachaziunnun yat ibba deara:
Vayesapperu-lo vayyomeru banu el-haaretz asher shelachtanu vegam zabat chalab udebash hiv vezeh-piryah
Veishtaiu leh vaamaru atena leara di shelachtana veap abeda chalab udebash hi veden ibbah:
Epes ki-az haam hayyosheb baaretz vehearim betzurot gedolot meod vegam-yelide haanaq rainu sham
Lechod are taqqip amma deyateb beara veqirvayya kerikan rabreban lachada veap bene gibbarayya chazena tamman:
Amaleq yosheb beeretz hannegeb vehachitti vehayebusi vehaemori yosheb bahar vehakkenaani yosheb al-hayyam veal yad hayyarden
Amalqaa yateb baara daroma vechittaa vibusaa veemoraa yateb betura ukenaanaa yateb al yamma veal kep yardena:
Vayyahas kaleb et-haam el-mosheh vayyomer aloh naaleh veyarashnu otah ki-yakol nukal lah
Veatztzet kaleb yat amma lemsheh vaamar mesaq nesaq venirat yatah are mekal nekul lah:
Vehaanashim asher-alu immo ameru lo nukal laalot el-haam ki-chazaq hu mimmennu
Vegubrayya di seliqu immeh amaru la nekul lemesaq levat amma are taqqip hu minnana:
Vayyotziu dibbat haaretz asher taru otah el-bene yisrael lemor haaretz asher abarnu bah latur otah eretz okelet yoshebeha hiv vekol-haam asher-rainu betokah anshe middot
Veappiqu shum bish al ara di allilu yatah levat bene yisrael lememar ara di abarna bah leallala yatah ara meqattelat yatbaha hi vekol amma di chazena begavvah enashin demishchan:
Vesham rainu et-hannepilim bene anaq min-hannepilim vannehi beenenu kachagabim veken hayinu beenehem
Vetamman chazena yat gibbarayya bene anaq min gibbarayya vahavena beene napshana keqamtzin veken havena beenehon:
Vattissa kol-haeda vayyittenu et-qolam vayyibku haam ballayla hahu
Vaarimat kol kenishta vihabu yat qalehon ubeko amma beleleya hahu:
Vayyillonu al-mosheh veal-aharon kol bene yisrael vayyomeru alehem kol-haeda lu-matnu beeretz mitzrayim o bammidbar hazzeh lu-matenu
Veitraamu al msheh veal aharon kol bene yisrael vaamaru lehon kol kenishta levay demitena beara demitzrayim o bemadbera haden levay demitena:
Velama Adonai mebi otanu el-haaretz hazzot linpol bachereb nashenu vetappenu yihyu labaz halo tob lanu shub mitzrayema
Ulema Adonai mael yatana leara hada leminpal becharba neshana vetaplana yehon lebizza hala tab lana di netub lemitzrayim:
Vayyomeru ish el-achiv nittena rosh venashuba mitzrayema
Vaamaru gebar leachohi nemanne resha unetub lemitzrayim:
Vayyippol mosheh veaharon al-penehem lipne kol-qehal adat bene yisrael
Unepal msheh veaharon al appehon qodam kol qehal kenishta dibne yisrael:
Vihoshua bin-nvn vekaleb ben-yepunneh min-hattarim et-haaretz qareu bigdehem
Vihoshua bar nun vekaleb bar yepunneh min meallale yat ara bezau lebushehon:
Vayyomeru el-kol-adat bene-yisrael lemor haaretz asher abarnu bah latur otah toba haaretz meod meod
Vaamaru lekol kenishta dibne yisrael lememar ara di abarna bah leallala yatah taba ara lachada lachada:
Im-chapetz banu Adonai vehebi otanu el-haaretz hazzot unetanah lanu eretz asher-hiv zabat chalab udebash
Im raava bana qodam Adonai veyael yatana leara hada veyitteninah lana ara di hi abeda chalab udebash:
Ak ba-Adonai al-timrodu veattem al-tireu et-am haaretz ki lachmenu hem sar tzillam mealehem va-Adonai ittanu al-tiraum
Beram bememera daAdonai la timredun veattun la tidchalun min amma deara are bidana mesirin innun ada taqepehon minnehon umemera daAdonai besadana la tidchalun minnehon:
Vayyomeru kol-haeda lirgom otam baabanim ukebod Adonai nira beohel moed el-kol-bene yisrael
Vaamaru kol kenishta lemirgam yatehon beabnayya viqara daAdonai itgeli bemashkan zimna lekol bene yisrael:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh ad-ana yenaatzuni haam hazzeh vead-ana lo-yaaminu bi bekol haotot asher asiti beqirbo
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ad ematay yehon meraggezin qodamay amma haden vead ematay la yehemenun bememeri bekol atayya di abadit benehon:
Akkennu baddeber veorishennu veeeseh oteka legoy-gadol veatzum mimmennu
Emchinnun bemota vaashetzinnun veebed yatak leam rab vetaqqip minnehon:
Vayyomer mosheh el-Adonai veshameu mitzrayim ki-heelita bekochaka et-haam hazzeh miqqirbo
Vaamar msheh qodam Adonai veyishmeun mitzrae are asseqta bechelak yat amma haden mibbenehon:
Veameru el-yosheb haaretz hazzot shameu ki-atta Adonai beqereb haam hazzeh asher-ayin beayin nira atta Adonai vaananeka omed alehem ubeammud anan atta holek lipnehem yomam ubeammud esh layela

Veyemerun leyateb ara hada dishmau are at Adonai dishkintak sharyat bego amma haden di beenehon chazan shekinat yeqara daAdonai vaananak mattel illavehon ubeammuda daanana at medabbar qodamehon bimama ubeammuda deeshshata beleleya:
Vehematta et-haam hazzeh keish echad veameru haggoyim asher-shameu et-shimaka lemor
Uteqattal yat amma haden kegabra chad veyemerun ammayya di shemau yat shema geburtak lememar:
Mibbilti yekolet Adonai lehabi et-haam hazzeh el-haaretz asher-nishba lahem vayyishchatem bammidbar
Middelet yukela qodam Adonai leaala yat amma haden leara di qayyem lehon veqattelinun bemadbera:
Veatta yigdal-na koach adonay kaasher dibbarta lemor
Ukean saggi kean chela min qodam Adonai kema demalleleta lememar:
Adonai erek appayim verab-chesed nose avon vapasha venaqqeh lo yenaqqeh poqed avon abot al-banim al-shilleshim veal-ribbeim

Adonai marcheq regaz umasge lemebad tabvan uqeshot shabeq laavayan velimrod ulechobin sallach lidtaybin leorayteh udela taybin la mezakke masar chobe abahan al benin meradin al dar telitae veal dar rebiae:
Selach-na laavon haam hazzeh kegodel chasdeka vekaasher nasata laam hazzeh mimmitzrayim vead-henna
Sheboq kean lechobe amma haden kisgiut tabvatak ukema di shebaqta leamma haden mimmitzrayim vead kean:
Vayyomer Adonai salachti kidbareka
Vaamar Adonai shebaqit kepitgamak:
Veulam chay-ani veyimmale kebod-Adonai et-kol-haaretz
Uberam qayyam ana umalya yeqara daAdonai yat kol ara:
Ki kol-haanashim haroim et-kebodi veet-ototay asher-asiti bemitzrayim ubammidbar vayenassu oti zeh eser peamim velo shameu beqoli
Are kol gubrayya dachazo yat yeqari veyat atvatay di abadit bemitzrayim ubemadbera venassiu qodamay denan asar zimnin vela qabbilu bememeri:
Im-yiru et-haaretz asher nishbati laabotam vekol-menaatzay lo yiruha
Im yechezun yat ara di qayyemit laabahathon vekol deargizu qodamay la yechezunnah:
Veabdi kaleb eqeb hayeta ruach acheret immo vayemalle acharay vahabiotiv el-haaretz asher-ba shamma vezaro yorishenna
Veabdi kaleb chalap dahava ruach ochari immeh veashlem batar dachalti vealinneh leara di al letamman ubenohi yetarkinnah:
Vehaamaleqi vehakkenaani yosheb baemeq machar penu useu lakem hammidbar derek yam-svp
Vaamalqaa ukenaanaa yateb bemeshera mechar itpenu vetulu lekon lemadbera orach yamma desup:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh veim aharon lememar:
Ad-matay laeda haraa hazzot asher hemma mallinim alay et-telunnot bene yisrael asher hemma mallinim alay shamaeti
Ad ematay liknishta bisheta hada di innun mitraamin alay yat turamat bene yisrael di innun mitraamin alay shemia qodamay:
Emor alehem chay-ani neum-Adonai im-lo kaasher dibbartem beoznay ken eeseh lakem
Emar lehon qayyam ana amar Adonai im la kema di malleltun qodamay ken ebed lekon:
Bammidbar hazzeh yippelu pigrekem vekol-pequdekem lekol-misparkem mibben esrim shana vamaela asher halinotem alay
Bemadbera haden yippelun pigrekon vekol minyanekon lekol chushbankon mibbar asrin shenin uleella di itraamtun alay:
Im-attem tabou el-haaretz asher nasati et-yadi leshakken etkem bah ki im-kaleb ben-yepunneh vihoshua bin-nvn
Im attun tealun leara di qayyemit bememeri leashraa yatekon bah ellahen kaleb bar yepunneh vihoshua bar nun:
Vetappekem asher amartem labaz yihyeh vehebeti otam veyadeu et-haaretz asher meastem bah
Vetaplekon di amartun lebizza yehe veael yatehon veyiddeun yat ara di qatztun bah:
Upigrekem attem yippelu bammidbar hazzeh
Upigrekon di lekon yippelun bemadbera haden:
Ubenekem yihyu roim bammidbar arbaim shana venaseu et-zenutekem ad-tom pigrekem bammidbar
Ubenekon yehon meacharin bemadbera arbein shenin viqabbelun yat chobekon ad disupun pigrekon bemadbera:
Bemispar hayyamim asher-tartem et-haaretz arbaim yom yom lashshana yom lashshana tisu et-avonotekem arbaim shana vidatem et-tenuati
Beminyan yomayya di alleltun yat ara arbein yomin yoma leshatta yoma leshatta teqabbelun yat chobekon arbein shenin vetiddeun yat deitraamtun alay:
Ani Adonai dibbarti im-lo zot eeseh lekol-haeda haraa hazzot hannoadim alay bammidbar hazzeh yittammu vesham yamutu
Ana Adonai gezarit bememeri im la da ebed lekol kenishta bisheta hada deizdammenun alay bemadbera haden yesupun vetamman yemutun:
Vehaanashim asher-shalach mosheh latur et-haaretz vayyashubu vayyallinu alayv et-kol-haeda lehotzi dibba al-haaretz
Vegubrayya di shelach msheh leallala yat ara vetabu vearimu alohi yat kol kenishta leappaqa shum bish al ara:
Vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat-haaretz raa bammaggepa lipne Adonai
Umitu gubrayya deappiqu shum bish al ara bemotana qodam Adonai:
Vihoshua bin-nvn vekaleb ben-yepunneh chayu min-haanashim hahem haholekim latur et-haaretz
Vihoshua bar nun vekaleb bar yepunneh itqayyemu min gubrayya hainnun daazalu leallala yat ara:
Vayedabber mosheh et-haddebarim haelleh el-kol-bene yisrael vayyiteabbelu haam meod
Umallil msheh yat pitgamayya haillen lekol bene yisrael veitabbalu amma lachada:
Vayyashkimu babboqer vayyaalu el-rosh-hahar lemor hinnennu vealinu el-hammaqom asher-amar Adonai ki chatanu
Veaqdimu betzapra useliqu leresh tura lememar ha anachna saleqin leatra di amar Adonai are chabna:
Vayyomer mosheh lamma zeh attem oberim et-pi Adonai vehiv lo titzlach
Vaamar msheh lema denan attun aberin al gezerat memera daAdonai vehi la tatzlach:
Al-taalu ki en Adonai beqirbekem velo tinnagepu lipne oyebekem
La tissequn are let shekinta daAdonai benekon vela tittabberun qodam baale debabekon:
Ki haamaleqi vehakkenaani sham lipnekem unepaltem bechareb ki-al-ken shabtem meachare Adonai velo-yihyeh Adonai immakem
Are amalqaa ukenaanaa tamman qodamekon vetippelun becharba are al ken tabtun mibbatar palechana daAdonai vela yehe memera daAdonai besadekon:
Vayyapilu laalot el-rosh hahar vaaron berit-Adonai umosheh lo-mashu miqqereb hammachaneh
Vearshau lemissaq leresh tura vaaron qeyama daAdonai umsheh la ado miggo mashrita:
Vayyered haamaleqi vehakkenaani hayyosheb bahar hahu vayyakkum vayyakketum ad-hachorma
Unechat amalqaa ukenaanaa deyateb betura hahu umechunnun uteradunnun ad charema:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki tabou el-eretz moshebotekem asher ani noten lakem
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are tealun laara motebanekon di ana yaheb lekon:
Vaasitem ishsheh la-Adonai ola o-zebach lepalle-neder o bindaba o bemoadekem laasot reach nichoach la-Adonai min-habbaqar o min-hatztzon
Vetabedun qurbana qodam Adonai alata o niksat qudeshayya leaprasha nidra o bindabta o bemoadekon lemebad leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai min tore o min ana:
Vehiqrib hammaqrib qorbano la-Adonai mincha solet issaron balul birbiit hahin shamen
Viqareb dimqareb qurbaneh qodam Adonai minchata sulta asrona depila berabut hina mishcha:
Veyayin lannesek rebiit hahin taaseh al-haola o lazzabach lakkebes haechad
Vechamra leniska rabut hina tabed al alata o leniksat qudeshayya leimmera chad:
O laayil taaseh mincha solet shene esronim belula bashshemen shelishit hahin
O ledikra tabed minchata sulta teren asronin depila bimshach taltut hina:
Veyayin lannesek shelishit hahin taqrib reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Vechamra leniska taltut hina teqareb leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai:
Veki-taaseh ben-baqar ola o-zabach lepalle-neder o-shelamim la-Adonai
Vaare tabed bar tore alata o niksat qudeshayya leparasha nidra o niksat qudeshayya qodam Adonai:
Vehiqrib al-ben-habbaqar mincha solet shelosha esronim balul bashshemen chatzi hahin
Viqareb al bar tore minchata sulta telata asronin depila bimshach palgut hina:
Veyayin taqrib lannesek chatzi hahin ishsheh reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Vechamra teqareb leniska palgut hina qurban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai:
Kaka yeaseh lashshor haechad o laayil haechad o-lasseh bakkebasim o baizzim
Keden yitabed letora chad o ledikra chad o leimmar beimmerayya o beizzayya:
Kammispar asher taasu kaka taasu laechad kemisparam
Keminyan di tabedun keden tabedun lechad keminyanhon:
Kol-haezrach yaaseh-kaka et-elleh lehaqrib ishsheh reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Kol yatztziba yabed keden yat illen leqaraba qurban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai:
Veki-yagur ittekem ger o asher-betokekem ledorotekem veasa ishsheh reach-nichoach la-Adonai kaasher taasu ken yaaseh
Vaare yitgayyar immekon giyyora o di benekon ledarekon veyabed qurban demitqabbel baraava qodam Adonai kema di tabedun ken yabed:
Haqqahal chuqqa achat lakem velagger haggar chuqqat olam ledorotekem kakem kagger yihyeh lipne Adonai
Qehala qeyama chad lekon ulegiyyora deyitgayyar qeyam alam ledarekon kevatekon kegiyyora yehe qodam Adonai:
Tora achat umishpat echad yihyeh lakem velagger haggar ittekem
Orayta chada vedina chad yehe lekon ulegiyyora deyitgayyar immekon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem beboakem el-haaretz asher ani mebi etkem shamma
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon bemealkon leara di ana mael yatekon letamman:
Vehaya baakolkem millechem haaretz tarimu teruma la-Adonai
Vihe bemekalkon millachma deara tapreshun aprashuta qodam Adonai:
Reshit arisotekem challa tarimu teruma kitrumat goren ken tarimu otah
Resh atzvatkon challeta tapreshun aprashuta kema di mapreshin min idra ken tapreshun yatah:
Mereshit arisotekem tittenu la-Adonai teruma ledorotekem
Meresh atzvatkon tittenun qodam Adonai aprashuta ledarekon:
Veki tishgu velo taasu et kol-hammitzvot haelleh asher-dibber Adonai el-mosheh
Vaare tishtelun vela tabedun yat kol piqqodayya haillen di mallil Adonai im msheh:
Et kol-asher tzivva Adonai alekem beyad-mosheh min-hayyom asher tzivva Adonai vahalea ledorotekem
Yat kol di paqqid Adonai yatekon bida demsheh min yoma di paqqid Adonai ulehalla ledarekon:
Vehaya im meene haeda neesta lishgaga veasu kol-haeda par ben-baqar echad leola lereach nichoach la-Adonai uminchato venisko kammishpat useir-izzim echad lechattat
Vihe im meene kenishta itabedat leshalu veyabedun kol kenishta tor bar tore chad laalata leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai uminchateh veniskeh kidchaze utzepir bar izze chad lechattata:
Vekipper hakkohen al-kol-adat bene yisrael venislach lahem ki-shegaga hiv vehem hebiu et-qorbanam ishsheh la-Adonai vechattatam lipne Adonai al-shiggatam
Vikappar kahana al kol kenishta dibne yisrael veyishtebeq lehon are shaluta hi veinnun aytiu yat qurbanhon qurbana qodam Adonai vechobathon qodam Adonai al shalutehon:
Venislach lekol-adat bene yisrael velagger haggar betokam ki lekol-haam bishgaga
Veyishtebeq lekol kenishta dibne yisrael ulegiyyora deyitgayyar benehon are lekol amma beshaluta:
Veim-nepesh achat techeta bishgaga vehiqriba ez bat-shenatah lechattat
Veim enash chad yechob beshalu viqareb izza bat shattah lechattata:
Vekipper hakkohen al-hannepesh hashshogeget becheta bishgaga lipne Adonai lekapper alayv venislach lo
Vikappar kahana al enash deishteli bemechabeh beshalu qodam Adonai lekappara alohi veyishtebeq leh:
Haezrach bibne yisrael velagger haggar betokam tora achat yihyeh lakem laoseh bishgaga
Yatztziba bibne yisrael ulegiyyora deyitgayyar benehon orayta chada yehe lekon lidyabed beshalu
Vehannepesh asher-taaseh beyad rama min-haezrach umin-hagger et-Adonai hu megaddep venikreta hannepesh hahiv miqqereb ammah
Veenash deyabed beresh geli min yatztzibayya umin giyyorayya qodam Adonai hu margez veyishtetze anasha hahi miggo ammeh:
Ki debar-Adonai baza veet-mitzvato hepar hikkaret tikkaret hannepesh hahiv avona bah
Are al memera daAdonai besar veyat piqqodohi ashne ishtetzaa tishtetze anasha hahi chobah bah:
Vayyihyu bene-yisrael bammidbar vayyimtzeu ish meqoshesh etzim beyom hashshabbat
Vahavo bene yisrael bemadbera veashkachu gabra kad megabbab ain beyoma deshabbeta:
Vayyaqribu oto hammotzeim oto meqoshesh etzim el-mosheh veel-aharon veel kol-haeda
Veqaribu yateh deashkachu yateh kad megabbab ain levat msheh ulevat aharon ulevat kol kenishta:
Vayyannichu oto bammishmar ki lo porash mah-yeaseh lo
Veasseru yateh bebet mattera are la itperash lehon ma deyabedun leh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh mot yumat haish ragom oto baabanim kol-haeda michutz lammachaneh
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh itqetala yitqetel gabra mirgam yateh beabnayya kol kenishta mibbara lemashrita:
Vayyotziu oto kol-haeda el-michutz lammachaneh vayyirgemu oto baabanim vayyamot kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veappiqu yateh kol kenishta lemibbara lemashrita uregamu yateh beabnayya umit kema di paqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem veasu lahem tzitzit al-kanpe bigdehem ledorotam venatenu al-tzitzit hakkanap petil tekelet
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon veyabedun lehon kerusepedin al kanpe kesutehon ledarehon veyittenun al kerusepeda dekanpa chuta ditkelta:
Vehaya lakem letzitzit ureitem oto uzekartem et-kol-mitzvot Adonai vaasitem otam velo-taturu achare lebabkem veachare enekem asher-attem zonim acharehem
Vihon lekon likrusepedin vetechezun yateh vetidkerun yat kol piqqudayya daAdonai vetabedun yatehon vela titteun batar hirhur libbekon ubatar chezu enekon di attun taan batrehon:
Lemaan tizkeru vaasitem et-kol-mitzvotay vihyitem qedoshim lelohekem
Bedil detidkerun vetabedun yat kol piqqoday utehon qaddishin qodam elahakon:
Ani Adonai elohekem asher hotzeti etkem meeretz mitzrayim lihyot lakem lelohim ani Adonai elohekem
Ana Adonai elahakon di appeqit yatekon meara demitzrayim lemehave lekon leelaha ana Adonai elahakon:
Vayyiqqach qorach ben-yitzhar ben-qehat ben-levi vedatan vaabiram bene eliab veon ben-pelet bene reuben
Veitpeleg qorach bar yitzhar bar qehat bar levi vedatan vaabiram bene eliab veon bar pelet bene reuben:
Vayyaqumu lipne mosheh vaanashim mibbene-yisrael chamishshim umatayim nesie eda qerie moed anshe-shem
Veqamu leappe msheh vegubrayya mibbene yisrael matan vechamshin rabrebe kenishta meare zeman enashin dishma:
Vayyiqqahalu al-mosheh veal-aharon vayyomeru alehem rab-lakem ki kol-haeda kullam qedoshim ubetokam Adonai umaddua titenasseu al-qehal Adonai
Veitkenashu al msheh veal aharon vaamaru lehon saggi lekon are kol kenishta kullehon qaddishin ubenehon sharya shekinta daAdonai uma den attun mitrabrebin al qehala daAdonai:
Vayyishma mosheh vayyippol al-panayv
Ushema msheh unepal al appohi:
Vayedabber el-qorach veel-kol-adato lemor boqer veyoda Adonai et-asher-lo veet-haqqadosh vehiqrib elayv veet asher yibchar-bo yaqrib elayv
Umallil im qorach veim kol kenishteh lememar betzapra vihoda Adonai yat dekashar leh veyat deqaddish viqareb loqodamohi veyat di yitree beh yeqareb leshimmusheh:
Zot asu qechu-lakem machtot qorach vekol-adato
Da ibidu sabu lekon machteyan qorach vekol kenishteh:
Utenu bahen esh vesimu alehen qetoret lipne Adonai machar vehaya haish asher-yibchar Adonai hu haqqadosh rab-lakem bene levi
Vehabu behon eshshata veshavviyu alehon qetoret busemin qodam Adonai mechar vihe gabra deyitree Adonai hu qaddish saggi lekon bene levi:
Vayyomer mosheh el-qorach shimu-na bene levi
Vaamar msheh leqorach shemau kean bene levi:
Hameat mikkem ki-hibdil elohe yisrael etkem meadat yisrael lehaqrib etkem elayv laabod et-abodat mishkan Adonai velaamod lipne haeda lesharetam
Hazzeer lekon are apresh elaha deyisrael yatekon mikkenishta deyisrael leqaraba yatekon qodamohi lemiplach yat palechan mashkena daAdonai ulemeqam qodam kenishta leshammashutehon:
Vayyaqreb oteka veet-kol-acheka bene-levi ittak ubiqqashtem gam-kehunna
Veqareb yatak veyat kol achayk bene levi immak ukean attun baan ap kehunnata rabbeta:
Laken atta vekol-adateka hannoadim al-Adonai veaharon mah-hv ki tallinu alayv
Beken at vekol kenishtak deizdammintun al Adonai veaharon ma hu are itraamtun alohi:
Vayyishlach mosheh liqro ledatan velaabiram bene eliab vayyomeru lo naaleh
Ushelach msheh lemiqre ledatan velaabiram bene eliab vaamaru la nissaq:
Hameat ki heelitanu meeretz zabat chalab udebash lahamitenu bammidbar ki-tistarer alenu gam-histarer
Hazzeer are asseqtana meara abeda chalab udebash leqattalutana bemadbera are itrabrabt alana ap itrabraba:
Ap lo el-eretz zabat chalab udebash habiotanu vattitten-lanu nachalat sadeh vakarem haene haanashim hahem tenaqqer lo naaleh
Beram la leara abeda chalab udebash aaltana vihabta lana achasanat chaqlin vekarmin haene gubrayya hainnun teshallach leavvara la nissaq:
Vayyichar lemosheh meod vayyomer el-Adonai al-tepen el-minchatam lo chamor echad mehem nasati velo hareoti et-achad mehem
Uteqep lemsheh lachada vaamar qodam Adonai la teqabbel beraava qurbanhon la chamara dechad minnehon shecharit vela abeshit yat chad minnehon:
Vayyomer mosheh el-qorach atta vekol-adateka heyu lipne Adonai atta vahem veaharon machar
Vaamar msheh leqorach at vekol kenishtak hevo zeminin loqodam Adonai at veinnun veaharon mechar:
Uqechu ish machtato unetattem alehem qetoret vehiqrabtem lipne Adonai ish machtato chamishshim umatayim machtot veatta veaharon ish machtato
Usebu gebar machtiteh uteshavvun alehon qetoret busemin uteqarebun qodam Adonai gebar machtiteh matan vechamshin machteyan veat veaharon gebar machtiteh:
Vayyiqchu ish machtato vayyittenu alehem esh vayyasimu alehem qetoret vayyaamdu petach ohel moed umosheh veaharon
Unesibu gebar machtiteh vihabu alehon eshshata veshavviu alehon qetoret busemin veqamu bitra mashkan zimna umsheh veaharon:
Vayyaqhel alehem qorach et-kol-haeda el-petach ohel moed vayyera kebod-Adonai el-kol-haeda
Veaknash alehon qorach yat kol kenishta litra mashkan zimna veitgele yeqara daAdonai lekol kenishta:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh veim aharon lememar:
Hibbadelu mittok haeda hazzot vaakalleh otam keraga
Itteperashu miggo kenishta hada veeshetze yatehon keshaa:
Vayyippelu al-penehem vayyomeru el elohe haruchot lekol-basar haish echad yecheta veal kol-haeda tiqtzop
Unepalu al appehon vaamaru el elaha ruchayya lekol bisra gabra chad yechob veal kol kenishta yehe rugeza:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallel Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-haeda lemor healu missabib lemishkan-qorach datan vaabiram
Mallel im kenishta lememar istallaqu missechor sechor lemashkena deqorach datan vaabiram:
Vayyaqom mosheh vayyelek el-datan vaabiram vayyeleku acharayv ziqne yisrael
Veqam msheh vaazal levat datan vaabiram vaazalu batrohi sabe yisrael:
Vayedabber el-haeda lemor suru na meal ohole haanashim hareshaim haelleh veal-tiggeu bekol-asher lahem pen-tissapu bekol-chattotam
Umallil im kenishta lememar zuru kean meillave mashkene gubrayya chayyabayya haillen vela tiqrebun bekol di lehon dilma tilqun bekol chobehon:
Vayyealu meal mishkan-qorach datan vaabiram missabib vedatan vaabiram yatzeu nitztzabim petach oholehem uneshehem ubenehem vetappam
Veistallaqu meillave mashkena deqorach datan vaabiram missechor sechor vedatan vaabiram nepaqu qayyemin bitra mashkenehon uneshehon ubenehon vetaplehon:
Vayyomer mosheh bezot tedeun ki-Adonai shelachani laasot et kol-hammaasim haelleh ki-lo millibbi
Vaamar msheh beda tiddeun are Adonai shallechanni lemebad yat kol obadayya haillen are la mereuti:
Im-kemot kol-haadam yemutun elleh upequddat kol-haadam yippaqed alehem lo Adonai shelachani
Im kemota dekal enasha yemutun illen useara dekal enasha yistear alehon la Adonai shallechanni:
Veim-beria yibra Adonai upatzeta haadama et-piha ubalea otam veet-kol-asher lahem veyaredu chayyim sheola vidatem ki niatzu haanashim haelleh et-Adonai
Veim beria yibre Adonai upetachat ara yat pumah ubelaat yatehon veyat kol di lehon veyechetun kad chayyin lishol vetiddeun are argizu gubrayya haillen qodam Adonai:
Vayehi kekalloto ledabber et kol-haddebarim haelleh vattibbaqa haadama asher tachtehem
Vahava kad shetze lemallala yat kol pitgamayya haillen veitbezaat ara di techotehon:
Vattiptach haaretz et-piha vattibla otam veet-battehem veet kol-haadam asher leqorach veet kol-harekush
Upetachat ara yat pumah ubelaat yatehon veyat enash battehon veyat kol enasha di leqorach veyat kol qinyana:
Vayyeredu hem vekol-asher lahem chayyim sheola vattekas alehem haaretz vayyobedu mittok haqqahal
Unechatu innun vekol di lehon kad chayyin lishol vachapat alehon ara vaabadu miggo qehala:
Vekol-yisrael asher sebibotehem nasu leqolam ki ameru pen-tiblaenu haaretz
Vekol yisrael di besacharanehon araqu leqalehon are amaru dilma tibleinnana ara:
Veesh yatzea meet Adonai vattokal et hachamishshim umatayim ish maqribe haqqetoret
Veeshshata nepaqat min qodam Adonai vaakalat yat matan vechamshin gabra meqarebe qetoret busemayya:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Emor el-elazar ben-aharon hakkohen veyarem et-hammachtot mibben hasserepa veet-haesh zereh-halea ki qadeshu
Amar leelazar bar aharon kahana veyapresh yat machteyata mibben yeqidayya veyat eshshata yarcheq lehala are itqaddashu:
Et machtot hachattaim haelleh benapshotam veasu otam riqque pachim tzippuy lammizbeach ki-hiqribum lipne-Adonai vayyiqdashu veyiheyu leot libne yisrael
Yat machteyat chayyabayya haillen deitchayyabu benapshatehon veyabedun yatehen tassin raddidin chopaa lemadbecha are qarebunnun qodam Adonai veitqaddashu vihevyan leat libne yisrael:
Vayyiqqach elazar hakkohen et machtot hannechoshet asher hiqribu hasserupim vayeraqqeum tzippuy lammizbeach
Unesib elazar kahana yat machteyata dinchasha deqaribu yoqidayya veraddidunnun chopaa lemadbecha:
Zikkaron libne yisrael lemaan asher lo-yiqrab ish zar asher lo mizzera aharon hu lehaqtir qetoret lipne Adonai velo-yihyeh keqorach vekaadato kaasher dibber Adonai beyad-mosheh lo
Dakerana libne yisrael bedil di la yiqrab gebar chillonay di la mizzara deaharon hu leassaqa qetoret busemin qodam Adonai vela yehe keqorach vekiknishteh kema di mallil Adonai bida demsheh leh:
Vayyillonu kol-adat bene-yisrael mimmochorat al-mosheh veal-aharon lemor attem hamittem et-am Adonai
Veitraamu kol kenishta dibne yisrael miyyoma debatrohi al msheh veal aharon lememar attun geramtun demit amma daAdonai:
Vayehi behiqqahel haeda al-mosheh veal-aharon vayyipnu el-ohel moed vehinneh kissahu heanan vayyera kebod Adonai
Vahava beitkannashut kenishta al msheh veal aharon veitpeniu lemashkan zimna veha chapahi anana veitgeli yeqara daAdonai:
Vayyabo mosheh veaharon el-pene ohel moed
Veal msheh veaharon loqodam mashkan zimna:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Herommu mittok haeda hazzot vaakalleh otam keraga vayyippelu al-penehem
Itperashu miggo kenishta hada veeshetze yatehon keshaa unepalu al appehon:
Vayyomer mosheh el-aharon qach et-hammachta veten-aleha esh meal hammizbeach vesim qetoret veholek mehera el-haeda vekapper alehem ki-yatza haqqetzep millipne Adonai hechel hannagep
Vaamar msheh leaharon sab yat machtita vehab alah eshshata meillave madbecha veshav qetoret busemayya veobil bipria liknishta vekapper alehon are nepaq rogza min qodam Adonai share motana:
Vayyiqqach aharon kaasher dibber mosheh vayyarotz el-tok haqqahal vehinneh hechel hannegep baam vayyitten et-haqqetoret vayekapper al-haam
Unesib aharon kema di mallil msheh urehat lego qehala veha share motana beamma vihab yat qetoret busemayya vekappar al amma:
Vayyaamod ben-hammetim uben hachayyim vatteatzar hammaggepa
Veqam ben metayya uben chayyayya veitkeli motana:
Vayyihyu hammetim bammaggepa arbaa asar elep usheba meot millebad hammetim al-debar-qorach
Vahavo demitu bemotana arbeat ashar alpin usheba mea bar middemitu al pelugta deqorach:
Vayyashob aharon el-mosheh el-petach ohel moed vehammaggepa neetzara
Vetab aharon lemsheh litra mashkan zimna umotana itkeli:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veqach meittam matteh matteh lebet ab meet kol-nesiehem lebet abotam shenem asar mattot ish et-shemo tiktob al-mattehu
Mallel im bene yisrael vesab minnehon chutra chutra lebet abba min kol rabrebanehon lebet abahathon tere asar chutrin gebar yat shemeh tiktob al chutreh:
Veet shem aharon tiktob al-matteh levi ki matteh echad lerosh bet abotam
Veyat shema deaharon tiktob al chutra delevi are chutra chad leresh bet abahathon:
Vehinnachtam beohel moed lipne haedut asher ivvaed lakem shamma
Vetatzneinnun bemashkan zimna qodam sahaduta di azammen memeri lekon tamman:
Vehaya haish asher ebchar-bo mattehu yiprach vahashikkoti mealay et-telunnot bene yisrael asher hem mallinim alekem
Vihe gabra deitree beh chutreh yine vaaniach min qodamay yat tureamat bene yisrael di innun mitraamin alekon:
Vayedabber mosheh el-bene yisrael vayyittenu elayv kol-nesiehem matteh lenasi echad matteh lenasi echad lebet abotam shenem asar mattot umatteh aharon betok mattotam
Umallil msheh im bene yisrael vihabu leh kol rabrebanehon chutra lerabba chad chutra lerabba chad lebet abahathon tere asar chutrin vechutra deaharon bego chutrehon:
Vayyannach mosheh et-hammattot lipne Adonai beohel haedut
Veatzna msheh yat chutrayya qodam Adonai bemashkena desahaduta:
Vayehi mimmochorat vayyabo mosheh el-ohel haedut vehinneh parach matteh-aharon lebet levi vayyotze perach vayyatzetz tzitz vayyigmol sheqedim
Vahava beyoma debatrohi veal msheh lemashkena desahaduta veha nea chutra deaharon lebet levi veappeq lablebin veanetz netz vekapet shigdin
Vayyotze mosheh et-kol-hammattot millipne Adonai el-kol-bene yisrael vayyiru vayyiqchu ish mattehu
Veappeq msheh yat kol chutrayya min qodam Adonai levat kol bene yisrael veishtemodau unesibu gebar chutreh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh hasheb et-matteh aharon lipne haedut lemishmeret leot libne-meri utekal telunnotam mealay velo yamutu
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ateb yat chutra deaharon loqodam sahaduta lemattera leat leamma sarbana visupan tureamathon min qodamay vela yemutun:
Vayyaas mosheh kaasher tzivva Adonai oto ken asa
Vaabad msheh kema di paqqid Adonai yateh ken abad:
Vayyomeru bene yisrael el-mosheh lemor hen gavanu abadnu kullanu abadenu
Vaamaru bene yisrael lemsheh lememar ha minnana qetalat charba ha minnana belaat ara veha minnana demitu bemotana:
Kol haqqareb haqqareb el-mishkan Adonai yamut haim tamnu ligvoa
Kol deqareb miqrab lemashkena daAdonai mait ha anachna saypin limmat:
Vayyomer Adonai el-aharon atta ubaneka ubet-abika ittak tisu et-avon hammiqdash veatta ubaneka ittak tisu et-avon kehunnatkem
Vaamar Adonai leaharon at ubenayk ubet abuk immak tesallechun al chobe maqdesha veat ubenayk immak tesallechun al chobe kehunnatkon:
Vegam et-acheka matteh levi shebet abika haqreb ittak veyillavu aleka visharetuka veatta ubaneka ittak lipne ohel haedut
Veap yat achayk shibta delevi shibta deabuk qareb levatak veyittosepun alak vishammeshunnak veat ubenayk immak qodam mashkena desahaduta:
Veshameru mishemarteka umishmeret kol-haohel ak el-kele haqqodesh veel-hammizbeach lo yiqrabu velo-yamutu gam-hem gam-attem
Veyitterun mattartak umatterat kol mashkena beram lemane qudesha ulemadbecha la yiqrebun vela yemutun ap innun ap attun:
Venilvu aleka veshameru et-mishmeret ohel moed lekol abodat haohel vezar lo-yiqrab alekem
Veyittosepun alak veyitterun yat matterat mashkan zimna lekol palechan mashkena vechillonay la yiqrab levatekon:
Ushemartem et mishmeret haqqodesh veet mishmeret hammizbeach velo-yihyeh od qetzep al-bene yisrael
Vetitterun yat matterat qudesha veyat matterat madbecha vela yehe od rogza al bene yisrael:
Vaani hinneh laqachti et-achekem haleviyyim mittok bene yisrael lakem mattana netunim la-Adonai laabod et-abodat ohel moed
Vaana ha qarebit yat achekon levae miggo bene yisrael lekon mattena yehibin qodam Adonai lemiplach yat palechan mashkan zimna:
Veatta ubaneka itteka tishmeru et-kehunnatkem lekol-debar hammizbeach ulemibbet lapparoket vaabadtem abodat mattana etten et-kehunnatkem vehazzar haqqareb yumat
Veat ubenayk immak titterun yat kehunnatkon lekol pitgam madbecha ulemiggav leparuketa vetiplechun palechan mattena ehab yat kehunnatkon vechillonay deyiqrab yitqetal:
Vayedabber Adonai el-aharon vaani hinneh natatti leka et-mishmeret terumotay lekol-qodshe bene-yisrael leka netattim lemoshcha ulebaneka lechoq-olam
Umallil Adonai im aharon vaana ha yehabit lak yat matterat aprashutay lekol qudeshayya dibne yisrael lak yehabtinnun lirbu velibnayk liqyam olam:
Zeh-yihyeh leka miqqodesh haqqodashim min-haesh kol-qorbanam lekol-minchatam ulekol-chattatam ulekol-ashamam asher yashibu li qodesh qodashim leka hu ulebaneka
Den yehe lak miqqodesh qudeshayya motar min eshshata kol qurebanehon lekol minchathon ulekal chatvathon ulekal ashamhon di yetibun qodamay qodesh qudeshin di lak hu velibnayk:
Beqodesh haqqodashim tokelennu kol-zakar yokal oto qodesh yiheyeh-lak
Beqodesh qudeshin tekelunneh kol dekura yekul yateh qudesha yehe lak:
Vezeh-leka terumat mattanam lekol-tenupot bene yisrael leka netattim ulebaneka velibnoteka itteka lechoq-olam kol-tahor bebeteka yokal oto
Veden lak aprashut mattenathon lekol aramut bene yisrael lak yehabtinnun velibnayk velibnatayk immak liqyam olam kol didke bebetak yekul yateh:
Kol cheleb yitzhar vekol-cheleb tirosh vedagan reshitam asher-yittenu la-Adonai leka netattim
Kol tub meshach vekol tub chamar veibbur reshitehon di yittenun qodam Adonai lak yehabtinnun:
Bikkure kol-asher beartzam asher-yabiu la-Adonai leka yihyeh kol-tahor bebeteka yokelennu
Bikkure kol di bearahon di yaytun qodam Adonai di lak yehe kol didke bebetak yekelunneh:
Kol-cherem beyisrael leka yihyeh
Kol cherma beyisrael di lak yehe:
Kol-peter rechem lekol-basar asher-yaqribu la-Adonai baadam ubabbehema yiheyeh-lak ak padoh tipdeh et bekor haadam veet bekor-habbehema hattemea tipdeh
Kol patach valeda lekol bisra di yeqarebun qodam Adonai beenasha ubibira yehe lak beram mipraq tipruq yat bukera deenasha veyat bukera dibira mesaaba tiproq:
Upeduyav mibben-chodesh tipdeh beerkeka kesep chameshet sheqalim besheqel haqqodesh esrim gera hu
Upureqaneh mibbar yarcha tiproq bepursaneh kesap chamesh silin besile qudesha asrin main hu:
Ak bekor-shor o-bekor keseb o-bekor ez lo tipdeh qodesh hem et-damam tizroq al-hammizbeach veet-chelbam taqtir ishsheh lereach nichoach la-Adonai
Beram bukera detora o bukera deimra o bukera deizza la tipruq qudesha innun yat dimhon tizruq al madbecha veyat tarbehon tasseq qureban leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai:
Ubesaram yihyeh-lak kachazeh hattenupa ukeshoq hayyamin leka yihyeh
Ubisrehon yehe lak kechadya daaramuta ukeshoqa deyammina lak yehe:
Kol terumot haqqodashim asher yarimu bene-yisrael la-Adonai natatti leka ulebaneka velibnoteka itteka lechoq-olam berit melach olam hiv lipne Adonai leka ulezaraka ittak
Kol aprashut qudeshayya di yipreshun bene yisrael qodam Adonai yehabit lak velibnayk velibnatayk immak liqyam olam qeyam melach olam hu qodam Adonai lak velibnayk immak:
Vayyomer Adonai el-aharon beartzam lo tinchal vecheleq lo-yihyeh leka betokam ani chelqeka venachalateka betok bene yisrael
Vaamar Adonai leaharon bearahon la tachasin vocholaq la yehe lak benehon mattenan di yehabit lak innun chuleqak veachasantak bego bene yisrael:
Velibne levi hinneh natatti kol-maaser beyisrael lenachala chelep abodatam asher-hem obedim et-abodat ohel moed
Velibne levi ha yehabit kol maasra beyisrael leachasana chalap pulechanhon di innun palechin yat pulechan mashkan zimna:
Velo-yiqrebu od bene yisrael el-ohel moed laset chet lamut
Vela yiqrebun od bene yisrael lemashkan zimna leqabbala choba limmat:
Veabad hallevi hu et-abodat ohel moed vehem yisu avonam chuqqat olam ledorotekem ubetok bene yisrael lo yinchalu nachala
Veyiplechun levae innun yat pulechan mashkan zimna veinnun yeqabbelun chobehon qeyam olam ledarekon ubego bene yisrael la yachsenun achasana:
Ki et-masar bene-yisrael asher yarimu la-Adonai teruma natatti lalviyyim lenachala al-ken amarti lahem betok bene yisrael lo yinchalu nachala
Are yat maasra dibne yisrael di yapreshun qodam Adonai aprashuta yehabit lelevae leachasana al ken amarit lehon bego bene yisrael la yachsenun achasana:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Veel-haleviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem ki-tiqchu meet bene-yisrael et-hammaaser asher natatti lakem meittam benachalatkem vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min-hammaaser
Ulelevae temallel vetemar lehon are tissebun min bene yisrael yat maasra di yehabit lekon minnehon beachasantekon vetapreshun minneh aprashuta qodam Adonai maasra min maasra:
Venechshab lakem terumatkem kaddagan min-haggoren vekamelea min-hayyaqeb
Vetitchashshab lekon aprashutekon keibbura min idra vekammeleata min matzarta:
Ken tarimu gam-attem terumat Adonai mikkol maserotekem asher tiqchu meet bene yisrael unetattem mimmennu et-terumat Adonai leaharon hakkohen
Ken tapreshun ap attun aprashuta qodam Adonai mikkol maasratekon di tissebun min bene yisrael vetittenun minneh yat aprashuta qodam Adonai leaharon kahana:
Mikkol mattenotekem tarimu et kol-terumat Adonai mikkol-chelbo et-miqdesho mimmennu
Mikkol mattenatkon tapreshun yat kol aprashuta daAdonai mikkol shupereh yat maqdesheh minneh:
Veamarta alehem baharimekem et-chelbo mimmennu venechshab lalviyyim kitbuat goren vekitbuat yaqeb
Vetemar lehon beaprashutekon yat shupereh minneh veyitchashshab lelevae kaalalat idra vekaalalat matzarta:
Vaakaltem oto bekol-maqom attem ubetekem ki-sakar hu lakem chelep abodatkem beohel moed
Vetekelun yateh bekol atar attun veenash battekon are agra hu lekon chalap palechankon bemashkan zimna:
Velo-tisu alayv chet baharimekem et-chelbo mimmennu veet-qodshe bene-yisrael lo techallelu velo tamutu
Vela teqabbelun alohi choba beaprashutekon yat shupereh minneh veyat qudeshayya dibne yisrael la tachalun vela temutun:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh veim aharon lememar:
Zot chuqqat hattora asher-tzivva Adonai lemor dabber el-bene yisrael veyiqchu eleka para adumma temima asher en-bah mum asher lo-ala aleha ol
Da gezerat orayta di paqqid Adonai lememar mallel im bene yisrael veyissebun lak toreta simmuqeta shelemta di let bah muma di la seliq alah nira:
Unetattem otah el-elazar hakkohen vehotzi otah el-michutz lammachaneh veshachat otah lepanayv
Vetittenun yatah leelazar kahana veyappeq yatah lemibbara lemashrita veyikkos yatah qodamohi:
Velaqach elazar hakkohen middamah beetzbao vehizza el-nokach pene ohel-moed middamah sheba peamim
Veyissab elazar kahana middemah beetzbeeh veyaddi loqobel appe mashkan zimna middemah sheba zimnin:
Vesarap et-happara leenayv et-orah veet-besarah veet-damah al-pirshah yisrop
Veyoqed yat toreta leenohi yat mashkah veyat bisrah veyat demah al oklah yoqed:
Velaqach hakkohen etz erez veezob usheni tolaat vehishlik el-tok serepat happara
Veyissab kahana aa dearza veezoba utzeba zehori veyirme lego yeqidat toreta:
Vekibbes begadayv hakkohen verachatz besaro bammayim veachar yabo el-hammachaneh vetame hakkohen ad-haareb
Vitzabba lebushohi kahana veyasche bisreh bemayya ubatar ken yeul lemashrita vihe mesaab kahana ad ramsha:
Vehassorep otah yekabbes begadayv bammayim verachatz besaro bammayim vetame ad-haareb
Udemoqed yatah yetzabba leboshohi bemayya veyasche bisreh bemayya vihe mesaab ad ramsha:
Veasap ish tahor et eper happara vehinniach michutz lammachaneh bemaqom tahor vehayeta laadat bene-yisrael lemishmeret leme nidda chattat hiv
Veyiknosh gebar deke yat qitma detoreta veyatzna lemibbara lemashrita baatar deke utehe liknishta dibne yisrael lemattara leme addayuta chattata hi:
Vekibbes haosep et-eper happara et-begadayv vetame ad-haareb vehayeta libne yisrael velagger haggar betokam lechuqqat olam
Vitzabba dekannesh yat qitma detoreta yat lebushohi vihe mesaab ad ramsha utehe libne yisrael ulegiyyorayya deyitgayyerun benehon liqyam olam:
Hannogea bemet lekol-nepesh adam vetame shibat yamim
Deyiqrab bemeta lekol napsha deenasha vihe mesaab shaba yomin:
Hu yitchatta-bo bayyom hashshelishi ubayyom hashshebii yithar veim-lo yitchatta bayyom hashshelishi ubayyom hashshebii lo yithar
Hu yadde alohi beyoma telitaa ubeyoma shebiaa yidke veim la yadde alohi beyoma telitaa ubeyoma shebiaa la yidke:
Kol-hannogea bemet benepesh haadam asher-yamut velo yitchatta et-mishkan Adonai timme venikreta hannepesh hahiv miyyisrael ki me nidda lo-zoraq alayv tame yihyeh od tumato bo
Kol deyiqrab bemita benapsha deenasha di yemut vela yadde alohi yat mashkena daAdonai saab veyishtetze enasha hahu miyyisrael are me addayuta la izderiqu alohi mesaab yehe od seobeteh beh:
Zot hattora adam ki-yamut beohel kol-habba el-haohel vekol-asher baohel yitma shibat yamim
Da orayta enash are yemut bemashkena kol dealel lemashkena vekol di bemashkena yehe mesaab shaba yomin:
Vekol keli patuach asher en-tzamid patil alayv tame hu
Vekol man dachasap petiach delet megupat sheyia maqqap alohi mesaab hu:
Vekol asher-yigga al-pene hassadeh bachalal-chereb o bemet o-beetzem adam o beqaber yitma shibat yamim
Vekol di yiqrab al appe chaqla biqtel charba o bemeta o begarma deenasha o beqibra yehe mesaab shaba yomin:
Velaqechu lattame meapar serepat hachattat venatan alayv mayim chayyim el-keli
Veyissebun ledimsaab meapar yeqedat chattata veyittenun alohi me mabbua leman:
Velaqach ezob vetabal bammayim ish tahor vehizza al-haohel veal-kol-hakkelim veal-hannepashot asher hayu-sham veal-hannogea baetzem o bechalal o bammet o baqqaber
Veyissab ezoba veyitbol bemayya gebar deke veyadde al mashkena veal kol manayya veal napshata di havo tamman veal deyiqrab begarma o beqatila o bemeta o beqibra:
Vehizza hattahor al-hattame bayyom hashshelishi ubayyom hashshebii vechitteo bayyom hashshebii vekibbes begadayv verachatz bammayim vetaher baareb
Veyadde dakya al mesaaba beyoma telitaa ubeyoma shebiaa vidakkinneh beyoma shebiaa vitzabba lebushohi veyasche bemayya veyidke beramsha:
Veish asher-yitma velo yitchatta venikreta hannepesh hahiv mittok haqqahal ki et-miqdash Adonai timme me nidda lo-zoraq alayv tame hu
Ugebar di yistaab vela yadde alohi veyishtetze enasha hahu miggo qehala are yat maqdesha daAdonai saib me addayuta la izderiqu alohi mesaab hu:
Vehayeta lahem lechuqqat olam umazzeh me-hannidda yekabbes begadayv vehannogea beme hannidda yitma ad-haareb
Utehe lehon liqyam olam udeyadde me addayuta yetzabba lebushohi udeyiqrab beme addayuta yehe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vekol asher-yigga-bo hattame yitma vehannepesh hannogaat titma ad-haareb
Vekol di yiqrab beh mesaaba yehe mesaab veenash deyiqrab beh yehe mesaab ad ramsha:
Vayyabou bene-yisrael kol-haeda midbar-tzin bachodesh harishon vayyesheb haam beqadesh vattamot sham miryam vattiqqaber sham
Vaato bene yisrael kol kenishta lemadbera detzin beyarcha qadmaa viteb amma birqam umitat tamman miryam veitqebarat tamman:
Velo-haya mayim laeda vayyiqqahalu al-mosheh veal-aharon
Vela hava mayya liknishta veitkenashu al msheh veal aharon:
Vayyareb haam im-mosheh vayyomeru lemor velu gavanu bigva achenu lipne Adonai
Unetza amma im msheh vaamaru lememar uleve demitna bemota deachana qodam Adonai:
Velama habetem et-qehal Adonai el-hammidbar hazzeh lamut sham anachnu ubeirenu
Ulema aeltun yat qehala daAdonai lemadbera haden limmat tamman anachna ubeirana:
Velama heelitunu mimmitzrayim lehabi otanu el-hammaqom hara hazzeh lo meqom zera uteena vegepen verimmon umayim ayin lishtot
Ulema asseqtuna mimmitzrayim leaytaa yatana leatra bisha haden la atar keshar lebet zera veap la tenin vegupenin verimmonin umayya let lemishte:
Vayyabo mosheh veaharon mippene haqqahal el-petach ohel moed vayyippelu al-penehem vayyera kebod-Adonai alehem
Veal msheh veaharon min qodam qehala litra mashkan zimna unepalu al appehon veitgele yeqara daAdonai lehon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Qach et-hammatteh vehaqhel et-haeda atta veaharon achika vedibbartem el-hassela leenehem venatan memayv vehotzeta lahem mayim min-hassela vehishqita et-haeda veet-beiram
Sab yat chutera veaknesh yat kenishta at veaharon achuk utemallelun im kepa leenehon veyitten mohi vetappeq lehon mayya min kepa vetashqe yat kenishta veyat beirehon:
Vayyiqqach mosheh et-hammatteh millipne Adonai kaasher tzivvahu
Unesib msheh yat chutera min qodam Adonai kema di paqqedeh:
Vayyaqhilu mosheh veaharon et-haqqahal el-pene hassala vayyomer lahem shimu-na hammorim hamin-hassela hazzeh notzi lakem mayim
Veaknishu msheh veaharon yat qehala loqodam kepa vaamar lehon shemau kean sarbanayya hamin kepa haden nappeq lekon mayya:
Vayyarem mosheh et-yado vayyak et-hassela bemattehu paamayim vayyetzeu mayim rabbim vattesht haeda ubeiram
Vaarem msheh yat yedeh umecha yat kepa bechutereh tarten zimnin unepaqu mayya saggie ushetiat kenishta ubeirehon:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon yaan lo-heemantem bi lehaqdisheni leene bene yisrael laken lo tabiu et-haqqahal hazzeh el-haaretz asher-natatti lahem
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh uleaharon chalap di la hemantun bememeri leqaddashuti leene bene yisrael beken la taalun yat qehala haden leara di yehabit lehon:
Hemma me meriba asher-rabu bene-yisrael et-Adonai vayyiqqadesh bam
Innun me matztzuta di netzo bene yisrael qodam Adonai veitqaddash behon:
Vayyishlach mosheh malakim miqqadesh el-melek edom koh amar achika yisrael atta yadata et kol-hattelaa asher metzaatenu
Ushelach msheh izgaddin mereqam levat malka deedom kidnan amar achuk yisrael at yedaat yat kol aqeta di ashkachtana:
Vayyeredu abotenu mitzrayma vannesheb bemitzrayim yamim rabbim vayyareu lanu mitzrayim velaabotenu
Unechatu abahatana lemitzrayim vitebena bemitzrayim yomin saggiin veabishu lana mitzrae velaabahatana:
Vannitzaq el-Adonai vayyishma qolenu vayyishlach malak vayyotzienu mimmitzrayim vehinneh anachnu beqadesh ir qetzeh gebuleka
Vetzallena qodam Adonai veqabbil tzelotana ushelach malaka veappeqana mimmitzrayim veha anachna birqam qarta debistar techumak:
Nabera-na beartzeka lo naabor besadeh ubekerem velo nishteh me beer derek hammelek nelek lo nitteh yamin usemovl ad asher-naabor gebuleka
Neibbar kean bearak la neibbar bachaqal ubikram vela nishte me gob beorach malka nezel la niste leyammina velismala ad dinibbar techumak:
Vayyomer elayv edom lo taabor bi pen-bachereb etze liqrateka
Vaamar leh edomaa la teibbar bitchumi dilema bidqatelin becharba eppoq loqodamutak:
Vayyomeru elayv bene-yisrael bamesilla naaleh veim-memeka nishteh ani umiqnay venatatti mikram raq en-dabar beraglay eebora
Vaamaru leh bene yisrael beorach kebisha nissaq veim meyymak nishte ana ubeiray veetten demehon lechod let pitgam debish beraglay aibbar:
Vayyomer lo taabor vayyetze edom liqrato beam kabed ubeyad chazaqa
Vaamar la teibbar unepaq edomaa loqodamuteh bechel rab ubida taqqipa:
Vayemaen edom neton et-yisrael abor bigbulo vayyet yisrael mealayv
Vesareb edomaa lemishbaq yat yisrael lemeebbar bitchumeh useta yisrael millevateh:
Vayyisu miqqadesh vayyabou bene-yisrael kol-haeda hor hahar
Unetalu mereqam vaato bene yisrael kol kenishta lehor tura:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh veel-aharon behor hahar al-gebul eretz-edom lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh uleaharon behor tura al techum ara deedom lememar:
Yeasep aharon el-ammayv ki lo yabo el-haaretz asher natatti libne yisrael al asher-meritem et-pi leme meriba
Yitkenesh aharon leammeh are la yeol leara di yehabit libne yisrael al di saribetun al memeri leme matztzuta:
Qach et-aharon veet-elazar beno vehaal otam hor hahar
Debar yat aharon veyat elazar bereh veasseq yatehon lehor tura:
Vehapshet et-aharon et-begadayv vehilbashtam et-elazar beno veaharon yeasep umet sham
Veashlach yat aharon yat lebushohi vetalbeshinnun yat elazar bereh veaharon yitkenesh vimut tamman:
Vayyaas mosheh kaasher tzivva Adonai vayyaalu el-hor hahar leene kol-haeda
Vaabad msheh kema di paqqid Adonai useliqu lehor tura leene kol kenishta:
Vayyapshet mosheh et-aharon et-begadayv vayyalbesh otam et-elazar beno vayyamot aharon sham berosh hahar vayyered mosheh veelazar min-hahar
Veashlach msheh yat aharon yat lebushohi vealbesh yatehon yat elazar bereh umit aharon tamman beresh tura unechat msheh veelazar min tura:
Vayyiru kol-haeda ki gava aharon vayyibku et-aharon sheloshim yom kol bet yisrael
Vachazo kol kenishta are mit aharon ubeko yat aharon telatin yomin kol bet yisrael:
Vayyishma hakkenaani melek-arad yosheb hannegeb ki ba yisrael derek haatarim vayyillachem beyisrael vayyishb mimmennu shebi
Ushema kenaanaa malka daarad yateb daroma are ata yisrael orach meallayya veaggach qeraba beyisrael usheba minneh shibya:
Vayyiddar yisrael neder la-Adonai vayyomar im-naton titten et-haam hazzeh beyadi vehacharamti et-arehem
Veqayyem yisrael qeyam qodam Adonai vaamar im mimsar timsar yat amma haden bidi vaagammar yat qirvehon:
Vayyishma Adonai beqol yisrael vayyitten et-hakkenaani vayyacharem ethem veet-arehem vayyiqra shem-hammaqom chorma
Veqabbel Adonai tzeloteh deyisrael umesar yat kenaanaa vegammar yatehon veyat qirvehon uqera shema deatra charema:
Vayyisu mehor hahar derek yam-svp lisbob et-eretz edom vattiqtzar nepesh-haam baddarek
Unetalu mehor tura orach yamma desup leaqqapa yat ara deedom vaaqat napsha deamma beorecha:
Vayedabber haam belohim ubemosheh lama heelitunu mimmitzrayim lamut bammidbar ki en lechem veen mayim venapshenu qatza ballechem haqqeloqel
Veitraam amma bememera daAdonai veim msheh netzo lema asseqtuna mimmitzrayim limmat bemadbera are let lachma velet mayya venapshana aqat bemanna haden demekeleh qalil:
Vayeshallach Adonai baam et hannechashim hasserapim vayenashsheku et-haam vayyamot am-rab miyyisrael
Vegare Adonai beamma yat chivan qalan unekitu yat amma umit am saggi miyyisrael:
Vayyabo haam el-mosheh vayyomeru chatanu ki-dibbarnu ba-Adonai vabak hitpallel el-Adonai veyaser mealenu et-hannachash vayyitpallel mosheh bead haam
Vaata amma lemsheh vaamaru chabna are itraamna qodam Adonai veimmak netzena tzalli qodam Adonai veyaaddi minnana yat chivya vetzalli msheh al amma:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh aseh leka sarap vesim oto al-nes vehaya kol-hannashuk veraa oto vachay
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh abed lak qaleya veshavve yateh al at vihe kol deyitnekit veyecheze yateh veyitqayyam:
Vayyaas mosheh nechash nechoshet vayesimehu al-hannes vehaya im-nashak hannachash et-ish vehibbit el-nechash hannechoshet vachay
Vaabad msheh chivya dinchasha veshavyeh al at vahava kad nakit chivya yat gabra umistakkel lechivya dinchasha umitqayyam:
Vayyisu bene yisrael vayyachanu beobot
Unetalu bene yisrael ushero beobot:
Vayyisu meobot vayyachanu beiyye haabarim bammidbar asher al-pene moab mimmizrach hashshamesh
Unetalu meobot ushero bimgizat abarae bemadbera di al appe moab mimmadnach shimsha:
Mishsham nasau vayyachanu benachal zared
Mittamman netalu ushero benachala dezared:
Mishsham nasau vayyachanu meeber arnon asher bammidbar hayyotze miggebul haemori ki arnon gebul moab ben moab uben haemori
Mittamman netalu ushero meibra dearnon di bemadbera denapeq mittechum emoraa are arnon techum moab ben moab uben emoraa:
Al-ken yeamar beseper milchamot Adonai et-vaheb besupa veet-hannechalim arnon
Al ken yitammar besipra qerabin daabad Adonai al yamma desup ugeburan deal nachale arnon:
Veeshed hannechalim asher nata leshebet ar venishan ligbul moab
Veshapuk nachalayya demiddabberin loqobel lechayyat umistemik litchum moab:
Umishsham beera hiv habbeer asher amar Adonai lemosheh esop et-haam veettena lahem mayim
Umittamman ityehibat lehon bera hi bera di amar Adonai lemsheh kenosh yat amma veetten lehon mayya:
Az yashir yisrael et-hashshira hazzot ali beer enu-la
Beken shabbach yisrael yat tushebachta hada saqqi bera shabbachu lah:
Beer chaparuha sarim karuha nedibe haam bimchoqeq bemishanotam umimmidbar mattana
Bera dechaperuha rabrebayya keruha reshe amma saprayya bechuterehon umimmadbera ityehibat lehon:
Umimmattana nachaliel uminnachaliel bamot
Umiddeityehibat lehon nachata immehon lenachalayya uminachalayya saleqa immehon leramata:
Umibbamot haggay asher bisdeh moab rosh happisga venishqapa al-pene hayeshimon
Umeramata lechelayya di bechaqle moab resh ramata umistakya al appe bet yeshimon:
Vayyishlach yisrael malakim el-sichon melek-haemori lemor
Ushelach yisrael izgaddin levat sichon malka deemoraa lememar:
Ebera beartzeka lo nitteh besadeh ubekerem lo nishteh me beer bederek hammelek nelek ad asher-naabor gebuleka
Aibar bearak la niste bachaqal ubikram la nishte me gob beorach malka nezel ad di neibar techumak:
Velo-natan sichon et-yisrael abor bigbulo vayyeesop sichon et-kol-ammo vayyetze liqrat yisrael hammidbara vayyabo yahetza vayyillachem beyisrael
Vela shebaq sichon yat yisrael lemebar bitchumeh ukenash sichon yat kol ammeh unepaq loqodamut yisrael lemadbera vaata leyahatz viaggiach qeraba beyisrael:
Vayyakkehu yisrael lepi-chareb vayyirash et-artzo mearnon ad-yabboq ad-bene ammon ki az gebul bene ammon
Umechahi yisrael lepitgam dechareb viret yat areh mearnona ad yubeqa ad bene ammon are taqqip techuma dibne ammon:
Vayyiqqach yisrael et kol-hearim haelleh vayyesheb yisrael bekol-are haemori becheshbon ubekol-benoteha
Ukebash yisrael yat kol qirvayya haillen viteb yisrael bekol qirve emoraa becheshbon ubekol kapranaha:
Ki cheshbon ir sichon melek haemori hiv vehu nilcham bemelek moab harishon vayyiqqach et-kol-artzo miyyado ad-arnon
Are cheshbon qarta desichon malka deemoraa hi vehu aggach qeraba bemalka demoab qadmaa unesib yat kol areh mideh ad arnon:
Al-ken yomeru hammoshelim bou cheshbon tibbaneh vetikkonen ir sichon
Al ken yemerun metalayya ulu lecheshbon titbene vetishtaklal qarta desichon:
Ki-esh yatzea mecheshbon lehaba miqqiryat sichon akela ar moab baale bamot arnon
Are qidum taqqip keeshsha nepaq mecheshbon abede qeraba keshalhobita miqqarta desichon qetilu amma dishro bilchayat moab kumerayya depalechin bet dachala ramata dearnon:
Oy-leka moab abadta am-kemosh natan banayv peletim ubenotayv bashshebit lemelek emori sichon
Vay lekon moabae abadtun amma depalechin likmosh mesar benohi tzirin ubenateh beshibya lemalka deemoraa sichon:
Vanniram abad cheshbon ad-dibon vannashshim ad-nopach asher ad-medeba
Umalku pesaqat mecheshbon ada shuletan middibon vetzadiu ad nopach dismik ad medeba:
Vayyesheb yisrael beeretz haemori
Viteb yisrael baara emoraa:
Vayyishlach mosheh leraggel et-yazer vayyilkedu benoteha vayyoresh et-haemori asher-sham
Ushelach msheh leallala yat yazer ukebashu kapranaha vetarik yat emoraa di tamman:
Vayyipnu vayyaalu derek habbashan vayyetze og melek-habbashan liqratam hu vekol-ammo lammilchama edrei
Veitpeniu useliqu leorach matnan unepaq og malka dematnan loqodamutehon hu vekol ammeh leaggacha qeraba leedrei:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh al-tira oto ki beyadeka natatti oto veet-kol-ammo veet-artzo veasita lo kaasher asita lesichon melek haemori asher yosheb becheshbon
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh la tidchal minneh are bidak mesarit yateh veyat kol ammeh veyat areh vetabed leh kema di abadt lesichon malka deemoraa di yateb becheshbon:
Vayyakku oto veet-banayv veet-kol-ammo ad-bilti hishir-lo sarid vayyireshu et-artzo
Umecho yateh veyat benohi veyat kol ammeh ad dela ishtear leh meshezib viritu yat areh:
Vayyisu bene yisrael vayyachanu bearebot moab meeber leyarden yerecho
Unetalu bene yisrael ushero bemesherayya demoab meibra leyardena direcho:
Vayyar balaq ben-tzippor et kol-asher-asa yisrael laemori
Vachaza balaq bar tzippor yat kol di abad yisrael leemorae:
Vayyagor moab mippene haam meod ki rab-hv vayyaqotz moab mippene bene yisrael
Udechel moabaa min qodam amma lachada are saggi hu vaaqat lemoabaa min qodam bene yisrael:
Vayyomer moab el-ziqne midyan atta yelachaku haqqahal et-kol-sebibotenu kilchok hashshor et yereq hassadeh ubalaq ben-tzippor melek lemoab baet hahiv
Vaamar moab lesabe midyan kean yeshetzun qehala yat kol sacharanana kema dimlachik tora yat yeroqa dechaqla ubalaq bar tzippor malka lemoab beiddana hahi:
Vayyishlach malakim el-bilam ben-beor petora asher al-hannahar eretz bene-ammo liqro-lo lemor hinneh am yatza mimmitzrayim hinneh kissa et-en haaretz vehu yosheb mimmuli
Ushelach izgaddin levat bilam bar beor liptor aram deal perat ara bene ammeh lemiqre leh lememar ha amma nepaq mimmitzrayim ha chapa yat en shimsha deara vehu share milleqibli:
Veatta leka-na ara-li et-haam hazzeh ki-atzum hu mimmenni ulay ukal nakkeh-bo vaagareshennu min-haaretz ki yadati et asher-tebarek meborak vaasher taor yuar
Ukean ita kean lot li yat amma haden are taqqip hu minni maim ekkul leaggacha beh qerab vaatarekinneh min ara are yedana yat di tebarak mebarak vedi telot lit:
Vayyeleku ziqne moab veziqne midyan uqesamim beyadam vayyabou el-bilam vayedabberu elayv dibre balaq
Vaazalu sabe moab vesabe midyan veqismayya bidehon vaato levat bilam umallilu immeh pitgame balaq:
Vayyomer alehem linu poh hallayla vahashiboti etkem dabar kaasher yedabber Adonai elay vayyeshebu sare-moab im-bilam
Vaamar lehon bitu haka beleleya veateb yatekon pitgama kema di mallel Adonai immi veoriku rabrebe moab im bilam:
Vayyabo elohim el-bilam vayyomer mi haanashim haelleh immak
Vaata memar min qodam Adonai levat bilam vaamar man gubrayya haillen deimmak:
Vayyomer bilam el-haelohim balaq ben-tzippor melek moab shalach elay
Vaamar bilam qodam Adonai balaq bar tzippor malka demoab shelach levati:
Hinneh haam hayyotze mimmitzrayim vayekas et-en haaretz atta leka qaba-li oto ulay ukal lehillachem bo vegerashtiv
Ha amma di nepaq mimmitzrayim vachapa yat en shimsha deara kean ita lot li yateh maim ekul leaggacha beh qerab vaatarekinneh:
Vayyomer elohim el-bilam lo telek immahem lo taor et-haam ki baruk hu
Vaamar Adonai lebilam la tezil immehon la telut yat amma are berik hu:
Vayyaqom bilam babboqer vayyomer el-sare balaq leku el-artzekem ki meen Adonai letitti lahalok immakem
Veqam bilam betzapra vaamar lerabrebe balaq izilu learakon are let raava qodam Adonai lemishbeqi lemizal immekon:
Vayyaqumu sare moab vayyabou el-balaq vayyomeru meen bilam halok immanu
Veqamu rabrebe moab vaato levat balaq vaamaru sareb bilam lemete immana:
Vayyosep od balaq sheloach sarim rabbim venikbadim meelleh
Veosip od balaq lemishlach rabrebin saggiin veyaqqirin meillen:
Vayyabou el-bilam vayyomeru lo koh amar balaq ben-tzippor al-na timmana mehalok elay
Vaato levat bilam vaamaru leh kidnan amar balaq bar tzippor la kean titmena millemete levati:
Ki-kabbed akabbedka meod vekol asher-tomar elay eeseh uleka-na qaba-li et haam hazzeh
Are yeqara ayaqqerinnak lachada vekol di temar li abed veita kean lot li yat amma haden:
Vayyaan bilam vayyomer el-abde balaq im-yitten-li balaq melo beto kesep vezahab lo ukal laabor et-pi Adonai elohay laasot qetanna o gedola
Veateb bilam vaamar leabde balaq im yitten li balaq mele beteh kesap udehab let li reshu lemebar al gezerat memera daAdonai elahi lemebad zeerta o rabbeta:
Veatta shebu na bazeh gam-attem hallayela veedea mah-yosep Adonai dabber immi
Ukean oriku kean haka ap attun beleleya veidda ma yosep Adonai lemallala immi:
Vayyabo elohim el-bilam layla vayyomer lo im-liqro leka bau haanashim qum lek ittam veak et-haddabar asher-adabber eleka oto taaseh
Vaata memar min qodam Adonai lebilam beleleya vaamar leh im lemiqre lak ato gubrayya qum izzel immehon uberam yat pitgama di amallel immak yateh tabed:
Vayyaqom bilam babboqer vayyachabosh et-atono vayyelek im-sare moab
Veqam bilam betzapra vezariz yat attaneh vaazal im rabrebe moab:
Vayyichar-ap elohim ki-holek hu vayyityatztzeb malak Adonai badderek lesatan lo vehu rokeb al-atono ushene nearayv immo
Uteqep rogza daAdonai are azel hu veitattad malaka daAdonai beorcha lesatan leh vehu rakib al attaneh uteren ulemohi immeh:
Vattere haaton et-malak Adonai nitztzab badderek vecharbo shelupa beyado vattet haaton min-hadderek vattelek bassadeh vayyak bilam et-haaton lehattotah haddarek
Vachazat attana yat malaka daAdonai meattad beorcha vecharbeh shelipa bideh usetat attana min orecha vaazalat bechaqla umecha bilam yat attana leastayutah leorcha:
Vayyaamod malak Adonai bemishol hakkeramim gader mizzeh vegader mizzeh
Veqam malaka daAdonai bishbil karmayya atra degadera mikka vegadera mikka:
Vattere haaton et-malak Adonai vattillachetz el-haqqir vattilchatz et-regel bilam el-haqqir vayyosep lehakkotah
Vachazat attana yat malaka daAdonai veidcheqat lekatela udecheqat yat rigla debilam lekatela veosip lemimchah:
Vayyosep malak-Adonai abor vayyaamod bemaqom tzar asher en-derek lintot yamin usemovl
Veosep malaka daAdonai lemebar veqam baatar aq di let orach lemiste leyammina velismala:
Vattere haaton et-malak Adonai vattirbatz tachat bilam vayyichar-ap bilam vayyak et-haaton bammaqqel
Vachazat attana yat malaka daAdonai urebaat techot bilam uteqep rugeza debilam umecha yat attana bechutra:
Vayyiptach Adonai et-pi haaton vattomer lebilam meh-asiti leka ki hikkitani zeh shalosh regalim
Upetach Adonai yat puma deaattana vaamarat lebilam meh abadit lak are mechitanni denan telat zimnin:
Vayyomer bilam laaton ki hitallalt bi lu yesh-chereb beyadi ki atta haragtik
Vaamar bilam leattana are chayyikt bi illupon it charba bidi are kean qetaltik:
Vattomer haaton el-bilam halo anoki atoneka asher-rakabta alay meodeka ad-hayyom hazzeh hahasken hiskanti laasot leka koh vayyomer lo
Vaamarat attana lebilam hala ana attanak di rekabt alay middeitak ad yoma haden hamelap allipena lemebad lak keden vaamar la:
Vayegal Adonai et-ene bilam vayyar et-malak Adonai nitztzab badderek vecharbo shelupa beyado vayyiqqod vayyishtachu leappayv
Ugela Adonai yat ene bilam vachaza yat malaka daAdonai meattad beorcha vecharbeh shelipa bideh ukera usegid leappohi:
Vayyomer elayv malak Adonai al-ma hikkita et-atoneka zeh shalosh regalim hinneh anoki yatzati lesatan ki-yarat hadderek lenegdi
Vaamar leh malaka daAdonai al ma mechita yat attanak denan telat zimnin ha ana nepaqit lemistan are gele qodamay deat rae lemezal beurecha leqibli:
Vattirani haaton vattet lepanay zeh shalosh regalim ulay nateta mippanay ki atta gam-oteka haragti veotah hecheyeti
Vachazatni attana usetat min qodamay denan telat zimnin illupon la setat min qodamay are kean ap yatak qetalit veyatah qayyemit:
Vayyomer bilam el-malak Adonai chatati ki lo yadati ki atta nitztzab liqrati baddarek veatta im-ra beeneka ashuba li
Vaamar bilam lemalaka daAdonai chabit are la yedait di at meattad loqodamuti beorcha ukean im bish beenayk etob li:
Vayyomer malak Adonai el-bilam lek im-haanashim veepes et-haddabar asher-adabber eleka oto tedabber vayyelek bilam im-sare balaq
Vaamar malaka daAdonai lebilam izzel im gubrayya ulechod yat pitgama di amallel immak yateh temallel vaazal bilam im rabrebe balaq:
Vayyishma balaq ki ba bilam vayyetze liqrato el-ir moab asher al-gebul arnon asher biqtzeh haggebul
Ushema balaq are ata bilam unepaq loqodamuteh leqarta demoab di al techum arnon di bistar techuma:
Vayyomer balaq el-bilam halo shaloach shalachti eleka liqro-lak lamma lo-halakta elay haumnam lo ukal kabbedeka
Vaamar balaq lebilam hala mishlach shelachit levatak lemiqre lak lema la ateta levati habbequsheta haveta amar let ana yakil leyaqqerutak:
Vayyomer bilam el-balaq hinneh-bati eleka atta hayakol ukal dabber meuma haddabar asher yasim elohim bepi oto adabber
Vaamar bilam lebalaq ha ateti levatak kean hamekal yakilna lemallala middaam pitgama dishavvi Adonai bepumi yateh amallel:
Vayyelek bilam im-balaq vayyabou qiryat chutzot
Vaazal bilam im balaq vaato leqiryat machozohi:
Vayyizbach balaq baqar vatzon vayeshallach lebilam velassarim asher itto
Unekes balaq torin vean ushelach lebilam ulerabrebayya di immeh:
Vayehi babboqer vayyiqqach balaq et-bilam vayyaalehu bamot baal vayyar mishsham qetzeh haam
Vahava betzapra udebar balaq yat bilam veasseqeh leramat dachalteh vechaza mittamman qetzat min amma:
Vayyomer bilam el-balaq beneh-li bazeh shiba mizbechot vehaken li bazeh shiba parim veshiba elim
Vaamar bilam lebalaq beneh li haka shaba madbechin veatqen li haka shaba torin veshaba dikrin:
Vayyaas balaq kaasher dibber bilam vayyaal balaq ubilam par vaayil bammizbeach
Vaabad balaq kema di mallel bilam veasseq balaq ubilam tor udekar al kol madbecha:
Vayyomer bilam lebalaq hityatztzeb al-olateka veeleka ulay yiqqareh Adonai liqrati udebar mah-yareni vehiggadti lak vayyelek shepi
Vaamar bilam lebalaq itattad al alatak veehak maim yeara memar min qodam Adonai loqodamuti upitgama deyachazinnani veechavve lak vaazal yechidi:
Vayyiqqar elohim el-bilam vayyomer elayv et-shibat hammizbechot arakti vaaal par vaayil bammizbeach
Vaara memar min qodam Adonai levat bilam vaamar leh yat shaba madbechin saddarit veasseqit tor udekar al kol madbecha:
Vayyasem Adonai dabar bepi bilam vayyomer shub el-balaq vekoh tedabber
Veshavvi Adonai pitgama bepuma debilam vaamar tub levat balaq ukeden temallel:
Vayyashob elayv vehinneh nitztzab al-olato hu vekol-sare moab
Vetab levateh veha meattad al alateh hu vekol rabrebe moab:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar min-aram yancheni balaq melek-moab meharre-qedem leka ara-li yaaqob uleka zoama yisrael
Unetal matleh vaamar min aram dabberani balaq malka demoab mitture maddinecha ita lut li yaaqob veita tarek li yisrael:
Ma eqqob lo qabboh el uma ezom lo zaam Adonai
Ma aloteh dela latyeh el uma atarekeh dela tarekeh Adonai:
Ki-merosh tzurim erennu umiggebaot ashurennu hen-am lebadad yishkon ubaggoyim lo yitchashshab
Are meresh turayya chaziteh umeramata sekiteh ha amma bilchodehon atidin deyachsenun alema ubaamamayya la yitdanun gemira:
Mi mana apar yaaqob umispar et-roba yisrael tamot napshi mot yesharim utehi achariti kamohu
Man yekol lemimne dadeqayya debet yaaqob deamir alehon yisgun keapra deara o chada mearba mashshiryata deyisrael temut napshi mota deqashshitohi vihe sopi kevatehon:
Vayyomer balaq el-bilam meh asita li laqob oyebay leqachtika vehinneh berakta barek
Vaamar balaq lebilam meh abadt li lemelat sanay debartik veha baraka mebarekat lehon:
Vayyaan vayyomar halo et asher yasim Adonai bepi oto eshmor ledabber
Vaateb vaamar hala yat dishavvi Adonai bepumi yateh ettar lemallala:
Vayyomer elayv balaq leka-na itti el-maqom acher asher tirennu mishsham epes qatzehu tireh vekullo lo tireh veqobno-li mishsham
Vaamar leh balaq ita kean immi laatar ochoran detechazinneh mittamman lechod qetzateh techeze vekulleh la techeze uteluteh li mittamman:
Vayyiqqachehu sedeh tzopim el-rosh happisga vayyiben shiba mizbechot vayyaal par vaayil bammizbeach
Vedabbereh lachaqal sekuta leresh ramata ubena shaba madbechin veasseq tor udekar al kol madbecha:
Vayyomer el-balaq hityatztzeb koh al-olateka veanoki iqqareh koh
Vaamar lebalaq itattad haka al alatak vaana itmete ad ka:
Vayyiqqar Adonai el-bilam vayyasem dabar bepiv vayyomer shub el-balaq vekoh tedabber
Vaara memar min qodam Adonai lebilam veshavvi pitgama bepumeh vaamar tub levat balaq ukeden temallel:
Vayyabo elayv vehinno nitztzab al-olato vesare moab itto vayyomer lo balaq mah-dibber Adonai
Vaata levateh vehu meattad al alateh verabrebe moab immeh vaamar leh balaq ma mallil Adonai:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar qum balaq ushema haazina aday beno tzippor
Unetal matleh vaamar qum balaq ushema atzet lememeri bar tzippor:
Lo ish el vikazzeb uben-adam veyitnecham hahu amar velo yaaseh vedibber velo yeqimenna
La kemille bene enasha memar elaha bene enasha amerin umekaddebin veap la keobade bene bisra di innun gazerin lemebad vetayyebin umitmallekin dehu amar veabed vekol memereh mitqayyam:
Hinneh barek laqacheti uberek velo ashibenna
Ha birkan qabbelit vaabarekinneh leyisrael vela ateb birketi minneh:
Lo-hibbit aven beyaaqob velo-raa amal beyisrael Adonai elohayv immo uteruat melek bo
Istakkalit let paleche gillulin bidbet yaaqob veap la abede leut sheqar beyisrael memera daAdonai elahahon besadehon ushekinat malkehon benehon:
El motziam mimmitzrayim ketoapot reem lo
Elaha deappeqinnun mimmtzerayim tuqepa veruma dileh:
