Ki lo-nachash beyaaqob velo-qesem beyisrael kaet yeamer leyaaqob uleyisrael mah-paal el
Are la nachashayya tzaban deyitab lidbet yaaqob veap la qesamayya rean birbut bet yisrael keiddan yitammar leyaaqob uleyisrael meh abad elaha:
Hen-am kelabi yaqum vekaari yitnassa lo yishkab ad-yokal terep vedam-chalalim yishteh
Ha amma keleta share ukearya yitnattal la yishre beareh ad deyiqtol qetol venikse ammayya yerat:
Vayyomer balaq el-bilam gam-qob lo tiqqobennu gam-barek lo tebarekennu
Vaamar balaq lebilam ap melat la telutinnun ap beraka la tebarekinnun:
Vayyaan bilam vayyomer el-balaq halo dibbarti eleka lemor kol asher-yedabber Adonai oto eeseh
Vaateb bilam vaamar lebalaq hala mallelit immak lememar kol di yemallel Adonai yateh ebed:
Vayyomer balaq el-bilam leka-na eqqachaka el-maqom acher ulay yishar beene haelohim veqabboto li mishsham
Vaamar balaq lebilam ita kean adabberinnak laatar ochoran maim yehe raava min qodam Adonai uteluteh li mittamman:
Vayyiqqach balaq et-bilam rosh happeor hannishqap al-pene hayeshimon
Udebar balaq yat bilam resh ramata demistakkeya al appe bet yeshimon:
Vayyomer bilam el-balaq beneh-li bazeh shiba mizbechot vehaken li bazeh shiba parim veshiba elim
Vaamar bilam lebalaq beneh li haka shaba madbechin veatqen li haka shaba torin veshaba dikrin:
Vayyaas balaq kaasher amar bilam vayyaal par vaayil bammizbeach
Vaabad balaq kema di amar bilam veasseq tor udekar al kol madbecha:
Vayyar bilam ki tob beene Adonai lebarek et-yisrael velo-halak kepaam-bepaam liqrat nechashim vayyashet el-hammidbar panayv
Vachaza bilam are taqqin qodam Adonai lebaraka yat yisrael vela halak kizman bizman ellahen loqodamut nechashayya veshavvi lemadbera appohi:
Vayyissa bilam et-enayv vayyar et-yisrael shoken lishbatayv vattehi alayv ruach elohim
Uzeqep bilam yat enohi vachaza yat yisrael sharan leshibtohi usherat alohi ruach nebua min qodam Adonai:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar neum bilam beno beor uneum haggeber shetum haayin
Unetal matleh vaamar emar bilam bereh beor veemar gabra deshappir chaze:
Neum shomea imre-el asher machazeh shadday yechezeh nopel ugeluy enayim
Emar dishma memar min qodam el vechezu min qodam shadday chaze shekib umitgele leh:
Mah-tobu ohaleka yaaqob mishkenoteka yisrael
Ma taba arak yaaqob bet mesherayk yisrael:
Kinchalim nittayu kegannot ale nahar kaahalim nata Adonai kaarazim ale-mayim
Kenachalin demiddabberin keginnat shaqya deal perat kebusemayya dintzib Adonai kearzin dintzibin al mayya:
Yizzal-mayim middaleyav vezaro bemayim rabbim veyarom meagag malko vetinnasse malkuto
Yisge malka deyitrabba mibbenohi veyishlot beammin saggiin veyitqop meagag malkeh vetitnetel malkuteh:
El motzio mimmitzrayim ketoapot reem lo yokal goyim tzarayv veatzmotehem yegarem vechitztzayv yimchatz
Elaha deappeqinnun mimmitzrayim taqepa veruma dileh yekelun bene yisrael nikse ammayya sanehon ubebizzat malkehon yitpannequn vearathon yachsenun:
Kara shakab kaari ukelabi mi yeqimennu mebarekeka baruk veorereka arur
Yenuach yishre bitqop kearya ukeleta let malku ditzazeineh berikak yehon berikin velitayk yehon litin:
Vayyichar-ap balaq el-bilam vayyispoq et-kappayv vayyomer balaq el-bilam laqob oyebay qeratika vehinneh berakta barek zeh shalosh peamim
Uteqep rugeza debalaq bebilam usheqapinnun lidohi vaamar balaq lebilam lemelat sanay qeritak veha baraka mebarekat lehon denan telat zimnin:
Veatta berach-leka el-meqomeka amarti kabbed akabbedka vehinneh menaaka Adonai mikkabod
Ukean ezil lak leatrak amarit yeqara ayaqqerinnak veha menaak Adonai min yeqar:
Vayyomer bilam el-balaq halo gam el-malakeka asher-shalachta elay dibbarti lemor
Vaamar bilam lebalaq hala ap leizgaddayk di shallechat levati mallelit lememar:
Im-yitten-li balaq melo beto kesep vezahab lo ukal laabor et-pi Adonai laasot toba o raa millibbi asher-yedabber Adonai oto adabber
Im yitten li balaq mele beteh kesap udehab let li reshu lemebar al gezerat memera daAdonai lemebad tabta o bisheta mereuti dimallel Adonai yateh amallel:
Veatta hinni holek leammi leka iatzeka asher yaaseh haam hazzeh leammeka beacharit hayyamim
Ukean ha ana azel leammi ita amalkinak ma detabed vaachavve lak ma deyabed amma haden leammak besop yomayya:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar neum bilam beno beor uneum haggeber shetum haayin
Unetal matleh vaamar emar bilam bereh beor veemar gabra deshappir chaze:
Neum shomea imre-el veyodea daat elyon machazeh shadday yechezeh nopel ugeluy enayim
Emar dishma memar min qodam el vida madda min qodam illaa chezu min qodam shadday chaze shekib umitgele leh:
Erennu velo atta ashurennu velo qarob darak kokab miyyaaqob veqam shebet miyyisrael umachatz paate moab veqarqar kol-bene-shet
Chaziteh vela kean sekiteh vela itohi qarib kad yequm malka miyyaaqob veyitrabba meshicha miyyishrael veyiqtol rabrebe moab veyishlot bekol bene enasha:
Vehaya edom yeresha vehaya yeresha seir oyebayv veyisrael oseh chayil
Vihe edom yerutta vihe yerutta seir lebaale debabohi veyisrael yatzlach beniksin:
Veyerd miyyaaqob veheebid sarid meir
Veyechut chad middebet yaaqob veyobed meshezeb miqqiryat ammayya:
Vayyar et-amaleq vayyissa meshalo vayyomar reshit goyim amaleq veacharito ade obed
Vachaza yat amalqaa unetal matleh vaamar resh qerabayya deyisrael hava amalqaa vesopeh lealema yebad:
Vayyar et-haqqeni vayyissa meshalo vayyomar etan moshabeka vesim bassela qinneka
Vachaza yat shalmaa unetal matleh vaamar taqqip bet motebak veshavvi bikrak taqqip medorak:
Ki im-yihyeh lebaer qayin ad-ma ashshur tishbekka
Are im yehe leshetzaa shalmaa ad ma aturaa yishbinnak:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar oy mi yichyeh missumo el
Unetal matleh vaamar vay lechayyabayya deyechon kad yaabbed elaha yat illen:
Vetzim miyyad kittim veinnu ashshur veinnu-eber vegam-hv ade obed
Vesian yitztarechan meromae viannun leatur veyishtabedun leebar perat veap innun lealema yebedun:
Vayyaqom bilam vayyelek vayyashob limqomo vegam-balaq halak ledarko
Veqam bilam vaazal vetab leatreh veap balaq azal leorcheh:
Vayyesheb yisrael bashshittim vayyachel haam liznot el-benot moab
Viteb yisrael beshittin veshare amma lemite batar benat moab:
Vattiqrena laam lezibche elohehen vayyokal haam vayyishetachavu lelohehen
Uqera leamma ledibche taavathon vaakal amma usegidu letaavathon:
Vayyitztzamed yisrael lebaal peor vayyichar-ap Adonai beyisrael
Veitchabbar yisrael lebaala peor uteqep rogza daAdonai beyisrael:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh qach et-kol-rashe haam vehoqa otam la-Adonai neged hashshamesh veyashob charon ap-Adonai miyyisrael
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh debar yat kol reshe amma vedun uqetol dechayyab qetol qodam Adonai loqobel shimsha vitub teqop rugeza daAdonai miyyisrael:
Vayyomer mosheh el-shopete yisrael hirgu ish anashayv hannitzmadim lebaal peor
Vaamar msheh ledayyane yisrael qetulu gebar gabrohi deitchabbaru lebaala peor:
Vehinneh ish mibbene yisrael ba vayyaqreb el-echayv et-hammidyanit leene mosheh uleene kol-adat bene-yisrael vehemma bokim petach ohel moed
Veha gabra mibbene yisrael ata veqareb levat achohi yat midyaneta leene msheh uleene kol kenishta dibne yisrael veinnun bakan bitra mashkan zimna:
Vayyar pinechas ben-elazar ben-aharon hakkohen vayyaqom mittok haeda vayyiqqach romach beyado
Vachaza pinechas bar elazar bar aharon kahana veqam miggo kenishta uneseb ramecha bideh:
Vayyabo achar ish-yisrael el-haqqubba vayyidqor et-shenehem et ish yisrael veet-haishsha el-qobatah vatteatzar hammaggepa meal bene yisrael
Veal batar gabra bar yisrael lequbata ubeza yat tarvehon yat gabra bar yisrael veyat itteta limaha veitkeli motana meal bene yisrael:
Vayyihyu hammetim bammaggepa arbaa veesrim alep
Vahavo demitu bemotana asrin vearbea alpin:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Pinechas ben-elazar ben-aharon hakkohen heshib et-chamati meal bene-yisrael beqano et-qinati betokam velo-killiti et-bene-yisrael beqinati
Pinechas bar elazar bar aharon kahana ateb yat chemeti meal bene yisrael bidqanne yat qinati benehon vela shetzeti yat bene yisrael beqinati:
Laken emor hinni noten lo et-beriti shalom
Beken emar ha ana gezar leh yat qeyami shelam:
Vehayeta lo ulezaro acharayv berit kehunnat olam tachat asher qinne lelohayv vayekapper al-bene yisrael
Utehe leh velibnohi batrohi qeyam kehunnat olam chalap di qanne qodam elaheh vekappar al bene yisrael:
Veshem ish yisrael hammukkeh asher hukka et-hammidyanit zimri ben-salu nesi bet-ab lashshimoni
Veshum gabra bar yisrael qetila di itqetel im midyaneta zimri bar salu rab bet abba lebet shimon:
Veshem haishsha hammukka hammidyanit kozbi bat-tzvr rosh ummot bet-ab bemidyan hu
Veshum itteta deitqetilat midyaneta kazebi bat tzur resh umme bet abba bemidyan hu:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Tzaror et-hammidyanim vehikkitem otam
Aeq yat midyanae vetiqtol yatehon:
Ki tzorerim hem lakem beniklehem asher-nikkelu lakem al-debar-peor veal-debar kozbi bat-nesi midyan achotam hammukka beyom-hammaggepa al-debar-peor
Are meiqin innun lekon beniklehon di nekilu lekon al esaq peor veal esaq kazebi bat rabba demidyan achathon deitqetilat beyoma demotana al esaq peor:
Vayehi achare hammaggepa vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh veel elazar ben-aharon hakkohen lemor
Vahava batar motana vaamar Adonai lemsheh uleelazar bar aharon kahana lememar:
Seu et-rosh kol-adat bene-yisrael mibben esrim shana vamala lebet abotam kol-yotze tzaba beyisrael
Qabbilu yat chushban kol kenishta dibne yisrael mibbar asrin shenin uleella lebet abahathon kol napeq chela beyisrael:
Vayedabber mosheh veelazar hakkohen otam bearebot moab al-yarden yerecho lemor
Umallil msheh veelazar kahana amaru lemimne yatehon bemesherayya demoab al yardena direcho lememar:
Mibben esrim shana vamaela kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh ubene yisrael hayyotzeim meeretz mitzrayim
Mibbar asrin shenin uleella kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh ubene yisrael di nepaqu meara demitzrayim:
Reuben bekor yisrael bene reuben chanok mishpachat hachanoki lepallu mishpachat happallui
Reuben bukera deyisrael bene reuben chanok zarit chanok lepallu zarit pallu:
Lechetzron mishpachat hachetzroni lekarmi mishpachat hakkarmi
Lechetzron zarit chetzron lekarmi zarit karmi:
Elleh mishpechot harubeni vayyihyu pequdehem shelosha vearbaim elep usheba meot usheloshim
Illen zarayat reuben vahavo minyanehon arbein utelata alpin usheba mea utelatin:
Ubene pallu eliab
Ubene pallu eliab:
Ubene eliab nemuel vedatan vaabiram hu-datan vaabiram qerie haeda asher hitztzu al-mosheh veal-aharon baadat-qorach behatztzotam al-Adonai
Ubene eliab nemuel vedatan vaabiram hu datan vaabiram meare kenishta deitkenashu al msheh veal aharon biknishta deqorach beitkannoshehon al Adonai:
Vattiptach haaretz et-piha vattibla otam veet-qorach bemot haeda baakol haesh et chamishshim umatayim ish vayyihyu lenes
Upetachat ara yat pumah ubelaat yatehon veyat qorach bemota diknishta kad akalat eshshata yat matan vechamshin gabra vahavo leat:
Ubene-qorach lo-metu
Ubene qorach la mitu:
Bene shimon lemishpechotam linmuel mishpachat hannemueli leyamin mishpachat hayyamini leyakin mishpachat hayyakini
Bene shimon lezarayathon linmuel zarit nemuel leyamin zarit yamin leyakin zarit yakin:
Lezerach mishpachat hazzarchi leshaul mishpachat hashshauli
Lezerach zarit zarach leshaul zarit shaul:
Elleh mishpechot hashshimoni shenayim veesrim elep umatayim
Illen zarayat shimon asrin uteren alpin umatan:
Bene gad lemishpechotam litzpon mishpachat hatztzeponi lechaggi mishpachat hachaggi leshuni mishpachat hashshuni
Bene gad lezarayathon litzpon zarit tzepon lechaggi zarit chaggi leshuni zarit shuni:
Leozni mishpachat haozni leeri mishpachat haeri
Leozni zarit ozni leeri zarit eri:
Laarod mishpachat haarodi leareli mishpachat haareli
Laarod zarit arodi leareli zarit areli:

Illen zarayat bene gad leminyanehon arbein alpin vachamesh mea:
Bene yehuda er veonan vayyamot er veonan beeretz kenaan
Bene yehuda er veonan umit er veonan beara diknaan:

Vahavo bene yehuda lezarayathon leshela zarit shela leperetz zarit peretz lezerach zarit zarach:

Vahavo bene peretz lechetzron zarit chetzron lechamul zarit chamul:
Elleh mishpechot yehuda lipqudehem shishsha veshibim elep vachamesh meot
Illen zarayat yehuda leminyanehon shabin veshitta alpin vachamesh mea:
Bene yissashkar lemishpechotam tola mishpachat hattolai lepuva mishpachat happuni
Bene yisashkar lezarayathon tola zarit tola lepuvva zarit puva:
Leyashub mishpachat hayyashubi leshimron mishpachat hashshimroni
Leyashub zarit yashub leshimron zarit shimron:
Elleh mishpechot yissashkar lipqudehem arbaa veshishshim elep ushelosh meot
Illen zarayat yisaskar leminyanehon shittin vearbea alpin utelat mea:

Bene zebulun lezarayathon lesered zarit sered leelon zarit elon leyachleel zarit yachleel:
Elleh mishpechot hazzebuloni lipqudehem shishshim elep vachamesh meot
Illen zarayat zebulun leminyanehon shittin alpin vachamesh mea:
Bene yosep lemishpechotam menashsheh veeprayim
Bene yosep lezarayathon menashsheh veeprayim:

Bene menashsheh lemakir zarit makir umakir olid yat gilad legilad zarit gilad:
Elleh bene gilad iezer mishpachat haiezri lecheleq mishpachat hachelqi
Illen bene gilad iezer zarit iezer lecheleq zarit cheleq:

Veasriel zarit asrieli veshekem zarit shekem:
Ushemida mishpachat hashshemidai vecheper mishpachat hachepri
Ushemida zarit shemida vecheper zarit cheper:

Utzelapechad bar cheper la havo leh benin ellahen benan veshum benat tzelapechad machla venoa chagela milka vetirtza:
Elleh mishpechot menashsheh upequdehem shenayim vachamishshim elep usheba meot
Illen zarit menashsheh uminyanehon chamshin uteren alpin usheba mea:

Illen bene eprayim lezarayathon leshutelach zarit shutelach lebeker zarit beker letachan zarit tachan:

Veillen bene shutalach leeran zarit eran:

Illen zarayat bene eprayim leminyanehon telatin uteren alpin vachamesh mea illen bene yosep lezarayathon:

Bene binyamin lezarayathon lebela zarit bela leashbel zarit ashbel laachiram zarit achiram:

Lishpupam zarit shepupam lechupam zarit chupam:
Vayyihyu bene-bela ard venaaman mishpachat haardi lenaaman mishpachat hannaami
Vahavo bene bela ard venaaman zarit haardi lenaaman zarit naami:

Illen bene binyamin lezarayathon uminyanehon arbein vechamsha alpin veshit mea:

Illen bene dan lezarayathon leshucham zarit shucham illen zarayat dan lezarayathon:

Kol zarayat shucham leminyanehon shittin vearba alpin vearba mea:

Bene asher lezarayathon leyimna zarit yimna leyishvi zarit yishvi libria zarit beria:

Libne beria lecheber zarit cheber lemalkiel zarit malkiel:

Veshum bat asher sarach:

Illen zarayat bene asher lemeneyenehon chamshin utelata alpin vearba mea:

Bene naptali lezarayathon leyachtzeel zarit yachtzeel leguni zarit guni:

Leyetzer zarit yetzer leshillem zarit shillem:

Illen zarayat naptali lezarayathon uminyanehon arbein vechamsha alpin vearba mea:

Illen minyane bene yisrael shit mea vechad alpin sheba mea utelatin:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Laelleh techaleq haaretz benachala bemispar shemot
Leillen titpeleg ara beachasana beminyan shemahan:
Larab tarbeh nachalato velamat tamit nachalato ish lepi pequdayv yuttan nachalato
Lesaggie tasgun achasantehon velizire tazarun achasantehon gebar lepum minyanohi tityehab achasanteh:
Ak-begoral yechaleq et-haaretz lishmot mattot-abotam yinchalu
Beram beadba titpeleg yat ara lishmahan shibte abahathon yachsenun:
Al-pi haggoral techaleq nachalato ben rab limat
Al pum adba titpeleg achasantehon ben saggie lizire:
Veelleh pequde hallevi lemishpechotam legereshon mishpachat haggereshunni liqhat mishpachat haqqehati limrari mishpachat hammerari
Veillen minyane levae lezarayathon legereshon zarit gereshon liqhat zarit qehat limrari zarit merari:
Elleh mishpechot levi mishpachat hallibni mishpachat hachebroni mishpachat hammachli mishpachat hammushi mishpachat haqqorchi uqehat holid et-amram
Illen zarayat levi zarit libni zarit chebron zarit machli zarit mushi zarit qorach uqehat olid yat amram:
Veshem eshet amram yokebed bat-levi asher yaleda otah lelevi bemitzrayim vatteled leamram et-aharon veet-mosheh veet miryam achotam
Veshum ittat amram yokebed bat levi diledat yatah lelevi bemitzrayim viledat leamram yat aharon veyat msheh veyat miryam achatehon:
Vayyivvaled leaharon et-nadab veet-abihu et-elazar veet-itamar
Veityelid leaharon yat nadab veyat abihu yat elazar veyat itamar:
Vayyamot nadab vaabihu behaqribam esh-zara lipne Adonai
Umit nadab vaabihu beqarobehon eshshata nukereta qodam Adonai:
Vayyihyu pequdehem shelosha veesrim elep kol-zakar mibben-chodesh vamaela ki lo hotpaqedu betok bene yisrael ki lo-nittan lahem nachala betok bene yisrael
Vahavo minyanehon asrin utelata alpin kol dekura mibbar yarcha uleella are la itmeniu bego bene yisrael are la ityehibat lehon achasana bego bene yisrael:
Elleh pequde mosheh veelazar hakkohen asher paqedu et-bene yisrael bearebot moab al yarden yerecho
Illen minyane msheh veelazar kahana di meno yat bene yisrael bemesherayya demoab al yardena direcho:
Ubeelleh lo-haya ish mippequde mosheh veaharon hakkohen asher paqedu et-bene yisrael bemidbar sinay
Ubeillen la hava gebar mimminyane msheh veaharon kahana di meno yat bene yisrael bemadbera desinay:
Ki-amar Adonai lahem mot yamutu bammidbar velo-notar mehem ish ki im-kaleb ben-yepunneh vihoshua bin-nvn
Are amar Adonai lehon memat yemutun bemadbera vela ishtear minhon enash ellahen kaleb bar yepunneh vihoshua bar nun:
Vattiqrabna benot tzelopchad ben-cheper ben-gilad ben-makir ben-menashsheh lemishpechot menashsheh ben-yosep veelleh shemot benotayv machla noa vechogla umilka vetirtza
Veqareba benat tzelapechad bar cheper bar gilad bar makir bar menashsheh lezarayat menashsheh bar yosep veillen shemahat benateh machla noa vechagela umilka vetirtza:
Vattaamodena lipne mosheh velipne elazar hakkohen velipne hannesiim vekol-haeda petach ohel-moed lemor
Veqama qodam msheh veqodam elazar kahana veqodam rabrebayya vekol kenishta bitra mashkan zimna lememar:
Abinu met bammidbar vehu lo-haya betok haeda hannoadim al-Adonai baadat-qorach ki-becheto met ubanim lo-hayu lo
Abuna mit bemadbera vehu la hava bego kenishta deizdammanu al Adonai biknishta deqorach are bechobeh mit ubenin la havo leh:
Lamma yiggara shem-abinu mittok mishpachto ki en lo ben tena-lanu achuzza betok ache abinu
Lema yitmena shema deabuna miggo zariteh are let leh bar hab lana achasana bego ache abuna:
Vayyaqreb mosheh et-mishpatan lipne Adonai
Veqareb msheh yat dinehen qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh lememar:
Ken benot tzelopchad doberot naton titten lahem achuzzat nachala betok ache abihem vehaabarta et-nachalat abihen lahen
Yaut benat tzelapechad memallelan mittan titten lehon achudat achasana bego ache abuhen vetaabar yat achasanat abuhen lehen:
Veel-bene yisrael tedabber lemor ish ki-yamut uben en lo vehaabartem et-nachalato lebitto
Veim bene yisrael temallel lememar gebar are yemut ubar let leh vetaberun yat achasanteh libratteh:
Veim-en lo bat unetattem et-nachalato leechayv
Veim let leh beratta vetittenun yat achasanteh laachohi:
Veim-en lo achim unetattem et-nachalato laache abiv
Veim let leh achin vetittenun yat achasanteh laache abuhi:
Veim-en achim leabiv unetattem et-nachalato lishero haqqarob elayv mimmishpachto veyarash otah vehayeta libne yisrael lechuqqat mishpat kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Veim let achin laabuhi vetittenun yat achasanteh leqaribeh deqarib leh mizzariteh veyerat yatah utehe libne yisrael ligzerat din kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh aleh el-har haabarim hazzeh ureeh et-haaretz asher natatti libne yisrael
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh saq letura daabarae haden vachaze yat ara di yehabit libne yisrael:
Veraita otah veneesapta el-ammeka gam-atta kaasher neesap aharon achika
Vetecheze yatah vetitkenesh leammayk ap at kema di itkenish aharon achuk:
Kaasher meritem pi bemidbar-tzin bimribat haeda lehaqdisheni bammayim leenehem hem me-meribat qadesh midbar-tzin
Kema di sarebetun al memeri bemadbera detzin bematztzut kenishta leqaddashuti bemayya leenehon innun me matztzut reqam madbera detzin:
Vayedabber mosheh el-Adonai lemor
Umallil msheh im Adonai lememar:
Yipqod Adonai elohe haruchot lekol-basar ish al-haeda
Yemanne Adonai elaha ruchayya lekol bisra gebar al kenishta:
Asher-yetze lipnehem vaasher yabo lipnehem vaasher yotziem vaasher yebiem velo tihyeh adat Adonai katztzon asher en-lahem roeh
Di yippoq qodamehon vedi yeol qodamehon vedi yappeqinnun vedi yeelinnun vela tehe kenishta daAdonai keana di let lehen rae:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh qach-leka et-yehoshua bin-nvn ish asher-rvach bo vesamakta et-yadeka alayv
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh debar lak yat yehoshu bar nun gebar di ruach nebua beh vetismok yat yedak alohi:
Vehaamadta oto lipne elazar hakkohen velipne kol-haeda vetzivvita oto leenehem
Uteqem yateh loqodam elazar kahana veloqodam kol kenishta utepaqqed yateh leenehon:
Venatatta mehodeka alayv lemaan yishmeu kol-adat bene yisrael
Vetitten mizzivak alohi bedil di yeqabbelun minneh kol kenishta dibne yisrael:
Velipne elazar hakkohen yaamod veshaal lo bemishpat haurim lipne Adonai al-piv yetzeu veal-piv yabou hu vekol-bene-yisrael itto vekol-haeda
Veloqodam elazar kahana yequm veyishal leh bedin urayya qodam Adonai al memereh yehon napeqin veal memereh yehon allin hu vekol bene yisrael immeh vekol kenishta:
Vayyaas mosheh kaasher tzivva Adonai oto vayyiqqach et-yehoshua vayyaamidehu lipne elazar hakkohen velipne kol-haeda
Vaabad msheh kema di paqqid Adonai yateh udebar yat yehoshua vaaqimeh qodam elazar kahana uqodam kol kenishta:
Vayyismok et-yadayv alayv vayetzavvehu kaasher dibber Adonai beyad-mosheh
Usemak yat yedohi alohi upaqqedeh kema di mallil Adonai bida demsheh:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Tzav et-bene yisrael veamarta alehem et-qorbani lachmi leishshay reach nichochi tishmeru lehaqrib li bemoado
Paqqed yat bene yisrael vetemar lehon yat qurebani lechem siddur lequrebani leitqabbala beraava titterun leqaraba qodamay bezimneh:
Veamarta lahem zeh haishsheh asher taqribu la-Adonai kebasim bene-shana temimim shenayim layyom ola tamid
Vetemar lehon den qurebana di teqarebun qodam Adonai immerin bene shena shalmin teren leyoma alata tedira:
Et-hakkebes echad taaseh babboqer veet hakkebes hashsheni taaseh ben haarbayim
Yat immera chad taabbed betzapra veyat immera tinyana taabbed ben shimshayya:
Vaasirit haepa solet lemincha belula beshemen katit rebiit hahin
Vechad min asra bitlat sein suleta leminchata depila bimshach ketisha rabut hina:
Olat tamid haasuya behar sinay lereach nichoach ishsheh la-Adonai
Alata tedira deitabida betura desinay leitqabbala beraava qurebana qodam Adonai:
Venisko rebiit hahin lakkebes haechad baqqodesh hassek nesek shekar la-Adonai
Veniskeh rabut hina leimmera chad bequdesha yitnassak nissuk dachamar attiq qodam Adonai:
Veet hakkebes hashsheni taaseh ben haarbayim keminchat habboqer ukenisko taaseh ishsheh reach nichoach la-Adonai
Veyat immera tinyana tabed ben shimshayya keminchat tzapra ukeniskeh tabed qurban demitqabbal beraava qodam Adonai:

Ubeyoma deshabbeta teren immerin bene shena shalmin uteren isronin suleta deminchata depila bimshach veniskeh:
Olat shabbat beshabbatto al-olat hattamid veniskah
Alat shabbeta detitabed beshabbatta al alata tedira veniskah:

Ubereshe yarchekon teqarbun alata qodam Adonai torin bene tore teren udekar chad immerin bene shena shaba shalmin:

Ubechamshat asra yoma leyarcha shebiaa meara qaddish yehe lekon kol ibidat pulechana la taabbedun utechaggun chagga qodam Adonai shaba yomin:
Vehiqrabtem ola ishsheh reach nichoach la-Adonai parim bene-baqar shelosha asar elim shenayim kebasim bene-shana arbaa asar temimim yihyu
Uteqarebun alata qureban demitqabbel beraava qodam Adonai torin bene tore telat asar dikrin teren immerin bene shena arbea asar shalmin yehon:

Uminchathon suleta depila bimshach telata isronin letora chad litlata asar torin teren isronin ledikra chad litren dikrin:
Veissaron issaron lakkebes haechad learbaa asar kebasim
Veisrona isrona leimmera chad learbeat asar immerin:
Useir-izzim echad chattat millebad olat hattamid minchatah veniskah
Utzepir bar izzin chad chattata bar mealat tedira minchatah veniskah:

Beyoma teminaa kenishu tehe lekon kol ibidat pulechan la taabbedun:

Uteqarebun alata qureban demitqabbal beraava qodam Adonai tor chad dekar chad immerin bene shena shaba shalmin:
Minchatam veniskehem lappar laayil velakkebasim bemisparam kammishpat
Minchathon veniskehon letora ledikra uleimmerin beminyanehon kidchaze:
Useir chattat echad millebad olat hattamid uminchatah veniskah
Utzepira dechattata chad bar mealat tedira uminchatah veniskah:
Elleh taasu la-Adonai bemoadekem lebad minnidrekem venidbotekem leolotekem uleminchotekem uleniskekem uleshalmekem
Illen taabbedun qodam Adonai bemoadekon bar minnidrekon venidbatkon laalavatkon uleminchatkon uleniskekon uleniksat qudeshekon:
Vayyomer mosheh el-bene yisrael kekol asher-tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vaamar msheh libne yisrael kekol di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayedabber mosheh el-rashe hammattot libne yisrael lemor zeh haddabar asher tzivva Adonai
Umallil msheh im reshe shibtayya libne yisrael lememar den pitgama di paqqid Adonai:
Ish ki-yiddor neder la-Adonai o-hishshaba shebua lesor issar al-napsho lo yachel debaro kekol-hayyotze mippiv yaaseh
Gebar are yiddar nedar qodam Adonai o yeqayyem qeyam lemesar esar al napsheh la yebattal pitgameh kekal deyippoq mippumeh yaabbed:
Veishsha ki-tiddor neder la-Adonai veasera issar bebet abiha binureha
Veitteta are tiddar nedar qodam Adonai vetesar esar bebet abuha berabyutaha:
Veshama abiha et-nidrah veesarah asher asera al-napshah vehecherish lah abiha veqamu kol-nedareha vekol-issar asher-asera al-napshah yaqum
Veyishma abuha yat nidrah veesarah di asarat al napshah veyishtoq lah abuha viqumun kol nidraha vekol esare di asarat al napshah yequmun:
Veim-heni abiha otah beyom shomo kol-nedareha veesareha asher-asera al-napshah lo yaqum va-Adonai yiselach-la ki-heni abiha otah
Veim adi abuha yatah beyoma dishma kol nidraha veesaraha di asarat al napshah la yequmun umin qodam Adonai yishtebeq lah are adi abuha yatah:
Veim-hayo tiheyeh leish unedareha aleha o mibta sepateha asher asera al-napshah
Veim meheva teheve ligbar venidraha alah o perush sipvataha di asarat al napshah:
Veshama ishah beyom shomo vehecherish lah veqamu nedareha veesareha asher-asera al-napshah yaqumu
Veyishma baalah beyoma dishma veyishtoq lah viqumun nidraha veesaraha di asarat al napshah yequmun:
Veim beyom shemoa ishah yani otah veheper et-nidrah asher aleha veet mibta sepateha asher asera al-napshah va-Adonai yiselach-la
Veim beyoma dishma baalah adi yatah ubattal yat nidraha di alah veyat perush sipvataha di asarat al napshah umin qodam Adonai yishtebeq lah:
Veneder almana ugerusha kol asher-asera al-napshah yaqum aleha
Unedar armela umetarka kol di asarat al napshah yequm alah:
Veim-bet ishah nadara o-asera issar al-napshah bishbua
Veim bet baalah nedarat o asarat esar al napshah beqiyyum:
Veshama ishah vehecherish lah lo heni otah veqamu kol-nedareha vekol-issar asher-asera al-napshah yaqum
Veyishma baalah veyishtoq lah la adi yatehon viqumun kol nidraha vekol esare di asarat al napshah yequmun:
Veim-haper yaper otam ishah beyom shomo kol-motza sepateha lindareha uleissar napshah lo yaqum ishah haperam va-Adonai yiselach-la
Veim battala yebattel yatehon balah beyoma di shema kol appaqut sipvataha lenidraha uleesar napshah la yequmun baalah battelinnun umin qodam Adonai yishtebeq lah:
Kol-neder vekol-shebuat issar leannot napesh ishah yeqimennu veishah yeperennu
Kol nedar vekol qiyyumat esar lesaggapa nepash baalah yeqayyeminnun ubaalah yebattelinnun:
Veim-hacharesh yacharish lah ishah miyyom el-yom veheqim et-kol-nedareha o et-kol-esareha asher aleha heqim otam ki-hecherish lah beyom shomo
Veim mishtaq yishtoq lah baalah miyyom leyom viqayyem yat kol nidraha o yat kol esaraha di alah qayyam yatehon are shateq lah beyoma dishma:
Veim-haper yaper otam achare shomo venasa et-avonah
Veim battala yebattel yatehon batar dishma viqabbal yat chobah:
Elleh hachuqqim asher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh ben ish leishto ben-ab lebitto binureha bet abiha
Illen qeyamayya di paqqid Adonai yat msheh ben gebar leitteteh ben abba libratteh berabyutaha bet abuha:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Neqom niqmat bene yisrael meet hammidyanim achar teasep el-ammeka
Itpera puranut bene yisrael min midyanae batar ken titkenesh leammayk:
Vayedabber mosheh el-haam lemor hechaletzu meittekem anashim latztzaba veyihyu al-midyan latet niqmat-Adonai bemidyan
Umallil msheh im amma lememar zerizu minnekon gubrin lechela vihon al midyan lemehab puranut din amma daAdonai bemidyan:
Elep lammatteh elep lammatteh lekol mattot yisrael tishlechu latztzaba
Alpa leshibta alpa leshibta lekol shibtayya deyisrael teshallechun lechela:
Vayyimmaseru mealpe yisrael elep lammatteh shenem-asar elep chalutze tzaba
Veitbecharu mealpayya deyisrael alpa leshibta tere asar alpin mezareze chela:
Vayyishlach otam mosheh elep lammatteh latztzaba otam veet-pinechas ben-elazar hakkohen latztzaba ukele haqqodesh vachatzotzerot hatterua beyado
Ushelach yatehon msheh alpa leshibta lechela yatehon veyat pinechas bar elazar kahana lechela umane dequdesha vachatzatzrat yabbebta bideh:
Vayyitzbeu al-midyan kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh vayyahargu kol-zakar
Veitchayyalu al midyan kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh uqetalu kol dekura:
Veet-malke midyan haregu al-challehem et-evi veet-reqem veet-tzvr veet-chvr veet-reba chameshet malke midyan veet bilam ben-beor haregu bechareb
Veyat malke midyan qetalu al qetilehon yat evi veyat reqem veyat tzur veyat chur veyat reba chamsha malke midyan veyat bilam bar beor qetalu becharba:
Vayyishbu bene-yisrael et-neshe midyan veet-tappam veet kol-behemtam veet-kol-miqnehem veet-kol-chelam bazazu
Ushebo bene yisrael yat neshe midyan veyat taplehon veyat kol beirehon veyat kol getehon veyat kol niksehon bezo:
Veet kol-arehem bemoshebotam veet kol-tirotam sarepu baesh
Veyat kol qirvehon bemotebanehon veyat kol bet sigdathon oqidu benura:
Vayyiqchu et-kol-hashshalal veet kol-hammalqoach baadam ubabbehema
Ushebo yat kol adaa veyat kol debarta beenasha ubibira:
Vayyabiu el-mosheh veel-elazar hakkohen veel-adat bene-yisrael et-hashshebi veet-hammalqoach veet-hashshalal el-hammachaneh el-arebot moab asher al-yarden yerecho
Veaytiyyu levat msheh ulevat elazar kahana ulevat kenishta dibne yisrael yat shibya veyat debarta veyat adaa lemashrita lemesherayya demoab di al yardena direcho:
Vayyetzeu mosheh veelazar hakkohen vekol-nesie haeda liqratam el-michutz lammachaneh
Unepaqu msheh veelazar kahana vekol rabrebe kenishta loqodamutehon lemibbara lemashrita:
Vayyiqtzop mosheh al pequde hechayil sare haalapim vesare hammeot habbaim mitztzeba hammilchama
Uregez msheh al dimmannan al chela rabbane alpin verabbane maavata daato mechel qeraba:
Vayyomer alehem mosheh hachiyyitem kol-neqeba
Vaamar lehon msheh haqayyemetun kol nuqeba:
Hen henna hayu libne yisrael bidbar bilam limsor-maal ba-Adonai al-debar-peor vattehi hammaggepa baadat Adonai
Ha innun havaa libne yisrael baatzat bilam leshaqqara sheqar qodam Adonai al esaq peor vahavat motana biknishta daAdonai:
Veatta hirgu kol-zakar battap vekol-ishsha yodaat ish lemishkab zakar harogu
Ukean qetulu kol dekura betapla vekol itteta didaat gebar lemishkebe dekura qetulu:
Vekol hattap bannashim asher lo-yadeu mishkab zakar hachayu lakem
Vekol tapla binshayya di la yedaa mishkebe dekura qayyeymu lekon:
Veattem chanu michutz lammachaneh shibat yamim kol horeg nepesh vekol nogea bechalal titechatteu bayyom hashshelishi ubayyom hashshebii attem ushebikem
Veattun shero mibbara lemashrita shaba yomin kol di qetal napsha vekol di qerab beqatila taddun alohi beyoma telitaa ubeyoma shebiaa attun ushebikon:
Vekol-beged vekol-keli-or vekol-maaseh izzim vekol-keli-etz titchattau
Vekol lebush vekol man dimshak vekol obad meazze vekol man dea taddun alohi:
Vayyomer elazar hakkohen el-anshe hatztzaba habbaim lammilchama zot chuqqat hattora asher-tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vaamar elazar kahana legabre chela daato liqraba da gezerat orayta di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Ak et-hazzahab veet-hakkasep et-hannechoshet et-habbarzel et-habbedil veet-haoparet
Beram yat dahaba veyat kaspa yat nechasha yat parzela yat abatza veyat abara:
Kol-dabar asher-yabo baesh taabiru baesh vetaher ak beme nidda yitchatta vekol asher lo-yabo baesh taabiru bammayim
Kol middaam demittaal benura taabrunneh benura veyidke beram beme addayuta yittadde vekol di la mittaal benura taabrunneh bemayya:
Vekibbastem bigdekem bayyom hashshebii utehartem veachar tabou el-hammachaneh
Utechavverun lebushekon beyoma shebiaa vetidkun ubatar ken tealun lemashrita:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh lememar:
Sa et rosh malqoach hashshebi baadam ubabbehema atta veelazar hakkohen verashe abot haeda
Qabbel yat chusheban dabrat shabya beenasha ubibira at veelazar kahana vereshe abahat kenishta:
Vechatzita et-hammalqoach ben topese hammilchama hayyotzeim latztzaba uben kol-haeda
Utepalleg yat debarta ben gabre megiche qeraba dinpaqu lechela uben kol kenishta:
Vaharemota mekes la-Adonai meet anshe hammilchama hayyotzeim latztzaba echad nepesh mechamesh hammeot min-haadam umin-habbaqar umin-hachamorim umin-hatztzon
Vetapresh nesiba qodam Adonai min gabre megiche qeraba dinpaqu lechela chad napsha mechamesh mea min enasha umin tore umin chamare umin ana:
Mimmachatzitam tiqqachu venatatta leelazar hakkohen terumat Adonai
Mippalgutehon tissebun vetitten leelazar kahana aprashuta qodam Adonai:
Umimmachatzit bene-yisrael tiqqach echad achuz min-hachamishshim min-haadam min-habbaqar min-hachamorim umin-hatztzon mikkol-habbehema venatatta otam lalviyyim shomere mishmeret mishkan Adonai
Umippalgut bene yisrael tissab chad deittachad min chamshin min enasha min tore min chamare umin ana mikkol beira vetitten yatehon lelevae natere matterat mashkena daAdonai:
Vayyaas mosheh veelazar hakkohen kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vaabad msheh veelazar kahana kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayehi hammalqoach yeter habbaz asher bazezu am hatztzaba tzon shesh-meot elep veshibim elep vachameshet alapim
Vahava debarta shear bizza di bezo amma di nepaqu lechela ana shit mea veshabin vechamsha alpin:
Ubaqar shenayim veshibim alep
Vetore shabin uteren alpin:
Vachamorim echad veshishshim alep
Vachamare shittin vechad alpin:
Venepesh adam min-hannashim asher lo-yadeu mishkab zakar kol-nepesh shenayim usheloshim alep
Venapsha deenasha min neshayya di la yedaa mishkebe dekura kol napshata telatin uteren alpin:
Vattehi hammechetza cheleq hayyotzeim batztzaba mispar hatztzon shelosh-meot elep usheloshim elep veshibat alapim vachamesh meot
Vahavat palguta chulaq gubrayya di nepaqu lechela minyan ana telat mea utelatin usheba alpin vachamesh mea:
Vayehi hammekes la-Adonai min-hatztzon shesh meot chamesh veshibim
Vahava nesiba qodam Adonai min ana shit mea shabin vechamesh:
Vehabbaqar shishsha usheloshim alep umiksam la-Adonai shenayim veshibim
Vetore telatin veshitta alpin unesibehon qodam Adonai shabin uteren:
Vachamorim sheloshim elep vachamesh meot umiksam la-Adonai echad veshishshim
Vachamare telatin alpin vachamesh mea unesibehon qodam Adonai shittin vechad:
Venepesh adam shishsha asar alep umiksam la-Adonai shenayim usheloshim napesh
Venapsha deenasha shitta asar alpin unesibehon qodam Adonai telatin uteren napshin:
Vayyitten mosheh et-mekes terumat Adonai leelazar hakkohen kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vihab msheh yat nesib aprashuta qodam Adonai leelazar kahana kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Umimmachatzit bene yisrael asher chatza mosheh min-haanashim hatztzobeim
Umippalgut bene yisrael di pelag msheh min gabrayya di nepaqu lechela:
Vattehi mechetzat haeda min-hatztzon shelosh-meot elep usheloshim elep shibat alapim vachamesh meot
Vahavat palgut kenishta min ana telat mea utelatin veshaba alpin vachamesh mea:
Ubaqar shishsha usheloshim alep
Vetore telatin veshitta alpin:
Vachamorim sheloshim elep vachamesh meot
Vachamare telatin alpin vachamesh mea:
Venepesh adam shishsha asar alep
Venapsha deenasha shitta asar alpin:
Vayyiqqach mosheh mimmachatzit bene-yisrael et-haachuz echad min-hachamishshim min-haadam umin-habbehema vayyitten otam lalviyyim shomere mishmeret mishkan Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Unesib msheh mippalgut bene yisrael yat deittachad chad min chamshin min enasha umin beira vihab yatehon lelevae natere matterat mashkena daAdonai kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Vayyiqrebu el-mosheh happequdim asher lealpe hatztzaba sare haalapim vesare hammeot
Veqaribu levat msheh di memannan al alpe chela rabbane alpin verabbane maavata:
Vayyomeru el-mosheh abadeka naseu et-rosh anshe hammilchama asher beyadenu velo-nipqad mimmennu ish
Vaamaru lemsheh abdayk qabbilu yat chushban gabre megiche qeraba di immana vela shega minnana enash:
Vannaqreb et-qorban Adonai ish asher matza keli-zahab etzada vetzamid tabbaat agil vekumaz lekapper al-napshotenu lipne Adonai
Veqarebna yat qurebana daAdonai gebar deashkach man didhab shirin veshibbekin izqan qaddashin umachok lekappara al napshatana qodam Adonai:
Vayyiqqach mosheh veelazar hakkohen et-hazzahab meittam kol keli maaseh
Unesib msheh veelazar kahana yat dahaba minnehon kol man deobada:
Vayehi kol-zehab hatteruma asher herimu la-Adonai shishsha asar elep sheba-meot vachamishshim shaqel meet sare haalapim umeet sare hammeot
Vahava kol dehab aprashuta di aprishu qodam Adonai shitta asar alpin sheba mea vechamshin silin min rabbane alpin umin rabbane maavata:
Anshe hatztzaba bazezu ish lo
Gabre dechela bazu gebar lenapsheh:
Vayyiqqach mosheh veelazar hakkohen et-hazzahab meet sare haalapim vehammeot vayyabiu oto el-ohel moed zikkaron libne-yisrael lipne Adonai
Unesib msheh veelazar kahana yat dahaba min rabbane alpin umaavata veaytiu yateh lemashkan zimna dakerana libne yisrael qodam Adonai:
Umiqneh rab haya libne reuben velibne-gad atzum meod vayyiru et-eretz yazer veet-eretz gilad vehinneh hammaqom meqom miqneh
Ubeir saggi hava libne reuben velibne gad taqqip lachada vachazo yat ara yazer veyat ara gilad veha atra atar keshar lebet beir:
Vayyabou bene-gad ubene reuben vayyomeru el-mosheh veel-elazar hakkohen veel-nesie haeda lemor
Vaato bene gad ubene reuben vaamaru lemsheh uleelazar kahana ulerabrebe kenishta lememar:
Atarot vedibon veyazer venimra vecheshbon veelaleh usebam unebo ubeon
Maklelta umalbeshta vekumerin ubet nimrin ubet chushebana ubaale debaba vekima vesiat bet qeburta demsheh ubeon:
Haaretz asher hikka Adonai lipne adat yisrael eretz miqneh hiv velaabadeka miqneh
Ara di mecha Adonai yat yatebaha qodam kenishta deyisrael ara kashera lebet beir hi uleabdayk it beir:
Vayyomeru im-matzanu chen beeneka yuttan et-haaretz hazzot laabadeka laachuzza al-taabirenu et-hayyarden
Vaamaru im ashkachna rachamin beenayk tityehib yat ara hada leabdayk leachasana la teabrinnana yat yardena:
Vayyomer mosheh libne-gad velibne reuben haachekem yabou lammilchama veattem teshebu poh
Vaamar msheh libne gad velibne reuben haachekon yealun liqraba veattun tetebun haka:
Velamma teniun et-leb bene yisrael meabor el-haaretz asher-natan lahem Adonai
Ulema tonun yat libba dibne yisrael millemebar leara dihab lehon Adonai:
Koh asu abotekem besholchi otam miqqadesh barnea lirot et-haaretz
Keden abadu abahatkon kad shelachit yatehon mereqam gea lemecheze yat ara:
Vayyaalu ad-nachal eshkol vayyiru et-haaretz vayyaniu et-leb bene yisrael lebilti-bo el-haaretz asher-natan lahem Adonai
Useliqu ad nachla deitkala vachazo yat ara veoniu yat libba dibne yisrael bedil dela lemeal leara dihab lehon Adonai:
Vayyichar-ap Adonai bayyom hahu vayyishshaba lemor
Uteqep rugeza daAdonai beyoma hahu veqayyem lememar:
Im-yiru haanashim haolim mimmitzrayim mibben esrim shana vamala et haadama asher nishbati leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob ki lo-milu acharay
Im yechezun gubrayya disliqu mimmitzrayim mibbar asrin shenin uleella yat ara di qayyemit leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob are la ashlimu batar dachalti:
Bilti kaleb ben-yepunneh haqqenizzi vihoshua bin-nvn ki milu achare Adonai
Elahen kaleb bar yepunneh qenizzaa vihoshua bar nun are ashlimu batar dachalta daAdonai:
Vayyichar-ap Adonai beyisrael vayeniem bammidbar arbaim shana ad-tom kol-haddor haoseh hara beene Adonai
Uteqep rugeza daAdonai beyisrael vetaredinnun bemadbera arbein shenin ad desap kol dara daabid debish qodam Adonai:
Vehinneh qamtem tachat abotekem tarbut anashim chattaim lispot od al charon ap-Adonai el-yisrael
Veha qamtun chalap abahatkon talmide gubrayya chayyabaya leosapa od al teqop rugeza daAdonai leyisrael:
Ki teshubun meacharayv veyasap od lehannicho bammidbar veshichattem lekol-haam hazzeh
Are tetubun mibbatar dachalteh veyosep od leacharutehon bemadbera utechabbelun lekol amma haden:
Vayyiggeshu elayv vayyomeru gidrot tzon nibneh lemiqnenu poh vearim letappenu
Veqaribu levateh vaamaru chatrin dean nibne libirana haka veqirvin letaplana:
Vaanachnu nechaletz chushim lipne bene yisrael ad asher im-habionum el-meqomam veyashab tappenu beare hammibtzar mippene yoshebe haaretz
Vaanachna nizdarez mabin qodam bene yisrael ad di neelinnun leatrehon veyetebun taplana beqirvin kerikin min qodam yatebe ara:
Lo nashub el-battenu ad hitnachel bene yisrael ish nachalato
La netub lebetana ad deyachsenun bene yisrael gebar achasanteh:
Ki lo ninchal ittam meeber layyarden vahalea ki baa nachalatenu elenu meeber hayyarden mizracha
Are la nachsin immehon meibra leyardena ulehala are qabbelena achasantana lana meibra leyardena maddinecha:
Vayyomer alehem mosheh im-taasun et-haddabar hazzeh im-techaletzu lipne Adonai lammilchama
Vaamar lehon msheh im tabedun yat pitgama haden im tizdarezun qodam amma daAdonai liqraba:
Veabar lakem kol-chalutz et-hayyarden lipne Adonai ad horisho et-oyebayv mippanayv
Veyaabber lekon kol dimzarez yat yardena qodam amma daAdonai ad ditarek yat baale debabohi min qodamohi:
Venikbesha haaretz lipne Adonai veachar tashubu vihyitem neqiyyim me-Adonai umiyyisrael vehayeta haaretz hazzot lakem laachuzza lipne Adonai
Vetitkebesh ara qodam amma daAdonai ubatar ken tetubun utehon zakkain min qodam Adonai umiyyisrael utehe ara hada lekon leachasana qodam Adonai:
Veim-lo taasun ken hinneh chatatem la-Adonai udeu chattatkem asher timtza etkem
Veim la taabbedun ken ha chabtun qodam Adonai vetidun chobatkon di tashkach yatekon:
Benu-lakem arim letappekem ugederot letzonaakem vehayyotze mippikem taasu
Benu lekon qirvin letaplekon vechatrin leankon udeyippoq mippumekon taabbedun:
Vayyomer bene-gad ubene reuben el-mosheh lemor abadeka yaasu kaasher adoni metzavveh
Vaamaru bene gad ubene reuben lemsheh lememar abdayk yabedun kema di ribboni mepaqqed:
Tappenu nashenu miqnenu vekol-behemtenu yiheyu-sham beare haggilad
Taplana neshana getana vekol beirana yehon tamman beqirve gilad:
Vaabadeka yaabru kol-chalutz tzaba lipne Adonai lammilchama kaasher adoni dober
Veabdayk yaberun kol dimzarez chela qodam amma daAdonai liqraba kema di ribboni memallel:
Vayetzav lahem mosheh et elazar hakkohen veet yehoshua bin-nvn veet-rashe abot hammattot libne yisrael
Upaqqid lehon msheh yat elazar kahana veyat yehoshua bar nun veyat reshe abahat shibtayya libne yisrael:
Vayyomer mosheh alehem im-yaabru bene-gad ubene-reuben ittekem et-hayyarden kol-chalutz lammilchama lipne Adonai venikbesha haaretz lipnekem unetattem lahem et-eretz haggilad laachuzza
Vaamar msheh lehon im yaberun bene gad ubene reuben immekon yat yardena kol dimzaraz liqraba qodam amma daAdonai vetitkebesh ara qodamekon vetittenun lehon yat ara degilad leachasana:
Veim-lo yaabru chalutzim ittekem venochazu betokekem beeretz kenaan
Veim la yaberun mezarezin immekon veyachsenun benekon beara diknaan:
Vayyaanu bene-gad ubene reuben lemor et asher dibber Adonai el-abadeka ken naaseh
Vaatibu bene gad ubene reuben lememar yat di mallil Adonai leabdayk ken nabed:
Nachnu naabor chalutzim lipne Adonai eretz kenaan veittanu achuzzat nachalatenu meeber layyarden
Nachna neibar mezarezin qodam amma daAdonai leara diknaan veimmana achudat achasantana meibra leyardena:
Vayyitten lahem mosheh libne-gad velibne reuben velachatzi shebet menashsheh ben-yosep et-mamleket sichon melek haemori veet-mamleket og melek habbashan haaretz leareha bigbulot are haaretz sabib
Vihab lehon msheh libne gad velibne reuben ulepalgut shibta dimnashsheh bar yosep yat malkevat sichon malka deemoraa veyat malkevat og malka dematnan ara leqirvaha bitchumin qirve ara sechor sechor:
Vayyibnu bene-gad et-dibon veet-atarot veet aroer
Ubeno bene gad yat dibon veyat atarot veyat aroer:
Veet-atrot shopan veet-yazer veyogbeha
Veyat atrot shopan veyat yazer veramata:
Veet-bet nimra veet-bet haran are mibtzar vegidrot tzon
Veyat bet nimra veyat bet haran qirvin kerikan vechatrin dean:
Ubene reuben banu et-cheshbon veet-elale veet qiryatayim
Ubene reuben beno yat cheshbbon veyat elale veyat qiryatayim:
Veet-nebo veet-baal meon musabbot shem veet-sibma vayyiqreu beshemot et-shemot hearim asher banu
Veyat nebo veyat baal meon maqqepan shemahan veyat sibma uqero bishmahan yat shemahat qirvayya di beno:
Vayyeleku bene makir ben-menashsheh gilada vayyilkeduha vayyoresh et-haemori asher-bah
Vaazalu bene makir bar menashsheh legilad vekibshuha vetarik yat emoraa di bah:
Vayyitten mosheh et-haggilad lemakir ben-menashsheh vayyesheb bah
Vihab msheh yat gilad lemakir bar menashsheh viteb bah:
Veyair ben-menashsheh halak vayyilkod et-chavvotehem vayyiqra ethen chavvot yair
Veyair bar menashsheh azal ukebash yat kapranehon uqera yatehen kaprane yair:
Venobach halak vayyilkod et-qenat veet-benoteha vayyiqra la nobach bishmo
Venobach azal ukebash yat qenat veyat kapranaha uqera lah nobach bishmeh:
Elleh mase bene-yisrael asher yatzeu meeretz mitzrayim letzibotam beyad-mosheh veaharon
Illen mattelane bene yisrael di nepaqu meara demitzrayim lechelehon bida demsheh veaharon:
Vayyiktob mosheh et-motzaehem lemasehem al-pi Adonai veelleh masehem lemotzaehem
Uketab msheh yat mappeqanehon lemattelanehon al memera daAdonai veillen mattelanehon lemappeqanehon:

Unetalu merameses beyarcha qadmaa bechamsha asra yoma leyarcha qadmaa mibbatar yoma depischa nepaqu bene yisrael beresh gele leene kol mitzrae:

Umitzrae meqabberin yat di qetal Adonai behon kol bukera ubetaavathon abad Adonai dinin:

Unetalu bene yisrael merameses ushero besukkot:

Unetalu missukkot ushero beetam di bistar madbera:

Unetalu meetam vetab al pum chirata di qodam beel tzepon ushero qodam migdol:

Unetalu mibbene yaaqan ushero bechor haggidgad:

Unetalu meabrona ushero beetzyon gaber:

Unetalu mereqam ushero behor tura bisyape ara deedom:

Useleq aharon kahana lehor tura al memera daAdonai umit tamman bishnat arbein lemeppaq bene yisrael meara demitzrayim beyarcha chamishshaa bechad leyarcha:

Veaharon bar mea veasrin utelat shenin kad mit behor tura:

Ushema kenaanaa malka daarad vehu yateb bidroma beara diknaan bemete bene yisrael:

Unetalu mehor tura ushero betzalmona:

Unetalu mitztzalmona ushero bepunon:

Unetalu mippunon ushero beobot:

Unetalu meobot ushero bimgizzat abarae bitchum moab:

Unetalu mimmegizzata ushero bedibon gad:

Unetalu middibon gad ushero bealmon diblatayema:

Unetalu mealmon diblatayma ushero beture daabarae diqodam nebo:

Umallil Adonai im msheh bemesherayya demoab al yardena direcho lememar:

Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are attun aberin yat yardena leara diknaan:
Vehorashtem et-kol-yoshebe haaretz mippenekem veibbadtem et kol-maskiyyotam veet kol-tzalme massekotam teabbedu veet kol-bamotam tashmidu
Utetarekun yat kol yatebe ara min qodamekon vetebedun yat kol bet sigdathon veyat kol tzalme mattekathon tebedun veyat kol bamathon teshetzun:
Vehorashtem et-haaretz vishabtem-bah ki lakem natatti et-haaretz lareshet otah
Utetarekun yat yatebe ara vetetebun bah are lekon yehabit yat ara lemerat yatah:
Vehitnachaltem et-haaretz begoral lemishpechotekem larab tarbu et-nachalato velamat tamit et-nachalato el asher-yetze lo shamma haggoral lo yihyeh lemattot abotekem titnechalu
Vetachsenun yat ara beadba lezarayatkon lesaggie tasgun yat achasantehon velizire tazirun yat achasantehon lidyippoq leh tamman adba di leh yehe leshibte abahatkon tachsenun:
Veim-lo torishu et-yoshebe haaretz mippenekem vehaya asher totiru mehem lesikkim beenekem velitzninim betziddekem vetzareru etkem al-haaretz asher attem yoshebim bah
Veim la tetarekun yat yatebe ara min qodamekon vihe di tasharun minnehon lesian natelan zeyan laqiblekon ulemashshiryan maqpankon viiqun lekon al ara di attun yatebin bah:
Vehaya kaasher dimmiti laasot lahem eeseh lakem
Vihe kema di chashabit lemebad lehon aabbed lekon:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Tzav et-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki-attem baim el-haaretz kenaan zot haaretz asher tippol lakem benachala eretz kenaan ligbuloteha
Paqqed yat bene yisrael vetemar lehon are attun alin leara diknaan da ara di titpeleg lekon beachasana ara diknaan litchumaha:
Vehaya lakem peat-negeb mimmidbar-tzin al-yede edom vehaya lakem gebul negeb miqtzeh yam-hammelach qedema
Vihe lekon ruach daroma mimmadbera detzin al techume edom vihe lekon techum daroma misseyape yamma demilcha qidduma:
Venasab lakem haggebul minnegeb lemaaleh aqrabbim veabar tzina vehayu totzeotayv minnegeb leqadesh barnea veyatza chatzar-addar veabar atzmona
Veyaschar lekon techuma midderoma lemasqana deaqrabbim viibar letzin vihon mappeqanohi midderoma lirqam gea veyippoq lachatzar addar viibar leatzmon:
Venasab haggebul meatzmon nachla mitzrayim vehayu totzeotayv hayyamma
Veyaschar techuma meatzmon lenachala demitzrayim vihon mappeqanohi leyamma:
Ugebul yam vehaya lakem hayyam haggadol ugebul zeh-yihyeh lakem gebul yam
Utechum maarba vihe lekon yamma rabba utechumeh den yehe lekon techum maarba:
Vezeh-yihyeh lakem gebul tzapon min-hayyam haggadol tetau lakem hor hahar
Veden yehe lekon techum tzippuna min yamma rabba tekavvenun lekon lehor tura:
Mehor hahar tetau lebo chamat vehayu totzeot haggebul tzedada
Mehor tura tekavvenun limte chamat vihon mappeqanohi ditchuma litzdad:
Veyatza haggebul ziprona vehayu totzeotayv chatzar enan zeh-yihyeh lakem gebul tzapon
Veyippoq techuma lezipron vihon mappeqanohi lachatzar enan den yehe lekon techum tzippuna:
Vehitavvitem lakem ligbul qedema mechatzar enan shepama
Utekavvenun lekon litchum qidduma mechatzar enan lishpam:
Veyarad haggebul mishshepam haribla miqqedem laayin veyarad haggebul umacha al-ketep yam-kinneret qedema
Veyechot techuma mishshepam leribla mimmadnach laayin veyechot techuma veyimte al kep yam ginesar qidduma:

Veyechot techuma leyardena vihon mappeqanohi leyamma demilcha da tehe lekon ara litchumaha sechor sechor:

Vetimshechun mibbara leqarta yat ruach qidduma teren alpin beammin veyat ruach deroma teren alpin beammin veyat ruach maarba teren alpin beammin veyat ruach tzippuna teren alpin beammin veqarta bimtzia den yehe lehon revache qirvayya:
Veet hearim asher tittenu lalviyyim et shesh-are hammiqlat asher tittenu lanus shamma harotzeach vaalehem tittenu arbaim ushetayim ir
Veyat qirvayya di tittenun lelevae yat shit qirve shezabuta di tittenun lemearaq tamman qatola vaalehon tittenun arbein vetarten qirvin:
Kol-hearim asher tittenu lalviyyim arbaim ushemoneh ir ethen veet-migreshehen
Kol qirvayya di tittenun lelevae arbein vetamne qirvin yatehen veyat revachehen:
Vehearim asher tittenu meachuzzat bene-yisrael meet harab tarbu umeet hameat tamitu ish kepi nachalato asher yinchalu yitten mearayv lalviyyim
Veqirvayya di tittenun meachudat bene yisrael min saggie tasgun umin zeire tazirun gebar kepum achasanteh di yachsenun yitten miqqirvohi lelevae:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki attem oberim et-hayyarden artza kenaan
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are attun aberin yat yardena leara diknaan:
Vehiqritem lakem arim are miqlat tihyena lakem venas shamma rotzeach makkeh-nepesh bishgaga
Utezammenun lekon qirvin qirve shezabuta yehevyan lekon veyearoq letamman qatola deyiqtol napsha beshalu:
Vehayu lakem hearim lemiqlat miggoel velo yamut harotzeach ad-omdo lipne haeda lammishpat
Vihon lekon qirvayya leshezaba miggael dema vela yemut qatola ad deyequm qodam kenishta ledina:
Vehearim asher tittenu shesh-are miqlat tihyena lakem
Veqirvayya di tittenun shit qirve shezabuta yehevyan lekon:
Et shelosh hearim tittenu meeber layyarden veet shelosh hearim tittenu beeretz kenaan are miqlat tihyena
Yat telat qirvayya tittenun meibra leyardena veyat telat qirvayya tittenun beara diknaan qirve shezabuta yehevyan:
Libne yisrael velagger velattoshab betokam tihyena shesh-hearim haelleh lemiqlat lanus shamma kol-makkeh-nepesh bishgaga
Libne yisrael ulegiyyora uletotabaya debenekon yehevyan shit qirvayya haillen leshezaba lemearoq letamman kol deyiqtol napsha beshalu:
Veim-bikli barzel hikkahu vayyamot rotzeach hu mot yumat harotzeach
Veim beman deparzela mechahi veqateleh qatola hu itqetala yitqetel qatola:
Veim beeben yad asher-yamut bah hikkahu vayyamot rotzeach hu mot yumat harotzeach
Veim beabna demitnaseba bida dehi kemissat di yemut bah mechahi veqateleh qatola hu itqetala yitqetel qatola:
O bikli etz-yad asher-yamut bo hikkahu vayyamot rotzeach hu mot yumat harotzeach
O beman dea demitnaseb bida dehi kemissat di yemut beh mechahi veqateleh qatola hu itqetala yitqetal qatola:
Goel haddam hu yamit et-harotzeach bepigo-bo hu yemitennu
Gael dema hu yiqtol yat qatola kad itchayyab leh min dina hu yiqtelinneh:
Veim-besina yehdopennu o-hishlik alayv bitzdiyya vayyamot
Veim besana dechahi o rema alohi bekamna veqateleh:
O beeba hikkahu beyado vayyamot mot-yvmat hammakkeh rotzeach hu goel haddam yamit et-harotzeach bepigo-bo
O bidbabu mechahi bideh veqateleh itqetala yitqetel machaya qatola hu gael dema yiqtol yat qatola kad itchayyab leh min dina:
Veim-bepeta belo-eba hadapo o-hishlik alayv kol-keli belo tzediyya
Veim bitkep bela debabu dechahi o rema alohi kol man bela keman leh:
O bekol-eben asher-yamut bah belo reot vayyappel alayv vayyamot vehu lo-oyeb lo velo mebaqqesh raato
O bekal abna dehi kemissat di yemut bah bela chaze urema alohi veqateleh vehu la sane leh vela taba bisheteh:
Veshapetu haeda ben hammakkeh uben goel haddam al hammishpatim haelleh
Vidunun kenishta ben machaya uben gael dema al dinayya haillen:
Vehitztzilu haeda et-harotzeach miyyad goel haddam veheshibu oto haeda el-ir miqlato asher-nas shamma veyashab bah ad-mot hakkohen haggadol asher-mashach oto beshemen haqqodesh
Vishezebun kenishta yat qatola miyyad gael dema vitibun yateh kenishta leqiryat shezabuteh di araq letamman viteb bah ad dimut kahana rabba di rabbi yateh bimshach qudesha:
Veim-yatzo yetze harotzeach et-gebul ir miqlato asher yanus shamma
Veim mippaq yippoq qatola yat techum qiryat shezabuteh di araq letamman:
Umatza oto goel haddam michutz ligbul ir miqlato veratzach goel haddam et-harotzeach en lo dam
Veyashkach yateh gael dema mibbara litchum qiryat shezabuteh veyiqtol gael dema yat qatola let leh dema:
Ki beir miqlato yesheb ad-mot hakkohen haggadol veachare mot hakkohen haggadol yashub harotzeach el-eretz achuzzato
Are beqiryat shezabuteh yitteb ad dimut kahana rabba ubatar dimut kahana rabba yetub qatola laara achasanteh:
Vehayu elleh lakem lechuqqat mishpat ledorotekem bekol moshebotekem
Vihon illen lekon ligzerat din ledarekon bekol motebanekon:
Kol-makkeh-nepesh lepi edim yirtzach et-harotzeach veed echad lo-yaaneh benepesh lamut
Kol deyiqtol napsha lepum sahadin yiqtol yat qatola vesahid chad la yashed beenash lemiqtal:
Velo-tiqchu koper lenepesh rotzeach asher-hv rasha lamut ki-mot yumat
Vela teqabbelun mamon al enash qatol di hu chayyab lemiqtal are itqetala yitqetel:
Velo-tiqchu koper lanus el-ir miqlato lashub lashebet baaretz ad-mot hakkohen
Vela teqabbelun mamon lemearoq leqiryat shezabuteh lemittub lemittab beara ad dimut kahana:
Velo-tachanipu et-haaretz asher attem bah ki haddam hu yachanip et-haaretz velaaretz lo-yekuppar laddam asher shuppak-bah ki-im bedam shopeko
Vela techayyebun yat ara di attun bah are dema hu mechayyab yat ara uleara la mitkapper al dam zakkay deittashad bah ellahen bedam ashdeh:
Velo tetamme et-haaretz asher attem yoshebim bah asher ani shoken betokah ki ani Adonai shoken betok bene yisrael
Vela tesaabun yat ara di attun yatebin bah di shekineti shareya begavvah are ana Adonai dishkinti shareya bego bene yisrael:
Vayyiqrebu rashe haabot lemishpachat bene-gilad ben-makir ben-menashsheh mimmishpechot bene yosep vayedabberu lipne mosheh velipne hannesiim rashe abot libne yisrael
Veqaribu reshe abahata lezarit bene gilad bar makir bar menashsheh mizzarayat bene yosep umallilu qodam msheh veqodam rabrebayya reshe abahata libne yisrael:
Vayyomeru et-adoni tzivva Adonai latet et-haaretz benachala begoral libne yisrael vadoni tzuvva ba-Adonai latet et-nachalat tzelopchad achinu libnotayv
Vaamaru yat ribboni paqqid Adonai lemittan yat ara beachasana beadba libne yisrael veribboni itpaqqad bememera daAdonai lemittan yat achasanat tzelapechad achuna libnateh:
Vehayu leechad mibbene shibte bene-yisrael lenashim venigrea nachalatan minnachalat abotenu venosap al nachalat hammatteh asher tihyena lahem umiggoral nachalatenu yiggarea
Vihevyan lechad mibbene shibtayya dibne yisrael linshin vetitmena achasantehon meachasanat abhatana vetittosap al achasanat shibtayya di yehevyan lehon umeadab achasanta yittimna:
Veim-yihyeh hayyobel libne yisrael venosepa nachalatan al nachalat hammatteh asher tihyena lahem uminnachalat matteh abotenu yiggara nachalatan
Veim yehe yobela libne yisrael vetittosap achasantehon al achasanat shibta di tehevyan lehon umeachasanat shibta daabhatana yittimna achasantehen:
Vayetzav mosheh et-bene yisrael al-pi Adonai lemor ken matteh bene-yosep doberim
Upaqqid msheh yat bene yisrael al memera daAdonai lememar yaut shibta dibne yosep memallelin:
Zeh haddabar asher-tzivva Adonai libnot tzelopchad lemor lattob beenehem tihyena lenashim ak lemishpachat matteh abihem tihyena lenashim
Den pitgama di paqqid Adonai libnat tzelapechad lememar lidtaqqin beenehon tehevyan linshin beram lezarit shibta daabuhen tehevyan linshin:
Velo-tissob nachala libne yisrael mimmatteh el-matteh ki ish benachalat matteh abotayv yidbequ bene yisrael
Vela taschar achasana libne yisrael mishshibta leshibta are gebar beachasanat shibta daabahatohi yiddabbequn bene yisrael:
Vekol-bat yoreshet nachala mimmattot bene yisrael leechad mimmishpachat matteh abiha tihyeh leishsha lemaan yireshu bene yisrael ish nachalat abotayv
Vekol beratta yaretat achasana mishshibtayya dibne yisrael lechad mizzarit shibta daabuha tehe leintu bedil di yeretun bene yisrael gebar achasanat abahatohi:
Velo-tissob nachala mimmatteh lematteh acher ki-ish benachalato yidbequ mattot bene yisrael
Vela taschar achasana mishshibta leshibta ocharana are gebar beachasanteh yiddebequn shibtayya dibne yisrael:
Kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh ken asu benot tzelopchad
Kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh ken abadu benat tzelapechad:
Vattihyena machla tirtza vechogla umilka venoa benot tzelopchad libne dodehen lenashim
Vahavaa machla tirtza vechagela umilka venoa benat tzelapechad libne ache abuhen linshin:
Mimmishpechot bene-menashsheh ben-yosep hayu lenashim vattehi nachalatan al-matteh mishpachat abihen
Mizarayat bene menashsheh bar yosep havaa linshin vahavat achasantehen al shibta zarit abuhen:
Elleh hammitzvot vehammishpatim asher tzivva Adonai beyad-mosheh el-bene yisrael bearebot moab al yarden yerecho
Illen piqqodayya vedinayya di paqqid Adonai bida demsheh levat bene yisrael bemesherayya demoab al yardena direcho:
Deuteronomy: Elleh haddebarim asher dibber mosheh el-kol-yisrael beeber hayyarden bammidbar baaraba mol sup ben-paran uben-topel velaban vachatzerot vedi zahab

Illen pitgamayya di mallil msheh im kol yisrael beibra deyardena okach yatehon al dechabu bemadbera veal deargizu bemeshera loqobel yam sup beparan deittappalu al manna ubachatzerot deargizu al bisra veal daabadu egal didhab:
Achad asar yom mechoreb derek har-seir ad qadesh barnea
Mahalak chad asar yomin mechoreb orach tura deseir ad reqam gea:
Vayehi bearbaim shana beashte-asar chodesh beechad lachodesh dibber mosheh el-bene yisrael kekol asher tzivva Adonai oto alehem
Vahava bearbein shenin bechad asar yarcha bechad leyarcha mallil msheh im bene yisrael kekol di paqqid Adonai yateh levatehon:
Achare hakkoto et sichon melek haemori asher yosheb becheshbon veet og melek habbashan asher-yosheb beashtarot beedrei
Batar dimcha yat sichon malka deemoraa deyateb becheshbon veyat og malka dematnan deyateb beashtarot beedrei:
Beeber hayyarden beeretz moab hoil mosheh beer et-hattora hazzot lemor
Beibra deyardena beara demoab shari msheh paresh yat ulepan orayta hada lememar:
Adonai elohenu dibber elenu bechoreb lemor rab-lakem shebet bahar hazzeh
Adonai elahana mallil immana bechoreb lememar saggi lekon ditebtun betura haden:
Penu useu lakem ubou har haemori veel-kol-shekenayv baaraba bahar ubashshepela ubannegeb ubechop hayyam eretz hakkenaani vehallebanon ad-hannahar haggadol nehar-perat
Itpenu vetulu lekon veulu letura deemoraa ulekal magirohi bemesherayya betura ubishpelta ubidroma ubispar yamma ara diknaanaa velibnan ad nahara rabba nahara perat:
Reeh natatti lipnekem et-haaretz bou ureshu et-haaretz asher nishba Adonai laabotekem leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob latet lahem ulezaram acharehem
Chaze dihabit qodamekon yat ara ulu veachasinu yat ara di qayyam Adonai laabahatekon leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob lemittan lehon velibnehon batrehon:
Vaomar alekem baet hahiv lemor lo-vkal lebaddi seet etkem
Vaamarit lekon beiddana hahi lememar let ana yakil bilchodi lesobara yatekon:
Adonai elohekem hirba etkem vehinnekem hayyom kekokebe hashshamayim larob
Adonai elahakon asge yatekon veha itekon yoma den kekokebe shemayya lemisge:
Adonai elohe abotekem yosep alekem kakem elep peamim vibarek etkem kaasher dibber lakem
Adonai elaha daabahatekon yosep alekon kevatekon alap zimnin vibarek yatekon kema di mallil lekon:
Eka essa lebaddi torchakem umassaakem veribekem
Ekden esobar bilchodi tarechakon veisqekon vedinekon:
Habu lakem anashim chakamim unebonim viduim leshibtekem vaasimem berashekem
Habu lekon gubrin chakkimin vesukeletanun umaddean leshibtekon veemanninnun reshin alekon:
Vattaanu oti vattomeru tob-haddabar asher-dibbarta laasot
Vaatebtun yati vaamartun taqqin pitgama di mallelta lemebad:
Vaeqqach et-rashe shibtekem anashim chakamim viduim vaetten otam rashim alekem sare alapim vesare meot vesare chamishshim vesare asarot veshoterim leshibtekem
Udebarit yat reshe shibtekon gubrin chakkimin umaddean umanneti yatehon reshin alekon rabbane alpin verabbane maavata verabbane chamshin verabbane issoreyata vesarekin leshibtekon:
Vaatzavveh et-shopetekem baet hahiv lemor shamoa ben-achekem ushepattem tzedeq ben-ish uben-achiv uben gero
Upaqqedit yat dayanekon beiddana hahi lememar shemau ben achekon utedunun qusheta ben gabra uben achuhi uben giyyoreh:
Lo-takkiru panim bammishpat kaqqaton kaggadol tishmaun lo taguru mippene-ish ki hammishpat lelohim hu vehaddabar asher yiqsheh mikkem taqribun elay ushemativ
La tishtemodeun appin bedina mille zeera kerabba tishmeun la tidchalun min qodam gabra are dina daAdonai hu upitgama di yiqshe minnekon teqarebun levati veeshmeinneh:
Vaatzavveh etkem baet hahiv et kol-haddebarim asher taasun
Upaqqedit yatekon beiddana hahi yat kol pitgamayya di tabedun:
Vannissa mechoreb vannelek et kol-hammidbar haggadol vehannora hahu asher reitem derek har haemori kaasher tzivva Adonai elohenu otanu vannabo ad qadesh barnea
Unetalna mechoreb vehallikena yat kol madbera rabba udechila hahu di chazetun orach tura deemoraa kema di paqqid Adonai elahana yatana vaatena ad reqam gea:
Vaomar alekem batem ad-har haemori asher-Adonai elohenu noten lanu
Vaamarit lekon atetun ad tura deemoraa daAdonai elahana yaheb lana:
Reeh natan Adonai eloheka lepaneka et-haaretz aleh resh kaasher dibber Adonai elohe aboteka lak al-tira veal-techat
Chaze yehab Adonai elahak qodamak yat ara saq achasan kema di mallil Adonai elaha daabahatak lak la tidchal vela tittebar:
Vattiqrebun elay kullekem vattomeru nishlecha anashim lepanenu veyachperu-lanu et-haaretz veyashibu otanu dabar et-hadderek asher naaleh-bah veet hearim asher nabo alehen
Uqerebtun levati kullekon vaamartun nishlach gubrin qodamana vialalun lana yat ara vitibun yatana pitgama yat orcha di nisseq bah veyat qirvayya di neol lehen:
Vayyitab beenay haddabar vaeqqach mikkem shenem asar anashim ish echad lashshabet
Ushepar beenay pitgama udebarit minnekon teren asar gubrin gabra chad leshibta:
Vayyipnu vayyaalu hahara vayyabou ad-nachal eshkol vayeraggelu otah
Veitpeniyyu useliqu letura vaato ad nachala deetkala veallilu yatah:
Vayyiqchu beyadam mipperi haaretz vayyoridu elenu vayyashibu otanu dabar vayyomeru toba haaretz asher-Adonai elohenu noten lanu
Unesibu bidehon meibba deara vaachitu lana vaatibu yatana pitgama vaamaru taba ara daAdonai elahana yaheb lana:
Velo abitem laalot vattamru et-pi Adonai elohekem
Vela abitun lemissaq vesarebtun al memera daAdonai elahakon:
Vatteragenu beoholekem vattomeru besinat Adonai otanu hotzianu meeretz mitzrayim latet otanu beyad haemori lehashmidenu
Veitraamtun bemashkenekon vaamartun bidsane Adonai yatana appeqana meara demitzrayim lemimsar yatana bida deemoraa leshetzayutana:
Ana anachnu olim achenu hemassu et-lebabenu lemor am gadol varam mimmennu arim gedolot ubetzurot bashshamayim vegam-bene anaqim rainu sham
Lean anachna saleqin achana tebaru yat libbana lememar am saggi vetaqqip minnana qirvin rabreban ukerikan ad tzet shemayya veap bene gibbarae chazena tamman:
Vaomar alekem lo-taartzun velo-tireun mehem
Vaamarit lekon la tittaberun vela tidchalun minnehon:
Adonai elohekem haholek lipnekem hu yillachem lakem kekol asher asa ittekem bemitzrayim leenekem
Adonai elahakon dimdabbar qodamekon hu yegiach lekon kekol di abad immekon bemitzrayim leenekon:
Ubammidbar asher raita asher nesaaka Adonai eloheka kaasher yissa-ish et-beno bekol-hadderek asher halaktem ad-boakem ad-hammaqom hazzeh
Ubemadbera di chazeta di soberak Adonai elahak kema di mesobar gebar yat bereh bekol orcha di hallektun ad metekon ad atra haden:
Ubaddabar hazzeh enekem maaminim ba-Adonai elohekem
Ubepitgama haden letekon mehemenin bememera daAdonai elahakon:
Haholek lipnekem badderek latur lakem maqom lachanotekem baesh layla larotekem badderek asher teleku-ba ubeanan yomam
Di medabber qodamekon beorcha leatqenaa lekon atar bet mesheri leashrayutekon beammuda deeshshata beleleya leachazayutekon beorcha di tehakun bah ubeammuda daanana bimama:
Vayyishma Adonai et-qol dibrekem vayyiqtzop vayyishshaba lemor
Ushemia qodam Adonai yat qal pitgamekon uregez veqayyam lememar:
Im-yireh ish baanashim haelleh haddor hara hazzeh et haaretz hattoba asher nishbati latet laabotekem
Im yecheze gebar begubrayya haillen dara bisha haden yat ara tabta di qayyemit lemittan laabahatekon:
Zulati kaleb ben-yepunneh hu yirenna velo-etten et-haaretz asher darak-bah ulebanayv yaan asher mille achare Adonai
Ellahen kaleb bar yepunneh hu yechezinnah veleh etten yat ara di derak bah velibnohi chalap di ashlim batar dachalta daAdonai:
Gam-bi hitannap Adonai biglalkem lemor gam-atta lo-tabo sham
Ap alay hava regaz min qodam Adonai bedilekon lememar ap at la teol tamman:
Yehoshua bin-nvn haomed lepaneka hu yabo shamma oto chazzeq ki-hv yanchilenna et-yisrael
Yehoshua bar nun deqaem qodamak hu yeol tamman yateh taqqep are hu yachseninnah leyisrael:
Vetappekem asher amartem labaz yihyeh ubenekem asher lo-yadeu hayyom tob vara hemma yabou shamma velahem ettenenna vehem yirashuha
Vetaplekon di amartun lebizza yehon ubenekon di la yedau yoma den tab ubish innun yaalun letamman ulehon etteninnah veinnun yeretunnah:
Veattem penu lakem useu hammidbara derek yam-svp
Veattun itpeniyyu lekon vetulu lemadbera orach yamma desup:
Vattaanu vattomeru elay chatanu la-Adonai anachnu naaleh venilchamnu kekol asher-tzivvanu Adonai elohenu vattachgeru ish et-kele milchamto vattahinu laalot hahara
Vaatebtun vaamartun li chabna qodam Adonai anachna nissaq unegiach beh qerab kekol di paqqedana Adonai elahana vezareztun gebar yat mane qerabeh vesharetun lemissaq letura:
Vayyomer Adonai elay emor lahem lo taalu velo-tillachamu ki enenni beqirbekem velo tinnagepu lipne oyebekem
Vaamar Adonai li emar lehon la tissequn vela tegichun qerab are let shekinti shareya benekon vela tittaberun qodam baale debabekon:
Vaadabber alekem velo shematem vattamru et-pi Adonai vattazidu vattaalu hahara
Umallelit immekon vela qabbeltun vesarebtun al gezerat memera daAdonai vearshatun useleqtun letura:
Vayyetze haemori hayyosheb bahar hahu liqratkem vayyirdepu etkem kaasher taasena haddeborim vayyakketu etkem beseir ad-chorma
Unepaq emoraa deyateb betura hahu leqaddamutekon uredapu yatekon kema di nattezan dabbaryata uteradu yatekon beseir ad charema:
Vattashubu vattibku lipne Adonai velo-shama Adonai beqolekem velo heezin alekem
Vetabtun ubekitun qodam Adonai vela qabbil Adonai tzelotekon vela atztzet lemillekon:
Vatteshebu beqadesh yamim rabbim kayyamim asher yeshabtem
Vitebtun birqam yomin saggiin keyomayya di yetebtun:
Vannepen vannissa hammidbara derek yam-svp kaasher dibber Adonai elay vannasob et-har-seir yamim rabbim
Veitpenena unetalna lemadbera orach yamma desup kema di mallil Adonai immi veaqqepena yat tura deseir yomin saggiin:
Vayyomer Adonai elay lemor
Vaamar Adonai li lememar:
Rab-lakem sob et-hahar hazzeh penu lakem tzapona
Saggi lekon deaqqeptun yat tura haden itpeniyyu lekon tzippuna:
Veet-haam tzav lemor attem oberim bigbul achekem bene-esav hayyoshebim beseir veyireu mikkem venishmartem meod
Veyat amma paqqed lememar attun aberin bitchum achukon bene esav deyatebin beseir veyidchalun minnekon vetistammerun lachada:
Al-titgaru bam ki lo-etten lakem meartzam ad midrak kap-ragel ki-yerushsha leesav natatti et-har seir
La titgarun behon are la etten lekon mearahon ad midrak parsat rigla are yerutta leesav yehabit yat tura deseir:
Okel tishberu meittam bakkesep vaakaltem vegam-mayim tikru meittam bakkesep ushetitem
Ibura tizbenun minnehon bekaspa vetekelun veap mayya tikrun minnehon bekaspa vetishtun:
Ki Adonai eloheka berakka bekol maaseh yadeka yada lekteka et-hammidbar haggadol hazzeh zeh arbaim shana Adonai eloheka immak lo chasarta dabar
Are Adonai elahak berekak bekol obad yedak sappeq lak tzorkak bemehekak lemadbera rabba haden denan arbein shenin memera daAdonai elahak besaaddak la menata middaam:
Vannaabor meet achenu bene-esav hayyoshebim beseir midderek haaraba meelat umeetzyon gaber vannepen vannaabor derek midbar moab
Vaabarna miqqodam achuna bene esav deyatebin beseir meorach meshera meelat umeetzyon gaber veitpenena vaabarna orach madbera demoab:
Vayyomer Adonai elay al-tatzar et-moab veal-titgar bam milchama ki lo-etten leka meartzo yerushsha ki libne-lot natatti et-ar yerushsha
Vaamar Adonai li la tetzur al moabae vela titgare lemebad immehon qerab are la etten lak meareh yerutta are libne lot yehabit yat lechayat yerutta:
Haemim lepanim yashebu bah am gadol verab varam kaanaqim
Emetane milleqadmin yetibu bah am rab vesaggi vetaqqip kegibbarayya:
Repaim yechashebu ap-hem kaanaqim vehammoabim yiqreu lahem emim
Gibbarae mitchashshebin ap innun kegibbarae umoabae yiqran lehon emetane:
Ubeseir yashebu hachorim lepanim ubene esav yirashum vayyashmidum mippenehem vayyeshebu tachtam kaasher asa yisrael leeretz yerushshato asher-natan Adonai lahem
Ubeseir yetibu chorae milleqadmin ubene esav tarekunnun veshetzayunnun miqqadamehon vitibu beatrehon kema di abad yisrael leara yeruttateh dihab Adonai lehon:
Atta qumu veibru lakem et-nachal zared vannaabor et-nachal zared
Kean qumu veibaru lekon yat nachala dezared vaabarna yat nachala dezared:
Vehayyamim asher-halaknu miqqadesh barnea ad asher-abarnu et-nachal zered sheloshim ushemoneh shana ad-tom kol-haddor anshe hammilchama miqqereb hammachaneh kaasher nishba Adonai lahem
Veyomayya di hallekna mereqam gea ad di abarna yat nachala dezered telatin vetamne shenin ad desap kol dara gubre megiche qeraba miggo mashrita kema di qayyim Adonai lehon:
Vegam yad-Adonai hayeta bam lehummam miqqereb hammachaneh ad tummam
Veap macha min qodam Adonai havat behon leshetzayutehon miggo mashrita ad dishlimu:
Vayehi kaasher-tammu kol-anshe hammilchama lamut miqqereb haam
Vahava kad shelimu kol gubre megiche qeraba limmat miggo amma:
Vayedabber Adonai elay lemor
Umallil Adonai immi lememar:
Atta ober hayyom et-gebul moab et-ar
At aber yoma den yat techum moab yat lechayat:
Veqarabta mul bene ammon al-tetzurem veal-titgar bam ki lo-etten meeretz bene-ammon leka yerushsha ki libne-lot netattiha yerushsha
Vetiqrab loqobel bene ammon la tetzur alehon vela titgare lemebad immehon qerab are la etten meara bene ammon lak yerutta are libne lot yehabittah yerutta:
Eretz-repaim techasheb ap-hiv repaim yashebu-ba lepanim vehaammonim yiqreu lahem zamzummim
Ara gibbarayya mitchashsheba ap hi gibbarae yatibu bah milleqadmin veammonae qeran lehon chushbane:
Am gadol verab varam kaanaqim vayyashmidem Adonai mippenehem vayyirashum vayyeshebu tachtam
Am rab vesaggi vetaqqip kegibbarayya veshetzinnun Adonai miqqodamehon vetarekunnun vitibu beatrehon:
Kaasher asa libne esav hayyoshebim beseir asher hishmid et-hachori mippenehem vayyirashum vayyeshebu tachtam ad hayyom hazzeh
Kema di abad libne esav deyatebin beseir di shetze yat chorae miqqodamehon vetarekunnun vitibu beatrehon ad yoma haden:
Vehaavvim hayyoshebim bachatzerim ad-azza kaptorim hayyotzeim mikkaptor hishmidum vayyeshebu tachtam
Veavvae deyatebin bidpiach ad azza qapputeqae dinpaqu miqqapputeqayya shetzunnun vitibu beatrehon:
Qumu seu veibru et-nachal arnon reeh natatti beyadeka et-sichon melek-cheshbon haemori veet-artzo hachel rash vehitgar bo milchama
Qumu tulu veibaru yat nachala dearnon chaze dimsarit bidak yat sichon malka decheshbon emoraa veyat areh share letarakuteh veitgare lemebad immeh qeraba:
Hayyom hazzeh achel tet pachdeka veyirateka al-pene haammim tachat kol-hashshamayim asher yishmeun shimaka verogzu vechalu mippaneka
Yoma haden eshare lemittan zutak vedachaltak al appe ammayya di techot kol shemayya di yishmeun shimak vizuun veyidchalun min qodamak:
Vaeshlach malakim mimmidbar qedemot el-sichon melek cheshbon dibre shalom lemor
Ushelachit izgaddin mimmadbera diqdemot levat sichon malka decheshbon pitgame shelama lememar:
Ebera beartzeka badderek badderek elek lo asur yamin usemovl
Eibbar bearak beorcha beorcha ezel la este yammina usemala:
Okel bakkesep tashbireni veakalti umayim bakkesep titten-li veshatiti raq ebera beraglay
Ibura bekaspa tezabben li veekul umayya bekaspa titten li veeshte lechod eibar beraglay:
Kaasher asu-li bene esav hayyoshebim beseir vehammoabim hayyoshebim bear ad asher-eebor et-hayyarden el-haaretz asher-Adonai elohenu noten lanu
Kema di abadu li bene esav deyatebin beseir umoabae deyatebin bilchayat ad deeibar yat yardena leara daAdonai elahana yaheb lana:
Velo aba sichon melek cheshbon haabirenu bo ki-hiqsha Adonai eloheka et-rvcho veimmetz et-lebabo lemaan titto beyadeka kayyom hazzeh
Vela abe sichon malka decheshbon lemishbeqana lemebar bitchumeh are aqshe Adonai elahak yat rucheh vetaqqip yat libbeh bedil lemimsereh bidak keyoma haden:
Vayyomer Adonai elay reeh hachilloti tet lepaneka et-sichon veet-artzo hachel rash lareshet et-artzo
Vaamar Adonai li chaze shareti lemimsar qodamak yat sichon veyat areh shere letarakuteh lemerat yat areh:
Vayyetze sichon liqratenu hu vekol-ammo lammilchama yahetza
Unepaq sichon leqaddamutana hu vekol ammeh laagacha qeraba leyahatz:
Vayyittenehu Adonai elohenu lepanenu vannak oto veet-banav veet-kol-ammo
Umasereh Adonai elahana qodamana umechena yateh veyat benohi veyat kol ammeh:
Vannilkod et-kol-arayv baet hahiv vannacharem et-kol-ir metim vehannashim vehattap lo hisharnu sarid
Ukebashna yat kol qirvohi beiddana hahi vegammarna yat kol qirve gubrayya uneshayya vetapla la asharna meshezeb:
Raq habbehema bazaznu lanu ushelal hearim asher lakadenu
Lechod beira bazzana lana vaadi qirvayya di kebashna:
Mearoer asher al-sepat-nachal arnon vehair asher bannachal vead-haggilad lo hayeta qirya asher sageba mimmennu et-hakkol natan Adonai elohenu lepanenu
Mearoer di al kep nachala dearnon veqarta di benachala vead gilad la havat qarta di teqepat minnana yat kolla mesar Adonai elahana qodamana:
Raq el-eretz bene-ammon lo qarabeta kol-yad nachal yabboq veare hahar vekol asher-tzivva Adonai elohenu
Lechod leara bene ammon la qarebta kol kep nachala yubeqa veqirve tura vekol di paqqid Adonai elahana:
Vannepen vannaal derek habbashan vayyetze og melek-habbashan liqratenu hu vekol-ammo lammilchama edrei
Veitpenena useleqna orach dematnan unepaq og malka dematnan leqaddamutana hu vekol ammeh laagacha qeraba edrei:
Vayyomer Adonai elay al-tira oto ki beyadeka natatti oto veet-kol-ammo veet-artzo veasita lo kaasher asita lesichon melek haemori asher yosheb becheshbon
Vaamar Adonai li la tidchal yateh are bidak mesarit yateh veyat kol ammeh veyat areh vetabed leh kema di abadta lesichon malka deemoraa di yateb becheshbon:
Vayyitten Adonai elohenu beyadenu gam et-og melek-habbashan veet-kol-ammo vannakkehu ad-bilti hishir-lo sarid
Umesar Adonai elahana bidana ap yat og malka dematnan veyat kol ammeh umechinnohi ad dela ishtaar leh meshezeb:
Vannilkod et-kol-arayv baet hahiv lo hayeta qirya asher lo-laqachnu meittam shishshim ir kol-chebel argob mamleket og babbashan
Ukebashna yat kol qirvohi beiddana hahi la havat qarta di la nesibna minnehon shittin qirvin kol bet palak terakona malkevata deog bematnan:
Kol-elleh arim betzurot choma geboha delatayim uberiach lebad meare happerazi harbeh meod
Kol illen qirvin kerikan maqqepan shur ram dilehen dashin veabberin bar miqqirve patzchayya saggi lachada:
Vannacharem otam kaasher asinu lesichon melek cheshbon hacharem kol-ir metim hannashim vehattap
Vegammarna yatehon kema di abadna lesichon malka decheshbon gammar kol qirve gubrayya neshayya vetapla:
Vekol-habbehema ushelal hearim bazzonu lanu
Vekol beira vaadi qirvayya bazzana lana:
Vanniqqach baet hahiv et-haaretz miyyad shene malke haemori asher beeber hayyarden minnachal arnon ad-har chermon
Unesibna beiddana hahi yat ara miyyada teren malke emoraa di beibra deyardena minnachala dearnon ad tura dechermon:
Tzidonim yiqreu lechermon siryon vehaemori yiqreu-lo senir
Tzidonae qeran lechermon siryon veemorae qeran leh tur talga:
Kol are hammishor vekol-haggilad vekol-habbashan ad-salka veedrei are mamleket og babbashan
Kol qirve meshera vekol gilad vekol dematnan ad salka veedrei qirve malkevata deog bematnan:
Ki raq-og melek habbashan nishar miyyeter harepaim hinneh arso eres barzel haloh hiv berabbat bene ammon tesha ammot orkah vearba ammot rochbah beammat-ish
Are lechod og malka dematnan ishtaar mishshear gibbarayya ha arseh arsa deparzela hala hi berabbat bene ammon tesha ammin orkah vearba ammin petayah beamat melak:
Veet-haaretz hazzot yarashnu baet hahiv mearoer asher-al-nachal arnon vachatzi har-haggilad vearayv natatti larubeni velaggadi
Veyat ara hada yeritena beiddana hahi mearoer di al nachala dearnon upalgut tura degilad veqirvohi yehabit leshibta diruben uleshibta degad:
Veyeter haggilad vekol-habbashan mamleket og natatti lachatzi shebet hamenashsheh kol chebel haargob lekol-habbashan hahu yiqqare eretz repaim
Ushear gilad vekol dematnan malkevata deog yehabit lepalgut shibta dimnashsheh kol bet palak terakona lekol matnan hahu mitqere ara gibbarayya:
Yair ben-menashsheh laqach et-kol-chebel argob ad-gebul haggeshuri vehammaakati vayyiqra otam al-shemo et-habbashan chavvot yair ad hayyom hazzeh
Yair bar menashsheh nesib yat kol bet palak terakona ad techum geshuraa veapqeros uqera yatehon al shemeh yat matnan kaprane yair ad yoma haden:
Ulemakir natatti et-haggilad
Ulemakir yehabit yat gilad:
Velarubeni velaggadi natatti min-haggilad vead-nachal arnon tok hannachal ugebul vead yabboq hannachal gebul bene ammon
Uleshibta diruben uleshibta degad yehabit min gilad vead nachala dearnon go nachala utechum vead yubeqa denachala techum bene ammon:
Vehaaraba vehayyarden ugebul mikkinneret vead yam haaraba yam hammelach tachat ashdot happisga mizracha
