Umeshera veyardena utechumeh miggenosar vead yamma demeshera yamma demilcha techot mashpak meramata madinecha:
Vaatzav etkem baet hahiv lemor Adonai elohekem natan lakem et-haaretz hazzot lerishtah chalutzim taabru lipne achekem bene-yisrael kol-bene-chayil
Upaqqedit yatekon beiddana hahi lememar Adonai elahakon yehab lekon yat ara hada lemeretah mezarezin taberun qodam achekon bene yisrael kol mezareze chela:
Raq neshekem vetappekem umiqnekem yadati ki-miqneh rab lakem yeshebu bearekem asher natatti lakem
Lechod neshekon vetaplekon ubeirekon yedana are beir saggi lekon yetebun beqirvekon di yehabit lekon:
Ad asher-yaniach Adonai laachekem kakem veyareshu gam-hem et-haaretz asher Adonai elohekem noten lahem beeber hayyarden veshabtem ish lirushshato asher natatti lakem
Ad di yeniach Adonai laachekon kevatekon veyeretun ap innun yat ara daAdonai elahakon yaheb lehon beibra deyardena utetubun gebar lirutteteh di yehabit lekon:
Veet-yehoshua tzivveti baet hahiv lemor eneka haroot et kol-asher asa Adonai elohekem lishne hammelakim haelleh ken-yaaseh Adonai lekol-hammamlakot asher atta ober shamma
Veyat yehoshua paqqedit beiddana hahi lememar enayk chazaa yat kol di abad Adonai elahakon litren malkayya haillen ken yabed Adonai lekol malkevata di at aber letamman:
Lo tiraum ki Adonai elohekem hu hannilcham lakem
La tidchalun minnehon are Adonai elahakon memereh yegiach lekon:
Vaetchannan el-Adonai baet hahiv lemor
Vetzalleti qodam Adonai beiddana hahi lememar:
Adonay Adonai atta hachillota leharot et-abdeka et-godleka veet-yadeka hachazaqa asher mi-el bashshamayim ubaaretz asher-yaaseh kemaaseka vekigburoteka
Adonai ellohim at shareta leachazaa yat abdak yat rebutak veyat yedak taqqepta di at hu elaha dishkintak bishmayya milella veshallit beara velet deyabed keobadayk ukegibbaretak:
Ebera-na veereh et-haaretz hattoba asher beeber hayyarden hahar hattob hazzeh vehallebanon
Eibar kean veecheze yat ara tabta di beibra deyardena tura taba haden ubet maqdasha:
Vayyitabber Adonai bi lemaankem velo shama elay vayyomer Adonai elay rab-lak al-tosep dabber elay od baddabar hazzeh
Vahava regaz min qodam Adonai alay bedilekon vela qabbil minni vaamar Adonai li saggi lak la tosep lemallala qodamay od bepitgama haden:
Aleh rosh happisga vesa eneka yamma vetzapona vetemana umizracha ureeh beeneka ki-lo taabor et-hayyarden hazzeh
Saq leresh ramata uzeqop enayk lemaaraba uletzippuna velidroma ulemadinecha vachaze beenayik are la teibar yat yardena haden:
Vetzav et-yehoshua vechazzeqehu veammetzehu ki-hv yaabor lipne haam hazzeh vehu yanchil otam et-haaretz asher tireh
Upaqqed yat yehoshua vetaqqephi veallemhi are hu yeibar qodam amma haden vehu yachsen yatehon yat ara di techeze:
Vannesheb baggay mul bet peor
Vitebena bechelata loqobel bet peor:
Veatta yisrael shema el-hachuqqim veel-hammishpatim asher anoki melammed etkem laasot lemaan ticheyu ubatem virishtem et-haaretz asher Adonai elohe abotekem noten lakem
Ukean yisrael shema liqyamayya uledinayya di ana meallep yatekon lemebad bedil detechun vetetun veteretun yat ara di Adonai elaha daabahatekon yaheb lekon:
Lo tosipu al-haddabar asher anoki metzavveh etkem velo tigreu mimmennu lishmor et-mitzvot Adonai elohekem asher anoki metzavveh etkem
La tosepun al pitgama di ana mepaqqed yatekon vela timneun minneh lemittar yat piqqudayya daAdonai elahakon di ana mepaqqed yatekon:
Enekem haroot et asher-asa Adonai bebaal peor ki kol-haish asher halak achare baal-peor hishmido Adonai eloheka miqqirbeka
Enekon chazan yat di abad Adonai bebaal peor are kol gabra di azal batar baal peor shetzeyeh Adonai elahak mibbenak:
Veattem haddebeqim ba-Adonai elohekem chayyim kullekem hayyom
Veattun deadbeqtun bedachalta daAdonai elahakon qayyamin kullekon yoma den:
Reeh limmadti etkem chuqqim umishpatim kaasher tzivvani Adonai elohay laasot ken beqereb haaretz asher attem baim shamma lerishtah
Chazo deallepit yatekon qeyamayya vedinayya kema di paqqedani Adonai elahay lemebad ken bego ara di attun allin tamman lemeretah:
Ushemartem vaasitem ki hiv chokmatkem ubinatkem leene haammim asher yishmeun et kol-hachuqqim haelleh veameru raq am-chakam venabon haggoy haggadol hazzeh
Vetitterun vetabedun are hi chokmatkon vesukeletanutekon leene ammayya di yishmeun yat kol qeyamayya haillen veyemerun lechod am chakkim vesukeletan amma rabba haden:
Ki mi-goy gadol asher-lo elohim qerobim elayv ka-Adonai elohenu bekol-qorenu elayv
Are man am rab di leh elaha qarib leh leqabbala tzeloteh beiddan aqteh kaAdonai elahana bekol iddan daanachna metzallin qodamohi:
Umi goy gadol asher-lo chuqqim umishpatim tzaddiqim kekol hattora hazzot asher anoki noten lipnekem hayyom
Uman am rab di leh qeyamin vedinin qashshitin kekol orayta hada di ana yaheb qodamekon yoma den:
Raq hishshamer leka ushemor napsheka meod pen-tishkach et-haddebarim asher-rau eneka upen-yasuru millebabeka kol yeme chayyeka vehodatam lebaneka velibne baneka
Lechod istammar lak vetar napshak lachada dilema tinshe yat pitgamayya di chazo enayik vedilema yeiddun millibbak kol yome chayyayk utehodeinnun libnayk velibne benayk:
Yom asher amadta lipne Adonai eloheka bechoreb beemor Adonai elay haqhel-li et-haam veashmiem et-debaray asher yilmedun leyira oti kol-hayyamim asher hem chayyim al-haadama veet-benehem yelammedun

Yoma di qamta qodam Adonai elahak bechoreb kad amar Adonai li kenosh qodamay yat amma veashmeinnun yat pitgamay di yelepun lemidchal qodamay kol yomayya di innun qayyamin al ara veyat benehon yallepun:
Vattiqrebun vattaamdun tachat hahar vehahar boer baesh ad-leb hashshamayim choshek anan vaarapel
Uqerebtun veqamtun beshippole tura vetura baer beeshshata ad tzet shemayya chashoka anana vaamiteta:
Vayedabber Adonai alekem mittok haesh qol debarim attem shomeim utemuna enekem roim zulati qol
Umallil Adonai immekon miggo eshshata qal pitgamin attun shamein udemut letekon chazan ellahen qala:
Vayyagged lakem et-berito asher tzivva etkem laasot aseret haddebarim vayyiktebem al-shene luchot abanim
Vechavvi lekon yat qeyameh di paqqid yatekon lemebad aseret pitgamin uketabinun al teren luche abnayya:
Veoti tzivva Adonai baet hahiv lelammed etkem chuqqim umishpatim laasotekem otam baaretz asher attem oberim shamma lerishtah
Veyati paqqid Adonai beiddana hahi leallapa yatekon qeyamin vedinin lemebadekon yatehon beara di attun aberin tamman lemeretah:
Venishmartem meod lenapshotekem ki lo reitem kol-temuna beyom dibber Adonai alekem bechoreb mittok haesh
Vetistammerun lachada lenapshatekon are la chazetun kol demut beyoma di mallil Adonai immekon bechoreb miggo eshshata:
Pen-tashchitun vaasitem lakem pesel temunat kol-samel tabnit zakar o neqeba
Dilema techabbelun vetabedun lekon tzelem demut kol tzura demut dekar o nuqba:
Tabnit kol-behema asher baaretz tabnit kol-tzippor kanap asher taup bashshamayim
Demut kol beira di beara demut kol tzippar gadpa di parach baaver reqia shemayya:
Tabnit kol-romes baadama tabnit kol-daga asher-bammayim mittachat laaretz
Demut kol richasha di beara demut kol nune di bemayya millera leara:

Upen-tissa eneka hashshamayma veraita et-hashshemesh veet-hayyareach veet-hakkokabim kol tzeba hashshamayim veniddachta vehishtachavita lahem vaabadtam asher chalaq Adonai eloheka otam lekol haammim tachat kol-hashshamayim

Vedilema tizqop enayk lishmayya vetecheze yat shimsha veyat sihara veyat kokebayya kol chele shemayya vetite vetisgud lehon vetiplechinnun di zammin Adonai elahak yatehon lekol ammayya techot kol shemayya:
Veetkem laqach Adonai vayyotzi etkem mikkur habbarzel mimmitzrayim lihyot lo leam nachala kayyom hazzeh
Veyatekon qarib Adonai ledachalteh veappeq yatekon mikkura deparzela mimmitzrayim lemeheve leh leamma achasana keyoma haden:
Va-Adonai hitannap-bi al-dibrekem vayyishshaba lebilti obri et-hayyarden ulebilti-bo el-haaretz hattoba asher Adonai eloheka noten leka nachala
Umin qodam Adonai hava regaz alay al pitgamekon veqayyim bedil dela lemeabar yat yardena ubedil dela lemeal leara taba di Adonai elahak yaheb lak achasana:
Ki anoki met baaretz hazzot enenni ober et-hayyarden veattem oberim virishtem et-haaretz hattoba hazzot
Are ana mait beara hada let ana aber yat yardena veattun aberin veteretun yat ara taba hada:
Hishshameru lakem pen-tishkechu et-berit Adonai elohekem asher karat immakem vaasitem lakem pesel temunat kol asher tzivveka Adonai eloheka
Istammaru lekon dilema tittinshun yat qeyama daAdonai elahakon di gezar immekon vetabedun lekon tzelem demut kolla di paqqedak Adonai elahak:
Ki Adonai eloheka esh okela hu el qanna
Are Adonai elahak memereh eshsha okla hu el qanna:
Ki-tolid banim ubene banim venoshantem baaretz vehishchattem vaasitem pesel temunat kol vaasitem hara beene Adonaieloheka lehakiso
Are toledun benin ubene benin vetitattequn beara utechabbelun vetabedun tzelem demut kolla vetabedun debish qodam Adonai elahak leargaza qodamohi:
Haidoti bakem hayyom et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz ki-abod tobedun maher meal haaretz asher attem oberim et-hayyarden shamma lerishtah lo-taarikun yamim aleha ki hishshamed tishshamedun
Ashedit bekon yoma den yat shemayya veyat ara are mebad tebedun bipria meal ara di attun aberin yat yardena letamman lemeretah la torekun yomin alah are ishtetzaa tishtetzun:
Vehepitz Adonai etkem baammim venishartem mete mispar baggoyim asher yenaheg Adonai etkem shamma
Vibaddar Adonai yatekon beammayya vetishtaarun am deminyan beammayya di yedabbar Adonai yatekon letamman:
Vaabadtem-sham elohim maaseh yede adam etz vaeben asher lo-yirun velo yishmeun velo yokelun velo yerichun
Vetiplechun tamman leammayya paleche taavata obad yede enasha aa veabna di la yechezun vela shamein vela oklin vela merichin:
Ubiqqashtem mishsham et-Adonai eloheka umatzata ki tidreshennu bekol-lebabeka ubekol-napsheka
Vetitbeun mittamman dachalta daAdonai elahak vetishkach are tibe min qodamohi bekol libbak ubekol napshak:
Batztzar leka umetzauka kol haddebarim haelleh beacharit hayyamim veshabta ad-Adonai eloheka veshamata beqolo
Kad yeoq lak veyashkechunnak kol pitgamayya haillen besop yomayya utetub ledachalta daAdonai elahak uteqabbel lememereh:
Ki el rachum Adonai eloheka lo yarpeka velo yashchiteka velo yishkach et-berit aboteka asher nishba lahem
Are elaha rachamana Adonai elahak la yishbeqinnak vela yechabbelinnak vela yittinshe yat qeyama daabahatak di qayyim lehon:
Ki sheal-na leyamim rishonim asher-hayu lepaneka lemin-hayyom asher bara elohim adam al-haaretz ulemiqtzeh hashshamayim vead-qetzeh hashshamayim haniheya kaddabar haggadol hazzeh o hanishma kamohu
Are sheel kean leyomayya qadmae dahavo qodamak lemin yoma di bera Adonai adam al ara ulemisseyape shemayya vead seyape shemayya hahava kepitgama rabba haden o haishtema kevateh:
Hashama am qol elohim medabber mittok-haesh kaasher-shamata atta vayyechi
Hashma amma qal memera daAdonai memallel miggo eshshata kema di shemaat at veyitqayyam:
O hanissa elohim labo laqachat lo goy miqqereb goy bemassot beotot ubemopetim ubemilchama ubeyad chazaqa ubizroa netuya ubemoraim gedolim kekol asher-asa lakem Adonai elohekem bemitzrayim leeneka

O nissin di abad Adonai leitgallaa lemipraq leh am miggo am benissin beatin ubemopetin ubiqraba ubida taqqipa ubidraa merama ubechezvanin rabrebin kekol di abad lekon Adonai elahakon bemitzrayim leenayk:
Atta horeta ladaat ki Adonai hu haelohim en od millebaddo
At itchazeta lemidda are Adonai hu ellohim let od bar minneh:
Min-hashshamayim hishmiaka et-qolo leyasserekka veal-haaretz heraka et-ishsho haggedola udebarayv shamata mittok haesh
Min shemayya ashmeak yat qal memereh leallaputak veal ara achzeyak yat eshshateh rabbeta upitgamohi shemaat miggo eshshata:
Vetachat ki ahab et-aboteka vayyibchar bezaro acharayv vayyotziaka bepanayv bekocho haggadol mimmitzrayim
Vocholap are rechim yat abahatak veittire bibnohi batrohi veappeqak bememereh becheleh rabba mimmitzrayim:
Lehorish goyim gedolim vaatzumim mimmeka mippaneka lahabiaka latet-leka et-artzam nachala kayyom hazzeh
Letaraka ammin rabrebin vetaqqipin minnak min qodamak leaalutak lemittan lak yat arahon achasana keyoma haden:
Veyadata hayyom vahashebota el-lebabeka ki Adonai hu haelohim bashshamayim mimmaal veal-haaretz mittachat en od
Vetidda yoma den utetub lelibbak are Adonai hu elaha dishkinteh bishmayya milleella veshallit al ara millera let od:
Veshamarta et-chuqqayv veet-mitzvotayv asher anoki metzavveka hayyom asher yitab leka ulebaneka achareka ulemaan taarik yamim al-haadama asher Adonai eloheka noten leka kol-hayyamim
Vetittar yat qeyamohi veyat piqudohi di ana mepaqqedak yoma den di yetab lak velibnayk batrak ubedil detorik yomin al ara di Adonai elahak yaheb lak kol yomayya:
Az yabdil mosheh shalosh arim beeber hayyarden mizrecha shamesh
Beken yapresh msheh telat qirvin beibra deyardena midnach shimsha:
Lanus shamma rotzeach asher yirtzach et-reehu bibli-daat vehu lo-sone lo mittemol shilshom venas el-achat min-hearim hael vachay
Lemeiroq tamman qatola di yiqtol yat chabreh bela mandee vehu la sane leh meitmalle umiddeqammohi veyeiroq lechad min qirvayya haillen veyitqayyam:
Et-betzer bammidbar beeretz hammishor larubeni veet-ramot baggilad laggadi veet-golan babbashan lamenashshi
Yat betzer bemadbera beara meshera leshibta diruben veyat ramot baggilad leshibta degad veyat golan bematnan leshibta dimnashsheh:
Vezot hattora asher-sam mosheh lipne bene yisrael
Veda orayta di saddar msheh qodam bene yisrael:
Elleh haedot vehachuqqim vehammishpatim asher dibber mosheh el-bene yisrael betzetam mimmitzrayim
Illen sahedvata uqeyamayya vedinayya di mallil msheh im bene yisrael bemippaqehon mimmitzrayim:
Beeber hayyarden baggay mul bet peor beeretz sichon melek haemori asher yosheb becheshbon asher hikka mosheh ubene yisrael betzetam mimmitzrayim
Beibra deyardena bechelata loqobel bet peor beara desichon malka deemoraa di yateb becheshbon di mecha msheh ubene yisrael bemippaqehon mimmitzrayim:
Vayyireshu et-artzo veet-eretz og melek-habbashan shene malke haemori asher beeber hayyarden mizrach shamesh
Viritu yat areh veyat ara deog malka dematnan teren malke emoraa di beibra deyardena midnach shimsha:
Mearoer asher al-sepat-nachal arnon vead-har sion hu chermon
Mearoer di al kep nachala dearnon vead tura desion hu chermon:
Vekol-haaraba eber hayyarden mizracha vead yam haaraba tachat ashdot happisga
Vekol meshera ibra deyardena lemadinecha vead yamma demeshera techot mashpak meramata:
Vayyiqra mosheh el-kol-yisrael vayyomer alehem shema yisrael et-hachuqqim veet-hammishpatim asher anoki dober beoznekem hayyom ulemadtem otam ushemartem laasotam
Uqera msheh lekol yisrael vaamar lehon shema yisrael yat qeyamayya veyat dinayya di ana memallel qodamekon yoma den vetallepun yatehon vetitterun lemebadehon:
Adonai elohenu karat immanu berit bechoreb
Adonai elahana gezar immana qeyam bechoreb:
Lo et-abotenu karat Adonai et-habberit hazzot ki ittanu anachnu elleh poh hayyom kullanu chayyim
La im abahatana gezar Adonai yat qeyama hada ellahen immana anachna illen haka yoma den kullana qayyamin:
Panim bepanim dibber Adonai immakem bahar mittok haesh
Mamlal im mamlal mallil Adonai immekon betura miggo eshshata:
Anoki omed ben-Adonai ubenekem baet hahiv lehaggid lakem et-debar Adonai ki yeretem mippene haesh velo-alitem bahar lemor
Ana haveti qaem ben memera daAdonai ubenekon beiddana hahi lechavvaa lekon yat pitgama daAdonai are decheltun miqqodam eshshata vela seleqtun betura lememar:
Anoki Adonai eloheka asher hotzetika meeretz mitzrayim mibbet abadim
Ana Adonai elahak di appeqetak meara demitzrayim mibbet abduta:
Lo-yihyeh-leka elohim acherim al-panaay
La yehe lak elaha ochoran bar minni:
Lo-taaseh-leka pesel kol-temuna asher bashshamayim mimmaal vaasher baaretz mittaachat vaasher bammayim mittachat laaretz
La tabed lak tzelem kol demut di bishmayya milleella vedi beara millera vedi bemayya millera leara:
Lo-tishtachaveh lahem velo toobdem ki anoki Adonai eloheka el qanna poqed avon abot al-banim veal-shilleshim veal-ribbeim lesoneay
La tisgud lehon vela tiplechinnun are ana Adonai elahak el qanna masar chobe abahan al benin meradin al dar telitay veal dar rebiay lesanay kad meshallemin benayya lemechete batar abahatehon:
Veoseh chesed laalapim leohabay uleshomere mitzvotay
Veabed tebu lealpe darin lerachamay ulenatere piqqoday:
Lo tissa et-shem-Adonai eloheka lashshav ki lo yenaqqeh Adonai et asher-yissa et-shemo lashshav
La teme yat shema daAdonai elahak lemaggana are la yezakke Adonai yat di yeme bishmeh leshiqra:
Shamor et-yom hashshabbat leqaddesho kaasher tzivveka Adonai eloheka
Tar yat yoma deshabbeta leqaddashuteh kema di paqdak Adonai elahak:
Sheshet yamim taabod veasita kol-melakteka
Shitta yomin tiplach vetabed kol ibidtak:

Veyom hashshebii shabbat la-Adonai eloheka lo taaseh kol-melaka atta ubinka-vbitteka veabdeka-vaamateka veshoreka vachamoreka vekol-behemteka vegereka asher bishareka lemaan yanuach abdeka vaamateka kamoka
Veyoma shebiaa shabbeta qodam Adonai elahak la tabed kol ibida at uberak uberattak veabdak veamtak vetorak vachamarak vekol beirak vegiyyorak di beqirvak bedil di yenuach abdak veamtak kevatak:
Vezakarta ki-ebed hayita beeretz mitzrayim vayyotziaka Adonai eloheka mishsham beyad chazaqa ubizroa netuya al-ken tzivveka Adonai eloheka laasot et-yom hashshabbat
Vetidkar are abda haveta beara demitzrayim veappeqak Adonai elahak mittamman bida taqqipa ubidraa merama al ken paqqedak Adonai elahak lemebad yat yoma deshabbeta:
Kabbed et-abika veet-immeka kaasher tzivveka Adonai eloheka lemaan yaarikun yameka ulemaan yitab lak al haadama asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak
Yaqqar yat abuk veyat immak kema di paqqedak Adonai elahak bedil deyorekun yomayk ubedil deyoteb lak al ara daAdonai elahak yaheb lak:
Lo tirtzach velo tinap velo tignob velo-taaneh bereaka ed shav
La tiqtol nepash. vela tegup. vela tignob. vela tashed bechabrak sahaduta deshiqra:
Velo tachmod eshet reeka velo titavveh bet reeka sadehu veabdo vaamato shoro vachamoro vekol asher lereeka
Vela tachmed ittat chabrak vela terog bet chabrak chaqleh veabdeh veamteh toreh vachamareh vekol di lechabrak:
Et-haddebarim haelleh dibber Adonai el-kol-qehalekem bahar mittok haesh heanan vehaarapel qol gadol velo yasap vayyiktebem al-shene luchot abanim vayyittenem elay
Yat pitgamayya haillen mallil Adonai im kol qehalekon betura miggo eshshata anana vaamiteta qal rab vela pesaq uketabinnun al teren luche abnayya vihabinnun li:
Vayehi keshomakem et-haqqol mittok hachoshek vehahar boer baesh vattiqrebun elay kol-rashe shibtekem veziqnekem
Vahava kad shemaakon yat qala miggo chashoka vetura baer beeshshata veqarebtun levati kol reshe shibtekon vesabekon:
Vattomeru hen heranu Adonai elohenu et-kebodo veet-godlo veet-qolo shamanu mittok haesh hayyom hazzeh rainu ki-yedabber elohim et-haadam vachay
Vaamartun ha achzeyana Adonai elahana yat yeqareh veyat rebuteh veyat qal memereh shemana miggo eshshata yoma haden chazena are yemallel Adonai im anasha veyitqayyam:
Veatta lamma namut ki tokelenu haesh haggedola hazzot im-yosepim anachnu lishmoa et-qol Adonai elohenu od vamatenu
Ukean lema nemut are tekelinnana eshshata rabbeta hada im mosepin anachna lemishma yat qal memera daAdonai elahana od umayetin anachna:
Ki mi kol-basar asher shama qol elohim chayyim medabber mittok-haesh kamonu vayyechi
Are man kol bisra di shema qal memera daAdonai qayyama memallel miggo eshshata kevatana veitqayyam:
Qerab atta ushema et kol-asher yomar Adonai elohenu veat tedabber elenu et kol-asher yedabber Adonai elohenu eleka veshamanu veasinu
Qerab at ushema yat kol di yemar Adonai elahana veat temallel immana yat kol di mallel Adonai elahana immak uneqabbel venabed:
Vayyishma Adonai et-qol dibrekem bedabberkem elay vayyomer Adonai elay shamati et-qol dibre haam hazzeh asher dibberu eleka hetibu kol-asher dibberu
Ushemia qodam Adonai yat qal pitgamekon bemallalutekon immi vaamar Adonai li shemia qodamay yat qal pitgame amma haden di mallilu immak atqinu kol di mallilu:
Mi-yitten vehaya lebabam zeh lahem leyira oti velishmor et-kol-mitzvotay kol-hayyamim lemaan yitab lahem velibnehem leolam
Levay di yehe libba haden lehon lemidchal qodamay ulemittar yat kol piqquday kol yomayya bedil deyetab lehon velibnehon lealam:
Lek emor lahem shubu lakem leoholekem
Izzel emar lehon tubu lekon lemashkenekon:
Veatta poh amod immadi vaadabbera eleka et kol-hammitzva vehachuqqim vehammishpatim asher telammedem veasu baaretz asher anoki noten lahem lerishtah
Veat haka qim qodamay veemallel immak yat kol tapqedta uqeyamayya vedinayya di tallepun veyabedun beara di ana yaheb lehon lemeretah:
Ushemartem laasot kaasher tzivva Adonai elohekem etkem lo tasuru yamin usemol
Vetitterun lemebad kema di paqqid Adonai elahakon yatekon la tistun yammina usemala:
Bekol-hadderek asher tzivva Adonai elohekem etkem teleku lemaan ticheyun vetob lakem vehaaraktem yamim baaretz asher tirashun
Bekol orcha di paqqid Adonai elahakon yatekon tehakun bedil detechun veyetab lekon vetorekun yomin beara di teretun:
Vezot hammitzva hachuqqim vehammishpatim asher tzivva Adonai elohekem lelammed etkem laasot baaretz asher attem oberim shamma lerishtah
Veda tapqedta qeyamayya vedinayya di paqqid Adonai elahakon leallapa yatekon lemebad beara di attun aberin tamman lemeretah:
Lemaan tira et-Adonai eloheka lishmor et-kol-chuqqotayv umitzvotayv asher anoki metzavveka atta ubinka uben-binka kol yeme chayyeka ulemaan yaarikun yameka
Bedil detidchal qodam Adonai elahak lemittar yat kol qeyamohi upiqqudohi di ana mepaqqedak at uberak ubar berak kol yome chayyayk ubedil deyorekun yomayk:
Veshamata yisrael veshamarta laasot asher yitab leka vaasher tirbun meod kaasher dibber Adonai elohe aboteka lak eretz zabat chalab udebash
Uteqabbel yisrael vetittar lemebad di yetab lak vedi tisgun lachada kema di mallil Adonai elaha daabahatak lak ara abeda chalab udebash:
Shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad
Shema yisrael Adonai elahana Adonai chad:
Veahabta et Adonai eloheka bekol-lebabeka ubekol-napsheka ubekol-meodeka
Vetircham yat Adonai elahak bekol libbak ubekol napshak ubekol niksak:
Vehayu haddebarim haelleh asher anoki metzavveka hayyom al-lebabeka
Vihon pitgamayya haillen di ana mepaqqedak yoma den al libbak:
Veshinnantam lebaneka vedibbarta bam beshibteka bebeteka ubelekteka badderek ubeshokbeka ubequmeka
Utetaninnun libnayk utemallel behon bemittebak bebetak ubimhakak beorcha ubemishkebak ubimqimak:
Uqeshartam leot al-yadeka vehayu letotapot ben eneka
Vetiqterinnun leat al yedak vihon litpillin ben enayk:
Uketabtam al-mezuzot beteka ubishareka
Vetiktebinnun al mezuzeyan vetiqbeinnun besippe betak ubetarayk:
Vehaya ki yebiaka Adonai eloheka el-haaretz asher nishba laaboteka leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob latet lak arim gedolot vetobot asher lo-banita
Vihe are yaelinnak Adonai elahak leara di qayyim laabahatak leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob lemittan lak qirvin rabreban vetaban di la beneta:
Ubattim meleim kol-tvb asher lo-milleta uborot chatzubim asher lo-chatzabta keramim vezetim asher lo-nataeta veakalta vesabaeta
Ubattin melan kol tub di la malleta vegubbin pesilan di la pesalta karmin vezetin di la netzebta vetekul vetisba:
Hishshamer leka pen-tishkach et-Adonai asher hotziaka meeretz mitzrayim mibbet abadim
Istammar lak dilema tinshe yat dachalta daAdonai di appeqak meara demitzrayim mibbet abduta:
Et-Adonai eloheka tira veoto taabod ubishmo tishshabea
Yat Adonai elahak tidchal veqadamohi tiplach ubishmeh teqayyam:
Lo telekun achare elohim acherim meelohe haammim asher sebibotekem
La tehakun batar taavat ammayya mittaavat ammayya di besacharanekon:
Ki el qanna Adonai eloheka beqirbeka pen-yechereh ap-Adonai eloheka bak vehishmideka meal pene haadama
Are el qanna Adonai elahak shekinteh benak dilema yitqep rogza daAdonai elahak bak vishetzak meal appe ara:
Lo tenassu et-Adonai elohekem kaasher nissitem bammassa
La tenassun qodam Adonai elahakon kema di nassetun benisseta:
Shamor tishmerun et-mitzvot Adonai elohekem veedotayv vechuqqayv asher tzivvak
Mittar titterun yat piqqudayya daAdonai elahakon usehedvateh uqeyamohi di paqdak:
Veasita hayyashar vehattob beene Adonai lemaan yitab lak ubata veyarashta et-haaretz hattoba asher-nishba Adonai laaboteka
Vetabed dekashar udetaqen qodam Adonai bedil deyetab lak veteul veterat yat ara tabta di qayyim Adonai laabahatak:
Lahadop et-kol-oyebeka mippaneka kaasher dibber Adonai
Lemittebar yat kol baale debabak miqqodamak kema di mallil Adonai:
Ki-yishaleka binka machar lemor ma haedot vehachuqqim vehammishpatim asher tzivva Adonai elohenu etkem
Are yishalinnak berak mechar lememar ma sahedvata uqeyamayya vedinayya di paqqid Adonai elahana yatekon:
Veamarta lebinka abadim hayinu leparoh bemitzrayim vayyotzienu Adonai mimmitzrayim beyad chazaqa
Vetemar libnak abdin havena leparoh bemitzrayim veappeqana Adonai mimmitzrayim bida taqqipa:
Vayyitten Adonai otot umopetim gedolim veraim bemitzrayim beparoh ubekol-beto leenenu
Vihab Adonai atin umopetin rabrebin ubishin bemitzrayim beparoh ubekol enash beteh leenana:
Veotanu hotzi mishsham lemaan habi otanu latet lanu et-haaretz asher nishba laabotenu
Veyatana appeq mittamman bedil leaala yatana lemittan lana yat ara di qayyim laabahatana:
Vayetzavvenu Adonai laasot et-kol-hachuqqim haelleh leyira et-Adonai elohenu letob lanu kol-hayyamim lechayyotenu kehayyom hazzeh
Upaqqedana Adonai lemebad yat kol qeyamayya haillen lemidchal yat Adonai elahana letab lana kol yomayya leqayyamutana keyoma haden:
Utzedaqa tiheyeh-lanu ki-nishmor laasot et-kol-hammitzva hazzot lipne Adonai elohenu kaasher tzivvanu
Vezakuta tehe lana are nittar lemebad yat kol tapqedta hada qodam Adonai elahana kema di paqqedana:

Ki yebiaka Adonai eloheka el-haaretz asher-atta ba-shamma lerishtah venashal goyim-rabbim mippaneka hachitti vehaggirgashi vehaemori vehakkenaani vehapperizzi vehachivvi vehayebusi shiba goyim rabbim vaatzumim mimmekka

Are yeelinnak Adonai elahak leara di at alel letamman lemeretah vitarek ammin saggiin min qodamak chittae vegirgashae veemorae ukenaanae uperizzae vechivvae vibusae shiba ammin saggiin vetaqqipin minnak:
Unetanam Adonai eloheka lepaneka vehikkitam hacharem tacharim otam lo-tikrot lahem berit velo techonnem
Veyimserinnun Adonai elahak qodamak vetimchinnun gammara tegammar yatehon la tigzar lehon qeyam vela teracham alehon:
Velo titchatten bam bitteka lo-titten libno ubitto lo-tiqqach libneka
Vela titchattan behon berattak la titten libreh uberatteh la tissab librak:
Ki-yasir et-binka meacharay veabedu elohim acherim vechara ap-Adonai bakem vehishmideka maher
Are yatayan yat berak mibbatar palechani veyiplechun letaavat ammayya veyitqep rogza daAdonai bekon vishetzak bipria:
Ki-im-koh taasu lahem mizbechotehem tittotzu umatztzebotam teshabberu vaasherehem tegaddeun upesilehem tisrepun baesh
Are im keden tabedun lehon egorehon tetareun veqamatehon tetabberun vaasherehon teqotzetzun vetzalme taavatehon toqedun benura:
Ki am qadosh atta la-Adonai eloheka beka bachar Adonai eloheka lihyot lo leam segulla mikkol haammim asher al-pene haadama
Are am qaddish at qodam Adonai elahak bak ittire Adonai elahak lemeheve leh leam chabbib mikkol ammayya di al appe ara:
Lo merubbekem mikkol-haammim chashaq Adonai bakem vayyibchar bakem ki-attem hameat mikkol-haammim
La middesaggiin attun mikkol ammayya tzabe Adonai bekon veittire bekon are attun zeerin mikkol ammayya:
Ki meahabat Adonai etkem umishshomro et-hashshebua asher nishba laabotekem hotzi Adonai etkem beyad chazaqa vayyipdeka mibbet abadim miyyad paroh melek-mitzrayim
Are midderacham Adonai yatekon umiddintar yat qeyama di qayyim laabahatekon appeq Adonai yatekon bida taqqipa upareqak mibbet abduta mida deparoh malka demitzrayim:
Veyadata ki-Adonai eloheka hu haelohim hael hanneeman shomer habberit vehachesed leohabayv uleshomere mitzvotav leelep dor
Vetidda are Adonai elahak hu ellohim elaha mehemena nater qeyama vechisda lerachamohi ulenatere piqqodohi lealpe darin:
Umeshallem lesoneayv el-panayv lehaabido lo yeacher lesoneo el-panayv yeshallem-lo
Umeshallem lesaneohi taban di innun abedin qodamohi bechayyehon leobadehon la meachar obad tab lesaneohi tabvan di innun abedin qodamohi bechayyehon meshallem lehon:
Veshamarta et-hammitzva veet-hachuqqim veet-hammishpatim asher anoki metzavveka hayyom laasotam
Vetittar yat tapqedta veyat qeyamayya veyat dinayya di ana mepaqqedak yoma den lemebadehon:
Vehaya eqeb tishmeun et hammishpatim haelleh ushemartem vaasitem otam veshamar Adonai eloheka leka et-habberit veet-hachesed asher nishba laaboteka
Vihe cholap di teqabbelun yat dinayya haillen vetitterun vetabedun yatehon veyittar Adonai elahak lak yat qeyama veyat chisda di qayyim laabahatak:
Vaahebeka uberakka vehirbeka uberak peri-bitneka uperi-admateka deganeka vetirosheka veyitzhareka shegar-alapeka veashterot tzoneka al haadama asher-nishba laaboteka latet lak
Veyirchaminnak vibarekinnak veyasginnak vibarek valeda dimak veibba dearak iburak vechamrak umishchak baqre torayk veedre anak al ara di qayyim laabahatak lemittan lak:
Baruk tiheyeh mikkol-haammim lo-yihyeh beka aqar vaaqara ubibhemteka
Berik tehe mikkol ammayya la yehe bak aqar veaqra ubibirak:
Vehesir Adonai mimmeka kol-choli vekol-madve mitzrayim haraim asher yadata lo yesimam bak unetanam bekol-soneeka
Veyede Adonai minnak kol marin vekol makteshe mitzrayim bishayya di yedaat la yeshavvinnun bak veyitteninnun bekol saneak:
Veakalta et-kol-haammim asher Adonai eloheka noten lak lo-tachos eneka alehem velo taabod et-elohehem ki-moqesh hu lak
Utegammar yat kol ammayya di Adonai elahak yaheb lak la techus enak alehon vela tiplach yat taavatehon are letaqla hu lak:
Ki tomar bilbabeka rabbim haggoyim haelleh mimmenni eka ukal lehorisham
Dilema temar belibbak saggiin ammayya haillen minni ekden ikkul letarakutehon:
Lo tira mehem zakor tizkor et asher-asa Adonai eloheka leparoh ulekol-mitzrayim
La tidchal minnehon midkar tidkar yat di abad Adonai elahak leparoh ulekal mitzrayim:
Hammassot haggedolot asher-rau eneka vehaotot vehammopetim vehayyad hachazaqa vehazzeroa hannetuya asher hotziaka Adonai eloheka ken-yaaseh Adonai eloheka lekol-haammim asher-atta yare mippenehem
Nissin rabrebin di chazaa enak veatayya umopetayya vida taqqepta uderaa meramema di appeqak Adonai elahak ken yabed Adonai elahak lekol ammayya di at dachel miqqodamehon:
Vegam et-hatztzira yeshallach Adonai eloheka bam ad-abod hannisharim vehannistarim mippaneka
Veap yat araita yegare Adonai elahak behon ad diyebaddun deishtaaru udeittammaru miqqodamak:
Lo taarotz mippenehem ki-Adonai eloheka beqirbeka el gadol venora
La tittebar miqqodamehon are Adonai elahak shekinteh benak elaha rabba udechila:
Venashal Adonai eloheka et-haggoyim hael mippaneka meat meat lo tukal kallotam maher pen-tirbeh aleka chayyat hassadeh
Vitarek Adonai elahak yat ammayya haillen miqqodamak zeer zeer la tikkul leshetzayutehon bipria dilema tisge alak chevat bara:
Unetanam Adonai eloheka lepaneka vehamam mehuma gedola ad hishshamedam
Veyimserinnun Adonai elahak qodamak vishaggeshinnun shiggush rab ad dishetzinnun:
Venatan malkehem beyadeka vehaabadta et-shemam mittachat hashshamayim lo-yityatztzeb ish bepaneka ad hishmideka otam
Veyimsar malkehon bidak vetobad yat shimhon mittechot shemayya la yitattad enash miqqodamak ad detishetze yatehon:
Pesile elohehem tisrepun baesh lo-tachmod kesep vezahab alehem velaqachta lak pen tivvaqesh bo ki toabat Adonai eloheka hu
Tzalme taavatehon toqedun benura la tachmed kaspa vedahaba di alehon vetissab lak dilema tittaqal beh are merachaqa daAdonai elahak hu:
Velo-tabi toeba el-beteka vehayita cherem kamohu shaqqetz teshaqqetzennu vetaeb tetaabennu ki-cherem hu
Vela tael dimrachaq lebetak utehe cherma kevateh shaqqatza teshaqqetzinneh verachaqa terachaqinneh are cherma hu:
Kol-hammitzva asher anoki metzavveka hayyom tishmerun laasot lemaan ticheyun urebitem ubatem virishtem et-haaretz asher-nishba Adonai laabotekem
Kol tapqedta di ana mepaqqedak yoma den titterun lemebad bedil detechun vetisgun vetetun veteretun yat ara di qayyim Adonai laabahatekon:
Vezakarta et-kol-hadderek asher holikeka Adonai eloheka zeh arbaim shana bammidbar lemaan annoteka lenassoteka ladaat et-asher bilebabeka hatishmor mitzvotav im-lo
Vetidkar yat kol orcha di dabberak Adonai elahak denan arbein shenin bemadbera bedil leannayutak lenassayutak lemidda yat di belibbak hatittar piqqudohi im la:
Vayeanneka vayyaribeka vayyaakileka et-hamman asher lo-yadata velo yadeun aboteka lemaan hodiaka ki lo al-hallechem lebaddo yichyeh haadam ki al-kol-motza pi-Adonai yichyeh haadam
Veanneyak veakpanak veokalak yat manna di la yedata vela yadeun abahatayk bedil leodautak are la al lachma bilchodohi mitqayyam enasha are al kol appaqut memera daAdonai yitqayyam enasha:
Simlateka lo baleta mealeka veragleka lo batzeqa zeh arbaim shana
Kesutak la ibliat minnak umesanak la yechepu denan arbein shenin:
Veyadata im-lebabeka ki kaasher yeyasser ish et-beno Adonai eloheka meyasserekka
Vetidda im libbak are kema di meallep gabra yat bereh Adonai elahak meallep lak:
Veshamarta et-mitzvot Adonai eloheka laleket bidrakayv uleyira oto
Vetittar yat piqqudayya daAdonai elahak limhak beorchan detaqnan qodamohi ulemidchal yateh:
Ki Adonai eloheka mebiaka el-eretz toba eretz nachale mayim ayanot utehomot yotzeim babbiqa ubahar
Are Adonai elahak maalak leara tabta ara nageda nachalin demayyin mabbue enayan utehomin napeqin bebiqan ubeturin:
Eretz chitta useora vegepen uteena verimmon eretz-zet shemen udebash
Ara chittin vesaarin vegupenin uteenin verimmonin ara dezetaha abedin mishcha vehi abeda debash:
Eretz asher lo bemiskenut tokal-bah lechem lo-techsar kol bah eretz asher abaneha barzel umeharareha tachtzob nechoshet
Ara di la beitztzurin tekul bah lachma la techsar kol middaam bah ara di abnaha parzela umitturaha tipsul nechasha:
Veakalta vesabaeta uberakta et-Adonai eloheka al-haaretz hattoba asher natan-lak
Vetekul vetisba utebarak yat Adonai elahak al ara tabta dihab lak:
Hishshamer leka pen-tishkach et-Adonai eloheka lebilti shemor mitzvotayv umishpatayv vechuqqotayv asher anoki metzavveka hayyom
Istammar lak dilema titneshe yat dachalta daAdonai elahak bedil dela lemittar piqqodohi vedinohi uqeyamohi di ana mepaqqedak yoma den:
Pen-tokal vesabaeta ubattim tobim tibneh veyashabeta
Dilema tekul vetisba ubattin shappirin tibne veteteb:
Ubeqareka vetzoneka yirbeyun vekesep vezahab yirbeh-lak vekol asher-leka yirbeh
Vetorak veanak yisgun vekaspa vedahaba yisge lak vekol di lak yisge:
Veram lebabeka veshakachta et-Adonai eloheka hammotziaka meeretz mitzrayim mibbet abadim
Virim libbak vetinshe yat dachalta daAdonai elahak di appeqak meara demitzrayim mibbet abduta:
Hammolikeka bammidbar haggadol vehannora nachash sarap veaqrab vetzimmaon asher en-mayim hammotzi leka mayim mitztzur hachallamish
Dedabberak bemadbera rabba udechila atar chevan qalan veaqrabbin ubet tzachavana atar di let mayya deappeq lak mayya mittinnara taqqipa:
Hammaakilka man bammidbar asher lo-yadeun aboteka lemaan annoteka ulemaan nassoteka lehetibeka beachariteka
Deokalak manna bemadbera di la yadeun abahatak bedil leannayutak ubedil lenassayutak leotaba lak besopak:
Veamarta bilbabeka kochi veotzem yadi asa li et-hachayil hazzeh
Vetemar belibbak cheli uteqep yedi qeno li yat niksayya haillen:
Vezakarta et-Adonai eloheka ki hu hannoten leka koach laasot chayil lemaan haqim et-berito asher-nishba laaboteka kayyom hazzeh
Vetidkar yat Adonai elahak are hu yaheb lak etza lemiqne niksin bedil leqayyama yat qeyameh di qayyim laabahatak keyoma haden:
Vehaya im-shakoach tishkach et-Adonai eloheka vehalakta achare elohim acherim vaabadtam vehishtachavita lahem haidoti bakem hayyom ki abod tobedun
Vihe im minshaa tinshe yat dachalta daAdonai elahak utehak batar taavat ammayya vetiplechinnun vetisgud lehon ashedit bekon yoma den are mebad tebedun:
Kaggoyim asher Adonai maabid mippenekem ken tobedun eqeb lo tishmeun beqol Adonai elohekem
Keammayya di Adonai mobid miqqadamekon ken tebedun cholap dila qabbeltun bememera daAdonai elahakon:
Shema yisrael atta ober hayyom et-hayyarden labo lareshet goyim gedolim vaatzumim mimmekka arim gedolot ubetzurot bashshamayim
Shema yisrael at aber yoma den yat yardena lemeal lemerat ammin rabrebin vetaqqipin minnak qirvin rabreban ukerikan ad tzet shemayya:
Am-gadol varam bene anaqim asher atta yadata veatta shamata mi yityatztzeb lipne bene anaq
Am rab vetaqqip bene gibbarayya di at yedaat veat shemaat man yikkul lemeqam qodam bene gibbarayya:
Veyadata hayyom ki Adonai eloheka hu-haober lepaneka esh okela hu yashmidem vehu yakniem lepaneka vehorashtam vehaabadtam maher kaasher dibber Adonai lak
Vetidda yoma den are Adonai elahak hu deibar qodamak memereh eshsha okla hu yeshetzinnun vehu yetarekinnun qodamak utetarekinnun vetobedinnun bipria kema di mallil Adonai lak:
Al-tomar bilbabeka bahadop Adonai eloheka otam millepaneka lemor betzidqati hebiani Adonai lareshet et-haaretz hazzot uberishat haggoyim haelleh Adonai morisham mippaneka
La temar belibbak bidyittebar Adonai elahak yatehon miqqodamak lememar bezakuti aalani Adonai lemerat yat ara hada ubechobe ammayya haillen Adonai metarek lehon miqqodamak:

Lo betzidqateka ubeyosher lebabeka atta ba lareshet et-artzam ki berishat haggoyim haelleh Adonai eloheka morisham mippaneka ulemaan haqim et-haddabar asher nishba Adonai laaboteka leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob

La bezakutak ubeqashshitut libbak at alel lemerat yat arahon are bechobe ammayya haillen Adonai elahak metarekhon miqqodamak ubedil laaqama yat pitgama di qayyim Adonai laabahatak leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob:
Veyadata ki lo betzidqateka Adonai eloheka noten leka et-haaretz hattoba hazzot lerishtah ki am-qesheh-orep atta
Vetidda are la bezakutak Adonai elahak yaheb lak yat ara tabta hada lemeretah are am qeshe qedal at:
Zekor al-tishkach et asher-hiqtzapta et-Adonai eloheka bammidbar lemin-hayyom asher-yatzata meeretz mitzrayim ad-boakem ad-hammaqom hazzeh mamrim heyitem im-Adonai
Heve dekir la tinshe yat di argezta qodam Adonai elahak bemadbera lemin yoma di nepaqta meara demitzrayim ad metekon ad atra haden mesarebin havetun qodam Adonai:
Ubechoreb hiqtzaptem et-Adonai vayyitannap Adonai bakem lehashmid etkem
Ubechoreb argeztun qodam Adonai vahava regaz min qodam Adonai bekon leshetzaa yatekon:
Baaloti hahara laqachat luchot haabanim luchot habberit asher-karat Adonai immakem vaesheb bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo akalti umayim lo shatiti
Bemisseqi letura lemissab luche abnayya luche qeyama di gezar Adonai immekon vitebit betura arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan lachma la akalit umayya la ishteti:
Vayyitten Adonai elay et-shene luchot haabanim ketubim beetzba elohim vaalehem kekol-haddebarim asher dibber Adonai immakem bahar mittok haesh beyom haqqahal
Vihab Adonai li yat teren luche abnayya ketibin beetzbea daAdonai vaalehon kekal pitgamayya di mallil Adonai immekon betura miggo eshshata beyoma diqhala:
Vayehi miqqetz arbaim yom vearbaim layela natan Adonai elay et-shene luchot haabanim luchot habberit
Vahava missop arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan yehab Adonai li yat teren luche abnayya luche qeyama:
Vayyomer Adonai elay qum red maher mizzeh ki shichet ammeka asher hotzeta mimmitzrayim saru maher min-hadderek asher tzivvitim asu lahem masseka
Vaamar Adonai li qum chut bipria mikka are chabbil ammak di appeqta mimmitzrayim satu bipria min orcha di paqqedtinnun abadu lehon matteka:
Vayyomer Adonai elay lemor raiti et-haam hazzeh vehinneh am-qesheh-orep hu
Vaamar Adonai li lememar geli qodamay yat amma haden veha am qeshe qedal hu:
Herep mimmenni veashmidem veemcheh et-shemam mittachat hashshamayim veeeseh oteka legoy-atzum varab mimmennu
Annach bautak miqqodamay veeshetzinnun veemche yat shimhon mittechot shemayya veebed yatak leam taqqip vesaggi minnehon:
Vaepen vaered min-hahar vehahar boer baesh ushene luchot habberit al shete yaday
Veitpeneti unechatit min tura vetura baer beeshshata uteren luche qeyama al tarten yeday:
Vaere vehinneh chatatem la-Adonai elohekem asitem lakem egel masseka sartem maher min-hadderek asher-tzivva Adonai etkem
Vachazeti veha chabtun qodam Adonai elahakon abadtun lekon egel matteka setetun bipria min orcha di paqqid Adonai yatekon:
Vaetpos bishne halluchot vaashlikem meal shete yaday vaashabberem leenekem
Vaachadit bitren luchayya uremitinnun meal tarten yeday utebartinnun leenekon:
Vaetnappal lipne Adonai karishona arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo akalti umayim lo shatiti al kol-chattatkem asher chatatem laasot hara beene Adonai lehakiso
Veishtattachit qodam Adonai keqadmeta arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan lachma la akalit umayya la ishteti al kol chobekon di chabtun lemebad debish qodam Adonai leargaza qodamohi:
Ki yagoreti mippene haap vehachema asher qatzap Adonai alekem lehashmid etkem vayyishma Adonai elay gam bappaam hahiv
Are dechelit miqqodam rogza vechemeta di regaz Adonai alekon leshetzaa yatekon veqabbil Adonai tzeloti ap bezimna hahi:
Ubeaharon hitannap Adonai meod lehashmido vaetpallel gam-bead aharon baet hahiv
Veal aharon hava regaz min qodam Adonai lachada leshetzayuteh vetzalleti ap al aharon beiddana hahi:
Veet-chattatkem asher-asitem et-haegel laqachti vaesrop oto baesh vaekkot oto tachon heteb ad asher-daq leapar vaashlik et-aparo el-hannachal hayyored min-hahar
Veyat chobatkon di abadtun yat egla nesebit veoqedit yateh benura veshapit yateh beshupina yaut ad di hava daqqiq leapra uremet yat apreh lenachala denachet min tura:
Ubetabera ubemassa ubeqibrot hattaava maqtzipim heyitem et-Adonai
Ubidleqta ubenisseta ubeqibre dimshaale margezin havetun qodam Adonai:
Ubishloach Adonai etkem miqqadesh barnea lemor alu ureshu et-haaretz asher natatti lakem vattamru et-pi Adonai elohekem velo heemantem lo velo shematem beqolo
Vekad shelach Adonai yatekon mereqam gea lememar seqo veachasinu yat ara di yehabit lekon vesarebtun al gezerat memera daAdonai elahakon vela hemantun leh vela qabbeltun lememereh:
Mamrim heyitem im-Adonai miyyom dati etkem
Mesarebin havetun qodam Adonai miyyoma didait yatekon:
Vaetnappal lipne Adonai et arbaim hayyom veet-arbaim hallayla asher hitnappaleti ki-amar Adonai lehashmid etkem
Veishtattachit qodam Adonai yat arbein yemamin veyat arbein lelavan di ishtattachit are amar Adonai leshetzaa yatekon:
Vaetpallel el-Adonai vaomar adonay Adonai al-tashchet ammeka venachalateka asher padita begodleka asher-hotzeta mimmitzrayim beyad chazaqa
Vetzalleti qodam Adonai vaamarit Adonai elahim la techabbal ammak veachasantak di peraqta betaqepak di appeqta mimmitzrayim bida taqqipa:
Zekor laabadeka leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob al-tepen el-qeshi haam hazzeh veel-risho veel-chattato
Iddekar leabdayk leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob la titpene leqashyut amma haden ulechobehon velachataehon:
Pen-yomeru haaretz asher hotzetanu mishsham mibbeli yekolet Adonai lahabiam el-haaretz asher-dibber lahem umissinato otam hotziam lahamitam bammidbar
Dilema yemerun dayere ara di appeqtana mittamman middelet yukela daAdonai leaaluthon leara di mallil lehon umiddesane yatehon appeqinnun leqattalutehon bemadbera:
Vehem ammeka venachalateka asher hotzeta bekochaka haggadol ubizeroaka hannetuya
Veinnun ammak veachasantak di appeqta bechelak rabba ubidraak meramema:
Baet hahiv amar Adonai elay pesol-leka shene-lvchot abanim karishonim vaaleh elay hahara veasita leka aron etz
Beiddana hahi amar Adonai li pesal lak teren luche abnayya keqadmae vesaq loqodamay letura vetabed lak arona deaa:
Veektob al-halluchot et-haddebarim asher hayu al-halluchot harishonim asher shibbarta vesamtam baaron
Veektob al luchayya yat pitgamayya di havo al luchayya qadmae di tebarta uteshavvinnun baarona:
Vaaas aron atze shittim vaepsol shene-luchot abanim karishonim vaaal hahara ushene halluchot beyadi
Vaabadit arona deae shittin upesalit teren luche abnayya keqadmae useleqit letura uteren luchayya bidi:
Vayyiktob al-halluchot kammiktab harishon et aseret haddebarim asher dibber Adonai alekem bahar mittok haesh beyom haqqahal vayyittenem Adonai elay
Uketab al luchayya kiktaba qadmaa yat asra pitgamayya di mallil Adonai immekon betura miggo eshata beyoma diqhala vihabinnun Adonai li:
Vaepen vaered min-hahar vaasim et-halluchot baaron asher asiti vayyihyu sham kaasher tzivvani Adonai
Veitpeneti unechatit min tura veshavveti yat luchayya baarona di abadit vahavo tamman kema di paqqedani Adonai:
Ubene yisrael naseu mibbeerot bene-yaaqan mosera sham met aharon vayyiqqaber sham vayekahen elazar beno tachtayv
Ubene yisrael netalu mibbeerot bene yaaqan lemosera tamman mit aharon veitqebar tamman veshammesh elazar bereh techotohi:
Mishsham naseu haggudgoda umin-haggudgoda yotbata eretz nachale mayim
Mittamman netalu legudgod umin gudgod leyatebat ara nagedan nachalin demayyin:
Baet hahiv hibdil Adonai et-shebet hallevi laset et-aron berit-Adonai laamod lipne Adonai leshareto ulebarek bishmo ad hayyom hazzeh
Beiddana hahi apresh Adonai yat shibta delevi lemittal yat aron qeyama daAdonai lemeqam qodam Adonai leshammashuteh ulebaraka bishmeh ad yoma haden:
Al-ken lo-haya lelevi cheleq venachala im-echayv Adonai hu nachalato kaasher dibber Adonai eloheka lo
Al ken la hava lelevi cholaq veachasana im achohi mattenan dihab leh Adonai innun achasanteh kema di mallil Adonai elahak leh:
Veanoki amadti bahar kayyamim harishonim arbaim yom vearbaim layela vayyishma Adonai elay gam bappaam hahiv lo-aba Adonai hashchiteka
Vaana haveti qaem betura keyomin qadmain arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan veqabbil Adonai tzeloti ap bezimna hahu la abe Adonai lechabbalutak:
Vayyomer Adonai elay qum lek lemassa lipne haam veyabou veyireshu et-haaretz asher-nishbati laabotam latet lahem
Vaamar Adonai li qum zil lemittul qodam amma veyealun veyeretun yat ara di qayyemit laabahatehon lemittan lehon:
Veatta yisrael ma Adonai eloheka shoel meimmak ki im-leyira et-Adonai eloheka laleket bekol-derakayv uleahaba oto velaabod et-Adonai eloheka bekol-lebabeka ubekol-napsheka
Ukean yisrael ma Adonai elahak taba minnak ellahen lemidchal qodam Adonai elahak limhak bekol orchan detaqenan qodamohi ulemircham yateh ulemiplach qodam Adonai elahak bekol libbak ubekol napshak:
Lishmor et-mitzvot Adonai veet-chuqqotayv asher anoki metzavveka hayyom letob lak
Lemittar yat piqqodayya daAdonai veyat qeyamohi daana mepaqqedak yoma den lidyetab lak:
Hen la-Adonai eloheka hashshamayim usheme hashshamayim haaretz vekol-asher-bah
Ha daAdonai elahak shemayya usheme shemayya ara vekol di bah:
Raq baaboteka chashaq Adonai leahaba otam vayyibchar bezaram acharehem bakem mikkol-haammim kayyom hazzeh
Lechod baabahatak tzabe Adonai lemircham yatehon veittire bibnehon batrehon bekon mikkol ammayya keyoma haden:
Umaltem et orlat lebabkem veorpekem lo taqshu od
Vetedun yat tapshut libbekon uqedalekon la taqshun od:
Ki Adonai elohekem hu elohe haelohim vaadone haadonim hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora asher lo-yissa panim velo yiqqach shochad
Are Adonai elahakon hu elaha dayyanin umare malkin elaha rabba gibbara udechila di let qodamohi missab appin veap la leqabbala shacheda:
Oseh mishpat yatom vealmana veoheb ger latet lo lechem vesimla
Abed din yittam vearmela verachem giyyora lemittan leh mezona ukesu:
Vaahabtem et-hagger ki-gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim
Vetirchamun yat giyyora are dayyarin havetun beara demitzrayim:
Et-Adonai eloheka tira oto taabod ubo tidbaq ubishmo tishshabea
Yat Adonai elahak tidchal uqodamohi tiplach uledachalteh tiqrab ubishmeh teqayyam:
Hu tehillateka vehu eloheka asher-asa itteka et-haggedolot veet-hannoraot haelleh asher rau eneka
Hu tushbachtak vehu elahak daabad immak yat rabrebata veyat chasinata haillen di chazo enayk:
Beshibim nepesh yaredu aboteka mitzrayema veatta sameka Adonai eloheka kekokebe hashshamayim larob
Beshabin napshan nechatu abahatak lemitzrayim ukean shavveyak Adonai elahak kekokebe shemayya lemisge:
Veahabta et Adonai eloheka veshamarta mishmarto vechuqqotayv umishpatayv umitzvotayv kol-hayyamim
Vetircham yat Adonai elahak vetittar matterat memereh uqeyamohi vedinohi upiqqodohi kol yomayya:
Vidatem hayyom ki lo et-benekem asher lo-yadeu vaasher lo-rau et-mvsar Adonai elohekem et-godlo et-yado hachazaqa uzeroo hannetuya
Vetiddeun yoma den are la yat benekon di la yedau vedi la chazo yat ulpana daAdonai elahakon yat rebuteh yat yedeh taqqipa uderaeh meramema:
Veet-ototayv veet-maasayv asher asa betok mitzrayim leparoh melek-mitzrayim ulekol-artzo
Veyat atvateh veyat obadohi di abad bego mitzrayim leparoh malka demitzrayim ulekal areh:
Vaasher asa lechel mitzrayim lesusayv ulerikbo asher hetzip et-me yam-svp al-penehem berodpam acharekem vayeabbedem Adonai ad hayyom hazzeh
Vedi abad lemashshiryat mitzrayim lesusavateh velirtikohi di attip yat me yamma desup al appehon bemirdapehon batrekon veobadinnun Adonai ad yoma haden:
Vaasher asa lakem bammidbar ad-boakem ad-hammaqom hazzeh
Vedi abad lekon bemadbera ad metekon ad atra haden:
Vaasher asa ledatan velaabiram bene eliab ben-reuben asher patzeta haaretz et-piha vattiblaem veet-battehem veet-oholehem veet kol-hayequm asher beraglehem beqereb kol-yisrael
Vedi abad ledatan velaabiram bene eliab bar reuben di petachat ara yat pumah ubelaatenun veyat enash battehon veyat mashkenehon veyat kol yequma di immehon bego kol yisrael:
Ki enekem haroot et-kol-maaseh Adonai haggadol asher asa
Are enekon chazaa yat kol obada daAdonai rabba di abad:
Ushemartem et-kol-hammitzva asher anoki metzavveka hayyom lemaan techezqu ubatem virishtem et-haaretz asher attem oberim shamma lerishtah
Vetittar yat kol tapqedta di ana mepaqqedak yoma den bedil detitqepun vetealun veteretun yat ara di attun aberin tamman lemeretah:
Ulemaan taariku yamim al-haadama asher nishba Adonai laabotekem latet lahem ulezaram eretz zabat chalab udebash
Ubedil detorekun yomin al ara di qayyim Adonai laabahatekon lemittan lehon velibnehon ara abeda chalab udebash:
Ki haaretz asher atta ba-shamma lerishtah lo keeretz mitzrayim hiv asher yetzatem mishsham asher tizra et-zaraka vehishqita beragleka kegan hayyaraq
Are ara di at alel letamman lemeretah la keara demitzrayim hi di nepaqtun mittamman di tizra yat zarak umashqat leh beraglak keginta yarqa:
Vehaaretz asher attem oberim shamma lerishtah eretz harim ubeqaot limtar hashshamayim tishteh-mayim
Veara di attun aberin tamman lemeretah ara turin ubiqan limtar shemayya tishte mayya:
Eretz asher-Adonai eloheka doresh otah tamid ene Adonai eloheka bah mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana
Ara daAdonai elahak taba yatah tedira ene Adonai elahak bah meresha deshatta vead sopa deshatta:
Vehaya im-shamoa tishmeu el-mitzvotay asher anoki metzavveh etkem hayyom leahaba et-Adonai elohekem uleobdo bekol-lebabkem ubekol-napshekem
Vihe im qabbala teqabbelun lepiqqoday di ana mepaqqed yatekon yoma den lemircham yat Adonai elahakon ulemiplach qodamohi bekol libbekon ubekol napshekon:
Venatatti metar-artzekem beitto yoreh umalqosh veasapta deganeka vetirosheka veyitzhareka
Veetten metar arakon beiddaneh bakkir velaqqish vetiknosh ibburak vechamrak umishchak:
Venatatti eseb besadeka libhemteka veakalta vesabaeta
Veetten isba bechaqlak libirak vetekul vetisba:
Hishshameru lakem pen yipteh lebabkem vesartem vaabadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem
Istammaru lekon dilema yitun libbekon vetistun vetiplechun letaavat ammayya vetisgedun lehon:
Vechara ap-Adonai bakem veatzar et-hashshamayim velo-yihyeh matar vehaadama lo titten et-yebulah vaabadtem mehera meal haaretz hattoba asher Adonai noten lakem
Veyitqop rogza daAdonai bekon veyechod yat shemayya vela yehe mitra veara la titten yat alaltah vetebedun bipria meal ara tabta daAdonai yaheb lekon:
Vesamtem et-debaray elleh al-lebabkem veal-napshekem uqeshartem otam leot al-yedkem vehayu letotapot ben enekem
Uteshavvun yat pitgamay illen al libbekon veal napshekon vetiqterun yatehon leat al yedkon vihon litpillin ben enekon:
Velimmadtem otam et-benekem ledabber bam beshibteka bebeteka ubelekteka badderek ubeshokbeka ubequmeka
Vetallepun yatehon yat benekon lemallala behon bemittebak bebetak ubimhakak beorcha ubemishkebak ubimqimak:
Uketabtam al-mezuzot beteka ubishareka
Vetiktebinnun al mezuzeyan vetiqbeinnun besippe betak ubetarak:
Lemaan yirbu yemekem vime benekem al haadama asher nishba Adonai laabotekem latet lahem kime hashshamayim al-haaretz
Bedil deyisgun yomekon veyome benekon al ara di qayyim Adonai laabahatekon lemittan lehon keyome shemayya al ara:
Ki im-shamor tishmerun et-kol-hammitzva hazzot asher anoki metzavveh etkem laasotah leahaba et-Adonai elohekem laleket bekol-derakayv uledobqa-bo
Are im mittar titterun yat kol tapqedta hada di ana mepaqqed yatekon lemebedah lemircham yat Adonai elahakon limhak bekol orchan detaqnan qodamohi uleitqeraba ledachalteh:
Vehorish Adonai et-kol-haggoyim haelleh millipnekem virishtem goyim gedolim vaatzumim mikkem
Vitarak Adonai yat kol ammayya haillen miqqodamekon veteretun ammin rabrebin vetaqqipin minnekon:
Kol-hammaqom asher tidrok kap-raglekem bo lakem yihyeh min-hammidbar vehallebanon min-hannahar nehar-perat vead hayyam haacharon yihyeh gebulkem
Kol atra di tidrok parsat raglekon beh dilkon yehe min madbera velibnan min nahara nehar perat vead yamma maarba yehe techumekon:
Lo-yityatztzeb ish bipnekem pachdekem umoraakem yitten Adonai elohekem al-pene kol-haaretz asher tidreku-ba kaasher dibber lakem
La yitattad enash qodamekon dachalatekon veematekon yitten Adonai elahakon al appe kol ara di tidrekun bah kema di mallil lekon:
Reeh anoki noten lipnekem hayyom beraka uqelala
Chaze di ana yaheb qodamekon yoma den birkan ulevatin:
Et-habberaka asher tishmeu el-mitzvot Adonai elohekem asher anoki metzavveh etkem hayyom
Yat birkan di teqabbelun lepiqqudayya daAdonai elahakon di ana mepaqqed yatekon yoma den:
Vehaqqelala im-lo tishmeu el-mitzvot Adonai elohekem vesartem min-hadderek asher anoki metzavveh etkem hayyom laleket achare elohim acherim asher lo-yedatem
Ulevatayya im la teqabbelun lepiqqudayya daAdonai elahakon vetistun min orcha di ana mepaqqed yatekon yoma den limhak batar taavat ammayya di la yedatun:
Vehaya ki yebiaka Adonai eloheka el-haaretz asher-atta ba-shamma lerishtah venatatta et-habberaka al-har gerizim veet-haqqelala al-har ebal
Vihe are yeelinnak Adonai elahak leara di at alel tamman lemeretah vetitten yat mebarekayya al tura diggerizzin veyat melattayya al tura deebal:
Halo-hemma beeber hayyarden achare derek mebo hashshemesh beeretz hakkenaani hayyosheb baaraba mul haggilgal etzel elone moreh
Hala innun beibra deyardena achore orach maalane shimsha beara kenaanaa deyateb bemeshera loqobel gilgela bistar meshere moreh:
Ki attem oberim et-hayyarden labo lareshet et-haaretz asher-Adonai elohekem noten lakem virishtem otah vishabtem-bah
Are attun aberin yat yardena lemeal lemerat yat ara daAdonai elahakon yaheb lekon veteretun yatah vetetebun bah:
Ushemartem laasot et kol-hachuqqim veet-hammishpatim asher anoki noten lipnekem hayyom
Vetitterun lemebad yat kol qeyamayya veyat dinayya di ana yaheb qodamekon yoma den:
Elleh hachuqqim vehammishpatim asher tishmerun laasot baaretz asher natan Adonai elohe aboteka leka lerishtah kol-hayyamim asher-attem chayyim al-haadama
Illen qeyamayya vedinayya di titterun lemebad beara dihab Adonai elaha daabahatak lak lemeretah kol yomayya di attun qayyamin al ara:
Abbed teabbedun et-kol-hammeqomot asher abedu-sham haggoyim asher attem yoreshim otam et-elohehem al-heharim haramim veal-haggebaot vetachat kol-etz raanan
Abbada teabbedun yat kol atrayya di pelachu tamman ammayya di attun yaretin yatehon yat taavatehon al turayya ramayya veal ramata utechot kol ilan abbop:
Venittatztem et-mizbechotam veshibbartem et-matztzebotam vaasherehem tisrepun baesh upesile elohehem tegaddeun veibbadtem et-shemam min-hammaqom hahu
Utetareun yat egorehon utetabberun yat qamatehon vaasherehon toqedun benura vetzalme taavatehon teqotzetzun vetobedun yat shimhon min atra hahu:
Lo-taasun ken la-Adonai elohekem
La tabedun ken qodam Adonai elahakon:
Ki im-el-hammaqom asher-yibchar Adonai elohekem mikkol-shibtekem lasum et-shemo sham leshikno tidreshu ubata shamma
Ellahen leatra di yittire Adonai elahakon mikkol shibtekon leashraa shekinteh tamman lebet shekinteh titbeun vetetun letamman:
Vahabetem shamma olotekem vezibchekem veet maserotekem veet terumat yedkem venidrekem venidbotekem ubekorot beqarkem vetzonekem
Vetaytun letamman alavatekon veniksat qudeshekon veyat maseratekon veyat aprashut yedkon venidrekon venidbatekon ubekore torekon veanekon:
Vaakaltem-sham lipne Adonai elohekem usemachtem bekol mishlach yedkem attem ubattekem asher berakka Adonai eloheka
Vetekelun tamman qodam Adonai elahakon vetechedun bekol oshatut yedkon attun veenash battekon di barekak Adonai elahak:
Lo taasun kekol asher anachnu osim poh hayyom ish kol-hayyashar beenayv
La tabedun kekol di anachna abedin haka yoma den gebar kol man dekashar qodamohi:
Ki lo-batem ad-atta el-hammenucha veel-hannachala asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak
Are la atetun ad kean lebet neyacha uleachasana daAdonai elahak yaheb lak:
Vaabartem et-hayyarden vishabtem baaretz asher-Adonai elohekem manchil etkem veheniach lakem mikkol-oyebekem missabib vishabtem-betach
Vetaberun yat yardena vetetebun beara daAdonai elahakon machasen yatekon viniach lekon mikkol baale debabekon missechor sechor vetetebun lerachetzan:

Vehaya hammaqom asher-yibchar Adonai elohekem bo leshakken shemo sham shamma tabiu et kol-asher anoki metzavveh etkem olotekem vezibchekem maserotekem uterumat yedkem vekol mibchar nidrekem asher tidderu la-Adonai

Vihe atra di yittire Adonai elahakon beh leashraa shekinteh tamman letamman taytun yat kol di ana mepaqqed yatekon alavatekon veniksat qudeshekon maseratekon veaprashut yedkon vekol shepar nidrekon di tidderun qodam Adonai:
Usemachtem lipne Adonai elohekem attem ubenekem ubenotekem veabdekem veamhotekem vehallevi asher beshaarekem ki en lo cheleq venachala ittekem
Vetechedun qodam Adonai elahakon attun ubenekon ubenatekon veabdekon veamhatekon velevaa di beqirvekon are let leh cholaq veachasana immekon:
Hishshamer leka pen-taaleh oloteka bekol-maqom asher tireh
Istammar lak dilema tasseq alavatak bekol atra di techeze:
Ki im-bammaqom asher-yibchar Adonai beachad shebateka sham taaleh oloteka vesham taaseh kol asher anoki metzavvekka
Ellahen beatra di yittire Adonai bechad min shibtayk tamman tasseq alavatak vetamman tabed kol di ana mepaqqedak:
Raq bekol-avvat napsheka tizbach veakalta basar kebirkat Adonai eloheka asher natan-leka bekol-sheareka hattame vehattahor yokelennu katztzebi vekaayyal
Lechod bekol reut napshak tikkos vetekul bisra kebirketa daAdonai elahak di yehab lak bekol qirvayk mesaaba vedakya yekeluneh kibsar tabya veayla:
Raq haddam lo tokelu al-haaretz tishpekennu kammayim
Lechod dema la tekelun al ara tishdinneh kemayya:
Lo-tvkal leekol bishareka masar deganeka vetirosheka veyitzhareka ubekorot beqareka vetzoneka vekol-nedareka asher tiddor venidboteka uterumat yadeka
Let lak reshu lemekal beqirvayk masar iburak chamrak umishchak ubekore torak veanak vekol nidrak di tiddar venidbatayk veaprashut yedak:
Ki im-lipne Adonai eloheka tokelennu bammaqom asher yibchar Adonai eloheka bo atta ubinka ubitteka veabdeka vaamateka vehallevi asher bishareka vesamachta lipne Adonai eloheka bekol mishlach yadeka
Ellahen qodam Adonai elahak tekelinneh beatra di yittire Adonai elahak beh at uberak uberattak veabdak veamtak velevaa di beqirvayk vetechede qodam Adonai elahak bekol oshatut yedak:
Hishshamer leka pen-taazob et-hallevi kol-yameka al-admateka
Istammar lak dilema tishboq yat levae kol yomayk al arak:
Ki-yarchib Adonai eloheka et-gebulka kaasher dibber-lak veamarta okela basar ki-teavveh napsheka leekol basar bekol-avvat napsheka tokal basar
Are yapte Adonai elahak yat techumak kema di mallil lak vetemar ekul bisra are tittire napshak lemekal bisra bekol reut napshak tekul bisra:
Ki-yirchaq mimmeka hammaqom asher yibchar Adonai eloheka lasum shemo sham vezabachta mibbeqareka umitztzoneka asher natan Adonai leka kaasher tzivvitika veakalta bishareka bekol avvat napsheka
Are yitrachaq minnak atra di yittire Adonai elahak leashraa shekinteh tamman vetikkos mittorak umeanak di yehab Adonai lak kema di paqqedittak vetekul beqirvayk bekol reut napshak:
Ak kaasher yeakel et-hatztzebi veet-haayyal ken tokelennu hattame vehattahor yachdav yokelennu
Beram kema di mitakel besar tabya veayla ken tekelinneh mesaaba vedakya kachada yekelinneh:
Raq chazaq lebilti akol haddam ki haddam hu hannapesh velo-tokal hannepesh im-habbasar
Lechod teqep bedil dela lemekal dema are dema hu napsha vela tekul napsha im bisra:
Lo tokelennu al-haaretz tishpekennu kammayim
La tekelinneh al ara tishdinneh kemayya:
Lo tokelennu lemaan yitab leka ulebaneka achareka ki-taaseh hayyashar beene Adonai
La tekelinneh bedil deyetab lak velibnayk batrak are tabed dekashar qodam Adonai:
Raq qodasheka asher-yihyu leka unedareka tissa ubata el-hammaqom asher-yibchar Adonai
Lechod masar qudeshayk dihon lak venidrak tittol vetete leatra di yittire Adonai:
Veasita oloteka habbasar vehaddam al-mizbach Adonai eloheka vedam-zebacheka yishshapek al-mizbach Adonai eloheka vehabbasar tokel
Vetabed alavatak bisra udema al madbecha daAdonai elahak vedam niksat qudeshayk yishtepek al madbecha daAdonai elahak ubisra tekul:
Shemor veshamata et kol-haddebarim haelleh asher anoki metzavvekka lemaan yitab leka ulebaneka achareka ad-olam ki taaseh hattob vehayyashar beene Adonai eloheka
Tar uteqabbal yat kol pitgamayya haillen di ana mepaqqedak bedil deyetab lak velibnayk batrak ad olam are tabed detaqen udekashar qodam Adonai elahak:
Ki-yakrit Adonai eloheka et-haggoyim asher atta ba-shamma lareshet otam mippaneka veyarashta otam veyashabta beartzam
Are yeshetze Adonai elahak yat ammayya di at alel letamman letaraka yatehon miqqodamak veterat yatehon vetetab bearahon:
Hishshamer leka pen-tinnaqesh acharehem achare hishshamedam mippaneka upen-tidrosh lelohehem lemor eka yaabdu haggoyim haelleh et-elohehem veeeseh-ken gam-ani
Istammar lak dilema tittaqal batrehon batar deyishtetzun miqqodamak vedilema titba letaavatehon lememar ekden palechin ammayya haillen yat taavatehon veebed ken ap ana:
Lo-taaseh ken la-Adonai eloheka ki kol-toabat Adonai asher sane asu lelohehem ki gam et-benehem veet-benotehem yisrepu baesh lelohehem
La tabed ken qodam Adonai elahak are kol dimrachaq qodam Adonai di sane abadu letaavatehon are ap yat benehon veyat benatehon yoqedin benura letaavatehon:
Et kol-haddabar asher anoki metzavveh etkem oto tishmeru laasot lo-tosep alayv velo tigra mimmennu
Yat kol pitgama di ana mepaqqed yatekon yateh titterun lemebad la tosepun alohi vela timneun minneh:
Ki-yaqum beqirbeka nabi o cholem chalom venatan eleka ot o mopet
Are yequm benak nebiyya o chalem chelma veyitten lak at o mopeta:
Uba haot vehammopet asher-dibber eleka lemor neleka achare elohim acherim asher lo-yedatam venoobdem
Veyete ata umopeta di mallil immak lememar nehak batar taavat ammayya di la yedatanun veniplechinnun:
Lo tishma el-dibre hannabi hahu o el-cholem hachalom hahu ki menasseh Adonai elohekem etkem ladaat hayishkem ohabim et-Adonai elohekem bekol-lebabkem ubekol-napshekem
La teqabbel lepitgame nebiyya hahu o lechalem chelma hahu are menasse Adonai elahakon yatekon lemidda haitekon rachamin yat Adonai elahakon bekol libbekon ubekol napshekon:
Achare Adonai elohekem teleku veoto tirau veet-mitzvotayv tishmoru ubeqolo tishmau veoto taabodu ubo tidbaqun
Batar dachalta daAdonai elahakon tehakun veyateh tidchalun veyat piqqodohi titterun ulememereh teqabbelun veqadamohi tiplechun ubedachalteh titqarebun:

Vehannabi hahu o cholem hachalom hahu yumat ki dibber-sara al-Adonai elohekem hammotzi etkem meeretz mitzrayim vehappodeka mibbet abadim lehaddichaka min-hadderek asher tzivveka Adonai eloheka laleket bah ubiarta hara miqqirbeka

Unebiyya hahu o chalem chelma hahu yitqetel are mallil satya al Adonai elahakon di appeq yatekon meara demitzrayim udepareqak mibbet abduta leatayutak min orcha di paqqedak Adonai elahak limhak bah utepalle abed debish mibbenak:
Ki yesiteka achika ben-immeka o-binka o-bitteka o eshet cheqeka o reaka asher kenapsheka basseter lemor neleka venaabda elohim acherim asher lo yadata atta vaaboteka
Are yemallekinnak achuk bar immak o berak o berattak o ittat qeyamak o chabrak di kenapshak besitra lememar nehak veniplach letaavat ammayya di la yedaat at vaabahatak:
Meelohe haammim asher sebibotekem haqqerobim eleka o harechoqim mimmekka miqtzeh haaretz vead-qetzeh haaretz
Mittaavat ammayya di besacharanekon diqribin lak o dirchiqin minnak misseyape ara vead seyape ara:
Lo-tobeh lo velo tishma elayv velo-tachos eneka alayv velo-tachmol velo-tekasseh alayv
La tebe leh vela teqabbel minneh vela techus enak alohi vela teracham vela tekasse alohi:
Ki harog tahargennu yadeka tiheyeh-bo barishona lahamito veyad kol-haam baacharona
Are miqtal tiqtelinneh yedak tehe beh beqadmeta lemiqteleh vida dekal amma bebatreta:
Useqalto baabanim vamet ki biqqesh lehaddichaka meal Adonai eloheka hammotziaka meeretz mitzrayim mibbet abadim
Vetirgeminneh beabnayya vimut are baa leatayutak middachalta daAdonai elahak di appeqak meara demitzrayim mibbet abduta:
Vekol-yisrael yishmeu veyiraun velo-yosipu laasot kaddabar hara hazzeh beqirbeka
Vekol yisrael yishmeun veyidchalun vela yosepun lemebad kepitgama bisha haden benak:
Ki-tishma beachat areka asher Adonai eloheka noten leka lashebet sham lemor
Are tishma bechad miqqirvayk di Adonai elahak yaheb lak lemittab tamman lememar:
Yatzeu anashim bene-beliyyaal miqqirbeka vayyaddichu et-yoshebe iram lemor neleka venaabda elohim acherim asher lo-yedatem
Nepaqu gubrin bene risha mibbenak veatayu yat yatebe qartehon lememar nehak veniplach letaavat ammayya di la yedatun:
Vedarashta vechaqarta veshaalta heteb vehinneh emet nakon haddabar neesta hattoeba hazzot beqirbeka
Vetitba vetibdoq vetishal yaut veha qushta kevan pitgama itabida toebta hada benak:
Hakkeh takkeh et-yoshebe hair hahiv lepi-chareb hacharem otah veet-kol-asher-bah veet-behemtah lepi-chareb
Mimcha timche yat yatebe qarta hahi lepitgam dechareb gammar yatah veyat kol di bah veyat beirah lepitgam dechareb:
Veet-kol-shelalah tiqbotz el-tok rechobah vesarapta baesh et-hair veet-kol-shelalah kalil la-Adonai eloheka vehayeta tel olam lo tibbaneh od
Veyat kol adaah tiknosh lego petayyah vetoqed benura yat qarta veyat kol adaah gemir qodam Adonai elahak utehe tel charib lealam la titbene od:
Velo-yidbaq beyadeka meuma min-hacherem lemaan yashub Adonai mecharon appo venatan-leka rachamim verichamka vehirbeka kaasher nishba laaboteka
Vela yidbaq bidak middaam min cherma bedil ditub Adonai mitteqop rugezeh veyehab lak rachamin viracham alak veyasginnak kema di qayyim laabahatak:
Ki tishma beqol Adonai eloheka lishmor et-kol-mitzvotayv asher anoki metzavveka hayyom laasot hayyashar beene Adonai eloheka
Are teqabbel lememera daAdonai elahak lemittar yat kol piqqodohi di ana mepaqqedak yoma den lemebad dekashar qodam Adonai elahak:
Banim attem la-Adonai elohekem lo titgodedu velo-tasimu qorcha ben enekem lamet
Benin attun qodam Adonai elahakon la titchammun vela teshavvun merat ben enekon al mit:
Ki am qadosh atta la-Adonai eloheka ubeka bachar Adonai liheyot lo leam segulla mikkol haammim asher al-pene haadama
Are am qaddish at qodam Adonai elahak ubak ittire Adonai lemeheve leh leam chabbib mikkol ammayya di al appe ara:
Lo tokal kol-toeba
La tekul kol dimrachaq:
Zot habbehema asher tokelu shor seh kesabim veseh izzim
Den beira detekelun torin immerin dirchelin vegadeyan deizzin:
Ayyal utzebi veyachmur veaqqo vedishon uteo vazamer
Ayyala vetabya veyachmura veyala verema vetorebala veditza:
Vekol-behema mapreset parsa veshosaat shesa shete perasot maalat gera babbehema otah tokelu
Vekol beira disdiqa parsata umattilpa tilpin tarten parsata masseqa pishra bibira yatah tekelun:
Ak et-zeh lo tokelu mimmaale haggera umimmaprise happarsa hashshesua et-haggamal veet-haarnebet veet-hashshapan ki-maaleh gera hemma uparsa lo hiprisu temeim hem lakem
Beram yat den la tekelun mimmasseqe pishra umimmasdiqe parsata mattilpe tilpayya yat gamla veyat arneba veyat tapza are masseqe pishra innun uparsatehon la sediqa mesaabin innun lekon:
Veet-hachazir ki-mapris parsa hu velo gera tame hu lakem mibbesaram lo tokelu ubeniblatam lo tiggau
Veyat chazira are masdiq parsata hu vela pashar mesaab hu lekon mibbisrehon la tekelun ubinbiltehon la tiqrebun:
Et-zeh tokelu mikkol asher bammayim kol asher-lo senappir veqasqeset tokelu
Yat den tekelun mikkol di bemayya kol di leh tzitzin veqalpin tekelun:
Vekol asher en-lo senappir veqasqeset lo tokelu tame hu lakem
Vekol di let leh tzitzin veqalpin la tekelun mesaab hu lekon:
Kol-tzippor tehora tokelu
Kol tzippar dakya tekelun:
Vezeh asher lo-tokelu mehem hannesher vehapperes vehaozniyya
Veden di la tekelun minnehon nishra vear veazya:
Veharaa veet-haayya vehaddayya leminah
Ubat kanpa vetarapita vedayyeta liznah:
Veet kol-oreb lemino
Veyat kol oreba lizneh:
Veet bat hayyaana veet-hattachmas veet-hashshachap veet-hannetz leminehu
Veyat bat naamita vetzitza vetzippar shachpa venatza liznohi:
Et-hakkos veet-hayyanshup vehattinshamet
Veqadya veqippopa ubavta:
Vehaqqaat veet-harachama veet-hashshalak
Veqata viraqreqa veshale nuna:
Vehachasida vehaanapa leminah vehaddukipat vehaatallep
Vechavvarita veibbu liznah venaggar tura vaatallepa:
Vekol sheretz haop tame hu lakem lo yeakelu
Vekol richasha deopa mesaab hu lekon la yitoklun:
Kol-op tahor tokelu
Kol opa deke tekelun:
Lo tokelu kol-nebela lagger asher-bishareka tittenenna vaakalah o makor lenokri ki am qadosh atta la-Adonai eloheka lo-tebashshel gedi bachaleb immo
La tekelun kol nebila letotab arel di beqirvayk titteninnah veyekelinnah o tezabbeninnah lebar ammin are am qaddish at qodam Adonai elahak la tekul besar bachalab:
Asser teasser et kol-tebuat zareka hayyotze hassadeh shana shana
Assera teasser yat kol alalat zarak deyippoq chaqla shatta beshatta:
Veakalta lipne Adonai eloheka bammaqom asher-yibchar leshakken shemo sham masar deganeka tirosheka veyitzhareka ubekorot beqareka vetzoneka lemaan tilmad leyira et-Adonai eloheka kol-hayyamim
Vetekul qodam Adonai elahak beatra di yittire leashraa shekinteh tamman masar iburak chamrak umishchak ubekore torak veanak bedil detelap lemidchal qodam Adonai elahak kol yomayya:
Veki-yirbeh mimmeka hadderek ki lo tukal seeto ki-yirchaq mimmeka hammaqom asher yibchar Adonai eloheka lasum shemo sham ki yebarekka Adonai eloheka
Vaare yisge minnak orcha are la tikkul lemitteleh are yitrachaq minnak atra di yittire Adonai elahak leashraa shekinteh tamman are yebarekinnak Adonai elahak:
Venatatta bakkasep vetzarta hakkesep beyadeka vehalakta el-hammaqom asher yibchar Adonai eloheka bo
Vetitten bekaspa utetzur kaspa bidak utehak leatra di yittire Adonai elahak beh:
Venatatta hakkesep bekol asher-teavveh napsheka babbaqar ubatztzon ubayyayin ubashshekar ubekol asher tishealeka napsheka veakalta sham lipne Adonai eloheka vesamachta atta ubeteka
Vetitten kaspa bekol di yittire napshak betore ubeana ubachamar chadat veattiq ubekol di tishalinnak napshak vetekul tamman qodam Adonai elahak vetechede at veenash betak:
Vehallevi asher-bishareka lo taazbennu ki en lo cheleq venachala immak
Velevaa di beqirvayk la tishbeqinneh are let leh cholaq veachasana immak:
Miqtzeh shalosh shanim totzi et-kol-masar tebuateka bashshana hahiv vehinnachta bishareka
Missop telat shenin tappeq yat kol masar alaltak beshatta hahi vetatzna beqirvayk:
Uba hallevi ki en-lo cheleq venachala immak vehagger vehayyatom vehaalmana asher bishareka veoklu vesabeu lemaan yebarekka Adonai eloheka bekol-maaseh yadeka asher taaseh
Veyete levaa are let leh cholaq veachasana immak vegiyyora veyittamma vearmela di beqirvayk veyekelun veyisbeun bedil di yebarekinnak Adonai elahak bekol obade yedak di tabed:
Miqqetz sheba-shanim taaseh shemitta
Missop sheba shenin tabed shemitteta:
Vezeh debar hashshemitta shamot kol-baal mashsheh yado asher yashsheh bereehu lo-yiggos et-reehu veet-achiv ki-qara shemitta la-Adonai
Veden pitgam shemitteta detashmet kol gebar mare reshu di yarshe bechabreh la yitba min chabreh umin achuhi are qera shemitteta qodam Adonai:
Et-hannokri tiggos vaasher yihyeh leka et-achika tashmet yadeka
Min bar ammin titba vedi yehe lak im achuk tashmet yedak:
Epes ki lo yiheyeh-beka ebyon ki-barek yebarekka Adonai baaretz asher Adonai eloheka noten-leka nachala lerishtah
Lechod are la yehe bak miskena are baraka yebarekinnak Adonai beara di Adonai elahak yaheb lak achasana lemeretah:
Raq im-shamoa tishma beqol Adonai eloheka lishmor laasot et-kol-hammitzva hazzot asher anoki metzavveka hayyom
Lechod im qabbala teqabbel lememera daAdonai elahak lemittar lemebad yat kol tapqedta hada di ana mepaqqedak yoma den:
Ki-Adonai eloheka berakka kaasher dibber-lak vehaabatta goyim rabbim veatta lo taabot umashalta begoyim rabbim ubeka lo yimsholu
Are Adonai elahak barekak kema di mallil lak vetozep leammin saggiin veat la tezup vetishlot beammin saggiin ubak la yishletun:
Ki-yihyeh beka ebyon meachad acheka beachad sheareka beartzeka asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak lo teammetz et-lebabeka velo tiqpotz et-yadeka meachika haebyon
Are yehe bak miskena chad meachayk bachada miqqirvayk bearak daAdonai elahak yaheb lak la tatqep yat libbak vela tiqpotz yat yedak meachuk miskena:
Ki-patoach tiptach et-yadeka lo vehaabet taabitennu de machsoro asher yechsar lo
Ella miptach tiptach yat yedak leh veozapa tozepinneh kemissat chesroneh deyachasir leh:
Hishshamer leka pen-yihyeh dabar im-lebabeka beliyyaal lemor qareba shenat-hashsheba shenat hashshemitta veraa eneka beachika haebyon velo titten lo veqara aleka el-Adonai vehaya beka chet
Istammar lak dilema yehe pitgam im libbak birsha lememar qeriba shatta shebiata shatta dishmitteta vetabesh enak beachuk miskena vela titten leh veyiqre alak qodam Adonai vihe bak choba:
Naton titten lo velo-yera lebabeka betitteka lo ki biglal haddabar hazzeh yebarekka Adonai eloheka bekol-maaseka ubekol mishlach yadeka
Mittan titten leh vela yabesh libbak bemittenak leh are bedil pitgama haden yebarekinnak Adonai elahak bekol obadak ubekol oshatut yedak:
Ki lo-yechdal ebyon miqqereb haaretz al-ken anoki metzavveka lemor patoach tiptach et-yadeka leachika laaniyyeka uleebyoneka beartzeka
Are la yipsoq miskena miggo ara al ken ana mepaqqedak lememar miptach tiptach yat yedak laachuk leanyak ulemiskenak bearak:
Ki-yimmaker leka achika haibri o haibriyya vaabadeka shesh shanim ubashshana hashshebiit teshallechennu chopshi meimmak
Are yizdabban lak achuk bar yisrael o bat yisrael veyiplechinnak shit shenin ubeshatta shebiata tipterinneh bar chorin meimmak:
Veki-teshallechennu chopshi meimmak lo teshallechennu reqam
Vaare tipterinneh bar chorin meimmak la tipterinneh reqan:
Haaneq taaniq lo mitztzoneka umiggorneka umiyyiqbeka asher berakka Adonai eloheka titten-lo
Aprasha tapresh leh meanak umeidderak umimmaatzartak di barekak Adonai elahak titten leh:
Vezakarta ki ebed hayita beeretz mitzrayim vayyipdeka Adonai eloheka al-ken anoki metzavveka et-haddabar hazzeh hayyom
Vetidkar are abda haveta beara demitzrayim upareqak Adonai elahak al ken ana mepaqqedak yat pitgama haden yoma den:
Vehaya ki-yomar eleka lo etze meimmak ki ahebeka veet-beteka ki-tob lo immak
Vihe are yemar lak la eppoq meimmak are rachamak veyat enash betak are tab leh immak:
Velaqachta et-hammartzea venatatta beozno ubaddelet vehaya leka ebed olam veap laamateka taaseh-ken
Vetissab yat martzea vetitten beudneh ubedasha vihe lak ibed palach lealam veap leamtak tabed ken:
Lo-yiqsheh beeneka beshallechaka oto chopshi meimmak ki mishneh sekar sakir abadeka shesh shanim uberakka Adonai eloheka bekol asher taaseh
La yiqshe beenak bemipterak yateh bar chorin meimmak are al chad teren kaagar agira palechak shit shenin vibarekinnak Adonai olahak bekol di tabed:
Kol-habbekor asher yivvaled bibqareka ubetzoneka hazzakar taqdish la-Adonai eloheka lo taabod bibkor shoreka velo tagoz bekor tzoneka
Kol bukera di yityelid betorak ubeanak dikrin taqdesh qodam Adonai elahak la tiplach bebukera detorak vela tegoz bukera deanak
Lipne Adonai eloheka tokelennu shana beshana bammaqom asher-yibchar Adonai atta ubeteka
Qodam Adonai elahak tekelinneh shatta beshatta beatra di yittire Adonai at veenash betak:
Veki-yihyeh bo mum pisseach o ivver kol mum ra lo tizbachennu la-Adonai eloheka
Vaare yehe beh muma chagir o avir kol mum bish la tikkesinneh qodam Adonai elahak:
Bishareka tokelennu hattame vehattahor yachdav katztzebi vekaayyal
Beqirvayk tekelinneh mesaaba vedakya kachada kibsar tabya veayla:
Raq et-damo lo tokel al-haaretz tishpekennu kammayim
Lechod yat demeh la tekul al ara tishdinneh kemayya:
Shamor et-chodesh haabib veasita pesach la-Adonai eloheka ki bechodesh haabib hotziaka Adonai eloheka mimmitzrayim layela
Tar yat yarcha daabiba vetabed pischa qodam Adonai elahak are beyarcha daabiba appeqak Adonai elahak mimmitzrayim vaabad lak nissin beleleya:
Vezabachta pesach la-Adonai eloheka tzon ubaqar bammaqom asher-yibchar Adonai leshakken shemo sham
Vetikkos pischa qodam Adonai elahak min bene ana veniksat qudeshayya min tore beatra di yittire Adonai leashraa shekinteh tamman:
Lo-tokal alayv chametz shibat yamim tokal-alayv matztzot lechem oni ki bechippazon yatzata meeretz mitzrayim lemaan tizkor et-yom tzeteka meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyeka
La tekul alohi chamia shiba yomin tekul alohi pattir lechem oni are bibhilu nepaqta meara demitzrayim bedil detidkar yat yoma mippeqak meara demitzrayim kol yome chayyayk:
Velo-yeraeh leka seor bekol-gebulka shibat yamim velo-yalin min-habbasar asher tizbach baereb bayyom harishon labboqer
Vela yitchaze lak chamir bekol techumak shiba yomin vela yebit min bisra di tikkos beramsha beyoma qadmaa letzapra:
Lo tukal lizboach et-happasach beachad sheareka asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak
Let lak reshu lemikkos yat pischa bachada miqqirvayk daAdonai elahak yaheb lak:
Ki im-el-hammaqom asher-yibchar Adonai eloheka leshakken shemo sham tizbach et-happesach baareb kebo hashshemesh moed tzeteka mimmitzrayim
Ellahen leatra di yittire Adonai elahak leashraa shekinteh tamman tikkos yat pischa beramsha kemeal shimsha zeman mippeqak mimmitzrayim:
Ubishshalta veakalta bammaqom asher yibchar Adonai eloheka bo upanita babboqer vehalakta leohaleka
Utebashshal vetekul beatra di yittire Adonai elahak beh vetitpene betzapra utehak leqirvak:
Sheshet yamim tokal matztzot ubayyom hashshebii atzeret la-Adonai eloheka lo taaseh melaka
Shitta yomin tekul pattira ubeyoma shebiaa kenesh qodam Adonai elahak la tabed ibida:
Shiba shabuot tispor-lak mehachel chermesh baqqama tachel lispor shiba shabuot
Shiba shabuin timne lak middesharyut maggela bachatzad umera daaramuta tishre lemimne shiba shabuin:
Veasita chag shabuot la-Adonai eloheka missat nidbat yadeka asher titten kaasher yebarekka Adonai eloheka
Vetabed chagga deshabuayya qodam Adonai elahak missat nidbat yedak di titten kema di yebarekinnak Adonai elahak:

Vesamachta lipne Adonai eloheka atta ubinka ubitteka veabdeka vaamateka vehallevi asher bishareka vehagger vehayyatom vehaalmana asher beqirbeka bammaqom asher yibchar Adonai eloheka leshakken shemo sham
Vetechede qodam Adonai elahak at uberak uberattak veabdak veamtak velevaa di beqirvayk vegiyyora veyittamma vearmela di benak beatra di yittire Adonai elahak leashraa shekinteh tamman:
Vezakarta ki-ebed hayita bemitzrayim veshamarta veasita et-hachuqqim haelleh
Vetidkar are abda haveta bemitzrayim vetittar vetabed yat qeyamayya haillen:
Chag hassukkot taaseh leka shibat yamim beospeka miggorneka umiyyiqbeka
Chagga dimtallayya tabed lak shiba yomin bemikneshak meidderak umimmaatzartak:
Vesamachta bechaggeka atta ubinka ubitteka veabdeka vaamateka vehallevi vehagger vehayyatom vehaalmana asher bishareka
Vetechede bechaggak at uberak uberattak veabdak veamtak velevaa vegiyyora veyittamma vearmela di beqirvayk:
Shibat yamim tachog la-Adonai eloheka bammaqom asher-yibchar Adonai ki yebarekka Adonai eloheka bekol tebuateka ubekol maaseh yadeka vehayita ak sameach
Shiba yomin techog qodam Adonai elahak beatra di yittire Adonai are yebarekinnak Adonai elahak bekol alaltak ubekol obade yedayk utehe beram chade:
