Shalosh peamim bashshana yeraeh kol-zekureka et-pene Adonai eloheka bammaqom asher yibchar bechag hammatztzot ubechag hashshabuot ubechag hassukkot velo yeraeh et-pene Adonai reqam
Telat zimnin beshatta yitchaze kol dekurak qodam Adonai elahak beatra di yittire bechagga depattirayya ubechagga deshabuayya ubechagga dimtallayya vela yitchaze qodam Adonai reqanun:
Ish kemattenat yado kebirkat Adonai eloheka asher natan-lak
Gebar kemattenat yedeh kebirketa daAdonai elahak di yehab lak:
Shopetim veshoterim titten-leka bekol-sheareka asher Adonai eloheka noten leka lishbateka veshapetu et-haam mishpat-tzedeq
Dayyanin upuranin temanne lak bekol qirvayk di Adonai elahak yaheb lak leshibtayk vidunun yat amma din diqshot:
Lo-tatteh mishpat lo takkir panim velo-tiqqach shochad ki hashshochad yeavver ene chakamim visallep dibre tzaddiqim
La tatzle din la tishtemoda appin vela teqabbel shochada are shochada meavver ene chakkimin umeqalqel pitgamin teritzin:
Tzedeq tzedeq tirdop lemaan ticheyeh veyarashta et-haaretz asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak
Qushta qushta tehe radip bedil deteche veterat yat ara daAdonai elahak yaheb lak:
Lo-titta leka ashera kol-etz etzel mizbach Adonai eloheka asher taaseh-lak
La titztzob lak asherat kol ilan bistar madbecha daAdonai elahak di tabed lak:
Velo-taqim leka matztzeba asher sane Adonai eloheka
Vela teqim lak qama di sane Adonai elahak:
Lo-tizbach la-Adonai eloheka shor vaseh asher yihyeh bo mum kol dabar ra ki toabat Adonai eloheka hu
La tikkos qodam Adonai elahak tor veimmar di yehe beh muma kol middaam bish are merachaq qodam Adonai elahak hu:
Ki-yimmatze beqirbeka beachad sheareka asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak ish o-ishsha asher yaaseh et-hara beene Adonaieloheka laabor berito
Are yishtekach benak bachada miqqirvayk daAdonai elahak yaheb lak gebar o itteta di yabed yat debish qodam Adonai elahak lemebar al qeyameh:
Vayyelek vayyaabod elohim acherim vayyishtachu lahem velashshemesh o layyareach o lekol-tzeba hashshamayim asher lo-tzivviti
Vaazal upelach letaavat ammayya usegid lehon uleshimsha o lesihara o lekol chele shemayya di la paqqedit:
Vehuggad-leka veshamaeta vedarashta heteb vehinneh emet nakon haddabar neesta hattoeba hazzot beyisrael
Vichavvun lak vetishma vetitba yaut veha qushta kevan pitgama itabidat toebta hada beyisrael:
Vehotzeta et-haish hahu o et-haishsha hahiv asher asu et-haddabar hara hazzeh el-sheareka et-haish o et-haishsha useqaltam baabanim vametu
Vetappeq yat gabra hahu o yat itteta hahi di abadu yat pitgama bisha haden litra bet dinak yat gabra o yat itteta vetirgeminnun beabnayya vimutun:
Al-pi shenayim edim o shelosha edim yumat hammet lo yumat al-pi ed echad
Al memar teren sahadin o telata sahadin yitqetel dechayyab qetol la yitqetel al memar sahid chad:
Yad haedim tiheyeh-bo barishona lahamito veyad kol-haam baacharona ubiarta hara miqqirbeka
Yeda desahadayya tehe beh beqadmeta lemiqteleh vida dekal amma bebatreta utepalle abed debish mibbenak:
Ki yippale mimmeka dabar lammishpat ben-dam ledam ben-din ledin uben nega lanega dibre ribot bishareka veqamta vealita el-hammaqom asher yibchar Adonai eloheka bo
Are yittikse minnak pitgama ledina ben dema lidma ben dina ledina uben maktash segiru lemaktash segiru pitgame pelugta dina beqirvayk utequm vetissaq leatra di yittire Adonai elahak beh:
Ubata el-hakkohanim haleviyyim veel-hashshopet asher yihyeh bayyamim hahem vedarashta vehiggidu leka et debar hammishpat
Vetete levat kahanaya levae ulevat dayyana di yehe beyomayya hainnun vetitba vichavvun lak yat pitgama dedina:
Veasita al-pi haddabar asher yaggidu leka min-hammaqom hahu asher yibchar Adonai veshamarta laasot kekol asher yoruka
Vetabed al memar pitgama di yechavvun lak min atra hahu di yittire Adonai vetittar lemebad kekol di yallepunnak:
Al-pi hattora asher yoruka veal-hammishpat asher-yomeru leka taaseh lo tasur min-haddabar asher-yaggidu leka yamin usemol
Al memar orayta di yallepunnak veal dina di yemerun lak tabed la tiste min pitgama di yechavvun lak yammina usemala:
Vehaish asher-yaaseh bezadon lebilti shemoa el-hakkohen haomed lesharet sham et-Adonai eloheka o el-hashshopet umet haish hahu ubiarta hara miyyisrael
Ugebar di yabed birsha bedil dela leqabbala min kahana deqaem leshammasha tamman qodam Adonai elahak o min dayyana veyitqetel gabra hahu utepalle abed debish miyyisrael:
Vekol-haam yishmeu veyirau velo yezidun od
Vekol amma yishmeun veyidchalun vela yarshiun od:
Ki-tabo el-haaretz asher Adonai eloheka noten lak virishtah veyashabta bah veamarta asima alay melek kekol-haggoyim asher sebibotay
Are teol leara daAdonai elahak yaheb lak veteretah veteteb bah vetemar emanni alay malka kekal ammayya di besacharanay:
Som tasim aleka melek asher yibchar Adonai eloheka bo miqqereb acheka tasim aleka melek lo tukal latet aleka ish nokri asher lo-achika hu
Mannaa temanne alak malka di yittire Adonai elahak beh miggo achayk temanne alak malka let lak reshu lemannaa alak gebar nukeray di la achuk hu:
Raq lo-yarbeh-lo susim velo-yashib et-haam mitzrayma lemaan harbot sus va-Adonai amar lakem lo tosipun lashub badderek hazzeh od
Lechod la yasge leh susavan vela yateb yat amma lemitzrayim bedil leasgaa leh susavan vaAdonai amar lekon la tosepun lemittub beorach hada od:
Velo yarbeh-lo nashim velo yasur lebabo vekesep vezahab lo yarbeh-lo meod
Vela yasge leh neshin vela yite libbeh vekaspa vedahaba la yasge leh lachada:
Vehaya keshibto al kisse mamlakto vekatab lo et-mishneh hattora hazzot al-seper millipne hakkohanim haleviyyim
Vihe kemittebeh al karesa malkuteh veyiktob leh yat patshegen orayta hada al sipra min qodam kahanayya levae:
Vehayeta immo veqara bo kol-yeme chayyayv lemaan yilmad leyira et-Adonai elohayv lishmor et-kol-dibre hattora hazzot veet-hachuqqim haelleh laasotam
Utehe immeh vihe qare beh kol yome chayyohi bedil deyelap lemidchal qodam Adonai elaheh lemittar yat kol pitgame orayta hada veyat qeyamayya haillen lemebadehon:
Lebilti rum-lebabo meechayv ulebilti sur min-hammitzva yamin usemovl lemaan yaarik yamim al-mamlakto hu ubanayv beqereb yisrael
Bedil dela yerim libbeh meachohi ubedil dela yiste min tapqedta yammina usemala bedil deyorek yomin al malkuteh hu ubenohi bego yisrael:
Lo-yihyeh lakkohanim haleviyyim kol-shebet levi cheleq venachala im-yisrael ishshe Adonai venachalato yokelun
La yehe lekahanayya levae kol shibta delevi cholaq veachasana im yisrael qurbanayya daAdonai veachasanteh yekelun:
Venachala lo-yiheyeh-lo beqereb echayv Adonai hu nachalato kaasher dibber-lo
Veachasana la yehe leh bego achohi mattenan dihab leh Adonai innun achasanteh kema di mallil leh:
Vezeh yihyeh mishpat hakkohanim meet haam meet zobeche hazzebach im-shor im-seh venatan lakkohen hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehaqqeba
Veden yehe dechaze lekahanayya min amma min nakese niksata im tor im immar veyitten lekahana deroa veloa vequbta:
Reshit deganeka tirosheka veyitzhareka vereshit gez tzoneka titten-lo
Resh iburak chamrak umishchak veresh gizza deanak titten leh:
Ki bo bachar Adonai eloheka mikkol-shebateka laamod lesharet beshem-Adonai hu ubanayv kol-hayyamim
Are beh yittire Adonai elahak mikkol shibtayk lemeqam leshammasha bishma daAdonai hu ubenohi kol yomayya:
Veki-yabo hallevi meachad sheareka mikkol-yisrael asher-hv gar sham uba bekol-avvat napsho el-hammaqom asher-yibchar Adonai
Vaare yete levaa mechada miqqirvayk mikkol yisrael di hu dar tamman veyete bekol reut napsheh leatra di yittire Adonai:
Vesheret beshem Adonai elohayv kekol-echayv haleviyyim haomedim sham lipne Adonai
Vishammash bishma daAdonai elaheh kekal achohi levae dimshammeshin tamman bitzlo qodam Adonai:
Cheleq kecheleq yokelu lebad mimkarayv al-haabot
Cholaq kocholaq yekelun bar mimmattarta deyete beshabbatta deken atqinu abahata:
Ki atta ba el-haaretz asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak lo-tilmad laasot ketoabot haggoyim hahem
Are at alel leara daAdonai elahak yaheb lak la telap lemebad ketaavat ammayya hainnun:
Lo-yimmatze beka maabir beno-vbitto baesh qosem qesamim meonen umenachesh umekashshep
La yishtekach bak maabar bereh uberatteh benura qasem qusmin meanen umenachesh vecharash:
Vechober chaber veshoel ob veyiddeoni vedoresh el-hammetim
Veratin retan veshael biddin uzekuru vetaba min metayya:
Ki-toabat Adonai kol-oseh elleh ubiglal hattoebot haelleh Adonai eloheka morish otam mippaneka
Are merachaq Adonai kol deyabed illen ubedil toabata haillen Adonai elahak metarak yatehon miqqodamak:
Tamim tiheyeh im Adonai eloheka
Shelim tehe bedachalta daAdonai elahak:
Ki haggoyim haelleh asher atta yoresh otam el-meonenim veel-qosemim yishmau veatta lo ken natan leka Adonai eloheka
Are ammayya haillen di at yaret yatehon min meanenayya umin qassamayya shamein veat la ken yehab lak Adonai elahak:
Nabi miqqirbeka meacheka kamoni yaqim leka Adonai eloheka elayv tishmaun
Nebiyya mibbenak meachayk kevati yeqim lak Adonai elahak minneh teqabbelun:
Kekol asher-shaalta meim Adonai eloheka bechoreb beyom haqqahal lemor lo osep lishmoa et-qol Adonai elohay veet-haesh haggedola hazzot lo-ereh od velo amut
Kekol di sheelta miqqodam Adonai elahak bechoreb beyoma diqhala lememar la osep lemishma yat qal memera daAdonai elahay veyat eshshata rabbeta hada la echeze od vela emut:
Vayyomer Adonai elay hetibu asher dibberu
Vaamar Adonai li otibu di mallilu:
Nabi aqim lahem miqqereb achehem kamoka venatatti debaray bepiv vedibber alehem et kol-asher atzavvennu
Nebiyya aqim lehon miggo achehon kevatak veetten pitgame nebuati bepumeh vimallel immehon yat kol di apaqqedinneh:
Vehaya haish asher lo-yishma el-debaray asher yedabber bishmi anoki edrosh meimmo
Vihe gabra di la yeqabbel lepitgamay di yemallel bishmi memeri yitba minneh:
Ak hannabi asher yazid ledabber dabar bishmi et asher lo-tzivvitiv ledabber vaasher yedabber beshem elohim acherim umet hannabi hahu
Beram nebiyya di yarsha lemallala pitgama bishmi yat di la paqqeditteh lemallala vedi yemallel beshum taavat ammayya veyitqetel nebiyya hahu:
Veki tomar bilbabeka eka neda et-haddabar asher lo-dibbero Adonai
Vaare temar belibbak ekden nidda yat pitgama di la malleleh Adonai:
Asher yedabber hannabi beshem Adonai velo-yihyeh haddabar velo yabo hu haddabar asher lo-dibbero Adonai bezadon dibbero hannabi lo tagur mimmennu
Di yemallel nebiyya bishma daAdonai vela yehe pitgama vela yitqayyam hu pitgama di la malleleh Adonai birsha malleleh nebiyya la tidchal minneh:
Ki-yakrit Adonai eloheka et-haggoyim asher Adonai eloheka noten leka et-artzam virishtam veyashabta bearehem ubebattehem
Are yeshetze Adonai elahak yat ammayya di Adonai elahak yaheb lak yat arahon veteretinnun veteteb beqirvehon ubebattehon:
Shalosh arim tabdil lak betok artzeka asher Adonai eloheka noten leka lerishtah
Telat qirvin taprash lak bego arak di Adonai elahak yaheb lak lemeretah:
Takin leka hadderek veshillashta et-gebul artzeka asher yanchileka Adonai eloheka vehaya lanus shamma kol-rotzeach
Tetaqqen lak orcha utetallat yat techum arak di yachseninnak Adonai elahak vihe lemeiroq tamman kol qatola:
Vezeh debar harotzeach asher-yanus shamma vachay asher yakkeh et-reehu bibli-daat vehu lo-sone lo mittemol shilshom
Veden pitgam qatola deyeiroq tamman veyitqayyam di yiqtol yat chabreh bela mandeeh vehu la sane leh meitmalle umiddeqamohi:
Vaasher yabo et-reehu bayyaar lachtob etzim veniddecha yado baggarzen likrot haetz venashal habbarzel min-haetz umatza et-reehu vamet hu yanus el-achat hearim-haelleh vachay
Vedi yeul im chabreh bechursha lemiqqatz ain vetitmereg yedeh beparzela lemiqqatz ain veyishtelep parzela min aa veyashkach yat chabreh vimut hu yeiroq lachada min qirvayya haillen veyitqayyam:
Pen-yirdop goel haddam achare harotzeach ki-yecham lebabo vehissigo ki-yirbeh hadderek vehikkahu napesh velo en mishpat-mavet ki lo sone hu lo mittemol shilshom
Dilema yirdop gael dema batar qatola are yecham libbeh veyadbeqinneh are tisge orcha veyiqtelinneh nepash veleh let chobat din diqtol are la sane hu leh mittemalli umiddeqamohi:
Al-ken anoki metzavveka lemor shalosh arim tabdil lak
Al ken ana mepaqqedak lememar telat qirvin tapresh lak:
Veim-yarchib Adonai eloheka et-gebulka kaasher nishba laaboteka venatan leka et-kol-haaretz asher dibber latet laaboteka
Veim yapte Adonai elahak yat techumak kema di qayyim laabahatak veyitten lak yat kol ara di mallil lemittan laabahatak:
Ki-tishmor et-kol-hammitzva hazzot laasotah asher anoki metzavveka hayyom leahaba et-Adonai eloheka velaleket bidrakayv kol-hayyamim veyasapta leka od shalosh arim al hashshalosh haelleh
Are tittar yat kol tapqedta hada lemebedah di ana mepaqqedak yoma den lemircham yat Adonai elahak velimhak beorchan detaqqenan qodamohi kol yomayya vetosep lak od telat qirvin al telat illen:
Velo yishshapek dam naqi beqereb artzeka asher Adonai eloheka noten leka nachala vehaya aleka damim
Vela yishtepek dam zakkay bego arak di Adonai elahak yaheb lak achasana vihe alak chobat din diqtol:
Veki-yihyeh ish sone lereehu vearab lo veqam alayv vehikkahu nepesh vamet venas el-achat hearim hael
Vaare yehe gebar sane lechabreh veyikman leh viqum alohi veyimchinneh nepash vimut veyeiroq lachada min qirvayya haillen:
Veshalechu ziqne iro velaqechu oto mishsham venatenu oto beyad goel haddam vamet
Vishallechun sabe qarteh veyidberun yateh mittamman veyittenun yateh beyad gael dema vimut:
Lo-tachos eneka alayv ubiarta dam-hannaqi miyyisrael vetob lak
La techus enak alohi utepalle ashdi dam zakkay miyyisrael veyetab lak:
Lo tassig gebul reaka asher gabelu rishonim benachalateka asher tinchal baaretz asher Adonai eloheka noten leka lerishtah
La tashne techuma dechabrak di techimu qadmae beachasantak di tachsen beara di Adonai elahak yaheb lak lemeretah:
Lo-yaqum ed echad beish lekol-avon ulekol-chattat bekol-chet asher yecheta al-pi shene edim o al-pi shelosha-edim yaqum dabar
La yequm sahid chad bigbar lekol avvayan ulekal chobin bekol chet di yechta al memar teren sahadin o al memar telata sahadin yitqayyam pitgama:
Ki-yaqum ed-chamas beish laanot bo sara
Are yequm sahid sheqar bigbar leashada beh satya:
Veamedu shene-haanashim asher-lahem harib lipne Adonai lipne hakkohanim vehashshopetim asher yihyu bayyamim hahem
Viqumun teren gubrin di lehon dina qodam Adonai qodam kahanayya vedayyanayya di yehon beyomayya hainnun:
Vedareshu hashshopetim heteb vehinneh ed-sheqer haed sheqer ana beachiv
Veyitbeun dayyanayya yaut veha sahid sheqar sahada shiqra ashad baachohi:
Vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv ubiarta hara miqqirbeka
Vetabedun leh kema di chashshib lemebad laachohi utepalle abed debish mibbenak:
Vehannisharim yishmeu veyirau velo-yosipu laasot od kaddabar hara hazzeh beqirbeka
Udeyishtaarun yishmeun veyidchalun vela yosepun lemebad od kepitgama bisha haden benak:
Velo tachos eneka nepesh benepesh ayin beayin shen beshen yad beyad regel beragel
Vela techus enak napsha cholap napsha ena cholap ena shinna cholap shinna yeda cholap yeda ragla cholap ragla:
Ki-tetze lammilchama al-oyebeka veraita sus varekeb am rab mimmeka lo tira mehem ki-Adonai eloheka immak hammaalka meeretz mitzrayim
Are tippoq laagacha qeraba al baale debabak vetecheze susavan uretikkin am saggi minnak la tidchal minnehon are Adonai elahak memereh besadak deasseqak meara demitzrayim:
Vehaya keqarobkem el-hammilchama veniggash hakkohen vedibber el-haam
Vihe kemiqrabekon laagacha qeraba veyitqerib kahana vimallel im amma:
Veamar alehem shema yisrael attem qerebim hayyom lammilchama al-oyebekem al-yerak lebabkem al-tireu veal-tachpezu veal-taartzu mippenehem
Veyemar lehon shema yisrael attun qeribin yoma den laagacha qeraba al baale debabekon la yezua libbekon la tidchalun vela tetebahatun vela tittaberun miqqodamehon:
Ki Adonai elohekem haholek immakem lehillachem lakem im-oyebekem lehoshia etkem
Are Adonai elahakon dimdabbar qodamekon laagacha lekon qerab im baale debabekon lemipraq yatekon:
Vedibberu hashshoterim el-haam lemor mi-haish asher bana bayit-chadash velo chanako yelek veyashob lebeto pen-yamut bammilchama veish acher yachnekennu
Vimallelun sarekayya qodam amma lememar man gabra di bena beta chadta vela chanekeh yehak vitub lebeteh dilema yemut baagacha qeraba ugebar ochoran yachnekinneh:
Umi-haish asher-nata kerem velo chillelo yelek veyashob lebeto pen-yamut bammilchama veish acher yechallelennu
Uman gabra di netzib karma vela achaleh yehak vitub lebeteh dilema yemut baagacha qeraba ugebar ochoran yechallinneh:
Umi-haish asher-eras ishsha velo leqachah yelek veyashob lebeto pen-yamut bammilchama veish acher yiqqachenna
Uman gabra di eras itteta vela nasebah yehak vitub lebeteh dilema yemut baagacha qeraba ugebar ochoran yissebinnah:
Veyasepu hashshoterim ledabber el-haam veameru mi-haish hayyare verak hallebab yelek veyashob lebeto velo yimmas et-lebab echayv kilbabo
Veyosepun sarekayya lemallala im amma veyemerun man gabra dedachel utebir libba yehak vitub lebeteh vela yittebar yat libba daachohi kelibbeh:
Vehaya kekallot hashshoterim ledabber el-haam upaqedu sare tzebaot berosh haam
Vihe kad yeshetzun sarekayya lemallala im amma vimannun rabbane chela beresh amma:
Ki-tiqrab el-ir lehillachem aleha veqarata eleha leshalom
Are tiqrab leqarta laagacha qeraba alah vetiqre lah millin dishlam:
Vehaya im-shalom taanka upatecha lak vehaya kol-haam hannimtza-ba yihyu leka lamas vaabaduka
Vihe im shelam taaninnak vetiptach lak vihe kol amma deyishtekach bah yehon lak masseqe missin veyiplechunnak:
Veim-lo tashlim immak veaseta immeka milchama vetzarta aleha
Veim la tashlem immak vetabed immak qerab utetzur alah:
Unetanah Adonai eloheka beyadeka vehikkita et-kol-zekurah lepi-chareb
Veyimserinnah Adonai elahak bidak vetimche yat kol dekurah lepitgam dechareb:
Raq hannashim vehattap vehabbehema vekol asher yihyeh bair kol-shelalah taboz lak veakalta et-shelal oyebeka asher natan Adonai eloheka lak
Lechod neshayya vetapla ubeira vekol di yehe beqarta kol adaah teboz lak vetekul yat adaa desaneak di yehab Adonai elahak lak:
Ken taaseh lekol-hearim harechoqot mimmeka meod asher lo-meare haggoyim-haelleh henna
Ken tabed lekol qirvayya di rechiqin minnak lachada di la miqqirve ammayya haillen innun:
Raq meare haammim haelleh asher Adonai eloheka noten leka nachala lo techayyeh kol-neshama
Lechod miqqirve ammayya haillen di Adonai elahak yaheb lak achasana la teqayyam kol nishmata:
Ki-hacharem tacharimem hachitti vehaemori hakkenaani vehapperizzi hachivvi vehayebusi kaasher tzivveka Adonai eloheka
Are gammara tegammerinnun chittae veemorae kenaanae uperizzae chivvae vibusae kema di paqqedak Adonai elahak:
Lemaan asher lo-yelammedu etkem laasot kekol toabotam asher asu lelohehem vachatatem la-Adonai elohekem
Bedil di la yallepun yatekon lemebad kekal toabatehon di abadu letaavatehon utechobun qodam Adonai elahakon:
Ki-tatzur el-ir yamim rabbim lehillachem aleha letopsah lo-tashchit et-etzah lindoach alayv garzen ki mimmennu tokel veoto lo tikrot ki haadam etz hassadeh labo mippaneka bammatzor
Are tetzur leqarta yomin saggiin laagacha alah lemikbeshah la techabbal yat ilanah laarama alohi garzena are minneh tekul veyateh la tequtz are la kaanasha ilan chaqla lemeal miqqodamak bitzyara:
Raq etz asher-teda ki-lo-etz maakal hu oto tashchit vekaratta ubanita matzor al-hair asher-hiv osa immeka milchama ad ridtah
Lechod ilan detidda are la ilan demaakal hu yateh techabbal utequtz vetibne karqomin al qarta di hi abeda immak qeraba ad detikbeshah:
Ki-yimmatze chalal baadama asher Adonai eloheka noten leka lerishtah nopel bassadeh lo noda mi hikkahu
Are yishtekach qetila beara di Adonai elahak yaheb lak lemeretah rame bechaqla la ityeda man qateleh:
Veyatzeu zeqeneka veshopeteka umadedu el-hearim asher sebibot hechalal
Veyippequn sabayk vedayyanayk veyimshechun leqirvayya di sacharanut qetila:
Vehaya hair haqqeroba el-hechalal velaqechu ziqne hair hahiv eglat baqar asher lo-ubbad bah asher lo-masheka beol
Utehe qarta diqariba liqtila veyidberun sabe qarta hahi eglat tore di la itpelach bah di la negidat benir:
Vehoridu ziqne hair hahiv et-haegla el-nachal etan asher lo-yeabed bo velo yizzarea vearepu-sham et-haegla bannachal
Veyechetun sabe qarta hahi yat agalta lenachala bayyar di la itpelach beh vela yizdera veyinqepun tamman yat agalta benachala:
Veniggeshu hakkohanim bene levi ki bam bachar Adonai eloheka leshareto ulebarek beshem Adonai veal-pihem yihyeh kol-rib vekol-naga
Veyitqarebun kahanayya bene levi are behon yittire Adonai elahak leshammashuteh ulebaraka bishma daAdonai veal memerehon yehe kol din vekol maktash segiru:
Vekol ziqne hair hahiv haqqerobim el-hechalal yirchatzu et-yedehem al-haegla haarupa bannachal
Vekol sabe qarta hahi diqribin liqtila yaschun yat yedehon al agalta dinqepta benachala:
Veanu veameru yadenu lo shapeku et-haddam hazzeh veenenu lo rau
Vitibun veyemerun yedana la ashdo yat dema haden veenana la chazaa:
Kapper leammeka yisrael asher-padita Adonai veal-titten dam naqi beqereb ammeka yisrael venikkapper lahem haddam
Kahanayya yemerun kappar leammak yisrael di peraqta Adonai vela titten chobat dam zakkay bego ammak yisrael veyitkappar lehon al dema:
Veatta tebaer haddam hannaqi miqqirbeka ki-taaseh hayyashar beene Adonai
Veat tepalle ashdi dam zakkay mibbenak are tabed dekashar qodam Adonai:
Ki-tetze lammilchama al-oyebeka unetano Adonai eloheka beyadeka veshabita shibyo
Are tippoq laagacha qeraba al baale debabak veyimserinnun Adonai elahak bidak vetishbe shibyehon:
Veraita bashshibya eshet yepat-toar vechashaqta bah velaqachta leka leishsha
Vetecheze beshibya itteta shappirat chezu vetitree bah vetissebah lak leintu:
Vahabetah el-tok beteka vegillecha et-roshah veaseta et-tzipporneha
Vetaelinnah lego betak utegallach yat reshah uterabbi yat tuperanaha:
Vehesira et-simlat shibyah mealeha veyasheba bebeteka ubaketa et-abiha veet-immah yerach yamim veachar ken tabo eleha ubealtah vehayeta leka leishsha
Vetede yat kesut shibyah minnah vetetab bebetak vetibke yat abuha veyat immah yerach yomin ubatar ken teul levatah vetibalinnah utehe lak leintu:
Vehaya im-lo chapatzta bah veshillachtah lenapshah umakor lo-timkerenna bakkasep lo-titammer bah tachat asher innitah
Vihe im la titree bah vetipterinnah lenapshah vezabbana la tezabbeninnah bekaspa la tittagar bah chalap di innitah:
Ki-tihyena leish shete nashim haachat ahuba vehaachat senua veyaledu-lo banim haahuba vehassenua vehaya habben habbekor lassenia
Are tehevyan ligbar tarten neshin chada rechemta vachada seniata vilidan leh benin rechemta useniata vihe bera bukera lisniata:
Vehaya beyom hanchilo et-banayv et asher-yihyeh lo lo yukal lebakker et-ben-haahuba al-pene ben-hassenua habbekor
Vihe beyoma deyachasen libnohi yat di yehe leh let leh reshu lebakkara yat bar rechemta al appe bar seniata bukera:
Ki et-habbekor ben-hassenua yakkir latet lo pi shenayim bekol asher-yimmatze lo ki-hv reshit ono lo mishpat habbekora
Are yat bukera bar seniata yaprash lemittan leh tarten cholaqin bekol di yishtekach leh are hu resh taqepeh leh chazeya bekeruta:
Ki-yihyeh leish ben sorer umoreh enennu shomea beqol abiv ubeqol immo veyisseru oto velo yishma alehem
Are yehe ligbar bar sate umare letohi meqabbal lememar abuhi ulememar immeh umallepan yateh vela yeqabbel minnehon:
Vetapesu bo abiv veimmo vehotziu oto el-ziqne iro veel-shaar meqomo
Veyechedun beh abuhi veimmeh veyappequn yateh loqodam sabe qarteh velitra bet din atreh:
Veameru el-ziqne iro benenu zeh sorer umoreh enennu shomea beqolenu zolel vesobe
Veyemerun lesabe qarteh benana den sate umare letohi meqabbel lememerana zalel besar vesabe chamar:
Uregamuhu kol-anshe iro baabanim vamet ubiarta hara miqqirbeka vekol-yisrael yishmeu veyirau
Veyirgemunneh kol gabre qarteh beabnayya vimut utepalle abed debish mibbenak vekol yisrael yishmeun veyidchalun:
Veki-yihyeh beish chet mishpat-mavet vehumat vetalita oto al-etz
Vaare yehe bigbar chobat din diqtol veyitqetel vetitzlob yateh al tzeliba:
Lo-talin niblato al-haetz ki-qabor tiqberennu bayyom hahu ki-qillat elohim taluy velo tetamme et-admateka asher Adonai eloheka noten leka nachala
La tebit nebilteh al tzeliba are miqbar tiqberinneh beyoma hahu are al dechab qodam Adonai itztelab vela tesaeb yat arak di Adonai elahak yaheb lak achasana:
Lo-tireh et-shor achika o et-seyo niddachim vehitallamta mehem hasheb teshibem leachika
La techeze yat tora deachuk o yat immereh detaan vetitkebesh minnehon ataba tatebinnun leachuk:
Veim-lo qarob achika eleka velo yedato vaasapto el-tok beteka vehaya immeka ad derosh achika oto vahasheboto lo
Veim la qareb achuk levatak vela yedaat leh vetakneshinneh lego betak vihe immak ad deyitba achuk yateh vetatebinneh leh:
Veken taaseh lachamoro veken taaseh lesimlato veken taaseh lekol-abedat achika asher-tobad mimmennu umetzatah lo tukal lehitallem
Veken tabed lachamareh veken tabed liksuteh veken tabed lekol abedat achuk di tebad minneh vetashkechinnah let lak reshu leitkassaa:
Lo-tireh et-chamor achika o shoro nopelim badderek vehitallamta mehem haqem taqim immo
La techeze yat chamara deachuk o toreh raman beorcha vetitkebesh minnehon aqama teqim immeh:
Lo-yihyeh keli-geber al-ishsha velo-yilbash geber simlat ishsha ki toabat Adonai eloheka kol-oseh elleh
La yehe tiqqun zen digbar al itteta vela yetaqqen gebar betiqqune itteta are merachaq qodam Adonai elahak kol abed illen:
Ki yiqqare qan-tzippor lepaneka badderek bekol-etz o al-haaretz eprochim o betzim vehaem robetzet al-haeprochim o al-habbetzim lo-tiqqach haem al-habbanim
Are yeara qinna detzippera qodamak beorcha bekol ilan o al ara eprochin o bein veima rebea al eprochin o al bein la tissab imma al benayya:
Shalleach teshallach et-haem veet-habbanim tiqqach-lak lemaan yitab lak vehaarakta yamim
Shallacha teshallach yat imma veyat benayya tissab lak bedil deyetab lak vetorik yomin:
Ki tibneh bayit chadash veasita maaqeh legaggeka velo-tasim damim bebeteka ki-yippol hannopel mimmennu
Are tibne beta chadta vetabed teyaqa leiggerak vela teshavvi chobat din diqtol bebetak are yippel denapel minneh:
Lo-tizra karmeka kilayim pen-tiqdash hamelea hazzera asher tizra utebuat hakkarem
La tizra karmak erubin dilema tistaab dimat zara di tizra vaalalat karma:
Lo-tacharosh beshor-vbachamor yachdav
La tirde betora ubachamara kachada:
Lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer upishtim yachdav
La tilbash shaatneza amar vekittan mechubbar kachada:
Gedilim taaseh-lak al-arba kanpot kesuteka asher tekasseh-bah
Keruspedin tabed lak al arba kanpe kesutak di tekasse bah:
Ki-yiqqach ish ishsha uba eleha useneah
Are yissab gebar itteta veyeul levatah veyisninnah:
Vesam lah alilot debarim vehotzi aleha shem ra veamar et-haishsha hazzot laqachti vaeqrab eleha velo-matzati lah betulim
Vishavvi lah tasqope millin veyappeq alah shum bish veyemar yat itteta hada nesebit veallit levatah vela ashkachit lah betulin:
Velaqach abi hannaara veimmah vehotziu et-betule hannaara el-ziqne hair hashshaera
Veyissab abuha deulemta veimmah veyappequn yat betule ulemta loqodam sabe qarta litra bet din atra:
Veamar abi hannaara el-hazzeqenim et-bitti natatti laish hazzeh leishsha vayyisnaeha
Veyemar abuha deulemta lesabayya yat beratti yehabit legabra haden leintu useninnah:
Vehinneh-hv sam alilot debarim lemor lo-matzati lebitteka betulim veelleh betule bitti uparesu hassimla lipne ziqne hair
Veha hu shavvi tasqope millin lememar la ashkachit librattak betulin veillen betule beratti veyipresun shoshipa qodam sabe qarta:
Velaqechu ziqne hair-hahiv et-haish veyisseru oto
Veyidberun sabe qarta hahi yat gabra veyalqun yateh:
Veaneshu oto mea kesep venatenu laabi hannaara ki hotzi shem ra al betulat yisrael velo-tihyeh leishsha lo-yvkal leshallechah kol-yamayv
Veyigbun minneh mea silin diksap veyittenun laabuha deulemta are appeq shum bish al betuleta deyisrael veleh tehe leintu let leh reshu lemipterah kol yomohi:
Veim-emet haya haddabar hazzeh lo-nimtzeu betulim lannaara
Veim qushta hava pitgama haden la ishtekachu betulin leulemta:
Vehotziu et-hannaara el-petach bet-abiha useqaluha anshe irah baabanim vameta ki-aseta nebala beyisrael liznot bet abiha ubiarta hara miqqirbeka
Veyappequn yat ulemta litra bet abuha veyirgemunnah enashe qartah beabnayya utemut are abedat qelana beyisrael lezannaa bet abuha utepalle abed debish mibbenak:
Ki-yimmatze ish shokeb im-ishsha beulat-baal umetu gam-shenehem haish hashshokeb im-haishsha vehaishsha ubiarta hara miyyisrael
Are yishtekach gebar deshakeb im itteta ittat gebar veyitqattelun ap tarvehon gabra deshakeb im itteta veitteta utepalle abed debish miyyisrael:
Ki yihyeh naara betula meorasa leish umetzaah ish bair veshakab immah
Are tehe ulemta betulta dimaresa ligbar veyashkechinnah gebar beqarta veyishkub immah:
Vehotzetem et-shenehem el-shaar hair hahiv useqaltem otam baabanim vametu et-hannaara al-debar asher lo-tzaaqa bair veet-haish al-debar asher-inna et-eshet reehu ubiarta hara miqqirbeka
Vetappequn yat tarvehon litra qarta hahi vetirgemun yatehon beabnayya vimutun yat ulemta al esaq di la tzevachat beqarta veyat gabra al esaq deanni yat ittat chabreh utepalle abed debish mibbenak:
Veim-bassadeh yimtza haish et-hannaara hameorasa vehecheziq-bah haish veshakab immah umet haish asher-shakab immah lebaddo
Veim bechaqla yashkach gebar yat ulemta dimaresa veyitqep bah gabra veyishkub immah veyitqetel gabra deshakeb immah bilchodohi:
Velannaara lo-taaseh dabar en lannaara chet mavet ki kaasher yaqum ish al-reehu uretzacho nepesh ken haddabar hazzeh
Uleulemta la tabed middaam let leulemta chobat din diqtol are kema diqum gabra al chabreh veyiqtelinneh nepash ken pitgama haden:
Ki bassadeh metzaah tzaaqa hannaara hameorasa veen moshia lah
Are bechaqla ashkechah tzevachat ulemta dimaresa velet depariq lah:
Ki-yimtza ish naara betula asher lo-orasa utepasah veshakab immah venimtzau
Are yashkach gebar ulemta betulta di la mearesa veyechedinnah veyishkub immah veyishtakkechun:
Venatan haish hashshokeb immah laabi hannaara chamishshim kasep velo-tihyeh leishsha tachat asher innah lo-yvkal shallechah kol-yamayv
Veyitten gabra deyishkub immah laabuha deulemta chamshin silin diksap veleh tehe leintu cholap di anyah let leh reshu lemipterah kol yomohi:
Lo-yiqqach ish et-eshet abiv velo yegalleh kenap abiv
La yissab gebar yat ittat abuhi vela yegalle kanpa daabuhi:
Lo-yabo petzua-dakka ukerut shopka biqhal Adonai
La yidke depasiq vedimchabbal lemeal biqhala daAdonai:
Lo-yabo mamzer biqhal Adonai gam dor asiri lo-yabo lo biqhal Adonai
La yidke mamzera lemeal biqhala daAdonai ap dara asiraa la yidke leh lemeal biqhala daAdonai:
Lo-yabo ammoni umoabi biqhal Adonai gam dor asiri lo-yabo lahem biqhal Adonai ad-olam
La yidkun ammonae umoabae lemeal biqhala daAdonai ap dara asiraa la yidke lehon lemeal biqhala daAdonai ad olam:
Al-debar asher lo-qiddemu etkem ballechem ubammayim badderek betzetekem mimmitzrayim vaasher sakar aleka et-bilam ben-beor mippetor aram naharayim leqalelekka
Al esaq di la arau yatekon belachma ubemayya beorcha bemippaqekon mimmitzrayim vedi agar alak yat bilam bar beor mippetor aram di al perat lelattayutak:
Velo-aba Adonai eloheka lishmoa el-bilam vayyahapok Adonai eloheka leka et-haqqelala libraka ki ahebeka Adonai eloheka
Vela abe Adonai elahak leqabbala min bilam vahapak Adonai elahak lak yat levatin lebirkan are rachamak Adonai elahak:
Lo-tidrosh shelomam vetobatam kol-yameka leolam
La titba shelamehon vetabatehon kol yomayk lealam:
Lo-tetaeb adomi ki achika hu lo-tetaeb mitzri ki-ger hayita beartzo
La terachaq edomaa are achuk hu la terachaq mitzraa are dayyar haveta beareh:
Banim asher-yivvaledu lahem dor shelishi yabo lahem biqhal Adonai
Benin di yityelidu lehon dara telitaa yidke lehon lemeal biqhala daAdonai:
Ki-tetze machaneh al-oyebeka venishmarta mikkol dabar ra
Are tippoq mashrita al baale debabak vetistammar mikkol middaam bish:
Ki-yihyeh beka ish asher lo-yihyeh tahor miqqereh-layela veyatza el-michutz lammachaneh lo yabo el-tok hammachaneh
Are yehe bak gebar di la yehe deke miqqereh leleya veyippoq lemibbara lemashrita la yeul lego mashrita:
Vehaya lipnot-ereb yirchatz bammayim ukebo hashshemesh yabo el-tok hammachaneh
Vihe lemipne ramsha yasche bemayya ukemeal shimsha yeul lego mashrita:
Veyad tihyeh leka michutz lammachaneh veyatzata shamma chutz
Vaatar metaqqan yehe lak mibbara lemashrita vetippoq tamman lebara:
Veyated tihyeh leka al-azeneka vehaya beshibteka chutz vechaparta bah veshabta vekissita et-tzeateka
Vesikketa tehe lak al zenak vihe bemitbak lebara vetachpar bah utetub utekasse yat mippeqatak:
Ki Adonai eloheka mithallek beqereb machaneka lehatztzileka velatet oyebeka lepaneka vehaya machaneka qadosh velo-yireh beka ervat dabar veshab meachareka
Are Adonai elahak shekinteh mehalleka bego mashritak leshezabutak ulemimsar baale debabak qodamak utehe mashritak qaddisha vela yitchaze bak aberat pitgam vitub memereh milleotaba lak:
Lo-tasgir ebed el-adonayv asher-yinnatzel eleka meim adonayv
La timsar ebed ammin leyad ribboneh deyishtezeb levatak millevat ribboneh:
Immeka yesheb beqirbeka bammaqom asher-yibchar beachad sheareka battob lo lo tonennu
Immak yitteb benak beatra di yittire bachada min qirvayk bidyetab leh la toninneh:
Lo-tihyeh qedesha mibbenot yisrael velo-yihyeh qadesh mibbene yisrael
La tehe itteta mibbenat yisrael ligbar abed vela yissab gabra mibbene yisrael itteta ama:
Lo-tabi etnan zona umechir keleb bet Adonai eloheka lekol-neder ki toabat Adonai eloheka gam-shenehem
La tael agar zannita vechulepan kalba lebet maqdesha daAdonai elahak lekol nidra are merachaq qodam Adonai elahak ap tarvehon:
Lo-tashshik leachika neshek kesep neshek okel neshek kol-dabar asher yishshak
La terabbe laachuk ribbit kesap ribbit ibur ribbit kol middaam demitrabbe:
Lannokri tashshik uleachika lo tashshik lemaan yebarekka Adonai eloheka bekol mishlach yadeka al-haaretz asher-atta ba-shamma lerishtah
Lebar ammin terabbe velaachuk la terabbe bedil dibarekinnak Adonai elahak bekol oshatut yedak al ara di at alel letamman lemeretah:
Ki-tiddor neder la-Adonai eloheka lo teacher leshallemo ki-darosh yidreshennu Adonai eloheka meimmak vehaya beka chet
Are tiddar nedar qodam Adonai elahak la teachar leshallamuteh are mitba yitbeinneh Adonai elahak minnak vihe bak choba:
Veki techdal lindor lo-yihyeh beka chet
Vaare tittimna lemindar la yehe bak choba:
Motza sepateka tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta la-Adonai eloheka nedaba asher dibbarta bepika
Appaqut sipvatak tittar vetabed kema di nedarta qodam Adonai elahak nedabta di mallelta bepumak:
Ki tabo bekerem reeka veakalta anabim kenapsheka sobeka veel-kelyeka lo titten
Are tittagar bekarma dechabrak vetekul innebin kenapshak sibak ulemanak la titten:
Ki tabo beqamat reeka veqatapta melilot beyadeka vechermesh lo tanip al qamat reeka
Are tittagar beqamta dechabrak vetiqtop melilan bidak umagla la terim al qamta dechabrak:
Ki-yiqqach ish ishsha ubealah vehaya im-lo timtza-chen beenayv ki-matza bah ervat dabar vekatab lah seper keritut venatan beyadah veshillechah mibbeto
Are yissab gebar itteta veyibalinnah vihe im la tashkach rachamin beenohi are ashkach bah aberat pitgam veyiktob lah get pitturin vihab bidah veyipterinnah mibbeteh:
Veyatzea mibbeto vehaleka vehayeta leish-acher
Vetippoq mibbeteh utehak utehe ligbar ochoran:
Useneah haish haacharon vekatab lah seper keritut venatan beyadah veshillechah mibbeto o ki yamut haish haacharon asher-leqachah lo leishsha
Veyisninnah gabra batraa veyiktob lah get pitturin veyitten bidah veyipterinnah mibbeteh o are yemut gabra batraa denasebah leh leintu:
Lo-yvkal balah harishon asher-shillechah lashub leqachtah lihyot lo leishsha achare asher huttammaa ki-toeba hiv lipne Adonai velo tachati et-haaretz asher Adonai eloheka noten leka nachala
Let leh reshu lebaalah qadmaa di paterah lemittub lemissebah lemeheve leh leintu batar di istaabat are merachaqa hi qodam Adonai vela techayyab yat ara di Adonai elahak yaheb lak achasana:
Ki-yiqqach ish ishsha chadasha lo yetze batztzaba velo-yaabor alayv lekol-dabar naqi yihyeh lebeto shana echat vesimmach et-ishto asher-laqach
Are yissab gebar itteta chadta la yippoq bechela vela yeibar alohi lekol middaam pane yehe lebeteh shatta chada veyachde yat itteteh di nesab:
Lo-yachabol rechayim varakeb ki-nepesh hu chobel
La yissab mashkona richya verikba are behon mitabed mazon lekol nepash:
Ki-yimmatze ish goneb nepesh meechayv mibbene yisrael vehitammer-bo umekaro umet haggannab hahu ubiarta hara miqqirbeka
Are yishtekach gebar ganeb napsha meachohi mibbene yisrael veyittagar beh vizabbeninneh veyitqetel gannaba hahu utepalle abed debish mibbenak:
Hishshamer benega-hatztzaraat lishmor meod velaasot kekol asher-yoru etkem hakkohanim haleviyyim kaasher tzivvitim tishmeru laasot
Istammar bemaktash segiru lemittar lachada ulemebad kekol di yallepun yatekon kahanayya levae kema di paqqedtinnun titterun lemebad:
Zakor et asher-asa Adonai eloheka lemiryam badderek betzetekem mimmitzrayim
Have dekir yat di abad Adonai elahak lemiryam beorcha bemippaqekon mimmitzrayim:
Ki-tashsheh bereaka mashshat meuma lo-tabo el-beto laabot aboto
Are tarshe bechabrak reshu middaam la teul lebeteh lemissab mashkoneh:
Bachutz taamod vehaish asher atta nosheh bo yotzi eleka et-haabot hachutza
Bebara tequm vegabra di at rashe beh yappeq levatak yat mashkona lebara:
Veim-ish ani hu lo tishkab baaboto
Veim gebar misken hu la tishkub bemashkoneh:
Hasheb tashib lo et-haabot kebo hashshemesh veshakab besalmato uberekekka uleka tihyeh tzedaqa lipne Adonai eloheka
Ataba tateb leh yat mashkona kemeal shimsha veyishkub biksuteh vibarekinnak velak tehe zekuta qodam Adonai elahak:
Lo-taashoq sakir ani veebyon meacheka o miggereka asher beartzeka bishareka
La teishshuq agira anya umiskena meachayk o miggiyyorak di bearak beqirvayk:
Beyomo titten sekaro velo-tabo alayv hashshemesh ki ani hu veelayv hu nose et-napsho velo-yiqra aleka el-Adonai vehaya beka chet
Beyomeh titten agreh vela teul alohi shimsha are anya hu veleh hu mesar yat napsheh vela yiqre alak qodam Adonai vihe bak choba:
Lo-yvmetu abot al-banim ubanim lo-yvmetu al-abot ish becheto yumatu
La yemutun abahan al pum benin ubenin la yemutun al pum abahan enash bechobeh yemutun:
Lo tatteh mishpat ger yatom velo tachabol beged almana
La tatzle din giyyora veyittamma vela tissab mashkona lebush armela:
Vezakarta ki ebed hayita bemitzrayim vayyipdeka Adonai eloheka mishsham al-ken anoki metzavveka laasot et-haddabar hazzeh
Vetidkar are abda haveta bemitzrayim upareqak Adonai elahak mittamman al ken ana mepaqqedak lemebad yat pitgama haden:
Ki tiqtzor qetzireka besadeka veshakachta omer bassadeh lo tashub leqachto lagger layyatom velaalmana yihyeh lemaan yebarekka Adonai eloheka bekol maaseh yadeka
Are tachtzod chatzadak bechaqlak vetinshe umra bechaqla la tetub lemissebeh legiyyora leyittamma ulearmela yehe bedil dibarekinnak Adonai elahak bekol obade yedak:
Ki tachbot zeteka lo tepaer achareka lagger layyatom velaalmana yihyeh
Are tachbot zetak la tepalle batrak legiyyora leyittamma ulearmela yehe:
Ki tibtzor karmeka lo teolel achareka lagger layyatom velaalmana yihyeh
Are tiqtop karmak la tealel batrak legiyyora leyittamma ulearmela yehe:
Vezakarta ki-ebed hayita beeretz mitzrayim al-ken anoki metzavveka laasot et-haddabar hazzeh
Vetidkar are abda haveta beara demitzrayim al ken ana mepaqqedak lemebad yat pitgama haden:
Ki-yihyeh rib ben anashim veniggeshu el-hammishpat ushepatum vehitzdiqu et-hatztzaddiq vehirshiu et-harasha
Are yehe din ben gubrayya veyitqarebun ledina vidununnun vizakkun yat zakkaa vichayyebun yat chayyaba:
Vehaya im-bin hakkot harasha vehippilo hashshopet vehikkahu lepanayv kede rishato bemispar
Vihe im bar chayyaba lealqaa chayyaba veyirminneh dayyana veyalqinneh qodamohi kemissat chobeteh beminyan:
Arbaim yakkennu lo yosip pen-yosip lehakkoto al-elleh makka rabba veniqla achika leeneka
Arbein yalqinneh la yosep dilema yosep lealqayuteh al illen macha rabba veyeqal achuk leenayk:
Lo-tachsom shor bedisho
La techod pum tora bidyasheh:
Ki-yeshebu achim yachdav umet achad mehem uben en-lo lo-tihyeh eshet-hammet hachutza leish zar yebamah yabo aleha uleqachah lo leishsha veyibbemah
Are yetebun achin kachada vimut chad minnehon ubar let leh la tehe ittat metana lebara ligbar ocharan yebamah yeul alah veyissebah leh leintu veyibbemah:
Vehaya habbekor asher teled yaqum al-shem achiv hammet velo-yimmacheh shemo miyyisrael
Vihe bukera di telid yequm al shema daachuhi metana vela yittimche shemeh miyyisrael:
Veim-lo yachpotz haish laqachat et-yebimto vealeta yebimto hashshara el-hazzeqenim veamera meen yebami lehaqim leachiv shem beyisrael lo aba yabbemi
Veim la yitzbe gabra lemissab yat yebimteh vetissaq yebimteh litra bet dina loqodam sabayya vetemar la tzabe yebami laaqama laachuhi shema beyisrael la abe leyabbamuti:
Veqareu-lo ziqne-iro vedibberu elayv veamad veamar lo chapatzti leqachtah
Veyiqrun leh sabe qarteh vimallelun immeh viqum veyemar la reena lemisbah:
Veniggesha yebimto elayv leene hazzeqenim vechaletza naalo meal raglo veyareqa bepanayv veaneta veamera kaka yeaseh laish asher lo-yibneh et-bet achiv
Vetitqerab yebimteh levateh loqodam sabayya vetashre seneh meal ragleh veteroq beanpohi vetateb vetemar keden yitabed ligbar di la yibne yat beta daachuhi:
Veniqra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal
Veyitqere shemeh beyisrael bet sheri sena:
Ki-yinnatzu anashim yachdav ish veachiv veqareba eshet haechad lehatztzil et-ishah miyyad makkehu veshalecha yadah vehecheziqa bimbushayv
Are yintzun gubrin kachada gebar vaachuhi vetitqereb ittat chad leshezaba yat baalah miyyad machuhi vetoshet yedah vetitqep bebet bahatteteh:
Veqatztzota et-kappah lo tachos eneka
Utequtz yat yedah la techus enak:
Lo-yihyeh leka bekiseka eben vaaben gedola uqetanna
La yehe lak bekisak matqal umatqal rabbeta uzeerta:
Lo-yihyeh leka bebeteka epa veepa gedola uqetanna
La yehe lak bebetak mekila umekila rabbeta uzeerta:
Eben shelema vatzedeq yiheyeh-lak epa shelema vatzedeq yiheyeh-lak lemaan yaariku yameka al haadama asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak
Matqelin shalemin diqshot yehon lak mekilan shalemin diqshot yehon lak bedil deyorekun yomayk al ara daAdonai elahak yaheb lak:
Ki toabat Adonai eloheka kol-oseh elleh kol oseh avel
Are merachaq qodam Adonai elahak kol abed illen kol abed sheqar:
Zakor et asher-asa leka amaleq badderek betzetekem mimmitzrayim
Have dekir yat di abad lak amaleq beorcha bemippaqekon mimmitzrayim:
Asher qareka badderek vayezanneb beka kol-hannecheshalim achareka veatta ayep veyagea velo yare elohim
Di areak beorcha veqatel bak kol dahavo mitacharin batrak veat meshalhe velae vela dachel min qodam Adonai:
Vehaya behaniach Adonai eloheka leka mikkol-oyebeka missabib baaretz asher Adonaieloheka noten leka nachala lerishtah timcheh et-zeker amaleq mittachat hashshamayim lo tishkach
Vihe kad yeniach Adonai elahak lak mikkol baale debabak missechor sechor beara di Adonai elahak yaheb lak achasana lemeretah timche yat dukerana daamaleq mittechot shemayya la tittinshe:
Vehaya ki-tabo el-haaretz asher Adonai eloheka noten leka nachala virishtah veyashabta bah
Vihe are teul leara di Adonai elahak yaheb lak achasana veteretah veteteb bah:
Velaqachta mereshit kol-peri haadama asher tabi meartzeka asher Adonai eloheka noten lak vesamta battene vehalakta el-hammaqom asher yibchar Adonai eloheka leshakken shemo sham
Vetissab meresh kol ibba deara di tael mearak di Adonai elahak yaheb lak uteshavve besalla utehak leatra di yittire Adonai elahak leashraa shekinteh tamman:
Ubata el-hakkohen asher yihyeh bayyamim hahem veamarta elayv higgadti hayyom la-Adonai eloheka ki-bati el-haaretz asher nishba Adonai laabotenu latet lanu
Vetete levat kahana di yehe beyomayya hainnun vetemar leh chavveti yoma den qodam Adonai elahak are allit leara di qayyim Adonai laabahatana lemittan lana:
Velaqach hakkohen hattene miyyadeka vehinnicho lipne mizbach Adonai eloheka
Veyissab kahana salla midak veyachtinneh qodam madbecha daAdonai elahak:
Veanita veamarta lipne Adonai eloheka arammi obed abi vayyered mitzrayma vayyagor sham bimte meat vayehi-sham legoy gadol atzum varab
Vetateb vetemar qodam Adonai elahak laban arammaa baa leobada yat abba unechat lemitzrayim vedar tamman beam zeer vahava tamman leam rab taqqip vesaggi:
Vayyareu otanu hammitzrim vayeannunu vayyittenu alenu aboda qasha
Veabishu lana mitzrayim veanneyana vihabu alana palechana qashya:
Vannitzaq el-Adonai elohe abotenu vayyishma Adonai et-qolenu vayyar et-onyenu veet-amalenu veet-lachatzenu
Vetzallena qodam Adonai elaha daabahatana veqabbil Adonai tzelotana ugele qodamohi amlana veleutana veduchaqana:
Vayyotzienu Adonai mimmitzrayim beyad chazaqa ubizroa netuya ubemora gadol ubeotot ubemopetim
Veappeqana Adonai mimmitzrayim bida taqqipa ubidraa meramema ubechezvana rabba ubeatin ubemopetin:
Vayebienu el-hammaqom hazzeh vayyitten-lanu et-haaretz hazzot eretz zabat chalab udebash
Veaytana leatra haden vihab lana yat ara hada ara abeda chalab udebash:
Veatta hinneh hebeti et-reshit peri haadama asher-natatta li Adonai vehinnachto lipne Adonai eloheka vehishetachavita lipne Adonai eloheka
Ukean ha ayteti yat resh ibba deara dihabt li Adonai vetachtineh qodam Adonai elahak vetisgud qodam Adonai elahak:
Vesamachta bekol-hattob asher natan-leka Adonai eloheka ulebeteka atta vehallevi vehagger asher beqirbeka
Vetechede bekal tabta di yehab lak Adonai elahak veleenash betak at velevae vegiyyora di benak:
Ki tekalleh laser et-kol-masar tebuateka bashshana hashshelishit shenat hammaaser venatatta lallevi lagger layyatom velaalmana veoklu bishareka vesabeu
Are teshetze leassara yat kol maasar alaltak beshatta telitaa shenat masera vetitten lelevae legiyyora leyittamma ulearmela veyekelun beqirvayk veyisbeun:
Veamarta lipne Adonai eloheka biarti haqqodesh min-habbayit vegam netattiv lallevi velagger layyatom velaalmana kekol-mitzvateka asher tzivvitani lo-abarti mimmitzvoteka velo shakacheti
Vetemar qodam Adonai elahak palleti qodesh masera min beta veap yehabitteh lelevae ulegiyyora leyittamma ulearmela kekal piqqudak di paqqidtani la abarit mippiqqudayk vela ittinsheti:
Lo-akalti beoni mimmennu velo-biarti mimmennu betame velo-natatti mimmennu lemet shamati beqol Adonai elohay asiti kekol asher tzivvitani
La akalit beebli minneh vela palleti minneh bedimsaab vela yehabit minneh lemit qabbelit lememera daAdonai elahay abadit kekol di paqqidtani:
Hashqipa mimmeon qodsheka min-hashshamayim ubarek et-ammeka et-yisrael veet haadama asher natatta lanu kaasher nishbata laabotenu eretz zabat chalab udebash
Isteki mimmedor qodshak min shemayya ubarek yat ammak yat yisrael veyat ara di yehabt lana kema di qayyemta laabahatana ara abeda chalab udebash:
Hayyom hazzeh Adonai eloheka metzavveka laasot et-hachuqqim haelleh veet-hammishpatim veshamarta veasita otam bekol-lebabeka ubekol-napsheka
Yoma haden Adonai elahak mepaqqedak lemebad yat qeyamayya haillen veyat dinayya vetittar vetabed yatehon bekol libbak ubekol napshak:
Et-Adonai heemarta hayyom lihyot leka lelohim velaleket bidrakayv velishmor chuqqayv umitzvotayv umishpatayv velishmoa beqolo
Yat Adonai chatabta yoma den lemeheve lak leelah velimhak beorchan detaqenan qodamohi ulemittar qeyamohi upiqqudohi vedinohi uleqabbala bememereh:
Va-Adonai heemireka hayyom lihyot lo leam segulla kaasher dibber-lak velishmor kol-mitzvotayv
Vayya chatebak yoma den lemeheve leh leam chabbib kema di mallil lak ulemittar kol piqqudohi:
Uletitteka elyon al kol-haggoyim asher asa lithilla uleshem uletiparet veliheyoteka am-qadosh la-Adonai eloheka kaasher dibber
Ulemittenak illaa al kol ammayya di abad letushbacha uleshum velirbu ulemehevak am qaddish qodam Adonai elahak kema di mallil:
Vayetzav mosheh veziqne yisrael et-haam lemor shamor et-kol-hammitzva asher anoki metzavveh etkem hayyom
Upaqqid msheh vesabe yisrael yat amma lememar tar yat kol tapqedta di ana mepaqqed yatekon yoma den:
Vehaya bayyom asher taabru et-hayyarden el-haaretz asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak vahaqemota leka abanim gedolot vesadta otam bassid
Vihe beyoma di taberun yat yardena leara daAdonai elahak yaheb lak uteqim lak abnin rabrebin utesud yatehon besida:
Vekatabta alehen et-kol-dibre hattora hazzot beobreka lemaan asher tabo el-haaretz asher-Adonai eloheka noten leka eretz zabat chalab udebash kaasher dibber Adonai elohe-aboteka lak
Vetiktob alehon yat kol pitgame orayta hada bemeberak bedil di teul leara daAdonai elahak yaheb lak ara abeda chalab udebash kema di mallil Adonai elaha daabahatak lak:
Vehaya beobrekem et-hayyarden taqimu et-haabanim haelleh asher anoki metzavveh etkem hayyom behar ebal vesadta otam bassid
Vihe bemeabarekon yat yardena teqimun yat abnayya haillen di ana mepaqqed yatekon yoma den betura deebal utesud yatehon besida:
Ubanita sham mizbeach la-Adonai eloheka mizbach abanim lo-tanip alehem barzel
Vetibne tamman madbecha qodam Adonai elahak madbach abnin la terim alehon parzela:
Abanim shelemot tibneh et-mizbach Adonai eloheka vehaalita alayv olot la-Adonai eloheka
Abnin shalemin tibne yat madbecha daAdonai elahak vetasseq alohi alavan qodam Adonai elahak:
Vezabachta shelamim veakalta sham vesamachta lipne Adonai eloheka
Vetikkos niksat qudeshin vetekul tamman vetechede qodam Adonai elahak:
Vekatabta al-haabanim et-kol-dibre hattora hazzot baer heteb
Vetiktob al abnayya yat kol pitgame orayta hada parash yaut:
Vayedabber mosheh vehakkohanim haleviyyim el kol-yisrael lemor hasket ushema yisrael hayyom hazzeh nihyeta leam la-Adonai eloheka
Umallil msheh vekahanayya levae lekol yisrael lememar atzet ushema yisrael yoma haden haveta leamma qodam Adonai elahak:
Veshamata beqol Adonai eloheka veasita et-mitzvotav veet-chuqqayv asher anoki metzavveka hayyom
Uteqabbel lememera daAdonai elahak vetabed yat piqqudohi veyat qeyamohi di ana mepaqqedak yoma den:
Vayetzav mosheh et-haam bayyom hahu lemor
Upaqqid msheh yat amma beyoma hahu lememar:
Elleh yaamdu lebarek et-haam al-har gerizim beobrekem et-hayyarden shimon velevi vihuda veyissashkar veyosep ubinyamin
Illen yequmun lebaraka yat amma al tura digrizzim bemeabarekon yat yardena shimon velevi vihuda veyissaskar veyosep ubinyamin:
Veelleh yaamdu al-haqqelala behar ebal reuben gad veasher uzebulun dan venaptali
Veillen yequmun al levatayya betura deebal reuben gad veasher uzebulun dan venaptali:
Veanu haleviyyim veameru el-kol-ish yisrael qol ram
Vitibun levae veyemerun lekol enash yisrael qala rama:
Arur haish asher yaaseh pesel umasseka toabat Adonai maaseh yede charash vesam bassater veanu kol-haam veameru amen
Lit gabra di yabed tzelem umatteka merachaqa qodam Adonai obad yede aman umeshavvi besitra vitibun kol amma veyemerun amen:
Arur maqleh abiv veimmo veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyiqle abuhi veimmeh veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur massig gebul reehu veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishne techuma dechabreh veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur mashgeh ivver baddarek veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyate avvira beorcha veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur matteh mishpat ger-yatom vealmana veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyatzle din dayyar yittamma vearmela veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur shokeb im-eshet abiv ki gilla kenap abiv veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishkub im ittat abuhi are galli kanpa daabuhi veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur shokeb im-kol-behema veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishkub im kol beira veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur shokeb im-achoto bat-abiv o bat-immo veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishkub im achateh bat abuhi o bat immeh veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur shokeb im-chotanto veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishkub im chamoteh veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur makkeh reehu bassater veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyimche lechabreh besitra veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur loqeach shochad lehakkot nepesh dam naqi veamar kol-haam amen
Lit di meqabbel shochada lemiqtal nepash dam zakkay veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur asher lo-yaqim et-dibre hattora-hazzot laasot otam veamar kol-haam amen
Lit di la yeqayyam yat pitgame orayta hada lemebad yatehon veyemar kol amma amen:
Vehaya im-shamoa tishma beqol Adonai eloheka lishmor laasot et-kol-mitzvotayv asher anoki metzavveka hayyom unetaneka Adonai eloheka elyon al kol-goye haaretz
Vihe im qabbala teqabbel lememera daAdonai elahak lemittar lemebad yat kol piqqudohi di ana mepaqqedak yoma den veyitteninnak Adonai elahak illay al kol amme ara:
Ubau aleka kol-habberakot haelleh vehissiguka ki tishma beqol Adonai eloheka
Veyetun alak kol birketa haillen veyidbequnnak are teqabbal lememera daAdonai elahak:
Baruk atta bair ubaruk atta bassadeh
Berik at beqarta uberik at bechaqla:
Baruk peri-bitneka uperi admateka uperi behemteka shegar alapeka veashterot tzoneka
Berik valeda dimak veibba dearak uvaleda dibirak baqre torayk veedre anak:
Baruk tanaka umisharteka
Berik sallak veatzvatak:
Baruk atta beboeka ubaruk atta betzeteka
Berik at bemealak uberik at bemippeqak:
Yitten Adonai et-oyebeka haqqamim aleka niggapim lepaneka bederek echad yetzeu eleka ubeshiba derakim yanusu lepaneka
Yitten Adonai yat baale debabak deqayemin alak tebirin qodamak beorcha chad yippequn levatak ubeshiba orchan yeirqun miqqodamak:
Yetzav Adonai itteka et-habberaka baasameka ubekol mishlach yadeka uberakka baaretz asher-Adonai eloheka noten lak
Yepaqqed Adonai immak yat birketa beotzarak ubekol oshatut yedak vibarekinnak beara daAdonai elahak yaheb lak:
Yeqimeka Adonai lo leam qadosh kaasher nisheba-lak ki tishmor et-mitzvot Adonai eloheka vehalakta bidrakayv
Yeqiminnak Adonai leh leam qaddish kema di qayyim lak are tittar yat piqqudayya daAdonai elahak utehak beorchan detaqenan qodamohi:
Verau kol-amme haaretz ki shem Adonai niqra aleka veyareu mimmekka
Veyechezun kol amme ara are shema daAdonai itqere alak veyidchalun minnak:
Vehotirka Adonai letoba bipri bitneka ubipri behemteka ubipri admateka al haadama asher nishba Adonai laaboteka latet lak
Veyoterinnak Adonai letaba bevaleda dimak ubevaleda dibirak ubeibba dearak al ara di qayyim Adonai laabahatak lemittan lak:
Yiptach Adonai leka et-otzaro hattob et-hashshamayim latet metar-artzeka beitto ulebarek et kol-maaseh yadeka vehilvita goyim rabbim veatta lo tilveh
Yiptach Adonai lak yat otzareh taba yat shemayya lemittan metar arak beiddaneh ulebaraka yat kol obade yedak vetozep leammin saggiin veat la tezup:
Unetaneka Adonai lerosh velo lezanab vehayita raq lemala velo tihyeh lematta ki-tishma el-mitzvot Adonai eloheka asher anoki metzavveka hayyom lishmor velaasot
Veyitteninnak Adonai letaqqip vela lechallash utehe beram leella vela tehe letachta are teqabbal lepiqqudayya daAdonai elahak di ana mepaqqedak yoma den lemittar ulemebad:
Velo tasur mikkol-haddebarim asher anoki metzavveh etkem hayyom yamin usemovl laleket achare elohim acherim leobdam
Vela tistun mikkol pitgamayya di ana mepaqqed yatekon yoma den yammina usemala limhak batar taavat ammayya lemiplechinnun:
Vehaya im-lo tishma beqol Adonai eloheka lishmor laasot et-kol-mitzvotayv vechuqqotayv asher anoki metzavveka hayyom ubau aleka kol-haqqelalot haelleh vehissiguka
Vihe im la teqabbal bememera daAdonai elahak lemittar lemebad yat kol piqqudohi uqeyamohi di ana mepaqqedak yoma den veyetun alak kol levatayya haillen veyidbequnnak:
Arur atta bair vearur atta bassadeh
Lit at beqarta velit at bechaqla:
Arur tanaka umisharteka
Lit sallak veatzvatak:
Arur peri-bitneka uperi admateka shegar alapeka veashterot tzoneka
Lit valeda dimak veibba dearak baqre torayk veedre anak:
Arur atta beboeka vearur atta betzeteka
Lit at bemealak velit at bemippeqak:
Yeshallach Adonai beka et-hammeera et-hammehuma veet-hammigeret bekol-mishlach yadeka asher taaseh ad hishshamedka vead-abodka maher mippene roa maalaleka asher azabtani
Yegare Adonai bak yat meerta veyat shiggushayya veyat mezopita bekol oshatut yedak di tabed ad detishtetze vead detebad bipria min qodam bishut obadayk dishbaqta dachalti:
Yadbeq Adonai beka et-haddaber ad kalloto oteka meal haadama asher-atta ba-shamma lerishtah
Yadbeq Adonai bak yat mota ad dishetze yatak meal ara di at alel letamman lemeretah:
Yakkeka Adonai bashshachepet ubaqqaddachat ubaddalleqet ubacharchur ubachereb ubashshiddapon ubayyeraqon uredapuka ad obdeka
Yimchinnak Adonai beshachepta ubeqaddachta ubidleqta ubecharchura ubecharba ubeshiddepona ubeyarqona veyirdepunnak ad detebad:
Vehayu shameka asher al-rosheka nechoshet vehaaretz asher-tachteka barzel
Vihon shemayyak di illave reshak chasinin kinchasha milleachata mitra veara di techotak taqqipa keparzela millemebad perin:
Yitten Adonai et-metar artzeka abaq veapar min-hashshamayim yered aleka ad hishshamedak
Yitten Adonai yat metar arak abqa veapra min shemayya yechut alak ad detishtetze:
Yittenka Adonai niggap lipne oyebeka bederek echad tetze elayv ubeshiba derakim tanus lepanayv vehayita lezaava lekol mamlekot haaretz
Yitteninnak Adonai tebir qodam saneak beorcha chada tippoq levateh ubeshiba orchan teiroq miqqodamohi utehe lezia lekol malkevat ara:
Vehayeta niblateka lemaakal lekol-op hashshamayim ulebehemat haaretz veen macharid
Utehe nebiltak meshaggera lemekal lekol opa dishmayya velibirat ara velet demanid:
Yakkeka Adonai bishchin mitzrayim ubattechorim ubaggarab ubechares asher lo-tvkal leherape
Yimchinnak Adonai beshichana demitzrayim ubitchorin ubegarba ubacharis yabbish di la tikkul leittassaa:
Yakkeka Adonai beshiggaon ubeivvaron ubetimhon lebab
Yimchinnak Adonai betapshuta ubesamyuta ubeshaamamut libba:
Vehayita memashshesh batztzohorayim kaasher yemashshesh haivver baapela velo tatzliach et-derakeka vehayita ak ashuq vegazul kol-hayyamim veen moshia
Utehe memashshesh betihara kema di mashshesh avvira beqabla vela tatzlach yat orchatayk utehe beram ashiq veanis kol yomayya velet depariq:
Ishsha teares veish acher yishkabenna bayit tibneh velo-tesheb bo kerem titta velo techallelennu
Itteta teros ugebar ochoran yishkebinnah beta tibne vela teteb beh karma titztzob vela techallinneh:
Shoreka tabuach leeneka velo tokal mimmennu chamoreka gazul millepaneka velo yashub lak tzoneka netunot leoyebeka veen leka moshia
Torak yehe nakes leenayk vela tekul minneh chamarak yehe anes miqqodamak vela yetub lak anak mesirin lebaale debabak velet lak pariq:
Baneka ubenoteka netunim leam acher veeneka root vekalot alehem kol-hayyom veen leel yadeka
Benayk ubenatayk mesirin leamma ochoran veenayk chazan visupan biglalehen kol yoma velet chela bidak:
Peri admateka vekol-yegiaka yokal am asher lo-yadaeta vehayita raq ashuq veratzutz kol-hayyamim
Ibba dearak vekol leutak yekul amma di la yedaat utehe beram ashiq ureia kol yomayya:
Vehayita meshugga mimmareh eneka asher tireh
Utehe mishtatteh mechezu enayk di techeze:
Yakkeka Adonai bishchin ra al-habbirkayim veal-hashshoqayim asher lo-tvkal leherape mikkap ragleka vead qodqodeka
Yimchinnak Adonai beshichana bisha al rekubayya veal shaqayya di la tikkul leittassaa mipparsat raglak vead mochak:
Yolek Adonai oteka veet-malkeka asher taqim aleka el-goy asher lo-yadata atta vaaboteka veabadta sham elohim acherim etz vaaben
Yagle Adonai yatak veyat malkak di teqim alak leam di la yedaat at vaabahatayk vetiplach tamman leammayya paleche taavata aa veabna:
Vehayita leshamma lemashal velishnina bekol haammim asher-yenahegka Adonai shamma
Utehe letzadu limtal uleshoe bekol ammayya di yidberinnak Adonai letamman:
Zera rab totzi hassadeh umeat teesop ki yachselennu haarbeh
Bar zera saggi tappeq lechaqla uzeer tiknosh are yachselinneh goba:
Keramim titta veabadeta veyayin lo-tishteh velo teegor ki tokelennu hattolaat
Karmin titztzob vetiplach vechamra la tishte vela tiknosh are tekelinneh tolata:
Zetim yihyu leka bekol-gebuleka veshemen lo tasuk ki yishshal zeteka
Zetin yehon lak bekol techumak umishcha la tesuk are yitterun zetayk:
Banim ubanot tolid velo-yihyu lak ki yeleku bashshebi
Benin ubenan tolid vela yehon lak are yehakun beshibya:
Kol-etzeka uperi admateka Adonairesh hatztzelatzal
Kol ilanak veibba dearak yachseninneh saqqaa:
Hagger asher beqirbeka yaaleh aleka mala maela veatta tered matta matta
Totab arel di benak yehe saliq el minnak leella leella veat tehe nachet letachta letachta:
Hu yalveka veatta lo talvennu hu yihyeh lerosh veatta tiheyeh lezanab
Hu yozepinnak veat la tozepinneh hu yehe letaqqip veat tehe lechallash:
Ubau aleka kol-haqqelalot haelleh uredapuka vehissiguka ad hishshamedak ki-lo shamata beqol Adonai eloheka lishmor mitzvotayv vechuqqotayv asher tzivvak
Veyetun alak kol levatayya haillen veyirdepunnak veyidbequnnak ad detishtetze are la qabbelta lememera daAdonai elahak lemittar piqqudohi uqeyamohi di paqqedak:
Vehayu beka leot ulemopet ubezaraka ad-olam
Vihon bak leat ulemopet ubibnayk ad olam:
Tachat asher lo-abadta et-Adonai eloheka besimcha ubetub lebab merob kol
Cholap di la pelachta qodam Adonai elahak bechedva ubeshappirut libba missege kolla:
Veabadta et-oyebeka asher yeshallechennu Adonai bak beraab ubetzama ubeerom ubechoser kol venatan ol barzel al-tzavvareka ad hishmido otak
Vetiplach yat baale debabak di yegarinneh Adonai bak bekapna ubetzachuta ubeartilyata ubachasirut kolla veyitten nir parzela al tzavverak ad dishetze yatak:
Yissa Adonai aleka goy merachoq miqtzeh haaretz kaasher yideh hannasher goy asher lo-tishma leshono
Yayti Adonai alak am merachiq misseyape ara kema di mishtedi nishra amma di la tishma lishaneh:
Goy az panim asher lo-yissa panim lezaqen venaar lo yachon
Am taqqip appin di la yissab appin lesaba veal yaneqa la merachem:
Veakal peri behemteka uperi-admateka ad hishshamedak asher lo-yashir leka dagan tirosh veyitzhar shegar alapeka veashterot tzoneka ad haabido otak
Veyekul valeda dibirak veibba dearak ad detishtetze di la yashar lak ibura chamra umishcha baqre torayk veedre anak ad deyobed yatak:
Vehetzar leka bekol-sheareka ad redet chomoteka haggebohot vehabbetzurot asher atta boteach bahen bekol-artzeka vehetzar leka bekol-sheareka bekol-artzeka asher natan Adonai eloheka lak
Veyaeq lak bekol qirvayk ad deyikbash shurayk ramayya ukerikayya di at rachetz leishtezaba behen bekol arak veyaeq lak bekol qirvayk bekol arak di yehab Adonai elahak lak:
Veakalta peri-bitneka besar baneka ubenoteka asher natan-leka Adonai eloheka bematzor ubematzoq asher-yatziq leka oyebeka
Vetekul valeda dimak besar benayk ubenatayk di yehab lak Adonai elahak bitzyara ubeaqta deyaeq lak saneak:
Haish harak beka veheanog meod tera eno beachiv ubeeshet cheqo ubeyeter banayv asher yotir
Gabra derakkik bak vedimpannaq lachada tibesh eneh beachuhi ubeittat qeyameh ubishar benohi di yashar:
Mittet leachad mehem mibbesar banayv asher yokel mibbeli hishir-lo kol bematzor ubematzoq asher yatziq leka oyibka bekol-sheareka
Millemittan lechad minnehon mibbesar benohi di yekul middela ishtaar leh kolla bitzyara ubeaqta di yaeq lak saneak bekol qirvayk:
Harakka beka vehaanugga asher lo-nisseta kap-raglah hatztzeg al-haaretz mehitanneg umerok tera enah beish cheqah ubibnah ubebittah
Derakkika bak vedimpanneqa di la nassiat parsat raglah laachata al ara mimmepannequ umerakkiku tabesh enah bigbar qeyamah ubibrah ubibrattah:
Ubeshilyatah hayyotzet mibben ragleha ubebaneha asher teled ki-tokelem bechoser-kol bassater bematzor ubematzoq asher yatziq leka oyibka bishareka
Ubizer benaha deyippequn minnah ubibnaha di telid are tekelinnun bachasirut kolla besitra bitzyara ubeaqta di yaeq lak saneak beqirvayk:
Im-lo tishmor laasot et-kol-dibre hattora hazzot hakketubim basseper hazzeh leyira et-hashshem hannikbad vehannora hazzeh et Adonai eloheka
Im la tittar lemebad yat kol pitgame orayta hada diktibin besipra haden lemidchal yat shema yaqqira udechila haden yat Adonai elahak:
Vehipla Adonai et-makkoteka veet makkot zareka makkot gedolot veneemanot vocholayim raim veneemanim
Veyaprash Adonai yat machatak veyat machat benayk machan rabreban umehemenan umakteshin bishin umehemenin:
Veheshib beka et kol-madveh mitzrayim asher yagoreta mippenehem vedabequ bak
Veyateb bak yat kol makteshe mitzrayim di dechelta miqqodamehon veyidbequn bak:
Gam kol-choli vekol-makka asher lo katub beseper hattora hazzot yalem Adonai aleka ad hishshamedak
Ap kol mera vekol macha di la ketibin besipra deorayta hada yaytinnun Adonai alak ad deyishtetzak:
Venishartem bimte meat tachat asher heyitem kekokebe hashshamayim larob ki-lo shamata beqol Adonai eloheka
Vetishtaarun beam zeer cholap di havetun kekokebe shemayya lemisge are la qabbelta lememera daAdonai elahak:
Vehaya kaasher-sas Adonai alekem lehetib etkem uleharbot etkem ken yasis Adonai alekem lehaabid etkem ulehashmid etkem venissachtem meal haadama asher-atta ba-shamma lerishtah
Vihe kema dichadde Adonai alekon leotaba yatekon uleasgaa yatekon ken yechede Adonai alekon leobada yatekon uleshetzaa yatekon vetittaltelun meal ara diat alel letamman lemeretah:
Vehepitzeka Adonai bekol-haammim miqtzeh haaretz vead-qetzeh haaretz veabadta sham elohim acherim asher lo-yadata atta vaaboteka etz vaaben
Vibadderinnak Adonai bekol ammayya misseyape ara vead seyape ara vetiplach tamman leammayya paleche taavata di la yedata at vaabahatak aa veabna:
Ubaggoyim hahem lo targia velo-yihyeh manoach lekap-ragleka venatan Adonai leka sham leb raggaz vekilyon enayim vedaabon napesh
Ubeammayya hainnun la tenuach vela yehe menach leparsat raglak veyitten Adonai lak tamman leb dachel vechashkat aynin umappechan nepash:
Vehayu chayyeka teluim leka minneged upachadta layla veyomam velo taamin bechayyeka
Vihon chayyayk telan lak miqqobel utehe taveh leleya vimama vela tehemin bechayyayk:
Babboqer tomar mi-yitten ereb ubaereb tomar mi-yitten boqer mippachad lebabeka asher tipchad umimmareh eneka asher tireh
Betzapra temar man yitten ramsha uberamsha temar man yitten tzapra mittavhut libbak di tehe taveh umechezu enayk di tehe chaze:
Veheshibeka Adonai mitzrayim booniyyot badderek asher amarti leka lo-tosip od lirotah vehitmakkartem sham leoyebeka laabadim velishpachot veen qoneh
Veyatebinnak Adonai mitzrayim bispinan beorcha di amarit lak la tosep od lemechezeyah vetizdabbenun tamman lebaale debabak leabdin uleamhan velet deqaneh:
Elleh dibre habberit asher-tzivva Adonai et-mosheh likrot et-bene yisrael beeretz moab millebad habberit asher-karat ittam bechoreb
Illen pitgame qeyama di paqqid Adonai yat msheh lemigzar im bene yisrael beara demoab bar miqqeyama di gezar immehon bechoreb:
Vayyiqra mosheh el-kol-yisrael vayyomer alehem attem reitem et kol-asher asa Adonai leenekem beeretz mitzrayim leparoh ulekol-abadayv ulekol-artzo
Uqera msheh lekol yisrael vaamar lehon attun chazetun yat kol di abad Adonai leenekon beara demitzrayim leparoh ulekal abdohi ulekal areh:
Hammassot haggedolot asher rau eneka haotot vehammopetim haggedolim hahem
Nisse rabrebayya di chazaa enayk atayya umopetayya rabrebayya hainnun:
Velo-natan Adonai lakem leb ladaat veenayim lirot veoznayim lishmoa ad hayyom hazzeh
Vela yehab Adonai lekon libba lemidda veaynin lemecheze veudnin lemishma ad yoma haden:
Vaolek etkem arbaim shana bammidbar lo-balu salmotekem mealekem venaalka lo-baleta meal ragleka
Vedabbarit yatekon arbein shenin bemadbera la beliat kesutekon minnekon umesanak la ado meal raglak:
Lechem lo akaltem veyayin veshekar lo shetitem lemaan tedeu ki ani Adonai elohekem
Lachma la akaltun vachamar chadat veattiq la shetetun bedil detiddeun are ana Adonai elahakon:
Vattabou el-hammaqom hazzeh vayyetze sichon melek-cheshbon veog melek-habbashan liqratenu lammilchama vannakkem
Vaatetun leatra haden unepaq sichon malka decheshbon veog malka dematnan loqodamutana laagacha qeraba umechonun:
Vanniqqach et-artzam vannittenah lenachala larubeni velaggadi velachatzi shebet hamenashshi
Unesibna yat arahon vihabinnah leachasana leshibta diruben uleshibta degad ulepalgut shibta dimnashsheh:
Ushemartem et-dibre habberit hazzot vaasitem otam lemaan taskilu et kol-asher taasun
Vetitterun yat pitgame qeyama hada vetabedun yatehon bedil detitzlechun yat kol di tabedun:
Attem nitztzabim hayyom kullekem lipne Adonai elohekem rashekem shibtekem ziqnekem veshoterekem kol ish yisrael
Attun qayemin yoma den kallekon qodam Adonai elahakon reshekon shibtekon sabekon vesarekekon kol enash yisrael:
Tappekem neshekem vegereka asher beqereb machaneka mechoteb etzeka ad shoeb memeka
Taplekon neshekon vegiyyorak di bego mashritayk millaqet aayk ad mele mayyayk:
Leobreka bibrit Adonai eloheka ubealato asher Adonai eloheka koret immeka hayyom
Leaalutak biqyama dayya elahak ubemomateh di Adonai elahak gezar immak yoma den:
Lemaan haqim-oteka hayyom lo leam vehu yiheyeh-leka lelohim kaasher dibber-lak vekaasher nishba laaboteka leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob
Bedil laaqama yatak yoma den qodamohi leamma vehu yehe lak leelah kema di mallil lak ukema di qayyim laabahatak leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob:
Velo ittekem lebaddekem anoki koret et-habberit hazzot veet-haala hazzot
Vela immekon bilchodekon ana gezar yat qeyama hada veyat momata hada:
Ki et-asher yeshno poh immanu omed hayyom lipne Adonai elohenu veet asher enennu poh immanu hayyom
Are yat man deitohi haka immana qaem yoma den qodam Adonai elahana veyat di letohi haka immana yoma den:
Ki-attem yedatem et asher-yashabnu beeretz mitzrayim veet asher-abarnu beqereb haggoyim asher abartem
Are attun yedatun yat ditebena beara demitzrayim veyat di abarna bego ammayya di abartun:
Vattiru et-shiqqutzehem veet gillulehem etz vaeben kesep vezahab asher immahem
Vachazetun yat shiqqutzehon veyat taavatehon aa veabna kaspa vedahaba di immehon:
Pen-yesh bakem ish o-ishsha o mishpacha o-shebet asher lebabo poneh hayyom meim Adonai elohenu laleket laabod et-elohe haggoyim hahem pen-yesh bakem shoresh poreh rosh velaana
Dilema it bekon gebar o itteta o zarit o shibta di libbeh pane yoma den middachalta daAdonai elahana lemehak lemiplach yat taavat ammayya hainnun dilema it bekon gebar meharhar chetin o zadon:
Vehaya beshomo et-dibre haala hazzot vehitbarek bilbabo lemor shalom yiheyeh-li ki bishrirut libbi elek lemaan sepot harava et-hatztzemea
Vihe bemishmeeh yat pitgame momata hada vichashshab belibbeh lememar shelama yehe li are beharhor libbi ana azel bedil leosapa leh chete shaluta al zedanuta:
Lo-yobeh Adonai seloach lo ki az yeshan ap-Adonai veqinato baish hahu verabetza bo kol-haala hakketuba basseper hazzeh umacha Adonai et-shemo mittachat hashshamayim
La yebe Adonai lemishbaq leh are beken yitqep rogza daAdonai vechemteh begabra hahu veyidbequn beh kol levatayya diktibin besipra haden veyimche Adonai yat shemeh mittechot shemayya:
Vehibdilo Adonai leraa mikkol shibte yisrael kekol alot habberit hakketuba beseper hattora hazzeh
Veyapreshinneh Adonai lebisha mikkol shibtayya deyisrael kekol levate qeyama diktibin besipra deorayta haden:
Veamar haddor haacharon benekem asher yaqumu meacharekem vehannokri asher yabo meeretz rechoqa verau et-makkot haaretz hahiv veet-tachalueha asher-chilla Adonai bah
Veyemar dara batraa benekon di yequmun mibbatrekon ubar ammin deyete meara rechiqa veyechezun yat mechata deara hahi veyat maraha di amra Adonai bah:
Goprit vamelach serepa kol-artzah lo tizzara velo tatzmiach velo-yaaleh bah kol-eseb kemahpekat sedom vaamora adma utzeboyim asher hapak Adonai beappo ubachamato
Gapereta umilcha yeqidat kol arah la tizra vela tatzmach vela yissaq bah kol esba kemahpekta disdom vaamora adma utzeboyim di hapak Adonai berogzeh ubechemteh:
Veameru kol-haggoyim al-meh asa Adonai kaka laaretz hazzot meh chori haap haggadol hazzeh
Veyemerun kol ammayya al meh abad Adonai keden leara hada ma teqop rogza rabba haden:
Veameru al asher azebu et-berit Adonai elohe abotam asher karat immam behotzio otam meeretz mitzrayim
Veyemerun al dishbaqu yat qeyama daAdonai elaha daabahatehon di gezar immehon beappaquteh yatehon meara demitzrayim:
Vayyeleku vayyaabdu elohim acherim vayyishetachavu lahem elohim asher lo-yedaum velo chalaq lahem
Vaazalu upelachu letaavat ammayya usegidu lehon dachalan di la yedaunnun vela otiba lehon:
Vayyichar-ap Adonai baaretz hahiv lehabi aleha et-kol-haqqelala hakketuba basseper hazzeh
Uteqep rogza daAdonai beara hahi leaytaa alah yat kol levatayya diktibin besipra haden:
Vayyitteshem Adonai meal admatam beap ubechema ubeqetzep gadol vayyashlikem el-eretz acheret kayyom hazzeh
Vetaltelinnun Adonai meal arahon birgaz ubechema ubechemeta ubitqop regaz veaglinnun leara ochori keyoma haden:
Hannistarot la-Adonai elohenu vehanniglot lanu ulebanenu ad-olam laasot et-kol-dibre hattora hazzot
Demittammeran qodam Adonai elahana udemiggolyan lana velibnana ad olam lemebad yat kol pitgame orayta hada:
Vehaya ki-yabou aleka kol-haddebarim haelleh habberaka vehaqqelala asher natatti lepaneka vahashebota el-lebabeka bekol-haggoyim asher hiddichaka Adonai eloheka shamma
Vihe are yetun alak kol pitgamayya haillen birkan ulevatin di yehabit qodamak utetub lelibbak bekol ammayya di aglak Adonai elahak letamman:
Veshabta ad-Adonai eloheka veshamata beqolo kekol asher-anoki metzavveka hayyom atta ubaneka bekol-lebabeka ubekol-napsheka
Utetub ledachalta daAdonai elahak uteqabbal lememereh kekol di ana mepaqqedak yoma den at ubenayk bekol libbak ubekol napshak:
Veshab Adonai eloheka et-shebuteka verichameka veshab veqibbetzka mikkol-haammim asher hepitzeka Adonai eloheka shamma
Vitub Adonai elahak yat shabe galvatak viracham alak vitub veyikneshinnak mikkol ammayya di yebadderinnak Adonai elahak letamman:
Im-yihyeh niddachaka biqtzeh hashshamayim mishsham yeqabbetzka Adonai eloheka umishsham yiqqacheka
Im yehe galvatak bisyape shemayya mittamman yikneshinnak Adonai elahak umittamman yeqarebinnak:
Vehebiaka Adonai eloheka el-haaretz asher-yareshu aboteka virishtah vehetibeka vehirbeka meaboteka
Veyaelinnak Adonai elahak leara diritu abahatak veteretah veyoteb lak veyasginnak meabahatak:
Umal Adonai eloheka et-lebabeka veet-lebab zareka leahaba et-Adonai eloheka bekol-lebabeka ubekol-napsheka lemaan chayyeka
Veyede Adonai elahak yat tapshut libbak veyat tapshut libba dibnayk lemircham yat Adonai elahak bekol libbak ubekol napshak bedil chayyayk:
Venatan Adonai eloheka et kol-haalot haelleh al-oyebeka veal-soneeka asher redapuka
Veyitten Adonai elahak yat kol levatayya haillen al baale debabak veal saneak di redapuk:
Veatta tashub veshamata beqol Adonai veasita et-kol-mitzvotayv asher anoki metzavveka hayyom
Veat tetub uteqabbal bememera daAdonai vetabed yat kol piqqudohi di ana mepaqqedak yoma den:
Vehotireka Adonai eloheka bekol maaseh yadeka bipri bitneka ubipri behemteka ubipri admateka letoba ki yashub Adonai lasus aleka letob kaasher-sas al-aboteka
Veyoterinnak Adonai elahak bekol obade yedak bevaleda dimak ubevaleda dibirak ubeibba dearak letaba are yetub Adonai lemechede alak letab kema di chadi al abahatak:
Ki tishma beqol Adonai eloheka lishmor mitzvotayv vechuqqotayv hakketuba beseper hattora hazzeh ki tashub el-Adonai eloheka bekol-lebabeka ubekol-napsheka
Are teqabbal bememera dayya elahak lemittar piqqudohi uqeyamohi diktibin besipra deorayta haden are tetub qodam Adonai elahak bekol libbak ubekol napshak:
Ki hammitzva hazzot asher anoki metzavveka hayyom lo-niplet hiv mimmeka velo rechoqa hiv
Are tapqedta hada di ana mepaqqedak yoma den la mapresha hi minnak vela rechiqa hi:
Lo bashshamayim hiv lemor mi yaaleh-lanu hashshamayma veyiqqacheha lanu veyashmienu otah venaasenna
La bishmayya hi lememar man yissaq lana lishmayya veyissebah lana veyashmeinnana yatah venabedinnah:
Velo-meeber layyam hiv lemor mi yaabor-lanu el-eber hayyam veyiqqacheha lanu veyashmienu otah venaasenna
Vela meibra leyamma hi lememar man yeibar lana leibra deyamma veyissebah lana veyashmeinnana yatah venabedinnah:
Ki-qarob eleka haddabar meod bepika ubilebabeka laasoto
Are qarib lak pitgama lachada bepumak ubelibbak lemebedeh:
Reeh natatti lepaneka hayyom et-hachayyim veet-hattob veet-hammavet veet-hara
Chaze dihabit qodamak yoma den yat chayye veyat tabta veyat mota veyat bisha:

Asher anoki metzavveka hayyom leahaba et-Adonai eloheka laleket bidrakayv velishmor mitzvotayv vechuqqotayv umishpatayv vechayita verabita uberakka Adonai eloheka baaretz asher-atta ba-shamma lerishtah

Di ana mepaqqedak yoma den lemircham yat Adonai elahak limhak beorchan detaqenan qodamohi ulemittar piqqudohi uqeyamohi vedinohi veteche vetisge vibarekinnak Adonai elahak beara di at alel letamman lemeretah:
Veim-yipneh lebabeka velo tishma veniddachta vehishetachavita lelohim acherim vaabadtam
Veim yipne libbak vela teqabbel vetite vetisgud letaavat ammayya vetiplechinnun:
Higgadti lakem hayyom ki abod tobedun lo-taarikun yamim al-haadama asher atta ober et-hayyarden labo shamma lerishtah
Chavveti lekon yoma den are mebad tebedun la torekon yomin al ara di at aber yat yardena lemeal letamman lemeretah:
Haidoti bakem hayyom et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz hachayyim vehammavet natatti lepaneka habberaka vehaqqelala ubacharta bachayyim lemaan ticheyeh atta vezareka
Ashedit bekon yoma den yat shemayya veyat ara chayye umota yehabit qodamak birkan ulevatin vetittire bechayye bedil deteche at ubenayk:
Leahaba et-Adonai eloheka lishmoa beqolo uledobqa-bo ki hu chayyeka veorek yameka lashebet al-haadama asher nishba Adonai laaboteka leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob latet lahem
Lemircham yat Adonai elahak leqabbala lememereh uleitqaraba ledachalteh are hu chayyayk veorakut yomayk lemittab al ara di qayyim Adonai laabahatak leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob lemittan lehon:
Vayyelek mosheh vayedabber et-haddebarim haelleh el-kol-yisrael
Vaazal msheh umallil yat pitgamayya haillen im kol yisrael:
Vayyomer alehem ben-mea veesrim shana anoki hayyom lo-vkal od latzet velabo va-Adonai amar elay lo taabor et-hayyarden hazzeh
Vaamar lehon bar mea veesrin shenin ana yoma den let ana yakil od lemippaq ulemeal vaAdonai amar li la teibbar yat yardena haden:
Adonai eloheka hu ober lepaneka hu-yashmid et-haggoyim haelleh millepaneka virishtam yehoshua hu ober lepaneka kaasher dibber Adonai
Adonai elahak memereh yeibar qodamak hu yeshetze yat ammayya haillen miqqodamak veteretinnun yehoshua hu aber qodamak kema di mallil Adonai:
Veasa Adonai lahem kaasher asa lesichon uleog malke haemori uleartzam asher hishmid otam
Veyabed Adonai lehon kema di abad lesichon uleog malke emoraa ulearahon di shetzi yatehon:
Unetanam Adonai lipnekem vaasitem lahem kekol-hammitzva asher tzivviti etkem
Veyimserinnun Adonai qodamekon vetabedun lehon kekal tapqedta di paqqedit yatekon:
Chizqu veimtzu al-tireu veal-taartzu mippenehem ki Adonai eloheka hu haholek immak lo yarpeka velo yaazbekka
Teqipu veallimu la tidchalun vela tittaberun miqqodamehon are Adonai elahak hu dimdabbar qodamak la yishbeqinnak vela yarteshinnak:
Vayyiqra mosheh lihoshua vayyomer elayv leene kol-yisrael chazaq veematz ki atta tabo et-haam hazzeh el-haaretz asher nishba Adonai laabotam latet lahem veatta tanchilenna otam
Uqera msheh lihoshua vaamar leh leene kol yisrael teqap veallim are at teul im amma haden leara di qayyim Adonai laabahatehon lemittan lehon veat tachseninnah yatehon:
Va-Adonai hu haholek lepaneka hu yihyeh immak lo yarpeka velo yaazbekka lo tira velo techat
VaAdonai hu dimdabbar qodamak memereh yehe besadak la yishbeqinnak vela yarcheqinnak la tidchal vela tittebar:
Vayyiktob mosheh et-hattora hazzot vayyittenah el-hakkohanim bene levi hannoseim et-aron berit Adonai veel-kol-ziqne yisrael
Uketab msheh yat orayta hada vihabah lekahanayya bene levi denatelin yat aron qeyama daAdonai ulekal sabe yisrael:
Vayetzav mosheh otam lemor miqqetz sheba shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot
Upaqqid msheh yatehon lememar missop sheba shenin bizman shatta dishmitteta bechagga dimtallayya:
Bebo kol-yisrael leraot et-pene Adonai eloheka bammaqom asher yibchar tiqra et-hattora hazzot neged kol-yisrael beoznehem
Bemete kol yisrael leitchazaa qodam Adonai elahak beatra di yittire tiqre yat orayta hada qodam kol yisrael vetashmeinnun:
Haqhel et-haam haanashim vehannashim vehattap vegereka asher bishareka lemaan yishmeu ulemaan yilmedu veyareu et-Adonai elohekem veshameru laasot et-kol-dibre hattora hazzot
Kenosh yat amma gubrayya uneshayya vetapla vegiyyorak di beqirvayk bedil deyishmeun ubedil deyillepun veyidchalun miqqodam Adonai elahakon veyitterun lemebad yat kol pitgame orayta hada:
Ubenehem asher lo-yadeu yishmeu velamedu leyira et-Adonai elohekem kol-hayyamim asher attem chayyim al-haadama asher attem oberim et-hayyarden shamma lerishtah
Ubenehon di la yadeun yishmeun veyallepun lemidchal yat Adonai elahakon kol yomayya di attun qayyamin al ara di attun aberin yat yardena tamman lemeretah:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh hen qarebu yameka lamut qera et-yehoshua vehiteyatztzebu beohel moed vaatzavvennu vayyelek mosheh vihoshua vayyiteyatztzebu beohel moed
