Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ha qeribu yomayk limmat qera yat yehoshua veitattadu bemashkan zimna veepaqqedinneh vaazal msheh vihoshu veitattadu bemashkan zimna:
Vayyera Adonai baohel beammud anan vayyaamod ammud heanan al-petach haohel
Veitgeli Adonai bemashkena beammuda daanana veqam ammuda daanana al tera mashkena:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mosheh hinneka shokeb im-aboteka veqam haam hazzeh vezana achare elohe nekar-haaretz asher hu ba-shamma beqirbo vaazabani veheper et-beriti asher karatti itto
Vaamar Adonai lemsheh ha at shakeb im abahatak viqum amma haden veyite batar taavat amme ara di hu al tamman benehon veyishbequn dachalti veyashnun yat qeyami di gezarit immehon:
Vechara appi bo bayyom-hahu vaazabtim vehistarti panay mehem vehaya leekol umetzauhu raot rabbot vetzarot veamar bayyom hahu halo al ki-en elohay beqirbi metzauni haraot haelleh

Veyitqop rogzi behon beyoma hahu vearcheqinnun veesalleq shekinti minnehon vihon lemibbaz veyiarean yatehon bishan saggian veaqan veyemar beyoma hahu hala middelet shekinat elahay beni areuni bishayya haillen:
Veanoki haster astir panay bayyom hahu al kol-haraa asher asa ki pana el-elohim acherim
Vaana sallaqa esalleq shekinti minnehon beyoma hahu al kol bisha di abadu are itpeniyyu letaavat ammayya:
Veatta kitbu lakem et-hashshira hazzot velammedah et-bene-yisrael simah bepihem lemaan tiheyeh-li hashshira hazzot leed bibne yisrael
Ukean ketibu lekon yat tushbachta hada veallepah yat bene yisrael shavveyah bepumhon bedil dithe qodamay tushbachta hada lesahid bibne yisrael:
Ki-abiennu el-haadama asher-nishbati laabotayv zabat chalab udebash veakal vesaba vedashen upana el-elohim acherim vaabadum veniatzuni veheper et-beriti
Are aelinnun leara di qayyemit laabahatehon abeda chalab udebash veyekelun veyisbeun veyitpannequn veyitpenun batar taavat ammayya veyiplechunnun veyirgezun qodamay veyashnun yat qeyami:
Vehaya ki-timtzena oto raot rabbot vetzarot veaneta hashshira hazzot lepanayv leed ki lo tishshakach mippi zaro ki yadati et-yitzro asher hu oseh hayyom beterem abiennu el-haaretz asher nishbati

Vihe are yearean yateh bishan saggian veaqan vetateb tushbachta hada qodamohi lesahid are la titneshe mippum benehon are gele qodamay yat yitzrehon di innun abedin yoma den ad la aelinnun leara di qayyemit:
Vayyiktob mosheh et-hashshira hazzot bayyom hahu vayelammedah et-bene yisrael
Uketab msheh yat tushebachta hada beyoma hahu veallepinnah libne yisrael:
Vayetzav et-yehoshua bin-nvn vayyomer chazaq veematz ki atta tabi et-bene yisrael el-haaretz asher-nishbati lahem veanoki ehyeh immak
Upaqqid yat yehoshua bar nun vaamar teqep veallim are at tael yat bene yisrael leara di qayyemit lehon umemeri yehe besaaddak:
Vayehi kekallot mosheh liktob et-dibre hattora-hazzot al-seper ad tummam
Vahava kad shetze msheh lemiktab yat pitgame orayta hada al sipra ad dishlimu:
Vayetzav mosheh et-haleviyyim nosee aron berit-Adonai lemor
Upaqqid msheh yat levae natele aron qeyama daAdonai lememar:
Laqoach et seper hattora hazzeh vesamtem oto mitztzad aron berit-Adonai elohekem vehaya-sham beka leed
Sibu yat sipra deorayta haden uteshavvun yateh missetar arona qeyama daAdonai elahakon vihe tamman bak lesahid:
Ki anoki yadati et-meryeka veet-orpeka haqqasheh hen beodenni chay immakem hayyom mamrim heyitem im-Adonai veap ki-achare moti
Are ana yedana yat sarbanutak veyat qedalak deqashya ha bead ana qayyam immekon yoma den mesarebin havetun qodam Adonai veap are batar deemut:
Haqhilu elay et-kol-ziqne shibtekem veshoterekem vaadabbera beoznehem et haddebarim haelleh veaida bam et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz
Kenishu levati yat kol sabe shibtekon vesarekekon veemallel qodamehon yat pitgamayya haillen veashed behon yat shemayya veyat ara:
Ki yadati achare moti ki-hashchet tashchitun vesartem min-hadderek asher tzivviti etkem veqarat etkem haraa beacharit hayyamim ki-taasu et-hara beene Adonai lehakiso bemaaseh yedekem
Are yedana batar deemut are chabbala techabbelun vetistun min orcha di paqqedit yatekon uteara yatekon bishta besop yomayya are tabedun yat debish qodam Adonai leargaza qodamohi beobade yedekon:
Vayedabber mosheh beozne kol-qehal yisrael et-dibre hashshira hazzot ad tummam
Umallil msheh qodam kol qehala deyisrael yat pitgame tushebachta hada ad dishlimu:
Haazinu hashshamayim vaadabbera vetishma haaretz imre-pi
Atzitu shemayya veemallel vetishshema ara imre pummi:
Yaarop kammatar liqchi tizzal kattal imrati kisirim ale-deshe vekirbibim ale-eseb
Yebassam kemitra ulpani yitqabbal ketalla memeri keruche mitra denashebin al dita vekirsise malqosha di al isba:
Ki shem Adonai eqra habu godel lelohenu
Are bishma daAdonai ana metzalle habu rebuta qodam elahana:
Hatztzur tamim poolo ki kol-derakayv mishpat el emuna veen avel tzaddiq veyashar hu
Taqqipa deshalemin obadohi are kol rechateh dina elaha mehemena demin qodamohi avla la napeq demin qodam zakkay veqashshit hu:
Shichet lo lo banayv mumam dor iqqesh upetaltol
Chabbilu lehon la leh benayya di pelachu letaavata dara deashniyyu obadohi veishtanniyyu:
Ha le-Adonai tigmelu-zot am nabal velo chakam halo-hv abika qaneka hu aseka vayekoneneka
Ha qodam Adonai attun gamelin da amma deqabbilu orayta vela chakkimu hala hu abuk veat di leh hu abedak veatqenak:
Zekor yemot olam binu shenot dor-vador sheal abika veyaggedeka zeqeneka veyomeru lak
Idkar yomin demin alema istakkal bishne dar vedar sheal abuk vichavvi lak sabik veyemerun lak:
Behanchel elyon goyim behaprido bene adam yatztzeb gebulot ammim lemispar bene yisrael
Beachasana illaa ammayya beparashuteh bene anasha qayyim techume ammayya leminyan bene yisrael:
Ki cheleq Adonai ammo yaaqob chebel nachalato
Are cholaqa daAdonai ammeh yaaqb adab achasanteh:
Yimtzaehu beeretz midbar ubetohu yelel yeshimon yesobebenhu yebonenehu yitztzerenhu keishon eno
Sappiq tzorkehon beara madbera ubet tzachavana ater di let mayya ashrinnun sechor sechor leshekinteh allepinnun pitgame orayta netarinnun kebabat enehon:
Kenesher yair qinno al-gozalayv yerachep yipros kenapayv yiqqachehu yissaehu al-ebrato
Kenishra dimchish leqinneh al benohi mitchopep paris gadpohi meqabbelhon menattelhon al teqop ebarohi:
Adonai badad yanchennu veen immo el nekar
Adonai bilchodohi atid leashrayutehon bealema dehu atid leitchaddata vela yitqayyam qodamohi palechan taavan:
Yarkibehu al-bomote aretz vayyokal tenubot saday vayyeniqehu debash missela veshemen mechalmish tzur
Ashrinnun al taqepe ara veokalinnun bizzat saneehon vihab lehon bizzat shallite qirvin venikse yatebe kerakkin taqqipin:
Chemat baqar vachaleb tzon im-cheleb karim veelim bene-bashan veattudim im-cheleb kilyot chitta vedam-enab tishteh-chamer
Yehab lehon bizzat malkehon veshallitehon im tar rabrebehon vetaqqipehon ama dearahon veachasantehon im bizzat chelehon umashshiryatehon vedam gibbarehon yittashad kemayya:
Vayyishman yeshurun vayyibat shamanta abita kasita vayyittosh eloah asahu vayenabbel tzur yeshuato
Veattar yisrael ubeat atzlach teqop qena niksin ushebaq palechan elaha deabedeh veargez qodam taqqipa depareqeh:
Yaqniuhu bezarim betoebot yakisuhu
Aqniu qodamohi bepalechan taavan betoebta argizu qodamohi:
Yizbechu lashshedim lo eloah elohim lo yedaum chadashim miqqarob bau lo searum abotekem
Dabbachu leshedin dilet behon tzerok dachalan dela yedaunnun chadta di miqqarib itabida la itassaqu behon abahatekon:
Tzur yeladeka teshi vattishkach el mecholeleka
Dachala taqqipa dibraak itnesheta shebaqta palechan elaha deabedak:
Vayyar Adonai vayyinatz mikkaas banayv ubenotayv
Ugeli qodam Adonai uteqep rogzeh midargizu qadamohi benin ubenan:
Vayyomer astira panay mehem ereh ma acharitam ki dor tahpukot hemma banim lo-emun bam
Vaamar esaleq shekinti minnehon geli qodamay ma yehe besopehon are dara deashniyyu innun benayya dilet behon hemanu:
Hem qinuni belo-el kiasuni behablehem vaani aqniem belo-am begoy nabal akisem
Innun aqniu qodamay bela dachala argizu qodamay bepalechan taavan vaana aqninnun bela am beamma tapsha argezinnun:
Ki-esh qadecha beappi vattiqad ad-sheol tachtit vattokal eretz vibulah vattelahet mosede harim
Are qiddum taqqip keeshsha nepaq miqqodamay birgaz veshetze ad sheol arait veasep ara vaalaltah veshetziyyat ad seyape turayya:
Aspeh alemo raot chitztzay akalleh-bam
Asep alehon bishin maktashay eshetze behon:
Meze raab ulechume reshep veqeteb meriri veshen-behemot ashallach-bam im-chamat zochale apar
Nipiche kapan vaakule up uketishe ruchin bishan veshen chevat bara egare behon im chamat tanninayya dezachalin beapra:
Michutz teshakkel-chereb umechadarim ema gam-bachur gam-betula yoneq im-ish seba
Mibbara tetakkel charba umittevanayya chargat mota ap ulemehon ap ulematehon yaneqehon im enash sabehon:
Amarti apehem ashbita meenosh zikram
Amarit echul rogzi alehon veeshetzinnun ebattal mibbene anasha dukeranehon:
Lule kaas oyeb agur pen-yenakkeru tzaremo pen-yomeru yadenu rama velo Adonai paal kol-zot
Illulapon rogza desanea kenish dilema yitrabrab beel debaba dilema yemerun yedana teqipat lana vela min qodam Adonai havat kol da:
Ki-goy obad etzot hemma veen bahem tebuna
Are am meabbede etza innun velet behon sukeletanu:
Lu chokmu yaskilu zot yabinu leacharitam
Illu chakkimu istakkalu beda sebaru ma yehe besopehon:
Eka yirdop echad elep ushenayim yanisu rebaba im-lo ki-tzvram mekaram va-Adonai hisgiram
Ekden yirdop chad alpa uteren yeerqun leribbota ellahen are taqqipehon mesarinnun vaAdonai ashleminnun:
Ki lo ketzurenu tzuram veoyebenu pelilim
Are la ketaqepana taqepehon ubaale debabana havo dayyanana:
Ki-miggepen sedom gapnam umishshadmot amora anabemo innebe-rosh ashkelot merorot lamo
Are kepuranut amma disdom puranutehon velaqutehon keam amra machatehon bishin kereshe chevyan vetushlamat obadehon kimrarutehon:
Chamat tanninim yenam verosh petanim akzar
Ha kemarat tanninayya ks puranutehon ukeresh petane chevyan akzerain:
Halo-hv kamus immadi chatum beotzerotay
Hala kol obadehon gelan qodamay genizin leyom dina beotzeray:
Li naqam veshillem leet tamut raglam ki qarob yom edam vechash atidot lamo
Qodamay puranuta vaana ashallem leiddan deyiglun mearahon are qarib yom tebarehon umabba deatid lehon:
Ki-yadin Adonai ammo veal-abadayv yitnecham ki yireh ki-azelat yad veepes atzur veazub
Are yedin Adonai dina deammeh upuranut abdohi tzaddiqayya yitpera are geli qodamohi dibiddan dititqep alehon machat sanea yehon mittaltelin ushebiqin:
Veamar e elohemo tzur chasayu bo
Veyemar an dachalatehon taqqipa dahavo rechitzin beh:
Asher cheleb zebachemo yokelu yishtu yen nesikam yaqumu veyazerukem yehi alekem sitra
Di terab niksatehon havo oklin shatan chamar niskehon yequmun kean visaadunekon yehon alekon magen:
Reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi ani amit vaachayyeh machatzti vaani erpa veen miyyadi matztzil
Chazo kean are ana ana hu velet elah bar minni ana memit umechayye machena veap massena velet min yedi meshezeb:
Ki-essa el-shamayim yadi veamarti chay anoki leolam
Are atqenit bishmayya bet shekinti vaamarit qayyam ana lealemin:
Im-shannoti beraq charbi vetochez bemishpat yadi ashib naqam letzaray velimsanay ashallem
Im al chad teren kechezu barqa missop shemayya vead sop shemayya titgeli charbi vetitqep bedina yedi ateb puranuta lesaneay ulebaale debabay eshallem:
Ashkir chitztzay middam vecharbi tokal basar middam chalal veshibya merosh parot oyeb
Eravve giray middema vecharbi tiqtol beammayya middam qetilan veshibyan leadaa kitrin meresh sanea ubeel debaba:
Harninu goyim ammo ki dam-abadayv yiqqom venaqam yashib letzarayv vekipper admato ammo
Shabbachu ammayya ammeh are puranut abdohi tzaddiqayya yitpera upuranut yateb lesaneohi vikappar al areh veal ammeh:
Vayyabo mosheh vayedabber et-kol-dibre hashshira-hazzot beozne haam hu vehoshea bin-nvn
Vaata msheh umallil yat kol pitgame tushbachta hada qodam amma hu vehoshea bar nun:
Vayekal mosheh ledabber et-kol-haddebarim haelleh el-kol-yisrael
Veshetzi msheh lemallala yat kol pitgamayya haillen im kol yisrael:
Vayyomer alehem simu lebabkem lekol-haddebarim asher anoki meid bakem hayyom asher tetzavvum et-benekem lishmor laasot et-kol-dibre hattora hazzot
Vaamar lehon shavvu libbekon lekol pitgamayya di ana mashed bekon yoma den di tepaqqedunnun yat benekon lemittar lemebad yat kol pitgame orayta hada:
Ki lo-dabar req hu mikkem ki-hv chayyekem ubaddabar hazzeh taariku yamim al-haadama asher attem oberim et-hayyarden shamma lerishtah
Are la pitgam reqa hu minnekon are hu chayyekon ubepitgama haden torekun yomin al ara di attun aberin yat yardena tamman lemeretah:
Vayedabber Adonai el-mosheh beetzem hayyom hazzeh lemor
Umallil Adonai im msheh bikran yoma haden lememar:
Aleh el-har haabarim hazzeh har-nebo asher beeretz moab asher al-pene yerecho ureeh et-eretz kenaan asher ani noten libne yisrael laachuzza
Saq letura daabarae haden tura dinbo di beara demoab di al appe yerecho vachaze yat ara diknaan di ana yaheb libne yisrael leachasana:
Umut bahar asher atta oleh shamma veheasep el-ammeka kaasher-met aharon achika behor hahar vayyeasep el-ammayv
Umut betura di at saleq letamman vetitkenesh leammak kema demit aharn achuk behor tura veitkenish leammeh:
Al asher mealtem bi betok bene yisrael beme-meribat qadesh midbar-tzin al asher lo-qiddashtem oti betok bene yisrael
Al di shaqqartun bememeri bego bene yisrael beme matztzut reqam madbera detzin al di la qaddishtun yati bego bene yisrael:
Ki minneged tireh et-haaretz veshamma lo tabo el-haaretz asher-ani noten libne yisrael
Are miqqobel techeze yat ara uletamman la teul leara di ana yaheb libne yisrael:
Vezot habberaka asher berak mosheh ish haelohim et-bene yisrael lipne moto
Veda birketa di barik msheh nebiyya daAdonai yat bene yisrael qodam moteh:
Vayyomar Adonai missinay ba vezarach misseir lamo hopia mehar paran veata meribbot qodesh mimino esh dat lamo
Vaamar Adonai missinay itgeli vezehor yeqareh misseir itchazi lana itgeli bigburteh mittura deparan veimmeh ribbat qaddishin ketab yammineh miggo eshshata orayta yehab lana:
Ap chobeb ammim kol-qedoshayv beyadeka vehem tukku leragleka yissa middabberoteka
Ap chabbibinnun leshibtayya kol qaddishohi bet yisrael bigbura appeqinnun mimmitzrayim veinnun middabberin techot ananak natelin al memerak:
Tora tzivva-lanu mosheh morasha qehillat yaaqob
Orayta yehab lana msheh mesarah yerutta lekinshat yaaqob:
Vayehi bishurun melek behitassep rashe am yachad shibte yisrael
Vahava beyisrael malka beitkannashut reshe amma kachada shibtayya deyisrael:
Yechi reuben veal-yamot vihi metayv mispar
Yechi reuben lechayye alema umota tinyana la yemut viqabbelun benohi achasantehon beminyanehon:
Vezot lihuda vayyomar shema Adonai qol yehuda veel-ammo tebiennu yadayv rab lo veezer mitztzarayv tihyeh
Veda lihuda vaamar qabbel Adonai tzeloteh dihuda bemippeqeh leaggacha qeraba uleammeh tatebinneh lishlam yedohi yabedan leh puranuta missaneohi vesaid mibbaale debabohi have leh:
Ulelevi amar tummeka veureka leish chasideka asher nissito bemassa teribehu al-me meriba
Ulelevi amar tummayya veurayya albeshta ligbar deishtekach chasida qodamak di nassitohi benisseta vahava shelim bechantohi al me matztzuta veishtekach meheman:
Haomer leabiv uleimmo lo reitiv veet-echayv lo hikkir veet-banav lo yada ki shameru imrateka uberiteka yintzoru
Deal abuhi veal immeh la rachem kad chabu min dina veappe achohi ubenohi la nesib are netaru matterat memerak uqeyamak la ashniyyu:
Yoru mishpateka leyaaqob vetorateka leyisrael yasimu qetora beappeka vekalil al-mizbecheka
Kasherin illen deyallepun dinayk leyaaqob veorayatak leyisrael yeshavvun qetoret busemin qodamak ugemir leraava al madbechak:
Barek Adonai chelo upoal yadayv tirtzeh mechatz motnayim qamayv umesanayv min-yequmun
Barek Adonai niksohi vequrban yedohi teqabbal beraava tebar chartza desaneohi udebaale debabohi dela yequmun:
Lebinyamin amar yedid Adonai yishkon labetach alayv chopep alayv kol-hayyom uben ketepayv shaken
Lebinyamin amar rechima daAdonai yishre lerachetzan alohi yehi magen alohi kol yoma ubeareh tishre shekinta:
Uleyosep amar meboreket Adonai artzo mimmeged shamayim mittal umittehom robetzet tachat
Uleyosep amar mebaraka min qodam Adonai areh abeda magdanin mittalla dishmayya milleella umimmabbue enavan utehomin denagedan mimmaamaqqe ara millera:
Umimmeged tebuot shamesh umimmeged geresh yerachim
Veabeda migdanin vaalalan mibul shimsha veabeda migdanin meresh yerach birach:
Umerosh harre-qedem umimmeged gibot olam
Umeresh turayya bakkirayya umittub raman dila paseqan:
Umimmeged eretz umeloah uretzon shokeni seneh tabota lerosh yosep uleqodqod nezir echayv
Umittub ara umelaah rae leh dishkinteh bishmayya veal msheh itgeli baasana yateyan kol illen leresha deyosep uleganya s" ulegabra parisha daachohi:
Bekor shoro hadar lo veqarne reem qarnayv bahem ammim yenaggach yachdav apse-aretz vehem ribbot eprayim vehem alpe menashsheh
Rabba dibnohi ziva leh ugeburan deitabida leh miqqodam taqepa veruma dileh bigburteh ammayya yiqtel kachada ad seyape ara veinnun ribvata debet eprayim veinnun alpayya debet menashsheh:
Velizbulun amar semach zebulun betzeteka veyissashkar beohaleka
Velizbulun amar chade zebulun bemippeqak laagacha qeraba al baale debabak veyissaskar bimhakak lemebad zimne moadayya birushelem:
Ammim har-yiqrau sham yizbechu zibche-tzedeq ki shepa yammim yinaqu usepune temune chol
Shibtayya deyisrael letur bet maqdesha yitkanneshun tamman yikkesun niksat qudeshin leraava are nikse ammayya yekelun vesima demittamra bechala mitgalya lehon:
Ulegad amar baruk marchib gad kelabi shaken vetarap zeroa ap-qodqod
Ulegad amar berik apte legad keleta share veyiqtol shiltonin im malkin:
Vayyar reshit lo ki-sham chelqat mechoqeq sapun vayyete rashe am tzidqat Adonai asa umishpatayv im-yisrael
Veitqabbel beqadmeta dileh are tamman beachasanteh msheh sapera rabba deyisrael qebir vehu napeq veal beresh amma zakvan qodam Adonai abad vedinohi im yisrael:
Uledan amar dan gur aryeh yezanneq min-habbashan
Uledan amar dan taqqip kegur aryavan areh shateya min nachalayya denagedan min matnan:
Ulenaptali amar naptali seba ratzon umale birkat Adonai yam vedarom yerasha
Ulenaptali amar naptali seba raava umele birkan min qodam Adonai maarab yam ginnosar vedaroma yerat:
Uleasher amar baruk mibbanim asher yehi retzuy echayv vetobel bashshemen raglo
Uleasher amar berik mibbirkat benayya asher yehe raava leachohi veyitrabbe betapnuqe malkin:
Barzel unechoshet minaleka ukeyameka dobeka
Taqqip keparzela unechasha mutabak ukeyome ulematak taqepak:
En kael yeshurun rokeb shamayim beezreka ubegaavato shechaqim
Let elah keelaha deyisrael dishkinteh bishmayya besadak vetaqepeh bishme shemayya:
Meona elohe qedem umittachat zeroot olam vayegaresh mippaneka oyeb vayyomer hashmed
Medor elaha di milleqadmin bememereh mitabed alema vetarik miqqodamak sanea vaamar shetzi:
Vayyishkon yisrael betach badad en yaaqob el-eretz dagan vetirosh ap-shamayv yaarpu tal
Ushera yisrael lerachetzan bilchodohi keen birketa dibarekinnun yaaqob abuhon leara abeda ibur vachamar ap shemayya diillavehon yeshammeshunnun betalla:
Ashreka yisrael mi kamoka am nosha ba-Adonai magen ezreka vaasher-chereb gaavateka veyikkachashu oyebeka lak veatta al-bamotemo tidrok
Tubak yisrael let dikvatak amma depurqaneh min qodam Adonai taqqip besadak udemin qodamohi nitzchan gibbarvatak vikaddebun saneak lak veat al periqat tzavvere malkehon tidrok:
Vayyaal mosheh mearbot moab el-har nebo rosh happisga asher al-pene yerecho vayyarehu Adonai et-kol-haaretz et-haggilad ad-dan
Useleq msheh mimmeshera demoab letura dinbo resh ramata di al appe yerecho veachzeyeh Adonai yat kol ara yat gilad ad dan:
Veet kol-naptali veet-eretz eprayim umenashsheh veet kol-eretz yehuda ad hayyam haacharon
Veyat kol naptali veyat ara deeprayim umenashsheh veyat kol ara dihuda ad yamma maarba:
Veet-hannegeb veet-hakkikkar biqat yerecho ir hattemarim ad-tzoar
Veyat daroma veyat meshera biqata direcho qarta dediqlayya ad tzoar:
Vayyomer Adonai elayv zot haaretz asher nishbati leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob lemor lezaraka ettenenna heritika beeneka veshamma lo taabor
Vaamar Adonai leh da ara di qayyemit leabraham leyitzchaq uleyaaqob lememar libnayk etteninnah achazitak beenayk uletamman la teibbar:
Vayyamot sham mosheh ebed-Adonai beeretz moab al-pi Adonai
Umit tamman msheh abda daAdonai beara demoab al memera daAdonai:
Vayyiqbor oto baggay beeretz moab mul bet peor velo-yada ish et-qeburato ad hayyom hazzeh
Uqebar yateh bechelata beara demoab loqobel bet peor vela yeda enash yat qeburteh ad yoma haden:
Umosheh ben-mea veesrim shana bemoto lo-kahata eno velo-nas lechoh
Umsheh bar mea veasrin shenin kad mit la kehat enohi vela shena ziv yeqara deappohi:
Vayyibku bene yisrael et-mosheh bearebot moab sheloshim yom vayyittemu yeme beki ebel mosheh
Ubeko bene yisrael yat msheh bemesherayya demoab telatin yomin ushelimu yome bekita ebla demsheh:
Vihoshua bin-nvn male ruach chokma ki-samak mosheh et-yadayv alayv vayyishmeu elayv bene-yisrael vayyaasu kaasher tzivva Adonai et-mosheh
Vihoshua bar nun mele ruach chokmeta are semak msheh yat yedohi alohi veqabbilu minneh bene yisrael vaabadu kema di paqqid Adonai yat msheh:
Velo-qam nabi od beyisrael kemosheh asher yedao Adonai panim el-panim
Vela qam nebiyya od beyisrael kemsheh di itgeli leh Adonai appin beappin:
Lekol-haotot vehammopetim asher shelacho Adonai laasot beeretz mitzrayim leparoh ulekol-abadayv ulekol-artzo
Lekol atayya umopetayya di shalecheh Adonai lemebad beara demitzrayim leparoh ulekal abdohi ulekal areh:
Ulekol hayyad hachazaqa ulekol hammora haggadol asher asa mosheh leene kol-yisrael
Ulekol yeda taqqepta ulekol chezevana rabba di abad msheh leene kol yisrael:
